      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-11"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#get-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-content-attribute-6">get
      the content attribute</a>.

  2.  If `contentAttributeValue` is null, then return false.

  3.  Return true.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the given value is false, then run
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-12"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#delete-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:delete-the-content-attribute-4">delete

  2.  If the given value is true, then run
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-13"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-6">set
      the content attribute</a> with the empty string.

  </div>

This corresponds to the rules for <a href="#boolean-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:boolean-attribute">boolean
content attributes</a>.

<div var-scope="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-10">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long"
data-x-internal="idl-long"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:idl-long">long</code></a>,
optionally <span id="limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers"
class="dfn">limited to only non-negative numbers</span> and optionally
with a <span id="default-value" class="dfn">default value</span>
`defaultValue`:

- <div algorithm="">

  The getter steps are:

  1.  Let `contentAttributeValue` be the result of running
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-14"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#get-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-content-attribute-7">get
      the content attribute</a>.

  2.  If `contentAttributeValue` is not null:

          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:rules-for-parsing-integers">integer
          parsing</a> `contentAttributeValue` if the
          <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-11">reflected
          IDL attribute</a> is not
          <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers">limited
          to only non-negative numbers</a>; otherwise the result of
          <a href="#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers">non-negative
          integer parsing</a> `contentAttributeValue`.

      2.  If `parsedValue` is not an error and is within the
          <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long"
          data-x-internal="idl-long"><code
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:idl-long-2">long</code></a>
          range, then return `parsedValue`.

  3.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-12">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> has a <a href="#default-value"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value">default
      value</a>, then return `defaultValue`.

  4.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-13">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-2">limited
      to only non-negative numbers</a>, then return −1.

  5.  Return 0.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-14">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-3">limited
      to only non-negative numbers</a> and the given value is negative,
      then throw an
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:indexsizeerror"
      data-x-internal="indexsizeerror">"<code>IndexSizeError</code>"</a>
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
      data-x-internal="domexception"><code
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

  2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-15"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-7">set
      the content attribute</a> with the given value converted to the
      shortest possible string representing the number as a
      <a href="#valid-integer"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:valid-integer">valid
      integer</a>.

  </div>

</div>

<div var-scope="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-15">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long"
data-x-internal="idl-unsigned-long"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:idl-unsigned-long">unsigned long</code></a>,
optionally
<span id="limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
class="dfn">limited to only positive numbers</span>,
<span id="limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback"
class="dfn">limited to only positive numbers with fallback</span>, or
<span id="clamped-to-the-range" class="dfn">clamped to the range</span>
\[`clampedMin`, `clampedMax`\], and optionally with a
<a href="#default-value"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value-2">default
value</a> `defaultValue`:

- <div algorithm="">

  The getter steps are:

  1.  Let `contentAttributeValue` be the result of running
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-16"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#get-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-content-attribute-8">get
      the content attribute</a>.

  2.  Let `minimum` be 0.

  3.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-16">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero">limited
      to only positive numbers</a> or <a
      href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback">limited
      to only positive numbers with fallback</a>, then set `minimum` to
      1.

  4.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-17">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is <a href="#clamped-to-the-range"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:clamped-to-the-range">clamped
      to the range</a>, then set `minimum` to `clampedMin`.

  5.  Let `maximum` be 2147483647 if the
      <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-18">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is not <a href="#clamped-to-the-range"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:clamped-to-the-range-2">clamped
      to the range</a>; otherwise `clampedMax`.

  6.  If `contentAttributeValue` is not null:

      1.  Let `parsedValue` be the result of
          <a href="#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers-2">non-negative
          integer parsing</a> `contentAttributeValue`.

      2.  If `parsedValue` is not an error and is in the range `minimum`
          to `maximum`, inclusive, then return `parsedValue`.

      3.  If `parsedValue` is not an error and the
          <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-19">reflected
          IDL attribute</a> is <a href="#clamped-to-the-range"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:clamped-to-the-range-3">clamped
          to the range</a>:

          1.  If `parsedValue` is less than `minimum`, then return
              `minimum`.

          2.  Return `maximum`.

  7.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-20">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> has a <a href="#default-value"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value-3">default
      value</a>, then return `defaultValue`.

  8.  Return `minimum`.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-21">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-2">limited
      to only positive numbers</a> and the given value is 0, then throw
      an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:indexsizeerror-2"
      data-x-internal="indexsizeerror">"<code>IndexSizeError</code>"</a>
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
      data-x-internal="domexception"><code
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

  2.  Let `minimum` be 0.

  3.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-22">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-3">limited
      to only positive numbers</a> or <a
      href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback-2">limited
      to only positive numbers with fallback</a>, then set `minimum` to
      1.

  4.  Let `newValue` be `minimum`.

  5.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-23">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> has a <a href="#default-value"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value-4">default
      value</a>, then set `newValue` to `defaultValue`.

  6.  If the given value is in the range `minimum` to 2147483647,
      inclusive, then set `newValue` to it.

  7.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-17"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-8">set
      the content attribute</a> with `newValue` converted to the
      shortest possible string representing the number as a
      <a href="#valid-non-negative-integer"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:valid-non-negative-integer">valid
      non-negative integer</a>.

  </div>

  <a href="#clamped-to-the-range"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:clamped-to-the-range-4">Clamped
  to the range</a> has no effect on the setter steps.

</div>

<div var-scope="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-24">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double"
data-x-internal="idl-double"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:idl-double">double</code></a>,
optionally

numbers</a> and optionally with a <a href="#default-value"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value-5">default
value</a> `defaultValue`:

- <div algorithm="">

  The getter steps are:

  1.  Let `contentAttributeValue` be the result of running
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-18"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s

          number parsing</a> `contentAttributeValue`.

      2.  If `parsedValue` is not an error and is greater than 0, then

      3.  If `parsedValue` is not an error and the

          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-25">reflected
          IDL attribute</a> is not
          <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-4">limited
          to only positive numbers</a>, then return `parsedValue`.

  3.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-26">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> has a <a href="#default-value"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:default-value-6">default
      value</a>, then return `defaultValue`.

  4.  Return 0.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-27">reflected
      IDL attribute</a> is
      <a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-5">limited
      to only positive numbers</a> and the given value is not greater
      than 0, then return.

  2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-19"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-9">set
      the content attribute</a> with the given value, converted to the
      <a href="#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number">best
      representation of the number as a floating-point number</a>.

  </div>

</div>

The values Infinity and Not-a-Number (NaN) values throw an exception on
setting, as defined in Web IDL. [\[WEBIDL\]](#refsWEBIDL)

<div algorithm="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-28">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-domtokenlist"
data-x-internal="domtokenlist"><code

object whose associated element is

content attribute name</a>. Specification authors cannot reflect IDL
attributes of this type on [`ElementInternals`](#elementinternals).

</div>

<div var-scope="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-29">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type `T``?`, where `T` is either
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:element">Element</code></a>
or an interface that inherits from
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:element-2">Element</code></a>,
then with `attr` being the <a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-12">reflected
content attribute name</a>:

- Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-9">reflected
  target</a> has an <span id="explicitly-set-attr-element"
  class="dfn">explicitly set `attr`-element</span>, which is a weak
  reference to an element or null. It is initially null.

- <div algorithm="">

  Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-10">reflected
  target</a> `reflectedTarget` has a <span id="attr-associated-element"
  class="dfn" dfn-for="Element,ElementInternals" export="">get the
  `attr`-associated element</span> algorithm, that runs these steps:

  1.  Let `element` be the result of running `reflectedTarget`'s
      <a href="#get-the-element"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-element-6">get
      the element</a>.

  2.  Let `contentAttributeValue` be the result of running
      `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#get-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-content-attribute-10">get
      the content attribute</a>.

  3.  If `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-element</a> is not null:

      1.  If `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element-2">explicitly
          set <var>attr</var>-element</a> is a
          <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:descendant"
          data-x-internal="descendant">descendant</a> of any of
          `element`'s
          <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-ancestor"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-shadow-including-ancestor"
          data-x-internal="concept-shadow-including-ancestor">shadow-including
          ancestors</a>, then return `reflectedTarget`'s
          <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element-3">explicitly
          set <var>attr</var>-element</a>.

      2.  Return null.

  4.  Otherwise, if `contentAttributeValue` is not null, return the
      first element `candidate`, in
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:tree-order"
      data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>, that meets the
      following criteria:

      - `candidate`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
        id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:root"
        data-x-internal="root">root</a> is the same as `element`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
        id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:root-2"
        data-x-internal="root">root</a>;

      - `candidate`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
        id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-id"
        data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> is `contentAttributeValue`;
        and

      - `candidate` <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements"
        id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:implements"
        data-x-internal="implements">implements</a> `T`.

      If no such element exists, then return null.

  5.  Return null.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The getter steps are to return the result of running
  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-21"
  data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#attr-associated-element"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:attr-associated-element">get
  the <var>attr</var>-associated element</a>.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the given value is null, then:

      1.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-22"
          data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
          <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element-4">explicitly
          set <var>attr</var>-element</a> to null.

      2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-23"
          data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
          <a href="#delete-the-content-attribute"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:delete-the-content-attribute-5">delete
          the content attribute</a>.

      3.  Return.

  2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-24"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-10">set
      the content attribute</a> with the empty string.

  3.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-25"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element-5">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-element</a> to a weak reference to the given
      value.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  For element <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-11">reflected
  targets</a> only: the following <a
  href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-element-attributes-change-ext"
  data-x-internal="concept-element-attributes-change-ext">attribute change
  steps</a>, given `element`, `localName`, `oldValue`, `value`, and
  `namespace`, are used to synchronize between the content attribute and
  the IDL attribute:

  1.  If `localName` is not `attr` or `namespace` is not null, then
      return.

  2.  Set `element`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-element-6">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-element</a> to null.

  </div>

</div>

<a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-30">Reflected
IDL attributes</a> of this type are strongly encouraged to have their
identifier end in "`Element`" for consistency.

<div var-scope="">

If a <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-31">reflected
IDL attribute</a> has the type `FrozenArray<``T``>?`, where `T` is
either <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:element-3">Element</code></a>
or an interface that inherits from
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:element-4">Element</code></a>,
then with `attr` being the <a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-13">reflected
content attribute name</a>:

- Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-12">reflected
  target</a> has an <span id="explicitly-set-attr-elements"
  class="dfn">explicitly set `attr`-elements</span>, which is either a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list"
  data-x-internal="list">list</a> of weak references to elements or
  null. It is initially null.

- Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-13">reflected
  target</a> has a <span id="cached-attr-associated-elements"
  class="dfn">cached `attr`-associated elements</span>, which is a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-2"
  data-x-internal="list">list</a> of elements. It is initially « ».

- Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-14">reflected
  target</a> has a <span id="cached-attr-associated-elements-object"
  class="dfn">cached `attr`-associated elements object</span>, which is
  a `FrozenArray<``T``>?`. It is initially null.

- <div algorithm="">

  Its <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-15">reflected
  target</a> `reflectedTarget` has a <span id="attr-associated-elements"
  class="dfn" dfn-for="Element,ElementInternals" export="">get the
  `attr`-associated elements</span> algorithm, which runs these steps:

  1.  Let `elements` be an empty
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-3"
      data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

  2.  Let `element` be the result of running `reflectedTarget`'s
      <a href="#get-the-element"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-element-7">get
      the element</a>.

  3.  If `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-elements">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-elements</a> is not null:

      1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-iterate"
          data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `attrElement` in
          `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-elements-2">explicitly
          set <var>attr</var>-elements</a>:

          1.  If `attrElement` is not a
              <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:descendant-2"
              data-x-internal="descendant">descendant</a> of any of
              `element`'s
              <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-ancestor"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-shadow-including-ancestor-2"
              data-x-internal="concept-shadow-including-ancestor">shadow-including
              ancestors</a>, then
              <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:continue"
              data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

          2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-append"
              data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `attrElement` to
              `elements`.

  4.  Otherwise:

      1.  Let `contentAttributeValue` be the result of running
          `reflectedTarget`'s <a href="#get-the-content-attribute"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:get-the-content-attribute-11">get
          the content attribute</a>.

      2.  If `contentAttributeValue` is null, then return null.

      3.  Let `tokens` be `contentAttributeValue`,
          <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:split-a-string-on-spaces"
          data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">split on ASCII whitespace</a>.

      4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-iterate-2"
          data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `id` of `tokens`:

          1.  Let `candidate` be the first element, in
              <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:tree-order-2"
              data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>, that meets
              the following criteria:

              - `candidate`'s
                <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
                id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:root-3"
                data-x-internal="root">root</a> is the same as
                `element`'s
                <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
                id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:root-4"
                data-x-internal="root">root</a>;

              - `candidate`'s
                <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
                id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-id-2"
                data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> is `id`; and

              - `candidate`
                <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#implements"
                id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:implements-2"
                data-x-internal="implements">implements</a> `T`.

              If no such element exists, then
              <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:continue-2"
              data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

          2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
              id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-append-2"
              data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `candidate` to
              `elements`.

  5.  Return `elements`.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  The getter steps are:

  1.  Let `elements` be the result of running
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-26"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#attr-associated-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:attr-associated-elements">get
      the <var>attr</var>-associated elements</a>.

  2.  If the contents of `elements` is equal to the contents of
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-27"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:cached-attr-associated-elements">cached
      <var>attr</var>-associated elements</a>, then return
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-28"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements-object"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:cached-attr-associated-elements-object">cached
      <var>attr</var>-associated elements object</a>.

  3.  Let `elementsAsFrozenArray` be `elements`,
      <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-idl-convert"
      data-x-internal="concept-idl-convert">converted</a> to a
      `FrozenArray<``T``>?`.

  4.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-29"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:cached-attr-associated-elements-2">cached
      <var>attr</var>-associated elements</a> to `elements`.

  5.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-30"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements-object"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:cached-attr-associated-elements-object-2">cached
      <var>attr</var>-associated elements object</a> to
      `elementsAsFrozenArray`.

  6.  Return `elementsAsFrozenArray`.

  </div>

  This extra caching layer is necessary to preserve the invariant that
  `element.reflectedElements === element.reflectedElements`.

- <div algorithm="">

  The setter steps are:

  1.  If the given value is null:

      1.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-31"
          data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
          <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-elements-3">explicitly
          set <var>attr</var>-elements</a> to null.

      2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-32"
          data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
          <a href="#delete-the-content-attribute"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:delete-the-content-attribute-6">delete
          the content attribute</a>.

      3.  Return.

  2.  Run <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-33"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#set-the-content-attribute"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:set-the-content-attribute-11">set
      the content attribute</a> with the empty string.

  3.  Let `elements` be an empty
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-4"
      data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

  4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-iterate-3"
      data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `element` in the given
      value:

      1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
          id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:list-append-3"
          data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> a weak reference to
          `element` to `elements`.

  5.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:this-34"
      data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
      <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-elements-4">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-elements</a> to `elements`.

  </div>

- <div algorithm="">

  For element <a href="#reflected-target"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-target-16">reflected
  targets</a> only: the following <a
  href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext"
  id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:concept-element-attributes-change-ext-2"
  data-x-internal="concept-element-attributes-change-ext">attribute change
  steps</a>, given `element`, `localName`, `oldValue`, `value`, and
  `namespace`, are used to synchronize between the content attribute and
  the IDL attribute:

  1.  If `localName` is not `attr` or `namespace` is not null, then
      return.

  2.  Set `element`'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
      id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:explicitly-set-attr-elements-5">explicitly
      set <var>attr</var>-elements</a> to null.

  </div>

</div>

<a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="reflecting-content-attributes-in-idl-attributes:reflected-idl-attribute-32">Reflected
IDL attributes</a> of this type are strongly encouraged to have their
identifier end in "`Elements`" for consistency.

#### <span class="secno">2.6.2</span> Using reflect via IDL extended attributes<a href="#using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes"
class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect">Reflection</a>
can be used from IDL through
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attributes</a>.
<span id="xattr-reflect" class="dfn" dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="Reflect">`[Reflect]`</span>, <span id="xattr-reflectsetter"
class="dfn" dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectSetter">`[ReflectSetter]`</span>, <span id="xattr-reflecturl"
class="dfn" dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectURL">`[ReflectURL]`</span>,
<span id="xattr-reflectnonnegative" class="dfn"
dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectNonNegative">`[ReflectNonNegative]`</span>,
<span id="xattr-reflectpositive" class="dfn"
dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectPositive">`[ReflectPositive]`</span>, and
<span id="xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback" class="dfn"
dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectPositiveWithFallback">`[ReflectPositiveWithFallback]`</span>
all trigger <a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-2">reflection</a>.
These must either take no arguments, or take a string; they must not
appear on anything other than an interface member attribute; and only
one of these can be used at a time.

For one of these primary reflection
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-2"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attributes</a>, its
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name">reflected
content attribute name</a> is the string value it takes, if one is
provided; otherwise it is the IDL attribute name
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:converted-to-ascii-lowercase"
data-x-internal="converted-to-ascii-lowercase">converted to ASCII
lowercase</a>.

IDL attributes with the [`[Reflect]`](#xattr-reflect)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-3"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-3">reflect</a>
[`[Reflect]`](#xattr-reflect)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-2">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

IDL attributes with the [`[ReflectSetter]`](#xattr-reflectsetter)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-4"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> on setting
must <a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-4">reflect</a>
[`[ReflectSetter]`](#xattr-reflectsetter)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-3">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

The [`[ReflectURL]`](#xattr-reflecturl)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-5"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must only
appear on attributes with a type of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-USVString"
data-x-internal="idl-usvstring"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-usvstring">USVString</code></a>.

IDL attributes with the [`[ReflectURL]`](#xattr-reflecturl)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-6"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-5">reflect</a>,
<a href="#treated-as-a-url"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:treated-as-a-url">as a
URL</a>, [`[ReflectURL]`](#xattr-reflecturl)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-4">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

The [`[ReflectNonNegative]`](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-7"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must only
appear on attributes with a type of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long"
data-x-internal="idl-long"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-long">long</code></a>.

IDL attributes with the
[`[ReflectNonNegative]`](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-8"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-6">reflect</a>,
<a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers">limited
to only non-negative numbers</a>,
[`[ReflectNonNegative]`](#xattr-reflectnonnegative)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-5">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

The [`[ReflectPositive]`](#xattr-reflectpositive) and
[`[ReflectPositiveWithFallback]`](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-9"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attributes</a> must only
appear on attributes with a type of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double"
data-x-internal="idl-double"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-double">double</code></a>
or <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long"
data-x-internal="idl-unsigned-long"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-unsigned-long">unsigned long</code></a>.

IDL attributes with the [`[ReflectPositive]`](#xattr-reflectpositive)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-10"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-7">reflect</a>,
<a href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero">limited
to only positive numbers</a>,
[`[ReflectPositive]`](#xattr-reflectpositive)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-6">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

IDL attributes with the
[`[ReflectPositiveWithFallback]`](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-11"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-8">reflect</a>, <a
href="#limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:limited-to-only-non-negative-numbers-greater-than-zero-with-fallback">limited
to only positive numbers with fallback</a>,
[`[ReflectPositiveWithFallback]`](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback)'s
<a href="#reflected-content-attribute-name"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflected-content-attribute-name-7">reflected
content attribute name</a>.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

To supplement the above
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-12"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attributes</a> we also
introduce <span id="xattr-reflectrange" class="dfn"
dfn-type="extended-attribute" lt="ReflectRange">`[ReflectRange]`</span>,
and <span id="xattr-reflectdefault" class="dfn"
dfn-type="extended-attribute"
lt="ReflectDefault">`[ReflectDefault]`</span>. These augment how
<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:reflect-9">reflection</a>
works and also must only appear on interface member attributes.

The [`[ReflectRange]`](#xattr-reflectrange)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-13"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must take an
integer list limited to two values. It must only be used on attributes
with a type of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long"
data-x-internal="idl-unsigned-long"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-unsigned-long-2">unsigned long</code></a>.
Additionally, it must also only appear alongside
[`[Reflect]`](#xattr-reflect).

IDL attributes with the [`[ReflectRange]`](#xattr-reflectrange)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-14"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> are
<a href="#clamped-to-the-range"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:clamped-to-the-range">clamped
to the range</a> \[`clampedMin`, `clampedMax`\] where `clampedMin` is
the first, and `clampedMax` is the second argument to the list provided
to [`[ReflectRange]`](#xattr-reflectrange).

The [`[ReflectDefault]`](#xattr-reflectdefault)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-15"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> must only be
used on attributes with a type of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double"
data-x-internal="idl-double"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-double-2">double</code></a>,
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-long"
data-x-internal="idl-long"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-long-2">long</code></a>,
or <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-unsigned-long"
data-x-internal="idl-unsigned-long"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-unsigned-long-3">unsigned long</code></a>.
When used on an attribute of type
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-double"
data-x-internal="idl-double"><code
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:idl-double-3">double</code></a>,
it must take a decimal; otherwise it must take an integer. Additionally,
it must also only appear alongside [`[Reflect]`](#xattr-reflect),
[`[ReflectNonNegative]`](#xattr-reflectnonnegative),
[`[ReflectPositive]`](#xattr-reflectpositive), or
[`[ReflectPositiveWithFallback]`](#xattr-reflectpositivewithfallback).

IDL attributes with the [`[ReflectDefault]`](#xattr-reflectdefault)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-extended-attribute"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:extended-attribute-16"
data-x-internal="extended-attribute">extended attribute</a> have a
<a href="#default-value"
id="using-reflect-via-idl-extended-attributes:default-value">default
value</a> provided by the argument provided to
[`[ReflectDefault]`](#xattr-reflectdefault).

#### <span class="secno">2.6.3</span> Using reflect in specifications<a href="#using-reflect-in-specifications" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#reflect"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflect">Reflection</a> is primarily
about improving web developer ergonomics by giving them typed access to
content attributes through <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-idl-attribute">reflected
IDL attributes</a>. The ultimate source of truth, which the web platform
builds upon, is the content attributes themselves. That is,
specification authors must not use the
<a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-idl-attribute-2">reflected
IDL attribute</a> getter or setter steps, but instead must use the
content attribute presence and value. (Or an abstraction on top, such as
the state of an <a href="#enumerated-attribute"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:enumerated-attribute">enumerated
attribute</a>.)

Two important exceptions to this are <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-idl-attribute-3">reflected
IDL attributes</a> whose type is one of the following:

- `T``?`, where `T` is either
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
  data-x-internal="element"><code
  id="using-reflect-in-specifications:element">Element</code></a> or an
  interface that inherits from
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
  data-x-internal="element"><code
  id="using-reflect-in-specifications:element-2">Element</code></a>

- `FrozenArray<``T``>?`, where `T` is either
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
  data-x-internal="element"><code
  id="using-reflect-in-specifications:element-3">Element</code></a> or
  an interface that inherits from
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
  data-x-internal="element"><code
  id="using-reflect-in-specifications:element-4">Element</code></a>

For those, specification authors must use the
<a href="#reflected-target"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-target">reflected
target</a>'s <a href="#attr-associated-element"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:attr-associated-element">get the
<var>attr</var>-associated element</a> and
<a href="#attr-associated-elements"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:attr-associated-elements">get the
<var>attr</var>-associated elements</a>, respectively. The content
attribute presence and value must not be used as they cannot be fully
synchronized with the <a href="#reflected-idl-attribute"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-idl-attribute-4">reflected
IDL attribute</a>.

A <a href="#reflected-target"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:reflected-target-2">reflected
target</a>'s <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-element"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:explicitly-set-attr-element">explicitly
set <var>attr</var>-element</a>, <a href="#explicitly-set-attr-elements"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:explicitly-set-attr-elements">explicitly
set <var>attr</var>-elements</a>,
<a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:cached-attr-associated-elements">cached
<var>attr</var>-associated elements</a>, and
<a href="#cached-attr-associated-elements-object"
id="using-reflect-in-specifications:cached-attr-associated-elements-object">cached
<var>attr</var>-associated elements object</a> are to be treated as
internal implementation details and not to be built upon.

#### <span class="secno">2.6.4</span> Collections<a href="#collections" class="self-link"></a>

The [`HTMLFormControlsCollection`](#htmlformcontrolscollection) and
[`HTMLOptionsCollection`](#htmloptionscollection) interfaces are
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection"
id="collections:concept-collection"
data-x-internal="concept-collection">collections</a> derived from the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
id="collections:htmlcollection">HTMLCollection</code></a> interface. The
[`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) interface is a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection"
id="collections:concept-collection-2"
data-x-internal="concept-collection">collection</a>, but is not so
derived.

##### <span class="secno">2.6.4.1</span> The [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) interface<a href="#the-htmlallcollection-interface" class="self-link"></a>

The [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) interface is used for the
legacy [`document.all`](#dom-document-all) attribute. It operates
similarly to
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:htmlcollection">HTMLCollection</code></a>;
the main differences are that it allows a staggering variety of
different (ab)uses of its methods to all end up returning something, and
that it can be called as a function as an alternative to property
access.

All [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) objects are rooted at a
[`Document`](#document) and have a filter that matches all elements, so
the elements
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:represented-by-the-collection"
data-x-internal="represented-by-the-collection">represented by the
collection</a> of an [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) object
consist of all the descendant elements of the root
[`Document`](#document).

Objects that implement the [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection)
interface are
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:legacy-platform-object"
data-x-internal="legacy-platform-object">legacy platform objects</a>
with an additional \[\[Call\]\] internal method described in the
[section below](#HTMLAllCollection-call). They also have an
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-IsHTMLDDA-internal-slot"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:ishtmldda"
data-x-internal="ishtmldda">[[IsHTMLDDA]]</a> internal slot.

<div class="note">

Objects that implement the [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection)
interface have several unusual behaviors, due of the fact that they have
an <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-IsHTMLDDA-internal-slot"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:ishtmldda-2"
data-x-internal="ishtmldda">[[IsHTMLDDA]]</a> internal slot:

- The <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-toboolean"
  id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:js-toboolean"
  data-x-internal="js-toboolean">ToBoolean</a> abstract operation in
  JavaScript returns false when given objects implementing the
  [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) interface.

- The <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-islooselyequal"
  id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:js-abstract-equality"
  data-x-internal="js-abstract-equality">IsLooselyEqual</a> abstract
  operation, when given objects implementing the
  [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) interface, returns true when
  compared to the `undefined` and `null` values. (Comparisons using the
  <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isstrictlyequal"
  id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:js-strict-equality"
  data-x-internal="js-strict-equality">IsStrictlyEqual</a> abstract
  operation, and IsLooselyEqual comparisons to other values such as
  strings or objects, are unaffected.)

- The <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-typeof-operator"
  data-x-internal="js-typeof"><code
  id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:js-typeof">typeof</code></a>
  operator in JavaScript returns the string `"undefined"` when applied
  to objects implementing the [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection)
  interface.

These special behaviors are motivated by a desire for compatibility with
two classes of legacy content: one that uses the presence of
[`document.all`](#dom-document-all) as a way to detect legacy user
agents, and one that only supports those legacy user agents and uses the
[`document.all`](#dom-document-all) object without testing for its
presence first. [\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#refsJAVASCRIPT)

</div>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties]
interface HTMLAllCollection {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  getter Element (unsigned long index);
  getter (HTMLCollection or Element)? namedItem(DOMString name);
  (HTMLCollection or Element)? item(optional DOMString nameOrIndex);

  // Note: HTMLAllCollection objects have a custom [[Call]] internal method and an [[IsHTMLDDA]] internal slot.
};
```

<div algorithm="">

The object's
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:supported-property-indices"
data-x-internal="supported-property-indices">supported property
indices</a> are as defined for
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:htmlcollection-4">HTMLCollection</code></a>
objects.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:supported-property-names"
data-x-internal="supported-property-names">supported property names</a>
consist of the non-empty values of all the [`id`](#the-id-attribute)
attributes of all the elements
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:represented-by-the-collection-2"
data-x-internal="represented-by-the-collection">represented by the
collection</a>, and the non-empty values of all the `name` attributes of
all the <a href="#all-named-elements"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:all-named-elements">"all"-named
elements</a>
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:represented-by-the-collection-3"
data-x-internal="represented-by-the-collection">represented by the
collection</a>, in
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:tree-order"
data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>, ignoring later duplicates,
with the [`id`](#the-id-attribute) of an element preceding its `name` if
it contributes both, they differ from each other, and neither is the
duplicate of an earlier entry.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-htmlallcollection-length" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLAllCollection" dfn-type="attribute">`length`</span> getter
steps are to return the number of nodes
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:represented-by-the-collection-4"
data-x-internal="represented-by-the-collection">represented by the
collection</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The indexed property getter must return the result of
<a href="#concept-get-all-indexed"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-get-all-indexed">getting the
"all"-indexed element</a> from
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a> given the passed index.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-htmlallcollection-nameditem" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLAllCollection"
dfn-type="method">`namedItem(``name``)`</span> method steps are to
return the result of <a href="#concept-get-all-named"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-get-all-named">getting the
"all"-named element(s)</a> from
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:this-2"
data-x-internal="this">this</a> given `name`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-htmlallcollection-item" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLAllCollection"
dfn-type="method">`item(``nameOrIndex``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  If `nameOrIndex` was not provided, return null.

2.  Return the result of <a href="#concept-get-all-indexed-or-named"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-get-all-indexed-or-named">getting
    the "all"-indexed or named element(s)</a> from
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>, given `nameOrIndex`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The following elements are <span id="all-named-elements"
class="dfn">"all"-named elements</span>: [`a`](#the-a-element),
[`button`](#the-button-element), [`embed`](#the-embed-element),
[`form`](#the-form-element), [`frame`](#frame), [`frameset`](#frameset),
[`iframe`](#the-iframe-element), [`img`](#the-img-element),
[`input`](#the-input-element), [`map`](#the-map-element),
[`meta`](#the-meta-element), [`object`](#the-object-element),
[`select`](#the-select-element), and [`textarea`](#the-textarea-element)

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-get-all-indexed" class="dfn">get the "all"-indexed
element</span> from an [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection)
`collection` given an index `index`, return the `index`<sup>th</sup>
element in `collection`, or null if there is no such
`index`<sup>th</sup> element.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-get-all-named" class="dfn">get the "all"-named
element(s)</span> from an [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection)
`collection` given a name `name`, perform the following steps:

1.  If `name` is the empty string, return null.

2.  Let `subCollection` be an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
    data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:htmlcollection-5">HTMLCollection</code></a>
    object rooted at the same [`Document`](#document) as `collection`,
    whose filter matches only elements that are either:

    - <a href="#all-named-elements"
      id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:all-named-elements-2">"all"-named
      elements</a> with a `name` attribute equal to `name`, or

    - elements with an <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
      id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-id"
      data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> equal to `name`.

3.  If there is exactly one element in `subCollection`, then return that
    element.

4.  Otherwise, if `subCollection` is empty, return null.

5.  Otherwise, return `subCollection`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-get-all-indexed-or-named" class="dfn">get the
"all"-indexed or named element(s)</span> from an
[`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) `collection` given
`nameOrIndex`:

1.  If `nameOrIndex`,
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-idl-convert"
    data-x-internal="concept-idl-convert">converted</a> to a JavaScript
    String value, is an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:array-index-property-name"
    data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
    name</a>, return the result of <a href="#concept-get-all-indexed"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-get-all-indexed-2">getting
    the "all"-indexed element</a> from `collection` given the number
    represented by `nameOrIndex`.

2.  Return the result of <a href="#concept-get-all-named"
    id="the-htmlallcollection-interface:concept-get-all-named-2">getting the
    "all"-named element(s)</a> from `collection` given `nameOrIndex`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">2.6.4.1.1</span> \[\[Call\]\] ( `thisArgument`, `argumentsList` )<a href="#HTMLAllCollection-call" class="self-link"></a>

1.  If `argumentsList`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="HTMLAllCollection-call:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> is zero, or if
    `argumentsList`\[0\] is undefined, return null.

2.  Let `nameOrIndex` be the result of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping"
    id="HTMLAllCollection-call:concept-idl-convert"
    data-x-internal="concept-idl-convert">converting</a>
    `argumentsList`\[0\] to a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-DOMString"
    data-x-internal="idl-domstring"><code
    id="HTMLAllCollection-call:idl-domstring">DOMString</code></a>.

3.  Let `result` be the result of
    <a href="#concept-get-all-indexed-or-named"
    id="HTMLAllCollection-call:concept-get-all-indexed-or-named">getting the
    "all"-indexed or named element(s)</a> from this
    [`HTMLAllCollection`](#htmlallcollection) given `nameOrIndex`.

4.  Return the result of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping"
    id="HTMLAllCollection-call:concept-idl-convert-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-idl-convert">converting</a> `result` to an
    ECMAScript value.

The `thisArgument` is ignored, and thus code such as
`Function.prototype.call.call(document.all, null, "x")` will still
search for elements. (`document.all.call` does not exist, since
`document.all` does not inherit from `Function.prototype`.)

</div>

##### <span class="secno">2.6.4.2</span> The [`HTMLFormControlsCollection`](#htmlformcontrolscollection) interface<a href="#the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface"
class="self-link"></a>

The [`HTMLFormControlsCollection`](#htmlformcontrolscollection)
interface is used for
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-collection"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:concept-collection"
data-x-internal="concept-collection">collections</a> of
<a href="#category-listed"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:category-listed">listed
elements</a> in [`form`](#the-form-element) elements.

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[HTMLFormControlsCollection](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLFormControlsCollection "The HTMLFormControlsCollection interface represents a collection of HTML form control elements, returned by the HTMLFormElement interface's elements property.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

``` idl

interface HTMLFormControlsCollection : HTMLCollection {

  attribute DOMString value;
```

`collection``.`<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-length"
id="dom-htmlcollection-length-dev"
data-x-internal="dom-htmlcollection-length"><code>length</code></a>

id="dom-htmlcollection-item-dev"
data-x-internal="dom-htmlcollection-item"><code>item</code></a>`(``index``)`

Returns the item at index `index` in `collection`. The items are sorted
in <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:tree-order"
data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

`element`` = ``collection``.`<a href="#dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem"
id="dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem-dev"><code>namedItem</code></a>`(``name``)`

`radioNodeList`` = ``collection``.`<a href="#dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem-2"><code>namedItem</code></a>`(``name``)`

`element`` = ``collection``[``name``]`

`radioNodeList`` = ``collection``[``name``]`

Returns the item with <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:concept-id"
data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> or [`name`](#attr-fe-name) `name`
from `collection`.

If there are multiple matching items, then a
[`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) object containing all those elements
is returned.

`radioNodeList``.`<a href="#dom-radionodelist-value"
id="dom-radionodelist-value-dev"><code>value</code></a>

Returns the value of the first checked radio button represented by
`radioNodeList`.

`radioNodeList``.`<a href="#dom-radionodelist-value"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:dom-radionodelist-value-2"><code>value</code></a>` = ``value`

Checks the first radio button represented by `radioNodeList` that has
value `value`.

<div algorithm="">

The object's
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:supported-property-indices"
data-x-internal="supported-property-indices">supported property
indices</a> are as defined for
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:htmlcollection-2">HTMLCollection</code></a>
objects.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:supported-property-names"
data-x-internal="supported-property-names">supported property names</a>
consist of the non-empty values of all the [`id`](#the-id-attribute) and
[`name`](#attr-fe-name) attributes of all the elements
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:represented-by-the-collection"
data-x-internal="represented-by-the-collection">represented by the
collection</a>, in
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:tree-order-2"
data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>, ignoring later duplicates,
with the [`id`](#the-id-attribute) of an element preceding its
[`name`](#attr-fe-name) if it contributes both, they differ from each
other, and neither is the duplicate of an earlier entry.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-htmlformcontrolscollection-nameditem" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLFormControlsCollection"
dfn-type="method">`namedItem(``name``)`</span> method must act according
to the following algorithm:

1.  If `name` is the empty string, return null and stop the algorithm.
2.  If, at the time the method is called, there is exactly one node in
    the collection that has either an [`id`](#the-id-attribute)
    attribute or a [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute equal to `name`,
    then return that node and stop the algorithm.
3.  Otherwise, if there are no nodes in the collection that have either
    an [`id`](#the-id-attribute) attribute or a [`name`](#attr-fe-name)
    attribute equal to `name`, then return null and stop the algorithm.
4.  Otherwise, create a new [`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) object
    representing a <a href="#live"
    id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:live">live</a> view of
    the [`HTMLFormControlsCollection`](#htmlformcontrolscollection)
    object, further filtered so that the only nodes in the
    [`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) object are those that have either
    an [`id`](#the-id-attribute) attribute or a [`name`](#attr-fe-name)
    attribute equal to `name`. The nodes in the
    [`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) object must be sorted in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:tree-order-3"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.
5.  Return that [`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) object.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Members of the [`RadioNodeList`](#radionodelist) interface inherited
from the <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist"
data-x-internal="nodelist"><code
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:nodelist-2">NodeList</code></a>
interface must behave as they would on a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist"
data-x-internal="nodelist"><code
id="the-htmlformcontrolscollection-interface:nodelist-3">NodeList</code></a>
object.

[RadioNodeList/value](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/RadioNodeList/value "If the underlying element collection contains radio buttons, the RadioNodeList.value property represents the checked radio button. On retrieving the value property, the value of the currently checked radio button is returned as a string. If the collection does not contain any radio buttons or none of the radio buttons in the collection is in checked state, the empty string is returned. On setting the value property, the first radio button input element whose value property is equal to the new value will be set to checked.")
