##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.1</span> Processing the [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute<a href="#processing-the-media-attribute" class="self-link"></a>

If the link is a <a href="#hyperlink"
id="processing-the-media-attribute:hyperlink">hyperlink</a> then the
[`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute is purely advisory, and describes
for which media the document in question was designed.

However, if the link is an <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-media-attribute:external-resource-link">external
resource link</a>, then the [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute is
prescriptive. The user agent must apply the external resource when the
[`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute's value
<a href="#matches-the-environment"
id="processing-the-media-attribute:matches-the-environment">matches the
environment</a> and the other relevant conditions apply, and must not
apply it otherwise.

The default, if the [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute is omitted, is
"`all`", meaning that by default links apply to all media.

The external resource might have further restrictions defined within
that limit its applicability. For example, a CSS style sheet might have
some `@media` blocks. This specification does not override such further
restrictions or requirements.

##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.2</span> Processing the [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute<a href="#processing-the-type-attribute" class="self-link"></a>

If the [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute is present, then the user
agent must assume that the resource is of the given type (even if that
is not a <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:valid-mime-type-string"
data-x-internal="valid-mime-type-string">valid MIME type string</a>,
e.g. the empty string). If the attribute is omitted, but the
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:external-resource-link">external
resource link</a> type has a default type defined, then the user agent
must assume that the resource is of that type. If the UA does not
support the given <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:mime-type"
data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a> for the given link
relationship, then the UA should not
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">fetch
and process the linked resource</a>; if the UA does support the given
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:mime-type-2"
data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a> for the given link
relationship, then the UA should
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-2">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> at the appropriate time as specified
for the <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:external-resource-link-2">external
resource link</a>'s particular type. If the attribute is omitted, and
the <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:external-resource-link-3">external
resource link</a> type does not have a default type defined, but the
user agent would <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-3">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> if the type was known and supported,
then the user agent should
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-4">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> under the assumption that it will be
supported.

User agents must not consider the [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute
authoritative — upon fetching the resource, user agents must not use the
[`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute to determine its actual type. Only
the actual type (as defined in the next paragraph) is used to determine
whether to *apply* the resource, not the aforementioned assumed type.

If the <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:external-resource-link-4">external
resource link</a> type defines rules for processing the resource's
<a href="#content-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type">Content-Type
metadata</a>, then those rules apply. Otherwise, if the resource is
expected to be an image, user agents may apply the <a
href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-images-specifically"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-sniffing:-image"
data-x-internal="content-type-sniffing:-image">image sniffing rules</a>,
with the `official type` being the type determined from the resource's
<a href="#content-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-2">Content-Type
metadata</a>, and use the resulting
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-sniffing-2"
data-x-internal="content-type-sniffing-2">computed type of the
resource</a> as if it was the actual type. Otherwise, if neither of
these conditions apply or if the user agent opts not to apply the image
sniffing rules, then the user agent must use the resource's
<a href="#content-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-3">Content-Type
metadata</a> to determine the type of the resource. If there is no type
metadata, but the <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:external-resource-link-5">external
resource link</a> type has a default type defined, then the user agent
must assume that the resource is of that type.

The [`stylesheet`](#link-type-stylesheet) link type defines rules for
processing the resource's <a href="#content-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-4">Content-Type
metadata</a>.

Once the user agent has established the type of the resource, the user
agent must apply the resource if it is of a supported type and the other
relevant conditions apply, and must ignore the resource otherwise.

<div class="example">

If a document contains style sheet links labeled as follows:

``` html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="A" type="text/plain">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="B" type="text/css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="C">
```

...then a compliant UA that supported only CSS style sheets would fetch
the B and C files, and skip the A file (since
<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3"
data-x-internal="text/plain"><code
id="processing-the-type-attribute:text/plain">text/plain</code></a> is
not the <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:mime-type-3"
data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a> for CSS style sheets).

For files B and C, it would then check the actual types returned by the
server. For those that are sent as [`text/css`](#text/css), it would
apply the styles, but for those labeled as
<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3"
data-x-internal="text/plain"><code
id="processing-the-type-attribute:text/plain-2">text/plain</code></a>,
or any other type, it would not.

If one of the two files was returned without a <a href="#content-type"
id="processing-the-type-attribute:content-type-5">Content-Type</a>
metadata, or with a syntactically incorrect type like
`Content-Type: "null"`, then the default type for
[`stylesheet`](#link-type-stylesheet) links would kick in. Since that
default type is [`text/css`](#text/css), the style sheet *would*
nonetheless be applied.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.3</span> <span id="obtaining-a-resource-from-a-link-element"></span>Fetching and processing a resource from a [`link`](#the-link-element) element<a href="#fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element"
class="self-link"></a>

<div var-scope="">

All <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:external-resource-link">external
resource links</a> have a
<span id="fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource" class="dfn">fetch and
process the linked resource</span> algorithm, which takes a
[`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`. They also have
<span id="linked-resource-fetch-setup-steps" class="dfn">linked resource
fetch setup steps</span> which take a [`link`](#the-link-element)
element `el` and
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> `request`. Individual link
types may provide their own
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> algorithm, but unless explicitly
stated, they use the
<a href="#default-fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:default-fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">default
fetch and process the linked resource</a> algorithm. Similarly,
individual link types may provide their own
<a href="#linked-resource-fetch-setup-steps"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:linked-resource-fetch-setup-steps">linked
resource fetch setup steps</a>, but unless explicitly stated, these
steps just return true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="default-fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
class="dfn">default fetch and process the linked resource</span>, given
a [`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`, is as follows:

1.  Let `options` be the result of
    <a href="#create-link-options-from-element"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:create-link-options-from-element">creating
    link options</a> from `el`.

2.  Let `request` be the result of <a href="#create-a-link-request"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:create-a-link-request">creating
    a link request</a> given `options`.

3.  If `request` is null, then return.

4.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#synchronous-flag"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:synchronous-flag"
    data-x-internal="synchronous-flag">synchronous flag</a>.

5.  Run the <a href="#linked-resource-fetch-setup-steps"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:linked-resource-fetch-setup-steps-2">linked
    resource fetch setup steps</a>, given `el` and `request`. If the
    result is false, then return.

6.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-initiator-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    to "`css`" if `el`'s [`rel`](#attr-link-rel) attribute contains the
    keyword [`stylesheet`](#link-type-stylesheet); "`link`" otherwise.

7.  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-fetch"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">Fetch</a> `request` with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to the following steps given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:byte-sequence"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes`:

    1.  Let `success` be true.

    2.  If any of the following are true:

        - `bodyBytes` is null or failure; or

        - `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
          id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-response-status"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not an
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
          id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:ok-status"
          data-x-internal="ok-status">ok status</a>,

        then set `success` to false.

        Note that content-specific errors, e.g., CSS parse errors or PNG
        decoding errors, do not affect `success`.

    3.  Otherwise, wait for the <a href="#external-resource-link"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:external-resource-link-2">link
        resource</a>'s <a href="#critical-subresources"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:critical-subresources">critical
        subresources</a> to finish loading.

        The specification that defines a link type's
        <a href="#critical-subresources"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:critical-subresources-2">critical
        subresources</a> (e.g., CSS) is expected to describe how these
        subresources are fetched and processed. However, since this is
        not currently explicit, this specification describes waiting for
        a <a href="#external-resource-link"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:external-resource-link-3">link
        resource</a>'s <a href="#critical-subresources"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:critical-subresources-3">critical
        subresources</a> to be fetched and processed, with the
        expectation that this will be done correctly.

    4.  <a href="#process-the-linked-resource"
        id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:process-the-linked-resource">Process
        the linked resource</a> given `el`, `success`, `response`, and
        `bodyBytes`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-link-request" class="dfn">create a link
request</span> given a <a href="#link-processing-options"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-processing-options">link
processing options</a> `options`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-href">href</a>
    is not the empty string.

2.  Let `url` be the result of <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing
    a URL</a> given `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-href-2">href</a>,
    relative to `options`'s <a href="#link-options-base-url"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-base-url">base
    URL</a>.

    Passing the base URL instead of a document or environment is tracked
    by [issue \#9715](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9715).

3.  If `url` is failure, then return null.

4.  Let `request` be the result of
    <a href="#create-a-potential-cors-request"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:create-a-potential-cors-request">creating
    a potential-CORS request</a> given `url`, `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-destination"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-destination">destination</a>,
    and `options`'s <a href="#link-options-crossorigin"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-crossorigin">crossorigin</a>.

5.  Set `request`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-policy-container"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-policy-container"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-policy-container">policy container</a>
    to `options`'s <a href="#link-options-policy-container"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-policy-container">policy
    container</a>.

6.  Set `request`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-integrity-metadata"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-integrity-metadata"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-integrity-metadata">integrity
    metadata</a> to `options`'s <a href="#link-options-integrity"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-integrity">integrity</a>.

7.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-nonce-metadata"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-nonce-metadata"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-nonce-metadata">cryptographic nonce
    metadata</a> to `options`'s <a href="#link-options-nonce"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-nonce">cryptographic
    nonce metadata</a>.

8.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-referrer-policy"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>
    to `options`'s <a href="#link-options-referrer-policy"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-referrer-policy">referrer
    policy</a>.

9.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-client"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> to `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-environment"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-environment">environment</a>.

10. Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-request-priority"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-priority">priority</a> to
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-fetch-priority"
    id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:link-options-fetch-priority">fetch
    priority</a>.

11. Return `request`.

</div>

User agents may opt to only try to
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-2">fetch
and process</a> such resources when they are needed, instead of
pro-actively fetching all the <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:external-resource-link-4">external
resources</a> that are not applied.

<div var-scope="">

Similar to the <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-3">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> algorithm, all
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:external-resource-link-5">external
resource links</a> have a <span id="process-the-linked-resource"
class="dfn">process the linked resource</span> algorithm which takes a
[`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`, boolean `success`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:concept-response-2"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`, and a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:byte-sequence-2"
data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes`.
Individual link types may provide their own
<a href="#process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:process-the-linked-resource-2">process
the linked resource</a> algorithm, but unless explicitly stated, that
algorithm does nothing.

</div>

Unless otherwise specified for a given [`rel`](#attr-link-rel) keyword,
the element must <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:delay-the-load-event">delay
the load event</a> of the element's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:node-document"
data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> until all the attempts
to <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-4">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> and its
<a href="#critical-subresources"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:critical-subresources-4">critical
subresources</a> are complete. (Resources that the user agent has not
yet attempted to fetch and process, e.g., because it is waiting for the
resource to be needed, do not <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
id="fetching-and-processing-a-resource-from-a-link-element:delay-the-load-event-2">delay
the load event</a>.)

##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.4</span> Processing \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="processing-link-headers:http-link">Link</code></a>\` headers<a href="#processing-link-headers" class="self-link"></a>

All link types that can be <a href="#external-resource-link"
id="processing-link-headers:external-resource-link">external resource
links</a> define a <span id="process-a-link-header" class="dfn">process
a link header</span> algorithm, which takes a
<a href="#link-processing-options"
id="processing-link-headers:link-processing-options">link processing
options</a>. This algorithm defines whether and how they react to
appearing in an HTTP
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="processing-link-headers:http-link-2">Link</code></a>\` response
header.

For most link types, this algorithm does nothing. The [summary
table](#table-link-relations) is a good reference to quickly know
whether a link type has defined <a href="#process-a-link-header"
id="processing-link-headers:process-a-link-header">process a link
header</a> steps.

A <span id="link-processing-options" class="dfn">link processing
options</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="processing-link-headers:struct" data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>.
It has the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="processing-link-headers:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

<span id="link-options-href" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">href</span> (default the empty string)  
<span id="link-options-initiator" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">initiator</span> (default "`link`")  
<span id="link-options-integrity" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">integrity</span> (default the empty string)  
<span id="link-options-type" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">type</span> (default the empty string)  
<span id="link-options-nonce" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">cryptographic nonce metadata</span> (default the empty string)  
A string

<span id="link-options-destination" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">destination</span> (default the empty string)  
A <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#destination-type"
id="processing-link-headers:destination-type"
data-x-internal="destination-type">destination type</a>.

<span id="link-options-crossorigin" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">crossorigin</span> (default <a href="#attr-crossorigin-none"
id="processing-link-headers:attr-crossorigin-none">No CORS</a>)  
A <a href="#cors-settings-attribute"
id="processing-link-headers:cors-settings-attribute">CORS settings
attribute</a> state

<span id="link-options-referrer-policy" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">referrer policy</span> (default the empty string)  
A <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
id="processing-link-headers:referrer-policy"
data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>

<span id="link-options-source-set" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">source set</span> (default null)  
Null or a
<a href="#source-set" id="processing-link-headers:source-set">source
set</a>

<span id="link-options-base-url" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">base URL</span>  
A <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="processing-link-headers:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>

<span id="link-options-origin" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">origin</span>  
An <a href="#concept-origin"
id="processing-link-headers:concept-origin">origin</a>

<span id="link-options-environment" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">environment</span>  
An <a href="#environment"
id="processing-link-headers:environment">environment</a>

<span id="link-options-policy-container" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">policy container</span>  
A <a href="#policy-container"
id="processing-link-headers:policy-container">policy container</a>

<span id="link-options-document" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">document</span> (default null)  
Null or a [`Document`](#document)

<span id="link-options-on-document-ready" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">on document ready</span> (default null)  
Null or an algorithm accepting a [`Document`](#document)

<span id="link-options-fetch-priority" class="dfn" dfn-for="link processing options">fetch priority</span> (default [`Auto`](#attr-fetchpriority-auto-state))  
A <a href="#fetch-priority-attribute"
id="processing-link-headers:fetch-priority-attribute">fetch priority
attribute</a> state

A <a href="#link-processing-options"
id="processing-link-headers:link-processing-options-2">link processing
options</a> has a <a href="#link-options-base-url"
id="processing-link-headers:link-options-base-url">base URL</a> and an
<a href="#link-options-href"
id="processing-link-headers:link-options-href">href</a> rather than a
parsed URL because the URL could be a result of the options's
<a href="#link-options-source-set"
id="processing-link-headers:link-options-source-set">source set</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-link-options-from-element" class="dfn">create link
options from element</span> given a [`link`](#the-link-element) element
`el`:

1.  Let `document` be `el`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="processing-link-headers:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

2.  Let `options` be a new <a href="#link-processing-options"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-processing-options-3">link processing
    options</a> with

    <a href="#link-options-crossorigin"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-crossorigin">crossorigin</a>  
    the state of `el`'s [`crossorigin`](#attr-link-crossorigin) content
    attribute

    <a href="#link-options-referrer-policy"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-referrer-policy">referrer
    policy</a>  
    the state of `el`'s [`referrerpolicy`](#attr-link-referrerpolicy)
    content attribute

    <a href="#link-options-source-set"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-source-set-2">source set</a>  
    `el`'s
    <a href="#source-set" id="processing-link-headers:source-set-2">source
    set</a>

    <a href="#link-options-base-url"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-base-url-2">base URL</a>  
    `document`'s <a href="#document-base-url"
    id="processing-link-headers:document-base-url">document base URL</a>

    <a href="#link-options-origin"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-origin">origin</a>  
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="processing-link-headers:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#link-options-environment"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-environment">environment</a>  
    `document`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="processing-link-headers:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
    object</a>

    <a href="#link-options-policy-container"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-policy-container">policy
    container</a>  
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
    id="processing-link-headers:concept-document-policy-container">policy
    container</a>

    <a href="#link-options-document"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-document">document</a>  
    `document`

    <a href="#link-options-nonce"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-nonce">cryptographic nonce
    metadata</a>  
    the current value of `el`'s <a href="#cryptographicnonce"
    id="processing-link-headers:cryptographicnonce">[[CryptographicNonce]]</a>
    internal slot

    <a href="#link-options-fetch-priority"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-fetch-priority">fetch
    priority</a>  
    the state of `el`'s [`fetchpriority`](#attr-link-fetchpriority)
    content attribute

3.  If `el` has an [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute, then set
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-href-2">href</a> to the
    value of `el`'s [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute.

4.  If `el` has an [`integrity`](#attr-link-integrity) attribute, then
    set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-integrity"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-integrity">integrity</a> to
    the value of `el`'s [`integrity`](#attr-link-integrity) content
    attribute.

5.  If `el` has a [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute, then set
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-type"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-type">type</a> to the value
    of `el`'s [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute.

6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="processing-link-headers:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-href-3">href</a> is not the
    empty string, or `options`'s <a href="#link-options-source-set"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-source-set-3">source set</a>
    is not null.

    A [`link`](#the-link-element) element with neither an
    [`href`](#attr-link-href) or an
    [`imagesrcset`](#attr-link-imagesrcset) does not represent a link.

7.  Return `options`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="extract-links-from-headers" class="dfn">extract links from
headers</span> given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list"
id="processing-link-headers:concept-header-list"
data-x-internal="concept-header-list">header list</a> `headers`:

1.  Let `links` be a new <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="processing-link-headers:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  Let `rawLinkHeaders` be the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-get-decode-split"
    id="processing-link-headers:concept-header-list-get-decode-split"
    data-x-internal="concept-header-list-get-decode-split">getting,
    decoding, and splitting</a> \`[`Link`](#the-link-element)\` from
    `headers`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="processing-link-headers:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `linkHeader` of
    `rawLinkHeaders`:

    1.  Let `linkObject` be the result of
        <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#parse-fv"
        id="processing-link-headers:parsing-a-link-field-value"
        data-x-internal="parsing-a-link-field-value">parsing</a>
        `linkHeader`. [\[WEBLINK\]](#refsWEBLINK)

    2.  If `linkObject`\["`target_uri`"\] does not
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="processing-link-headers:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="processing-link-headers:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `linkObject` to
        `links`.

4.  Return `links`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="process-link-headers" class="dfn">process link
headers</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `doc`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="processing-link-headers:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`, and a
"`pre-media`" or "`media`" `phase`:

1.  Let `links` be the result of <a href="#extract-links-from-headers"
    id="processing-link-headers:extract-links-from-headers">extracting
    links</a> from `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="processing-link-headers:concept-response-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="processing-link-headers:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `linkObject` in `links`:

    1.  Let `rel` be `linkObject`\["`relation_type`"\].

    2.  Let `attribs` be `linkObject`\["`target_attributes`"\].

    3.  Let `expectedPhase` be "`media`" if either
        "[`srcset`](#attr-img-srcset)",
        "[`imagesrcset`](#attr-link-imagesrcset)", or
        "[`media`](#attr-link-media)"
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-2"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a> in `attribs`; otherwise
        "`pre-media`".

    4.  If `expectedPhase` is not `phase`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="processing-link-headers:continue-2"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    5.  If `attribs`\["[`media`](#attr-link-media)"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-3"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and
        `attribs`\["[`media`](#attr-link-media)"\] does not
        <a href="#matches-the-environment"
        id="processing-link-headers:matches-the-environment">match the
        environment</a>, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="processing-link-headers:continue-3"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    6.  Let `options` be a new <a href="#link-processing-options"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-processing-options-4">link processing
        options</a> with

        <a href="#link-options-href"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-href-4">href</a>  
        `linkObject`\["`target_uri`"\]

        <a href="#link-options-base-url"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-base-url-3">base URL</a>  
        `doc`'s <a href="#document-base-url"
        id="processing-link-headers:document-base-url-2">document base URL</a>

        <a href="#link-options-origin"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-origin-2">origin</a>  
        `doc`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="processing-link-headers:concept-document-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

        <a href="#link-options-environment"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-environment-2">environment</a>  
        `doc`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="processing-link-headers:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant
        settings object</a>

        <a href="#link-options-policy-container"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-policy-container-2">policy
        container</a>  
        `doc`'s <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
        id="processing-link-headers:concept-document-policy-container-2">policy
        container</a>

        <a href="#link-options-document"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-document-2">document</a>  
        `doc`

    7.  <a href="#apply-link-options-from-parsed-header-attributes"
        id="processing-link-headers:apply-link-options-from-parsed-header-attributes">Apply
        link options from parsed header attributes</a> to `options`
        given `attribs` and `rel`. If that returned false, then return.

    8.  If `attribs`\["[`imagesrcset`](#attr-link-imagesrcset)"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-4"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and
        `attribs`\["[`imagesizes`](#attr-link-imagesizes)"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-5"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `options`'s
        <a href="#link-options-source-set"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-source-set-4">source set</a>
        to the result of <a href="#create-a-source-set"
        id="processing-link-headers:create-a-source-set">creating a source
        set</a> given `linkObject`\["`target_uri`"\],
        `attribs`\["[`imagesrcset`](#attr-link-imagesrcset)"\],
        `attribs`\["[`imagesizes`](#attr-link-imagesizes)"\], and null.

    9.  Run the <a href="#process-a-link-header"
        id="processing-link-headers:process-a-link-header-2">process a link
        header</a> steps for `rel` given `options`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="apply-link-options-from-parsed-header-attributes"
class="dfn">apply link options from parsed header attributes</span> to a
<a href="#link-processing-options"
id="processing-link-headers:link-processing-options-5">link processing
options</a> `options` given `attribs` and a string `rel`:

1.  If `rel` is "[`preload`](#link-type-preload)":

    1.  If `attribs`\["[`as`](#attr-link-as)"\] does not
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-6"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then return false.

    2.  Let `destination` be the result of
        <a href="#translate-a-preload-destination"
        id="processing-link-headers:translate-a-preload-destination">translating</a>
        `attribs`\["[`as`](#attr-link-as)"\].

    3.  If `destination` is null, then return false.

    4.  Set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-destination"
        id="processing-link-headers:link-options-destination">destination</a>
        to `destination`.

2.  If `attribs`\["[`crossorigin`](#attr-link-crossorigin)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-7"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and is an
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
    id="processing-link-headers:ascii-case-insensitive"
    data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
    match for one of the <a href="#cors-settings-attribute"
    id="processing-link-headers:cors-settings-attribute-2">CORS settings
    attribute</a> <a href="#enumerated-attribute"
    id="processing-link-headers:enumerated-attribute">keywords</a>, then
    set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-crossorigin"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-crossorigin-2">crossorigin</a>
    to the <a href="#cors-settings-attribute"
    id="processing-link-headers:cors-settings-attribute-3">CORS settings
    attribute</a> state corresponding to that keyword.

3.  If `attribs`\["[`integrity`](#attr-link-integrity)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-8"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-integrity"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-integrity-2">integrity</a>
    to `attribs`\["[`integrity`](#attr-link-integrity)"\].

4.  If `attribs`\["[`referrerpolicy`](#attr-link-referrerpolicy)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-9"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and is an
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
    id="processing-link-headers:ascii-case-insensitive-2"
    data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
    match for some <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
    id="processing-link-headers:referrer-policy-2"
    data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>, then set
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-referrer-policy"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-referrer-policy-2">referrer
    policy</a> to that <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
    id="processing-link-headers:referrer-policy-3"
    data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>.

5.  If `attribs`\["[`nonce`](#attr-nonce)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-10"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-nonce"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-nonce-2">nonce</a> to
    `attribs`\["[`nonce`](#attr-nonce)"\].

6.  If `attribs`\["[`type`](#attr-link-type)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-11"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-type"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-type-2">type</a> to
    `attribs`\["[`type`](#attr-link-type)"\].

7.  If `attribs`\["[`fetchpriority`](#attr-link-fetchpriority)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="processing-link-headers:map-exists-12"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and is an
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
    id="processing-link-headers:ascii-case-insensitive-3"
    data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
    match for a <a href="#fetch-priority-attribute"
    id="processing-link-headers:fetch-priority-attribute-2">fetch priority
    attribute</a> keyword, then set `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-fetch-priority"
    id="processing-link-headers:link-options-fetch-priority-2">fetch
    priority</a> to that <a href="#fetch-priority-attribute"
    id="processing-link-headers:fetch-priority-attribute-3">fetch priority
    attribute</a> keyword.

8.  Return true.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.5</span> Early hints<a href="#early-hints" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

MDN

<div class="feature">

[Status/103](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/103 "The HTTP 103 Early Hints information response may be sent by a server while it is still preparing a response, with hints about the resources that the server is expecting the final response will link. This allows a browser to start preloading resources even before the server has prepared and sent that final response.")

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefoxpreview+</span><span class="safari no">SafariNo</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome103+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera no">OperaNo</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge103+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge unknown">Edge
(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

<span id="early-hints-2" class="dfn">Early hints</span> allow
user-agents to perform some operations, such as to speculatively load
resources that are likely to be used by the document, before the
navigation request is fully handled by the server and a response code is
served. Servers can indicate early hints by serving a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="early-hints:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> with a 103 status code
before serving the final
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="early-hints:concept-response-2"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>.[\[RFC8297\]](#refsRFC8297)

For compatibility reasons [early hints are typically delivered over
HTTP/2 or
above](https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8297.html#security-considerations),
but for readability we use HTTP/1.1-style notation below.

<div class="example">

For example, given the following sequence of responses:

    103 Early Hint
    Link: </image.png>; rel=preload; as=image

    200 OK
    Content-Type: text/html

    <!DOCTYPE html>
    ...
    <img src="/image.png">

the image will start loading before the HTML content arrives.

</div>

Only the first early hint response served during the navigation is
handled, and it is discarded if it is succeeded by a cross-origin
redirect.

In addition to the
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="early-hints:http-link">Link</code></a>\` headers, it is possible
that the 103 response contains a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#content-security-policy-object"
id="early-hints:content-security-policy"
data-x-internal="content-security-policy">Content Security Policy</a>
header, which is enforced when processing the early hint.

<div class="example">

For example, given the following sequence of responses:

    103 Early Hint
    Content-Security-Policy: style-src: self;
    Link: </style.css>; rel=preload; as=style

    103 Early Hint
    Link: </image.png>; rel=preload; as=image

    302 Redirect
    Location: /alternate.html

    200 OK
    Content-Security-Policy: style-src: none;
    Link: </font.ttf>; rel=preload; as=font

The font and style would be loaded, and the image will be discarded, as
only the first early hint response in the final redirect chain is
respected. The late <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#content-security-policy-object"
id="early-hints:content-security-policy-2"
data-x-internal="content-security-policy">Content Security Policy</a>
header comes after the request to fetch the style has already been
performed, but the style will not be accessible to the document.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="process-early-hint-headers" class="dfn">process early hint
headers</span> given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="early-hints:concept-response-3"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and an
<a href="#environment" id="early-hints:environment">environment</a>
`reservedEnvironment`:

Early-hint \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="early-hints:http-link-2">Link</code></a>\` headers are always
processed before
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="early-hints:http-link-3">Link</code></a>\` headers from the final
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="early-hints:concept-response-4"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>, followed by
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements. This is equivalent to prepending
the contents of the early and final
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8288.html#header"
data-x-internal="http-link"><code
id="early-hints:http-link-4">Link</code></a>\` headers to the
[`Document`](#document)'s [`head`](#the-head-element) element, in
respective order.

1.  Let `earlyPolicyContainer` be the result of
    <a href="#creating-a-policy-container-from-a-fetch-response"
    id="early-hints:creating-a-policy-container-from-a-fetch-response">creating
    a policy container from a fetch response</a> given `response` and
    `reservedEnvironment`.

    This allows the early hint
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="early-hints:concept-response-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> to include a <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#content-security-policy-object"
    id="early-hints:content-security-policy-3"
    data-x-internal="content-security-policy">Content Security Policy</a>
    which would be
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#enforced"
    id="early-hints:enforce-the-policy"
    data-x-internal="enforce-the-policy">enforced</a> when fetching the
    early hint <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="early-hints:concept-request"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a>.

2.  Let `links` be the result of <a href="#extract-links-from-headers"
    id="early-hints:extract-links-from-headers">extracting links</a>
    from `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="early-hints:concept-response-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

3.  Let `earlyHints` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="early-hints:list"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="early-hints:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `linkObject` in `links`:

    The moment we receive the early hint link header, we begin
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="early-hints:concept-fetch"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetching</a> `earlyRequest`. If it
    comes back before the [`Document`](#document) is created, we set
    `earlyResponse` to the
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="early-hints:concept-response-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> of that
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="early-hints:concept-fetch-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> and once the
    [`Document`](#document) is created we commit it (by making it
    available in the <a href="#map-of-preloaded-resources"
    id="early-hints:map-of-preloaded-resources">map of preloaded
    resources</a> as if it was a [`link`](#the-link-element) element).
    If the [`Document`](#document) is created first, the
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="early-hints:concept-response-7"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> is committed as soon
    as it becomes available.

    1.  Let `rel` be `linkObject`\["`relation_type`"\].

    2.  Let `options` be a new <a href="#link-processing-options"
        id="early-hints:link-processing-options">link processing options</a>
        with

        <a href="#link-options-href" id="early-hints:link-options-href">href</a>  
        `linkObject`\["`target_uri`"\]

        <a href="#link-options-initiator"
        id="early-hints:link-options-initiator">initiator</a>  
        "`early-hint`"

        <a href="#link-options-base-url"
        id="early-hints:link-options-base-url">base URL</a>  
        `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="early-hints:concept-response-url"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>

        <a href="#link-options-origin"
        id="early-hints:link-options-origin">origin</a>  
        `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="early-hints:concept-response-url-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
        id="early-hints:concept-url-origin"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>

        <a href="#link-options-environment"
        id="early-hints:link-options-environment">environment</a>  
        `reservedEnvironment`

        <a href="#link-options-policy-container"
        id="early-hints:link-options-policy-container">policy container</a>  
        `earlyPolicyContainer`

    3.  Let `attribs` be `linkObject`\["`target_attributes`"\].

        Only the [`as`](#attr-link-as),
        [`crossorigin`](#attr-link-crossorigin),
        [`integrity`](#attr-link-integrity), and
        [`type`](#attr-link-type) attributes are handled as part of
        early hint processing. The other ones, in particular
        [`blocking`](#attr-link-blocking),
        [`imagesrcset`](#attr-link-imagesrcset),
        [`imagesizes`](#attr-link-imagesizes), and
        [`media`](#attr-link-media) are only applicable once a
        [`Document`](#document) is created.

    4.  <a href="#apply-link-options-from-parsed-header-attributes"
        id="early-hints:apply-link-options-from-parsed-header-attributes">Apply
        link options from parsed header attributes</a> to `options`
        given `attribs` and `rel`. If that returned false, then return.

    5.  Run the <a href="#process-a-link-header"
        id="early-hints:process-a-link-header">process a link header</a>
        steps for `rel` given `options`.

    6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="early-hints:list-append" data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a>
        `options` to `earlyHints`.

5.  Return the following substeps given [`Document`](#document) `doc`:
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="early-hints:list-iterate-2" data-x-internal="list-iterate">for
    each</a> `options` in `earlyHints`:

    1.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-on-document-ready"
        id="early-hints:link-options-on-document-ready">on document ready</a>
        is null, then set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-document"
        id="early-hints:link-options-document">document</a> to `doc`.

    2.  Otherwise, call `options`'s
        <a href="#link-options-on-document-ready"
        id="early-hints:link-options-on-document-ready-2">on document ready</a>
        with `doc`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.2.4.6</span> Providing users with a means to follow hyperlinks created using the [`link`](#the-link-element) element<a
href="#providing-users-with-a-means-to-follow-hyperlinks-created-using-the-link-element"
class="self-link"></a>

Interactive user agents may provide users with a means to
<a href="#following-hyperlinks-2"
id="providing-users-with-a-means-to-follow-hyperlinks-created-using-the-link-element:following-hyperlinks-2">follow
the hyperlinks</a> created using the [`link`](#the-link-element)
element, somewhere within their user interface. Such invocations of the
<a href="#following-hyperlinks-2"
id="providing-users-with-a-means-to-follow-hyperlinks-created-using-the-link-element:following-hyperlinks-2-2">follow
the hyperlink</a> algorithm must set the
*[userInvolvement](#following-userinvolvement)* argument to
"[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)". The exact interface is not defined by
this specification, but it could include the following information
(obtained from the element's attributes, again as defined below), in
some form or another (possibly simplified), for each
<a href="#hyperlink"
id="providing-users-with-a-means-to-follow-hyperlinks-created-using-the-link-element:hyperlink">hyperlink</a>
created with each [`link`](#the-link-element) element in the document:

- The relationship between this document and the resource (given by the
  [`rel`](#attr-link-rel) attribute)
- The title of the resource (given by the [`title`](#attr-link-title)
  attribute).
- The address of the resource (given by the [`href`](#attr-link-href)
  attribute).
- The language of the resource (given by the
  [`hreflang`](#attr-link-hreflang) attribute).
- The optimum media for the resource (given by the
  [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute).

User agents could also include other information, such as the type of
the resource (as given by the [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute).
