(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android yes">Samsung
Internet4.0+</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

The [`preconnect`](#link-type-preconnect) keyword may be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements. This keyword creates an
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="link-type-preconnect:external-resource-link">external resource
link</a>. This keyword is
<a href="#body-ok" id="link-type-preconnect:body-ok">body-ok</a>.

The [`preconnect`](#link-type-preconnect) keyword indicates that
preemptively initiating a connection to the <a href="#concept-origin"
id="link-type-preconnect:concept-origin">origin</a> of the specified
resource is likely to be beneficial, as it is highly likely that the
user will require resources located at that <a href="#concept-origin"
id="link-type-preconnect:concept-origin-2">origin</a>, and the user
experience would be improved by preempting the latency costs associated
with establishing the connection.

There is no default type for resources given by the
[`preconnect`](#link-type-preconnect) keyword.

A user agent must not <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
id="link-type-preconnect:delay-the-load-event">delay the load event</a>
for this link type.

<div algorithm="">

The appropriate times to
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-preconnect:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">fetch
and process</a> this type of link are:

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preconnect:external-resource-link-2">external resource
  link</a> is created on a [`link`](#the-link-element) element that is
  already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preconnect:browsing-context-connected">browsing-context
  connected</a>.

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preconnect:external-resource-link-3">external resource
  link</a>'s [`link`](#the-link-element) element
  <a href="#becomes-browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preconnect:becomes-browsing-context-connected">becomes
  browsing-context connected</a>.

- When the [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preconnect:external-resource-link-4">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preconnect:browsing-context-connected-2">browsing-context
  connected</a> is changed.

- When the [`crossorigin`](#attr-link-crossorigin) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preconnect:external-resource-link-5">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preconnect:browsing-context-connected-3">browsing-context
  connected</a> is set, changed, or removed.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-preconnect:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-2">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> steps for this type of linked
resource, given a [`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`, are to
<a href="#create-link-options-from-element"
id="link-type-preconnect:create-link-options-from-element">create link
options</a> from `el` and to <a href="#preconnect"
id="link-type-preconnect:preconnect">preconnect</a> given the result.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#process-a-link-header"
id="link-type-preconnect:process-a-link-header">process a link
header</a> step for this type of linked resource given a
<a href="#link-processing-options"
id="link-type-preconnect:link-processing-options">link processing
options</a> `options` are to <a href="#preconnect"
id="link-type-preconnect:preconnect-2">preconnect</a> given `options`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="preconnect" class="dfn">preconnect</span> given a
<a href="#link-processing-options"
id="link-type-preconnect:link-processing-options-2">link processing
options</a> `options`:

1.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-href">href</a> is an empty
    string, return.

2.  Let `url` be the result of <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
    id="link-type-preconnect:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing a
    URL</a> given `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-href-2">href</a>, relative to
    `options`'s <a href="#link-options-base-url"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-base-url">base URL</a>.

    Passing the base URL instead of a document or environment is tracked
    by [issue \#9715](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9715).

3.  If `url` is failure, then return.

4.  If `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="link-type-preconnect:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is not an
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
    id="link-type-preconnect:http(s)-scheme"
    data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>, then return.

5.  Let `partitionKey` be the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#determine-the-network-partition-key"
    id="link-type-preconnect:determine-the-network-partition-key"
    data-x-internal="determine-the-network-partition-key">determining the
    network partition key</a> given `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-environment"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-environment">environment</a>.

6.  Let `useCredentials` be true.

7.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-crossorigin"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-crossorigin">crossorigin</a>
    is <a href="#attr-crossorigin-anonymous"
    id="link-type-preconnect:attr-crossorigin-anonymous">Anonymous</a>
    and `options`'s <a href="#link-options-origin"
    id="link-type-preconnect:link-options-origin">origin</a> does not
    have the
    <a href="#same-origin" id="link-type-preconnect:same-origin">same
    origin</a> as `url`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
    id="link-type-preconnect:concept-url-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>, then set
    `useCredentials` to false.

8.  The user agent should
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-connection-obtain"
    id="link-type-preconnect:obtain-a-connection"
    data-x-internal="obtain-a-connection">obtain a connection</a> given
    `partitionKey`, `url`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
    id="link-type-preconnect:concept-url-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>, and
    `useCredentials`.

    This connection is obtained but not used directly. It will remain in
    the <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-connection-pool"
    id="link-type-preconnect:connection-pool"
    data-x-internal="connection-pool">connection pool</a> for subsequent
    use.

    The user agent should attempt to initiate a preconnect and perform
    the full connection handshake (DNS+TCP for HTTP, and DNS+TCP+TLS for
    HTTPS origins) whenever possible, but is allowed to elect to perform
    a partial handshake (DNS only for HTTP, and DNS or DNS+TCP for HTTPS
    origins), or skip it entirely, due to resource constraints or other
    reasons.

    The optimal number of connections per origin is dependent on the
    negotiated protocol, users current connectivity profile, available
    device resources, global connection limits, and other context
    specific variables. As a result, the decision for how many
    connections should be opened is deferred to the user agent.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.6.8.19</span> Link type "<span class="dfn" dfn-for="link/rel" dfn-type="attr-value">`prefetch`</span>"<a href="#link-type-prefetch" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

MDN

<div class="feature">

[Link_types/prefetch](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Link_types/prefetch "The prefetch keyword for the rel attribute of the <link> element is a hint to browsers that the user is likely to need the target resource for future navigations, and therefore the browser can likely improve the user experience by preemptively fetching and caching the resource.")

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox2+</span><span class="safari no">SafariNo</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome8+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera unknown">Opera?</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer11</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android yes">Samsung
Internet1.5+</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

The [`prefetch`](#link-type-prefetch) keyword may be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements. This keyword creates an
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="link-type-prefetch:external-resource-link">external resource
link</a>. This keyword is
<a href="#body-ok" id="link-type-prefetch:body-ok">body-ok</a>.

The [`prefetch`](#link-type-prefetch) keyword indicates that
preemptively <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="link-type-prefetch:concept-fetch"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetching</a> and caching the specified
resource or same-site document is likely to be beneficial, as it is
highly likely that the user will require this resource for future
navigations.

There is no default type for resources given by the
[`prefetch`](#link-type-prefetch) keyword.

<div algorithm="">

The appropriate times to
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-prefetch:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">fetch and
process</a> this type of link are:

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-prefetch:external-resource-link-2">external resource
  link</a> is created on a [`link`](#the-link-element) element that is
  already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-prefetch:browsing-context-connected">browsing-context
  connected</a>.

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-prefetch:external-resource-link-3">external resource
  link</a>'s [`link`](#the-link-element) element
  <a href="#becomes-browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-prefetch:becomes-browsing-context-connected">becomes
  browsing-context connected</a>.

- When the [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-prefetch:external-resource-link-4">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-prefetch:browsing-context-connected-2">browsing-context
  connected</a> is changed.

- When the [`crossorigin`](#attr-link-crossorigin) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-prefetch:external-resource-link-5">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-prefetch:browsing-context-connected-3">browsing-context
  connected</a> is set, changed, or removed.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-prefetch:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-2">fetch
and process the linked resource</a> algorithm for
[`prefetch`](#link-type-prefetch) links, given a
[`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`, is as follows:

1.  If `el`'s [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute's value is the empty
    string, then return.

2.  Let `options` be the result of
    <a href="#create-link-options-from-element"
    id="link-type-prefetch:create-link-options-from-element">creating link
    options</a> from `el`.

3.  Let `request` be the result of <a href="#create-a-link-request"
    id="link-type-prefetch:create-a-link-request">creating a link
    request</a> given `options`.

4.  If `request` is null, then return.

5.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-initiator"
    id="link-type-prefetch:concept-request-initiator"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator">initiator</a> to
    "`prefetch`".

6.  Let `processPrefetchResponse` be the following steps given a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="link-type-prefetch:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="link-type-prefetch:byte-sequence"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bytesOrNull`:

    1.  If `response` is a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="link-type-prefetch:network-error"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>,
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="link-type-prefetch:concept-event-fire"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`error`](#event-error) at `el`.

    2.  Otherwise,
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="link-type-prefetch:concept-event-fire-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`load`](#event-load) at `el`.

7.  The user agent should
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="link-type-prefetch:concept-fetch-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> `request`, with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to `processPrefetchResponse`. User agents may delay the fetching
    of `request` to prioritize other requests that are necessary for the
    current document.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#process-a-link-header"
id="link-type-prefetch:process-a-link-header">process a link header</a>
steps for this type of linked resource are to do nothing.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.6.8.20</span> Link type "<span class="dfn" dfn-for="link/rel" dfn-type="attr-value">`preload`</span>"<a href="#link-type-preload" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**⚠**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Link_types/preload](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Link_types/preload "The preload value of the <link> element's rel attribute lets you declare fetch requests in the HTML's <head>, specifying resources that your page will need very soon, which you want to start loading early in the page lifecycle, before browsers' main rendering machinery kicks in. This ensures they are available earlier and are less likely to block the page's render, improving performance. Even though the name contains the term load, it doesn't load and execute the script but only schedules it to be downloaded and cached with a higher priority.")

Support in one engine only.

The [`preload`](#link-type-preload) keyword may be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements. This keyword creates an
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link">external resource link</a>.
This keyword is
<a href="#body-ok" id="link-type-preload:body-ok">body-ok</a>.

The [`preload`](#link-type-preload) keyword indicates that the user
agent will preemptively
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="link-type-preload:concept-fetch"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> and cache the specified
resource according to the <a href="#preload-destination"
id="link-type-preload:preload-destination">preload destination</a> given
by the [`as`](#attr-link-as) attribute, and the
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-priority"
data-x-internal="concept-request-priority">priority</a> given by the
[`fetchpriority`](#attr-link-fetchpriority) attribute, as it is highly
likely that the user will require this resource for the current
navigation.

User-agents might perform additional operations when a resource is
loaded, such as preemptively
<a href="#dom-img-decode" id="link-type-preload:dom-img-decode">decoding
images</a> or
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#create-a-css-style-sheet"
id="link-type-preload:create-a-css-style-sheet"
data-x-internal="create-a-css-style-sheet">creating style sheets</a>.
However, these additional operations cannot have observable effects.

There is no default type for resources given by the
[`preload`](#link-type-preload) keyword.

A user agent must not <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
id="link-type-preload:delay-the-load-event">delay the load event</a> for
this link type.

<div algorithm="">

The appropriate times to
<a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-preload:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource">fetch and
process the linked resource</a> for such a link are:

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-2">external resource
  link</a> is created on a [`link`](#the-link-element) element that is
  already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:browsing-context-connected">browsing-context
  connected</a>.

- When the <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-3">external resource
  link</a>'s [`link`](#the-link-element) element
  <a href="#becomes-browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:becomes-browsing-context-connected">becomes
  browsing-context connected</a>.

- When the [`href`](#attr-link-href) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-4">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:browsing-context-connected-2">browsing-context
  connected</a> is changed.

- When the [`as`](#attr-link-as) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-5">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:browsing-context-connected-3">browsing-context
  connected</a> is changed.

- When the [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-6">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:browsing-context-connected-4">browsing-context
  connected</a>, but was previously not obtained due to the
  [`type`](#attr-link-type) attribute specifying an unsupported type for
  the request
  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
  id="link-type-preload:concept-request-destination"
  data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>, is set,
  removed, or changed.

- When the [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute of the
  [`link`](#the-link-element) element of an
  <a href="#external-resource-link"
  id="link-type-preload:external-resource-link-7">external resource
  link</a> that is already <a href="#browsing-context-connected"
  id="link-type-preload:browsing-context-connected-5">browsing-context
  connected</a>, but was previously not obtained due to the
  [`media`](#attr-link-media) attribute not
  <a href="#matches-the-environment"
  id="link-type-preload:matches-the-environment">matching the
  environment</a>, is changed or removed.

</div>

A [`Document`](#document) has a <span id="map-of-preloaded-resources"
class="dfn">map of preloaded resources</span>, which is an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="link-type-preload:ordered-map" data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered
map</a>, initially empty.

A <span id="preload-key" class="dfn">preload key</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="link-type-preload:struct" data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>. It
has the following <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="link-type-preload:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

<span id="preload-url" class="dfn">URL</span>  
A <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="link-type-preload:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>

<span id="preload-key-destination" class="dfn">destination</span>  
A <a href="#preload-destination"
id="link-type-preload:preload-destination-2">preload destination</a>

<span id="preload-mode" class="dfn">mode</span>  
A <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-mode"
data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">request mode</a>, either
"`same-origin`", "`cors`", or "`no-cors`"

<span id="preload-credentials-mode" class="dfn">credentials mode</span>  
A <a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-credentials-mode"
data-x-internal="concept-request-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>

A <span id="preload-entry" class="dfn">preload entry</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="link-type-preload:struct-2" data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>. It
has the following <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="link-type-preload:struct-item-2"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

<span id="preload-integrity-metadata" class="dfn">integrity metadata</span>  
A string

<span id="preload-response" class="dfn">response</span>  
Null or a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="link-type-preload:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>

<span id="preload-on-response-available" class="dfn">on response available</span>  
Null, or an algorithm accepting a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="link-type-preload:concept-response-2"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> or null

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="consume-a-preloaded-resource" class="dfn" export="">consume
a preloaded resource</span> for [`Window`](#window) `window`, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="link-type-preload:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, a
string `destination`, a string `mode`, a string `credentialsMode`, a
string `integrityMetadata`, and `onResponseAvailable`, which is an
algorithm accepting a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="link-type-preload:concept-response-3"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>:

1.  Let `key` be a
    <a href="#preload-key" id="link-type-preload:preload-key">preload
    key</a> whose
    <a href="#preload-url" id="link-type-preload:preload-url">URL</a> is
    `url`, <a href="#preload-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-destination-3">destination</a> is
    `destination`,
    <a href="#preload-mode" id="link-type-preload:preload-mode">mode</a>
    is `mode`, and <a href="#preload-credentials-mode"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>
    is `credentialsMode`.

2.  Let `preloads` be `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>'s <a href="#map-of-preloaded-resources"
    id="link-type-preload:map-of-preloaded-resources">map of preloaded
    resources</a>.

3.  If `key` does not
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="link-type-preload:map-exists" data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>
    in `preloads`, then return false.

4.  Let `entry` be `preloads`\[`key`\].

5.  Let `consumerIntegrityMetadata` be the result of <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#parse-metadata"
    id="link-type-preload:parse-integrity-metadata"
    data-x-internal="parse-integrity-metadata">parsing</a>
    `integrityMetadata`.

6.  Let `preloadIntegrityMetadata` be the result of <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#parse-metadata"
    id="link-type-preload:parse-integrity-metadata-2"
    data-x-internal="parse-integrity-metadata">parsing</a> `entry`'s
    <a href="#preload-integrity-metadata"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-integrity-metadata">integrity metadata</a>.

7.  If none of the following conditions apply:

    - `consumerIntegrityMetadata` is `no metadata`;

    - `consumerIntegrityMetadata` is equal to
      `preloadIntegrityMetadata`; or

      This comparison would ignore unknown integrity options. See [issue
      \#116.](https://github.com/w3c/webappsec-subresource-integrity/issues/116)

    then return false.

    A mismatch in integrity metadata between the preload and the
    consumer, even if both match the data, would lead to an additional
    fetch from the network.

    It is important that
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
    id="link-type-preload:network-error"
    data-x-internal="network-error">network errors</a> are added to the
    preload cache so that if a preload request results in an error, the
    erroneous response isn't re-requested from the network later. This
    also has security implications; consider the case where a developer
    specifies subresource integrity metadata on a preload request, but
    not the following resource request. If the preload request fails
    subresource integrity verification and is discarded, the resource
    request will fetch and consume a potentially-malicious response from
    the network without verifying its integrity. [\[SRI\]](#refsSRI)

8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
    id="link-type-preload:map-remove"
    data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a> `preloads`\[`key`\].

9.  If `entry`'s <a href="#preload-response"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-response">response</a> is null, then
    set `entry`'s <a href="#preload-on-response-available"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-on-response-available">on response
    available</a> to `onResponseAvailable`.

10. Otherwise, call `onResponseAvailable` with `entry`'s
    <a href="#preload-response"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-response-2">response</a>.

11. Return true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

For the purposes of this section, a string `type`
<span id="match-preload-type" class="dfn">matches</span> a
<a href="#preload-destination"
id="link-type-preload:preload-destination-4">preload destination</a>
`destination` if the following algorithm returns true:

1.  If `type` is an empty string, then return true.

2.  If `destination` is "`fetch`", then return true.

3.  Let `mimeTypeRecord` be the result of
    <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#parse-a-mime-type"
    id="link-type-preload:parse-a-mime-type"
    data-x-internal="parse-a-mime-type">parsing</a> `type`.

4.  If `mimeTypeRecord` is failure, then return false.

5.  If `mimeTypeRecord` is not
    <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#supported-by-the-user-agent"
    id="link-type-preload:is-mime-type-supported-by-the-user-agent"
    data-x-internal="is-mime-type-supported-by-the-user-agent">supported by
    the user agent</a>, then return false.

6.  If any of the following are true:

    - `destination` is "`script`" and `mimeTypeRecord` is a
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type"
      id="link-type-preload:javascript-mime-type"
      data-x-internal="javascript-mime-type">JavaScript MIME type</a>;

    - `destination` is "`image`" and `mimeTypeRecord` is an
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#image-mime-type"
      id="link-type-preload:image-mime-type"
      data-x-internal="image-mime-type">image MIME type</a>;

    - `destination` is "`font`" and `mimeTypeRecord` is a
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#font-mime-type"
      id="link-type-preload:font-mime-type"
      data-x-internal="font-mime-type">font MIME type</a>;

    - `destination` is "`style`" and `mimeTypeRecord`'s
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence"
      id="link-type-preload:mime-type-essence"
      data-x-internal="mime-type-essence">essence</a> is
      [`text/css`](#text/css); or

    - `destination` is "`track`" and `mimeTypeRecord`'s
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence"
      id="link-type-preload:mime-type-essence-2"
      data-x-internal="mime-type-essence">essence</a> is
      [`text/vtt`](#text/vtt),

    then return true.

7.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-preload-key" class="dfn">create a preload
key</span> for a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> `request`, return a new
<a href="#preload-key" id="link-type-preload:preload-key-2">preload
key</a> whose
<a href="#preload-url" id="link-type-preload:preload-url-2">URL</a> is
`request`'s <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-url"
data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a>,
<a href="#preload-destination"
id="link-type-preload:preload-destination-5">destination</a> is
`request`'s
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-destination-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>,
<a href="#preload-mode" id="link-type-preload:preload-mode-2">mode</a>
is `request`'s
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-mode-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">mode</a>, and
<a href="#preload-credentials-mode"
id="link-type-preload:preload-credentials-mode-2">credentials mode</a>
is `request`'s <a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode"
id="link-type-preload:concept-request-credentials-mode-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>.

</div>

A <span id="preload-destination" class="dfn">preload destination</span>
is "`fetch`", "`font`", "`image`", "`script`", "`style`", or "`track`".

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="translate-a-preload-destination" class="dfn">translate a
preload destination</span> given a string `destination`:

1.  If `destination` is not a <a href="#preload-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-destination-6">preload destination</a>,
    then return null.

2.  Return the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-potential-destination-translate"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-potential-destination-translate"
    data-x-internal="concept-potential-destination-translate">translating</a>
    `destination`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="preload" class="dfn">preload</span> given a
<a href="#link-processing-options"
id="link-type-preload:link-processing-options">link processing
options</a> `options` and an optional `processResponse`, which is an
algorithm accepting a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="link-type-preload:concept-response-4"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>:

1.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-type"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-type">type</a> doesn't
    <a href="#match-preload-type"
    id="link-type-preload:match-preload-type">match</a> `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-destination">destination</a>,
    then return.

2.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-destination-2">destination</a> is
    "`image`" and `options`'s <a href="#link-options-source-set"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-source-set">source set</a> is not
    null, then set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-href"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-href">href</a> to the result of
    <a href="#select-an-image-source-from-a-source-set"
    id="link-type-preload:select-an-image-source-from-a-source-set">selecting
    an image source</a> from `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-source-set"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-source-set-2">source set</a>.

3.  Let `request` be the result of <a href="#create-a-link-request"
    id="link-type-preload:create-a-link-request">creating a link request</a>
    given `options`.

4.  If `request` is null, then return.

5.  Let `unsafeEndTime` be 0.

6.  Let `entry` be a new
    <a href="#preload-entry" id="link-type-preload:preload-entry">preload
    entry</a> whose <a href="#preload-integrity-metadata"
    id="link-type-preload:preload-integrity-metadata-2">integrity
    metadata</a> is `options`'s <a href="#link-options-integrity"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-integrity">integrity</a>.

7.  Let `key` be the result of <a href="#create-a-preload-key"
    id="link-type-preload:create-a-preload-key">creating a preload key</a>
    given `request`.

8.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-document"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-document">document</a> is null,
    then set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-request-initiator-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    to "`early hint`".

9.  Let `controller` be null.

10. Let `reportTiming` given a [`Document`](#document) `document` be to
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#finalize-and-report-timing"
    id="link-type-preload:report-timing"
    data-x-internal="report-timing">report timing</a> for `controller`
    given `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>.

11. Set `controller` to the result of
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-fetch-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetching</a> `request`, with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to the following steps given a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-response-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="link-type-preload:byte-sequence"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes`:

    1.  If `bodyBytes` is a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
        id="link-type-preload:byte-sequence-2"
        data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a>, then set
        `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
        id="link-type-preload:concept-response-body"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a> to `bodyBytes`
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body"
        id="link-type-preload:as-a-body" data-x-internal="as-a-body">as a
        body</a>.

        By using
        *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
        data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*,
        we have
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#bodyinit-safely-extract"
        id="link-type-preload:body-safely-extract"
        data-x-internal="body-safely-extract">extracted</a> the entire
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
        id="link-type-preload:concept-response-body-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a>. This is
        necessary to ensure the preloader loads the entire body from the
        network, regardless of whether the preload will be consumed
        (which is uncertain at this point). This step then resets the
        request's body to a new body containing the same bytes, so that
        other specifications can read from it at the time of actual
        consumption, despite us having already done so once.

    2.  Otherwise, set `response` to a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="link-type-preload:network-error-2"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>.

    3.  Set `unsafeEndTime` to the
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-unsafe-shared-current-time"
        id="link-type-preload:unsafe-shared-current-time"
        data-x-internal="unsafe-shared-current-time">unsafe shared current
        time</a>.

    4.  If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-document"
        id="link-type-preload:link-options-document-2">document</a> is
        not null, then call `reportTiming` given `options`'s
        <a href="#link-options-document"
        id="link-type-preload:link-options-document-3">document</a>.

    5.  If `entry`'s <a href="#preload-on-response-available"
        id="link-type-preload:preload-on-response-available-2">on response
        available</a> is null, then set `entry`'s
        <a href="#preload-response"
        id="link-type-preload:preload-response-3">response</a> to
        `response`; otherwise call `entry`'s
        <a href="#preload-on-response-available"
        id="link-type-preload:preload-on-response-available-3">on response
        available</a> given `response`.

    6.  If `processResponse` is given, then call `processResponse` with
        `response`.

12. Let `commit` be the following steps given a [`Document`](#document)
    `document`:

    1.  If `entry`'s <a href="#preload-response"
        id="link-type-preload:preload-response-4">response</a> is not
        null, then call `reportTiming` given `document`.

    2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#map-of-preloaded-resources"
        id="link-type-preload:map-of-preloaded-resources-2">map of preloaded
        resources</a>\[`key`\] to `entry`.

13. If `options`'s <a href="#link-options-document"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-document-4">document</a> is null,
    then set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-on-document-ready"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-on-document-ready">on document
    ready</a> to `commit`. Otherwise, call `commit` with `options`'s
    <a href="#link-options-document"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-document-5">document</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource"
id="link-type-preload:fetch-and-process-the-linked-resource-2">fetch and
process the linked resource</a> steps for this type of linked resource,
given a [`link`](#the-link-element) element `el`, are:

1.  <a href="#update-the-source-set"
    id="link-type-preload:update-the-source-set">Update the source set</a>
    for `el`.

2.  Let `options` be the result of
    <a href="#create-link-options-from-element"
    id="link-type-preload:create-link-options-from-element">creating link
    options</a> from `el`.

3.  Let `destination` be the result of
    <a href="#translate-a-preload-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:translate-a-preload-destination">translating</a>
    the keyword representing the state of `el`'s [`as`](#attr-link-as)
    attribute.

4.  If `destination` is null, then return.

5.  Set `options`'s <a href="#link-options-destination"
    id="link-type-preload:link-options-destination-3">destination</a> to
    `destination`.

6.  <a href="#preload" id="link-type-preload:preload">Preload</a>
    `options`, with the following steps given a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="link-type-preload:concept-response-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`:

    1.  If `response` is a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="link-type-preload:network-error-3"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>,
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="link-type-preload:concept-event-fire"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`error`](#event-error) at `el`. Otherwise,
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="link-type-preload:concept-event-fire-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`load`](#event-load) at `el`.

        The actual browsers' behavior is different from the spec here,
        and the feasibility of changing the behavior has not yet been
        investigated. See [issue
        \#1142](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/1142).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#process-a-link-header"
id="link-type-preload:process-a-link-header">process a link header</a>
step for this type of link given a <a href="#link-processing-options"
id="link-type-preload:link-processing-options-2">link processing
options</a> `options` is to
<a href="#preload" id="link-type-preload:preload-2">preload</a>
`options`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.6.8.21</span> Link type "<span class="dfn" dfn-for="link/rel,a/rel,area/rel" dfn-type="attr-value">`privacy-policy`</span>"<a href="#link-type-privacy-policy" class="self-link"></a>

The [`privacy-policy`](#link-type-privacy-policy) keyword may be used
with [`link`](#the-link-element), [`a`](#the-a-element), and
[`area`](#the-area-element) elements. This keyword creates a
<a href="#hyperlink"
id="link-type-privacy-policy:hyperlink">hyperlink</a>.

The [`privacy-policy`](#link-type-privacy-policy) keyword indicates that
the referenced document contains information about the data collection
and usage practices that apply to the current document, as described in
more detail in Additional Link Relation Types. The referenced document
may be a standalone privacy policy, or a specific section of some more
general document. [\[RFC6903\]](#refsRFC6903)

##### <span class="secno">4.6.8.22</span> Link type "<span class="dfn" dfn-for="link/rel,a/rel,area/rel,form/rel" dfn-type="attr-value">`search`</span>"<a href="#link-type-search" class="self-link"></a>

The [`search`](#link-type-search) keyword may be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element), [`a`](#the-a-element),
[`area`](#the-area-element), and [`form`](#the-form-element) elements.
This keyword creates a
<a href="#hyperlink" id="link-type-search:hyperlink">hyperlink</a>.

The [`search`](#link-type-search) keyword indicates that the referenced
document provides an interface specifically for searching the document
and its related resources.

OpenSearch description documents can be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements and the
[`search`](#link-type-search) link type to enable user agents to
autodiscover search interfaces. [\[OPENSEARCH\]](#refsOPENSEARCH)

##### <span class="secno">4.6.8.23</span> Link type "<span class="dfn" dfn-for="link/rel" dfn-type="attr-value">`stylesheet`</span>"<a href="#link-type-stylesheet" class="self-link"></a>

The [`stylesheet`](#link-type-stylesheet) keyword may be used with
[`link`](#the-link-element) elements. This keyword creates an
<a href="#external-resource-link"
id="link-type-stylesheet:external-resource-link">external resource
link</a> that contributes to the styling processing model. This keyword
is <a href="#body-ok" id="link-type-stylesheet:body-ok">body-ok</a>.

The specified resource is a
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#css-style-sheet"
id="link-type-stylesheet:css-style-sheet"
data-x-internal="css-style-sheet">CSS style sheet</a> that describes how
to present the document.

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**⚠**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Alternative_style_sheets](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Alternative_style_sheets "Specifying alternative style sheets in a web page provides a way for users to see multiple versions of a page, based on their needs or preferences.")

Support in one engine only.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox3+</span><span class="safari unknown">Safari?</span><span class="chrome no">Chrome1–48</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer8+</span>
