<a href="#concept-element-categories"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-categories">Categories</a>:  
None.

<a href="#concept-element-contexts"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-contexts">Contexts in which this
element can be used</a>:  
As a child of a
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element">media
element</a>, before any
<a href="#flow-content-2" id="the-track-element:flow-content-2">flow
content</a>.

<a href="#concept-element-content-model"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-content-model">Content model</a>:  
<a href="#concept-content-nothing"
id="the-track-element:concept-content-nothing">Nothing</a>.

<a href="#concept-element-tag-omission"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-tag-omission">Tag omission in
text/html</a>:  
No <a href="#syntax-end-tag" id="the-track-element:syntax-end-tag">end
tag</a>.

<a href="#concept-element-attributes"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-attributes">Content attributes</a>:  
<a href="#global-attributes"
id="the-track-element:global-attributes">Global attributes</a>

[`kind`](#attr-track-kind) — The type of text track

[`src`](#attr-track-src) — Address of the resource

[`srclang`](#attr-track-srclang) — Language of the text track

[`label`](#attr-track-label) — User-visible label

[`default`](#attr-track-default) — Enable the track if no other
<a href="#text-track" id="the-track-element:text-track">text track</a>
is more suitable

<a href="#concept-element-accessibility-considerations"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-accessibility-considerations">Accessibility
considerations</a>:  
[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-track).

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-track).

<a href="#concept-element-dom"
id="the-track-element:concept-element-dom">DOM interface</a>:  
``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTrackElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString kind;
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString srclang;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString label;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean default;

  const unsigned short NONE = 0;
  const unsigned short LOADING = 1;
  const unsigned short LOADED = 2;
  const unsigned short ERROR = 3;
  readonly attribute unsigned short readyState;

  readonly attribute TextTrack track;
};
```

The [`track`](#the-track-element) element allows authors to specify
explicit external timed
<a href="#text-track" id="the-track-element:text-track-2">text
tracks</a> for
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element-2">media
elements</a>. It does not
<a href="#represents" id="the-track-element:represents">represent</a>
anything on its own.

The <span id="attr-track-kind" class="dfn" dfn-for="track"
dfn-type="element-attr">`kind`</span> attribute is an
<a href="#enumerated-attribute"
id="the-track-element:enumerated-attribute">enumerated attribute</a>
with the following keywords and states:

| Keyword | State | Brief description |
|----|----|----|
| <span id="attr-track-kind-keyword-subtitles" class="dfn" dfn-for="track/kind" dfn-type="attr-value">`subtitles`</span> | <span id="attr-track-kind-subtitles" class="dfn">Subtitles</span> | Transcription or translation of the dialogue, suitable for when the sound is available but not understood (e.g. because the user does not understand the language of the <a href="#media-resource" id="the-track-element:media-resource">media
resource</a>'s audio track). Overlaid on the video. |
| <span id="attr-track-kind-keyword-captions" class="dfn" dfn-for="track/kind" dfn-type="attr-value">`captions`</span> | <span id="attr-track-kind-captions" class="dfn">Captions</span> | Transcription or translation of the dialogue, sound effects, relevant musical cues, and other relevant audio information, suitable for when sound is unavailable or not clearly audible (e.g. because it is muted, drowned-out by ambient noise, or because the user is deaf). Overlaid on the video; labeled as appropriate for the hard-of-hearing. |
| <span id="attr-track-kind-keyword-descriptions" class="dfn" dfn-for="track/kind" dfn-type="attr-value">`descriptions`</span> | <span id="attr-track-kind-descriptions" class="dfn">Descriptions</span> | Textual descriptions of the video component of the <a href="#media-resource" id="the-track-element:media-resource-2">media
resource</a>, intended for audio synthesis when the visual component is obscured, unavailable, or not usable (e.g. because the user is interacting with the application without a screen while driving, or because the user is blind). Synthesized as audio. |
| <span id="attr-track-kind-keyword-chapters" class="dfn" dfn-for="track/kind" dfn-type="attr-value">`chapters`</span> | <span id="attr-track-kind-chapters" class="dfn">Chapters metadata</span> | Tracks intended for use from script. Not displayed by the user agent. |
| <span id="attr-track-kind-keyword-metadata" class="dfn" dfn-for="track/kind" dfn-type="attr-value">`metadata`</span> | <span id="attr-track-kind-metadata" class="dfn">Metadata</span> |  |

<div algorithm="">

The attribute's *[missing value default](#missing-value-default)* is the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-subtitles"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-subtitles">subtitles</a> state,
and its *[invalid value default](#invalid-value-default)* is the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-metadata"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-metadata">metadata</a> state.

</div>

The <span id="attr-track-src" class="dfn" dfn-for="track"
dfn-type="element-attr">`src`</span> attribute gives the
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-track-element:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> of the text
track data. The value must be a
<a href="#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces"
id="the-track-element:valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces">valid
non-empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces</a>. This attribute must
be present.

The element has an associated <span id="track-url" class="dfn">track
URL</span> (a string), initially the empty string.

<div algorithm="">

When the element's [`src`](#attr-track-src) attribute is set, run these
steps:

1.  Let `trackURL` be failure.

2.  Let `value` be the element's [`src`](#attr-track-src) attribute
    value.

3.  If `value` is not the empty string, then set `trackURL` to the
    result of <a href="#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url"
    id="the-track-element:encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url">encoding-parsing-and-serializing
    a URL</a> given `value`, relative to the element's
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-track-element:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

4.  Set the element's
    <a href="#track-url" id="the-track-element:track-url">track URL</a>
    to `trackURL` if it is not failure; otherwise to the empty string.

</div>

If the element's
<a href="#track-url" id="the-track-element:track-url-2">track URL</a>
identifies a WebVTT resource, and the element's
[`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attribute is not in the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-chapters"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-chapters">chapters metadata</a> or
<a href="#attr-track-kind-metadata"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-metadata-2">metadata</a> state,
then the WebVTT file must be a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/webvtt/#webvtt-file-using-cue-text"
id="the-track-element:webvtt-file-using-cue-text"
data-x-internal="webvtt-file-using-cue-text">WebVTT file using cue
text</a>. [\[WEBVTT\]](#refsWEBVTT)

The <span id="attr-track-srclang" class="dfn" dfn-for="track"
dfn-type="element-attr">`srclang`</span> attribute gives the language of
the text track data. The value must be a valid BCP 47 language tag. This
attribute must be present if the element's [`kind`](#attr-track-kind)
attribute is in the <a href="#attr-track-kind-subtitles"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-subtitles-2">subtitles</a> state.
[\[BCP47\]](#refsBCP47)

<div algorithm="">

If the element has a [`srclang`](#attr-track-srclang) attribute whose
value is not the empty string, then the element's
<span id="track-language" class="dfn">track language</span> is the value
of the attribute. Otherwise, the element has no
<a href="#track-language" id="the-track-element:track-language">track
language</a>.

</div>

The <span id="attr-track-label" class="dfn" dfn-for="track"
dfn-type="element-attr">`label`</span> attribute gives a user-readable
title for the track. This title is used by user agents when listing
<a href="#attr-track-kind-subtitles"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-subtitles-3">subtitle</a>,
<a href="#attr-track-kind-captions"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-captions">caption</a>, and
<a href="#attr-track-kind-descriptions"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-descriptions">audio
description</a> tracks in their user interface.

The value of the [`label`](#attr-track-label) attribute, if the
attribute is present, must not be the empty string. Furthermore, there
must not be two [`track`](#the-track-element) element children of the
same
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element-3">media
element</a> whose [`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attributes are in the same
state, whose [`srclang`](#attr-track-srclang) attributes are both
missing or have values that represent the same language, and whose
[`label`](#attr-track-label) attributes are again both missing or both
have the same value.

<div algorithm="">

If the element has a [`label`](#attr-track-label) attribute whose value
is not the empty string, then the element's <span id="track-label"
class="dfn">track label</span> is the value of the attribute. Otherwise,
the element's
<a href="#track-label" id="the-track-element:track-label">track
label</a> is an empty string.

</div>

The <span id="attr-track-default" class="dfn" dfn-for="track"
dfn-type="element-attr">`default`</span> attribute is a
<a href="#boolean-attribute"
id="the-track-element:boolean-attribute">boolean attribute</a>, which,
if specified, indicates that the track is to be enabled if the user's
preferences do not indicate that another track would be more
appropriate.

Each
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element-4">media
element</a> must have no more than one [`track`](#the-track-element)
element child whose [`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-subtitles"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-subtitles-4">subtitles</a> or
<a href="#attr-track-kind-captions"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-captions-2">captions</a> state and
whose [`default`](#attr-track-default) attribute is specified.

Each
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element-5">media
element</a> must have no more than one [`track`](#the-track-element)
element child whose [`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-descriptions"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-descriptions-2">description</a>
state and whose [`default`](#attr-track-default) attribute is specified.

Each
<a href="#media-element" id="the-track-element:media-element-6">media
element</a> must have no more than one [`track`](#the-track-element)
element child whose [`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-chapters"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-chapters-2">chapters metadata</a>
state and whose [`default`](#attr-track-default) attribute is specified.

There is no limit on the number of [`track`](#the-track-element)
elements whose [`kind`](#attr-track-kind) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-track-kind-metadata"
id="the-track-element:attr-track-kind-metadata-3">metadata</a> state and
whose [`default`](#attr-track-default) attribute is specified.

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-readystate"
id="dom-track-readystate-dev"><code>readyState</code></a>  
Returns the <a href="#text-track-readiness-state"
id="the-track-element:text-track-readiness-state">text track readiness
state</a>, represented by a number from the following list:

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-none" id="dom-track-none-dev"><code>NONE</code></a>` (0)`  
The <a href="#text-track-not-loaded"
id="the-track-element:text-track-not-loaded">text track not loaded</a>
state.

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-loading"
id="dom-track-loading-dev"><code>LOADING</code></a>` (1)`  
The <a href="#text-track-loading"
id="the-track-element:text-track-loading">text track loading</a> state.

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-loaded"
id="dom-track-loaded-dev"><code>LOADED</code></a>` (2)`  
The <a href="#text-track-loaded"
id="the-track-element:text-track-loaded">text track loaded</a> state.

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-error"
id="dom-track-error-dev"><code>ERROR</code></a>` (3)`  
The <a href="#text-track-failed-to-load"
id="the-track-element:text-track-failed-to-load">text track failed to
load</a> state.

`track``.`<a href="#dom-track-track"
id="dom-track-track-dev"><code>track</code></a>  
Returns the [`TextTrack`](#texttrack) object corresponding to the
<a href="#text-track" id="the-track-element:text-track-3">text track</a>
of the [`track`](#the-track-element) element.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-track-readystate" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement" dfn-type="attribute">`readyState`</span>
attribute must return the numeric value corresponding to the
<a href="#text-track-readiness-state"
id="the-track-element:text-track-readiness-state-2">text track readiness
state</a> of the [`track`](#the-track-element) element's
<a href="#text-track" id="the-track-element:text-track-4">text track</a>,
as defined by the following list:

<span id="dom-track-none" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement" dfn-type="const">`NONE`</span> (numeric value 0)  
The <a href="#text-track-not-loaded"
id="the-track-element:text-track-not-loaded-2">text track not loaded</a>
state.

<span id="dom-track-loading" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement" dfn-type="const">`LOADING`</span> (numeric value 1)  
The <a href="#text-track-loading"
id="the-track-element:text-track-loading-2">text track loading</a>
state.

<span id="dom-track-loaded" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement" dfn-type="const">`LOADED`</span> (numeric value 2)  
The <a href="#text-track-loaded"
id="the-track-element:text-track-loaded-2">text track loaded</a> state.

<span id="dom-track-error" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement" dfn-type="const">`ERROR`</span> (numeric value 3)  
The <a href="#text-track-failed-to-load"
id="the-track-element:text-track-failed-to-load-2">text track failed to
load</a> state.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-track-track" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`track`</span> IDL attribute must, on getting,
return the [`track`](#the-track-element) element's
<a href="#text-track" id="the-track-element:text-track-5">text track</a>'s
corresponding [`TextTrack`](#texttrack) object.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-track-kind" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLTrackElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`kind`</span> IDL attribute must
<a href="#reflect" id="the-track-element:reflect">reflect</a> the
content attribute of the same name,
<a href="#limited-to-only-known-values"
id="the-track-element:limited-to-only-known-values">limited to only
known values</a>.

</div>

<div class="example">

This video has subtitles in several languages:

``` html
<video src="brave.webm">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.en.vtt srclang=en label="English">
 <track kind=captions src=brave.en.hoh.vtt srclang=en label="English for the Hard of Hearing">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.fr.vtt srclang=fr lang=fr label="Français">
 <track kind=subtitles src=brave.de.vtt srclang=de lang=de label="Deutsch">
</video>
```

(The [`lang`](#attr-lang) attributes on the last two describe the
language of the [`label`](#attr-track-label) attribute, not the language
of the subtitles themselves. The language of the subtitles is given by
the [`srclang`](#attr-track-srclang) attribute.)

</div>

#### <span class="secno">4.8.11</span> Media elements<a href="#media-elements" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#htmlmediaelement"
id="media-elements:htmlmediaelement">HTMLMediaElement</a> objects
([`audio`](#the-audio-element) and [`video`](#the-video-element), in
this specification) are simply known as <span id="media-element"
class="dfn" lt="media element" export="">media elements</span>.

``` idl
enum CanPlayTypeResult { "" /* empty string */, "maybe", "probably" };
typedef (MediaStream or MediaSource or Blob) MediaProvider;

[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLMediaElement : HTMLElement {

  // error state
  readonly attribute MediaError? error;

  // network state
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  attribute MediaProvider? srcObject;
  readonly attribute USVString currentSrc;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString? crossOrigin;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_EMPTY = 0;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_IDLE = 1;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_LOADING = 2;
  const unsigned short NETWORK_NO_SOURCE = 3;
  readonly attribute unsigned short networkState;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString preload;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges buffered;
  undefined load();
  CanPlayTypeResult canPlayType(DOMString type);

  // ready state
  const unsigned short HAVE_NOTHING = 0;
  const unsigned short HAVE_METADATA = 1;
  const unsigned short HAVE_CURRENT_DATA = 2;
  const unsigned short HAVE_FUTURE_DATA = 3;
  const unsigned short HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA = 4;
  readonly attribute unsigned short readyState;
  readonly attribute boolean seeking;

  // playback state
  attribute double currentTime;
  undefined fastSeek(double time);
  readonly attribute unrestricted double duration;
  object getStartDate();
  readonly attribute boolean paused;
  attribute double defaultPlaybackRate;
  attribute double playbackRate;
  attribute boolean preservesPitch;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges played;
  readonly attribute TimeRanges seekable;
  readonly attribute boolean ended;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean autoplay;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean loop;
  Promise<undefined> play();
  undefined pause();

  // controls
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean controls;
  attribute double volume;
  attribute boolean muted;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="muted"] attribute boolean defaultMuted;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString loading;

  // tracks
  [SameObject] readonly attribute AudioTrackList audioTracks;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute VideoTrackList videoTracks;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute TextTrackList textTracks;
  TextTrack addTextTrack(TextTrackKind kind, optional DOMString label = "", optional DOMString language = "");
};
```

The <span id="media-element-attributes" class="dfn">media element
attributes</span>, [`src`](#attr-media-src),
[`crossorigin`](#attr-media-crossorigin),
[`preload`](#attr-media-preload), [`autoplay`](#attr-media-autoplay),
[`loop`](#attr-media-loop), [`muted`](#attr-media-muted),
[`controls`](#attr-media-controls), and
[`loading`](#attr-media-loading), apply to all
<a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element">media
elements</a>. They are defined in this section.

The <span id="attr-media-loading" class="dfn" dfn-for="audio,video"
dfn-type="element-attr">`loading`</span> attribute is a
<a href="#lazy-loading-attribute"
id="media-elements:lazy-loading-attribute">lazy loading attribute</a>.
Its purpose is to indicate the policy for loading media resources that
are outside the viewport.

<div algorithm="">

When the [`loading`](#attr-media-loading) attribute's state is changed
to the <a href="#attr-loading-eager-state"
id="media-elements:attr-loading-eager-state">Eager</a> state, the user
agent must run these steps:

1.  Let `resumptionSteps` be the
    <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-2">media
    element</a>'s <a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
    id="media-elements:lazy-load-resumption-steps">lazy load resumption
    steps</a>.

2.  Let `posterResumptionSteps` be null.

    If the
    <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-3">media
    element</a> is a [`video`](#the-video-element) element, then set
    `posterResumptionSteps` to the [`video`](#the-video-element)
    element's <a href="#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps"
    id="media-elements:poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps">poster lazy load
    resumption steps</a>.

3.  If `resumptionSteps` is null and `posterResumptionSteps` is null,
    then return.

4.  If `resumptionSteps` is not null, then:

    1.  Set the
        <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-4">media
        element</a>'s <a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
        id="media-elements:lazy-load-resumption-steps-2">lazy load resumption
        steps</a> to null.

    2.  Invoke `resumptionSteps`.

5.  If `posterResumptionSteps` is not null, then:

    1.  Set the [`video`](#the-video-element) element's
        <a href="#poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps"
        id="media-elements:poster-lazy-load-resumption-steps-2">poster lazy load
        resumption steps</a> to null.

    2.  Invoke `posterResumptionSteps`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-media-loading" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`loading`</span> IDL attribute must
<a href="#reflect" id="media-elements:reflect">reflect</a> the
[`loading`](#attr-media-loading) content attribute,
<a href="#limited-to-only-known-values"
id="media-elements:limited-to-only-known-values">limited to only known
values</a>.

</div>

When the [`loading`](#attr-media-loading) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-loading-lazy-state"
id="media-elements:attr-loading-lazy-state">Lazy</a> state, it takes
precedence over the [`preload`](#attr-media-preload) attribute by
deferring data fetching.

If the [`autoplay`](#attr-media-autoplay) attribute is present and the
[`loading`](#attr-media-loading) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-loading-lazy-state"
id="media-elements:attr-loading-lazy-state-2">Lazy</a> state, the user
agent must also defer starting playback (and any associated network
requests autoplay can introduce) until the element's
<a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
id="media-elements:lazy-load-resumption-steps-3">lazy load resumption
steps</a> are invoked.

<a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-5">Media
elements</a> are used to present audio data, or video and audio data, to
the user. This is referred to as <span id="media-data" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" export="">media data</span> in this section,
since this section applies equally to
<a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-6">media
elements</a> for audio or for video. The term <span id="media-resource"
class="dfn">media resource</span> is used to refer to the complete set
of media data, e.g. the complete video file, or complete audio file.

A <a href="#media-resource" id="media-elements:media-resource">media
resource</a> has an associated <span id="media-resource-origin"
class="dfn">origin</span>, which is either "`none`", "`multiple`",
"`rewritten`", or an
<a href="#concept-origin" id="media-elements:concept-origin">origin</a>.
It is initially set to "`none`".

A <a href="#media-resource" id="media-elements:media-resource-2">media
resource</a> can have multiple audio and video tracks. For the purposes
of a <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-7">media
element</a>, the video data of the
<a href="#media-resource" id="media-elements:media-resource-3">media
resource</a> is only that of the currently selected track (if any) as
given by the element's [`videoTracks`](#dom-media-videotracks) attribute
when the
<a href="#event-loop" id="media-elements:event-loop">event loop</a> last
reached [step 1](#step1), and the audio data of the
<a href="#media-resource" id="media-elements:media-resource-4">media
resource</a> is the result of mixing all the currently enabled tracks
(if any) given by the element's [`audioTracks`](#dom-media-audiotracks)
attribute when the
<a href="#event-loop" id="media-elements:event-loop-2">event loop</a>
last reached [step 1](#step1).

Both [`audio`](#the-audio-element) and [`video`](#the-video-element)
elements can be used for both audio and video. The main difference
between the two is simply that the [`audio`](#the-audio-element) element
has no playback area for visual content (such as video or captions),
whereas the [`video`](#the-video-element) element does.

Each <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-8">media
element</a> has a unique <span id="media-element-event-task-source"
class="dfn">media element event task source</span>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="queue-a-media-element-task" class="dfn" export="">queue a
media element task</span> with a
<a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-9">media
element</a> `element` and a series of steps `steps`,
<a href="#queue-an-element-task"
id="media-elements:queue-an-element-task">queue an element task</a> on
the <a href="#media-element" id="media-elements:media-element-10">media
element</a>'s <a href="#media-element-event-task-source"
id="media-elements:media-element-event-task-source">media element event
task source</a> given `element` and `steps`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

All <a href="#media-element" id="error-codes:media-element">media
elements</a> have an associated error status, which records the last
error the element encountered since its
<a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
id="error-codes:concept-media-load-algorithm">resource selection
algorithm</a> was last invoked. The <span id="dom-media-error"
class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`error`</span> attribute, on getting, must return
the [`MediaError`](#mediaerror) object created for this last error, or
null if there has not been an error.

</div>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface MediaError {
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED = 1;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_NETWORK = 2;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_DECODE = 3;
  const unsigned short MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED = 4;

  readonly attribute unsigned short code;
  readonly attribute DOMString message;
};
```

Returns a specific informative diagnostic message about the error
condition encountered. The message and message format are not generally
uniform across different user agents. If no such message is available,
then the empty string is returned.

Every [`MediaError`](#mediaerror) object has a
<span id="concept-mediaerror-message" class="dfn">message</span>, which
is a string, and a <span id="concept-mediaerror-code"
class="dfn">code</span>, which is one of the following:

<span id="dom-mediaerror-media_err_aborted" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError" dfn-type="const">`MEDIA_ERR_ABORTED`</span> (numeric value 1)  
The fetching process for the
<a href="#media-resource" id="error-codes:media-resource">media
resource</a> was aborted by the user agent at the user's request.

<span id="dom-mediaerror-media_err_network" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError" dfn-type="const">`MEDIA_ERR_NETWORK`</span> (numeric value 2)  
A network error of some description caused the user agent to stop
fetching the
<a href="#media-resource" id="error-codes:media-resource-2">media
resource</a>, after the resource was established to be usable.

<span id="dom-mediaerror-media_err_decode" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError" dfn-type="const">`MEDIA_ERR_DECODE`</span> (numeric value 3)  
An error of some description occurred while decoding the
<a href="#media-resource" id="error-codes:media-resource-3">media
resource</a>, after the resource was established to be usable.

<span id="dom-mediaerror-media_err_src_not_supported" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError" dfn-type="const">`MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED`</span> (numeric value 4)  
The <a href="#media-resource" id="error-codes:media-resource-4">media
resource</a> indicated by the [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute or
<a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
id="error-codes:assigned-media-provider-object">assigned media provider
object</a> was not suitable.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-mediaerror" class="dfn" export="">create a
`MediaError`</span>, given an error code which is one of the above
values, return a new [`MediaError`](#mediaerror) object whose
<a href="#concept-mediaerror-code"
id="error-codes:concept-mediaerror-code">code</a> is the given error
code and whose <a href="#concept-mediaerror-message"
id="error-codes:concept-mediaerror-message">message</a> is a string
containing any details the user agent is able to supply about the cause
of the error condition, or the empty string if the user agent is unable
to supply such details. This message string must not contain only the
information already available via the supplied error code; for example,
it must not simply be a translation of the code into a string format. If
no additional information is available beyond that provided by the error
code, the <a href="#concept-mediaerror-message"
id="error-codes:concept-mediaerror-message-2">message</a> must be set to
the empty string.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-mediaerror-code" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError"
dfn-type="attribute">`code`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="error-codes:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-mediaerror-code"
id="error-codes:concept-mediaerror-code-2">code</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-mediaerror-message" class="dfn" dfn-for="MediaError"
dfn-type="attribute">`message`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="error-codes:this-2"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-mediaerror-message"
id="error-codes:concept-mediaerror-message-3">message</a>.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.8.11.2</span> Location of the media resource<a href="#location-of-the-media-resource" class="self-link"></a>

The <span id="attr-media-src" class="dfn" dfn-for="audio,video"
dfn-type="element-attr">`src`</span> content attribute on
<a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element">media elements</a>
gives the <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> of
the media resource (video, audio) to show. The attribute, if present,
must contain a
<a href="#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces">valid
non-empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces</a>.

If the [`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute is
specified on the <a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-2">media element</a>,
then the [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute must also be specified.

The <span id="attr-media-crossorigin" class="dfn" dfn-for="audio,video"
dfn-type="element-attr">`crossorigin`</span> content attribute on
<a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-3">media elements</a>
is a <a href="#cors-settings-attribute"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:cors-settings-attribute">CORS
settings attribute</a>.

<div algorithm="">

If a <a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-4">media element</a> is
created with a [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute, the user agent must
<a href="#immediately"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:immediately">immediately</a> invoke
the <a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-5">media element</a>'s
<a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-algorithm">resource
selection algorithm</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

If a [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute of a <a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-6">media element</a> is
set or changed, the user agent must invoke the <a href="#media-element"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-7">media element</a>'s
<a href="#media-element-load-algorithm"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-element-load-algorithm">media
element load algorithm</a>. (*Removing* the [`src`](#attr-media-src)
attribute does not do this, even if there are
[`source`](#the-source-element) elements present.)

</div>

There are three ways to specify a <a href="#media-resource"
id="location-of-the-media-resource:media-resource-4">media resource</a>:
the [`srcObject`](#dom-media-srcobject) IDL attribute, the
[`src`](#attr-media-src) content attribute, and
[`source`](#the-source-element) elements. The IDL attribute takes
priority, followed by the content attribute, followed by the elements.

##### <span class="secno">4.8.11.3</span> MIME types<a href="#mime-types" class="self-link"></a>

A <a href="#media-resource" id="mime-types:media-resource">media
resource</a> can be described in terms of its *type*, specifically a
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="mime-types:mime-type" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a>, in
some cases with a `codecs` parameter. (Whether the `codecs` parameter is
allowed or not depends on the MIME type.) [\[RFC6381\]](#refsRFC6381)

Types are usually somewhat incomplete descriptions; for example
"`video/mpeg`" doesn't say anything except what the container type is,
and even a type like "`video/mp4; codecs="avc1.42E01E, mp4a.40.2"`"
doesn't include information like the actual bitrate (only the maximum
bitrate). Thus, given a type, a user agent can often only know whether
it *might* be able to play media of that type (with varying levels of
confidence), or whether it definitely *cannot* play media of that type.

<span id="a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render"
class="dfn">A type that the user agent knows it cannot render</span> is
one that describes a resource that the user agent definitely does not
support, for example because it doesn't recognize the container type, or
it doesn't support the listed codecs.

The <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="mime-types:mime-type-2" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a>
"<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1"
data-x-internal="application/octet-stream"><code
id="mime-types:application/octet-stream">application/octet-stream</code></a>"
with no parameters is never
<a href="#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render"
id="mime-types:a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render">a type
that the user agent knows it cannot render</a>. User agents must treat
that type as equivalent to the lack of any explicit
<a href="#content-type" id="mime-types:content-type">Content-Type
metadata</a> when it is used to label a potential
<a href="#media-resource" id="mime-types:media-resource-2">media
resource</a>.

Only the <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="mime-types:mime-type-3" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a>
"<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1"
data-x-internal="application/octet-stream"><code
id="mime-types:application/octet-stream-2">application/octet-stream</code></a>"
with no parameters is special-cased here; if any parameter appears with
it, it will be treated just like any other
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="mime-types:mime-type-4" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a>.
This is a deviation from the rule that unknown
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="mime-types:mime-type-5" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a>
parameters should be ignored.

`media``.`<a href="#dom-navigator-canplaytype"
id="dom-navigator-canplaytype-dev"><code>canPlayType</code></a>`(``type``)`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

Support in all current engines.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer9+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios yes">Safari
iOS3+</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android yes">WebView
Android37+</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android yes">Opera
Android12.1+</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Returns the empty string (a negative response), "maybe", or "probably"
based on how confident the user agent is that it can play media
resources of the given type.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigator-canplaytype" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement"
dfn-type="method">`canPlayType(``type``)`</span> method must return
<span id="dom-canplaytyperesult-nil" class="dfn">the empty string</span>
if `type` is
<a href="#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render"
id="mime-types:a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render-2">a
type that the user agent knows it cannot render</a> or is the type
"<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1"
data-x-internal="application/octet-stream"><code
id="mime-types:application/octet-stream-3">application/octet-stream</code></a>";
it must return "<span id="dom-canplaytyperesult-probably" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanPlayTypeResult" dfn-type="enum-value">`probably`</span>" if
the user agent is confident that the type represents a
<a href="#media-resource" id="mime-types:media-resource-3">media
resource</a> that it can render if used with this
[`audio`](#the-audio-element) or [`video`](#the-video-element) element;
and it must return "<span id="dom-canplaytyperesult-maybe" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanPlayTypeResult" dfn-type="enum-value">`maybe`</span>"
otherwise. Implementers are encouraged to return
"[`maybe`](#dom-canplaytyperesult-maybe)" unless the type can be
confidently established as being supported or not. Generally, a user
agent should never return
"[`probably`](#dom-canplaytyperesult-probably)" for a type that allows
the `codecs` parameter if that parameter is not present.

</div>

<div class="example">

This script tests to see if the user agent supports a (fictional) new
format to dynamically decide whether to use a
[`video`](#the-video-element) element:

``` html
<section id="video">
 <p><a href="playing-cats.nfv">Download video</a></p>
</section>
<script>
 const videoSection = document.getElementById('video');
 const videoElement = document.createElement('video');
 const support = videoElement.canPlayType('video/x-new-fictional-format;codecs="kittens,bunnies"');
 if (support === "probably") {
   videoElement.setAttribute("src", "playing-cats.nfv");
   videoSection.replaceChildren(videoElement);
 }
</script>
```

</div>

The [`type`](#attr-source-type) attribute of the
[`source`](#the-source-element) element allows the user agent to avoid
downloading resources that use formats it cannot render.

Returns the current state of network activity for the element, from the
codes in the list below.

<div algorithm="">

As <a href="#media-element" id="network-states:media-element">media
elements</a> interact with the network, their current network activity
is represented by the <span id="dom-media-networkstate" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="attribute">`networkState`</span>
attribute. On getting, it must return the current network state of the
element, which must be one of the following values:

</div>

<span id="dom-media-network_empty" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="const">`NETWORK_EMPTY`</span> (numeric value 0)  
The element has not yet been initialized. All attributes are in their
initial states.

<span id="dom-media-network_idle" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="const">`NETWORK_IDLE`</span> (numeric value 1)  
The element's <a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
id="network-states:concept-media-load-algorithm">resource selection
algorithm</a> is active and has selected a <a href="#media-resource"
id="network-states:media-resource">resource</a>, but it is not actually
using the network at this time.

<span id="dom-media-network_loading" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="const">`NETWORK_LOADING`</span> (numeric value 2)  
The user agent is actively trying to download data.

<span id="dom-media-network_no_source" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="const">`NETWORK_NO_SOURCE`</span> (numeric value 3)  
The element's <a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
id="network-states:concept-media-load-algorithm-2">resource selection
algorithm</a> is active, but it has not yet found a
<a href="#media-resource"
id="network-states:media-resource-2">resource</a> to use.

The <a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
id="network-states:concept-media-load-algorithm-3">resource selection
algorithm</a> defined below describes exactly when the
[`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) attribute changes value and
what events fire to indicate changes in this state.

Causes the element to reset and start selecting and loading a new
<a href="#media-resource"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource">media resource</a> from
scratch.

All <a href="#media-element"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element">media elements</a> have a
<span id="can-autoplay-flag" class="dfn">can autoplay flag</span>, which
must begin in the true state, and a
<span id="delaying-the-load-event-flag"
class="dfn">delaying-the-load-event flag</span>, which must begin in the
false state. While the <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag">delaying-the-load-event
flag</a> is true, the element must <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event">delay the load
event</a> of its document.

<div algorithm="">

When the <span id="dom-media-load" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLMediaElement" dfn-type="method">`load()`</span> method on a
<a href="#media-element"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-2">media element</a> is
invoked, the user agent must run the following steps:

1.  Let `resumptionSteps` be the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-3">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:lazy-load-resumption-steps">lazy load
    resumption steps</a>.

2.  If `resumptionSteps` is not null, then:

    1.  Set the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-4">media element</a>'s
        <a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:lazy-load-resumption-steps-2">lazy load
        resumption steps</a> to null.

    2.  Invoke `resumptionSteps`.

3.  Run the <a href="#media-element-load-algorithm"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-load-algorithm">media
    element load algorithm</a>.

</div>

A <a href="#media-element"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-5">media element</a> has an
associated boolean <span id="is-currently-stalled" class="dfn">is
currently stalled</span>, which is initially false.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="media-element-load-algorithm" class="dfn">media element
load algorithm</span> consists of the following steps.

1.  Set this element's <a href="#is-currently-stalled"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:is-currently-stalled">is currently
    stalled</a> to false.

2.  Abort any already-running instance of the
    <a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-algorithm">resource
    selection algorithm</a> for this element.

3.  Let `pending tasks` be a list of all <a href="#concept-task"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task">tasks</a> from the
    <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-6">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#media-element-event-task-source"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-event-task-source">media
    element event task source</a> in one of the
    <a href="#task-queue" id="loading-the-media-resource:task-queue">task
    queues</a>.

4.  For each task in `pending tasks` that would
    <a href="#resolve-pending-play-promises"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:resolve-pending-play-promises">resolve
    pending play promises</a> or <a href="#reject-pending-play-promises"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:reject-pending-play-promises">reject
    pending play promises</a>, immediately resolve or reject those
    promises in the order the corresponding tasks were queued.

5.  Remove each <a href="#concept-task"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task-2">task</a> in
    `pending tasks` from its
    <a href="#task-queue" id="loading-the-media-resource:task-queue-2">task
    queue</a>.

    Basically, pending events and callbacks are discarded and promises
    in-flight to be resolved/rejected are resolved/rejected immediately
    when the media element starts loading a new resource.

6.  If the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-7">media element</a>'s
    [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) is set to
    [`NETWORK_LOADING`](#dom-media-network_loading) or
    [`NETWORK_IDLE`](#dom-media-network_idle),
    <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task">queue a media
    element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-8">media element</a> to
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    [`abort`](#event-media-abort) at the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-9">media element</a>.

7.  If the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-10">media element</a>'s
    [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) is not set to
    [`NETWORK_EMPTY`](#dom-media-network_empty), then:

    1.  <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-2">Queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-11">media element</a>
        to <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`emptied`](#event-media-emptied) at the
        <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-12">media element</a>.

    2.  If a fetching process is in progress for the
        <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-13">media element</a>,
        the user agent should stop it.

    3.  If the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-14">media element</a>'s
        <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object">assigned
        media provider object</a> is a
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#idl-def-mediasource"
        data-x-internal="mediasource"><code
        id="loading-the-media-resource:mediasource">MediaSource</code></a>
        object, then
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/media-source/#mediasource-detach"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:detaching-from-a-media-element"
        data-x-internal="detaching-from-a-media-element">detach</a> it.

    4.  <a href="#forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks">Forget
        the media element's media-resource-specific tracks</a>.

    5.  If [`readyState`](#dom-media-readystate) is not set to
        [`HAVE_NOTHING`](#dom-media-have_nothing), then set it to that
        state.

    6.  If the [`paused`](#dom-media-paused) attribute is false, then:

        1.  Set the [`paused`](#dom-media-paused) attribute to true.

        2.  <a href="#take-pending-play-promises"
            id="loading-the-media-resource:take-pending-play-promises">Take pending
            play promises</a> and
            <a href="#reject-pending-play-promises"
            id="loading-the-media-resource:reject-pending-play-promises-2">reject
            pending play promises</a> with the result and an
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
            id="loading-the-media-resource:aborterror"
            data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="loading-the-media-resource:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

    7.  If [`seeking`](#dom-media-seeking) is true, set it to false.

    8.  Set the <a href="#current-playback-position"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:current-playback-position">current
        playback position</a> to 0.

        Set the <a href="#official-playback-position"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:official-playback-position">official
        playback position</a> to 0.

        If this changed the <a href="#official-playback-position"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:official-playback-position-2">official
        playback position</a>, then
        <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-3">queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-15">media element</a>
        to <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`timeupdate`](#event-media-timeupdate) at the
        <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-16">media element</a>.

    9.  Set the <a href="#timeline-offset"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:timeline-offset">timeline offset</a>
        to Not-a-Number (NaN).

    10. Update the [`duration`](#dom-media-duration) attribute to
        Not-a-Number (NaN).

        The user agent [will not](#durationChange) fire a
        [`durationchange`](#event-media-durationchange) event for this
        particular change of the duration.

8.  Set the [`playbackRate`](#dom-media-playbackrate) attribute to the
    value of the [`defaultPlaybackRate`](#dom-media-defaultplaybackrate)
    attribute.

9.  Set the [`error`](#dom-media-error) attribute to null and the
    <a href="#can-autoplay-flag"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:can-autoplay-flag">can autoplay flag</a>
    to true.

10. Invoke the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-17">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-media-load-algorithm"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-algorithm-2">resource
    selection algorithm</a>.

11. Playback of any previously playing <a href="#media-resource"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource-2">media resource</a>
    for this element stops.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-media-load-algorithm" class="dfn">resource
selection algorithm</span> for a <a href="#media-element"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-18">media element</a> is as
follows. This algorithm is always invoked as part of a
<a href="#concept-task"
id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task-3">task</a>, but one of the
first steps in the algorithm is to return and continue running the
remaining steps
<a href="#in-parallel" id="loading-the-media-resource:in-parallel">in
parallel</a>. In addition, this algorithm interacts closely with the
<a href="#event-loop" id="loading-the-media-resource:event-loop">event
loop</a> mechanism; in particular, it has <a href="#synchronous-section"
id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section">synchronous
sections</a> (which are triggered as part of the
<a href="#event-loop" id="loading-the-media-resource:event-loop-2">event
loop</a> algorithm). Steps in such sections are marked with ⌛.

1.  Set the element's [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate)
    attribute to the [`NETWORK_NO_SOURCE`](#dom-media-network_no_source)
    value.

2.  Set the element's <a href="#show-poster-flag"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:show-poster-flag">show poster flag</a>
    to true.

3.  If the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-19">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#lazy-loading-attribute"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:lazy-loading-attribute">lazy loading
    attribute</a> is in the <a href="#attr-loading-eager-state"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:attr-loading-eager-state">Eager</a>
    state or <a href="#concept-n-noscript"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-n-noscript">scripting is
    disabled</a>, set the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-20">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag-2">delaying-the-load-event
    flag</a> to true (this <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event-2">delays the load
    event</a>).

4.  <a href="#await-a-stable-state"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:await-a-stable-state">Await a stable
    state</a>, allowing the <a href="#concept-task"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task-4">task</a> that invoked
    this algorithm to continue. The <a href="#synchronous-section"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-2">synchronous
    section</a> consists of all the remaining steps of this algorithm
    until the algorithm says the <a href="#synchronous-section"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-3">synchronous
    section</a> has ended. (Steps in <a href="#synchronous-section"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-4">synchronous
    sections</a> are marked with ⌛.)

5.  ⌛ If the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-21">media element</a>'s
    <a href="#blocked-on-parser"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:blocked-on-parser">blocked-on-parser</a>
    flag is false, then
    <a href="#populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:populate-the-list-of-pending-text-tracks">populate
    the list of pending text tracks</a>.

6.  ⌛ If the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-22">media element</a>
    has an <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object-2">assigned
    media provider object</a>, then let `mode` be *object*.

    ⌛ Otherwise, if the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-23">media element</a>
    has no <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object-3">assigned
    media provider object</a> but has a [`src`](#attr-media-src)
    attribute, then let `mode` be *attribute*.

    ⌛ Otherwise, if the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-24">media element</a>
    does not have an <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object-4">assigned
    media provider object</a> and does not have a
    [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute, but does have a
    [`source`](#the-source-element) element child, then let `mode` be
    *children* and let `candidate` be the first such
    [`source`](#the-source-element) element child in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:tree-order"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

    ⌛ Otherwise, the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-25">media element</a>
    has no <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object-5">assigned
    media provider object</a> and has neither a [`src`](#attr-media-src)
    attribute nor a [`source`](#the-source-element) element child:

    1.  ⌛ Set the [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) to
        [`NETWORK_EMPTY`](#dom-media-network_empty).

    2.  ⌛ Set the element's <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag-3">delaying-the-load-event
        flag</a> to false. This stops <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event-3">delaying the load
        event</a>.

    3.  End the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-5">synchronous
        section</a> and return.

7.  ⌛ Set the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-26">media element</a>'s
    [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) to
    [`NETWORK_LOADING`](#dom-media-network_loading).

8.  ⌛ <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-4">Queue a
    media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-27">media element</a>
    to <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    [`loadstart`](#event-media-loadstart) at the
    <a href="#media-element"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-28">media element</a>.

9.  Run the appropriate steps from the following list:

    If `mode` is *object*  
    1.  ⌛ Set the [`currentSrc`](#dom-media-currentsrc) attribute to
        the empty string.

    2.  End the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-6">synchronous
        section</a>, continuing the remaining steps
        <a href="#in-parallel" id="loading-the-media-resource:in-parallel-2">in
        parallel</a>.

    3.  Run the <a href="#concept-media-load-resource"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-resource">resource
        fetch algorithm</a> with the
        <a href="#assigned-media-provider-object"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:assigned-media-provider-object-6">assigned
        media provider object</a>. If that algorithm returns without
        aborting *this* one, then the load failed.

    4.  *Failed with media provider*: Reaching this step indicates that
        the media resource failed to load.
        <a href="#take-pending-play-promises"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:take-pending-play-promises-2">Take
        pending play promises</a> and
        <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-5">queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-29">media element</a>
        to run the <a href="#dedicated-media-source-failure-steps"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:dedicated-media-source-failure-steps">dedicated
        media source failure steps</a> with the result.

    5.  Wait for the <a href="#concept-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task-5">task</a> queued
        by the previous step to have executed.

    6.  Return. The element won't attempt to load another resource until
        this algorithm is triggered again.

    If `mode` is *attribute*  
    1.  ⌛ If the [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute's value is the
        empty string, then end the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-7">synchronous
        section</a>, and jump down to the *failed with attribute* step
        below.

    2.  ⌛ Let `urlRecord` be the result of
        <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing
        a URL</a> given the [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute's value,
        relative to the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-30">media element</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:node-document"
        data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> when the
        [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute was last changed.

    3.  ⌛ If `urlRecord` is not failure, then set the
        [`currentSrc`](#dom-media-currentsrc) attribute to the result of
        applying the
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-url-serializer"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">URL serializer</a> to
        `urlRecord`.

    4.  End the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-8">synchronous
        section</a>, continuing the remaining steps
        <a href="#in-parallel" id="loading-the-media-resource:in-parallel-3">in
        parallel</a>.

    5.  If `urlRecord` is not failure, then run the
        <a href="#concept-media-load-resource"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-resource-2">resource
        fetch algorithm</a> with `urlRecord`. If that algorithm returns
        without aborting *this* one, then the load failed.

    6.  *Failed with attribute*: Reaching this step indicates that the
        media resource failed to load or that `urlRecord` is failure.
        <a href="#take-pending-play-promises"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:take-pending-play-promises-3">Take
        pending play promises</a> and
        <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-6">queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-31">media element</a>
        to run the <a href="#dedicated-media-source-failure-steps"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:dedicated-media-source-failure-steps-2">dedicated
        media source failure steps</a> with the result.

    7.  Wait for the <a href="#concept-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-task-6">task</a> queued
        by the previous step to have executed.

    8.  Return. The element won't attempt to load another resource until
        this algorithm is triggered again.

    Otherwise (`mode` is *children*)  
    1.  ⌛ Let `pointer` be a position defined by two adjacent nodes in
        the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-32">media element</a>'s
        child list, treating the start of the list (before the first
        child in the list, if any) and end of the list (after the last
        child in the list, if any) as nodes in their own right. One node
        is the node before `pointer`, and the other node is the node
        after `pointer`. Initially, let `pointer` be the position
        between the `candidate` node and the next node, if there are
        any, or the end of the list, if it is the last node.

        As nodes are
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert-ext"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-node-insert-ext"
        data-x-internal="concept-node-insert-ext">inserted</a>,
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove-ext"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-node-remove-ext"
        data-x-internal="concept-node-remove-ext">removed</a>, and
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-move-ext"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-node-move-ext"
        data-x-internal="concept-node-move-ext">moved</a> into the
        <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-33">media element</a>,
        `pointer` must be updated as follows:

        If a new node is <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert-ext"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-node-insert-ext-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-node-insert-ext">inserted</a> or <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-move-ext"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-node-move-ext-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-node-move-ext">moved</a> between the two nodes that define `pointer`  
        Let `pointer` be the point between the node before `pointer` and
        the new node. In other words, insertions at `pointer` go after
        `pointer`.

        If the node before `pointer` is removed  
        Let `pointer` be the point between the node after `pointer` and
        the node before the node after `pointer`. In other words,
        `pointer` doesn't move relative to the remaining nodes.

        If the node after `pointer` is removed  
        Let `pointer` be the point between the node before `pointer` and
        the node after the node before `pointer`. Just as with the
        previous case, `pointer` doesn't move relative to the remaining
        nodes.

        Other changes don't affect `pointer`.

    2.  ⌛ *Process candidate*: If `candidate` does not have a
        [`src`](#attr-source-src) attribute, or if its
        [`src`](#attr-source-src) attribute's value is the empty string,
        then end the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-9">synchronous
        section</a>, and jump down to the *failed with elements* step
        below.

    3.  ⌛ If `candidate` has a [`media`](#attr-source-media) attribute
        whose value does not <a href="#matches-the-environment"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:matches-the-environment">match the
        environment</a>, then end the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-10">synchronous
        section</a>, and jump down to the *failed with elements* step
        below.

    4.  ⌛ Let `urlRecord` be the result of
        <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:encoding-parsing-a-url-2">encoding-parsing
        a URL</a> given `candidate`'s [`src`](#attr-media-src)
        attribute's value, relative to `candidate`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:node-document-2"
        data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> when the
        [`src`](#attr-media-src) attribute was last changed.

    5.  ⌛ If `urlRecord` is failure, then end the
        <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-11">synchronous
        section</a>, and jump down to the *failed with elements* step
        below.

    6.  ⌛ If `candidate` has a [`type`](#attr-source-type) attribute
        whose value, when parsed as a
        <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:mime-type"
        data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME type</a> (including any codecs
        described by the `codecs` parameter, for types that define that
        parameter), represents
        <a href="#a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:a-type-that-the-user-agent-knows-it-cannot-render">a
        type that the user agent knows it cannot render</a>, then end
        the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-12">synchronous
        section</a>, and jump down to the *failed with elements* step
        below.

    7.  ⌛ Set the [`currentSrc`](#dom-media-currentsrc) attribute to
        the result of applying the
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-url-serializer-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">URL serializer</a> to
        `urlRecord`.

    8.  End the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-13">synchronous
        section</a>, continuing the remaining steps
        <a href="#in-parallel" id="loading-the-media-resource:in-parallel-4">in
        parallel</a>.

    9.  Run the <a href="#concept-media-load-resource"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-media-load-resource-3">resource
        fetch algorithm</a> with `urlRecord`. If that algorithm returns
        without aborting *this* one, then the load failed.

    10. *Failed with elements*: <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-7">Queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-34">media element</a>
        to <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire-5"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
        [`error`](#event-source-error) at `candidate`.

    11. <a href="#await-a-stable-state"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:await-a-stable-state-2">Await a stable
        state</a>. The <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-14">synchronous
        section</a> consists of all the remaining steps of this
        algorithm until the algorithm says the
        <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-15">synchronous
        section</a> has ended. (Steps in <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-16">synchronous
        sections</a> are marked with ⌛.)

    12. ⌛
        <a href="#forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks-2">Forget
        the media element's media-resource-specific tracks</a>.

    13. ⌛ *Find next candidate*: Let `candidate` be null.

    14. ⌛ *Search loop*: If the node after `pointer` is the end of the
        list, then jump to the *waiting* step below.

    15. ⌛ If the node after `pointer` is a
        [`source`](#the-source-element) element, let `candidate` be that
        element.

    16. ⌛ Advance `pointer` so that the node before `pointer` is now
        the node that was after `pointer`, and the node after `pointer`
        is the node after the node that used to be after `pointer`, if
        any.

    17. ⌛ If `candidate` is null, jump back to the *search loop* step.
        Otherwise, jump back to the *process candidate* step.

    18. ⌛ *Waiting*: Set the element's
        [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) attribute to the
        [`NETWORK_NO_SOURCE`](#dom-media-network_no_source) value.

    19. ⌛ Set the element's <a href="#show-poster-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:show-poster-flag-2">show poster flag</a>
        to true.

    20. ⌛ <a href="#queue-a-media-element-task"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:queue-a-media-element-task-8">Queue a
        media element task</a> given the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-35">media element</a>
        to set the element's <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag-4">delaying-the-load-event
        flag</a> to false. This stops <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event-4">delaying the load
        event</a>.

    21. End the <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-17">synchronous
        section</a>, continuing the remaining steps
        <a href="#in-parallel" id="loading-the-media-resource:in-parallel-5">in
        parallel</a>.

    22. Wait until the node after `pointer` is a node other than the end
        of the list. (This step might wait forever.)

    23. <a href="#await-a-stable-state"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:await-a-stable-state-3">Await a stable
        state</a>. The <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-18">synchronous
        section</a> consists of all the remaining steps of this
        algorithm until the algorithm says the
        <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-19">synchronous
        section</a> has ended. (Steps in <a href="#synchronous-section"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:synchronous-section-20">synchronous
        sections</a> are marked with ⌛.)

    24. ⌛ Set the element's <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag-5">delaying-the-load-event
        flag</a> back to true (this <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event-5">delays the load
        event</a> again, in case it hasn't been fired yet).

    25. ⌛ Set the [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) back to
        [`NETWORK_LOADING`](#dom-media-network_loading).

    26. ⌛ Jump back to the *find next candidate* step above.

    The <span id="dedicated-media-source-failure-steps"
    class="dfn">dedicated media source failure steps</span> with a list
    of promises `promises` are the following steps:

    1.  Set the [`error`](#dom-media-error) attribute to the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-mediaerror"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:creating-a-mediaerror">creating a
        <code>MediaError</code></a> with
        [`MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED`](#dom-mediaerror-media_err_src_not_supported).

    2.  <a href="#forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:forget-the-media-element&#39;s-media-resource-specific-tracks-3">Forget
        the media element's media-resource-specific tracks</a>.

    3.  Set the element's [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate)
        attribute to the
        [`NETWORK_NO_SOURCE`](#dom-media-network_no_source) value.

    4.  Set the element's <a href="#show-poster-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:show-poster-flag-3">show poster flag</a>
        to true.

    5.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-event-fire-6"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
        [`error`](#event-media-error) at the <a href="#media-element"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:media-element-36">media element</a>.

    6.  <a href="#reject-pending-play-promises"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:reject-pending-play-promises-3">Reject
        pending play promises</a> with `promises` and a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:notsupportederror"
        data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="loading-the-media-resource:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

    7.  Set the element's <a href="#delaying-the-load-event-flag"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delaying-the-load-event-flag-6">delaying-the-load-event
        flag</a> to false. This stops <a href="#delay-the-load-event"
        id="loading-the-media-resource:delay-the-load-event-6">delaying the load
        event</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="verify-a-media-response" class="dfn">verify a media
response</span> given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`, a
<a href="#media-resource"
id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource-3">media resource</a>
`resource`, and "`entire resource`" or a (number, number or
"`until end`") tuple `byteRange`:

1.  If `response` is a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:network-error"
    data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>, then return
    false.

2.  If `byteRange` is "`entire resource`", then return true.

3.  Let `internalResponse` be `response`'s <a href="#unsafe-response"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:unsafe-response">unsafe response</a>.

4.  If `internalResponse`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-response-status"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is 200, then
    return true.

5.  If `internalResponse`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-response-status-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not 206,
    then return false.

6.  If the result of <a
    href="https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#extract-content-range-values"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:extract-content-range-values"
    data-x-internal="extract-content-range-values">extracting content-range
    values</a> from `internalResponse` is failure, then return false.

    Note that the extracted values are not used, and in particular are
    not compared to `byteRange`. So this step serves as syntactic
    validation of the
    \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.content-range"
    data-x-internal="http-content-range"><code
    id="loading-the-media-resource:http-content-range">Content-Range</code></a>\`
    header, but if the
    \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.content-range"
    data-x-internal="http-content-range"><code
    id="loading-the-media-resource:http-content-range-2">Content-Range</code></a>\`
    values on the response mismatch the
    \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7233.html#header.range"
    data-x-internal="http-range"><code
    id="loading-the-media-resource:http-range">Range</code></a>\` values
    on the request, that is not considered a failure.

7.  Let `origin` be "`rewritten`" if `internalResponse`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-response-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a> is null; otherwise
    `internalResponse`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-response-url-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-url-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>.

8.  Let `previousOrigin` be `resource`'s
    <a href="#media-resource-origin"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource-origin">origin</a>.

9.  If any of the following are true:

    - `previousOrigin` is "`none`";

    - `origin` and `previousOrigin` are "`rewritten`"; or

    - `origin` and `previousOrigin` are <a href="#concept-origin"
      id="loading-the-media-resource:concept-origin">origins</a>, and
      `origin` is
      <a href="#same-origin" id="loading-the-media-resource:same-origin">same
      origin</a> with `previousOrigin`,

    then set `resource`'s <a href="#media-resource-origin"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource-origin-2">origin</a>
    to `origin`.

    Otherwise, if `response` is <a href="#cors-cross-origin"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:cors-cross-origin">CORS-cross-origin</a>,
    then return false.

    Otherwise, set `resource`'s <a href="#media-resource-origin"
    id="loading-the-media-resource:media-resource-origin-3">origin</a>
    to "`multiple`".
