implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-number).

[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute in the
<a href="#range-state-(type=range)"
id="the-input-element:range-state-(type=range)">Range</a> state: [for
authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-input-range); [for
implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-range).

[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute in the
<a href="#color-state-(type=color)"
id="the-input-element:color-state-(type=color)">Color</a> state: [for
authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-input-color); [for
implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-color).

[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute in the
<a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)">Checkbox</a>
state: [for
authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-input-checkbox); [for
implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-checkbox).

[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute in the
<a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"

state: [for authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-input-radio);
[for implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-radio).

[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute in the

id="the-input-element:file-upload-state-(type=file)-2">File Upload</a>

[for implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-input-file).

<a href="#concept-element-dom"
id="the-input-element:concept-element-dom">DOM interface</a>:  
``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLInputElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString accept;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean alpha;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString alt;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString autocomplete;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="checked"] attribute boolean defaultChecked;
  attribute boolean checked;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString colorSpace;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString dirName;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  attribute FileList? files;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute USVString formAction;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formEnctype;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formMethod;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean formNoValidate;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString formTarget;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute unsigned long height;
  attribute boolean indeterminate;
  readonly attribute HTMLDataListElement? list;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString max;
  [CEReactions, ReflectNonNegative] attribute long maxLength;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString min;
  [CEReactions, ReflectNonNegative] attribute long minLength;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean multiple;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString pattern;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString placeholder;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean readOnly;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean required;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute unsigned long size;
  [CEReactions, ReflectURL] attribute USVString src;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString step;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="value"] attribute DOMString defaultValue;
  [CEReactions] attribute [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString value;
  attribute object? valueAsDate;
  attribute unrestricted double valueAsNumber;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute unsigned long width;

  undefined stepUp(optional long n = 1);
  undefined stepDown(optional long n = 1);

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  readonly attribute NodeList? labels;

  undefined select();
  attribute unsigned long? selectionStart;
  attribute unsigned long? selectionEnd;
  attribute DOMString? selectionDirection;
  undefined setRangeText(DOMString replacement);
  undefined setRangeText(DOMString replacement, unsigned long start, unsigned long end, optional SelectionMode selectionMode = "preserve");
  undefined setSelectionRange(unsigned long start, unsigned long end, optional DOMString direction);

  undefined showPicker();

  // also has obsolete members
};
HTMLInputElement includes PopoverTargetAttributes;
```

The [`input`](#the-input-element) element
<a href="#represents" id="the-input-element:represents">represents</a> a
typed data field, usually with a form control to allow the user to edit
the data.

The <span id="attr-input-type" class="dfn" dfn-for="input"
dfn-type="element-attr">`type`</span> attribute controls the data type
(and associated control) of the element. It is an
<a href="#enumerated-attribute"
id="the-input-element:enumerated-attribute">enumerated attribute</a>
with the following keywords and states:

| Keyword | State | Data type | Control type |
|----|----|----|----|
| <span id="attr-input-type-hidden-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`hidden`</span> | <a href="#hidden-state-(type=hidden)"
id="the-input-element:hidden-state-(type=hidden)-6">Hidden</a> | An arbitrary string | n/a |
| <span id="attr-input-type-text-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`text`</span> | <a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="the-input-element:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-3">Text</a> | Text with no line breaks | A text control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-search-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`search`</span> | <a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="the-input-element:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-4">Search</a> | Text with no line breaks | Search control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-tel-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`tel`</span> | <a href="#telephone-state-(type=tel)"
id="the-input-element:telephone-state-(type=tel)-2">Telephone</a> | Text with no line breaks | A text control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-url-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`url`</span> | <a href="#url-state-(type=url)"
id="the-input-element:url-state-(type=url)-2">URL</a> | An absolute URL | A text control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-email-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`email`</span> | <a href="#email-state-(type=email)"
id="the-input-element:email-state-(type=email)-2">Email</a> | An email address or list of email addresses | A text control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-password-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`password`</span> | <a href="#password-state-(type=password)"
id="the-input-element:password-state-(type=password)-2">Password</a> | Text with no line breaks (sensitive information) | A text control that obscures data entry |
| <span id="attr-input-type-date-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`date`</span> | <a href="#date-state-(type=date)"
id="the-input-element:date-state-(type=date)-2">Date</a> | A date (year, month, day) with no time zone | A date control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-month-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`month`</span> | <a href="#month-state-(type=month)"
id="the-input-element:month-state-(type=month)-2">Month</a> | A date consisting of a year and a month with no time zone | A month control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-week-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`week`</span> | <a href="#week-state-(type=week)"
id="the-input-element:week-state-(type=week)-2">Week</a> | A date consisting of a week-year number and a week number with no time zone | A week control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-time-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`time`</span> | <a href="#time-state-(type=time)"
id="the-input-element:time-state-(type=time)-2">Time</a> | A time (hour, minute, seconds, fractional seconds) with no time zone | A time control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-datetime-local-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`datetime-local`</span> | <a href="#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)"
id="the-input-element:local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)-2">Local
Date and Time</a> | A date and time (year, month, day, hour, minute, second, fraction of a second) with no time zone | A date and time control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-number-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`number`</span> | <a href="#number-state-(type=number)"
id="the-input-element:number-state-(type=number)-2">Number</a> | A numerical value | A text control or spinner control |
| <span id="attr-input-type-range-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`range`</span> | <a href="#range-state-(type=range)"
id="the-input-element:range-state-(type=range)-2">Range</a> | A numerical value, with the extra semantic that the exact value is not important | A slider control or similar |
| <span id="attr-input-type-color-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`color`</span> | <a href="#color-state-(type=color)"
id="the-input-element:color-state-(type=color)-2">Color</a> | An sRGB color with 8-bit red, green, and blue components | A color picker |
| <span id="attr-input-type-checkbox-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`checkbox`</span> | <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-2">Checkbox</a> | A set of zero or more values from a predefined list | A checkbox |
| <span id="attr-input-type-radio-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`radio`</span> | <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
id="the-input-element:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-2">Radio
Button</a> | An enumerated value | A radio button |
| <span id="attr-input-type-file-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`file`</span> | <a href="#file-upload-state-(type=file)"
id="the-input-element:file-upload-state-(type=file)-3">File Upload</a> | Zero or more files each with a <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="the-input-element:mime-type" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME
type</a> and optionally a filename | A label and a button |
| <span id="attr-input-type-submit-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`submit`</span> | <a href="#submit-button-state-(type=submit)"
id="the-input-element:submit-button-state-(type=submit)-2">Submit
Button</a> | An enumerated value, with the extra semantic that it must be the last value selected and initiates form submission | A button |
| <span id="attr-input-type-image-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`image`</span> | <a href="#image-button-state-(type=image)"
id="the-input-element:image-button-state-(type=image)-2">Image
Button</a> | A coordinate, relative to a particular image's size, with the extra semantic that it must be the last value selected and initiates form submission | Either a clickable image, or a button |
| <span id="attr-input-type-reset-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`reset`</span> | <a href="#reset-button-state-(type=reset)"
id="the-input-element:reset-button-state-(type=reset)-2">Reset
Button</a> | n/a | A button |
| <span id="attr-input-type-button-keyword" class="dfn" dfn-for="input/type" dfn-type="attr-value">`button`</span> | <a href="#button-state-(type=button)"
id="the-input-element:button-state-(type=button)-2">Button</a> | n/a | A button |

<div algorithm="">

The attribute's *[missing value default](#missing-value-default)* and
*[invalid value default](#invalid-value-default)* are both the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="the-input-element:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-5">Text</a>
state.

Which of the [`accept`](#attr-input-accept),
[`alpha`](#attr-input-alpha), [`alt`](#attr-input-alt),
[`autocomplete`](#attr-fe-autocomplete),
[`checked`](#attr-input-checked),
[`colorspace`](#attr-input-colorspace), [`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname),
[`formaction`](#attr-fs-formaction),
[`formenctype`](#attr-fs-formenctype),
[`formmethod`](#attr-fs-formmethod),
[`formnovalidate`](#attr-fs-formnovalidate),
[`formtarget`](#attr-fs-formtarget), [`height`](#attr-dim-height),
[`list`](#attr-input-list), [`max`](#attr-input-max),
[`maxlength`](#attr-input-maxlength), [`min`](#attr-input-min),
[`minlength`](#attr-input-minlength),
[`multiple`](#attr-input-multiple), [`pattern`](#attr-input-pattern),
[`placeholder`](#attr-input-placeholder),
[`readonly`](#attr-input-readonly), [`required`](#attr-input-required),
[`size`](#attr-input-size), [`src`](#attr-input-src),
[`step`](#attr-input-step), and [`width`](#attr-dim-width) content
attributes, the [`checked`](#dom-input-checked),
[`files`](#dom-input-files), [`valueAsDate`](#dom-input-valueasdate),
[`valueAsNumber`](#dom-input-valueasnumber), and
[`list`](#dom-input-list) IDL attributes, the
[`select()`](#dom-textarea/input-select) method, the
[`selectionStart`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart),
[`selectionEnd`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend), and
[`selectionDirection`](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection), IDL
attributes, the [`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext) and
[`setSelectionRange()`](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange) methods,
the [`stepUp()`](#dom-input-stepup) and
[`stepDown()`](#dom-input-stepdown) methods, and the
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
data-x-internal="event-input"><code
id="the-input-element:event-input">input</code></a> and
[`change`](#event-change) events <span id="concept-input-apply"
class="dfn">apply</span> to an [`input`](#the-input-element) element
depends on the state of its [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute. The
subsections that define each type also clearly define in normative
"bookkeeping" sections which of these feature apply, and which
<span id="do-not-apply" class="dfn">do not apply</span>, to each type.
The behavior of these features depends on whether they apply or not, as
defined in their various sections (q.v. for [content
attributes](#common-input-element-attributes), for
[APIs](#common-input-element-apis), for
[events](#common-input-element-events)).

Some states of the [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute define a
<span id="value-sanitization-algorithm" class="dfn">value sanitization
algorithm</span>.

Each [`input`](#the-input-element) element has a
<a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value">value</a>, which is exposed by
the [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute. Some states define an
<span id="concept-input-value-string-number" class="dfn">algorithm to
convert a string to a number</span>, an
<span id="concept-input-value-number-string" class="dfn">algorithm to
convert a number to a string</span>, an
<span id="concept-input-value-string-date" class="dfn">algorithm to
convert a string to a `Date` object</span>, and an
<span id="concept-input-value-date-string" class="dfn">algorithm to
convert a `Date` object to a string</span>, which are used by
[`max`](#attr-input-max), [`min`](#attr-input-min),
[`step`](#attr-input-step), [`valueAsDate`](#dom-input-valueasdate),
[`valueAsNumber`](#dom-input-valueasnumber), and
[`stepUp()`](#dom-input-stepup).

<div algorithm="">

An [`input`](#the-input-element) element's <a href="#concept-fe-dirty"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-dirty">dirty value flag</a> must be set
to true whenever the user interacts with the control in a way that
changes the <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-2">value</a>. (It is also set to
true when the value is programmatically changed, as described in the
definition of the [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute.)

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="attr-input-value" class="dfn" dfn-for="input"
dfn-type="element-attr">`value`</span> content attribute gives the
default <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-3">value</a> of the
[`input`](#the-input-element) element. When the
[`value`](#attr-input-value) content attribute is added, set, or
removed, if the control's <a href="#concept-fe-dirty"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-dirty-2">dirty value flag</a> is false,
the user agent must set the <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-4">value</a> of the element to
the value of the [`value`](#attr-input-value) content attribute, if
there is one, or the empty string otherwise, and then run the current
<a href="#value-sanitization-algorithm"
id="the-input-element:value-sanitization-algorithm">value sanitization
algorithm</a>, if one is defined.

</div>

Each [`input`](#the-input-element) element has a
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked">checkedness</a>, which is
exposed by the [`checked`](#dom-input-checked) IDL attribute.

<div algorithm="">

Each [`input`](#the-input-element) element has a boolean
<span id="concept-input-checked-dirty-flag" class="dfn">dirty
checkedness flag</span>. When it is true, the element is said to have a
<span id="concept-input-checked-dirty" class="dfn">*dirty
checkedness*</span>. The <a href="#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag"
id="the-input-element:concept-input-checked-dirty-flag">dirty
checkedness flag</a> must be initially set to false when the element is
created, and must be set to true whenever the user interacts with the
control in a way that changes the <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-2">checkedness</a>.

</div>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Element/input#checked](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#checked "The <input> HTML element is used to create interactive controls for web-based forms in order to accept data from the user; a wide variety of types of input data and control widgets are available, depending on the device and user agent. The <input> element is one of the most powerful and complex in all of HTML due to the sheer number of combinations of input types and attributes.")

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="attr-input-checked" class="dfn" dfn-for="input"
dfn-type="element-attr">`checked`</span> content attribute is a
<a href="#boolean-attribute"
id="the-input-element:boolean-attribute">boolean attribute</a> that
gives the default <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-3">checkedness</a> of the
[`input`](#the-input-element) element. When the
[`checked`](#attr-input-checked) content attribute is added, if the
control does not have *[dirty
checkedness](#concept-input-checked-dirty)*, the user agent must set the
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-4">checkedness</a> of the
element to true; when the [`checked`](#attr-input-checked) content
attribute is removed, if the control does not have *[dirty
checkedness](#concept-input-checked-dirty)*, the user agent must set the
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-5">checkedness</a> of the
element to false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#concept-form-reset-control"
id="the-input-element:concept-form-reset-control">reset algorithm</a>
for [`input`](#the-input-element) elements is to set its
<a href="#user-validity" id="the-input-element:user-validity">user
validity</a>, <a href="#concept-fe-dirty"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-dirty-3">dirty value flag</a>, and
<a href="#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag"
id="the-input-element:concept-input-checked-dirty-flag-2">dirty
checkedness flag</a> back to false, set the <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-5">value</a> of the element to
the value of the [`value`](#attr-input-value) content attribute, if
there is one, or the empty string otherwise, set the
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-6">checkedness</a> of the
element to true if the element has a [`checked`](#attr-input-checked)
content attribute and false if it does not, empty the list of
<a href="#concept-input-type-file-selected"
id="the-input-element:concept-input-type-file-selected">selected
files</a>, and then invoke the <a href="#value-sanitization-algorithm"
id="the-input-element:value-sanitization-algorithm-2">value sanitization
algorithm</a>, if the [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute's current
state defines one.

</div>

Each [`input`](#the-input-element) element can be
*[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*. Except where otherwise specified, an
[`input`](#the-input-element) element is always
*[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*. Similarly, except where otherwise
specified, the user agent should not allow the user to modify the
element's <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-6">value</a> or
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-7">checkedness</a>.

<div algorithm="">

When an [`input`](#the-input-element) element is
<a href="#concept-fe-disabled"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-disabled">disabled</a>, it is not
*[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*.

</div>

The [`readonly`](#attr-input-readonly) attribute can also in some cases
(e.g. for the <a href="#date-state-(type=date)"
id="the-input-element:date-state-(type=date)-4">Date</a> state, but not
the <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-4">Checkbox</a>
state) stop an [`input`](#the-input-element) element from being
*[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*.

The [`input`](#the-input-element) element can
<span id="input-support-picker" class="dfn">support a picker</span>. A
picker is a user interface element that allows the end user to choose a
value. Whether an [`input`](#the-input-element) element supports a
picker depends on the [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute state and
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
id="the-input-element:implementation-defined"
data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
behavior. An [`input`](#the-input-element) element must support a picker
when its [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
<a href="#file-upload-state-(type=file)"
id="the-input-element:file-upload-state-(type=file)-5">File Upload</a>
state.

<div class="note">

As of the time of this writing, typical browser implementations show
such picker UI for:

- [`input`](#the-input-element) elements whose
  [`type`](#attr-input-type) attributes are in the
  <a href="#date-state-(type=date)"
  id="the-input-element:date-state-(type=date)-5">Date</a>,
  <a href="#month-state-(type=month)"
  id="the-input-element:month-state-(type=month)-4">Month</a>,
  <a href="#week-state-(type=week)"
  id="the-input-element:week-state-(type=week)-4">Week</a>,
  <a href="#time-state-(type=time)"
  id="the-input-element:time-state-(type=time)-4">Time</a>,
  <a href="#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)"
  id="the-input-element:local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)-4">Local
  Date and Time</a>, and <a href="#color-state-(type=color)"
  id="the-input-element:color-state-(type=color)-4">Color</a> states;

- [`input`](#the-input-element) elements in various states that have a
  <a href="#concept-input-list"
  id="the-input-element:concept-input-list">suggestions source element</a>;

- [`input`](#the-input-element) elements whose
  [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
  <a href="#file-upload-state-(type=file)"
  id="the-input-element:file-upload-state-(type=file)-6">File Upload</a>
  state; and

- [`select`](#the-select-element) elements.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone-ext"
id="the-input-element:concept-node-clone-ext"
data-x-internal="concept-node-clone-ext">cloning steps</a> for
[`input`](#the-input-element) elements given `node`, `copy`, and
`subtree` are to propagate the <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-7">value</a>,
<a href="#concept-fe-dirty"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-dirty-4">dirty value flag</a>,
<a href="#concept-fe-checked"
id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-8">checkedness</a>, and
<a href="#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag"
id="the-input-element:concept-input-checked-dirty-flag-3">dirty
checkedness flag</a> from `node` to `copy`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior"
id="the-input-element:activation-behaviour"
data-x-internal="activation-behaviour">activation behavior</a> for
[`input`](#the-input-element) elements `element`, given `event`, are
these steps:

1.  If `element` is not *[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*, and
    `element`'s [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is neither in the
    <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
    id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-5">Checkbox</a>
    nor in the <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-4">Radio</a>
    state, then return.

2.  Run `element`'s <span id="input-activation-behavior"
    class="dfn">input activation behavior</span>, if any, and do nothing
    otherwise.

3.  If `element` has a
    <a href="#form-owner" id="the-input-element:form-owner">form owner</a>
    and `element`'s [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is not in the
    <a href="#button-state-(type=button)"
    id="the-input-element:button-state-(type=button)-4">Button</a>
    state, then return.

4.  Run the <a href="#popover-target-attribute-activation-behavior"
    id="the-input-element:popover-target-attribute-activation-behavior">popover
    target attribute activation behavior</a> given `element` and
    `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-target"
    id="the-input-element:concept-event-target"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-target">target</a>.

</div>

Recall that an element's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior"
id="the-input-element:activation-behaviour-2"
data-x-internal="activation-behaviour">activation behavior</a> runs for
both user-initiated activations and for synthetic activations (e.g., via
`el.click()`). User agents might also have behaviors for a given control
— not specified here — that are triggered only by true user-initiated
activations. A common choice is to
<a href="#show-the-picker,-if-applicable"
id="the-input-element:show-the-picker,-if-applicable">show the picker,
if applicable</a>, for the control. In contrast, the
<a href="#input-activation-behavior"
id="the-input-element:input-activation-behavior">input activation
behavior</a> only shows pickers for the special historical cases of the
<a href="#file-upload-state-(type=file)"
id="the-input-element:file-upload-state-(type=file)-7">File Upload</a>
and <a href="#color-state-(type=color)"
id="the-input-element:color-state-(type=color)-5">Color</a> states.

<div algorithm="">

The <a
href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior"
id="the-input-element:legacy-pre-activation-behavior"
data-x-internal="legacy-pre-activation-behavior">legacy-pre-activation
behavior</a> for [`input`](#the-input-element) elements are these steps:

1.  If this element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
    <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
    id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-6">Checkbox
    state</a>, then set this element's <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-9">checkedness</a> to its
    opposite value (i.e. true if it is false, false if it is true) and
    set this element's [`indeterminate`](#dom-input-indeterminate) IDL
    attribute to false.

2.  If this element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
    <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-5">Radio Button
    state</a>, then get a reference to the element in this element's
    <a href="#radio-button-group"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-group">radio button group</a>
    that has its <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-10">checkedness</a> set to
    true, if any, and then set this element's
    <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-11">checkedness</a> to
    true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <a
href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-canceled-activation-behavior"
id="the-input-element:legacy-canceled-activation-behavior"
data-x-internal="legacy-canceled-activation-behavior">legacy-canceled-activation
behavior</a> for [`input`](#the-input-element) elements are these steps:

1.  If the element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
    <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
    id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-7">Checkbox
    state</a>, then set the element's <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-12">checkedness</a> and the
    element's [`indeterminate`](#dom-input-indeterminate) IDL attribute
    back to the values they had before the <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior"
    id="the-input-element:legacy-pre-activation-behavior-2"
    data-x-internal="legacy-pre-activation-behavior">legacy-pre-activation
    behavior</a> was run.

2.  If this element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
    <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-6">Radio Button
    state</a>, then if the element to which a reference was obtained in
    the <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior"
    id="the-input-element:legacy-pre-activation-behavior-3"
    data-x-internal="legacy-pre-activation-behavior">legacy-pre-activation
    behavior</a>, if any, is still in what is now this element's
    <a href="#radio-button-group"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-group-2">radio button group</a>,
    if it still has one, and if so, set that element's
    <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-13">checkedness</a> to
    true; or else, if there was no such element, or that element is no
    longer in this element's <a href="#radio-button-group"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-group-3">radio button group</a>,
    or if this element no longer has a <a href="#radio-button-group"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-group-4">radio button group</a>,
    set this element's <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-checked-14">checkedness</a> to
    false.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

When an [`input`](#the-input-element) element is first created, the
element's rendering and behavior must be set to the rendering and
behavior defined for the [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute's state,
and the <a href="#value-sanitization-algorithm"
id="the-input-element:value-sanitization-algorithm-3">value sanitization
algorithm</a>, if one is defined for the [`type`](#attr-input-type)
attribute's state, must be invoked.

</div>

<div id="input-type-change">

<div algorithm="">

When an [`input`](#the-input-element) element's
[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute changes state, the user agent must
run the following steps:

1.  If the previous state of the element's [`type`](#attr-input-type)
    attribute put the [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in the
    *[value](#dom-input-value-value)* mode, and the element's
    <a href="#concept-fe-value"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-8">value</a> is not the empty
    string, and the new state of the element's
    [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute puts the
    [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in either the
    *[default](#dom-input-value-default)* mode or the
    *[default/on](#dom-input-value-default-on)* mode, then set the
    element's [`value`](#attr-input-value) content attribute to the
    element's <a href="#concept-fe-value"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-9">value</a>.

2.  Otherwise, if the previous state of the element's
    [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute put the
    [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in any mode other than the
    *[value](#dom-input-value-value)* mode, and the new state of the
    element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute puts the
    [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in the
    *[value](#dom-input-value-value)* mode, then set the
    <a href="#concept-fe-value"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-10">value</a> of the element
    to the value of the [`value`](#attr-input-value) content attribute,
    if there is one, or the empty string otherwise, and then set the
    control's <a href="#concept-fe-dirty"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-dirty-5">dirty value flag</a> to
    false.

3.  Otherwise, if the previous state of the element's
    [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute put the
    [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in any mode other than the
    *[filename](#dom-input-value-filename)* mode, and the new state of
    the element's [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute puts the
    [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute in the
    *[filename](#dom-input-value-filename)* mode, then set the
    <a href="#concept-fe-value"
    id="the-input-element:concept-fe-value-11">value</a> of the element
    to the empty string.

4.  Update the element's rendering and behavior to the new state's.

5.  <span id="signal-a-type-change" class="dfn">Signal a type
    change</span> for the element. (The
    <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
    id="the-input-element:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-7">Radio
    Button</a> state uses this, in particular.)

6.  Invoke the <a href="#value-sanitization-algorithm"
    id="the-input-element:value-sanitization-algorithm-4">value sanitization
    algorithm</a>, if one is defined for the [`type`](#attr-input-type)
    attribute's new state.

7.  Let `previouslySelectable` be true if
    [`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext) previously
    <a href="#concept-input-apply"
    id="the-input-element:concept-input-apply-2">applied</a> to the
    element, and false otherwise.

8.  Let `nowSelectable` be true if
    [`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext) now
    <a href="#concept-input-apply"
    id="the-input-element:concept-input-apply-3">applies</a> to the
    element, and false otherwise.

9.  If `previouslySelectable` is false and `nowSelectable` is true, set
    the element's <a href="#concept-textarea/input-cursor"
    id="the-input-element:concept-textarea/input-cursor">text entry cursor
    position</a> to the beginning of the text control, and
    <a href="#set-the-selection-direction"
    id="the-input-element:set-the-selection-direction">set its selection
    direction</a> to "`none`".

</div>

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute represents the element's name. The
[`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname) attribute controls how the element's
<a href="#the-directionality"
id="the-input-element:the-directionality-2">directionality</a> is
submitted. The [`disabled`](#attr-fe-disabled) attribute is used to make
the control non-interactive and to prevent its value from being
submitted. The [`form`](#attr-fae-form) attribute is used to explicitly
associate the [`input`](#the-input-element) element with its
<a href="#form-owner" id="the-input-element:form-owner-2">form owner</a>.
The [`autocomplete`](#attr-fe-autocomplete) attribute controls how the
user agent provides autofill behavior.

The <span id="dom-input-indeterminate" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLInputElement" dfn-type="attribute">`indeterminate`</span>
IDL attribute must initially be set to false. On getting, it must return
the last value it was set to. On setting, it must be set to the new
value. It has no effect except for changing the appearance of
<a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
id="the-input-element:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-8">checkbox</a>
controls.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-input-colorspace" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLInputElement" dfn-type="attribute">`colorSpace`</span> IDL
attribute must
<a href="#reflect" id="the-input-element:reflect">reflect</a> the
[`colorspace`](#attr-input-colorspace) content attribute,
<a href="#limited-to-only-known-values"
id="the-input-element:limited-to-only-known-values">limited to only
known values</a>. The <span id="dom-input-type" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLInputElement" dfn-type="attribute">`type`</span> IDL
attribute must
<a href="#reflect" id="the-input-element:reflect-2">reflect</a> the
respective content attribute of the same name,
<a href="#limited-to-only-known-values"
id="the-input-element:limited-to-only-known-values-2">limited to only
known values</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The IDL attributes <span id="dom-input-width" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLInputElement" dfn-type="attribute">`width`</span> and
<span id="dom-input-height" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLInputElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`height`</span> must return the rendered width and
height of the image, in
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
id="the-input-element:&#39;px&#39;" data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS
pixels</a>, if an image is
<a href="#being-rendered" id="the-input-element:being-rendered">being
rendered</a>; or else the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions"
id="the-input-element:natural-dimensions"
data-x-internal="natural-dimensions">natural width and height</a> of the
image, in <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
id="the-input-element:&#39;px&#39;-2" data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS
pixels</a>, if an image is *[available](#input-img-available)* but not
<a href="#being-rendered" id="the-input-element:being-rendered-2">being
rendered</a>; or else 0, if no image is
*[available](#input-img-available)*. When the
[`input`](#the-input-element) element's [`type`](#attr-input-type)
attribute is not in the <a href="#image-button-state-(type=image)"
id="the-input-element:image-button-state-(type=image)-4">Image
Button</a> state, then no image is *[available](#input-img-available)*.
[\[CSS\]](#refsCSS)

</div>

The [`willValidate`](#dom-cva-willvalidate),
[`validity`](#dom-cva-validity), and
[`validationMessage`](#dom-cva-validationmessage) IDL attributes, and
the [`checkValidity()`](#dom-cva-checkvalidity),
[`reportValidity()`](#dom-cva-reportvalidity), and
[`setCustomValidity()`](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity) methods, are part of
the <a href="#the-constraint-validation-api"
id="the-input-element:the-constraint-validation-api">constraint
validation API</a>. The [`labels`](#dom-lfe-labels) IDL attribute
provides a list of the element's [`label`](#the-label-element)s. The
[`select()`](#dom-textarea/input-select),
[`selectionStart`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart),
[`selectionEnd`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend),
[`selectionDirection`](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection),
[`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext), and
[`setSelectionRange()`](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange) methods
and IDL attributes expose the element's text selection. The
[`disabled`](#dom-fe-disabled), [`form`](#dom-fae-form), and
[`name`](#dom-fe-name) IDL attributes are part of the element's forms
API.

Hidden inputs are completely invisible in the rendered page, and there is no way to make it visible in the page's content.")

When an [`input`](#the-input-element) element's
[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
<a href="#hidden-state-(type=hidden)"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):hidden-state-(type=hidden)">Hidden</a>
state, the rules in this section apply.

The [`input`](#the-input-element) element <a href="#represents"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):represents">represents</a> a value that
is not intended to be examined or manipulated by the user.

<div algorithm="">

**Constraint validation**: If an [`input`](#the-input-element) element's
[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
<a href="#hidden-state-(type=hidden)"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):hidden-state-(type=hidden)-2">Hidden</a>
state, it is <a href="#barred-from-constraint-validation"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):barred-from-constraint-validation">barred
from constraint validation</a>.

</div>

If the [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute is present and has a value that
is an <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):ascii-case-insensitive"
data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
match for "[`_charset_`](#attr-fe-name-charset)", then the element's
[`value`](#attr-input-value) attribute must be omitted.

<div class="bookkeeping">

The [`autocomplete`](#attr-fe-autocomplete) and
[`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname) content attributes
<a href="#concept-input-apply"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):concept-input-apply">apply</a> to this
element.

The [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute
<a href="#concept-input-apply"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):concept-input-apply-2">applies</a> to
this element and is in mode <a href="#dom-input-value-default"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):dom-input-value-default">default</a>.

The following content attributes must not be specified and
<a href="#do-not-apply" id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):do-not-apply">do
not apply</a> to the element: [`accept`](#attr-input-accept),
[`alpha`](#attr-input-alpha), [`alt`](#attr-input-alt),
[`checked`](#attr-input-checked),
[`colorspace`](#attr-input-colorspace),
[`formaction`](#attr-fs-formaction),
[`formenctype`](#attr-fs-formenctype),
[`formmethod`](#attr-fs-formmethod),
[`formnovalidate`](#attr-fs-formnovalidate),
[`formtarget`](#attr-fs-formtarget), [`height`](#attr-dim-height),
[`list`](#attr-input-list), [`max`](#attr-input-max),
[`maxlength`](#attr-input-maxlength), [`min`](#attr-input-min),
[`minlength`](#attr-input-minlength),
[`multiple`](#attr-input-multiple), [`pattern`](#attr-input-pattern),
[`placeholder`](#attr-input-placeholder),
[`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget),
[`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction),
[`readonly`](#attr-input-readonly), [`required`](#attr-input-required),
[`size`](#attr-input-size), [`src`](#attr-input-src),
[`step`](#attr-input-step), and [`width`](#attr-dim-width).

The following IDL attributes and methods <a href="#do-not-apply"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):do-not-apply-2">do not apply</a> to the
element: [`checked`](#dom-input-checked), [`files`](#dom-input-files),
[`list`](#dom-input-list),
[`selectionStart`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart),
[`selectionEnd`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend),
[`selectionDirection`](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection),
[`valueAsDate`](#dom-input-valueasdate), and
[`valueAsNumber`](#dom-input-valueasnumber) IDL attributes;
[`select()`](#dom-textarea/input-select),
[`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext),
[`setSelectionRange()`](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange),
[`stepDown()`](#dom-input-stepdown), and [`stepUp()`](#dom-input-stepup)
methods.

The <a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
data-x-internal="event-input"><code
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):event-input">input</code></a> and
[`change`](#event-change) events <a href="#do-not-apply"
id="hidden-state-(type=hidden):do-not-apply-3">do not apply</a>.

</div>

When an [`input`](#the-input-element) element's
[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)">Text</a>
state or the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-2">Search</a>
state, the rules in this section apply.

The [`input`](#the-input-element) element <a href="#represents"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):represents">represents</a>
a one line plain text edit control for the element's
<a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-fe-value">value</a>.

The difference between the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-3">Text</a>
state and the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-4">Search</a>
state is primarily stylistic: on platforms where search controls are
distinguished from regular text controls, the
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-5">Search</a>
state might result in an appearance consistent with the platform's
search controls rather than appearing like a regular text control.

If the element is *[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*, its
<a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-fe-value-2">value</a>
should be editable by the user. User agents must not allow users to
insert U+000A LINE FEED (LF) or U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR) characters
into the element's <a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-fe-value-3">value</a>.

<div algorithm="">

If the element is *[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)*, the user agent
should allow the user to change the writing direction of the element,
setting it either to a left-to-right writing direction or a
right-to-left writing direction. If the user does so, the user agent
must then run the following steps:

1.  Set the element's [`dir`](#attr-dir) attribute to
    "[`ltr`](#attr-dir-ltr)" if the user selected a left-to-right
    writing direction, and "[`rtl`](#attr-dir-rtl)" if the user selected
    a right-to-left writing direction.

2.  <a href="#queue-an-element-task"
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):queue-an-element-task">Queue
    an element task</a> on the <a href="#user-interaction-task-source"
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):user-interaction-task-source">user
    interaction task source</a> given the element to
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
    data-x-internal="event-input"><code
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):event-input">input</code></a>
    at the element, with the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):dom-event-bubbles">bubbles</code></a>
    and <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-composed"><code
    id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):dom-event-composed">composed</code></a>
    attributes initialized to true.

</div>

The [`value`](#attr-input-value) attribute, if specified, must have a
value that contains no U+000A LINE FEED (LF) or U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN
(CR) characters.

<div algorithm="">

**The <a href="#value-sanitization-algorithm"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):value-sanitization-algorithm">value
sanitization algorithm</a> is as follows**:
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):strip-newlines"
data-x-internal="strip-newlines">Strip newlines</a> from the
<a href="#concept-fe-value"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-fe-value-4">value</a>.

</div>

<div class="bookkeeping">

The following common [`input`](#the-input-element) element content
attributes, IDL attributes, and methods <a href="#concept-input-apply"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-input-apply">apply</a>
to the element: [`autocomplete`](#attr-fe-autocomplete),
[`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname), [`list`](#attr-input-list),
[`maxlength`](#attr-input-maxlength),
[`minlength`](#attr-input-minlength), [`pattern`](#attr-input-pattern),
[`placeholder`](#attr-input-placeholder),
[`readonly`](#attr-input-readonly), [`required`](#attr-input-required),
and [`size`](#attr-input-size) content attributes;
[`list`](#dom-input-list),
[`selectionStart`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart),
[`selectionEnd`](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend),
[`selectionDirection`](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection), and
[`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attributes;
[`select()`](#dom-textarea/input-select),
[`setRangeText()`](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext), and
[`setSelectionRange()`](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange) methods.

The [`value`](#dom-input-value) IDL attribute is in mode
<a href="#dom-input-value-value"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):dom-input-value-value">value</a>.

The <a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
data-x-internal="event-input"><code
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):event-input-2">input</code></a>
and [`change`](#event-change) events <a href="#concept-input-apply"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):concept-input-apply-2">apply</a>.

The following content attributes must not be specified and
<a href="#do-not-apply"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):do-not-apply">do
not apply</a> to the element: [`accept`](#attr-input-accept),
[`alpha`](#attr-input-alpha), [`alt`](#attr-input-alt),
[`checked`](#attr-input-checked),
[`colorspace`](#attr-input-colorspace),
[`formaction`](#attr-fs-formaction),
[`formenctype`](#attr-fs-formenctype),
[`formmethod`](#attr-fs-formmethod),
[`formnovalidate`](#attr-fs-formnovalidate),
[`formtarget`](#attr-fs-formtarget), [`height`](#attr-dim-height),
[`max`](#attr-input-max), [`min`](#attr-input-min),
[`multiple`](#attr-input-multiple),
[`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget),
[`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction),
[`src`](#attr-input-src), [`step`](#attr-input-step), and
[`width`](#attr-dim-width).

The following IDL attributes and methods <a href="#do-not-apply"
id="text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search):do-not-apply-2">do
not apply</a> to the element: [`checked`](#dom-input-checked),
[`files`](#dom-input-files), [`valueAsDate`](#dom-input-valueasdate),
and [`valueAsNumber`](#dom-input-valueasnumber) IDL attributes;
[`stepDown()`](#dom-input-stepdown) and [`stepUp()`](#dom-input-stepup)
methods.

</div>
