    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Run the <a href="#report-validity-steps"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:report-validity-steps-2">report
    validity steps</a> on `element`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-cva-validationmessage" class="dfn"
dfn-for="HTMLObjectElement,HTMLInputElement,HTMLButtonElement,HTMLSelectElement,HTMLTextAreaElement,HTMLOutputElement,HTMLFieldSetElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`validationMessage`</span> attribute's getter must
run these steps:

1.  If this element is not a
    <a href="#candidate-for-constraint-validation"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:candidate-for-constraint-validation-5">candidate
    for constraint validation</a> or if this element
    <a href="#concept-fv-valid"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:concept-fv-valid-3">satisfies its
    constraints</a>, then return the empty string.

2.  Return a suitably localized message that the user agent would show
    the user if this were the only form control with a validity
    constraint problem. If the user agent would not actually show a
    textual message in such a situation (e.g., it would show a graphical
    cue instead), then return a suitably localized message that
    expresses (one or more of) the validity constraint(s) that the
    control does not satisfy. If the element is a
    <a href="#candidate-for-constraint-validation"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:candidate-for-constraint-validation-6">candidate
    for constraint validation</a> and is
    <a href="#suffering-from-a-custom-error"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:suffering-from-a-custom-error-2">suffering
    from a custom error</a>, then the
    <a href="#custom-validity-error-message"
    id="the-constraint-validation-api:custom-validity-error-message-2">custom
    validity error message</a> should be present in the return value.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.21.4</span> Security<a href="#security-forms" class="self-link"></a>

Servers should not rely on client-side validation. Client-side
validation can be intentionally bypassed by hostile users, and
unintentionally bypassed by users of older user agents or automated
tools that do not implement these features. The constraint validation
features are only intended to improve the user experience, not to
provide any kind of security mechanism.

#### <span class="secno">4.10.22</span> <span id="form-submission" class="dfn">Form submission</span><a href="#form-submission-2" class="self-link"></a>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.1</span> Introduction<a href="#introduction-5" class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

When a form is submitted, the data in the form is converted into the
structure specified by the <a href="#concept-fs-enctype"
id="introduction-5:concept-fs-enctype">enctype</a>, and then sent to the
destination specified by the <a href="#concept-fs-action"
id="introduction-5:concept-fs-action">action</a> using the given
<a href="#concept-fs-method"
id="introduction-5:concept-fs-method">method</a>.

For example, take the following form:

``` html
<form action="/find.cgi" method=get>
 <input type=text name=t>
 <input type=search name=q>
 <input type=submit>
</form>
```

If the user types in "cats" in the first field and "fur" in the second,
and then hits the submit button, then the user agent will load
`/find.cgi?t=cats&q=fur`.

On the other hand, consider this form:

``` html
<form action="/find.cgi" method=post enctype="multipart/form-data">
 <input type=text name=t>
 <input type=search name=q>
 <input type=submit>
</form>
```

Given the same user input, the result on submission is quite different:
the user agent instead does an HTTP POST to the given URL, with as the
entity body something like the following text:

    ------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE
    Content-Disposition: form-data; name="t"

    cats
    ------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE
    Content-Disposition: form-data; name="q"

    fur
    ------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE--

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.2</span> Implicit submission<a href="#implicit-submission" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

A [`form`](#the-form-element) element's <span id="default-button"
class="dfn">default button</span> is the first
<a href="#concept-submit-button"
id="implicit-submission:concept-submit-button">submit button</a> in
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
id="implicit-submission:tree-order" data-x-internal="tree-order">tree
order</a> whose
<a href="#form-owner" id="implicit-submission:form-owner">form owner</a>
is that [`form`](#the-form-element) element.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

If the user agent supports letting the user submit a form implicitly
(for example, on some platforms hitting the "enter" key while a text
control is
<a href="#focused" id="implicit-submission:focused">focused</a>
implicitly submits the form), then doing so for a form, whose
<a href="#default-button"
id="implicit-submission:default-button">default button</a> has
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior"
id="implicit-submission:activation-behaviour"
data-x-internal="activation-behaviour">activation behavior</a> and is
not <a href="#concept-fe-disabled"
id="implicit-submission:concept-fe-disabled">disabled</a>, must cause
the user agent to <a href="#fire-a-click-event"
id="implicit-submission:fire-a-click-event">fire a <code>click</code>
event</a> at that <a href="#default-button"
id="implicit-submission:default-button-2">default button</a>.

</div>

There are pages on the web that are only usable if there is a way to
implicitly submit forms, so user agents are strongly encouraged to
support this.

<div algorithm="">

If the form has no <a href="#concept-submit-button"
id="implicit-submission:concept-submit-button-2">submit button</a>, then
the implicit submission mechanism must perform the following steps:

1.  If the form has more than one
    <a href="#field-that-blocks-implicit-submission"
    id="implicit-submission:field-that-blocks-implicit-submission">field
    that blocks implicit submission</a>, then return.

2.  <a href="#concept-form-submit"
    id="implicit-submission:concept-form-submit">Submit</a> the
    [`form`](#the-form-element) element from the
    [`form`](#the-form-element) element itself with
    *[userInvolvement](#submit-user-involvement)* set to
    "[`activation`](#uni-activation)".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

For the purpose of the previous paragraph, an element is a
<span id="field-that-blocks-implicit-submission" class="dfn">field that
blocks implicit submission</span> of a [`form`](#the-form-element)
element if it is an [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
<a href="#form-owner" id="implicit-submission:form-owner-2">form
owner</a> is that [`form`](#the-form-element) element and whose
[`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in one of the following states:
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="implicit-submission:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)">Text</a>,
<a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
id="implicit-submission:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-2">Search</a>,
<a href="#telephone-state-(type=tel)"
id="implicit-submission:telephone-state-(type=tel)">Telephone</a>,
<a href="#url-state-(type=url)"
id="implicit-submission:url-state-(type=url)">URL</a>,
<a href="#email-state-(type=email)"
id="implicit-submission:email-state-(type=email)">Email</a>,
<a href="#password-state-(type=password)"
id="implicit-submission:password-state-(type=password)">Password</a>,
<a href="#date-state-(type=date)"
id="implicit-submission:date-state-(type=date)">Date</a>,
<a href="#month-state-(type=month)"
id="implicit-submission:month-state-(type=month)">Month</a>,
<a href="#week-state-(type=week)"
id="implicit-submission:week-state-(type=week)">Week</a>,
<a href="#time-state-(type=time)"
id="implicit-submission:time-state-(type=time)">Time</a>,
<a href="#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)"
id="implicit-submission:local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)">Local
Date and Time</a>, <a href="#number-state-(type=number)"
id="implicit-submission:number-state-(type=number)">Number</a>

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.3</span> Form submission algorithm<a href="#form-submission-algorithm" class="self-link"></a>

Each [`form`](#the-form-element) element has a
<span id="constructing-entry-list" class="dfn">constructing entry
list</span> boolean, initially false.

Each [`form`](#the-form-element) element has a
<span id="firing-submission-events" class="dfn">firing submission
events</span> boolean, initially false.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-form-submit" class="dfn">submit</span> a
[`form`](#the-form-element) element `form` from an element `submitter`
(typically a button), given an optional boolean
<span id="submit-subbmitted-from-method"
class="dfn">`submitted from ``submit()`` method`</span> (default false)
and an optional <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="form-submission-algorithm:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> <span id="submit-user-involvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span> (default "[`none`](#uni-none)"):

1.  If `form` <a href="#cannot-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:cannot-navigate">cannot navigate</a>,
    then return.

2.  If `form`'s <a href="#constructing-entry-list"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:constructing-entry-list">constructing
    entry list</a> is true, then return.

3.  Let `form document` be `form`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

4.  <div id="sandboxSubmitBlocked">

    If `form document`'s <a href="#active-sandboxing-flag-set"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:active-sandboxing-flag-set">active
    sandboxing flag set</a> has its
    <a href="#sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
    forms browsing context flag</a> set, then return.

    </div>

5.  If `submitted from `[`submit()`](#dom-form-submit)` method` is
    false, then:

    1.  If `form`'s <a href="#firing-submission-events"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:firing-submission-events">firing
        submission events</a> is true, then return.

    2.  Set `form`'s <a href="#firing-submission-events"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:firing-submission-events-2">firing
        submission events</a> to true.

    3.  For each element `field` in the list of
        <a href="#category-submit"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:category-submit">submittable elements</a>
        whose
        <a href="#form-owner" id="form-submission-algorithm:form-owner">form
        owner</a> is `form`, set `field`'s <a href="#user-validity"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:user-validity">user validity</a>
        to true.

    4.  If the `submitter` element's <a href="#concept-fs-novalidate"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-fs-novalidate">no-validate
        state</a> is false, then
        <a href="#interactively-validate-the-constraints"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:interactively-validate-the-constraints">interactively
        validate the constraints</a> of `form` and examine the result.
        If the result is negative (i.e., the constraint validation
        concluded that there were invalid fields and probably informed
        the user of this), then:

        1.  Set `form`'s <a href="#firing-submission-events"
            id="form-submission-algorithm:firing-submission-events-3">firing
            submission events</a> to false.

        2.  Return.

    5.  Let `submitterButton` be null if `submitter` is `form`.
        Otherwise, let `submitterButton` be `submitter`.

    6.  Let `shouldContinue` be the result of
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-event-fire"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">firing an event</a> named
        [`submit`](#event-submit) at `form` using
        [`SubmitEvent`](#submitevent), with the
        [`submitter`](#dom-submitevent-submitter) attribute initialized
        to `submitterButton`, the
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
        data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
        id="form-submission-algorithm:dom-event-bubbles">bubbles</code></a>
        attribute initialized to true, and the
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
        data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
        id="form-submission-algorithm:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
        attribute initialized to true.

    7.  Set `form`'s <a href="#firing-submission-events"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:firing-submission-events-4">firing
        submission events</a> to false.

    8.  If `shouldContinue` is false, then return.

    9.  If `form` <a href="#cannot-navigate"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:cannot-navigate-2">cannot navigate</a>,
        then return.

        <a href="#cannot-navigate"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:cannot-navigate-3">Cannot navigate</a>
        is run again as dispatching the [`submit`](#event-submit) event
        could have changed the outcome.

6.  Let `encoding` be the result of
    <a href="#picking-an-encoding-for-the-form"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:picking-an-encoding-for-the-form">picking
    an encoding for the form</a>.

7.  Let `entry list` be the result of
    <a href="#constructing-the-form-data-set"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:constructing-the-form-data-set">constructing
    the entry list</a> with `form`, `submitter`, and `encoding`.

8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `entry list` is not null.

9.  If `form` <a href="#cannot-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:cannot-navigate-4">cannot navigate</a>,
    then return.

    <a href="#cannot-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:cannot-navigate-5">Cannot navigate</a>
    is run again as dispatching the [`formdata`](#event-formdata) event
    in <a href="#constructing-the-form-data-set"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:constructing-the-form-data-set-2">constructing
    the entry list</a> could have changed the outcome.

10. Let `method` be the `submitter` element's
    <a href="#concept-fs-method"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-fs-method">method</a>.

11. If `method` is <a href="#attr-fs-method-dialog"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-dialog">dialog</a>,
    then:

    1.  If `form` does not have an ancestor
        [`dialog`](#the-dialog-element) element, then return.

    2.  Let `subject` be `form`'s nearest ancestor
        [`dialog`](#the-dialog-element) element.

    3.  Let `result` be null.

    4.  If `submitter` is an [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
        [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
        <a href="#image-button-state-(type=image)"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:image-button-state-(type=image)">Image
        Button</a> state, then:

        1.  Let (`x`, `y`) be the
            <a href="#concept-input-type-image-coordinate"
            id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-input-type-image-coordinate">selected
            coordinate</a>.

        2.  Set `result` to the concatenation of `x`, "`,`", and `y`.

    5.  Otherwise, if `submitter` is a <a href="#concept-submit-button"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-submit-button">submit button</a>,
        then set `result` to `submitter`'s
        <a href="#concept-fe-optional-value"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-fe-optional-value">optional
        value</a>.

    6.  <a href="#close-the-dialog"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:close-the-dialog">Close the dialog</a>
        `subject` with `result` and null.

    7.  Return.

12. Let `action` be the `submitter` element's
    <a href="#concept-fs-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-fs-action">action</a>.

13. If `action` is the empty string, let `action` be the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> of the
    `form document`.

14. Let `parsed action` be the result of
    <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing a
    URL</a> given `action`, relative to `submitter`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

15. If `parsed action` is failure, then return.

16. Let `scheme` be the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> of `parsed action`.

17. Let `enctype` be the `submitter` element's
    <a href="#concept-fs-enctype"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-fs-enctype">enctype</a>.

18. Let `formTarget` be null.

19. If the `submitter` element is a <a href="#concept-submit-button"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-submit-button-2">submit button</a>
    and it has a [`formtarget`](#attr-fs-formtarget) attribute, then set
    `formTarget` to the [`formtarget`](#attr-fs-formtarget) attribute
    value.

20. Let `target` be the result of <a href="#get-an-element&#39;s-target"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:get-an-element&#39;s-target">getting an
    element's target</a> given `submitter`'s
    <a href="#form-owner" id="form-submission-algorithm:form-owner-2">form
    owner</a> and `formTarget`.

21. Let `noopener` be the result of
    <a href="#get-an-element&#39;s-noopener"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:get-an-element&#39;s-noopener">getting an
    element's noopener</a> with `form`, `parsed action`, and `target`.

22. Let `targetNavigable` be the first return value of applying
    <a href="#the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable">the
    rules for choosing a navigable</a> given `target`, `form`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:node-navigable">node navigable</a>,
    and `noopener`.

23. If `targetNavigable` is null, then return.

24. Let `historyHandling` be
    "[`auto`](#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)".

25. If `form document` equals `targetNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:nav-document">active document</a>, and
    `form document` has not yet <a href="#completely-loaded"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:completely-loaded">completely loaded</a>,
    then set `historyHandling` to
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

26. Select the appropriate row in the table below based on `scheme` as
    given by the first cell of each row. Then, select the appropriate
    cell on that row based on `method` as given in the first cell of
    each column. Then, jump to the steps named in that cell and defined
    below the table.

    |  | <a href="#attr-fs-method-get"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-get">GET</a> | <a href="#attr-fs-method-post"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-post">POST</a> |
    |----|----|----|
    | `http` | <a href="#submit-mutate-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action">Mutate action
    URL</a> | <a href="#submit-body" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-body">Submit
    as entity body</a> |
    | `https` | <a href="#submit-mutate-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action-2">Mutate action
    URL</a> | <a href="#submit-body"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-body-2">Submit as entity body</a> |
    | `ftp` | <a href="#submit-get-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action">Get action URL</a> | <a href="#submit-get-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-2">Get action URL</a> |
    | `javascript` | <a href="#submit-get-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-3">Get action URL</a> | <a href="#submit-get-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-4">Get action URL</a> |
    | `data` | <a href="#submit-mutate-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action-3">Mutate action
    URL</a> | <a href="#submit-get-action"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-5">Get action URL</a> |
    | `mailto` | <a href="#submit-mailto-headers"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mailto-headers">Mail with
    headers</a> | <a href="#submit-mailto-body"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mailto-body">Mail as body</a> |

    If `scheme` is not one of those listed in this table, then the
    behavior is not defined by this specification. User agents should,
    in the absence of another specification defining this, act in a
    manner analogous to that defined in this specification for similar
    schemes.

    Each [`form`](#the-form-element) element has a
    <span id="planned-navigation" class="dfn">planned navigation</span>,
    which is either null or a <a href="#concept-task"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-task">task</a>; when the
    [`form`](#the-form-element) is first created, its
    <a href="#planned-navigation"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:planned-navigation">planned navigation</a>
    must be set to null. In the behaviors described below, when the user
    agent is required to <span id="plan-to-navigate" class="dfn">plan to
    navigate</span> to a
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
    `url` given an optional <a href="#post-resource"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:post-resource">POST resource</a>-or-null
    `postResource` (default null), it must run the following steps:

    1.  Let `referrerPolicy` be the empty string.

    2.  If the [`form`](#the-form-element) element's [link
        types](#linkTypes) include the
        [`noreferrer`](#link-type-noreferrer) keyword, then set
        `referrerPolicy` to "`no-referrer`".

    3.  If the [`form`](#the-form-element) has a non-null
        <a href="#planned-navigation"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:planned-navigation-2">planned
        navigation</a>, remove it from its
        <a href="#task-queue" id="form-submission-algorithm:task-queue">task
        queue</a>.

    4.  <a href="#queue-an-element-task"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:queue-an-element-task">Queue an element
        task</a> on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM
        manipulation task source</a> given the
        [`form`](#the-form-element) element and the following steps:

        1.  Set the [`form`](#the-form-element)'s
            <a href="#planned-navigation"
            id="form-submission-algorithm:planned-navigation-3">planned
            navigation</a> to null.

        2.  <a href="#navigate" id="form-submission-algorithm:navigate">Navigate</a>
            `targetNavigable` to `url` using the
            [`form`](#the-form-element) element's
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
            id="form-submission-algorithm:node-document-3"
            data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>, with
            *[historyHandling](#navigation-hh)* set to
            `historyHandling`,
            *[userInvolvement](#navigation-user-involvement)* set to
            `userInvolvement`,
            *[sourceElement](#navigation-source-element)* set to
            `submitter`, *[referrerPolicy](#navigation-referrer-policy)*
            set to `referrerPolicy`,
            *[documentResource](#navigation-resource)* set to
            `postResource`, and
            *[formDataEntryList](#navigation-form-data-entry-list)* set
            to `entry list`.

    5.  Set the [`form`](#the-form-element)'s
        <a href="#planned-navigation"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:planned-navigation-4">planned
        navigation</a> to the just-queued <a href="#concept-task"
        id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-task-2">task</a>.

    The behaviors are as follows:

    <span id="submit-mutate-action" class="dfn">Mutate action URL</span>  
    Let `pairs` be the result of
    <a href="#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs">converting
    to a list of name-value pairs</a> with `entry list`.

    Let `query` be the result of running the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer"
    data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer"><code>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code>
    serializer</a> with `pairs` and `encoding`.

    Set `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> component to `query`.

    <a href="#plan-to-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:plan-to-navigate">Plan to navigate</a>
    to `parsed action`.

    <span id="submit-body" class="dfn">Submit as entity body</span>  
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `method` is
    <a href="#attr-fs-method-post"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-post-2">POST</a>.

    Switch on `enctype`:

    [`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`](#attr-fs-enctype-urlencoded)  
    Let `pairs` be the result of
    <a href="#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs-2">converting
    to a list of name-value pairs</a> with `entry list`.

    Let `body` be the result of running the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer-2"
    data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer"><code>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code>
    serializer</a> with `pairs` and `encoding`.

    Set `body` to the result of
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-encode"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:utf-8-encode"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-encode">encoding</a> `body`.

    Let `mimeType` be
    \`<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded"
    data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"><code
    id="form-submission-algorithm:application/x-www-form-urlencoded">application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code></a>\`.

    [`multipart/form-data`](#attr-fs-enctype-formdata)  
    Let `body` be the result of running the
    <a href="#multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm"><code>multipart/form-data</code>
    encoding algorithm</a> with `entry list` and `encoding`.

    Let `mimeType` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#isomorphic-encode"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:isomorphic-encode"
    data-x-internal="isomorphic-encode">isomorphic encoding</a> of the
    concatenation of "`multipart/form-data; boundary=`" and the
    <a href="#multipart/form-data-boundary-string"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:multipart/form-data-boundary-string"><code>multipart/form-data</code>
    boundary string</a> generated by the
    <a href="#multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm-2"><code>multipart/form-data</code>
    encoding algorithm</a>.

    [`text/plain`](#attr-fs-enctype-text)  
    Let `pairs` be the result of
    <a href="#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs-3">converting
    to a list of name-value pairs</a> with `entry list`.

    Let `body` be the result of running the
    <a href="#text/plain-encoding-algorithm"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:text/plain-encoding-algorithm"><code>text/plain</code>
    encoding algorithm</a> with `pairs`.

    Set `body` to the result of
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encode"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:encode"
    data-x-internal="encode">encoding</a> `body` using `encoding`.

    Let `mimeType` be
    \`<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3"
    data-x-internal="text/plain"><code
    id="form-submission-algorithm:text/plain">text/plain</code></a>\`.

    <a href="#plan-to-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:plan-to-navigate-2">Plan to navigate</a>
    to `parsed action` given a <a href="#post-resource"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:post-resource-2">POST resource</a>
    whose <a href="#post-resource-request-body"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:post-resource-request-body">request
    body</a> is `body` and <a href="#post-resource-request-content-type"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:post-resource-request-content-type">request
    content-type</a> is `mimeType`.

    <span id="submit-get-action" class="dfn">Get action URL</span>  
    <a href="#plan-to-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:plan-to-navigate-3">Plan to navigate</a>
    to `parsed action`.

    `entry list` is discarded.

    <span id="submit-mailto-headers" class="dfn">Mail with headers</span>  
    Let `pairs` be the result of
    <a href="#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs-4">converting
    to a list of name-value pairs</a> with `entry list`.

    Let `headers` be the result of running the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer-3"
    data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer"><code>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code>
    serializer</a> with `pairs` and `encoding`.

    Replace occurrences of U+002B PLUS SIGN characters (+) in `headers`
    with the string "`%20`".

    Set `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> to `headers`.

    <a href="#plan-to-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:plan-to-navigate-4">Plan to navigate</a>
    to `parsed action`.

    <span id="submit-mailto-body" class="dfn">Mail as body</span>  
    Let `pairs` be the result of
    <a href="#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs-5">converting
    to a list of name-value pairs</a> with `entry list`.

    Switch on `enctype`:

    [`text/plain`](#attr-fs-enctype-text)  
    Let `body` be the result of running the
    <a href="#text/plain-encoding-algorithm"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:text/plain-encoding-algorithm-2"><code>text/plain</code>
    encoding algorithm</a> with `pairs`.

    Set `body` to the result of running
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-utf-8-percent-encode"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:utf-8-percent-encode"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-percent-encode">UTF-8 percent-encode</a> on
    `body` using the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#default-encode-set"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:default-encode-set"
    data-x-internal="default-encode-set">default encode set</a>.
    [\[URL\]](#refsURL)

    Otherwise  
    Let `body` be the result of running the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer-4"
    data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded-serializer"><code>application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code>
    serializer</a> with `pairs` and `encoding`.

    If `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> is null, then set it
    to the empty string.

    If `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> is not the empty
    string, then append a single U+0026 AMPERSAND character (&) to it.

    Append "`body=`" to `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a>.

    Append `body` to `parsed action`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:concept-url-query-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a>.

    <a href="#plan-to-navigate"
    id="form-submission-algorithm:plan-to-navigate-5">Plan to navigate</a>
    to `parsed action`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.4</span> Constructing the entry list<a href="#constructing-form-data-set" class="self-link"></a>

An <span id="entry-list" class="dfn" export="">entry list</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="constructing-form-data-set:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#form-entry"
id="constructing-form-data-set:form-entry">entries</a>, typically
representing the contents of a form. An <span id="form-entry"
class="dfn" dfn-for="entry list" export="">entry</span> is a tuple
consisting of a <span id="form-entry-name" class="dfn"
dfn-for="entry list/entry" export="">name</span> (a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
id="constructing-form-data-set:scalar-value-string"
data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a>) and a
<span id="form-entry-value" class="dfn" dfn-for="entry list/entry"
export="">value</span> (either a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
id="constructing-form-data-set:scalar-value-string-2"
data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a> or a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
data-x-internal="file"><code
id="constructing-form-data-set:file">File</code></a> object).

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-an-entry" class="dfn" dfn-for="entry list"
export="">create an entry</span> given a string `name`, a string or
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
data-x-internal="blob"><code
id="constructing-form-data-set:blob">Blob</code></a> object `value`, and
optionally a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
id="constructing-form-data-set:scalar-value-string-3"
data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a>
`filename`:

1.  Set `name` to the result of
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:convert"
    data-x-internal="convert">converting</a> `name` into a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:scalar-value-string-4"
    data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a>.

2.  If `value` is a string, then set `value` to the result of
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:convert-2"
    data-x-internal="convert">converting</a> `value` into a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:scalar-value-string-5"
    data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a>.

3.  Otherwise:

    1.  If `value` is not a
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
        data-x-internal="file"><code
        id="constructing-form-data-set:file-2">File</code></a> object,
        then set `value` to a new
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
        data-x-internal="file"><code
        id="constructing-form-data-set:file-3">File</code></a> object,
        representing the same bytes, whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name"
        data-x-internal="dom-file-name"><code
        id="constructing-form-data-set:dom-file-name">name</code></a>
        attribute value is "`blob`".

    2.  If `filename` is given, then set `value` to a new
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
        data-x-internal="file"><code
        id="constructing-form-data-set:file-4">File</code></a> object,
        representing the same bytes, whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name"
        data-x-internal="dom-file-name"><code
        id="constructing-form-data-set:dom-file-name-2">name</code></a>
        attribute is `filename`.

    These operations will create a new
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
    data-x-internal="file"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:file-5">File</code></a> object if
    either `filename` is given or the passed
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
    data-x-internal="blob"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:blob-2">Blob</code></a> is not a
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
    data-x-internal="file"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:file-6">File</code></a> object. In
    those cases, the identity of the passed
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
    data-x-internal="blob"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:blob-3">Blob</code></a> object is not
    kept.

4.  Return an <a href="#form-entry"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:form-entry-2">entry</a> whose
    <a href="#form-entry-name"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:form-entry-name">name</a> is `name`
    and whose <a href="#form-entry-value"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:form-entry-value">value</a> is
    `value`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="constructing-the-form-data-set" class="dfn"
lt="constructing the entry list" export="">construct the entry
list</span> given a `form`, an optional `submitter` (default null), and
an optional `encoding` (default
<a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8"
id="constructing-form-data-set:utf-8" data-x-internal="utf-8">UTF-8</a>):

1.  If `form`'s <a href="#constructing-entry-list"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:constructing-entry-list">constructing
    entry list</a> is true, then return null.

2.  Set `form`'s <a href="#constructing-entry-list"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:constructing-entry-list-2">constructing
    entry list</a> to true.

3.  Let `controls` be a list of all the <a href="#category-submit"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:category-submit">submittable elements</a>
    whose
    <a href="#form-owner" id="constructing-form-data-set:form-owner">form
    owner</a> is `form`, in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:tree-order"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

4.  Let `entry list` be a new empty
    <a href="#entry-list" id="constructing-form-data-set:entry-list">entry
    list</a>.

5.  For each element `field` in `controls`, in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:tree-order-2"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>:

    1.  If any of the following are true:

        - `field` has a [`datalist`](#the-datalist-element) element
          ancestor;

        - `field` is <a href="#concept-fe-disabled"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-fe-disabled">disabled</a>;

        - `field` is a <a href="#concept-button"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-button">button</a> but
          it is not `submitter`;

        - `field` is an [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
          [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
          <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)">Checkbox</a>
          state and whose <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-fe-checked">checkedness</a>
          is false; or

        - `field` is an [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
          [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
          <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:radio-button-state-(type=radio)">Radio
          Button</a> state and whose <a href="#concept-fe-checked"
          id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-fe-checked-2">checkedness</a>
          is false,

        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    2.  If the `field` element is an [`input`](#the-input-element)
        element whose [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
        <a href="#image-button-state-(type=image)"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:image-button-state-(type=image)">Image
        Button</a> state, then:

        1.  If the `field` element is not `submitter`, then
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:continue-2"
            data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

        2.  If the `field` element has a [`name`](#attr-fe-name)
            attribute specified and its value is not the empty string,
            let `name` be that value followed by U+002E (.). Otherwise,
            let `name` be the empty string.

        3.  Let `name`<sub>`x`</sub> be the concatenation of `name` and
            U+0078 (x).

        4.  Let `name`<sub>`y`</sub> be the concatenation of `name` and
            U+0079 (y).

        5.  Let (`x`, `y`) be the
            <a href="#concept-input-type-image-coordinate"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-input-type-image-coordinate">selected
            coordinate</a>.

        6.  <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry">Create an entry</a>
            with `name`<sub>`x`</sub> and `x`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

        7.  <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-2">Create an entry</a>
            with `name`<sub>`y`</sub> and `y`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-2"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

        8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:continue-3"
            data-x-internal="continue">Continue</a>.

    3.  If the `field` is a <a href="#form-associated-custom-element"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:form-associated-custom-element">form-associated
        custom element</a>, then perform the
        <a href="#face-entry-construction"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:face-entry-construction">entry
        construction algorithm</a> given `field` and `entry list`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:continue-4"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    4.  If either the `field` element does not have a
        [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute specified, or its
        [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute's value is the empty string,
        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:continue-5"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    5.  Let `name` be the value of the `field` element's
        [`name`](#attr-fe-name) attribute.

    6.  If the `field` element is a [`select`](#the-select-element)
        element, then for each [`option`](#the-option-element) element
        in the [`select`](#the-select-element) element's
        <a href="#concept-select-option-list"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-select-option-list">list of
        options</a> whose <a href="#concept-option-selectedness"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-option-selectedness">selectedness</a>
        is true and that is not <a href="#concept-option-disabled"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-option-disabled">disabled</a>,
        <a href="#create-an-entry"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-3">create an entry</a>
        with `name` and the <a href="#concept-option-value"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-option-value">value</a>
        of the [`option`](#the-option-element) element, and
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-3"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

    7.  Otherwise, if the `field` element is an
        [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
        [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
        <a href="#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)-2">Checkbox</a>
        state or the <a href="#radio-button-state-(type=radio)"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:radio-button-state-(type=radio)-2">Radio
        Button</a> state, then:

        1.  If the `field` element has a [`value`](#attr-input-value)
            attribute specified, then let `value` be the value of that
            attribute; otherwise, let `value` be the string "`on`".

        2.  <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-4">Create an entry</a>
            with `name` and `value`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-4"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

    8.  Otherwise, if the `field` element is an
        [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
        [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
        <a href="#file-upload-state-(type=file)"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:file-upload-state-(type=file)">File
        Upload</a> state, then:

        1.  If there are no <a href="#concept-input-type-file-selected"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-input-type-file-selected">selected
            files</a>, then <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-5">create an entry</a>
            with `name` and a new
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
            data-x-internal="file"><code
            id="constructing-form-data-set:file-7">File</code></a>
            object with an empty name,
            <a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1"
            data-x-internal="application/octet-stream"><code
            id="constructing-form-data-set:application/octet-stream">application/octet-stream</code></a>
            as type, and an empty body, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-5"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

        2.  Otherwise, for each file in
            <a href="#concept-input-type-file-selected"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-input-type-file-selected-2">selected
            files</a>, <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-6">create an entry</a>
            with `name` and a
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
            data-x-internal="file"><code
            id="constructing-form-data-set:file-8">File</code></a>
            object representing the file, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-6"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

    9.  Otherwise, if the `field` element is an
        [`input`](#the-input-element) element whose
        [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
        <a href="#hidden-state-(type=hidden)"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:hidden-state-(type=hidden)">Hidden</a>
        state and `name` is an
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:ascii-case-insensitive"
        data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
        match for "[`_charset_`](#attr-fe-name-charset)":

        1.  Let `charset` be the
            <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#name"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:encoding-name"
            data-x-internal="encoding-name">name</a> of `encoding`.

        2.  <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-7">Create an entry</a>
            with `name` and `charset`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-7"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

    10. Otherwise, <a href="#create-an-entry"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-8">create an entry</a>
        with `name` and the <a href="#concept-fe-value"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-fe-value">value</a> of
        the `field` element, and
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-8"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

    11. If the element has a [`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname) attribute,
        that attribute's value is not the empty string, and the element
        is an <a href="#auto-directionality-form-associated-elements"
        id="constructing-form-data-set:auto-directionality-form-associated-elements">auto-directionality
        form-associated element</a>:

        1.  Let `dirname` be the value of the element's
            [`dirname`](#attr-fe-dirname) attribute.

        2.  Let `dir` be the string "`ltr`" if
            <a href="#the-directionality"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:the-directionality">the
            directionality</a> of the element is '<a href="#concept-ltr"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-ltr">ltr</a>', and
            "`rtl`" otherwise (i.e., when <a href="#the-directionality"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:the-directionality-2">the
            directionality</a> of the element is '<a href="#concept-rtl"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-rtl">rtl</a>').

        3.  <a href="#create-an-entry"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:create-an-entry-9">Create an entry</a>
            with `dirname` and `dir`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="constructing-form-data-set:list-append-9"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to `entry list`.

6.  Let `form data` be a new
    <a href="https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata"
    data-x-internal="formdata"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:formdata">FormData</code></a> object
    associated with `entry list`.

7.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
    [`formdata`](#event-formdata) at `form` using
    [`FormDataEvent`](#formdataevent), with the
    [`formData`](#dom-formdataevent-formdata) attribute initialized to
    `form data` and the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
    id="constructing-form-data-set:dom-event-bubbles">bubbles</code></a>
    attribute initialized to true.

8.  Set `form`'s <a href="#constructing-entry-list"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:constructing-entry-list-3">constructing
    entry list</a> to false.

9.  Return a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone"
    id="constructing-form-data-set:list-clone"
    data-x-internal="list-clone">clone</a> of `entry list`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.5</span> Selecting a form submission encoding<a href="#selecting-a-form-submission-encoding" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

If the user agent is to <span id="picking-an-encoding-for-the-form"
class="dfn">pick an encoding for a form</span>, it must run the
following steps:

1.  Let `encoding` be the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
    id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:document&#39;s-character-encoding"
    data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">document's character
    encoding</a>.

2.  If the [`form`](#the-form-element) element has an
    [`accept-charset`](#attr-form-accept-charset) attribute, set
    `encoding` to the return value of running these substeps:

    1.  Let `input` be the value of the [`form`](#the-form-element)
        element's [`accept-charset`](#attr-form-accept-charset)
        attribute.

    2.  Let `candidate encoding labels` be the result of
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
        id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:split-a-string-on-spaces"
        data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">splitting <var>input</var> on
        ASCII whitespace</a>.

    3.  Let `candidate encodings` be an empty list of
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding"
        id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:encoding"
        data-x-internal="encoding">character encodings</a>.

    4.  For each token in `candidate encoding labels` in turn (in the
        order in which they were found in `input`),
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get"
        id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:getting-an-encoding"
        data-x-internal="getting-an-encoding">get an encoding</a> for
        the token and, if this does not result in failure, append the
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding"
        id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:encoding-2"
        data-x-internal="encoding">encoding</a> to
        `candidate encodings`.

    5.  If `candidate encodings` is empty, return
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8"
        id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:utf-8"
        data-x-internal="utf-8">UTF-8</a>.

    6.  Return the first encoding in `candidate encodings`.

3.  Return the result of
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#get-an-output-encoding"
    id="selecting-a-form-submission-encoding:get-an-output-encoding"
    data-x-internal="get-an-output-encoding">getting an output encoding</a>
    from `encoding`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.6</span> Converting an entry list to a list of name-value pairs<a href="#converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs"
class="self-link"></a>

The <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded"
data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"><code
id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:application/x-www-form-urlencoded">application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code></a>
and [`text/plain`](#text/plain-encoding-algorithm) encoding algorithms
take a list of name-value pairs, where the values must be strings,
rather than an <a href="#entry-list"
id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:entry-list">entry
list</a> where the value can be a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
data-x-internal="file"><code
id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:file">File</code></a>.
The following algorithm performs the conversion.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs" class="dfn">convert
to a list of name-value pairs</span> an <a href="#entry-list"
id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:entry-list-2">entry
list</a> `entry list`, run these steps:

1.  Let `list` be an empty <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:list"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a> of name-value pairs.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `entry` of `entry list`:

    1.  Let `name` be `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-name"
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:form-entry-name">name</a>,
        with every occurrence of U+000D (CR) not followed by U+000A
        (LF), and every occurrence of U+000A (LF) not preceded by U+000D
        (CR), replaced by a string consisting of U+000D (CR) and U+000A
        (LF).

    2.  If `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-value"
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:form-entry-value">value</a>
        is a <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
        data-x-internal="file"><code
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:file-2">File</code></a>
        object, then let `value` be `entry`'s
        <a href="#form-entry-value"
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:form-entry-value-2">value</a>'s
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name"
        data-x-internal="dom-file-name"><code
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:dom-file-name">name</code></a>.
        Otherwise, let `value` be `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-value"
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:form-entry-value-3">value</a>.

    3.  Replace every occurrence of U+000D (CR) not followed by U+000A
        (LF), and every occurrence of U+000A (LF) not preceded by U+000D
        (CR), in `value`, by a string consisting of U+000D (CR) and
        U+000A (LF).

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> to `list` a new
        name-value pair whose name is `name` and whose value is `value`.

3.  Return `list`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.7</span> URL-encoded form data<a href="#url-encoded-form-data" class="self-link"></a>

<span id="application/x-www-form-urlencoded-encoding-algorithm"></span>See
URL for details on
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded"
data-x-internal="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"><code
id="url-encoded-form-data:application/x-www-form-urlencoded">application/x-www-form-urlencoded</code></a>.
[\[URL\]](#refsURL)

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.8</span> Multipart form data<a href="#multipart-form-data" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm" class="dfn"
export="">`multipart/form-data` encoding algorithm</span>, given an
<a href="#entry-list" id="multipart-form-data:entry-list">entry list</a>
`entry list` and an <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding"
id="multipart-form-data:encoding"
data-x-internal="encoding">encoding</a> `encoding`, is as follows:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="multipart-form-data:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `entry` of `entry list`:

    1.  Replace every occurrence of U+000D (CR) not followed by U+000A
        (LF), and every occurrence of U+000A (LF) not preceded by U+000D
        (CR), in `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-name"
        id="multipart-form-data:form-entry-name">name</a>, by a string
        consisting of a U+000D (CR) and U+000A (LF).

    2.  If `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-value"
        id="multipart-form-data:form-entry-value">value</a> is not a
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file"
        data-x-internal="file"><code
        id="multipart-form-data:file">File</code></a> object, then
        replace every occurrence of U+000D (CR) not followed by U+000A
        (LF), and every occurrence of U+000A (LF) not preceded by U+000D
        (CR), in `entry`'s <a href="#form-entry-value"
        id="multipart-form-data:form-entry-value-2">value</a>, by a
        string consisting of a U+000D (CR) and U+000A (LF).

2.  Return the byte sequence resulting from encoding the `entry list`
    using the rules described by RFC 7578, Returning Values from Forms:
    `multipart/form-data`, given the following conditions:
    [\[RFC7578\]](#refsRFC7578)

    - Each
      <a href="#form-entry" id="multipart-form-data:form-entry">entry</a>
      in `entry list` is a *field*, the <a href="#form-entry-name"
      id="multipart-form-data:form-entry-name-2">name</a> of the entry
      is the *field name* and the <a href="#form-entry-value"
      id="multipart-form-data:form-entry-value-3">value</a> of the entry
      is the *field value*.

    - The order of parts must be the same as the order of fields in
      `entry list`. Multiple entries with the same name must be treated
      as distinct fields.

    - Field names, field values for non-file fields, and filenames for
      file fields, in the generated
      [`multipart/form-data`](#multipart/form-data) resource must be set
      to the result of
      <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encode"
      id="multipart-form-data:encode" data-x-internal="encode">encoding</a>
      the corresponding entry's name or value with `encoding`, converted
      to a byte sequence.

    - For field names and filenames for file fields, the result of the
      encoding in the previous bullet point must be escaped by replacing
      any 0x0A (LF) bytes with the byte sequence \``%0A`\`, 0x0D (CR)
      with \``%0D`\` and 0x22 (") with \``%22`\`. The user agent must
      not perform any other escapes.

    - The parts of the generated
      [`multipart/form-data`](#multipart/form-data) resource that
      correspond to non-file fields must not have a
      \`[`Content-Type`](#content-type)\` header specified.

    - The boundary used by the user agent in generating the return value
      of this algorithm is the
      <span id="multipart/form-data-boundary-string" class="dfn"
      export="">`multipart/form-data` boundary string</span>. (This
      value is used to generate the MIME type of the form submission
      payload generated by this algorithm.)

</div>

For details on how to interpret
[`multipart/form-data`](#multipart/form-data) payloads, see RFC 7578.
[\[RFC7578\]](#refsRFC7578)

##### <span class="secno">4.10.22.9</span> Plain text form data<a href="#plain-text-form-data" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="text/plain-encoding-algorithm" class="dfn">`text/plain`
encoding algorithm</span>, given a list of name-value pairs `pairs`, is
as follows:

1.  Let `result` be the empty string.

2.  For each `pair` in `pairs`:

    1.  Append `pair`'s name to `result`.

    2.  Append a single U+003D EQUALS SIGN character (=) to `result`.

    3.  Append `pair`'s value to `result`.

    4.  Append a U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR) U+000A LINE FEED (LF)
        character pair to `result`.

3.  Return `result`.

</div>

Payloads using the
<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3"
data-x-internal="text/plain"><code
id="plain-text-form-data:text/plain">text/plain</code></a> format are
intended to be human readable. They are not reliably interpretable by
computer, as the format is ambiguous (for example, there is no way to
distinguish a literal newline in a value from the newline at the end of
the value).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">4.10.23</span> Resetting a form<a href="#resetting-a-form" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When a [`form`](#the-form-element) element `form` is
<span id="concept-form-reset" class="dfn">reset</span>, run these steps:

1.  Let `reset` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="resetting-a-form:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">firing an event</a> named
    [`reset`](#event-reset) at `form`, with the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
    id="resetting-a-form:dom-event-bubbles">bubbles</code></a> and
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
    id="resetting-a-form:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
    attributes initialized to true.

2.  If `reset` is true, then invoke the
    <a href="#concept-form-reset-control"
    id="resetting-a-form:concept-form-reset-control">reset algorithm</a>
    of each <a href="#category-reset"
    id="resetting-a-form:category-reset">resettable element</a> whose
    <a href="#form-owner" id="resetting-a-form:form-owner">form owner</a>
    is `form`.

</div>

Each <a href="#category-reset"
id="resetting-a-form:category-reset-2">resettable element</a> defines
its own <span id="concept-form-reset-control" class="dfn">reset
algorithm</span>. Changes made to form controls as part of these
algorithms do not count as changes caused by the user (and thus, e.g.,
do not cause <a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
data-x-internal="event-input"><code
id="resetting-a-form:event-input">input</code></a> events to fire).
