Objects which implement the [`CanvasShadowStyles`](#canvasshadowstyles)
interface have an associated
<span id="concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color" class="dfn">shadow
color</span>, which is a CSS color. Initially, it must be
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
id="shadows:transparent-black"
data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-context-2d-shadowcolor" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanvasShadowStyles" dfn-type="attribute">`shadowColor`</span>
getter steps are to return the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#serializing-color-values"
id="shadows:serialisation-of-a-color"
data-x-internal="serialisation-of-a-color">serialization</a> of
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="shadows:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color"
id="shadows:concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color">shadow color</a>
with <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-serialization-html-compatible-serialization-is-requested"
id="shadows:html-compatible-serialization-is-requested"
data-x-internal="html-compatible-serialization-is-requested">HTML-compatible
serialization requested</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`shadowColor`](#dom-context-2d-shadowcolor) setter steps are:

1.  Let `context` be
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="shadows:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s [`canvas`](#dom-context-2d-canvas)
    attribute's value, if that is an element; otherwise null.

2.  Let `parsedValue` be the result of
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value"
    id="shadows:parsed-as-a-css-color-value"
    data-x-internal="parsed-as-a-css-color-value">parsing</a> the given
    value with `context` if non-null.

3.  If `parsedValue` is failure, then return.

4.  Set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="shadows:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color"
    id="shadows:concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color-2">shadow color</a>
    to `parsedValue`.

</div>

The <span id="dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanvasShadowStyles" dfn-type="attribute">`shadowOffsetX`</span>
and <span id="dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanvasShadowStyles" dfn-type="attribute">`shadowOffsetY`</span>
attributes specify the distance that the shadow will be offset in the
positive horizontal and positive vertical distance respectively. Their
values are in coordinate space units. They are not affected by the
current transformation matrix.

When the context is created, the shadow offset attributes must initially
have the value 0.

<div algorithm="">

On getting, they must return their current value. On setting, the
attribute being set must be set to the new value, except if the value is
infinite or NaN, in which case the new value must be ignored.

</div>

The <span id="dom-context-2d-shadowblur" class="dfn"
dfn-for="CanvasShadowStyles" dfn-type="attribute">`shadowBlur`</span>
attribute specifies the level of the blurring effect. (The units do not
map to coordinate space units, and are not affected by the current
transformation matrix.)

When the context is created, the
[`shadowBlur`](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur) attribute must initially have
the value 0.

<div algorithm="">

On getting, the attribute must return its current value. On setting, the
attribute must be set to the new value, except if the value is negative,
infinite or NaN, in which case the new value must be ignored.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<span id="when-shadows-are-drawn" class="dfn">Shadows are only drawn
if</span> the opacity component of the alpha component of the
<a href="#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color"
id="shadows:concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color-3">shadow color</a>
is nonzero and either the [`shadowBlur`](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur) is
nonzero, or the [`shadowOffsetX`](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx) is
nonzero, or the [`shadowOffsetY`](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety) is
nonzero.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<a href="#when-shadows-are-drawn"
id="shadows:when-shadows-are-drawn">When shadows are drawn</a>, they
must be rendered as follows:

1.  Let `A` be an infinite
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="shadows:transparent-black-2"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> bitmap on
    which the source image for which a shadow is being created has been
    rendered.

2.  Let `B` be an infinite
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="shadows:transparent-black-3"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> bitmap,
    with a coordinate space and an origin identical to `A`.

3.  Copy the alpha component of `A` to `B`, offset by
    [`shadowOffsetX`](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsetx) in the positive `x`
    direction, and [`shadowOffsetY`](#dom-context-2d-shadowoffsety) in
    the positive `y` direction.

4.  If [`shadowBlur`](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur) is greater than 0:

    1.  Let `σ` be half the value of
        [`shadowBlur`](#dom-context-2d-shadowblur).

    2.  Perform a 2D Gaussian Blur on `B`, using `σ` as the standard
        deviation.

    User agents may limit values of `σ` to an implementation-specific
    maximum value to avoid exceeding hardware limitations during the
    Gaussian blur operation.

5.  Set the red, green, and blue components of every pixel in `B` to the
    red, green, and blue components (respectively) of the
    <a href="#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color"
    id="shadows:concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color-4">shadow color</a>.

6.  Multiply the alpha component of every pixel in `B` by the alpha
    component of the <a href="#concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color"
    id="shadows:concept-canvasshadowstyles-shadow-color-5">shadow color</a>.

7.  The shadow is in the bitmap `B`, and is rendered as part of the
    <a href="#drawing-model" id="shadows:drawing-model">drawing model</a>
    described below.

</div>

If the <a href="#current-compositing-and-blending-operator"
id="shadows:current-compositing-and-blending-operator">current
compositing and blending operator</a> is "<a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_src"
data-x-internal="gcop-copy"><code id="shadows:gcop-copy">copy</code></a>",
then shadows effectively won't render (since the shape will overwrite
the shadow).

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.1.20</span> Filters<a href="#filters" class="self-link"></a>

All drawing operations on an object which implements the
[`CanvasFilters`](#canvasfilters) interface are affected by the global
<span id="dom-context-2d-filter" class="dfn" dfn-for="CanvasFilters"
dfn-type="attribute">`filter`</span> attribute.

`context``.`<a href="#dom-context-2d-filter"
id="dom-context-2d-filter-dev"><code>filter</code></a>` [ = ``value`` ]`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

MDN

<div class="feature">

[CanvasRenderingContext2D/filter](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CanvasRenderingContext2D/filter "The CanvasRenderingContext2D.filter property of the Canvas 2D API provides filter effects such as blurring and grayscaling. It is similar to the CSS filter property and accepts the same values.")

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox49+</span><span class="safari no">SafariNo</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome52+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera unknown">Opera?</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge unknown">Edge
(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Returns the current filter.

Can be set, to change the filter. Values can either be the string
"`none`" or a string parseable as a <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
id="filters:filter-value-list"
data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a>. Other
values are ignored.

Such objects have an associated <span id="concept-canvas-current-filter"
class="dfn">current filter</span>, which is a string. Initially the
<a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter">current filter</a> is set to
the string "`none`". Whenever the value of the
<a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-2">current filter</a> is the
string "`none`" filters will be disabled for the context.

<div algorithm="">

The [`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter) getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="filters:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-3">current filter</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter) setter steps are:

1.  If the given value is "`none`", then set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="filters:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-4">current filter</a> to
    "`none`" and return.

2.  Let `parsedValue` be the result of
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-syntax/#parse-grammar"
    id="filters:parse-something-according-to-a-css-grammar"
    data-x-internal="parse-something-according-to-a-css-grammar">parsing</a>
    the given values as a <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
    id="filters:filter-value-list-2"
    data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a>.
    If any property-independent style sheet syntax like 'inherit' or
    'initial' is present, then this parsing must return failure.

3.  If `parsedValue` is failure, then return.

4.  Set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this" id="filters:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-5">current filter</a> to
    the given value.

</div>

Though `context``.`[`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter)` = "``none``"`
will disable filters for the context,
`context``.`[`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter)` = ""`,
`context``.`[`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter)` = null`, and
`context``.`[`filter`](#dom-context-2d-filter)` = undefined` are all
treated as unparseable inputs and the value of the
<a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-6">current filter</a> is left
unchanged.

Coordinates used in the value of the
<a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-7">current filter</a> are
interpreted such that one pixel is equivalent to one SVG user space unit
and to one canvas coordinate space unit. Filter coordinates are not
affected by the
<a href="#transformations" id="filters:transformations">current
transformation matrix</a>. The current transformation matrix affects
only the input to the filter. Filters are applied in the
<a href="#output-bitmap" id="filters:output-bitmap">output bitmap</a>'s
coordinate space.

When the value of the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-8">current filter</a> is a
string parsable as a <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
id="filters:filter-value-list-3"
data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a> which
defines lengths using percentages or using
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#em"
id="filters:&#39;em&#39;" data-x-internal="&#39;em&#39;">'em'</a> or
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#ex"
id="filters:&#39;ex&#39;" data-x-internal="&#39;ex&#39;">'ex'</a> units,
these must be interpreted relative to the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value"
id="filters:computed-value" data-x-internal="computed-value">computed
value</a> of the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-fonts/#font-size-prop"
id="filters:&#39;font-size&#39;"
data-x-internal="&#39;font-size&#39;">'font-size'</a> property of the
<a href="#font-style-source-object"
id="filters:font-style-source-object">font style source object</a> at
the time that the attribute is set. If the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-cascade/#computed-value"
id="filters:computed-value-2" data-x-internal="computed-value">computed
values</a> are undefined for a particular case (e.g. because the
<a href="#font-style-source-object"
id="filters:font-style-source-object-2">font style source object</a> is
not an element or is not
<a href="#being-rendered" id="filters:being-rendered">being rendered</a>),
then the relative keywords must be interpreted relative to the default
value of the [`font`](#dom-context-2d-font) attribute. The 'larger' and
'smaller' keywords are not supported.

If the value of the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-9">current filter</a> is a
string parseable as a <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
id="filters:filter-value-list-4"
data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a> with a
reference to an SVG filter in the same document, and this SVG filter
changes, then the changed filter is used for the next draw operation.

If the value of the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
id="filters:concept-canvas-current-filter-10">current filter</a> is a
string parseable as a <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
id="filters:filter-value-list-5"
data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a> with a
reference to an SVG filter in an external resource document and that
document is not loaded when a drawing operation is invoked, then the
drawing operation must proceed with no filtering.

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.1.21</span> Working with externally-defined SVG filters<a href="#working-with-externally-defined-svg-filters"
class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

Since drawing is performed using filter value "`none`" until an
externally-defined filter has finished loading, authors might wish to
determine whether such a filter has finished loading before proceeding
with a drawing operation. One way to accomplish this is to load the
externally-defined filter elsewhere within the same page in some element
that sends a `load` event (for example, an
<a href="https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/struct.html#UseElement"
id="working-with-externally-defined-svg-filters:svg-use"
data-x-internal="svg-use">SVG <code>use</code></a> element), and wait
for the `load` event to be dispatched.

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.1.22</span> <span class="dfn">Drawing model</span><a href="#drawing-model" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When a shape or image is painted, user agents must follow these steps,
in the order given (or act as if they do):

1.  Render the shape or image onto an infinite
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="drawing-model:transparent-black"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> bitmap,
    creating image `A`, as described in the previous sections. For
    shapes, the current fill, stroke, and line styles must be honored,
    and the stroke must itself also be subjected to the current
    transformation matrix.

2.  Convert the image `A` to the <a href="#concept-canvas-color-space"
    id="drawing-model:concept-canvas-color-space">context's color space</a>.

    There do not exist any inputs to a 2D context for which the color
    space is undefined. The color space for CSS colors is defined in CSS
    Color. The color space for images that specify no color profile
    information is
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb"
    id="drawing-model:&#39;srgb&#39;"
    data-x-internal="&#39;srgb&#39;">'srgb'</a>, as specified in the
    [Color Spaces of Untagged
    Colors](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#untagged) section of CSS
    Color. [\[CSSCOLOR\]](#refsCSSCOLOR)

3.  Multiply the alpha component of every pixel in `A` by
    [`global alpha`](#concept-canvas-global-alpha).

4.  When the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="drawing-model:concept-canvas-current-filter">current filter</a>
    is set to a value other than "`none`" and all the externally-defined
    filters it references, if any, are in documents that are currently
    loaded, then use image `A` as the input to the
    <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="drawing-model:concept-canvas-current-filter-2">current filter</a>,
    creating image `B`. If the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="drawing-model:concept-canvas-current-filter-3">current filter</a>
    is a string parseable as a <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/filter-effects/#typedef-filter-value-list"
    id="drawing-model:filter-value-list"
    data-x-internal="filter-value-list">&lt;filter-value-list&gt;</a>,
    then draw using the <a href="#concept-canvas-current-filter"
    id="drawing-model:concept-canvas-current-filter-4">current filter</a>
    in the same manner as SVG.

    Otherwise, let `B` be an alias for `A`.

5.  <a href="#when-shadows-are-drawn"
    id="drawing-model:when-shadows-are-drawn">When shadows are drawn</a>,
    render the shadow from image `B`, using the current shadow styles,
    creating image `C`.

6.  <a href="#when-shadows-are-drawn"
    id="drawing-model:when-shadows-are-drawn-2">When shadows are drawn</a>,
    composite `C` within the
    <a href="#clipping-region" id="drawing-model:clipping-region">clipping
    region</a> over the current
    <a href="#output-bitmap" id="drawing-model:output-bitmap">output
    bitmap</a> using the
    <a href="#current-compositing-and-blending-operator"
    id="drawing-model:current-compositing-and-blending-operator">current
    compositing and blending operator</a>.

7.  Composite `B` within the
    <a href="#clipping-region" id="drawing-model:clipping-region-2">clipping
    region</a> over the current
    <a href="#output-bitmap" id="drawing-model:output-bitmap-2">output
    bitmap</a> using the
    <a href="#current-compositing-and-blending-operator"
    id="drawing-model:current-compositing-and-blending-operator-2">current
    compositing and blending operator</a>.

</div>

When compositing onto the
<a href="#output-bitmap" id="drawing-model:output-bitmap-3">output
bitmap</a>, pixels that would fall outside of the
<a href="#output-bitmap" id="drawing-model:output-bitmap-4">output
bitmap</a> must be discarded.

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.1.23</span> Best practices<a href="#best-practices" class="self-link"></a>

When a canvas is interactive, authors should include
<a href="#focusable" id="best-practices:focusable">focusable</a>
elements in the element's fallback content corresponding to each
<a href="#focusable" id="best-practices:focusable-2">focusable</a> part
of the canvas, as in the [example above](#drawCustomFocusRingExample).

When rendering focus rings, to ensure that focus rings have the
appearance of native focus rings, authors should use the
[`drawFocusIfNeeded()`](#dom-context-2d-drawfocusifneeded) method,
passing it the element for which a ring is being drawn. This method only
draws the focus ring if the element is
<a href="#focused" id="best-practices:focused">focused</a>, so that it
can simply be called whenever drawing the element, without checking
whether the element is focused or not first.

Authors should avoid implementing text editing controls using the
[`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element. Doing so has a large number of
disadvantages:

- Mouse placement of the caret has to be reimplemented.
- Keyboard movement of the caret has to be reimplemented (possibly
  across lines, for multiline text input).
- Scrolling of the text control has to be implemented (horizontally for
  long lines, vertically for multiline input).
- Native features such as copy-and-paste have to be reimplemented.
- Native features such as spell-checking have to be reimplemented.
- Native features such as drag-and-drop have to be reimplemented.
- Native features such as page-wide text search have to be
  reimplemented.
- Native features specific to the user, for example custom text
  services, have to be reimplemented. This is close to impossible since
  each user might have different services installed, and there is an
  unbounded set of possible such services.
- Bidirectional text editing has to be reimplemented.
- For multiline text editing, line wrapping has to be implemented for
  all relevant languages.
- Text selection has to be reimplemented.
- Dragging of bidirectional text selections has to be reimplemented.
- Platform-native keyboard shortcuts have to be reimplemented.
- Platform-native input method editors (IMEs) have to be reimplemented.
- Undo and redo functionality has to be reimplemented.
- Accessibility features such as magnification following the caret or
  selection have to be reimplemented.

This is a huge amount of work, and authors are most strongly encouraged
to avoid doing any of it by instead using the
[`input`](#the-input-element) element, the
[`textarea`](#the-textarea-element) element, or the
[`contenteditable`](#attr-contenteditable) attribute.

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.1.24</span> Examples<a href="#examples" class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

<div class="example">

Here is an example of a script that uses canvas to draw [pretty glowing
lines](data:text/html;charset=utf-8;base64,PCFET0NUWVBFIEhUTUw%2BDQo8aHRtbCBsYW5nPSJlbiI%2BDQogPGhlYWQ%2BDQogIDx0aXRsZT5QcmV0dHkgR2xvd2luZyBMaW5lczwvdGl0bGU%2BDQogPC9oZWFkPg0KIDxib2R5Pg0KPGNhbnZhcyB3aWR0aD0iODAwIiBoZWlnaHQ9IjQ1MCI%2BPC9jYW52YXM%%2BDQogPC9ib2R5Pg0KPC9odG1sPg0K).

``` html
<canvas width="800" height="450"></canvas>
<script>

 var context = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0].getContext('2d');

 var lastX = context.canvas.width * Math.random();
 var lastY = context.canvas.height * Math.random();
 var hue = 0;
 function line() {
   context.save();
   context.translate(context.canvas.width/2, context.canvas.height/2);
   context.scale(0.9, 0.9);
   context.translate(-context.canvas.width/2, -context.canvas.height/2);
   context.beginPath();
   context.lineWidth = 5 + Math.random() * 10;
   context.moveTo(lastX, lastY);
   lastX = context.canvas.width * Math.random();
   lastY = context.canvas.height * Math.random();
   context.bezierCurveTo(context.canvas.width * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.height * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.width * Math.random(),
                         context.canvas.height * Math.random(),
                         lastX, lastY);

   hue = hue + 10 * Math.random();
   context.strokeStyle = 'hsl(' + hue + ', 50%, 50%)';
   context.shadowColor = 'white';
   context.shadowBlur = 10;
   context.stroke();
   context.restore();
 }
 setInterval(line, 50);

 function blank() {
   context.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
   context.fillRect(0, 0, context.canvas.width, context.canvas.height);
 }
 setInterval(blank, 40);

</script>
```

</div>

<div class="example">

The 2D rendering context for [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) is often
used for sprite-based games. The following example demonstrates this:

Here is the source for this example:

``` html
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang="en">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Blue Robot Demo</title>
<style>
  html { overflow: hidden; min-height: 200px; min-width: 380px; }
  body { height: 200px; position: relative; margin: 8px; }
  .buttons { position: absolute; bottom: 0px; left: 0px; margin: 4px; }
</style>
<canvas width="380" height="200"></canvas>
<script>
 var Landscape = function (context, width, height) {
   this.offset = 0;
   this.width = width;
   this.advance = function (dx) {
     this.offset += dx;
   };
   this.horizon = height * 0.7;
   // This creates the sky gradient (from a darker blue to white at the bottom)
   this.sky = context.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, this.horizon);
   this.sky.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgb(55,121,179)');
   this.sky.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgb(121,194,245)');
   this.sky.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgb(164,200,214)');
   // this creates the grass gradient (from a darker green to a lighter green)
   this.earth = context.createLinearGradient(0, this.horizon, 0, height);
   this.earth.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgb(81,140,20)');
   this.earth.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgb(123,177,57)');
   this.paintBackground = function (context, width, height) {
     // first, paint the sky and grass rectangles
     context.fillStyle = this.sky;
     context.fillRect(0, 0, width, this.horizon);
     context.fillStyle = this.earth;
     context.fillRect(0, this.horizon, width, height-this.horizon);
     // then, draw the cloudy banner
     // we make it cloudy by having the draw text off the top of the
     // canvas, and just having the blurred shadow shown on the canvas
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*3.2)) % (this.width*4.0))+0, 0);
     context.shadowColor = 'white';
     context.shadowOffsetY = 30+this.horizon/3; // offset down on canvas
     context.shadowBlur = '5';
     context.fillStyle = 'white';
     context.textAlign = 'left';
     context.textBaseline = 'top';
     context.font = '20px sans-serif';
     context.fillText('WHATWG ROCKS', 10, -30); // text up above canvas
     context.restore();
     // then, draw the background tree
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*0.2)) % (this.width*1.5))+30, 0);
     context.beginPath();
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(143,89,2)';
     context.lineStyle = 'rgb(10,10,10)';
     context.lineWidth = 2;
     context.rect(0, this.horizon+5, 10, -50); // trunk
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.beginPath();
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(78,154,6)';
     context.arc(5, this.horizon-60, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); // leaves
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.restore();
   };
   this.paintForeground = function (context, width, height) {
     // draw the box that goes in front
     context.save();
     context.translate(width-((this.offset+(this.width*0.7)) % (this.width*1.1))+0, 0);
     context.beginPath();
     context.rect(0, this.horizon - 5, 25, 25);
     context.fillStyle = 'rgb(220,154,94)';
     context.lineStyle = 'rgb(10,10,10)';
     context.lineWidth = 2;
     context.fill();
     context.stroke();
     context.restore();
   };
 };
</script>
<script>
 var BlueRobot = function () {
   this.sprites = new Image();
   this.sprites.src = 'blue-robot.png'; // this sprite sheet has 8 cells
   this.targetMode = 'idle';
   this.walk = function () {
     this.targetMode = 'walk';
   };
   this.stop = function () {
     this.targetMode = 'idle';
   };
   this.frameIndex = {
     'idle': [0], // first cell is the idle frame
     'walk': [1,2,3,4,5,6], // the walking animation is cells 1-6
     'stop': [7], // last cell is the stopping animation
   };
   this.mode = 'idle';
   this.frame = 0; // index into frameIndex
   this.tick = function () {
     // this advances the frame and the robot
     // the return value is how many pixels the robot has moved
     this.frame += 1;
     if (this.frame >= this.frameIndex[this.mode].length) {
       // we've reached the end of this animation cycle
       this.frame = 0;
       if (this.mode != this.targetMode) {
         // switch to next cycle
         if (this.mode == 'walk') {
           // we need to stop walking before we decide what to do next
           this.mode = 'stop';
         } else if (this.mode == 'stop') {
           if (this.targetMode == 'walk')
             this.mode = 'walk';
           else
             this.mode = 'idle';
         } else if (this.mode == 'idle') {
           if (this.targetMode == 'walk')
             this.mode = 'walk';
         }
       }
     }
     if (this.mode == 'walk')
       return 8;
     return 0;
   },
   this.paint = function (context, x, y) {
     if (!this.sprites.complete) return;
     // draw the right frame out of the sprite sheet onto the canvas
     // we assume each frame is as high as the sprite sheet
     // the x,y coordinates give the position of the bottom center of the sprite
     context.drawImage(this.sprites,
                       this.frameIndex[this.mode][this.frame] * this.sprites.height, 0, this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height,
                       x-this.sprites.height/2, y-this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height, this.sprites.height);
   };
 };
</script>
<script>
 var canvas = document.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
 var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
 var landscape = new Landscape(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
 var blueRobot = new BlueRobot();
 // paint when the browser wants us to, using requestAnimationFrame()
 function paint() {
   context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   landscape.paintBackground(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   blueRobot.paint(context, canvas.width/2, landscape.horizon*1.1);
   landscape.paintForeground(context, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   requestAnimationFrame(paint);
 }
 paint();
 // but tick every 100ms, so that we don't slow down when we don't paint
 setInterval(function () {
   var dx = blueRobot.tick();
   landscape.advance(dx);
 }, 100);
</script>
<p class="buttons">
 <input type=button value="Walk" onclick="blueRobot.walk()">
 <input type=button value="Stop" onclick="blueRobot.stop()">
<footer>
 <small> Blue Robot Player Sprite by <a href="https://johncolburn.deviantart.com/">JohnColburn</a>.
 Licensed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 3.0 Unported license.</small>
 <small> This work is itself licensed under a <a rel="license" href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/">Creative
 Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License</a>.</small>
</footer>
```

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.12.5.2</span> The [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) rendering context<a href="#the-imagebitmap-rendering-context" class="self-link"></a>

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.2.1</span> Introduction<a href="#introduction-6" class="self-link"></a>

[`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) is a
performance-oriented interface that provides a low overhead method for
displaying the contents of [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) objects. It
uses transfer semantics to reduce overall memory consumption. It also
streamlines performance by avoiding intermediate compositing, unlike the
[`drawImage()`](#dom-context-2d-drawimage) method of
[`CanvasRenderingContext2D`](#canvasrenderingcontext2d).

Using an [`img`](#the-img-element) element as an intermediate for
getting an image resource into a canvas, for example, would result in
two copies of the decoded image existing in memory at the same time: the
[`img`](#the-img-element) element's copy, and the one in the canvas's
backing store. This memory cost can be prohibitive when dealing with
extremely large images. This can be avoided by using
[`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext).

<div class="example">

Using [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext),
here is how to transcode an image to the JPEG format in a memory- and
CPU-efficient way:

``` js
createImageBitmap(inputImageBlob).then(image => {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const context = canvas.getContext('bitmaprenderer');
  context.transferFromImageBitmap(image);

  canvas.toBlob(outputJPEGBlob => {
    // Do something with outputJPEGBlob.
  }, 'image/jpeg');
});
```

</div>

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.2.2</span> The [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) interface<a href="#the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface"
class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

``` idl
[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface ImageBitmapRenderingContext {
  readonly attribute (HTMLCanvasElement or OffscreenCanvas) canvas;
  undefined transferFromImageBitmap(ImageBitmap? bitmap);
};

dictionary ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings {
  boolean alpha = true;
};
```

`context`` = ``canvas``.`<a href="#dom-canvas-getcontext"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:dom-canvas-getcontext"><code>getContext</code></a>`('bitmaprenderer' [, { [ `<a href="#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha-2"><code>alpha</code></a>`: false ] } ])`

Returns an [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)
object that is permanently bound to a particular
[`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element.

If the [`alpha`](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha) setting
is provided and set to false, then the canvas is forced to always be
opaque.

`context``.`<a href="#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-canvas"
id="dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-canvas-dev"><code>canvas</code></a>

Returns the [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element that the context is
bound to.

`context``.`<a href="#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap"
id="dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap-dev"><code>transferFromImageBitmap</code></a>`(imageBitmap)`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[ImageBitmapRenderingContext/transferFromImageBitmap](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ImageBitmapRenderingContext/transferFromImageBitmap "The ImageBitmapRenderingContext.transferFromImageBitmap() method displays the given ImageBitmap in the canvas associated with this rendering context. The ownership of the ImageBitmap is transferred to the canvas as well.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox50+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari11.1+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome66+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera unknown">Opera?</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge unknown">Edge
(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Transfers the underlying <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data">bitmap
data</a> from `imageBitmap` to `context`, and the bitmap becomes the
contents of the [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element to which
`context` is bound.

`context``.`<a href="#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap-2"><code>transferFromImageBitmap</code></a>`(null)`

Replaces contents of the [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element to
which `context` is bound with a
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:transparent-black"
data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> bitmap whose
size corresponds to the [`width`](#attr-canvas-width) and
[`height`](#attr-canvas-height) content attributes of the
[`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-canvas" class="dfn"
dfn-for="ImageBitmapRenderingContext"
dfn-type="attribute">`canvas`</span> attribute must return the value it
was initialized to when the object was created.

</div>

An [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object
has an <span id="concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
class="dfn">output bitmap</span>, which is a reference to
<a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-2">bitmap
data</a>.

An [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object
has a <span id="concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode"
class="dfn">bitmap mode</span>, which can be set to
<span id="concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid"
class="dfn">valid</span> or
<span id="concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank"
class="dfn">blank</span>. A value of
<a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid">valid</a>
indicates that the context's
<a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap">output
bitmap</a> refers to <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-3">bitmap
data</a> that was acquired via
[`transferFromImageBitmap()`](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap).
A value <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank">blank</a>
indicates that the context's
<a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-2">output
bitmap</a> is a default transparent bitmap.

<div algorithm="">

An [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object
also has an <span id="concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha"
class="dfn">alpha</span> flag, which can be set to true or false. When
an [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object
has its <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha">alpha</a>
flag set to false, the contents of the [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element)
element to which the context is bound are obtained by compositing the
context's <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-3">output
bitmap</a> onto an
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:opaque-black"
data-x-internal="opaque-black">opaque black</a> bitmap of the same size
using the <a
href="https://drafts.csswg.org/compositing/#porterduffcompositingoperators_srcover"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:gcop-source-over"
data-x-internal="gcop-source-over">source-over</a> compositing operator.
If the <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha-2">alpha</a>
flag is set to true, then the
<a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-4">output
bitmap</a> is used as the contents of the
[`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element to which the context is bound.
[\[COMPOSITE\]](#refsCOMPOSITE)

</div>

The step of compositing over an
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:opaque-black-2"
data-x-internal="opaque-black">opaque black</a> bitmap ought to be
elided whenever equivalent results can be obtained more efficiently by
other means.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

When a user agent is required to
<span id="set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext's-output-bitmap"
class="dfn">set an `ImageBitmapRenderingContext`'s output bitmap</span>,
with a `context` argument that is an
[`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object and
an optional argument `bitmap` that refers to
<a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-4">bitmap
data</a>, it must run these steps:

1.  If a `bitmap` argument was not provided, then:

    1.  Set `context`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode">bitmap
        mode</a> to <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-blank-2">blank</a>.

    2.  Let `canvas` be the [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element to
        which `context` is bound.

    3.  Set `context`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-5">output
        bitmap</a> to be
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:transparent-black-2"
        data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> with a
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-width"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:natural-width"
        data-x-internal="natural-width">natural width</a> equal to
        <a href="#obtain-numeric-values"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:obtain-numeric-values">the
        numeric value</a> of `canvas`'s [`width`](#attr-canvas-width)
        attribute and a
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:natural-height"
        data-x-internal="natural-height">natural height</a> equal to
        <a href="#obtain-numeric-values"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:obtain-numeric-values-2">the
        numeric value</a> of `canvas`'s [`height`](#attr-canvas-height)
        attribute, those values being interpreted in
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:&#39;px&#39;"
        data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS pixels</a>.

    4.  Set the
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-6">output
        bitmap</a>'s <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean">origin-clean</a>
        flag to true.

2.  If a `bitmap` argument was provided, then:

    1.  Set `context`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-bitmap-mode-2">bitmap
        mode</a> to <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-valid-2">valid</a>.

    2.  Set `context`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-7">output
        bitmap</a> to refer to the same underlying bitmap data as
        `bitmap`, without making a copy.

        The <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-2">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `bitmap` is included in the bitmap data to be referenced
        by `context`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
        id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-8">output
        bitmap</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="imagebitmaprenderingcontext-creation-algorithm"
class="dfn">`ImageBitmapRenderingContext` creation algorithm</span>,
which is passed a `target` and `options`, consists of running these
steps:

1.  Let `settings` be the result of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#es-type-mapping"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-idl-convert"
    data-x-internal="concept-idl-convert">converting</a> `options` to
    the dictionary type
    [`ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings).
    (This can throw an exception.)

2.  Let `context` be a new
    [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext)
    object.

3.  Initialize `context`'s [`canvas`](#dom-context-2d-canvas) attribute
    to point to `target`.

4.  Set `context`'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-output-bitmap-9">output
    bitmap</a> to the same bitmap as `target`'s bitmap (so that they are
    shared).

5.  Run the steps to
    <a href="#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap">set
    an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>'s output bitmap</a> with
    `context`.

6.  Initialize `context`'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha-3">alpha</a>
    flag to true.

7.  Process each of the members of `settings` as follows:

    <span id="dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontextsettings-alpha" class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmapRenderingContextSettings" dfn-type="dict-member">`alpha`</span>  
    If false, then set `context`'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-alpha-4">alpha</a>
    flag to false.

8.  Return `context`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap"
class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmapRenderingContext"
dfn-type="method">`transferFromImageBitmap(``bitmap``)`</span> method,
when invoked, must run these steps:

1.  Let `bitmapContext` be the
    [`ImageBitmapRenderingContext`](#imagebitmaprenderingcontext) object
    on which the
    [`transferFromImageBitmap()`](#dom-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-transferfromimagebitmap)
    method was called.

2.  If `bitmap` is null, then run the steps to
    <a href="#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap-2">set
    an ImageBitmapRenderingContext's output bitmap</a>, with
    `bitmapContext` as the *context* argument and no *bitmap* argument,
    then return.

3.  If the value of `bitmap`'s <a href="#detached"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:detached">[[Detached]]</a>
    internal slot is set to true, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:invalidstateerror"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  Run the steps to
    <a href="#set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:set-an-imagebitmaprenderingcontext&#39;s-output-bitmap-3">set
    an <code>ImageBitmapRenderingContext</code>'s output bitmap</a>,
    with the *context* argument equal to `bitmapContext`, and the
    *bitmap* argument referring to `bitmap`'s underlying
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-5">bitmap
    data</a>.

5.  Set the value of `bitmap`'s <a href="#detached"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:detached-2">[[Detached]]</a>
    internal slot to true.

6.  Unset `bitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmaprenderingcontext-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-6">bitmap
    data</a>.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">4.12.5.3</span> The [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) interface<a href="#the-offscreencanvas-interface" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[OffscreenCanvas](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/OffscreenCanvas "When using the <canvas> element or the Canvas API, rendering, animation, and user interaction usually happen on the main execution thread of a web application. The computation relating to canvas animations and rendering can have a significant impact on application performance.")

(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari

</div>

``` idl
typedef (OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D or ImageBitmapRenderingContext or WebGLRenderingContext or WebGL2RenderingContext or GPUCanvasContext) OffscreenRenderingContext;

dictionary ImageEncodeOptions {
  DOMString type = "image/png";
  unrestricted double quality;
};

enum OffscreenRenderingContextId { "2d", "bitmaprenderer", "webgl", "webgl2", "webgpu" };

[Exposed=(Window,Worker), Transferable]
interface OffscreenCanvas : EventTarget {
  constructor([EnforceRange] unsigned long long width, [EnforceRange] unsigned long long height);

  attribute [EnforceRange] unsigned long long width;
  attribute [EnforceRange] unsigned long long height;

  OffscreenRenderingContext? getContext(OffscreenRenderingContextId contextId, optional any options = null);
  ImageBitmap transferToImageBitmap();
  Promise<Blob> convertToBlob(optional ImageEncodeOptions options = {});

  attribute EventHandler oncontextlost;
  attribute EventHandler oncontextrestored;
};
```

[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) is an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-eventtarget"
data-x-internal="eventtarget"><code
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:eventtarget-2">EventTarget</code></a>,
so both
[`OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D`](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)
and WebGL can fire events at it.
[`OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D`](#offscreencanvasrenderingcontext2d)
can fire [`contextlost`](#event-contextlost) and
[`contextrestored`](#event-contextrestored), and WebGL can fire
`webglcontextlost` and `webglcontextrestored`. [\[WEBGL\]](#refsWEBGL)

[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) objects are used to create
rendering contexts, much like an
[`HTMLCanvasElement`](#htmlcanvaselement), but with no connection to the
DOM. This makes it possible to use canvas rendering contexts in
[workers](#workers).

An [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object may hold a weak
reference to a <span id="offscreencanvas-placeholder"
class="dfn">placeholder `canvas` element</span>, which is typically in
the DOM, whose embedded content is provided by the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object. The bitmap of the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object is pushed to the
<a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder">placeholder
<code>canvas</code> element</a> as part of the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas)'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
<a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-agent-event-loop">event
loop</a>'s <a href="#update-the-rendering"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:update-the-rendering">update the
rendering</a> steps.

`offscreenCanvas`` = new `<a href="#dom-offscreencanvas"
id="dom-offscreencanvas-dev"><code>OffscreenCanvas</code></a>`(``width``, ``height``)`

Returns a new [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object that is not
linked to a <a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder-2">placeholder
<code>canvas</code> element</a>, and whose bitmap's size is determined
by the `width` and `height` arguments.

Returns an object that exposes an API for drawing on the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object. `contextId` specifies the
desired API: "[`2d`](#offscreen-context-type-2d)",
"[`bitmaprenderer`](#offscreen-context-type-bitmaprenderer)",
"[`webgl`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)",
"[`webgl2`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)", or
"[`webgpu`](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)". `options` is handled by
that API.

This specification defines the "[`2d`](#canvas-context-2d)" context
below, which is similar but distinct from the
"[`2d`](#offscreen-context-type-2d)" context that is created from a
[`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element. The WebGL specifications define
the "[`webgl`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)" and
"[`webgl2`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)" contexts. WebGPU defines
the "[`webgpu`](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)" context.
[\[WEBGL\]](#refsWEBGL) [\[WEBGPU\]](#refsWEBGPU)

Returns null if the canvas has already been initialized with another
context type (e.g., trying to get a "[`2d`](#offscreen-context-type-2d)"
context after getting a "[`webgl`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)"
context).

An [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object has an internal
<span id="offscreencanvas-bitmap" class="dfn">bitmap</span> that is
initialized when the object is created. The width and height of the
<a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap">bitmap</a> are
equal to the values of the [`width`](#dom-offscreencanvas-width) and
[`height`](#dom-offscreencanvas-height) attributes of the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object. Initially, all the
bitmap's pixels are
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transparent-black"
data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a>.

An [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object has an internal
<span id="offscreencanvas-inherited-lang" class="dfn">inherited
language</span> and <span id="offscreencanvas-inherited-direction"
class="dfn">inherited direction</span> set when the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) is created.

An [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object can have a rendering
context bound to it. Initially, it does not have a bound rendering
context. To keep track of whether it has a rendering context or not, and
what kind of rendering context it is, an
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object also has a
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-mode" class="dfn">context mode</span>,
which is initially <span id="offscreencanvas-context-none"
class="dfn">none</span> but can be changed to either
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-2d" class="dfn">2d</span>,
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-bitmaprenderer"
class="dfn">bitmaprenderer</span>,
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-webgl" class="dfn">webgl</span>,
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-webgl2" class="dfn">webgl2</span>,
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-webgpu" class="dfn">webgpu</span>, or
<span id="offscreencanvas-context-detached" class="dfn">detached</span>
by algorithms defined in this specification.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-offscreencanvas" class="dfn" dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas"
dfn-type="constructor">`new OffscreenCanvas(``width``, ``height``)`</span>
constructor steps are:

1.  Initialize the <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-2">bitmap</a>
    of <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>
    to a rectangular array of
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transparent-black-2"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> pixels of
    the dimensions specified by `width` and `height`.

2.  Initialize the [`width`](#dom-offscreencanvas-width) of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a> to `width`.

3.  Initialize the [`height`](#dom-offscreencanvas-height) of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a> to `height`.

4.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-lang">inherited
    language</a> to <a href="#concept-explicitly-unknown"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-explicitly-unknown">explicitly
    unknown</a>.

5.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-5"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-direction">inherited
    direction</a> to "`ltr`".

6.  Let `global` be the <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a> of <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-6"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

7.  If `global` is a [`Window`](#window) object:

    1.  Let `element` be the
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element"
        id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:document-element"
        data-x-internal="document-element">document element</a> of
        `global`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-document-window">associated
        <code>Document</code></a>.

    2.  If `element` is not null:

        1.  Set the <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-lang-2">inherited
            language</a> of
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-7"
            data-x-internal="this">this</a> to `element`'s
            <a href="#language"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:language">language</a>.

        2.  Set the <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-direction-2">inherited
            direction</a> of
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-8"
            data-x-internal="this">this</a> to `element`'s
            <a href="#the-directionality"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:the-directionality">directionality</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) objects are
<a href="#transferable-objects"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transferable-objects">transferable</a>.
Their <a href="#transfer-steps"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transfer-steps">transfer steps</a>,
given `value` and `dataHolder`, are as follows:

1.  If `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode">context
    mode</a> is not equal to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-none"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-none">none</a>,
    then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Set `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-2">context
    mode</a> to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-detached"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-detached">detached</a>.

3.  Let `width` and `height` be the dimensions of `value`'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-3">bitmap</a>.

4.  Let `language` and `direction` be the values of `value`'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-lang-3">inherited
    language</a> and <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-direction-3">inherited
    direction</a>.

5.  Unset `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-4">bitmap</a>.

6.  Set `dataHolder`.\[\[Width\]\] to `width` and
    `dataHolder`.\[\[Height\]\] to `height`.

7.  Set `dataHolder`.\[\[Language\]\] to `language` and
    `dataHolder`.\[\[Direction\]\] to `direction`.

8.  Set `dataHolder`.\[\[PlaceholderCanvas\]\] to be a weak reference to
    `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder-3">placeholder
    <code>canvas</code> element</a>, if `value` has one, or null if it
    does not.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Their <a href="#transfer-receiving-steps"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transfer-receiving-steps">transfer-receiving
steps</a>, given `dataHolder` and `value`, are:

1.  Initialize `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-5">bitmap</a>
    to a rectangular array of
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transparent-black-3"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> pixels
    with width given by `dataHolder`.\[\[Width\]\] and height given by
    `dataHolder`.\[\[Height\]\].

2.  Set `value`'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-lang"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-lang-4">inherited
    language</a> to `dataHolder`.\[\[Language\]\] and its
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-inherited-direction"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-inherited-direction-4">inherited
    direction</a> to `dataHolder`.\[\[Direction\]\].

3.  If `dataHolder`.\[\[PlaceholderCanvas\]\] is not null, set `value`'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder-4">placeholder
    <code>canvas</code> element</a> to
    `dataHolder`.\[\[PlaceholderCanvas\]\] (while maintaining the weak
    reference semantics).

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas"

    JavaScript value.

3.  Run the steps in the cell of the following table whose column header
    matches this [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-3">context
    mode</a> and whose row header matches `contextId`:

    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-7">context
    mode</a> to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-webgpu"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-webgpu-2">webgpu</a>.</p></li>
    <li><p>Return <var>context</var>.</p></li>
    </ol></td>
    <td>Return null.</td>
    <td>Return null.</td>
    <td>Return null.</td>
    <td>Return the same value as was returned the last time the method was
    invoked with this same first argument.</td>
    <td>Throw an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-5"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>

    data-x-internal="domexception"><code

These attributes return the dimensions of the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
<a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-6">bitmap</a>.

They can be set, to replace the <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-7">bitmap</a>
with a new,
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transparent-black-4"
data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> bitmap of the
specified dimensions (effectively resizing it).

<div algorithm="">

If either the <span id="dom-offscreencanvas-width" class="dfn"
dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas" dfn-type="attribute">`width`</span> or
<span id="dom-offscreencanvas-height" class="dfn"
dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas" dfn-type="attribute">`height`</span>
attributes of an [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object are set
(to a new value or to the same value as before) and the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
<a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-8">context
mode</a> is <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-2d"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-2d-3">2d</a>,
then <a href="#reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:reset-the-rendering-context-to-its-default-state">reset
the rendering context to its default state</a> and resize the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
<a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-8">bitmap</a>
to the new values of the [`width`](#dom-offscreencanvas-width) and
[`height`](#dom-offscreencanvas-height) attributes.

</div>

The resizing behavior for "[`webgl`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl)" and
"[`webgl2`](#offscreen-context-type-webgl2)" contexts is defined in the
WebGL specifications. [\[WEBGL\]](#refsWEBGL)

The resizing behavior for "[`webgpu`](#offscreen-context-type-webgpu)"
context is defined in WebGPU. [\[WEBGPU\]](#refsWEBGPU)

If an [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object whose dimensions were
changed has a <a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder-5">placeholder
<code>canvas</code> element</a>, then the
<a href="#offscreencanvas-placeholder"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-placeholder-6">placeholder
<code>canvas</code> element</a>'s
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:natural-dimensions"
data-x-internal="natural-dimensions">natural size</a> will only be
updated during the [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas)'s
<a href="#relevant-agent"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:relevant-agent-2">relevant agent</a>'s
<a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-agent-event-loop-2">event
loop</a>'s <a href="#update-the-rendering"
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:update-the-rendering-2">update the
rendering</a> steps.

Returns a promise that will fulfill with a new
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
data-x-internal="blob"><code
id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:blob-2">Blob</code></a> object
representing a file containing the image in the
[`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object.

The argument, if provided, is a dictionary that controls the encoding
options of the image file to be created. The
[`type`](#image-encode-options-type) field specifies the file format and
has a default value of "[`image/png`](#image/png)"; that type is also
used if the requested type isn't supported. If the image format supports
variable quality (such as "[`image/jpeg`](#image/jpeg)"), then the
[`quality`](#image-encode-options-quality) field is a number in the
range 0.0 to 1.0 inclusive indicating the desired quality level for the
resulting image.

`canvas``.`<a href="#dom-offscreencanvas-transfertoimagebitmap"
id="dom-offscreencanvas-transfertoimagebitmap-dev"><code>transferToImageBitmap</code></a>`()`

The OffscreenCanvas allocates a new image for its subsequent rendering.")

Returns a newly created [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object with the
image in the [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object. The image in
the [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object is replaced with a new
blank image.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-offscreencanvas-converttoblob" class="dfn"
dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas"
dfn-type="method">`convertToBlob(``options``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  If the value of <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-15"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#detached"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:detached">[[Detached]]</a>
    internal slot is true, then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:a-promise-rejected-with"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-6"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-16"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-9">context
    mode</a> is <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-2d"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-2d-4">2d</a>
    and the rendering context's <a href="#output-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:output-bitmap">output bitmap</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean">origin-clean</a>
    flag is set to false, then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-2"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-7">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-17"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-9">bitmap</a>
    has no pixels (i.e., either its horizontal dimension or its vertical
    dimension is zero), then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-3"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:indexsizeerror"
    data-x-internal="indexsizeerror">"<code>IndexSizeError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-8">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  Let `bitmap` be a copy of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-18"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-10">bitmap</a>.

5.  Let `result` be a new promise object.

6.  Let `global` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:this-19"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant
    global object</a>.

7.  Run these steps
    <a href="#in-parallel" id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:in-parallel">in
    parallel</a>:

    1.  Let `file` be <a href="#a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file"
        id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:a-serialisation-of-the-bitmap-as-a-file">a
        serialization of <var>bitmap</var> as a file</a>, with
        `options`'s <span id="image-encode-options-type"
        class="dfn">`type`</span> and
        <span id="image-encode-options-quality"
        class="dfn">`quality`</span> if present.

    2.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:queue-a-global-task">Queue a global
        task</a> on the <a href="#canvas-blob-serialisation-task-source"
        id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:canvas-blob-serialisation-task-source">canvas
        blob serialization task source</a> given `global` to run these
        steps:

        1.  If `file` is null, then reject `result` with an
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#encodingerror"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:encodingerror"
            data-x-internal="encodingerror">"<code>EncodingError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-9">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Otherwise, resolve `result` with a new
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
            data-x-internal="blob"><code
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:blob-3">Blob</code></a>
            object, created in `global`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
            id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-relevant-realm">relevant
            realm</a>, representing `file`. [\[FILEAPI\]](#refsFILEAPI)

8.  Return `result`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-offscreencanvas-transfertoimagebitmap" class="dfn"
dfn-for="OffscreenCanvas"
dfn-type="method">`transferToImageBitmap()`</span> method, when invoked,
must run the following steps:

1.  If the value of this [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
    <a href="#detached"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:detached-2">[[Detached]]</a>
    internal slot is set to true, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-7"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-10">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  If this [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-mode"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-mode-10">context
    mode</a> is set to <a href="#offscreencanvas-context-none"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-context-none-3">none</a>,
    then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:invalidstateerror-8"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:domexception-11">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Let `image` be a newly created [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object
    that references the same underlying bitmap data as this
    [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-11">bitmap</a>.

4.  Set this [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) object's
    <a href="#offscreencanvas-bitmap"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:offscreencanvas-bitmap-12">bitmap</a>
    to reference a newly created bitmap of the same dimensions and color
    space as the previous bitmap, and with its pixels initialized to
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:transparent-black-5"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a>, or
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:opaque-black"
    data-x-internal="opaque-black">opaque black</a> if the rendering
    context's <a href="#concept-canvas-alpha"
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:concept-canvas-alpha">alpha</a> is
    false.

    This means that if the rendering context of this
    [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas) is a <a
    href="https://www.khronos.org/registry/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#WebGLRenderingContext"
    data-x-internal="webglrenderingcontext"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:webglrenderingcontext-2">WebGLRenderingContext</code></a>,
    the value of <a
    href="https://www.khronos.org/registry/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/#WebGLContextAttributes"
    data-x-internal="webglcontextattributes"><code
    id="the-offscreencanvas-interface:webglcontextattributes">preserveDrawingBuffer</code></a>
    will have no effect. [\[WEBGL\]](#refsWEBGL)

5.  Return `image`.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">4.12.5.3.1</span> The offscreen 2D rendering context<a href="#the-offscreen-2d-rendering-context" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D "The OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D interface is a CanvasRenderingContext2D rendering context for drawing to the bitmap of an OffscreenCanvas object. It is similar to the CanvasRenderingContext2D object, with the following differences:")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

------------------------------------------------------------------------
