Elements with an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute may have an
<span id="attr-itemtype" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global"
dfn-type="element-attr">`itemtype`</span> attribute specified, to give
the <a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types">item types</a> of the
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item">item</a>.

The [`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute, if specified, must have a
value that is an
<a href="#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens"
id="items:unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens">unordered set
of unique space-separated tokens</a>, none of which are
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="items:identical-to" data-x-internal="identical-to">identical to</a>
another token and each of which is a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string"
id="items:valid-url-string" data-x-internal="valid-url-string">valid URL
string</a> that is an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="items:absolute-url" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute URL</a>,
and all of which are defined to use the same vocabulary. The attribute's
value must have at least one token.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="item-types" class="dfn">item types</span> of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-2">item</a> are the
tokens obtained by
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
id="items:split-a-string-on-spaces"
data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">splitting the element's
<code>itemtype</code> attribute's value on ASCII whitespace</a>. If the
[`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute is missing or parsing it in this
way finds no tokens, the
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-3">item</a> is said to
have no <a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-2">item types</a>.

</div>

The <a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-3">item types</a> must
all be types defined in <a href="#other-applicable-specifications"
id="items:other-applicable-specifications">applicable specifications</a>
and must all be defined to use the same vocabulary.

Except if otherwise specified by that specification, the
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url" id="items:url"
data-x-internal="url">URLs</a> given as the
<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-4">item types</a> should not
be automatically dereferenced.

A specification could define that its
<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-5">item type</a> can be
dereferenced to provide the user with help information, for example. In
fact, vocabulary authors are encouraged to provide useful information at
the given
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url" id="items:url-2"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a>.

<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-6">Item types</a> are opaque
identifiers, and user agents must not dereference unknown
<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-7">item types</a>, or
otherwise deconstruct them, in order to determine how to process
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-4">items</a> that use
them.

The [`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute must not be specified on
elements that do not have an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute
specified.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

An <a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-5">item</a> is said to
be a <span id="typed-item" class="dfn">typed item</span> when either it
has an <a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-8">item type</a>, or
it is the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="items:concept-property-value">value</a> of a
<a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="items:the-properties-of-an-item">property</a> of a
<a href="#typed-item" id="items:typed-item">typed item</a>. The
<span id="relevant-types" class="dfn">relevant types</span> for a
<a href="#typed-item" id="items:typed-item-2">typed item</a> is the
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-6">item</a>'s
<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-9">item types</a>, if it has
any, or else is the
<a href="#relevant-types" id="items:relevant-types">relevant types</a>
of the <a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-7">item</a> for
which it is a <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="items:the-properties-of-an-item-2">property</a>'s
<a href="#concept-property-value"
id="items:concept-property-value-2">value</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome

Elements with an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute and an
[`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute that references a vocabulary that
is defined to <span id="support-global-identifiers-for-items"
class="dfn">support global identifiers for items</span> may also have an
<span id="attr-itemid" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global"
dfn-type="element-attr">`itemid`</span> attribute specified, to give a
global identifier for the
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-8">item</a>, so that it
can be related to other
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-9">items</a> on pages
elsewhere on the web.

The [`itemid`](#attr-itemid) attribute, if specified, must have a value
that is a <a href="#valid-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces"
id="items:valid-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces">valid URL
potentially surrounded by spaces</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="global-identifier" class="dfn">global identifier</span> of
an <a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-10">item</a> is the
value of its element's [`itemid`](#attr-itemid) attribute, if it has
one, <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
id="items:encoding-parsing-a-url">parsed</a> relative to the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="items:node-document" data-x-internal="node-document">node
document</a> of the element on which the attribute is specified. If the
[`itemid`](#attr-itemid) attribute is missing or if parsing it returns
failure, it is said to have no
<a href="#global-identifier" id="items:global-identifier">global
identifier</a>.

</div>

The [`itemid`](#attr-itemid) attribute must not be specified on elements
that do not have both an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute and an
[`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute specified, and must not be
specified on elements with an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute
whose [`itemtype`](#attr-itemtype) attribute specifies a vocabulary that
does not <a href="#support-global-identifiers-for-items"
id="items:support-global-identifiers-for-items">support global
identifiers for items</a>, as defined by that vocabulary's
specification.

The exact meaning of a
<a href="#global-identifier" id="items:global-identifier-2">global
identifier</a> is determined by the vocabulary's specification. It is up
to such specifications to define whether multiple items with the same
global identifier (whether on the same page or on different pages) are
allowed to exist, and what the processing rules for that vocabulary are
with respect to handling the case of multiple items with the same ID.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet ExplorerYes</span>

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome

Elements with an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute may have an
<span id="attr-itemref" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global"
dfn-type="element-attr">`itemref`</span> attribute specified, to give a
list of additional elements to crawl to find the name-value pairs of the
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-11">item</a>.

The [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) attribute, if specified, must have a
value that is an
<a href="#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens"
id="items:unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens-2">unordered
set of unique space-separated tokens</a> none of which are
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="items:identical-to-2" data-x-internal="identical-to">identical
to</a> another token and consisting of
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id" id="items:concept-id"
data-x-internal="concept-id">IDs</a> of elements in the same
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree" id="items:tree"
data-x-internal="tree">tree</a>.

The [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) attribute must not be specified on
elements that do not have an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute
specified.

The [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) attribute is not part of the microdata
data model. It is merely a syntactic construct to aid authors in adding
annotations to pages where the data to be annotated does not follow a
convenient tree structure. For example, it allows authors to mark up
data in a table so that each column defines a separate
<a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-12">item</a>, while
keeping the properties in the cells.

<div class="example">

This example shows a simple vocabulary used to describe the products of
a model railway manufacturer. The vocabulary has just five property
names:

product-code  
An integer that names the product in the manufacturer's catalog.

name  
A brief description of the product.

scale  
One of "HO", "1", or "Z" (potentially with leading or trailing
whitespace), indicating the scale of the product.

digital  
If present, one of "Digital", "Delta", or "Systems" (potentially with
leading or trailing whitespace) indicating that the product has a
digital decoder of the given type.

track-type  
For track-specific products, one of "K", "M", "C" (potentially with
leading or trailing whitespace) indicating the type of track for which
the product is intended.

This vocabulary has four defined
<a href="#item-types" id="items:item-types-10">item types</a>:

https://md.example.com/loco  
Rolling stock with an engine

https://md.example.com/passengers  
Passenger rolling stock

https://md.example.com/track  
Track pieces

https://md.example.com/lighting  
Equipment with lighting

Each <a href="#concept-item" id="items:concept-item-13">item</a> that
uses this vocabulary can be given one or more of these types, depending
on what the product is.

Thus, a locomotive might be marked up as:

``` html
<dl itemscope itemtype="https://md.example.com/loco
                        https://md.example.com/lighting">
 <dt>Name:
 <dd itemprop="name">Tank Locomotive (DB 80)
 <dt>Product code:
 <dd itemprop="product-code">33041
 <dt>Scale:
 <dd itemprop="scale">HO
 <dt>Digital:
 <dd itemprop="digital">Delta
</dl>
```

A turnout lantern retrofit kit might be marked up as:

``` html
<dl itemscope itemtype="https://md.example.com/track
                        https://md.example.com/lighting">
 <dt>Name:
 <dd itemprop="name">Turnout Lantern Kit
 <dt>Product code:
 <dd itemprop="product-code">74470
 <dt>Purpose:
 <dd>For retrofitting 2 <span itemprop="track-type">C</span> Track
 turnouts. <meta itemprop="scale" content="HO">
</dl>
```

A passenger car with no lighting might be marked up as:

``` html
<dl itemscope itemtype="https://md.example.com/passengers">
 <dt>Name:
 <dd itemprop="name">Express Train Passenger Car (DB Am 203)
 <dt>Product code:
 <dd itemprop="product-code">8710
 <dt>Scale:
 <dd itemprop="scale">Z
</dl>
```

Great care is necessary when creating new vocabularies. Often, a
hierarchical approach to types can be taken that results in a vocabulary
where each item only ever has a single type, which is generally much
simpler to manage.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">5.2.3</span> Names: the <span class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global" dfn-type="element-attr">`itemprop`</span> attribute<a href="#names:-the-itemprop-attribute" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Global_attributes/itemprop](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/itemprop "The itemprop global attribute is used to add properties to an item. Every HTML element can have an itemprop attribute specified, and an itemprop consists of a name-value pair. Each name-value pair is called a property, and a group of one or more properties forms an item. Property values are either a string or a URL and can be associated with a very wide range of elements including <audio>, <embed>, <iframe>, <img>, <link>, <object>, <source>, <track>, and <video>.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">FirefoxYes</span><span class="safari yes">SafariYes</span><span class="chrome yes">ChromeYes</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera unknown">Opera?</span><span class="edge_blink yes">EdgeYes</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet ExplorerYes</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Every <a href="#html-elements"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:html-elements">HTML element</a> may
have an [`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute
specified, if doing so <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:the-properties-of-an-item">adds one or
more properties</a> to one or more <a href="#concept-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:concept-item">items</a> (as defined
below).

The [`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute, if
specified, must have a value that is an
<a href="#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens">unordered
set of unique space-separated tokens</a> none of which are
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:identical-to"
data-x-internal="identical-to">identical to</a> another token,
representing the names of the name-value pairs that it adds. The
attribute's value must have at least one token.

Each token must be either:

- If the item is a <a href="#typed-item"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:typed-item">typed item</a>: a
  <span id="defined-property-name" class="dfn">defined property
  name</span> allowed in this situation according to the specification
  that defines the <a href="#relevant-types"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:relevant-types">relevant types</a>
  for the item, or
- A <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:valid-url-string"
  data-x-internal="valid-url-string">valid URL string</a> that is an
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:absolute-url"
  data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute URL</a> defined as an item
  property name allowed in this situation by a vocabulary specification,
  or
- A <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:valid-url-string-2"
  data-x-internal="valid-url-string">valid URL string</a> that is an
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:absolute-url-2"
  data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute URL</a>, used as a proprietary
  item property name (i.e. one used by the author for private purposes,
  not defined in a public specification), or
- If the item is not a <a href="#typed-item"
  id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:typed-item-2">typed item</a>: a
  string that contains no U+002E FULL STOP characters (.) and no U+003A
  COLON characters (:), used as a proprietary item property name (i.e.
  one used by the author for private purposes, not defined in a public
  specification).

Specifications that introduce <a href="#defined-property-name"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:defined-property-name">defined
property names</a> must ensure all such property names contain no U+002E
FULL STOP characters (.), no U+003A COLON characters (:), and no
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:space-characters"
data-x-internal="space-characters">ASCII whitespace</a>.

The rules above disallow U+003A COLON characters (:) in non-URL values
because otherwise they could not be distinguished from URLs. Values with
U+002E FULL STOP characters (.) are reserved for future extensions.
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:space-characters-2"
data-x-internal="space-characters">ASCII whitespace</a> are disallowed
because otherwise the values would be parsed as multiple tokens.

When an element with an [`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)
attribute <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:the-properties-of-an-item-2">adds a
property</a> to multiple <a href="#concept-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:concept-item-2">items</a>, the
requirement above regarding the tokens applies for each
<a href="#concept-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:concept-item-3">item</a> individually.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="property-names" class="dfn">property names</span> of an
element are the tokens that the element's
[`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute is found to
contain when its value is
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:split-a-string-on-spaces"
data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">split on ASCII whitespace</a>,
with the order preserved but with duplicates removed (leaving only the
first occurrence of each name).

</div>

Within an <a href="#concept-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:concept-item-4">item</a>, the
properties are unordered with respect to each other, except for
properties with the same name, which are ordered in the order they are
given by the algorithm that defines <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="names:-the-itemprop-attribute:the-properties-of-an-item-3">the
properties of an item</a>.

<div class="example">

In the following example, the "a" property has the values "1" and "2",
*in that order*, but whether the "a" property comes before the "b"
property or not is not important:

``` html
<div itemscope>
 <p itemprop="a">1</p>
 <p itemprop="a">2</p>
 <p itemprop="b">test</p>
</div>
```

Thus, the following is equivalent:

``` html
<div itemscope>
 <p itemprop="b">test</p>
 <p itemprop="a">1</p>
 <p itemprop="a">2</p>
</div>
```

As is the following:

``` html
<div itemscope>
 <p itemprop="a">1</p>
 <p itemprop="b">test</p>
 <p itemprop="a">2</p>
</div>
```

And the following:

``` html
<div id="x">
 <p itemprop="a">1</p>
</div>
<div itemscope itemref="x">
 <p itemprop="b">test</p>
 <p itemprop="a">2</p>
</div>
```

</div>

#### <span class="secno">5.2.4</span> Values<a href="#values" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-property-value" class="dfn">property value</span>
of a name-value pair added by an element with an
[`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute is as given for
the first matching case in the following list:

If the element also has an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope) attribute  
The value is the
<a href="#concept-item" id="values:concept-item">item</a> created by the
element.

If the element is a [`meta`](#the-meta-element) element  
The value is the value of the element's [`content`](#attr-meta-content)
attribute, if any, or the empty string if there is no such attribute.

If the element is an [`audio`](#the-audio-element), [`embed`](#the-embed-element), [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element), [`img`](#the-img-element), [`source`](#the-source-element), [`track`](#the-track-element), or [`video`](#the-video-element) element  
The value is the result of
<a href="#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url"
id="values:encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url">encoding-parsing-and-serializing
a URL</a> given the element's `src` attribute's value, relative to the
element's <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="values:node-document" data-x-internal="node-document">node
document</a>, at the time the attribute is set, or the empty string if
there is no such attribute or the result is failure.

If the element is an [`a`](#the-a-element), [`area`](#the-area-element), or [`link`](#the-link-element) element  
The value is the result of
<a href="#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url"
id="values:encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url-2">encoding-parsing-and-serializing
a URL</a> given the element's `href` attribute's value, relative to the
element's <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="values:node-document-2" data-x-internal="node-document">node
document</a>, at the time the attribute is set, or the empty string if
there is no such attribute or the result is failure.

If the element is an [`object`](#the-object-element) element  
The value is the result of
<a href="#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url"
id="values:encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url-3">encoding-parsing-and-serializing
a URL</a> given the element's `data` attribute's value, relative to the
element's <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="values:node-document-3" data-x-internal="node-document">node
document</a>, at the time the attribute is set, or the empty string if
there is no such attribute or the result is failure.

If the element is a [`data`](#the-data-element) element  
The value is the value of the element's [`value`](#attr-data-value)
attribute, if it has one, or the empty string otherwise.

If the element is a [`meter`](#the-meter-element) element  
The value is the value of the element's [`value`](#attr-meter-value)
attribute, if it has one, or the empty string otherwise.

If the element is a [`time`](#the-time-element) element  
The value is the element's
<a href="#datetime-value" id="values:datetime-value">datetime value</a>.

Otherwise  
The value is the element's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content"
id="values:descendant-text-content"
data-x-internal="descendant-text-content">descendant text content</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="url-property-elements" class="dfn">URL property
elements</span> are the [`a`](#the-a-element),
[`area`](#the-area-element), [`audio`](#the-audio-element),
[`embed`](#the-embed-element), [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element),
[`img`](#the-img-element), [`link`](#the-link-element),
[`object`](#the-object-element), [`source`](#the-source-element),
[`track`](#the-track-element), and [`video`](#the-video-element)
elements.

</div>

If a property's <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="values:concept-property-value">value</a>, as defined by the
property's definition, is an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="values:absolute-url" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute URL</a>,
the property must be specified using a
<a href="#url-property-elements" id="values:url-property-elements">URL
property element</a>.

These requirements do not apply just because a property value happens to
match the syntax for a URL. They only apply if the property is
explicitly defined as taking such a value.

For example, a book about the first moon landing could be called
"mission:moon". A "title" property from a vocabulary that defines a
title as being a string would not expect the title to be given in an
[`a`](#the-a-element) element, even though it looks like a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url" id="values:url"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a>. On the other hand, if there was a (rather
narrowly scoped!) vocabulary for "books whose titles look like URLs"
which had a "title" property defined to take a URL, then the property
*would* expect the title to be given in an [`a`](#the-a-element) element
(or one of the other
<a href="#url-property-elements" id="values:url-property-elements-2">URL
property elements</a>), because of the requirement above.

#### <span class="secno">5.2.5</span> Associating names with items<a href="#associating-names-with-items" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To find <span id="the-properties-of-an-item" class="dfn">the properties
of an item</span> defined by the element `root`, the user agent must run
the following steps. These steps are also used to flag
<a href="#microdata-error"
id="associating-names-with-items:microdata-error">microdata errors</a>.

1.  Let `results`, `memory`, and `pending` be empty lists of elements.

2.  Add the element `root` to `memory`.

3.  Add the child elements of `root`, if any, to `pending`.

4.  If `root` has an [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) attribute,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
    id="associating-names-with-items:split-a-string-on-spaces"
    data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">split the value of that
    <code>itemref</code> attribute on ASCII whitespace</a>. For each
    resulting token `ID`, if there is an element in the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree"
    id="associating-names-with-items:tree" data-x-internal="tree">tree</a>
    of `root` with the <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
    id="associating-names-with-items:concept-id"
    data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> `ID`, then add the first such
    element to `pending`.

5.  While `pending` is not empty:

    1.  Remove an element from `pending` and let `current` be that
        element.

    2.  If `current` is already in `memory`, there is a
        <a href="#microdata-error"
        id="associating-names-with-items:microdata-error-2">microdata error</a>;
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="associating-names-with-items:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    3.  Add `current` to `memory`.

    4.  If `current` does not have an [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope)
        attribute, then: add all the child elements of `current` to
        `pending`.

    5.  If `current` has an [`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute)
        attribute specified and has one or more
        <a href="#property-names"
        id="associating-names-with-items:property-names">property names</a>,
        then add `current` to `results`.

6.  Sort `results` in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="associating-names-with-items:tree-order"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

7.  Return `results`.

</div>

A document must not contain any <a href="#concept-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:concept-item">items</a> for which the
algorithm to find <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:the-properties-of-an-item">the
properties of an item</a> finds any <span id="microdata-error"
class="dfn">microdata errors</span>.

<div algorithm="">

An <a href="#concept-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:concept-item-2">item</a> is a
<span id="top-level-microdata-items" class="dfn">top-level microdata
item</span> if its element does not have an
[`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute.

</div>

All [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) attributes in a [`Document`](#document)
must be such that there are no cycles in the graph formed from
representing each <a href="#concept-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:concept-item-3">item</a> in the
[`Document`](#document) as a node in the graph and each
<a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:the-properties-of-an-item-2">property</a>
of an item whose <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="associating-names-with-items:concept-property-value">value</a> is
another item as an edge in the graph connecting those two items.

A document must not contain any elements that have an
[`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute) attribute that would not be
found to be a property of any of the <a href="#concept-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:concept-item-4">items</a> in that
document were their <a href="#the-properties-of-an-item"
id="associating-names-with-items:the-properties-of-an-item-3">properties</a>
all to be determined.

<div class="example">

In this example, a single license statement is applied to two works,
using [`itemref`](#attr-itemref) from the items representing the works:

``` html
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<html lang="en">
 <head>
  <title>Photo gallery</title>
 </head>
 <body>
  <h1>My photos</h1>
  <figure itemscope itemtype="http://n.whatwg.org/work" itemref="licenses">
   <img itemprop="work" src="images/house.jpeg" alt="A white house, boarded up, sits in a forest.">
   <figcaption itemprop="title">The house I found.</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <figure itemscope itemtype="http://n.whatwg.org/work" itemref="licenses">
   <img itemprop="work" src="images/mailbox.jpeg" alt="Outside the house is a mailbox. It has a leaflet inside.">
   <figcaption itemprop="title">The mailbox.</figcaption>
  </figure>
  <footer>
   <p id="licenses">All images licensed under the <a itemprop="license"
   href="http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php">MIT
   license</a>.</p>
  </footer>
 </body>
</html>
```

The above results in two items with the type
"`http://n.whatwg.org/work`", one with:

work  
`images/house.jpeg`

title  
The house I found.

license  
`http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php`

...and one with:

work  
`images/mailbox.jpeg`

title  
The mailbox.

license  
`http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php`

</div>

#### <span class="secno">5.2.6</span> Microdata and other namespaces<a href="#microdata-and-other-namespaces" class="self-link"></a>

Currently, the [`itemscope`](#attr-itemscope),
[`itemprop`](#names:-the-itemprop-attribute), and other microdata
attributes are only defined for <a href="#html-elements"
id="microdata-and-other-namespaces:html-elements">HTML elements</a>.
This means that attributes with the literal names "`itemscope`",
"`itemprop`", etc, do not cause microdata processing to occur on
elements in other namespaces, such as SVG.

<div class="example">

Thus, in the following example there is only one item, not two.

``` bad
<p itemscope></p> <!-- this is an item (with no properties and no type) -->
<svg itemscope></svg> <!-- this is not, it's just an SVG svg element with an invalid unknown attribute -->
```

</div>

### <span class="secno">5.3</span> Sample microdata vocabularies<a href="#mdvocabs" class="self-link"></a>

The vocabularies in this section are primarily intended to demonstrate
how a vocabulary is specified, though they are also usable in their own
right.

#### <span class="secno">5.3.1</span> vCard<a href="#vcard" class="self-link"></a>

An item with the
<a href="#item-types" id="vcard:item-types">item type</a>
<span id="md-vcard"
class="dfn">`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`</span> represents a
person's or organization's contact information.

This vocabulary does not <a href="#support-global-identifiers-for-items"
id="vcard:support-global-identifiers-for-items">support global
identifiers for items</a>.

The following are the type's <a href="#defined-property-name"
id="vcard:defined-property-name">defined property names</a>. They are
based on the vocabulary defined in vCard Format Specification (vCard)
and its extensions, where more information on how to interpret the
values can be found. [\[RFC6350\]](#refsRFC6350)

<span id="md-vcard-kind" class="dfn">`kind`</span>  
Describes what kind of contact the item represents.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value">value</a> must be text that is
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="vcard:identical-to" data-x-internal="identical-to">identical to</a>
one of the
<a href="#kind-strings" id="vcard:kind-strings">kind strings</a>.

A single property with the name [`kind`](#md-vcard-kind) may be present
within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-fn" class="dfn">`fn`</span>  
Gives the formatted text corresponding to the name of the person or
organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-2">value</a> must be text.

Exactly one property with the name [`fn`](#md-vcard-fn) must be present
within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-2">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n" class="dfn">`n`</span>  
Gives the structured name of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-3">value</a> must be an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-3">item</a> with zero or
more of each of the [`family-name`](#md-vcard-n-family-name),
[`given-name`](#md-vcard-n-given-name),
[`additional-name`](#md-vcard-n-additional-name),
[`honorific-prefix`](#md-vcard-n-honorific-prefix), and
[`honorific-suffix`](#md-vcard-n-honorific-suffix) properties.

Exactly one property with the name [`n`](#md-vcard-n) must be present
within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-4">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n-family-name" class="dfn">`family-name`</span> (inside [`n`](#md-vcard-n))  
Gives the family name of the person, or the full name of the
organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-4">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`family-name`](#md-vcard-n-family-name) may be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-5">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-5">value</a> of the [`n`](#md-vcard-n)
property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-6">item</a> with the type
[`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n-given-name" class="dfn">`given-name`</span> (inside [`n`](#md-vcard-n))  
Gives the given-name of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-6">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`given-name`](#md-vcard-n-given-name) may be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-7">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-7">value</a> of the [`n`](#md-vcard-n)
property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-8">item</a> with the type
[`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n-additional-name" class="dfn">`additional-name`</span> (inside [`n`](#md-vcard-n))  
Gives the any additional names of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-8">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`additional-name`](#md-vcard-n-additional-name) may be present within
the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-9">item</a> that
forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-9">value</a> of the [`n`](#md-vcard-n)
property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-10">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n-honorific-prefix" class="dfn">`honorific-prefix`</span> (inside [`n`](#md-vcard-n))  
Gives the honorific prefix of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-10">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`honorific-prefix`](#md-vcard-n-honorific-prefix) may be present within
the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-11">item</a> that
forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-11">value</a> of the [`n`](#md-vcard-n)
property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-12">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-n-honorific-suffix" class="dfn">`honorific-suffix`</span> (inside [`n`](#md-vcard-n))  
Gives the honorific suffix of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-12">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`honorific-suffix`](#md-vcard-n-honorific-suffix) may be present within
the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-13">item</a> that
forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-13">value</a> of the [`n`](#md-vcard-n)
property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-14">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-nickname" class="dfn">`nickname`</span>  
Gives the nickname of the person or organization.

The nickname is the descriptive name given instead of or in addition to
the one belonging to a person, place, or thing. It can also be used to
specify a familiar form of a proper name specified by the
[`fn`](#md-vcard-fn) or [`n`](#md-vcard-n) properties.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-14">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name [`nickname`](#md-vcard-nickname)
may be present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-15">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-photo" class="dfn">`photo`</span>  
Gives a photograph of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-15">value</a> must be an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="vcard:absolute-url" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute URL</a>.

Any number of properties with the name [`photo`](#md-vcard-photo) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-16">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-bday" class="dfn">`bday`</span>  
Gives the birth date of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-16">value</a> must be a
<a href="#valid-date-string" id="vcard:valid-date-string">valid date
string</a>.

A single property with the name [`bday`](#md-vcard-bday) may be present
within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-17">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-anniversary" class="dfn">`anniversary`</span>  
Gives the birth date of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-17">value</a> must be a
<a href="#valid-date-string" id="vcard:valid-date-string-2">valid date
string</a>.

A single property with the name [`anniversary`](#md-vcard-anniversary)
may be present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-18">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-sex" class="dfn">`sex`</span>  
Gives the biological sex of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-18">value</a> must be one of `F`,
meaning "female", `M`, meaning "male", `N`, meaning "none or not
applicable", `O`, meaning "other", or `U`, meaning "unknown".

A single property with the name [`sex`](#md-vcard-sex) may be present
within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-19">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-gender-identity" class="dfn">`gender-identity`</span>  
Gives the gender identity of the person.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-19">value</a> must be text.

A single property with the name
[`gender-identity`](#md-vcard-gender-identity) may be present within
each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-20">item</a> with
the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-adr" class="dfn">`adr`</span>  
Gives the delivery address of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-20">value</a> must be an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-21">item</a> with zero or
more [`type`](#md-vcard-adr-type),
[`post-office-box`](#md-vcard-adr-post-office-box),
[`extended-address`](#md-vcard-adr-extended-address), and
[`street-address`](#md-vcard-adr-street-address) properties, and
optionally a [`locality`](#md-vcard-adr-locality) property, optionally a
[`region`](#md-vcard-adr-region) property, optionally a
[`postal-code`](#md-vcard-adr-postal-code) property, and optionally a
[`country-name`](#md-vcard-adr-country-name) property.

If no [`type`](#md-vcard-adr-type) properties are present within an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-22">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-21">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-23">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard), then the
<a href="#address-type-strings" id="vcard:address-type-strings">address
type string</a> [`work`](#md-vcard-type-adr-work) is implied.

Any number of properties with the name [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-24">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-adr-type" class="dfn">`type`</span> (inside [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr))  
Gives the type of delivery address.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-22">value</a> must be text that is
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="vcard:identical-to-2" data-x-internal="identical-to">identical
to</a> one of the <a href="#address-type-strings"
id="vcard:address-type-strings-2">address type strings</a>.

Any number of properties with the name [`type`](#md-vcard-adr-type) may
be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-25">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-23">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-26">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard), but within
each such [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-27">item</a> there must
only be one [`type`](#md-vcard-adr-type) property per distinct value.

<span id="md-vcard-adr-post-office-box" class="dfn">`post-office-box`</span> (inside [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr))  
Gives the post office box component of the delivery address of the
person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-24">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`post-office-box`](#md-vcard-adr-post-office-box) may be present within
the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-28">item</a> that
forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-25">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-29">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

vCard urges authors not to use this field.

<span id="md-vcard-adr-extended-address" class="dfn">`extended-address`</span> (inside [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr))  
Gives an additional component of the delivery address of the person or
organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-26">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`extended-address`](#md-vcard-adr-extended-address) may be present
within the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-30">item</a>
that forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-27">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-31">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

vCard urges authors not to use this field.

<span id="md-vcard-adr-street-address" class="dfn">`street-address`</span> (inside [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr))  
Gives the street address component of the delivery address of the person
or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-28">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`street-address`](#md-vcard-adr-street-address) may be present within
the <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-32">item</a> that
forms the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-29">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-33">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-adr-locality" class="dfn">`locality`</span> (inside [`adr`](#md-vcard-adr))  
Gives the locality component (e.g. city) of the delivery address of the
person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-30">value</a> must be text.

A single property with the name [`locality`](#md-vcard-adr-locality) may
be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-34">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-31">value</a> of an
[`adr`](#md-vcard-adr) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-35">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

id="vcard:concept-property-value-33">value</a> of an

<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-37">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

id="vcard:concept-property-value-34">value</a> must be text.

A single property with the name
[`postal-code`](#md-vcard-adr-postal-code) may be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-38">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-35">value</a> of an

<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-39">item</a> with the

id="vcard:concept-property-value-37">value</a> of an

<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-41">item</a> with the

<span id="md-vcard-tel" class="dfn">`tel`</span>  
Gives the telephone number of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-38">value</a> must be either text that
can be interpreted as a telephone number as defined in the CCITT
specifications E.163 and X.121, or an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-42">item</a> with zero or
more [`type`](#md-vcard-tel-type) properties and exactly one
[`value`](#md-vcard-tel-value) property. [\[E163\]](#refsE163)
[\[X121\]](#refsX121)

If no [`type`](#md-vcard-tel-type) properties are present within an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-43">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-39">value</a> of a
[`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-44">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard), or if the
<a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-40">value</a> of such a
[`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) property is text, then the
<a href="#telephone-type-strings"
id="vcard:telephone-type-strings">telephone type string</a>
[`voice`](#md-vcard-type-tel-voice) is implied.

Any number of properties with the name [`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-45">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-tel-type" class="dfn">`type`</span> (inside [`tel`](#md-vcard-tel))  
Gives the type of telephone number.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-41">value</a> must be text that is
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
id="vcard:identical-to-3" data-x-internal="identical-to">identical
to</a> one of the <a href="#telephone-type-strings"
id="vcard:telephone-type-strings-2">telephone type strings</a>.

Any number of properties with the name [`type`](#md-vcard-tel-type) may
be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-46">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-42">value</a> of a
[`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-47">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard), but within
each such [`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) property
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-48">item</a> there must
only be one [`type`](#md-vcard-tel-type) property per distinct value.

<span id="md-vcard-tel-value" class="dfn">`value`</span> (inside [`tel`](#md-vcard-tel))  
Gives the actual telephone number of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-43">value</a> must be text that can be
interpreted as a telephone number as defined in the CCITT specifications
E.163 and X.121. [\[E163\]](#refsE163) [\[X121\]](#refsX121)

Exactly one property with the name [`value`](#md-vcard-tel-value) must
be present within the
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-49">item</a> that forms
the <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-44">value</a> of a
[`tel`](#md-vcard-tel) property of an
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-50">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-email" class="dfn">`email`</span>  
Gives the email address of the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-45">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name [`email`](#md-vcard-email) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-51">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

Gives a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url" id="vcard:url"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> for instant messaging and presence
protocol communications with the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-46">value</a> must be an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="vcard:absolute-url-2" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute
URL</a>.

Any number of properties with the name [`impp`](#md-vcard-impp) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-52">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-lang" class="dfn">`lang`</span>  
Gives a language understood by the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-47">value</a> must be a valid BCP 47
language tag. [\[BCP47\]](#refsBCP47)

Any number of properties with the name [`lang`](#md-vcard-lang) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-53">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-tz" class="dfn">`tz`</span>  
Gives the time zone of the person or organization.

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-48">value</a> must be text and must
match the following syntax:

1.  Either a U+002B PLUS SIGN character (+) or a U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
    character (-).
2.  A <a href="#valid-non-negative-integer"
    id="vcard:valid-non-negative-integer">valid non-negative integer</a>
    that is exactly two digits long and that represents a number in the
    range 00..23.
3.  A U+003A COLON character (:).
4.  A <a href="#valid-non-negative-integer"
    id="vcard:valid-non-negative-integer-2">valid non-negative integer</a>
    that is exactly two digits long and that represents a number in the
    range 00..59.

</div>

Any number of properties with the name [`tz`](#md-vcard-tz) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-54">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-geo" class="dfn">`geo`</span>  
Gives the geographical position of the person or organization.

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-49">value</a> must be text and must
match the following syntax:

1.  Optionally, either a U+002B PLUS SIGN character (+) or a U+002D
    HYPHEN-MINUS character (-).
2.  One or more <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit"
    id="vcard:ascii-digits" data-x-internal="ascii-digits">ASCII digits</a>.
3.  Optionally\*, a U+002E FULL STOP character (.) followed by one or
    more <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit"
    id="vcard:ascii-digits-2" data-x-internal="ascii-digits">ASCII
    digits</a>.
4.  A U+003B SEMICOLON character (;).
5.  Optionally, either a U+002B PLUS SIGN character (+) or a U+002D
    HYPHEN-MINUS character (-).
6.  One or more <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit"
    id="vcard:ascii-digits-3" data-x-internal="ascii-digits">ASCII
    digits</a>.
7.  Optionally\*, a U+002E FULL STOP character (.) followed by one or
    more <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-digit"
    id="vcard:ascii-digits-4" data-x-internal="ascii-digits">ASCII
    digits</a>.

</div>

The optional components marked with an asterisk (\*) should be included,
and should have six digits each.

The value specifies latitude and longitude, in that order (i.e., "LAT
LON" ordering), in decimal degrees. The longitude represents the
location east and west of the prime meridian as a positive or negative
real number, respectively. The latitude represents the location north
and south of the equator as a positive or negative real number,
respectively.

Any number of properties with the name [`geo`](#md-vcard-geo) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-55">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

Gives the job title, functional position or function of the person or
organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-50">value</a> must be text.

present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-56">item</a> with the

Gives the name of a category or tag that the person or organization

id="vcard:concept-property-value-65">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name
[`categories`](#md-vcard-categories) may be present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-75">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<span id="md-vcard-note" class="dfn">`note`</span>  
Gives supplemental information or a comment about the person or

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-66">value</a> must be text.

Any number of properties with the name [`note`](#md-vcard-note) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-76">item</a> with the

Gives the revision date and time of the contact information.

id="vcard:concept-property-value-67">value</a> must be text that is a

id="vcard:valid-global-date-and-time-string">valid global date and time
string</a>.

The value distinguishes the current revision of the information for
other renditions of the information.

Any number of properties with the name [`rev`](#md-vcard-rev) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-77">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

Gives a sound file relating to the person or organization.

id="vcard:concept-property-value-68">value</a> must be an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="vcard:absolute-url-7" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute
URL</a>.

Any number of properties with the name [`sound`](#md-vcard-sound) may be
present within each
<a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-78">item</a> with the
type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

within each <a href="#concept-item" id="vcard:concept-item-79">item</a>
with the type [`http://microformats.org/profile/hcard`](#md-vcard).

<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url" id="vcard:url-4"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> relating to the person or organization.

The <a href="#concept-property-value"
id="vcard:concept-property-value-70">value</a> must be an
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute"
id="vcard:absolute-url-8" data-x-internal="absolute-url">absolute
URL</a>.
