<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-showpopover" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLElement"
dfn-type="method">`showPopover(``options``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `source` be
    `options`\["[`source`](#dom-showpopoveroptions-source)"\] if it
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-popover-attribute:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>; otherwise, null.

2.  Run
    <a href="#show-popover" id="the-popover-attribute:show-popover">show
    popover</a> given <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
    true, and `source`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="show-popover" class="dfn">show popover</span>, given an
<a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-11">HTML element</a> `element`,
a boolean `throwExceptions`, and an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-12">HTML element</a> or null
`source`:

1.  If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
    id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity">check popover
    validity</a> given `element`, false, `throwExceptions`, and null is
    false, then return.

2.  Let `document` be `element`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-popover-attribute:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `element`'s <a href="#popover-trigger"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-trigger">popover trigger</a> is
    null.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-popover-attribute:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `element` is not in `document`'s
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#document-top-layer"
    id="the-popover-attribute:top-layer" data-x-internal="top-layer">top
    layer</a>.

5.  Let `nestedShow` be `element`'s <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding">popover showing or
    hiding</a>.

6.  Let `fireEvents` be the boolean negation of `nestedShow`.

7.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding-2">popover showing
    or hiding</a> to true.

8.  Let `cleanupShowingFlag` be the following steps:

    1.  If `nestedShow` is false, then set `element`'s
        <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding-3">popover showing
        or hiding</a> to false.

9.  If the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="the-popover-attribute:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">firing an event</a> named
    [`beforetoggle`](#event-beforetoggle), using
    [`ToggleEvent`](#toggleevent), with the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
    id="the-popover-attribute:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
    attribute initialized to true, the
    [`oldState`](#dom-toggleevent-oldstate) attribute initialized to
    "`closed`", the [`newState`](#dom-toggleevent-newstate) attribute
    initialized to "`open`", and the [`source`](#dom-toggleevent-source)
    attribute initialized to `source` at `element` is false, then run
    `cleanupShowingFlag` and return.

10. If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
    id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-2">check popover
    validity</a> given `element`, false, `throwExceptions`, and
    `document` is false, then run `cleanupShowingFlag` and return.

    <a href="#check-popover-validity"
    id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-3">Check popover
    validity</a> is called again because firing the
    [`beforetoggle`](#event-beforetoggle) event could have disconnected
    this element or changed its [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute.

11. Let `shouldRestoreFocus` be false.

12. Let `originalType` be the current state of `element`'s
    [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute.

13. Let `stackToAppendTo` be null.

14. Let `autoAncestor` be the result of running the
    <a href="#topmost-popover-ancestor"
    id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-popover-ancestor-2">topmost popover
    ancestor</a> algorithm given `element`, `document`'s
    <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list">showing auto popover
    list</a>, `source`, and true.

15. Let `hintAncestor` be the result of running the
    <a href="#topmost-popover-ancestor"
    id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-popover-ancestor-3">topmost popover
    ancestor</a> algorithm given `element`, `document`'s
    <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list">showing hint
    popover list</a>, `source`, and true.

16. If `originalType` is the <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-4">Auto</a> state,
    then:

    1.  Run <a href="#close-entire-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:close-entire-popover-list">close entire
        popover list</a> given `document`'s
        <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-2">showing hint
        popover list</a>, `shouldRestoreFocus`, and `fireEvents`.

    2.  Let `ancestor` be the result of running the
        <a href="#topmost-popover-ancestor"
        id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-popover-ancestor-4">topmost popover
        ancestor</a> algorithm given `element`, `document`'s
        <a href="#auto-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-2">showing auto popover
        list</a>, `source`, and true.

    3.  If `ancestor` is null, then set `ancestor` to `document`.

    4.  Run <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until">hide all popovers
        until</a> given `ancestor`, `shouldRestoreFocus`, and
        `fireEvents`.

    5.  Set `stackToAppendTo` to "`auto`".

17. If `originalType` is the <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state">Hint</a> state,
    then:

    1.  If `hintAncestor` is not null, then:

        1.  Run <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
            id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-2">hide all popovers
            until</a> given `hintAncestor`, `shouldRestoreFocus`, and
            `fireEvents`.

        2.  Set `stackToAppendTo` to "`hint`".

    2.  Otherwise:

        1.  Run <a href="#close-entire-popover-list"
            id="the-popover-attribute:close-entire-popover-list-2">close entire
            popover list</a> given `document`'s
            <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
            id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-3">showing hint
            popover list</a>, `shouldRestoreFocus`, and `fireEvents`.

        2.  If `autoAncestor` is not null, then:

            1.  Run <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
                id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-3">hide all popovers
                until</a> given `autoAncestor`, `shouldRestoreFocus`,
                and `fireEvents`.

            2.  Set `stackToAppendTo` to "`auto`".

        3.  Otherwise, set `stackToAppendTo` to "`hint`".

18. If `originalType` is <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-5">Auto</a> or
    <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state-2">Hint</a>, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-3" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `stackToAppendTo` is not null.

    2.  If `originalType` is not equal to the value of `element`'s
        [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute, then:

        1.  If `throwExceptions` is true, then throw an
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
            id="the-popover-attribute:invalidstateerror"
            data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="the-popover-attribute:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Return.

    3.  If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-4">check popover
        validity</a> given `element`, false, `throwExceptions`, and
        `document` is false, then run `cleanupShowingFlag` and return.

        <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-5">Check popover
        validity</a> is called again because running
        <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-4">hide all popovers
        until</a> above could have fired the
        [`beforetoggle`](#event-beforetoggle) event, and an event
        handler could have disconnected this element or changed its
        [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute.

    4.  If the result of running <a href="#topmost-auto-popover"
        id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-auto-popover">topmost auto or hint
        popover</a> on `document` is null, then set `shouldRestoreFocus`
        to true.

        This ensures that focus is returned to the previously-focused
        element only for the first popover in a stack.

    5.  If `stackToAppendTo` is "`auto`":

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-popover-attribute:assert-4" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `document`'s <a href="#auto-popover-list"
            id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-3">showing auto popover
            list</a> does not contain `element`.

        2.  Set `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
            id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode">opened in popover
            mode</a> to "`auto`".

        Otherwise:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-popover-attribute:assert-5" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `stackToAppendTo` is "`hint`".

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-popover-attribute:assert-6" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `document`'s <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
            id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-4">showing hint
            popover list</a> does not contain `element`.

        3.  Set `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
            id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode-2">opened in popover
            mode</a> to "`hint`".

    6.  <div id="canceling-popovers">

        Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-close-watcher"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-close-watcher">popover close
        watcher</a> to the result of
        <a href="#establish-a-close-watcher"
        id="the-popover-attribute:establish-a-close-watcher">establishing a
        close watcher</a> given `element`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="the-popover-attribute:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
        object</a>, with:

        - *[cancelAction](#create-close-watcher-cancelaction)* being to
          return true.

        - *[closeAction](#create-close-watcher-closeaction)* being to
          <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
          id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-algorithm-2">hide a popover</a>
          given `element`, true, true, false, and null.

        - *[getEnabledState](#create-close-watcher-getenabledstate)*
          being to return true.

        </div>

19. Set `element`'s <a href="#previously-focused-element"
    id="the-popover-attribute:previously-focused-element">previously focused
    element</a> to null.

20. Let `originallyFocusedElement` be `document`'s
    <a href="#focused-area-of-the-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:focused-area-of-the-document">focused area of
    the document</a>'s
    <a href="#dom-anchor" id="the-popover-attribute:dom-anchor">DOM
    anchor</a>.

21. <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#add-an-element-to-the-top-layer"
    id="the-popover-attribute:add-an-element-to-the-top-layer"
    data-x-internal="add-an-element-to-the-top-layer">Add an element to the
    top layer</a> given `element`.

22. Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-2">popover visibility
    state</a> to <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-2">showing</a>.

23. Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-trigger"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-trigger-2">popover trigger</a> to
    `source`.

24. Set `element`'s <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position/#implicit-anchor-element"
    id="the-popover-attribute:implicit-anchor-element"
    data-x-internal="implicit-anchor-element">implicit anchor element</a>
    to `source`.

25. Run the <a href="#popover-focusing-steps"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-focusing-steps">popover focusing
    steps</a> given `element`.

26. If `shouldRestoreFocus` is true and `element`'s
    [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is not in the
    <a href="#attr-popover-none-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-none-state">No Popover</a>
    state, then set `element`'s <a href="#previously-focused-element"
    id="the-popover-attribute:previously-focused-element-2">previously
    focused element</a> to `originallyFocusedElement`.

27. <a href="#queue-a-popover-toggle-event-task"
    id="the-popover-attribute:queue-a-popover-toggle-event-task">Queue a
    popover toggle event task</a> given `element`, "`closed`", "`open`",
    and `source`.

28. Run `cleanupShowingFlag`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="queue-a-popover-toggle-event-task" class="dfn">queue a
popover toggle event task</span> given an element `element`, a string
`oldState`, a string `newState`, and an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="the-popover-attribute:element">Element</code></a> or null `source`:

1.  If `element`'s <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker">popover toggle
    task tracker</a> is not null, then:

    1.  Set `oldState` to `element`'s
        <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker-2">popover toggle
        task tracker</a>'s <a href="#toggle-task-old-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:toggle-task-old-state">old state</a>.

    2.  Remove `element`'s <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker-3">popover toggle
        task tracker</a>'s <a href="#toggle-task-task"
        id="the-popover-attribute:toggle-task-task">task</a> from its
        <a href="#task-queue" id="the-popover-attribute:task-queue">task
        queue</a>.

    3.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker-4">popover toggle
        task tracker</a> to null.

2.  <a href="#queue-an-element-task"
    id="the-popover-attribute:queue-an-element-task">Queue an element
    task</a> given the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
    id="the-popover-attribute:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM manipulation
    task source</a> and `element` to run the following steps:

    1.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="the-popover-attribute:concept-event-fire-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
        [`toggle`](#event-toggle) at `element`, using
        [`ToggleEvent`](#toggleevent), with the
        [`oldState`](#dom-toggleevent-oldstate) attribute initialized to
        `oldState`, the [`newState`](#dom-toggleevent-newstate)
        attribute initialized to `newState`, and the
        [`source`](#dom-toggleevent-source) attribute initialized to
        `source`.

    2.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker-5">popover toggle
        task tracker</a> to null.

3.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-toggle-task-tracker"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-toggle-task-tracker-6">popover toggle
    task tracker</a> to a struct with <a href="#toggle-task-task"
    id="the-popover-attribute:toggle-task-task-2">task</a> set to the
    just-queued
    <a href="#concept-task" id="the-popover-attribute:concept-task">task</a>
    and <a href="#toggle-task-old-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:toggle-task-old-state-2">old state</a> set
    to `oldState`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-hidepopover" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLElement"
dfn-type="method">`hidePopover()`</span> method steps are:

1.  Run the <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
    id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-algorithm-3">hide popover
    algorithm</a> given <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
    true, true, true, and null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="hide-popover-algorithm" class="dfn">hide a popover</span>
given an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-13">HTML element</a> `element`,
a boolean `focusPreviousElement`, a boolean `fireEvents`, a boolean
`throwExceptions`, and an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-14">HTML element</a> or null
`source`:

1.  If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
    id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-6">check popover
    validity</a> given `element`, true, `throwExceptions`, and null is
    false, then return.

2.  Let `document` be `element`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

3.  Let `nestedHide` be `element`'s <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding-4">popover showing
    or hiding</a>.

4.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding-5">popover showing
    or hiding</a> to true.

5.  If `nestedHide` is true, then set `fireEvents` to false.

6.  Let `cleanupSteps` be the following steps:

    1.  If `nestedHide` is false, then set `element`'s
        <a href="#popover-showing-or-hiding"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-or-hiding-6">popover showing
        or hiding</a> to false.

    2.  If `element`'s <a href="#popover-close-watcher"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-close-watcher-2">popover close
        watcher</a> is not null, then:

        1.  <a href="#close-watcher-destroy"
            id="the-popover-attribute:close-watcher-destroy">Destroy</a>
            `element`'s <a href="#popover-close-watcher"
            id="the-popover-attribute:popover-close-watcher-3">popover close
            watcher</a>.

        2.  Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-close-watcher"
            id="the-popover-attribute:popover-close-watcher-4">popover close
            watcher</a> to null.

7.  If `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
    id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode-3">opened in popover
    mode</a> is "`auto`" or "`hint`", then:

    1.  Run <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-5">hide all popovers
        until</a> given `element`, `focusPreviousElement`, and
        `fireEvents`.

    2.  If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-7">check popover
        validity</a> given `element`, true, `throwExceptions`, and null
        is false, then run `cleanupSteps` and return.

        <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-8">Check popover
        validity</a> is called again because running
        <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-6">hide all popovers
        until</a> could have disconnected `element` or changed its
        [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute.

8.  Let `autoPopoverListContainsElement` be true if `document`'s
    <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-4">showing auto popover
    list</a>'s last item is `element`, otherwise false.

9.  If `fireEvents` is true:

    1.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="the-popover-attribute:concept-event-fire-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
        [`beforetoggle`](#event-beforetoggle), using
        [`ToggleEvent`](#toggleevent), with the
        [`oldState`](#dom-toggleevent-oldstate) attribute initialized to
        "`open`", the [`newState`](#dom-toggleevent-newstate) attribute
        initialized to "`closed`", and the
        [`source`](#dom-toggleevent-source) attribute set to `source` at
        `element`.

    2.  If `autoPopoverListContainsElement` is true and `document`'s
        <a href="#auto-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-5">showing auto popover
        list</a>'s last item is not `element`, then run
        <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-7">hide all popovers
        until</a> given `element`, `focusPreviousElement`, and false.

    3.  If the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-9">check popover
        validity</a> given `element`, true, `throwExceptions`, and null
        is false, then run `cleanupSteps` and return.

        <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-10">Check popover
        validity</a> is called again because firing the
        [`beforetoggle`](#event-beforetoggle) event could have
        disconnected `element` or changed its [`popover`](#attr-popover)
        attribute.

    4.  <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#request-an-element-to-be-removed-from-the-top-layer"
        id="the-popover-attribute:request-an-element-to-be-removed-from-the-top-layer"
        data-x-internal="request-an-element-to-be-removed-from-the-top-layer">Request
        an element to be removed from the top layer</a> given `element`.

    5.  Set `element`'s <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-anchor-position/#implicit-anchor-element"
        id="the-popover-attribute:implicit-anchor-element-2"
        data-x-internal="implicit-anchor-element">implicit anchor element</a>
        to null.

10. Otherwise, <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#remove-an-element-from-the-top-layer-immediately"
    id="the-popover-attribute:remove-an-element-from-the-top-layer-immediately"
    data-x-internal="remove-an-element-from-the-top-layer-immediately">remove
    an element from the top layer immediately</a> given `element`.

11. Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-trigger"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-trigger-3">popover trigger</a> to
    null.

12. Set `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
    id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode-4">opened in popover
    mode</a> to null.

13. Set `element`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-3">popover visibility
    state</a> to <a href="#popover-hidden-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-hidden-state-2">hidden</a>.

14. If `fireEvents` is true, then
    <a href="#queue-a-popover-toggle-event-task"
    id="the-popover-attribute:queue-a-popover-toggle-event-task-2">queue a
    popover toggle event task</a> given `element`, "`open`", "`closed`",
    and `source`.

15. Let `previouslyFocusedElement` be `element`'s
    <a href="#previously-focused-element"
    id="the-popover-attribute:previously-focused-element-3">previously
    focused element</a>.

16. If `previouslyFocusedElement` is not null, then:

    1.  Set `element`'s <a href="#previously-focused-element"
        id="the-popover-attribute:previously-focused-element-4">previously
        focused element</a> to null.

    2.  If `focusPreviousElement` is true and `document`'s
        <a href="#focused-area-of-the-document"
        id="the-popover-attribute:focused-area-of-the-document-2">focused area
        of the document</a>'s
        <a href="#dom-anchor" id="the-popover-attribute:dom-anchor-2">DOM
        anchor</a> is a <a
        href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
        id="the-popover-attribute:shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
        data-x-internal="shadow-including-inclusive-descendant">shadow-including
        inclusive descendant</a> of `element`, then run the
        <a href="#focusing-steps"
        id="the-popover-attribute:focusing-steps">focusing steps</a> for
        `previouslyFocusedElement`; the viewport should not be scrolled
        by doing this step.

17. Run `cleanupSteps`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-togglepopover" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLElement"
dfn-type="method">`togglePopover(``options``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `force` be null.

2.  If `options` is a boolean, set `force` to `options`.

3.  Otherwise, if
    `options`\["[`force`](#dom-togglepopoveroptions-force)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-popover-attribute:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, set `force` to
    `options`\["[`force`](#dom-togglepopoveroptions-force)"\].

4.  Let `source` be
    `options`\["[`source`](#dom-showpopoveroptions-source)"\] if it
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-popover-attribute:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>; otherwise, null.

5.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-4">popover visibility
    state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-3">showing</a>, and
    `force` is null or false, then run the
    <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
    id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-algorithm-4">hide popover
    algorithm</a> given <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
    true, true, true, and null.

6.  Otherwise, if `force` is null or true, then run
    <a href="#show-popover" id="the-popover-attribute:show-popover-2">show
    popover</a> given <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
    true, and `source`.

7.  Otherwise:

    1.  Let `expectedToBeShowing` be true if
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-popover-attribute:this-6" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-5">popover visibility
        state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-4">showing</a>;
        otherwise false.

    2.  Run <a href="#check-popover-validity"
        id="the-popover-attribute:check-popover-validity-11">check popover
        validity</a> given `expectedToBeShowing`, true, and null.

8.  Return true if <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-popover-attribute:this-7" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-6">popover visibility
    state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-5">showing</a>;
    otherwise false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="hide-all-popovers-until" class="dfn" export="">hide all
popovers until</span>, given an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-15">HTML element</a> or
[`Document`](#document) `endpoint`, a boolean `focusPreviousElement`,
and a boolean `fireEvents`:

1.  If `endpoint` is an <a href="#html-elements"
    id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-16">HTML element</a> and
    `endpoint` is not in the <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-6">popover showing
    state</a>, then return.

2.  Let `document` be `endpoint`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-3"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-popover-attribute:assert-7" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `endpoint` is a [`Document`](#document) or `endpoint`'s
    <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-7">popover visibility
    state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-7">showing</a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-popover-attribute:assert-8" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `endpoint` is a [`Document`](#document) or `endpoint`'s
    [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
    <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-6">Auto</a> state
    or `endpoint`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
    <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state-3">Hint</a> state.

5.  If `endpoint` is a [`Document`](#document):

    1.  Run <a href="#close-entire-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:close-entire-popover-list-3">close entire
        popover list</a> given `document`'s
        <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-5">showing hint
        popover list</a>, `focusPreviousElement`, and `fireEvents`.

    2.  Run <a href="#close-entire-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:close-entire-popover-list-4">close entire
        popover list</a> given `document`'s <a href="#auto-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-6">showing auto popover
        list</a>, `focusPreviousElement`, and `fireEvents`.

    3.  Return.

6.  If `document`'s <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-6">showing hint
    popover list</a> contains `endpoint`:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-9" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `endpoint`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
        <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state-4">Hint</a>
        state.

    2.  Run <a href="#hide-popover-stack-until"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-stack-until">hide popover stack
        until</a> given `endpoint`, `document`'s
        <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
        id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-7">showing hint
        popover list</a>, `focusPreviousElement`, and `fireEvents`.

    3.  Return.

7.  Run <a href="#close-entire-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:close-entire-popover-list-5">close entire
    popover list</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-8">showing hint
    popover list</a>, `focusPreviousElement`, and `fireEvents`.

8.  If `document`'s <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-7">showing auto popover
    list</a> does not contain `endpoint`, then return.

9.  Run <a href="#hide-popover-stack-until"
    id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-stack-until-2">hide popover stack
    until</a> given `endpoint`, `document`'s
    <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-8">showing auto popover
    list</a>, `focusPreviousElement`, and `fireEvents`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="hide-popover-stack-until" class="dfn">hide popover stack
until</span>, given an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-17">HTML element</a> `endpoint`,
a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="the-popover-attribute:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
`popoverList`, a boolean `focusPreviousElement`, and a boolean
`fireEvents`:

1.  Let `repeatingHide` be false.

2.  Perform the following steps at least once:

    1.  Let `lastToHide` be null.

    2.  For each `popover` in `popoverList`:

        1.  If `popover` is `endpoint`, then
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
            id="the-popover-attribute:break" data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

        2.  Set `lastToHide` to `popover`.

    3.  If `lastToHide` is null, then return.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
        id="the-popover-attribute:while" data-x-internal="while">While</a>
        `lastToHide`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-8">popover visibility
        state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-8">showing</a>:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-popover-attribute:assert-10" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `popoverList` is not empty.

        2.  Run the <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
            id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-algorithm-5">hide popover
            algorithm</a> given the last item in `popoverList`,
            `focusPreviousElement`, `fireEvents`, false, and null.

    5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-11" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `repeatingHide` is false or `popoverList`'s last item is
        `endpoint`.

    6.  Set `repeatingHide` to true if `popoverList` contains `endpoint`
        and `popoverList`'s last item is not `endpoint`, otherwise
        false.

    7.  If `repeatingHide` is true, then set `fireEvents` to false.

    and keep performing them
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
    id="the-popover-attribute:while-2" data-x-internal="while">while</a>
    `repeatingHide` is true.

</div>

The <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
id="the-popover-attribute:hide-all-popovers-until-8">hide all popovers
until algorithm</a> is used in several cases to hide all popovers that
don't stay open when something happens. For example, during
light-dismiss of a popover, this algorithm ensures that we close only
the popovers that aren't related to the node clicked by the user.

<div algorithm="">

To find the <span id="topmost-popover-ancestor" class="dfn"
export="">topmost popover ancestor</span>, given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="the-popover-attribute:node">Node</code></a>
`newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="the-popover-attribute:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
`popoverList`, an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-18">HTML element</a> or null
`source`, and a boolean `isPopover`, perform the following steps. They
return an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-19">HTML element</a> or null.

<div class="note">

The <a href="#topmost-popover-ancestor"
id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-popover-ancestor-5">topmost popover
ancestor</a> algorithm will return the topmost (latest in the
<a href="#auto-popover-list"
id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-9">showing auto popover
list</a>) ancestor popover for the provided popover or top layer
element. Popovers can be related to each other in several ways, creating
a tree of popovers. There are two paths through which one popover (call
it the "child" popover) can have a topmost ancestor popover (call it the
"parent" popover):

1.  The popovers are nested within each other in the node tree. In this
    case, the descendant popover is the "child" and its topmost ancestor
    popover is the "parent".

2.  A popover trigger element (e.g., a [`button`](#the-button-element))
    has a [`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget) attribute pointing to a
    popover. In this case, the popover is the "child", and the popover
    subtree the trigger element is in is the "parent". The trigger
    element has to be in a popover and reference an open popover.

In each of the relationships formed above, the parent popover has to be
strictly earlier in the <a href="#auto-popover-list"
id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-10">showing auto popover
list</a> than the child popover, or it does not form a valid ancestral
relationship. This eliminates non-showing popovers and self-pointers
(e.g., a popover containing an invoking element that points back to the
containing popover), and it allows for the construction of a well-formed
tree from the (possibly cyclic) graph of connections. Only
<a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-7">Auto</a> popovers
are considered.

If the provided element is a top layer element such as a
[`dialog`](#the-dialog-element) which is not showing as a popover, then
<a href="#topmost-popover-ancestor"
id="the-popover-attribute:topmost-popover-ancestor-6">topmost popover
ancestor</a> will only look in the node tree to find the first popover.

</div>

1.  If `isPopover` is true:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-12" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `newPopoverOrTopLayerElement` is an <a href="#html-elements"
        id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-20">HTML element</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-13" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover)
        attribute is not in the <a href="#attr-popover-none-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-none-state-2">No Popover
        State</a> or the <a href="#attr-popover-manual-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-manual-state-2">Manual</a>
        state.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-14" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`'s
        <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-9">popover visibility
        state</a> is not in the <a href="#popover-showing-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-9">popover showing
        state</a>.

2.  Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="the-popover-attribute:assert-15" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `source` is null.

3.  Let `popoverPositions` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="the-popover-attribute:ordered-map"
    data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered map</a>.

4.  Let `index` be 0.

5.  For each `popover` of `popoverList`:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
        id="the-popover-attribute:map-set" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
        `popoverPositions`\[`popover`\] to `index`.

    2.  Increment `index` by 1.

6.  If `isPopover` is true, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
    id="the-popover-attribute:map-set-2" data-x-internal="map-set">set</a>
    `popoverPositions`\[`newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`\] to `index`.

7.  Increment `index` by 1.

8.  Let `topmostPopoverAncestor` be null.

9.  Let `checkAncestor` be an algorithm which performs the following
    steps given `candidate`:

    1.  If `candidate` is null, then return.

    2.  Let `okNesting` be false.

    3.  Let `candidateAncestor` be null.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
        id="the-popover-attribute:while-3" data-x-internal="while">While</a>
        `okNesting` is false:

        1.  Set `candidateAncestor` to the result of running
            <a href="#nearest-inclusive-open-popover"
            id="the-popover-attribute:nearest-inclusive-open-popover">nearest
            inclusive open popover</a> given `candidate`.

        2.  If `candidateAncestor` is null or `popoverPositions` does
            not contain `candidateAncestor`, then return.

        3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-popover-attribute:assert-16" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `candidateAncestor`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute
            is not in the <a href="#attr-popover-manual-state"
            id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-manual-state-3">Manual</a>
            or <a href="#attr-popover-none-state"
            id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-none-state-3">None</a>
            state.

        4.  Set `okNesting` to true if `isPopover` is false,
            `newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover)
            attribute is in the <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
            id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state-5">Hint</a>
            state, or `candidateAncestor`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover)
            attribute is in the <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
            id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-8">Auto</a>
            state.

        5.  If `okNesting` is false, then set `candidate` to
            `candidateAncestor`'s parent in the
            <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping/#flat-tree"
            id="the-popover-attribute:flat-tree" data-x-internal="flat-tree">flat
            tree</a>.

    5.  Let `candidatePosition` be
        `popoverPositions`\[`candidateAncestor`\].

    6.  If `topmostPopoverAncestor` is null or
        `popoverPositions`\[`topmostPopoverAncestor`\] is less than
        `candidatePosition`, then set `topmostPopoverAncestor` to
        `candidateAncestor`.

10. Run `checkAncestor` given `newPopoverOrTopLayerElement`'s parent
    node within the
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping/#flat-tree"
    id="the-popover-attribute:flat-tree-2" data-x-internal="flat-tree">flat
    tree</a>.

11. Run `checkAncestor` given `source`.

12. Return `topmostPopoverAncestor`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To find the <span id="nearest-inclusive-open-popover"
class="dfn">nearest inclusive open popover</span> given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="the-popover-attribute:node-2">Node</code></a> `node`, perform the
following steps. They return an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-21">HTML element</a> or null.

1.  Let `currentNode` be `node`.

2.  While `currentNode` is not null:

    1.  If `currentNode`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in
        the <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-auto-state-9">Auto</a>
        state or the <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-hint-state-6">Hint</a>
        state, and `currentNode`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-10">popover
        visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
        id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-10">showing</a>,
        then return `currentNode`.

    2.  Set `currentNode` to `currentNode`'s parent in the
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping/#flat-tree"
        id="the-popover-attribute:flat-tree-3" data-x-internal="flat-tree">flat
        tree</a>.

3.  Return null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="topmost-auto-popover" class="dfn">find the topmost auto or
hint popover</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `document`, perform
the following steps. They return an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-22">HTML element</a> or null.

1.  If `document`'s <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-9">showing hint
    popover list</a> is not empty, then return `document`'s
    <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:showing-hint-popover-list-10">showing hint
    popover list</a>'s last element.

2.  If `document`'s <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-11">showing auto popover
    list</a> is not empty, then return `document`'s
    <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="the-popover-attribute:auto-popover-list-12">showing auto popover
    list</a>'s last element.

3.  Return null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To perform the <span id="popover-focusing-steps" class="dfn">popover
focusing steps</span> for an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-23">HTML element</a> `subject`:

1.  If the <a href="#allow-focus-steps"
    id="the-popover-attribute:allow-focus-steps">allow focus steps</a>
    given `subject`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-4"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> return false, then
    return.

2.  If `subject` is a [`dialog`](#the-dialog-element) element, then run
    the <a href="#dialog-focusing-steps"
    id="the-popover-attribute:dialog-focusing-steps">dialog focusing
    steps</a> given `subject` and return.

3.  If `subject` has the [`autofocus`](#attr-fe-autofocus) attribute,
    then let `control` be `subject`.

4.  Otherwise, let `control` be the <a href="#autofocus-delegate"
    id="the-popover-attribute:autofocus-delegate">autofocus delegate</a>
    for `subject` given "`other`".

5.  If `control` is null, then return.

6.  Run the <a href="#focusing-steps"
    id="the-popover-attribute:focusing-steps-2">focusing steps</a> given
    `control`.

7.  Let `topDocument` be `control`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="the-popover-attribute:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-top" id="the-popover-attribute:nav-top">top-level
    traversable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="the-popover-attribute:nav-document">active
    document</a>.

8.  If `control`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-5"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="the-popover-attribute:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not the
    <a href="#same-origin" id="the-popover-attribute:same-origin">same</a>
    as the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="the-popover-attribute:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of
    `topDocument`, then return.

9.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-empty"
    id="the-popover-attribute:list-empty"
    data-x-internal="list-empty">Empty</a> `topDocument`'s
    <a href="#autofocus-candidates"
    id="the-popover-attribute:autofocus-candidates">autofocus candidates</a>.

10. Set `topDocument`'s <a href="#autofocus-processed-flag"
    id="the-popover-attribute:autofocus-processed-flag">autofocus processed
    flag</a> to true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="check-popover-validity" class="dfn">check popover
validity</span> for an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-24">HTML element</a> `element`
given a boolean `expectedToBeShowing`, a boolean `throwExceptions`, and
a [`Document`](#document) or null `expectedDocument`, perform the
following steps. They throw an exception or return a boolean.

1.  If `element`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
    <a href="#attr-popover-none-state"
    id="the-popover-attribute:attr-popover-none-state-4">No Popover</a>
    state, then:

    1.  If `throwExceptions` is true, then throw a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"
        id="the-popover-attribute:notsupportederror"
        data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-popover-attribute:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

    2.  Return false.

2.  If any of the following are true:

    - `expectedToBeShowing` is true and `element`'s
      <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
      id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-11">popover
      visibility state</a> is not <a href="#popover-showing-state"
      id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-11">showing</a>;
      or

    - `expectedToBeShowing` is false and `element`'s
      <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
      id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-12">popover
      visibility state</a> is not <a href="#popover-hidden-state"
      id="the-popover-attribute:popover-hidden-state-3">hidden</a>,

    then return false.

3.  If any of the following are true:

    - `element` is not <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected"
      id="the-popover-attribute:connected"
      data-x-internal="connected">connected</a>;

    - `element`'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
      id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-6"
      data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> is not
      <a href="#fully-active" id="the-popover-attribute:fully-active">fully
      active</a>;

    - `expectedDocument` is not null and `element`'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
      id="the-popover-attribute:node-document-7"
      data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> is not
      `expectedDocument`;

    - `element` is a [`dialog`](#the-dialog-element) element and its
      <a href="#is-modal" id="the-popover-attribute:is-modal">is modal</a>
      is set to true; or

    - `element`'s
      <a href="https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/#fullscreen-flag"
      id="the-popover-attribute:fullscreen-flag"
      data-x-internal="fullscreen-flag">fullscreen flag</a> is set,

    then:

    1.  If `throwExceptions` is true, then throw an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-popover-attribute:invalidstateerror-2"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-popover-attribute:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

    2.  Return false.

4.  Return true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="auto-popover-list" class="dfn">showing auto popover
list</span> for a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  Let `popovers` be « ».

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="the-popover-attribute:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a>
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
    data-x-internal="element"><code
    id="the-popover-attribute:element-2">Element</code></a> `element` in
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#document-top-layer"
    id="the-popover-attribute:top-layer-2" data-x-internal="top-layer">top
    layer</a>:

    1.  If all of the following are true:

        - `element` is an <a href="#html-elements"
          id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-25">HTML element</a>;

        - `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
          id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode-5">opened in popover
          mode</a> is "`auto`"; and

        - `element`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
          id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-13">popover
          visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
          id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-12">showing</a>,

        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="the-popover-attribute:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `element` to
        `popovers`.

3.  Return `popovers`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="showing-hint-popover-list" class="dfn">showing hint
popover list</span> for a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  Let `popovers` be « ».

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="the-popover-attribute:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a>
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
    data-x-internal="element"><code
    id="the-popover-attribute:element-3">Element</code></a> `element` in
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-position-4/#document-top-layer"
    id="the-popover-attribute:top-layer-3" data-x-internal="top-layer">top
    layer</a>:

    1.  If all of the following are true:

        - `element` is an <a href="#html-elements"
          id="the-popover-attribute:html-elements-26">HTML element</a>;

        - `element`'s <a href="#opened-in-popover-mode"
          id="the-popover-attribute:opened-in-popover-mode-6">opened in popover
          mode</a> is "`hint`"; and

        - `element`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
          id="the-popover-attribute:popover-visibility-state-14">popover
          visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
          id="the-popover-attribute:popover-showing-state-13">showing</a>,

        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="the-popover-attribute:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `element` to
        `popovers`.

3.  Return `popovers`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="close-entire-popover-list" class="dfn">close entire popover
list</span> given a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="the-popover-attribute:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
`popoverList`, a boolean `focusPreviousElement`, and a boolean
`fireEvents`:

1.  While `popoverList` is not empty:

    1.  Run the <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
        id="the-popover-attribute:hide-popover-algorithm-6">hide popover
        algorithm</a> given `popoverList`'s last item,
        `focusPreviousElement`, `fireEvents`, false, and null.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">6.12.1</span> The popover target attributes<a href="#the-popover-target-attributes" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#concept-button"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-button">Buttons</a> may have
the following content attributes:

- <span id="attr-popovertarget" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global"
  dfn-type="element-attr">`popovertarget`</span>

- <span id="attr-popovertargetaction" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global"
  dfn-type="element-attr">`popovertargetaction`</span>

If specified, the [`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget) attribute value
must be the <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-id"
data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> of an element with a
[`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute in the same
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:tree" data-x-internal="tree">tree</a>
as the <a href="#concept-button"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-button-2">button</a> with the
[`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget) attribute.

The [`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction) attribute is an
<a href="#enumerated-attribute"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:enumerated-attribute">enumerated
attribute</a> with the following keywords and states:

| Keyword | State | Brief description |
|----|----|----|
| <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-toggle" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global/popovertargetaction" dfn-type="attr-value">`toggle`</span> | <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-toggle-state" class="dfn">Toggle</span> | Shows or hides the targeted popover element. |
| <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-show" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global/popovertargetaction" dfn-type="attr-value">`show`</span> | <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-show-state" class="dfn">Show</span> | Shows the targeted popover element. |
| <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-hide" class="dfn" dfn-for="html-global/popovertargetaction" dfn-type="attr-value">`hide`</span> | <span id="attr-popovertargetaction-hide-state" class="dfn">Hide</span> | Hides the targeted popover element. |

<div algorithm="">

The attribute's *[missing value default](#missing-value-default)* and
*[invalid value default](#invalid-value-default)* are both the
<a href="#attr-popovertargetaction-toggle-state"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:attr-popovertargetaction-toggle-state">Toggle</a>
state.

</div>

Whenever possible ensure the popover element is placed immediately after
its triggering element in the DOM. Doing so will help ensure that the
popover is exposed in a logical programmatic reading order for users of
assistive technology, such as screen readers.

<div class="example">

The following shows how the [`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget)
attribute in combination with the
[`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction) attribute can be used
to show and close a popover:

``` html
<button popovertarget="foo" popovertargetaction="show">
  Show a popover
</button>

<article popover="auto" id="foo">
  This is a popover article!
  <button popovertarget="foo" popovertargetaction="hide">Close</button>
</article>
```

If a [`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction) attribute is not
specified, the default action will be to toggle the associated popover.
The following shows how only specifying the
[`popovertarget`](#attr-popovertarget) attribute on its invoking button
can toggle a manual popover between its opened and closed states. A
manual popover will not respond to <a href="#popover-light-dismiss"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-light-dismiss">light
dismiss</a> or <a href="#close-request"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:close-request">close requests</a>:

``` html
<input type="button" popovertarget="foo" value="Toggle the popover">

<div popover=manual id="foo">
  This is a popover!
</div>
```

</div>

<a href="#concept-element-dom"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-element-dom">DOM interface</a>:

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-popovertargetaction" class="dfn" dfn-for="HTMLElement"
dfn-type="attribute">`popoverTargetAction`</span> IDL attribute must
<a href="#reflect"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:reflect">reflect</a> the
[`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction) attribute,
<a href="#limited-to-only-known-values"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:limited-to-only-known-values">limited
to only known values</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To run the <span id="popover-target-attribute-activation-behavior"
class="dfn">popover target attribute activation behavior</span> given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="the-popover-target-attributes:node">Node</code></a> `node` and a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="the-popover-target-attributes:node-2">Node</code></a> `eventTarget`:

1.  Let `popover` be `node`'s <a href="#popover-target-element"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-target-element">popover target
    element</a>.

2.  If `popover` is null, then return.

3.  If `eventTarget` is a <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-inclusive-descendant">shadow-including
    inclusive descendant</a> of `popover` and `popover` is a <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-descendant"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:shadow-including-descendant"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-descendant">shadow-including
    descendant</a> of `node`, then return.

4.  If `node`'s [`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction)
    attribute is in the <a href="#attr-popovertargetaction-show"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:attr-popovertargetaction-show">show</a>
    state and `popover`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-visibility-state">popover
    visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-showing-state">showing</a>,
    then return.

5.  If `node`'s [`popovertargetaction`](#attr-popovertargetaction)
    attribute is in the <a href="#attr-popovertargetaction-hide"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:attr-popovertargetaction-hide">hide</a>
    state and `popover`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-visibility-state-2">popover
    visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-hidden-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-hidden-state">hidden</a>,
    then return.

6.  If `popover`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-visibility-state-3">popover
    visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-showing-state-2">showing</a>,
    then run the <a href="#hide-popover-algorithm"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:hide-popover-algorithm">hide popover
    algorithm</a> given `popover`, true, true, false, and `node`.

7.  Otherwise, if `popover`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-visibility-state-4">popover
    visibility state</a> is <a href="#popover-hidden-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:popover-hidden-state-2">hidden</a>
    and the result of running <a href="#check-popover-validity"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:check-popover-validity">check popover
    validity</a> given `popover`, false, false, and null is true, then
    run <a href="#show-popover"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:show-popover">show popover</a>
    given `popover`, false, and `node`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="popover-target-element" class="dfn">popover target
element</span> given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="the-popover-target-attributes:node-3">Node</code></a> `node`,
perform the following steps. They return an <a href="#html-elements"
id="the-popover-target-attributes:html-elements">HTML element</a> or
null.

1.  If `node` is not a <a href="#concept-button"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-button-3">button</a>, then
    return null.

2.  If `node` is <a href="#concept-fe-disabled"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-fe-disabled">disabled</a>,
    then return null.

3.  If `node` has a
    <a href="#form-owner" id="the-popover-target-attributes:form-owner">form
    owner</a> and `node` is a <a href="#concept-submit-button"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:concept-submit-button">submit
    button</a>, then return null.

4.  Let `popoverElement` be the result of running `node`'s
    <a href="#attr-associated-element"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:attr-associated-element">get the
    <code>popovertarget</code>-associated element</a>.

5.  If `popoverElement` is null, then return null.

6.  If `popoverElement`'s [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
    <a href="#attr-popover-none-state"
    id="the-popover-target-attributes:attr-popover-none-state">No
    Popover</a> state, then return null.

7.  Return `popoverElement`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">6.12.2</span> <span class="dfn">Popover light dismiss</span><a href="#popover-light-dismiss" class="self-link"></a>

"Light dismiss" means that clicking outside of a popover whose
[`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
<a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
id="popover-light-dismiss:attr-popover-auto-state">Auto</a> state will
close the popover. This is in addition to how such popovers respond to
<a href="#close-request" id="popover-light-dismiss:close-request">close
requests</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="light-dismiss-open-popovers" class="dfn">light dismiss open
popovers</span>, given a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#pointerevent-interface"
data-x-internal="pointerevent"><code
id="popover-light-dismiss:pointerevent">PointerEvent</code></a> `event`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-istrusted"><code
    id="popover-light-dismiss:dom-event-istrusted">isTrusted</code></a>
    attribute is true.

2.  Let `target` be `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-target"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:concept-event-target"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-target">target</a>.

3.  Let `document` be `target`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

4.  Let `topmostPopover` be the result of running
    <a href="#topmost-auto-popover"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:topmost-auto-popover">topmost auto popover</a>
    given `document`.

5.  If `topmostPopover` is null, then return.

6.  If `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-type"><code
    id="popover-light-dismiss:dom-event-type">type</code></a> is
    "<a href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#the-pointerdown-event"
    data-x-internal="event-pointerdown"><code
    id="popover-light-dismiss:event-pointerdown">pointerdown</code></a>",
    then: set `document`'s <a href="#popover-pointerdown-target"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-pointerdown-target">popover
    pointerdown target</a> to the result of running
    <a href="#topmost-clicked-popover"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:topmost-clicked-popover">topmost clicked
    popover</a> given `target`.

7.  If `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-type"><code
    id="popover-light-dismiss:dom-event-type-2">type</code></a> is
    "<a href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#the-pointerup-event"
    data-x-internal="event-pointerup"><code
    id="popover-light-dismiss:event-pointerup">pointerup</code></a>",
    then:

    1.  Let `ancestor` be the result of running
        <a href="#topmost-clicked-popover"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:topmost-clicked-popover-2">topmost clicked
        popover</a> given `target`.

    2.  Let `sameTarget` be true if `ancestor` is `document`'s
        <a href="#popover-pointerdown-target"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-pointerdown-target-2">popover
        pointerdown target</a>.

    3.  Set `document`'s <a href="#popover-pointerdown-target"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-pointerdown-target-3">popover
        pointerdown target</a> to null.

    4.  If `ancestor` is null, then set `ancestor` to `document`.

    5.  If `sameTarget` is true, then run
        <a href="#hide-all-popovers-until"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:hide-all-popovers-until">hide all popovers
        until</a> given `ancestor`, false, and true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To find the <span id="topmost-clicked-popover" class="dfn">topmost
clicked popover</span>, given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="popover-light-dismiss:node">Node</code></a> `node`:

1.  Let `clickedPopover` be the result of running
    <a href="#nearest-inclusive-open-popover"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:nearest-inclusive-open-popover">nearest
    inclusive open popover</a> given `node`.

2.  Let `targetPopover` be the result of running
    <a href="#nearest-inclusive-target-popover"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:nearest-inclusive-target-popover">nearest
    inclusive target popover</a> given `node`.

3.  If the result of <a href="#get-the-popover-stack-position"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:get-the-popover-stack-position">getting the
    popover stack position</a> given `clickedPopover` is greater than
    the result of <a href="#get-the-popover-stack-position"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:get-the-popover-stack-position-2">getting the
    popover stack position</a> given `targetPopover`, then return
    `clickedPopover`.

4.  Return `targetPopover`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="get-the-popover-stack-position" class="dfn">get the popover
stack position</span>, given an
<a href="#html-elements" id="popover-light-dismiss:html-elements">HTML
element</a> `popover`:

1.  Let `hintList` be `popover`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="#showing-hint-popover-list"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:showing-hint-popover-list">showing hint
    popover list</a>.

2.  Let `autoList` be `popover`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:node-document-3"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="#auto-popover-list"
    id="popover-light-dismiss:auto-popover-list">showing auto popover
    list</a>.

3.  If `popover` is in `hintList`, then return the index of `popover` in
    `hintList` + the size of `autoList` + 1.

4.  If `popover` is in `autoList`, then return the index of `popover` in
    `autoList` + 1.

5.  Return 0.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To find the <span id="nearest-inclusive-target-popover"
class="dfn">nearest inclusive target popover</span> given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
data-x-internal="node"><code
id="popover-light-dismiss:node-2">Node</code></a> `node`:

1.  Let `currentNode` be `node`.

2.  While `currentNode` is not null:

    1.  Let `targetPopover` be `currentNode`'s
        <a href="#popover-target-element"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-target-element">popover target
        element</a>.

    2.  If `targetPopover` is not null and `targetPopover`'s
        [`popover`](#attr-popover) attribute is in the
        <a href="#attr-popover-auto-state"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:attr-popover-auto-state-2">Auto</a>
        state or the <a href="#attr-popover-hint-state"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:attr-popover-hint-state">Hint</a>
        state, and `targetPopover`'s <a href="#popover-visibility-state"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-visibility-state">popover visibility
        state</a> is <a href="#popover-showing-state"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:popover-showing-state">showing</a>,
        then return `targetPopover`.

    3.  Set `currentNode` to `currentNode`'s ancestor in the
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-scoping/#flat-tree"
        id="popover-light-dismiss:flat-tree" data-x-internal="flat-tree">flat
        tree</a>.

</div>

## <span class="secno">7</span> Loading web pages<a href="#browsers" class="self-link"></a>

This section describes features that apply most directly to web
browsers. Having said that, except where specified otherwise, the
requirements defined in this section *do* apply to all user agents,
whether they are web browsers or not.

### <span class="secno">7.1</span> Supporting concepts<a href="#loading-web-pages-supporting-concepts" class="self-link"></a>

#### <span class="secno">7.1.1</span> Origins<a href="#origin" class="self-link"></a>

Origins are the fundamental currency of the web's security model. Two
actors in the web platform that share an origin are assumed to trust
each other and to have the same authority. Actors with differing origins
are considered potentially hostile versus each other, and are isolated
from each other to varying degrees.

For example, if Example Bank's web site, hosted at `bank.example.com`,
tries to examine the DOM of Example Charity's web site, hosted at
`charity.example.org`, a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
id="origin:securityerror"
data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="origin:domexception">DOMException</code></a> will be raised.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

An <span id="concept-origin" class="dfn" export="">origin</span> is one
of the following:

An <span id="concept-origin-opaque" class="dfn" export="">opaque origin</span>  
An internal value, with no serialization it can be recreated from (it is
serialized as "`null`" per <a href="#ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin"
id="origin:ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin">serialization of an
origin</a>), for which the only meaningful operation is testing for
equality.

A <span id="concept-origin-tuple" class="dfn" export="">tuple origin</span>  
A <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tuple" id="origin:tuple"
data-x-internal="tuple">tuple</a> consisting of:

- A <span id="concept-origin-scheme" class="dfn" dfn-for="origin"
  export="">scheme</span> (an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-string"
  id="origin:ascii-string" data-x-internal="ascii-string">ASCII string</a>).
- A <span id="concept-origin-host" class="dfn" dfn-for="origin"
  export="">host</span> (a
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-host"
  id="origin:concept-host" data-x-internal="concept-host">host</a>).
- A <span id="concept-origin-port" class="dfn" dfn-for="origin"
  export="">port</span> (null or a 16-bit unsigned integer).
- A <span id="concept-origin-domain" class="dfn" dfn-for="origin"
  export="">domain</span> (null or a
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-domain"
  id="origin:concept-domain" data-x-internal="concept-domain">domain</a>).
  Null unless stated otherwise.

<a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin">Origins</a> can be
shared, e.g., among multiple [`Document`](#document) objects.
Furthermore,
<a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin-2">origins</a> are
generally immutable. Only the <a href="#concept-origin-domain"
id="origin:concept-origin-domain">domain</a> of a
<a href="#concept-origin-tuple" id="origin:concept-origin-tuple">tuple
origin</a> can be changed, and only through the
[`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) API.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-origin-effective-domain" class="dfn"
export="">effective domain</span> of an
<a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin-3">origin</a>
`origin` is computed as follows:

1.  If `origin` is an <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="origin:concept-origin-opaque">opaque origin</a>, then return
    null.

2.  If `origin`'s <a href="#concept-origin-domain"
    id="origin:concept-origin-domain-2">domain</a> is non-null, then
    return `origin`'s <a href="#concept-origin-domain"
    id="origin:concept-origin-domain-3">domain</a>.

3.  Return `origin`'s
    <a href="#concept-origin-host" id="origin:concept-origin-host">host</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin" class="dfn"
lt="serialization of an
  origin|ASCII serialization of an origin" export="">serialization of an
origin</span> is the string obtained by applying the following algorithm
to the given
<a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin-4">origin</a>
`origin`:

1.  If `origin` is an <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="origin:concept-origin-opaque-2">opaque origin</a>, then return
    "`null`".

2.  Otherwise, let `result` be `origin`'s
    <a href="#concept-origin-scheme"
    id="origin:concept-origin-scheme">scheme</a>.

3.  Append "`://`" to `result`.

4.  Append `origin`'s <a href="#concept-origin-host"
    id="origin:concept-origin-host-2">host</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-host-serializer"
    id="origin:host-serializer"
    data-x-internal="host-serializer">serialized</a>, to `result`.

5.  If `origin`'s
    <a href="#concept-origin-port" id="origin:concept-origin-port">port</a>
    is non-null, append a U+003A COLON character (:), and `origin`'s
    <a href="#concept-origin-port"
    id="origin:concept-origin-port-2">port</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#serialize-an-integer"
    id="origin:serialize-an-integer"
    data-x-internal="serialize-an-integer">serialized</a>, to `result`.

6.  Return `result`.

</div>

The <a href="#ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin"
id="origin:ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin-2">serialization</a> of
("`https`", "`xn--maraa-rta.example`", null, null) is
"`https://xn--maraa-rta.example`".

<a href="#unicode-serialisation-of-an-origin" class="self-link"></a>There
used to also be a *Unicode serialization of an origin*. However, it was
never widely adopted.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

Two <a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin-5">origins</a>,
`A` and `B`, are said to be <span id="same-origin" class="dfn"
export="">same origin</span> if the following algorithm returns true:

1.  If `A` and `B` are the same <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="origin:concept-origin-opaque-3">opaque origin</a>, then return
    true.

2.  If `A` and `B` are both
    <a href="#concept-origin-tuple" id="origin:concept-origin-tuple-2">tuple
    origins</a> and their <a href="#concept-origin-scheme"
    id="origin:concept-origin-scheme-2">schemes</a>,
    <a href="#concept-origin-host"
    id="origin:concept-origin-host-3">hosts</a>, and
    <a href="#concept-origin-port"
    id="origin:concept-origin-port-3">port</a> are identical, then
    return true.

3.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Two <a href="#concept-origin" id="origin:concept-origin-6">origins</a>,
`A` and `B`, are said to be <span id="same-origin-domain" class="dfn"
export="">same origin-domain</span> if the following algorithm returns
true:

1.  If `A` and `B` are the same <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="origin:concept-origin-opaque-4">opaque origin</a>, then return
    true.

2.  If `A` and `B` are both
    <a href="#concept-origin-tuple" id="origin:concept-origin-tuple-3">tuple
    origins</a>:

    1.  If `A` and `B`'s <a href="#concept-origin-scheme"
        id="origin:concept-origin-scheme-3">schemes</a> are identical,
        and their <a href="#concept-origin-domain"
        id="origin:concept-origin-domain-4">domains</a> are identical
        and non-null, then return true.

    2.  Otherwise, if `A` and `B` are
        <a href="#same-origin" id="origin:same-origin">same origin</a>
        and their <a href="#concept-origin-domain"
        id="origin:concept-origin-domain-5">domains</a> are both null,
        return true.

3.  Return false.

</div>

<div class="example">

|  |  |  |  |
|----|----|----|----|
| `A` | `B` | <a href="#same-origin" id="origin:same-origin-2">same origin</a> | <a href="#same-origin-domain" id="origin:same-origin-domain">same
origin-domain</a> |
| ("`https`", "`example.org`", null, null) | ("`https`", "`example.org`", null, null) | ✅ | ✅ |
| ("`https`", "`example.org`", 314, null) | ("`https`", "`example.org`", 420, null) | ❌ | ❌ |
