        id="browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy:assert-2"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `newBrowsingContext`'s
        <a href="#popup-sandboxing-flag-set"
        id="browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy:popup-sandboxing-flag-set">popup
        sandboxing flag set</a>
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
        id="browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy:list-is-empty"
        data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is empty</a>.

    3.  Set `newBrowsingContext`'s <a href="#popup-sandboxing-flag-set"
        id="browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy:popup-sandboxing-flag-set-2">popup
        sandboxing flag set</a> to `sandboxFlags`.

15. Return `newBrowsingContext`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.1.3.3</span> <span id="reporting"></span>Reporting<a href="#coop-reporting" class="self-link"></a>

An <span id="accessor-accessed-relationship"
class="dfn">accessor-accessed relationship</span> is an enum that
describes the relationship between two <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context">browsing contexts</a> between which
an access happened. It can take the following values:

<span id="accessor-accessed-opener" class="dfn">accessor is opener</span>  
The accessor <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-2">browsing context</a> or one of
its <a href="#ancestor-browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:ancestor-browsing-context">ancestors</a> is the
<a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:opener-browsing-context">opener browsing context</a>
of the accessed <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-3">browsing context</a>'s
<a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc">top-level browsing
context</a>.

<span id="accessor-accessed-openee" class="dfn">accessor is openee</span>  
The accessed <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-4">browsing context</a> or one of
its <a href="#ancestor-browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:ancestor-browsing-context-2">ancestors</a> is the
<a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:opener-browsing-context-2">opener browsing
context</a> of the accessor <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-5">browsing context</a>'s
<a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-2">top-level browsing
context</a>.

<span id="accessor-accessed-none" class="dfn">none</span>  
There is no opener relationship between the accessor
<a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-6">browsing context</a>, the
accessor <a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-7">browsing context</a>, or any of
their <a href="#ancestor-browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:ancestor-browsing-context-3">ancestors</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-check-access-report" class="dfn">check if an access
between two browsing contexts should be reported</span>, given two
<a href="#browsing-context"
id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-8">browsing contexts</a> `accessor`
and `accessed`, a JavaScript property name `P`, and an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="coop-reporting:environment-settings-object">environment settings
object</a> `environment`:

1.  If `P` is not a
    <a href="#cross-origin-accessible-window-property-name"
    id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-accessible-window-property-name">cross-origin
    accessible window property name</a>, then return.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="coop-reporting:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `accessor`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document">active
    document</a> and `accessed`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-2">active
    document</a> are both
    <a href="#fully-active" id="coop-reporting:fully-active">fully
    active</a>.

3.  Let `accessorTopDocument` be `accessor`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-3">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-3">active
    document</a>.

4.  Let `accessorInclusiveAncestorOrigins` be the list obtained by
    taking the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of the
    <a href="#nav-document" id="coop-reporting:nav-document">active
    document</a> of each of `accessor`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-4">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#inclusive-ancestor-navigables"
    id="coop-reporting:inclusive-ancestor-navigables">inclusive ancestor
    navigables</a>.

5.  Let `accessedTopDocument` be `accessed`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-4">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-5">active
    document</a>.

6.  Let `accessedInclusiveAncestorOrigins` be the list obtained by
    taking the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of the
    <a href="#nav-document" id="coop-reporting:nav-document-2">active
    document</a> of each of `accessed`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-6">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#inclusive-ancestor-navigables"
    id="coop-reporting:inclusive-ancestor-navigables-2">inclusive ancestor
    navigables</a>.

7.  If any of `accessorInclusiveAncestorOrigins` are not
    <a href="#same-origin" id="coop-reporting:same-origin">same origin</a>
    with `accessorTopDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, or if any of
    `accessedInclusiveAncestorOrigins` are not
    <a href="#same-origin" id="coop-reporting:same-origin-2">same origin</a>
    with `accessedTopDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then return.

    This avoids leaking information about cross-origin iframes to a top
    level frame with opener policy reporting.

8.  If `accessor`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-5">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#virtual-browsing-context-group-id"
    id="coop-reporting:virtual-browsing-context-group-id">virtual browsing
    context group ID</a> is `accessed`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-6">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#virtual-browsing-context-group-id"
    id="coop-reporting:virtual-browsing-context-group-id-2">virtual browsing
    context group ID</a>, then return.

9.  Let `accessorAccessedRelationship` be a new
    <a href="#accessor-accessed-relationship"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-relationship">accessor-accessed
    relationship</a> with value <a href="#accessor-accessed-none"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-none">none</a>.

10. If `accessed`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-7">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
    id="coop-reporting:opener-browsing-context-3">opener browsing
    context</a> is `accessor` or is an
    <a href="#ancestor-browsing-context"
    id="coop-reporting:ancestor-browsing-context-4">ancestor</a> of
    `accessor`, then set `accessorAccessedRelationship` to
    <a href="#accessor-accessed-opener"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-opener">accessor is opener</a>.

11. If `accessor`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-8">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
    id="coop-reporting:opener-browsing-context-4">opener browsing
    context</a> is `accessed` or is an
    <a href="#ancestor-browsing-context"
    id="coop-reporting:ancestor-browsing-context-5">ancestor</a> of
    `accessed`, then set `accessorAccessedRelationship` to
    <a href="#accessor-accessed-openee"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-openee">accessor is openee</a>.

12. <a href="#coop-violation-access"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access">Queue violation reports for
    accesses</a>, given `accessorAccessedRelationship`,
    `accessorTopDocument`'s <a href="#concept-document-coop"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-coop">opener policy</a>,
    `accessedTopDocument`'s <a href="#concept-document-coop"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-coop-2">opener policy</a>,
    `accessor`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-7">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="coop-reporting:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>, `accessed`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-8">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="coop-reporting:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>, `accessor`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-9">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#browsing-context-initial-url"
    id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-initial-url">initial URL</a>,
    `accessed`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-10">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#browsing-context-initial-url"
    id="coop-reporting:browsing-context-initial-url-2">initial URL</a>,
    `accessor`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-9">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, `accessed`'s
    <a href="#active-document" id="coop-reporting:active-document-10">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-document-origin-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, `accessor`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-11">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#opener-origin-at-creation"
    id="coop-reporting:opener-origin-at-creation">opener origin at
    creation</a>, `accessed`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="coop-reporting:bc-tlbc-12">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#opener-origin-at-creation"
    id="coop-reporting:opener-origin-at-creation-2">opener origin at
    creation</a>, `accessorTopDocument`'s
    <a href="#dom-document-referrer"
    id="coop-reporting:dom-document-referrer">referrer</a>,
    `accessedTopDocument`'s <a href="#dom-document-referrer"
    id="coop-reporting:dom-document-referrer-2">referrer</a>, `P`, and
    `environment`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="sanitize-url-report" class="dfn">sanitize a URL to send in
a report</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="coop-reporting:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`:

1.  Let `sanitizedURL` be a copy of `url`.

2.  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#set-the-username"
    id="coop-reporting:set-the-username"
    data-x-internal="set-the-username">Set the username</a> given
    `sanitizedURL` and the empty string.

3.  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#set-the-password"
    id="coop-reporting:set-the-password"
    data-x-internal="set-the-password">Set the password</a> given
    `sanitizedURL` and the empty string.

4.  Return the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-url-serializer"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a> of
    `sanitizedURL` with
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-serializer-exclude-fragment"
    id="coop-reporting:url-serializer-exclude-fragment"
    data-x-internal="url-serializer-exclude-fragment"><em>exclude
    fragment</em></a> set to true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-violation-navigation-to" class="dfn">queue a violation
report for browsing context group switch when navigating to a COOP
response</span> given an <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-opener-policy">opener policy</a> `coop`,
a string `disposition`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="coop-reporting:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `coopURL`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="coop-reporting:url-3" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`previousResponseURL`, two
<a href="#concept-origin" id="coop-reporting:concept-origin">origins</a>
`coopOrigin` and `previousResponseOrigin`, and a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
id="coop-reporting:concept-request-referrer"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> `referrer`:

1.  If `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint">reporting endpoint</a>
    is null, return.

2.  Let `coopValue` be `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-value"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-value">value</a>.

3.  If `disposition` is "`reporting`", then set `coopValue` to `coop`'s
    <a href="#coop-struct-report-only-value"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-only-value">report-only value</a>.

4.  Let `serializedReferrer` be an empty string.

5.  If `referrer` is a
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="coop-reporting:url-4" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>, set
    `serializedReferrer` to the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="coop-reporting:concept-url-serializer-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a> of
    `referrer`.

6.  Let `body` be a new object containing the following properties:

    | key | value |
    |----|----|
    | disposition | `disposition` |
    | effectivePolicy | `coopValue` |
    | previousResponseURL | If `coopOrigin` and `previousResponseOrigin` are <a href="#same-origin" id="coop-reporting:same-origin-3">same origin</a> this is the <a href="#sanitize-url-report"
    id="coop-reporting:sanitize-url-report">sanitization</a> of `previousResponseURL`, null otherwise. |
    | referrer | `serializedReferrer` |
    | type | "`navigation-to-response`" |

7.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="coop-reporting:queue-a-report"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for
    `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-2">reporting endpoint</a>
    with `coopURL`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-violation-navigation-from" class="dfn">queue a
violation report for browsing context group switch when navigating away

id="coop-reporting:url-6" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>

`nextResponseOrigin`, and a boolean `isCOOPResponseNavigationSource`:

    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-3">reporting endpoint</a>
    is null, return.

2.  Let `coopValue` be `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-value"

    <a href="#coop-struct-report-only-value"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-only-value-2">report-only
    value</a>.

4.  Let `body` be a new object containing the following properties:

    | key | value |
    |----|----|

    | effectivePolicy | `coopValue` |
    | nextResponseURL | If `coopOrigin` and `nextResponseOrigin` are <a href="#same-origin" id="coop-reporting:same-origin-4">same origin</a> or `isCOOPResponseNavigationSource` is true, this is the <a href="#sanitize-url-report"
    id="coop-reporting:sanitize-url-report-2">sanitization</a> of `nextResponseURL`, null otherwise. |
    | type | "`navigation-from-response`" |

5.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="coop-reporting:queue-a-report-2"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for

    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-4">reporting endpoint</a>
    with `coopURL`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-violation-access" class="dfn">queue violation reports
for accesses</span>, given an <a href="#accessor-accessed-relationship"
id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-relationship-2">accessor-accessed
relationship</a> `accessorAccessedRelationship`, two
<a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-opener-policy-3">opener policies</a>
`accessorCOOP` and `accessedCOOP`, four
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="coop-reporting:url-7" data-x-internal="url">URLs</a> `accessorURL`,
`accessedURL`, `accessorInitialURL`, `accessedInitialURL`, four
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="coop-reporting:concept-origin-3">origins</a> `accessorOrigin`,
`accessedOrigin`, `accessorCreatorOrigin` and `accessedCreatorOrigin`,
two <a href="#dom-document-referrer"
id="coop-reporting:dom-document-referrer-3">referrers</a>
`accessorReferrer` and `accessedReferrer`, a string `propertyName`, and
an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="coop-reporting:environment-settings-object-2">environment settings
object</a> `environment`:

1.  If `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-5">reporting endpoint</a>
    is null, return.

2.  Let `coopValue` be `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-value"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-value-3">value</a>.

3.  If `disposition` is "`reporting`", then set `coopValue` to `coop`'s
    <a href="#coop-struct-report-only-value"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-only-value-3">report-only
    value</a>.

4.  If `accessorAccessedRelationship` is
    <a href="#accessor-accessed-opener"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-opener-2">accessor is opener</a>:

    1.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-to-opened"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-to-opened">Queue a violation
        report for access to an opened window</a>, given `accessorCOOP`,
        `accessorURL`, `accessedURL`, `accessedInitialURL`,
        `accessorOrigin`, `accessedOrigin`, `accessedCreatorOrigin`,
        `propertyName`, and `environment`.

    2.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-from-opener"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-from-opener">Queue a violation
        report for access from the opener</a>, given `accessedCOOP`,
        `accessedURL`, `accessorURL`, `accessedOrigin`,
        `accessorOrigin`, `propertyName`, and `accessedReferrer`.

5.  Otherwise, if `accessorAccessedRelationship` is
    <a href="#accessor-accessed-openee"
    id="coop-reporting:accessor-accessed-openee-2">accessor is openee</a>:

    1.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-to-opener"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-to-opener">Queue a violation
        report for access to the opener</a>, given `accessorCOOP`,
        `accessorURL`, `accessedURL`, `accessorOrigin`,
        `accessedOrigin`, `propertyName`, `accessorReferrer`, and
        `environment`.

    2.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-from-opened"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-from-opened">Queue a violation
        report for access from an opened window</a>, given
        `accessedCOOP`, `accessedURL`, `accessorURL`,
        `accessorInitialURL`, `accessedOrigin`, `accessorOrigin`,
        `accessorCreatorOrigin`, and `propertyName`.

6.  Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-to-opened"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-to-opened-2">Queue a violation
        report for access to another window</a>, given `accessorCOOP`,
        `accessorURL`, `accessedURL`, `accessorOrigin`,
        `accessedOrigin`, `propertyName`, and `environment`.

    2.  <a href="#coop-violation-access-from-other"
        id="coop-reporting:coop-violation-access-from-other">Queue a violation
        report for access from another window</a>, given `accessedCOOP`,
        `accessedURL`, `accessorURL`, `accessedOrigin`,
        `accessorOrigin`, and `propertyName`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-violation-access-to-opener" class="dfn">queue a
violation report for access to the opener</span>, given an
<a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-opener-policy-4">opener policy</a>

    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for
    `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-6">reporting endpoint</a>
    with `coopURL` and `environment`.

</div>

To <span id="coop-violation-access-to-opened" class="dfn">queue a

    | sourceFile | `sourceFile` |
    | lineNumber | `lineNumber` |

    | type | "`access-to-opener`" |

3.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="coop-reporting:queue-a-report-4"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for

    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-7">reporting endpoint</a>
    with `coopURL` and `environment`.

</div>

To <span id="coop-violation-access-to-other" class="dfn">queue a
violation report for access to another window</span>, given an
<a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-opener-policy-6">opener policy</a>
`coop`, two <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"

    script URL and problematic position which triggered this report.

2.  Let `body` be a new object containing the following properties:

    | type | "`access-to-opener`" |

3.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="coop-reporting:queue-a-report-5"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for
    `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-8">reporting endpoint</a>
    with `coopURL` and `environment`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="coop-violation-access-from-opener" class="dfn">queue a
violation report for access from the opener</span>, given an
<a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="coop-reporting:cross-origin-opener-policy-7">opener policy</a>
`coop`, two <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="coop-reporting:url-12" data-x-internal="url">URLs</a> `coopURL` and
`openerURL`, two <a href="#concept-origin"
id="coop-reporting:concept-origin-7">origins</a> `coopOrigin` and
`openerOrigin`, a string `propertyName`, and a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
id="coop-reporting:concept-request-referrer-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> `referrer`:

1.  If `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-9">reporting endpoint</a>
    is null, return.

2.  Let `serializedReferrer` be an empty string.

3.  If `referrer` is a

4.  Let `body` be a new object containing the following properties:

    | key | value |

    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-only-value-7">report-only
    value</a> |

    id="coop-reporting:sanitize-url-report-7">sanitization</a> of `openerURL`, null otherwise. |
    | referrer | `serializedReferrer` |
    | type | "`access-to-opener`" |

5.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="coop-reporting:queue-a-report-6"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as "`coop`" for
    `coop`'s <a href="#coop-struct-report-endpoint"
    id="coop-reporting:coop-struct-report-endpoint-10">reporting
    endpoint</a> with `coopURL`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

#### <span class="secno">7.1.4</span> Cross-origin embedder policies<a href="#coep" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Headers/Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy "The HTTP Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy (COEP) response header configures embedding cross-origin resources into the document.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox79+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari15.2+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome83+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera unknown">Opera?</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge83+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge unknown">Edge
(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie no">Internet ExplorerNo</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android yes">WebView
Android86+</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

An <span id="embedder-policy-value" class="dfn" export="">embedder
policy value</span> is one of three strings that controls the fetching
of cross-origin resources without explicit permission from resource
owners.

"<span id="coep-unsafe-none" class="dfn" dfn-for="embedder policy value" export="">`unsafe-none`</span>"  
This is the default value. When this value is used, cross-origin
resources can be fetched without giving explicit permission through the
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cors-protocol"
id="coep:cors-protocol" data-x-internal="cors-protocol">CORS
protocol</a> or the \`<a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cross-origin-resource-policy"
data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy"><code
id="coep:cross-origin-resource-policy">Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy</code></a>\`
header.

"<span id="coep-require-corp" class="dfn" dfn-for="embedder policy value" export="">`require-corp`</span>"  
When this value is used, fetching cross-origin resources requires the
server's explicit permission through the
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cors-protocol"
id="coep:cors-protocol-2" data-x-internal="cors-protocol">CORS
protocol</a> or the \`<a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cross-origin-resource-policy"
data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy"><code
id="coep:cross-origin-resource-policy-2">Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy</code></a>\`
header.

"<span id="coep-credentialless" class="dfn" dfn-for="embedder policy value" export="">`credentialless`</span>"  
When this value is used, fetching cross-origin no-CORS resources omits
credentials. In exchange, an explicit \`<a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cross-origin-resource-policy"
data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy"><code
id="coep:cross-origin-resource-policy-3">Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy</code></a>\`
header is not required. Other requests sent with credentials require the
server's explicit permission through the
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cors-protocol"
id="coep:cors-protocol-3" data-x-internal="cors-protocol">CORS
protocol</a> or the \`<a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-cross-origin-resource-policy"
data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy"><code
id="coep:cross-origin-resource-policy-4">Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy</code></a>\`
header.

<div class="warning">

Before supporting "[`credentialless`](#coep-credentialless)",
implementers are strongly encouraged to support both:

- [Private Network
  Access](https://wicg.github.io/private-network-access/)
- [Opaque Response Blocking](https://github.com/annevk/orb)

Otherwise, it would allow attackers to leverage the client's network
position to read non public resources, using the
<a href="#concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability"
id="coep:concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability">cross-origin
isolated capability</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

An <a href="#embedder-policy-value"
id="coep:embedder-policy-value">embedder policy value</a> is
<span id="compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation" class="dfn">compatible
with cross-origin isolation</span> if it is
"[`credentialless`](#coep-credentialless)" or
"[`require-corp`](#coep-require-corp)".

</div>

An <span id="embedder-policy" class="dfn" export="">embedder
policy</span> consists of:

- A <span id="embedder-policy-value-2" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="embedder policy" export="">value</span>, which is an
  <a href="#embedder-policy-value"
  id="coep:embedder-policy-value-2">embedder policy value</a>, initially
  "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)".

- A <span id="embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="embedder policy" export="">reporting endpoint</span> string,
  initially the empty string.

- A <span id="embedder-policy-report-only-value" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="embedder policy" export="">report only value</span>, which is
  an <a href="#embedder-policy-value"
  id="coep:embedder-policy-value-3">embedder policy value</a>, initially
  "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)".

- A <span id="embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint"
  class="dfn" dfn-for="embedder
     policy" export="">report only reporting endpoint</span> string,
  initially the empty string.

The <span id="coep-report-type" class="dfn" export="">"`coep`" report
type</span> is a <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#report-type"
id="coep:report-type" data-x-internal="report-type">report type</a>
whose value is "`coep`". It is
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#visible-to-reportingobservers"
id="coep:visible-to-reportingobservers"
data-x-internal="visible-to-reportingobservers">visible to
<code>ReportingObserver</code>s</a>.

##### <span class="secno">7.1.4.1</span> The headers<a href="#the-coep-headers" class="self-link"></a>

The \`<span id="cross-origin-embedder-policy" class="dfn"
dfn-type="http-header">`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`</span>\` and
\`<span id="cross-origin-embedder-policy-report-only" class="dfn"
dfn-type="http-header">`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy-Report-Only`</span>\`
HTTP response headers allow a server to declare an
<a href="#embedder-policy"
id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy">embedder policy</a> for an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="the-coep-headers:environment-settings-object">environment settings
object</a>. These headers are
<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html"
id="the-coep-headers:http-structured-header"
data-x-internal="http-structured-header">structured headers</a> whose
values must be <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html#token"
id="the-coep-headers:http-structured-header-token"
data-x-internal="http-structured-header-token">token</a>.
[\[STRUCTURED-FIELDS\]](#refsSTRUCTURED-FIELDS)

The valid <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html#token"
id="the-coep-headers:http-structured-header-token-2"
data-x-internal="http-structured-header-token">token</a> values are the
<a href="#embedder-policy-value"
id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-value">embedder policy values</a>.
The token may also have attached
<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html#param"
id="the-coep-headers:http-structured-header-parameters"
data-x-internal="http-structured-header-parameters">parameters</a>; of
these, the "<span id="coep-report-to" class="dfn">`report-to`</span>"
parameter can have a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string"
id="the-coep-headers:valid-url-string"
data-x-internal="valid-url-string">valid URL string</a> identifying an
appropriate reporting endpoint. [\[REPORTING\]](#refsREPORTING)

<div class="note">

The <a href="#obtain-an-embedder-policy"
id="the-coep-headers:obtain-an-embedder-policy">processing model</a>
fails open (by defaulting to "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)") in
the presence of a header that cannot be parsed as a token. This includes
inadvertent lists created by combining multiple instances of the
\`[`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`](#cross-origin-embedder-policy)\`
header present in a given response:

| \`[`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`](#cross-origin-embedder-policy)\` | Final <a href="#embedder-policy-value"
id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-value-2">embedder policy value</a> |
|----|----|
| *No header delivered* | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |
| \``require-corp`\` | "[`require-corp`](#coep-require-corp)" |
| \``unknown-value`\` | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |
| \``require-corp, unknown-value`\` | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |
| \``unknown-value, unknown-value`\` | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |
| \``unknown-value, require-corp`\` | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |
| \``require-corp, require-corp`\` | "[`unsafe-none`](#coep-unsafe-none)" |

(The same applies to
\`[`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy-Report-Only`](#cross-origin-embedder-policy-report-only)\`.)

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="obtain-an-embedder-policy" class="dfn" export="">obtain an
embedder policy</span> from a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="the-coep-headers:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and an
<a href="#environment" id="the-coep-headers:environment">environment</a>
`environment`:

1.  Let `policy` be a new <a href="#embedder-policy"
    id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-2">embedder policy</a>.

2.  If `environment` is a <a href="#non-secure-context"
    id="the-coep-headers:non-secure-context">non-secure context</a>,
    then return `policy`.

3.  Let `parsedItem` be the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-get-structured-header"
    id="the-coep-headers:getting-a-structured-field-value"
    data-x-internal="getting-a-structured-field-value">getting a structured
    field value</a> with
    \`[`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy`](#cross-origin-embedder-policy)\`
    and "`item`" from `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="the-coep-headers:concept-response-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

4.  If `parsedItem` is non-null and `parsedItem`\[0\] is
    <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="the-coep-headers:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a>:

    1.  Set `policy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
        id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-value-2-2">value</a> to
        `parsedItem`\[0\].

    2.  If `parsedItem`\[1\]\["[`report-to`](#coep-report-to)"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="the-coep-headers:map-exists" data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>,
        then set `policy`'s
        <a href="#embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint"
        id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint">endpoint</a>
        to `parsedItem`\[1\]\["[`report-to`](#coep-report-to)"\].

5.  Set `parsedItem` to the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-get-structured-header"
    id="the-coep-headers:getting-a-structured-field-value-2"
    data-x-internal="getting-a-structured-field-value">getting a structured
    field value</a> with
    \`[`Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy-Report-Only`](#cross-origin-embedder-policy-report-only)\`
    and "`item`" from `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="the-coep-headers:concept-response-header-list-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

6.  If `parsedItem` is non-null and `parsedItem`\[0\] is
    <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="the-coep-headers:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-2">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a>:

    1.  Set `policy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-value"
        id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-report-only-value">report only
        value</a> to `parsedItem`\[0\].

    2.  If `parsedItem`\[1\]\["[`report-to`](#coep-report-to)"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="the-coep-headers:map-exists-2"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `policy`'s
        <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint"
        id="the-coep-headers:embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint">endpoint</a>
        to `parsedItem`\[1\]\["[`report-to`](#coep-report-to)"\].

7.  Return `policy`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.1.4.2</span> Embedder policy checks<a href="#embedder-policy-checks" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="check-a-navigation-response's-adherence-to-its-embedder-policy"
class="dfn">check a navigation response's adherence to its embedder
policy</span> given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`, a
<a href="#navigable" id="embedder-policy-checks:navigable">navigable</a>
`navigable`, and an <a href="#embedder-policy"
id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy">embedder policy</a>
`responsePolicy`:

1.  If `navigable` is not a <a href="#child-navigable"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:child-navigable">child navigable</a>,
    then return true.

2.  Let `parentPolicy` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:nav-container-document">container
    document</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-document-policy-container">policy
    container</a>'s <a href="#policy-container-embedder-policy"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:policy-container-embedder-policy">embedder
    policy</a>.

3.  If `parentPolicy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-value"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-report-only-value">report-only
    value</a> is <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a> and `responsePolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2">value</a> is
    not, then
    <a href="#queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation">queue
    a cross-origin embedder policy inheritance violation</a> with
    `response`, "`navigation`", `parentPolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint">report
    only reporting endpoint</a>, "`reporting`", and `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:nav-container-document-2">container
    document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
    object</a>.

4.  If `parentPolicy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2-2">value</a> is
    not <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-2">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a> or `responsePolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2-3">value</a> is
    <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-3">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a>, then return true.

5.  <a href="#queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation-2">Queue
    a cross-origin embedder policy inheritance violation</a> with
    `response`, "`navigation`", `parentPolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint">reporting
    endpoint</a>, "`enforce`", and `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:nav-container-document-3">container
    document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant settings
    object</a>.

6.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="check-a-global-object's-embedder-policy" class="dfn">check
a global object's embedder policy</span> given a
[`WorkerGlobalScope`](#workerglobalscope) `workerGlobalScope`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="embedder-policy-checks:environment-settings-object">environment
settings object</a> `owner`, and a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-response-2"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`:

1.  If `workerGlobalScope` is not a
    [`DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope`](#dedicatedworkerglobalscope) object,
    then return true.

2.  Let `policy` be `workerGlobalScope`'s
    <a href="#concept-workerglobalscope-embedder-policy"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-workerglobalscope-embedder-policy">embedder
    policy</a>.

3.  Let `ownerPolicy` be `owner`'s
    <a href="#concept-settings-object-policy-container"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-settings-object-policy-container">policy
    container</a>'s <a href="#policy-container-embedder-policy"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:policy-container-embedder-policy-2">embedder
    policy</a>.

4.  If `ownerPolicy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-value"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-report-only-value-2">report-only
    value</a> is <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-4">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a> and `policy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2-4">value</a> is
    not, then
    <a href="#queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation-3">queue
    a cross-origin embedder policy inheritance violation</a> with
    `response`, "`worker initialization`", `ownerPolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-report-only-reporting-endpoint-2">report
    only reporting endpoint</a>, "`reporting`", and `owner`.

5.  If `ownerPolicy`'s <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2-5">value</a> is
    not <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-5">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a> or `policy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-value-2"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-value-2-6">value</a> is
    <a href="#compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:compatible-with-cross-origin-isolation-6">compatible
    with cross-origin isolation</a>, then return true.

6.  <a href="#queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation-4">Queue
    a cross-origin embedder policy inheritance violation</a> with
    `response`, "`worker initialization`", `ownerPolicy`'s
    <a href="#embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:embedder-policy-reporting-endpoint-2">reporting
    endpoint</a>, "`enforce`", and `owner`.

7.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="queue-a-cross-origin-embedder-policy-inheritance-violation"
class="dfn">queue a cross-origin embedder policy inheritance
violation</span> given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="embedder-policy-checks:concept-response-3"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response`, a string
`type`, a string `endpoint`, a string `disposition`, and an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="embedder-policy-checks:environment-settings-object-2">environment
settings object</a> `settings`:

1.  Let `serialized` be the result of <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#serialize-a-response-url-for-reporting"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:serialize-a-response-url-for-reporting"
    data-x-internal="serialize-a-response-url-for-reporting">serializing a
    response URL for reporting</a> with `response`.

2.  Let `body` be a new object containing the following properties:

    | key         | value         |
    |-------------|---------------|
    | type        | `type`        |
    | blockedURL  | `serialized`  |
    | disposition | `disposition` |

3.  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/reporting/#queue-report"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:queue-a-report"
    data-x-internal="queue-a-report">Queue</a> `body` as the
    <a href="#coep-report-type"
    id="embedder-policy-checks:coep-report-type">"<code>coep</code>" report
    type</a> for `endpoint` on `settings`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.1.5</span> Sandboxing<a href="#sandboxing" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="sandboxing-flag-set" class="dfn" export="">sandboxing flag
set</span> is a set of zero or more of the following flags, which are
used to restrict the abilities that potentially untrusted resources
have:

The <span id="sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed navigation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [prevents content from navigating browsing contexts other than
the sandboxed browsing context itself](#sandboxLinks) (or browsing
contexts further nested inside it),
<a href="#auxiliary-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:auxiliary-browsing-context">auxiliary browsing
contexts</a> (which are protected by the
<a href="#sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
auxiliary navigation browsing context flag</a> defined next), and the
<a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:top-level-browsing-context">top-level browsing
context</a> (which is protected by the <a
href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</a>
and <a
href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag</a>
defined below).

If the <a href="#sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag-2">sandboxed
auxiliary navigation browsing context flag</a> is not set, then in
certain cases the restrictions nonetheless allow popups (new
<a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:top-level-browsing-context-2">top-level browsing
contexts</a>) to be opened. These
<a href="#browsing-context" id="sandboxing:browsing-context">browsing
contexts</a> always have <span id="one-permitted-sandboxed-navigator"
class="dfn">one permitted sandboxed navigator</span>, set when the
browsing context is created, which allows the
<a href="#browsing-context" id="sandboxing:browsing-context-2">browsing
context</a> that created them to actually navigate them. (Otherwise, the
<a href="#sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
navigation browsing context flag</a> would prevent them from being
navigated even if they were opened.)

The <span id="sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed auxiliary navigation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [prevents content from creating new auxiliary browsing
contexts](#sandboxWindowOpen), e.g. using the
[`target`](#attr-hyperlink-target) attribute or the
[`window.open()`](#dom-open) method.

The <span id="sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [prevents content from navigating their top-level browsing
context](#sandboxLinks) and [prevents content from closing their
top-level browsing context](#sandboxClose). It is consulted only when
the sandboxed browsing context's
<a href="#active-window" id="sandboxing:active-window">active window</a>
does not have <a href="#transient-activation"
id="sandboxing:transient-activation">transient activation</a>.

When the <a
href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag-2">sandboxed
top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</a>
is *not* set, content can navigate its
<a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:top-level-browsing-context-3">top-level browsing
context</a>, but other
<a href="#browsing-context" id="sandboxing:browsing-context-3">browsing
contexts</a> are still protected by the
<a href="#sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag-2">sandboxed
navigation browsing context flag</a> and possibly the
<a href="#sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag-3">sandboxed
auxiliary navigation browsing context flag</a>.

The <span id="sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [prevents content from navigating their top-level browsing
context](#sandboxLinks) and [prevents content from closing their
top-level browsing context](#sandboxClose). It is consulted only when
the sandboxed browsing context's
<a href="#active-window" id="sandboxing:active-window-2">active
window</a> has <a href="#transient-activation"
id="sandboxing:transient-activation-2">transient activation</a>.

As with the <a
href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag-3">sandboxed
top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</a>,
this flag only affects the <a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:top-level-browsing-context-4">top-level browsing
context</a>; if it is not set, other
<a href="#browsing-context" id="sandboxing:browsing-context-4">browsing
contexts</a> might still be protected by other flags.

The <span id="sandboxed-origin-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed origin browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [forces content into an opaque origin](#sandboxOrigin), thus
preventing it from accessing other content from the same
<a href="#concept-origin" id="sandboxing:concept-origin">origin</a>.

This flag also [prevents script from reading from or writing to the
`document.cookie` IDL attribute](#sandboxCookies), and blocks access to
[`localStorage`](#dom-localstorage).

The <span id="sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed forms browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [blocks form submission](#sandboxSubmitBlocked).

The <span id="sandboxed-pointer-lock-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed pointer lock browsing context flag</span>  
This flag disables the Pointer Lock API.
[\[POINTERLOCK\]](#refsPOINTERLOCK)

The <span id="sandboxed-scripts-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed scripts browsing context flag</span>  
This flag [blocks script execution](#sandboxScriptBlocked).

The <span id="sandboxed-automatic-features-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed automatic features browsing context flag</span>  
This flag blocks features that trigger automatically, such as
<a href="#attr-media-autoplay"
id="sandboxing:attr-media-autoplay">automatically playing a video</a> or
<a href="#attr-fe-autofocus"
id="sandboxing:attr-fe-autofocus">automatically focusing a form
control</a>.

The <span id="sandboxed-document.domain-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed `document.domain` browsing context flag</span>  
This flag prevents content from using the
[`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) setter.

The <span id="sandbox-propagates-to-auxiliary-browsing-contexts-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandbox propagates to auxiliary browsing contexts flag</span>  
This flag prevents content from escaping the sandbox by ensuring that
any <a href="#auxiliary-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:auxiliary-browsing-context-2">auxiliary browsing
context</a> it creates inherits the content's
<a href="#active-sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:active-sandboxing-flag-set">active sandboxing flag
set</a>.

The <span id="sandboxed-modals-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed modals flag</span>  
This flag prevents content from using any of the following features to
produce modal dialogs:

- [`window.alert()`](#dom-alert)
- [`window.confirm()`](#dom-confirm)
- [`window.print()`](#dom-print)
- [`window.prompt()`](#dom-prompt)
- the [`beforeunload`](#event-beforeunload) event

The <span id="sandboxed-orientation-lock-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed orientation lock browsing context flag</span>  
This flag disables the ability to lock the screen orientation.
[\[SCREENORIENTATION\]](#refsSCREENORIENTATION)

The <span id="sandboxed-presentation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed presentation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag disables the Presentation API.
[\[PRESENTATION\]](#refsPRESENTATION)

The <span id="sandboxed-downloads-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed downloads browsing context flag</span>  
This flag prevents content from initiating or instantiating downloads,
whether through <a href="#downloading-hyperlinks"
id="sandboxing:downloading-hyperlinks">downloading hyperlinks</a> or
through [navigation](#navigation-as-a-download) that gets
<a href="#handle-as-a-download"
id="sandboxing:handle-as-a-download">handled as a download</a>.

The <span id="sandboxed-custom-protocols-navigation-browsing-context-flag" class="dfn" export="">sandboxed custom protocols navigation browsing context flag</span>  
This flag prevents navigations toward non
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
id="sandboxing:fetch-scheme" data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch
schemes</a> from being <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
id="sandboxing:hand-off-to-external-software">handed off to external
software</a>.

<div algorithm="">

When the user agent is to <span id="parse-a-sandboxing-directive"
class="dfn" export="">parse a sandboxing directive</span>, given a
string `input` and a <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set">sandboxing flag set</a> `output`, it
must run the following steps:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace"
    id="sandboxing:split-a-string-on-spaces"
    data-x-internal="split-a-string-on-spaces">Split <var>input</var> on
    ASCII whitespace</a>, to obtain `tokens`.

2.  Let `output` be empty.

3.  Add the following flags to `output`:

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag-3">sandboxed
      navigation browsing context flag</a>.

    - The
      <a href="#sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-auxiliary-navigation-browsing-context-flag-4">sandboxed
      auxiliary navigation browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens`
      contains the <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups"
      class="dfn" dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-popups`</span> keyword.

    - The <a
      href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag-4">sandboxed
      top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</a>,
      unless `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-top-navigation`</span> keyword.

    - The <a
      href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag-2">sandboxed
      top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag</a>,
      unless `tokens` contains either the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation"
      class="dfn" dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`</span>
      keyword or the
      [`allow-top-navigation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)
      keyword.

      This means that if the
      [`allow-top-navigation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)
      is present, the
      [`allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation)
      keyword will have no effect. For this reason, specifying both is a
      document conformance error.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-origin-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-origin-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed origin
      browsing context flag</a>, unless the `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-same-origin`</span> keyword.

      <div class="note">

      The [`allow-same-origin`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-same-origin)
      keyword is intended for two cases.

      First, it can be used to allow content from the same site to be
      sandboxed to disable scripting, while still allowing access to the
      DOM of the sandboxed content.

      Second, it can be used to embed content from a third-party site,
      sandboxed to prevent that site from opening popups, etc, without
      preventing the embedded page from communicating back to its
      originating site, using the database APIs to store data, etc.

      </div>

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed forms
      browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-forms" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-forms`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-pointer-lock-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-pointer-lock-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      pointer lock browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens` contains
      the <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-pointer-lock" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-pointer-lock`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-scripts-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-scripts-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      scripts browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-scripts`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-automatic-features-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-automatic-features-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      automatic features browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens`
      contains the [`allow-scripts`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-scripts)
      keyword (defined above).

      This flag is relaxed by the same keyword as scripts, because when
      scripts are enabled these features are trivially possible anyway,
      and it would be unfortunate to force authors to use script to do
      them when sandboxed rather than allowing them to use the
      declarative features.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-document.domain-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-document.domain-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      <code>document.domain</code> browsing context flag</a>.

    - The
      <a href="#sandbox-propagates-to-auxiliary-browsing-contexts-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandbox-propagates-to-auxiliary-browsing-contexts-flag">sandbox
      propagates to auxiliary browsing contexts flag</a>, unless
      `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"
      class="dfn" dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox`</span>
      keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-modals-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-modals-flag">sandboxed modals flag</a>,
      unless `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-modals" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-modals`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-orientation-lock-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-orientation-lock-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      orientation lock browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens`
      contains the <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-orientation-lock"
      class="dfn" dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-orientation-lock`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-presentation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-presentation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      presentation browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens` contains
      the <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-presentation" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-presentation`</span> keyword.

    - The <a href="#sandboxed-downloads-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-downloads-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      downloads browsing context flag</a>, unless `tokens` contains the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-downloads" class="dfn"
      dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-downloads`</span> keyword.

    - The
      <a href="#sandboxed-custom-protocols-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="sandboxing:sandboxed-custom-protocols-navigation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      custom protocols navigation browsing context flag</a>, unless
      `tokens` contains either the
      <span id="attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols"
      class="dfn" dfn-for="iframe/sandbox"
      dfn-type="attr-value">`allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols`</span>
      keyword, the [`allow-popups`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups)
      keyword, or the
      [`allow-top-navigation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation)
      keyword.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every <a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="sandboxing:top-level-browsing-context-5">top-level browsing
context</a> has a <span id="popup-sandboxing-flag-set" class="dfn">popup
sandboxing flag set</span>, which is a <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set-2">sandboxing flag set</a>. When a
<a href="#browsing-context" id="sandboxing:browsing-context-5">browsing
context</a> is created, its <a href="#popup-sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:popup-sandboxing-flag-set">popup sandboxing flag set</a>
must be empty. It is populated by
<a href="#the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable"
id="sandboxing:the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable">the rules for
choosing a navigable</a> and the
<a href="#obtain-browsing-context-navigation"
id="sandboxing:obtain-browsing-context-navigation">obtain a browsing
context to use for a navigation response</a> algorithm.

Every [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element has an
<span id="iframe-sandboxing-flag-set" class="dfn">`iframe` sandboxing
flag set</span>, which is a <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set-3">sandboxing flag set</a>. Which
flags in an <a href="#iframe-sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:iframe-sandboxing-flag-set"><code>iframe</code>
sandboxing flag set</a> are set at any particular time is determined by
the [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element's
[`sandbox`](#attr-iframe-sandbox) attribute.

Every [`Document`](#document) has an
<span id="active-sandboxing-flag-set" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
export="">active sandboxing flag set</span>, which is a
<a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set-4">sandboxing flag set</a>. When the
[`Document`](#document) is created, its
<a href="#active-sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:active-sandboxing-flag-set-2">active sandboxing flag
set</a> must be empty. It is populated by the
<a href="#navigate" id="sandboxing:navigate">navigation algorithm</a>.

<div algorithm="">

Every <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#csp-list"
id="sandboxing:concept-csp-list" data-x-internal="concept-csp-list">CSP
list</a> `cspList` has <span id="csp-derived-sandboxing-flags"
class="dfn">CSP-derived sandboxing flags</span>, which is a
<a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set-5">sandboxing flag set</a>. It is the
return value of the following algorithm:

1.  Let `directives` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set" id="sandboxing:set"
    data-x-internal="set">ordered set</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="sandboxing:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a>
    policy in `cspList`:

    1.  If `policy`'s
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#policy-disposition"
        id="sandboxing:csp-disposition"
        data-x-internal="csp-disposition">disposition</a> is not
        "`enforce`", then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="sandboxing:continue" data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    2.  If `policy`'s
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#policy-directive-set"
        id="sandboxing:csp-directive-set"
        data-x-internal="csp-directive-set">directive set</a>
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
        id="sandboxing:list-contains"
        data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> a
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#directives"
        id="sandboxing:content-security-policy-directive"
        data-x-internal="content-security-policy-directive">directive</a>
        whose name is
        "<a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#sandbox"
        data-x-internal="sandbox-directive"><code
        id="sandboxing:sandbox-directive">sandbox</code></a>", then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="sandboxing:list-append" data-x-internal="list-append">append</a>
        that directive to `directives`.

3.  If `directives` is empty, then return an empty
    <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
    id="sandboxing:sandboxing-flag-set-6">sandboxing flag set</a>.

4.  Let `directive` be `directives`\[`directives`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="sandboxing:list-size" data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> −
    1\].

5.  Return the result of <a href="#parse-a-sandboxing-directive"
    id="sandboxing:parse-a-sandboxing-directive">parsing the sandboxing
    directive</a> `directive`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.1.7</span> Policy containers<a href="#policy-containers" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="policy-container" class="dfn" export="">policy
container</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="policy-containers:struct" data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>
containing policies that apply to a [`Document`](#document), a
[`WorkerGlobalScope`](#workerglobalscope), or a
[`WorkletGlobalScope`](#workletglobalscope). It has the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="policy-containers:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- A <span id="policy-container-csp-list" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="policy container" export="">CSP list</span>, which is a
  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#csp-list"
  id="policy-containers:concept-csp-list"
  data-x-internal="concept-csp-list">CSP list</a>. It is initially
  empty.

- An <span id="policy-container-embedder-policy" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="policy container" export="">embedder policy</span>, which is
  an <a href="#embedder-policy"
  id="policy-containers:embedder-policy">embedder policy</a>. It is
  initially a new <a href="#embedder-policy"
  id="policy-containers:embedder-policy-2">embedder policy</a>.

- A <span id="policy-container-referrer-policy" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="policy container" export="">referrer policy</span>, which is
  a <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
  id="policy-containers:referrer-policy"
  data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>. It is initially
  the <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#default-referrer-policy"
  id="policy-containers:default-referrer-policy"
  data-x-internal="default-referrer-policy">default referrer policy</a>.

- An <span id="policy-container-integrity-policy" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="policy container" export="">integrity policy</span>, which is
  an <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-policy"
  id="policy-containers:integrity-policy"
  data-x-internal="integrity-policy">integrity policy</a>, initially a
  new <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-policy"
  id="policy-containers:integrity-policy-2"
  data-x-internal="integrity-policy">integrity policy</a>.

- A <span id="policy-container-report-only-integrity-policy" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="policy container" export="">report only integrity
  policy</span>, which is an <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-policy"
  id="policy-containers:integrity-policy-3"
  data-x-internal="integrity-policy">integrity policy</a>, initially a
  new <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-subresource-integrity/#integrity-policy"
  id="policy-containers:integrity-policy-4"
  data-x-internal="integrity-policy">integrity policy</a>.

Move other policies into the policy container.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="clone-a-policy-container" class="dfn" export="">clone a
policy container</span> given a <a href="#policy-container"
id="policy-containers:policy-container">policy container</a>
`policyContainer`:

1.  Let `clone` be a new <a href="#policy-container"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-2">policy container</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="policy-containers:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `policy` in `policyContainer`'s
    <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-csp-list">CSP list</a>,
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="policy-containers:list-append"
    data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> a copy of `policy` into
    `clone`'s <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-csp-list-2">CSP list</a>.

3.  Set `clone`'s <a href="#policy-container-embedder-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-embedder-policy">embedder
    policy</a> to a copy of `policyContainer`'s
    <a href="#policy-container-embedder-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-embedder-policy-2">embedder
    policy</a>.

4.  Set `clone`'s <a href="#policy-container-referrer-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-referrer-policy">referrer
    policy</a> to `policyContainer`'s
    <a href="#policy-container-referrer-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-referrer-policy-2">referrer
    policy</a>.

5.  Set `clone`'s <a href="#policy-container-integrity-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-integrity-policy">integrity
    policy</a> to a copy of `policyContainer`'s
    <a href="#policy-container-integrity-policy"
    id="policy-containers:policy-container-integrity-policy-2">integrity
    policy</a>.

6.  Return `clone`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To determine whether a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="policy-containers:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`
<span id="requires-storing-the-policy-container-in-history"
class="dfn">requires storing the policy container in history</span>:

1.  If `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="policy-containers:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is "`blob`", then
    return false.

2.  If `url` <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#is-local"

    then return true.

</div>
