### <span class="secno">7.2</span> APIs related to navigation and session history<a href="#nav-traversal-apis" class="self-link"></a>

#### <span class="secno">7.2.1</span> Security infrastructure for [`Window`](#window), [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy), and [`Location`](#location) objects<a href="#cross-origin-objects" class="self-link"></a>

Although typically objects cannot be accessed across
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="cross-origin-objects:concept-origin">origins</a>, the web platform
would not be true to itself if it did not have some legacy exceptions to
that rule that the web depends upon.

This section uses the terminology and typographic conventions from the
JavaScript specification. [\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#refsJAVASCRIPT)

##### <span class="secno">7.2.1.1</span> Integration with IDL<a href="#integration-with-idl" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-perform-a-security-check"
id="integration-with-idl:perform-a-security-check"
data-x-internal="perform-a-security-check">perform a security check</a>
is invoked, with a `platformObject`, `identifier`, and `type`, run these
steps:

1.  If `platformObject` is not a [`Window`](#window) or
    [`Location`](#location) object, then return.

2.  For each `e` of <a href="#crossoriginproperties-(-o-)"
    id="integration-with-idl:crossoriginproperties-(-o-)">CrossOriginProperties</a>(`platformObject`):

    1.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-samevalue"
        id="integration-with-idl:samevalue"
        data-x-internal="samevalue">SameValue</a>(`e`.\[\[Property\]\],
        `identifier`) is true, then:

        1.  If `type` is "`method`" and `e` has neither \[\[NeedsGet\]\]
            nor \[\[NeedsSet\]\], then return.

        2.  Otherwise, if `type` is "`getter`" and `e`.\[\[NeedsGet\]\]
            is true, then return.

        3.  Otherwise, if `type` is "`setter`" and `e`.\[\[NeedsSet\]\]
            is true, then return.

3.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="integration-with-idl:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`platformObject`)
    is false, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="integration-with-idl:securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="integration-with-idl:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.1.2</span> Shared internal slot: \[\[CrossOriginPropertyDescriptorMap\]\]<a href="#shared-internal-slot:-crossoriginpropertydescriptormap"
class="self-link"></a>

[`Window`](#window) and [`Location`](#location) objects both have a
<span id="crossoriginpropertydescriptormap"
class="dfn">\[\[CrossOriginPropertyDescriptorMap\]\]</span> internal
slot, whose value is initially an empty map.

<div algorithm="">

The <a href="#crossoriginpropertydescriptormap"
id="shared-internal-slot:-crossoriginpropertydescriptormap:crossoriginpropertydescriptormap">[[CrossOriginPropertyDescriptorMap]]</a>
internal slot contains a map with entries whose keys are
(`currentGlobal`, `objectGlobal`, `propertyKey`)-tuples and values are
property descriptors, as a memoization of what is visible to scripts
when `currentGlobal` inspects a [`Window`](#window) or
[`Location`](#location) object from `objectGlobal`. It is filled lazily
by <a href="#crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-)"
id="shared-internal-slot:-crossoriginpropertydescriptormap:crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-)">CrossOriginGetOwnPropertyHelper</a>,
which consults it on future lookups.

</div>

User agents should allow a value held in the map to be garbage collected
along with its corresponding key when nothing holds a reference to any
part of the value. That is, as long as garbage collection is not
observable.

For example, with
`const href = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(crossOriginLocation, "href").set`
the value and its corresponding key in the map cannot be garbage
collected as that would be observable.

User agents may have an optimization whereby they remove key-value pairs
from the map when [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) is set. This
is not observable as [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) cannot
revisit an earlier value.

For example, setting [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) to
"`example.com`" on www.example.com means user agents can remove all
key-value pairs from the map where part of the key is www.example.com,
as that can never be part of the <a href="#concept-origin"
id="shared-internal-slot:-crossoriginpropertydescriptormap:concept-origin">origin</a>
again and therefore the corresponding value could never be retrieved
from the map.

##### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3</span> Shared abstract operations<a href="#shared-abstract-operations" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.1</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginProperties</span> ( `O` )<a href="#crossoriginproperties-(-o-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="crossoriginproperties-(-o-):assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `O` is a
    [`Location`](#location) or [`Window`](#window) object.

2.  If `O` is a [`Location`](#location) object, then return « {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`href`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: false,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: true }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`replace`" } ».

3.  Return « { \[\[Property\]\]: "`window`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`self`",
    \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true, \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`location`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: true }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`close`" }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`closed`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`focus`" }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`blur`" }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`frames`",
    \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true, \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`length`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`top`",
    \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true, \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`opener`", \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true,
    \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, { \[\[Property\]\]: "`parent`",
    \[\[NeedsGet\]\]: true, \[\[NeedsSet\]\]: false }, {
    \[\[Property\]\]: "`postMessage`" } ».

</div>

This abstract operation does not return a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
id="crossoriginproperties-(-o-):completion-record"
data-x-internal="completion-record">Completion Record</a>.

Indexed properties do not need to be safelisted in this algorithm, as
they are handled directly by the [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object.

<div algorithm="">

A JavaScript property name `P` is a
<span id="cross-origin-accessible-window-property-name"
class="dfn">cross-origin accessible window property name</span> if it is
"`window`", "`self`", "`location`", "`close`", "`closed`", "`focus`",
"`blur`", "`frames`", "`length`", "`top`", "`opener`", "`parent`",
"`postMessage`", or an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
id="crossoriginproperties-(-o-):array-index-property-name"
data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
name</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.2</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginPropertyFallback</span> ( `P` )<a href="#crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  If `P` is "`then`", <a href="#symbol.tostringtag"
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):symbol.tostringtag">%Symbol.toStringTag%</a>,
    <a href="#symbol.hasinstance"
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):symbol.hasinstance">%Symbol.hasInstance%</a>,
    or <a href="#symbol.isconcatspreadable"
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):symbol.isconcatspreadable">%Symbol.isConcatSpreadable%</a>,
    then return <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):propertydescriptor"
    data-x-internal="propertydescriptor">PropertyDescriptor</a> {
    \[\[Value\]\]: undefined, \[\[Writable\]\]: false,
    \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

2.  Throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-):domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.3</span> <span class="dfn">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</span> ( `O` )<a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Return true if the <a href="#current-settings-object"
    id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):current-settings-object">current
    settings object</a>'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
    id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):concept-settings-object-origin">origin</a>
    is <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):same-origin-domain">same
    origin-domain</a> with `O`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
    id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):concept-settings-object-origin-2">origin</a>,
    and false otherwise.

</div>

This abstract operation does not return a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):completion-record"
data-x-internal="completion-record">Completion Record</a>.

Here the <a href="#current-settings-object"
id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):current-settings-object-2">current
settings object</a> roughly corresponds to the "caller", because this
check occurs before the
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-execution-contexts"
id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):javascript-execution-context"
data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context">execution context</a> for
the getter/setter/method in question makes its way onto the
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack"
id="isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-):javascript-execution-context-stack"
data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context-stack">JavaScript
execution context stack</a>. For example, in the code `w.document`, this
step is invoked before the [`document`](#dom-document-2) getter is
reached as part of the [\[\[Get\]\]](#windowproxy-get) algorithm for the
[`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) `w`.

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.4</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginGetOwnPropertyHelper</span> ( `O`, `P` )<a href="#crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-)"
class="self-link"></a>

If this abstract operation returns undefined and there is no custom
behavior, the caller needs to throw a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):securityerror"
data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):domexception">DOMException</code></a>.
In practice this is handled by the caller calling
<a href="#crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-)"
id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-)">CrossOriginPropertyFallback</a>.

1.  Let `crossOriginKey` be a tuple consisting of the
    <a href="#current-settings-object"
    id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):current-settings-object">current
    settings object</a>, `O`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>, and `P`.

2.  For each `e` of <a href="#crossoriginproperties-(-o-)"
    id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):crossoriginproperties-(-o-)">CrossOriginProperties</a>(`O`):

    1.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-samevalue"
        id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):samevalue"
        data-x-internal="samevalue">SameValue</a>(`e`.\[\[Property\]\],
        `P`) is true, then:

        1.  If the value of the
            <a href="#crossoriginpropertydescriptormap"
            id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):crossoriginpropertydescriptormap">[[CrossOriginPropertyDescriptorMap]]</a>
            internal slot of `O` contains an entry whose key is
            `crossOriginKey`, then return that entry's value.

        2.  Let `originalDesc` be
            <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarygetownproperty"
            id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):ordinarygetownproperty"
            data-x-internal="ordinarygetownproperty">OrdinaryGetOwnProperty</a>(`O`,
            `P`).

        3.  Let `crossOriginDesc` be undefined.

        4.  If `e`.\[\[NeedsGet\]\] and `e`.\[\[NeedsSet\]\] are absent,
            then:

            1.  Let `value` be `originalDesc`.\[\[Value\]\].

            2.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-iscallable"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):iscallable"
                data-x-internal="iscallable">IsCallable</a>(`value`) is
                true, then set `value` to an anonymous built-in
                function, created in the
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):current-realm"
                data-x-internal="current-realm">current realm</a>, that
                performs the same steps as the IDL operation `P` on
                object `O`.

            3.  Set `crossOriginDesc` to <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):propertydescriptor"
                data-x-internal="propertydescriptor">PropertyDescriptor</a>
                { \[\[Value\]\]: `value`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false,
                \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

        5.  Otherwise:

            1.  Let `crossOriginGet` be undefined.

            2.  If `e`.\[\[NeedsGet\]\] is true, then set
                `crossOriginGet` to an anonymous built-in function,
                created in the
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):current-realm-2"
                data-x-internal="current-realm">current realm</a>, that
                performs the same steps as the getter of the IDL
                attribute `P` on object `O`.

            3.  Let `crossOriginSet` be undefined.

            4.  If `e`.\[\[NeedsSet\]\] is true, then set
                `crossOriginSet` to an anonymous built-in function,
                created in the
                <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#current-realm"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):current-realm-3"
                data-x-internal="current-realm">current realm</a>, that
                performs the same steps as the setter of the IDL
                attribute `P` on object `O`.

            5.  Set `crossOriginDesc` to <a
                href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
                id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):propertydescriptor-2"
                data-x-internal="propertydescriptor">PropertyDescriptor</a>
                { \[\[Get\]\]: `crossOriginGet`, \[\[Set\]\]:
                `crossOriginSet`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false,
                \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

        6.  Create an entry in the value of the
            <a href="#crossoriginpropertydescriptormap"
            id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):crossoriginpropertydescriptormap-2">[[CrossOriginPropertyDescriptorMap]]</a>
            internal slot of `O` with key `crossOriginKey` and value
            `crossOriginDesc`.

        7.  Return `crossOriginDesc`.

3.  Return undefined.

</div>

This abstract operation does not return a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):completion-record"
data-x-internal="completion-record">Completion Record</a>.

The reason that the property descriptors produced here are configurable
is to preserve the <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
id="crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-):invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
data-x-internal="invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods">invariants
of the essential internal methods</a> required by the JavaScript
specification. In particular, since the value of the property can change
as a consequence of navigation, it is required that the property be
configurable. (However, see [tc39/ecma262 issue
\#672](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/issues/672) and references to it
elsewhere in this specification for cases where we are not able to
preserve these invariants, for compatibility with existing web content.)
[\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#refsJAVASCRIPT)

The reason the property descriptors are non-enumerable, despite this
mismatching the same-origin behavior, is for compatibility with existing
web content. See [issue
\#3183](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3183) for details.

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.5</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginGet</span> ( `O`, `P`, `Receiver` )<a href="#crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `desc` be ? `O`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](`P`).

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `desc` is not undefined.

3.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isdatadescriptor"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):isdatadescriptor"
    data-x-internal="isdatadescriptor">IsDataDescriptor</a>(`desc`) is
    true, then return `desc`.\[\[Value\]\].

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isaccessordescriptor"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):isaccessordescriptor"
    data-x-internal="isaccessordescriptor">IsAccessorDescriptor</a>(`desc`)
    is true.

5.  Let `getter` be `desc`.\[\[Get\]\].

6.  If `getter` is undefined, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

7.  Return ? <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-call"
    id="crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-):call"
    data-x-internal="call">Call</a>(`getter`, `Receiver`).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.6</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginSet</span> ( `O`, `P`, `V`, `Receiver` )<a href="#crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `desc` be ? `O`.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](`P`).

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-):assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `desc` is not undefined.

3.  If `desc`.\[\[Set\]\] is present and its value is not undefined,
    then:

    1.  Perform ? <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-call"
        id="crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-):call"
        data-x-internal="call">Call</a>(`desc`.\[\[Set\]\], `Receiver`,
        « `V` »).

    2.  Return true.

4.  Throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-):securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-):domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

###### <span class="secno">7.2.1.3.7</span> <span class="dfn">CrossOriginOwnPropertyKeys</span> ( `O` )<a href="#crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-)" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `keys` be a new empty <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-list-and-record-specification-type"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):js-list"
    data-x-internal="js-list">List</a>.

2.  For each `e` of <a href="#crossoriginproperties-(-o-)"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):crossoriginproperties-(-o-)">CrossOriginProperties</a>(`O`),
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):list-append"
    data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `e`.\[\[Property\]\] to
    `keys`.

3.  Return the concatenation of `keys` and « "`then`",
    <a href="#symbol.tostringtag"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):symbol.tostringtag">%Symbol.toStringTag%</a>,
    <a href="#symbol.hasinstance"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):symbol.hasinstance">%Symbol.hasInstance%</a>,
    <a href="#symbol.isconcatspreadable"
    id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):symbol.isconcatspreadable">%Symbol.isConcatSpreadable%</a>
    ».

</div>

This abstract operation does not return a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-completion-record-specification-type"
id="crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-):completion-record"
data-x-internal="completion-record">Completion Record</a>.

``` idl
[Global=Window,
 Exposed=Window,
 LegacyUnenumerableNamedProperties]
interface Window : EventTarget {
  // the current browsing context
  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute WindowProxy window;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute WindowProxy self;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute Document document;
  attribute DOMString name; 
  [PutForwards=href, LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute Location location;
  readonly attribute History history;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute Navigation navigation;
  readonly attribute CustomElementRegistry customElements;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp locationbar;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp menubar;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp personalbar;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp scrollbars;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp statusbar;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute BarProp toolbar;
  attribute DOMString status;
  undefined close();
  readonly attribute boolean closed;
  undefined stop();
  undefined focus();
  undefined blur();

  // other browsing contexts
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute WindowProxy frames;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute WindowProxy? top;
  attribute any opener;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute WindowProxy? parent;
  readonly attribute Element? frameElement;
  WindowProxy? open(optional USVString url = "", optional DOMString target = "_blank", optional [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString features = "");

  // Since this is the global object, the IDL named getter adds a NamedPropertiesObject exotic
  // object on the prototype chain. Indeed, this does not make the global object an exotic object.
  // Indexed access is taken care of by the WindowProxy exotic object.
  getter object (DOMString name);

  // the user agent
  readonly attribute Navigator navigator;
  [Replaceable] readonly attribute Navigator clientInformation; // legacy alias of .navigator
  readonly attribute boolean originAgentCluster;

  // user prompts
  undefined alert();
  undefined alert(DOMString message);
  boolean confirm(optional DOMString message = "");
  DOMString? prompt(optional DOMString message = "", optional DOMString default = "");
  undefined print();

  undefined postMessage(any message, USVString targetOrigin, optional sequence<object> transfer = []);
  undefined postMessage(any message, optional WindowPostMessageOptions options = {});

  // also has obsolete members
};
Window includes GlobalEventHandlers;
Window includes WindowEventHandlers;

dictionary WindowPostMessageOptions : StructuredSerializeOptions {
  USVString targetOrigin = "/";
};
```

It can be used with dot notation on a window object (that is, window.self) or standalone (self). The advantage of the standalone notation is that a similar notation exists for non-window contexts, such as in Web Workers. By using self, you can refer to the global scope in a way that will work not only in a window context (self will resolve to window.self) but also in a worker context (self will then resolve to WorkerGlobalScope.self).")

<code>about:blank</code></a> page is reused and gets a new

class="self-link"></a>

Opens a window to show `url` (defaults to
"[`about:blank`](#about:blank)"), and returns it. `target` (defaults to
"`_blank`") gives the name of the new window. If a window already exists
with that name, it is reused. The `features` argument can contain a
<a href="#set-of-comma-separated-tokens"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:set-of-comma-separated-tokens">set
of comma-separated tokens</a>:

"`noopener`"  
"`noreferrer`"  
These behave equivalently to the [`noopener`](#link-type-noopener) and
[`noreferrer`](#link-type-noreferrer) link types on <a href="#hyperlink"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:hyperlink">hyperlinks</a>.

"`popup`"  
Encourages user agents to provide a minimal web browser user interface
for the new window. (Impacts the [`visible`](#dom-barprop-visible)
getter on all [`BarProp`](#barprop) objects as well.)

``` example
globalThis.open("https://email.example/message/CAOOOkFcWW97r8yg=SsWg7GgCmp4suVX9o85y8BvNRqMjuc5PXg", undefined, "noopener,popup");
```

Cancels the document load.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="get-noopener-for-window-open" class="dfn">get noopener for
window open</span>, given a [`Document`](#document) `sourceDocument`, an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:ordered-map"
data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered map</a> `tokenizedFeatures`, and a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:url-record"
data-x-internal="url-record">URL record</a>-or-null `url`, perform the
following steps. They return a boolean.

1.  If `url` is not null and `url`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-blob-entry"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-url-blob-entry"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-blob-entry">blob URL entry</a> is not
    null:

    1.  Let `blobOrigin` be `url`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-blob-entry"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-url-blob-entry-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-blob-entry">blob URL entry</a>'s
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#blob-url-entry-environment"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:blob-url-entry-environment"
        data-x-internal="blob-url-entry-environment">environment</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-settings-object-origin">origin</a>.

    2.  Let `topLevelOrigin` be `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:relevant-settings-object">relevant
        settings object</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-origin"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-environment-top-level-origin">top-level
        origin</a>.

    3.  If `blobOrigin` is not <a href="#same-site"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:same-site">same
        site</a> with `topLevelOrigin`, then return true.

2.  Let `noopener` be false.

3.  If `tokenizedFeatures`\["`noopener`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `noopener` to the
    result of <a href="#concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean">parsing
    <var>tokenizedFeatures</var>["<code>noopener</code>"] as a boolean
    feature</a>.

4.  Return `noopener`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="window-open-steps" class="dfn">window open steps</span>,
given a string `url`, a string `target`, and a string `features`, are as
follows:

1.  If the <a href="#event-loop"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:event-loop">event
    loop</a>'s <a href="#termination-nesting-level"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:termination-nesting-level">termination
    nesting level</a> is nonzero, then return null.

2.  Let `sourceDocument` be the <a href="#entry-global-object"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:entry-global-object">entry
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

3.  Let `urlRecord` be null.

4.  If `url` is not the empty string, then:

    1.  Set `urlRecord` to the result of
        <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing
        a URL</a> given `url`, relative to `sourceDocument`.

    2.  If `urlRecord` is failure, then throw a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:syntaxerror"
        data-x-internal="syntaxerror">"<code>SyntaxError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

5.  If `target` is the empty string, then set `target` to "`_blank`".

6.  Let `tokenizedFeatures` be the result of
    <a href="#concept-window-open-features-tokenize"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-window-open-features-tokenize">tokenizing</a>
    `features`.

7.  Let `noreferrer` be false.

8.  If `tokenizedFeatures`\["`noreferrer`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `noreferrer` to
    the result of <a href="#concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean-2">parsing
    <var>tokenizedFeatures</var>["<code>noreferrer</code>"] as a boolean
    feature</a>.

9.  Let `noopener` be the result of
    <a href="#get-noopener-for-window-open"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:get-noopener-for-window-open">getting
    noopener for window open</a> with `sourceDocument`,
    `tokenizedFeatures`, and `urlRecord`.

10. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-remove"
    data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a>
    `tokenizedFeatures`\["`noopener`"\] and
    `tokenizedFeatures`\["`noreferrer`"\].

11. Let `referrerPolicy` be the empty string.

12. If `noreferrer` is true, then set `noopener` to true and set
    `referrerPolicy` to "`no-referrer`".

13. Let `targetNavigable` and `windowType` be the result of applying
    <a href="#the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable">the
    rules for choosing a navigable</a> given `target`,
    `sourceDocument`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>, and `noopener`.

    If there is a user agent that supports control-clicking a link to
    open it in a new tab, and the user control-clicks on an element
    whose [`onclick`](#handler-onclick) handler uses the
    [`window.open()`](#dom-open) API to open a page in an
    [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element, the user agent could
    override the selection of the target browsing context to instead
    target a new tab.

14. If `targetNavigable` is null, then return null.

15. If `windowType` is either "`new and unrestricted`" or
    "`new with no opener`", then:

    1.  Set `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-bc"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-bc">active
        browsing context</a>'s <a href="#is-popup"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:is-popup">is
        popup</a> to the result of <a href="#popup-window-is-requested"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:popup-window-is-requested">checking
        if a popup window is requested</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`.

    2.  <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#set-up-browsing-context-features"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:set-up-browsing-context-features"
        data-x-internal="set-up-browsing-context-features">Set up browsing
        context features</a> for `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-bc"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-bc-2">active
        browsing context</a> given `tokenizedFeatures`.
        [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#refsCSSOMVIEW)

    3.  If `urlRecord` is null, then set `urlRecord` to a
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:url-record-2"
        data-x-internal="url-record">URL record</a> representing
        [`about:blank`](#about:blank).

    4.  If `urlRecord` <a href="#matches-about:blank"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:matches-about:blank">matches
        <code>about:blank</code></a>, then perform the
        <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:url-and-history-update-steps">URL
        and history update steps</a> given `targetNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-document">active
        document</a> and `urlRecord`.

        This is necessary in case `url` is something like
        `about:blank?foo`. If `url` is just plain `about:blank`, this
        will do nothing.

    5.  Otherwise, <a href="#navigate"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:navigate">navigate</a>
        `targetNavigable` to `urlRecord` using `sourceDocument`, with
        *[referrerPolicy](#navigation-referrer-policy)* set to
        `referrerPolicy` and *<a href="#exceptions-enabled"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:exceptions-enabled">exceptionsEnabled</a>*
        set to true.

16. Otherwise:

    1.  If `urlRecord` is not null, then <a href="#navigate"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:navigate-2">navigate</a>
        `targetNavigable` to `urlRecord` using `sourceDocument`, with
        *[referrerPolicy](#navigation-referrer-policy)* set to
        `referrerPolicy` and *<a href="#exceptions-enabled"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:exceptions-enabled-2">exceptionsEnabled</a>*
        set to true.

    2.  If `noopener` is false, then set `targetNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-bc"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-bc-3">active
        browsing context</a>'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:opener-browsing-context">opener
        browsing context</a> to `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="#concept-document-bc"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-document-bc">browsing
        context</a>.

17. If `noopener` is true or `windowType` is "`new with no opener`",
    then return null.

18. Return `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-wp"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-wp">active
    <code>WindowProxy</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-open" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="method">`open(``url``, ``target``, ``features``)`</span>
method steps are to run the <a href="#window-open-steps"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-open-steps">window
open steps</a> with `url`, `target`, and `features`.

</div>

The method provides a mechanism for <a href="#navigate"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:navigate-3">navigating</a>
an existing <a href="#browsing-context"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:browsing-context">browsing
context</a> or opening and navigating an
<a href="#auxiliary-browsing-context"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:auxiliary-browsing-context">auxiliary
browsing context</a>.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-window-open-features-tokenize" class="dfn">tokenize
the `features` argument</span>:

1.  Let `tokenizedFeatures` be a new
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:ordered-map-2"
    data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered map</a>.

2.  Let `position` point at the first code point of `features`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:while"
    data-x-internal="while">While</a> `position` is not past the end of
    `features`:

    1.  Let `name` be the empty string.

    2.  Let `value` be the empty string.

    3.  <a
        href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:collect-a-sequence-of-code-points"
        data-x-internal="collect-a-sequence-of-code-points">Collect a sequence
        of code points</a> that are <a href="#feature-separator"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator">feature
        separators</a> from `features` given `position`. This skips past
        leading separators before the name.

    4.  <a
        href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:collect-a-sequence-of-code-points-2"
        data-x-internal="collect-a-sequence-of-code-points">Collect a sequence
        of code points</a> that are not <a href="#feature-separator"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator-2">feature
        separators</a> from `features` given `position`. Set `name` to
        the collected characters,
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:converted-to-ascii-lowercase"
        data-x-internal="converted-to-ascii-lowercase">converted to ASCII
        lowercase</a>.

    5.  Set `name` to the result of
        <a href="#normalizing-the-feature-name"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:normalizing-the-feature-name">normalizing
        the feature name</a> `name`.

    6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:while-2"
        data-x-internal="while">While</a> `position` is not past the end
        of `features` and the code point at `position` in `features` is
        not U+003D (=):

        1.  If the code point at `position` in `features` is U+002C (,),
            or if it is not a <a href="#feature-separator"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator-3">feature
            separator</a>, then
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:break"
            data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

        2.  Advance `position` by 1.

        This skips to the first U+003D (=) but does not skip past a
        U+002C (,) or a non-separator.

    7.  If the code point at `position` in `features` is a
        <a href="#feature-separator"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator-4">feature
        separator</a>:

        1.  While `position` is not past the end of `features` and the
            code point at `position` in `features` is a
            <a href="#feature-separator"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator-5">feature
            separator</a>:

            1.  If the code point at `position` in `features` is U+002C
                (,), then
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
                id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:break-2"
                data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

            2.  Advance `position` by 1.

            This skips to the first non-separator but does not skip past
            a U+002C (,).

        2.  <a
            href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#collect-a-sequence-of-code-points"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:collect-a-sequence-of-code-points-3"
            data-x-internal="collect-a-sequence-of-code-points">Collect a sequence
            of code points</a> that are not <a href="#feature-separator"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:feature-separator-6">feature
            separators</a> code points from `features` given `position`.
            Set `value` to the collected code points,
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase"
            id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:converted-to-ascii-lowercase-2"
            data-x-internal="converted-to-ascii-lowercase">converted to ASCII
            lowercase</a>.

    8.  If `name` is not the empty string, then set
        `tokenizedFeatures`\[`name`\] to `value`.

4.  Return `tokenizedFeatures`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="window-feature-is-set" class="dfn">check if a window
feature is set</span>, given `tokenizedFeatures`, `featureName`, and
`defaultValue`:

1.  If `tokenizedFeatures`\[`featureName`\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then return the result of
    <a href="#concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean-3">parsing
    <var>tokenizedFeatures</var>[<var>featureName</var>] as a boolean
    feature</a>.

2.  Return `defaultValue`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="popup-window-is-requested" class="dfn">check if a popup
window is requested</span>, given `tokenizedFeatures`:

1.  If `tokenizedFeatures` is
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-is-empty"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-empty"
    data-x-internal="map-empty">empty</a>, then return false.

2.  If `tokenizedFeatures`\["`popup`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:map-exists-4"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then return the result of
    <a href="#concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean-4">parsing
    <var>tokenizedFeatures</var>["<code>popup</code>"] as a boolean
    feature</a>.

3.  Let `location` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`location`", and false.

4.  Let `toolbar` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set-2">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`toolbar`", and false.

5.  If `location` and `toolbar` are both false, then return true.

6.  Let `menubar` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set-3">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`menubar`", and false.

7.  If `menubar` is false, then return true.

8.  Let `resizable` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set-4">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`resizable`", and true.

9.  If `resizable` is false, then return true.

10. Let `scrollbars` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set-5">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`scrollbars`", and false.

11. If `scrollbars` is false, then return true.

12. Let `status` be the result of <a href="#window-feature-is-set"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-feature-is-set-6">checking
    if a window feature is set</a>, given `tokenizedFeatures`,
    "`status`", and false.

13. If `status` is false, then return true.

14. Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A code point is a <span id="feature-separator" class="dfn">feature
separator</span> if it is
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:space-characters"
data-x-internal="space-characters">ASCII whitespace</a>, U+003D (=), or
U+002C (,).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

For legacy reasons, there are some aliases of some feature names. To
<span id="normalizing-the-feature-name" class="dfn">normalize a feature
name</span> `name`, switch on `name`:

"`screenx`"  
Return "`left`".

"`screeny`"  
Return "`top`".

"`innerwidth`"  
Return "`width`".

"`innerheight`"  
Return "`height`".

Anything else  
Return `name`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-window-open-features-parse-boolean"
class="dfn">parse a boolean feature</span> given a string `value`:

1.  If `value` is the empty string, then return true.

2.  If `value` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:is"
    data-x-internal="is">is</a> "`yes`", then return true.

3.  If `value` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:is-2"
    data-x-internal="is">is</a> "`true`", then return true.

4.  Let `parsed` be the result of <a href="#rules-for-parsing-integers"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:rules-for-parsing-integers">parsing
    <var>value</var> as an integer</a>.

5.  If `parsed` is an error, then set it to 0.

6.  Return false if `parsed` is 0, and true otherwise.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-name" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`name`</span> getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:this"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable">navigable</a>
    is null, then return the empty string.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-target"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-target">target
    name</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`name`](#dom-name) setter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable-3">navigable</a>
    is null, then return.

2.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable-4">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-active-history-entry">active
    session history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:she-document-state">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
    target name</a> to the given value.

</div>

The name [gets reset](#resetBCName) when the navigable is
<a href="#navigate"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:navigate-4">navigated</a>
to another <a href="#concept-origin"
id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-origin">origin</a>.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-close" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="method">`close()`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `thisTraversable` be
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:this-5"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable-5">navigable</a>.

2.  If `thisTraversable` is not a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:top-level-traversable">top-level
    traversable</a>, then return.

3.  If `thisTraversable`'s <a href="#is-closing"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:is-closing">is
    closing</a> is true, then return.

4.  Let `browsingContext` be `thisTraversable`'s <a href="#nav-bc"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-bc-4">active
    browsing context</a>.

5.  Let `sourceSnapshotParams` be the result of
    <a href="#snapshotting-source-snapshot-params"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:snapshotting-source-snapshot-params">snapshotting
    source snapshot params</a> given `thisTraversable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document"
    id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:nav-document-2">active
    document</a>.

6.  If all the following are true:

    - `thisTraversable` is <a href="#script-closable"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:script-closable">script-closable</a>;

    - the <a href="#concept-incumbent-global"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-incumbent-global">incumbent
      global object</a>'s <a href="#window-bc"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-bc">browsing
      context</a> is <a href="#familiar-with"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:familiar-with">familiar
      with</a> `browsingContext`; and

    - <div id="sandboxClose">

      the <a href="#concept-incumbent-global"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:concept-incumbent-global-2">incumbent
      global object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:window-navigable-6">navigable</a>
      is <a href="#allowed-to-navigate"
      id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:allowed-to-navigate">allowed
      by sandboxing to navigate</a> `thisTraversable`, given
      `sourceSnapshotParams`,

      </div>

    then:

    1.  Set `thisTraversable`'s <a href="#is-closing"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:is-closing-2">is
        closing</a> to true.

    2.  <a href="#queue-a-task"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:queue-a-task">Queue
        a task</a> on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM
        manipulation task source</a> to
        <a href="#definitely-close-a-top-level-traversable"
        id="apis-for-creating-and-navigating-browsing-contexts-by-name:definitely-close-a-top-level-traversable">definitely
        close</a> `thisTraversable`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable"

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-length" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`length`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="accessing-other-browsing-contexts:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
id="accessing-other-browsing-contexts:concept-document-window">associated
<code>Document</code></a>'s <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
id="accessing-other-browsing-contexts:document-tree-child-navigables-3">document-tree
child navigables</a>'s
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
id="accessing-other-browsing-contexts:list-size"
data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>.

</div>

Indexed access to <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
id="accessing-other-browsing-contexts:document-tree-child-navigables-4">document-tree
child navigables</a> is defined through the
[\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#windowproxy-getownproperty) internal method of
the [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object.

##### <span class="secno">7.2.2.3</span> Named access on the [`Window`](#window) object<a href="#named-access-on-the-window-object" class="self-link"></a>

`window``[``name``]`  
Returns the indicated element or collection of elements.

As a general rule, relying on this will lead to brittle code. Which IDs
end up mapping to this API can vary over time, as new features are added
to the web platform, for example. Instead of this, use
`document.getElementById()` or `document.querySelector()`.

<div algorithm="">

<span id="document-tree-child-browsing-context-name-property-set"></span>The
<span id="document-tree-child-navigable-target-name-property-set"
class="dfn">document-tree child navigable target name property
set</span> of a [`Window`](#window) object `window` is the return value
of running these steps:

1.  Let `children` be the <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:document-tree-child-navigables">document-tree
    child navigables</a> of `window`'s
    <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  Let `firstNamedChildren` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:set" data-x-internal="set">ordered
    set</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `children`:

    1.  Let `name` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-target"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-target">target name</a>.

    2.  If `name` is the empty string, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    3.  If `firstNamedChildren`
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:list-contains"
        data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> a
        <a href="#navigable"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:navigable">navigable</a>
        whose <a href="#nav-target"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-target-2">target name</a>
        is `name`, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:continue-2"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `navigable` to
        `firstNamedChildren`.

4.  Let `names` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:set-2"
    data-x-internal="set">ordered set</a>.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `firstNamedChildren`:

    1.  Let `name` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-target"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-target-3">target name</a>.

    2.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-document">active document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-origin"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
        <a href="#same-origin"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:same-origin">same origin</a>
        with `window`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:relevant-settings-object">relevant
        settings object</a>'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-settings-object-origin">origin</a>,
        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `name` to `names`.

6.  Return `names`.

</div>

<div class="example">

The two seperate iterations mean that in the following example, hosted
on `https://example.org/`, assuming `https://elsewhere.example/` sets
[`window.name`](#dom-name) to "`spices`", evaluating `window.spices`
after everything has loaded will yield undefined:

``` html
<iframe src=https://elsewhere.example.com/></iframe>
<iframe name=spices></iframe>
```

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`Window`](#window) object
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-support-named-properties"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:support-named-properties"
data-x-internal="support-named-properties">supports named properties</a>.
The
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:supported-property-names"
data-x-internal="supported-property-names">supported property names</a>
of a [`Window`](#window) object `window` at any moment consist of the
following, in <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:tree-order"
data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a> according to the element
that contributed them, ignoring later duplicates:

- `window`'s
  <a href="#document-tree-child-navigable-target-name-property-set"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:document-tree-child-navigable-target-name-property-set">document-tree
  child navigable target name property set</a>;

- the value of the `name` content attribute for all
  [`embed`](#the-embed-element), [`form`](#the-form-element),
  [`img`](#the-img-element), and [`object`](#the-object-element)
  elements that have a non-empty `name` content attribute and are
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:in-a-document-tree"
  data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in a document tree</a> with
  `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-2">associated
  <code>Document</code></a> as their
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:root"
  data-x-internal="root">root</a>; and

- the value of the [`id`](#the-id-attribute) content attribute for all
  <a href="#html-elements"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:html-elements">HTML elements</a>
  that have a non-empty [`id`](#the-id-attribute) content attribute and
  are <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:in-a-document-tree-2"
  data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in a document tree</a> with
  `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-3">associated
  <code>Document</code></a> as their
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:root-2"
  data-x-internal="root">root</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <a
href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:determine-the-value-of-a-named-property"
data-x-internal="determine-the-value-of-a-named-property">determine the
value of a named property</a> `name` in a [`Window`](#window) object
`window`, the user agent must return the value obtained using the
following steps:

1.  Let `objects` be the list of <a href="#dom-window-nameditem-filter"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:dom-window-nameditem-filter">named
    objects</a> of `window` with the name `name`.

    There will be at least one such object, since the algorithm would
    otherwise not have been <a
    href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#named-properties-object-getownproperty"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:named-properties-object-getownproperty"
    data-x-internal="named-properties-object-getownproperty">invoked by Web
    IDL</a>.

2.  If `objects` contains a <a href="#navigable"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:navigable-2">navigable</a>,
    then:

    1.  Let `container` be the first <a href="#navigable-container"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:navigable-container">navigable
        container</a> in `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-4">associated
        <code>Document</code></a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:descendant"
        data-x-internal="descendant">descendants</a> whose
        <a href="#content-navigable"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:content-navigable">content
        navigable</a> is in `objects`.

    2.  Return `container`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
        id="named-access-on-the-window-object:content-navigable-2">content
        navigable</a>'s
        <a href="#nav-wp" id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-wp">active
        <code>WindowProxy</code></a>.

3.  Otherwise, if `objects` has only one element, return that element.

4.  Otherwise, return an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection"
    data-x-internal="htmlcollection"><code
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:htmlcollection">HTMLCollection</code></a>
    rooted at `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-5">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>, whose filter matches only
    <a href="#dom-window-nameditem-filter"
    id="named-access-on-the-window-object:dom-window-nameditem-filter-2">named
    objects</a> of `window` with the name `name`. (By definition, these
    will all be elements.)

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<span id="dom-window-nameditem-filter" class="dfn">Named objects</span>
of [`Window`](#window) object `window` with the name `name`, for the
purposes of the above algorithm, consist of the following:

- <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:document-tree-child-navigables-2">document-tree
  child navigables</a> of `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-6">associated
  <code>Document</code></a> whose <a href="#nav-target"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:nav-target-4">target name</a> is
  `name`;

- [`embed`](#the-embed-element), [`form`](#the-form-element),
  [`img`](#the-img-element), or [`object`](#the-object-element) elements
  that have a `name` content attribute whose value is `name` and are
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:in-a-document-tree-3"
  data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in a document tree</a> with
  `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-7">associated
  <code>Document</code></a> as their
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:root-3"
  data-x-internal="root">root</a>; and

- <a href="#html-elements"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:html-elements-2">HTML elements</a>
  that have an [`id`](#the-id-attribute) content attribute whose value
  is `name` and are
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:in-a-document-tree-4"
  data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in a document tree</a> with
  `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:concept-document-window-8">associated
  <code>Document</code></a> as their
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
  id="named-access-on-the-window-object:root-4"
  data-x-internal="root">root</a>.

</div>

Since the [`Window`](#window) interface has the
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#Global"
data-x-internal="global"><code
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:global">[Global]</code></a>
extended attribute, its named properties follow the rules for
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-named-properties-object"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:named-properties-object"
data-x-internal="named-properties-object">named properties objects</a>
rather than
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-legacy-platform-object"
id="named-access-on-the-window-object:legacy-platform-object"
data-x-internal="legacy-platform-object">legacy platform objects</a>.

Returns the <a href="#navigable-container"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:navigable-container">navigable
container</a> element.

Returns null if there isn't one, and in cross-origin situations.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-top" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`top`</span> getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-navigable">navigable</a>
    is null, then return null.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-top"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-top">top-level
    traversable</a>'s <a href="#nav-wp"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-wp">active
    <code>WindowProxy</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-opener" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`opener`</span> getter steps are:

1.  Let `current` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-bc"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-bc">browsing
    context</a>.

2.  If `current` is null, then return null.

3.  If `current`'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-2">opener
    browsing context</a> is null, then return null.

4.  Return `current`'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-3">opener
    browsing context</a>'s [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`opener`](#dom-opener) setter steps are:

1.  If the given value is null and
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-bc"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-bc-2">browsing
    context</a> is non-null, then set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-5"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-bc"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-bc-3">browsing
    context</a>'s <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-4">opener
    browsing context</a> to null.

2.  If the given value is non-null, then perform ?
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-definepropertyorthrow"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:definepropertyorthrow"
    data-x-internal="definepropertyorthrow">DefinePropertyOrThrow</a>(<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-6"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>, "`opener`", { \[\[Value\]\]: the
    given value, \[\[Writable\]\]: true, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true,
    \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }).

</div>

<div class="note">

Setting [`window.opener`](#dom-opener) to null clears the
<a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-5">opener
browsing context</a> reference. In practice, this prevents future
scripts from accessing their <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-6">opener
browsing context</a>'s [`Window`](#window) object.

By default, scripts can access their <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-7">opener
browsing context</a>'s [`Window`](#window) object through the
[`window.opener`](#dom-opener) getter. E.g., a script can set
`window.opener.location`, causing the <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:opener-browsing-context-8">opener
browsing context</a> to navigate.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-parent" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`parent`</span> getter steps are:

1.  Let `navigable` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-7"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:window-navigable-3">navigable</a>.

2.  If `navigable` is null, then return null.

3.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-parent"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-parent-2">parent</a>
    is not null, then set `navigable` to `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-parent"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-parent-3">parent</a>.

4.  Return `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-wp"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-wp-2">active
    <code>WindowProxy</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-frameelement" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`frameElement`</span> getter steps are:

1.  Let `current` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:this-8"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>.

2.  If `current` is null, then return null.

3.  Let `container` be `current`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:nav-container">container</a>.

4.  If `container` is null, then return null.

5.  If `container`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:same-origin-domain">same
    origin-domain</a> with the <a href="#current-settings-object"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:current-settings-object">current
    settings object</a>'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
    id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:concept-settings-object-origin">origin</a>,
    then return null.

6.  Return `container`.

</div>

<div class="example">

An example of when these properties can return null is as follows:

``` html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<iframe></iframe>

<script>
"use strict";
const element = document.querySelector("iframe");
const iframeWindow = element.contentWindow;
element.remove();

console.assert(iframeWindow.top === null);
console.assert(iframeWindow.parent === null);
console.assert(iframeWindow.frameElement === null);
</script>
```

Here the <a href="#browsing-context"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:browsing-context">browsing
context</a> corresponding to `iframeWindow` was
<a href="#destroy-a-document"
id="navigating-nested-browsing-contexts-in-the-dom:destroy-a-document">nulled
out</a> when `element` was removed from the document.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.2.5</span> Historical browser interface element APIs<a href="#browser-interface-elements" class="self-link"></a>

For historical reasons, the [`Window`](#window) interface had some
properties that represented the visibility of certain web browser
interface elements.

For privacy and interoperability reasons, those properties now return
values that represent whether the [`Window`](#window)'s
<a href="#window-bc" id="browser-interface-elements:window-bc">browsing
context</a>'s
<a href="#is-popup" id="browser-interface-elements:is-popup">is
popup</a> property is true or false.

Each interface element is represented by a [`BarProp`](#barprop) object:
