<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-barprop-visible" class="dfn" dfn-for="BarProp"
dfn-type="attribute">`visible`</span> getter steps are:

1.  Let `browsingContext` be
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="browser-interface-elements:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="browser-interface-elements:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-bc"
    id="browser-interface-elements:window-bc-2">browsing context</a>.

2.  If `browsingContext` is null, then return true.

3.  Return the negation of `browsingContext`'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="browser-interface-elements:bc-tlbc">top-level
    browsing context</a>'s
    <a href="#is-popup" id="browser-interface-elements:is-popup-2">is
    popup</a>.

</div>

The following [`BarProp`](#barprop) objects must exist for each
[`Window`](#window) object:

<span id="the-location-bar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The location bar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented the user interface element that contains a
control that displays the browser's location bar.

<span id="the-menu-bar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The menu bar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented the user interface element that contains a list
of commands in menu form, or some similar interface concept.

<span id="the-personal-bar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The personal bar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented the user interface element that contains links
to the user's favorite pages, or some similar interface concept.

<span id="the-scrollbar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The scrollbar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented the user interface element that contains a
scrolling mechanism, or some similar interface concept.

<span id="the-status-bar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The status bar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented a user interface element found immediately
below or after the document, as appropriate for the user's media, which
typically provides information about ongoing network activity or
information about elements that the user's pointing device is currently
indicating.

<span id="the-toolbar-barprop-object" class="dfn">The toolbar `BarProp` object</span>  
Historically represented the user interface element found immediately
above or before the document, as appropriate for the user's media, which
typically provides <a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
id="browser-interface-elements:apply-the-traverse-history-step">session
history traversal</a> controls (back and forward buttons, reload
buttons, etc.).

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-locationbar" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`locationbar`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-location-bar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-location-bar-barprop-object">the
location bar <code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-menubar" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`menubar`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-menu-bar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-menu-bar-barprop-object">the menu bar
<code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-personalbar" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`personalbar`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-personal-bar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-personal-bar-barprop-object">the
personal bar <code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-scrollbars" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`scrollbars`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-scrollbar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-scrollbar-barprop-object">the
scrollbar <code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-statusbar" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`statusbar`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-status-bar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-status-bar-barprop-object">the status
bar <code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-window-toolbar" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`toolbar`</span> attribute must return
<a href="#the-toolbar-barprop-object"
id="browser-interface-elements:the-toolbar-barprop-object">the toolbar
<code>BarProp</code> object</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

For historical reasons, the <span id="dom-window-status" class="dfn"
dfn-for="Window" dfn-type="attribute">`status`</span> attribute on the
[`Window`](#window) object must, on getting, return the last string it
was set to, and on setting, must set itself to the new value. When the
[`Window`](#window) object is created, the attribute must be set to the
empty string. It does not do anything else.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.2.6</span> Script settings for [`Window`](#window) objects<a href="#script-settings-for-window-objects" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="set-up-a-window-environment-settings-object"
class="dfn">set up a window environment settings object</span>, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="script-settings-for-window-objects:url"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `creationURL`, a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-execution-contexts"
id="script-settings-for-window-objects:javascript-execution-context"
data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context">JavaScript execution
context</a> `execution context`, null or an <a href="#environment"
id="script-settings-for-window-objects:environment">environment</a>
`reservedEnvironment`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="script-settings-for-window-objects:url-2"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `topLevelCreationURL`, and an
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-origin">origin</a>
`topLevelOrigin`, run these steps:

1.  Let `realm` be the value of `execution context`'s Realm component.

2.  Let `window` be `realm`'s <a href="#concept-realm-global"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-realm-global">global
    object</a>.

3.  Let `settings object` be a new
    <a href="#environment-settings-object"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:environment-settings-object">environment
    settings object</a> whose algorithms are defined as follows:

    The <a href="#realm-execution-context"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:realm-execution-context">realm
    execution context</a>  
    Return `execution context`.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-module-map"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-module-map">module
    map</a>  
    Return the <a href="#concept-document-module-map"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-module-map">module
    map</a> of `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

    The <a href="#api-base-url"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:api-base-url">API base URL</a>  
    Return the current <a href="#document-base-url"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:document-base-url">base URL</a>
    of `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-origin">origin</a>  
    Return the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of `window`'s
    <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-3">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-has-cross-site-ancestor"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-has-cross-site-ancestor">has
    cross-site ancestor</a>  
    1.  If `window`'s <a href="#navigable"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:navigable">navigable</a>'s
        <a href="#nav-parent"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:nav-parent">parent</a> is
        null, then return false.

    2.  Let `parentDocument` be `window`'s <a href="#navigable"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
        <a href="#nav-parent"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:nav-parent-2">parent</a>'s
        <a href="#nav-document"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:nav-document">active document</a>.

    3.  If `parentDocument`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:relevant-settings-object">relevant
        settings object</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-settings-object-has-cross-site-ancestor"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-has-cross-site-ancestor-2">has
        cross-site ancestor</a> is true, then return true.

    4.  If `parentDocument`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
        <a href="#same-site"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:same-site">same site</a>
        with `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-4">associated
        <code>Document</code></a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-origin-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then
        return true.

    5.  Return false.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-policy-container"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-policy-container">policy
    container</a>  
    Return the <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-policy-container">policy
    container</a> of `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-5">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability">cross-origin
    isolated capability</a>  
    Return true if both of the following hold, and false otherwise:

    - `realm`'s <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-agent-clusters"
      id="script-settings-for-window-objects:agent-cluster"
      data-x-internal="agent-cluster">agent cluster</a>'s
      <a href="#agent-cluster-cross-origin-isolation"
      id="script-settings-for-window-objects:agent-cluster-cross-origin-isolation">cross-origin-isolation
      mode</a> is "[`concrete`](#cross-origin-isolation-concrete)", and

    - `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
      id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-6">associated
      <code>Document</code></a> is <a href="#allowed-to-use"
      id="script-settings-for-window-objects:allowed-to-use">allowed to
      use</a> the
      "[`cross-origin-isolated`](#cross-origin-isolated-feature)"
      feature.

    The <a href="#concept-settings-object-time-origin"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-settings-object-time-origin">time
    origin</a>  
    Return `window`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-document-window-7">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>'s <a href="#load-timing-info"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:load-timing-info">load timing
    info</a>'s <a href="#navigation-start-time"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:navigation-start-time">navigation
    start time</a>.

4.  If `reservedEnvironment` is non-null, then:

    1.  Set `settings object`'s <a href="#concept-environment-id"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-id">id</a>
        to `reservedEnvironment`'s <a href="#concept-environment-id"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-id-2">id</a>,
        <a href="#concept-environment-target-browsing-context"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-target-browsing-context">target
        browsing context</a> to `reservedEnvironment`'s
        <a href="#concept-environment-target-browsing-context"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-target-browsing-context-2">target
        browsing context</a>, and
        <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-active-service-worker">active
        service worker</a> to `reservedEnvironment`'s
        <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-active-service-worker-2">active
        service worker</a>.

    2.  Set `reservedEnvironment`'s <a href="#concept-environment-id"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-id-3">id</a>
        to the empty string.

        The identity of the reserved environment is considered to be
        fully transferred to the created
        <a href="#environment-settings-object"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:environment-settings-object-2">environment
        settings object</a>. The reserved environment is not searchable
        by the <a href="#environment"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:environment-2">environment</a>’s
        <a href="#concept-environment-id"
        id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-id-4">id</a>
        from this point on.

5.  Otherwise, set `settings object`'s <a href="#concept-environment-id"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-id-5">id</a>
    to a new unique opaque string, `settings object`'s
    <a href="#concept-environment-target-browsing-context"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-target-browsing-context-3">target
    browsing context</a> to null, and `settings object`'s
    <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-active-service-worker-3">active
    service worker</a> to null.

6.  Set `settings object`'s <a href="#concept-environment-creation-url"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-creation-url">creation
    URL</a> to `creationURL`, `settings object`'s
    <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-creation-url"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-top-level-creation-url">top-level
    creation URL</a> to `topLevelCreationURL`, and `settings object`'s
    <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-origin"
    id="script-settings-for-window-objects:concept-environment-top-level-origin">top-level
    origin</a> to `topLevelOrigin`.

7.  Set `realm`'s \[\[HostDefined\]\] field to `settings object`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.2.3</span> The [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) exotic object<a href="#the-windowproxy-exotic-object" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="windowproxy" class="dfn"
dfn-type="interface">`WindowProxy`</span> is an exotic object that wraps
a [`Window`](#window) ordinary object, indirecting most operations
through to the wrapped object. Each <a href="#browsing-context"
id="the-windowproxy-exotic-object:browsing-context">browsing context</a>
has an associated [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object. When the
<a href="#browsing-context"
id="the-windowproxy-exotic-object:browsing-context-2">browsing
context</a> is <a href="#navigate"
id="the-windowproxy-exotic-object:navigate">navigated</a>, the
[`Window`](#window) object wrapped by the <a href="#browsing-context"
id="the-windowproxy-exotic-object:browsing-context-3">browsing
context</a>'s associated [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object is
changed.

The [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) exotic object must use the ordinary
internal methods except where it is explicitly specified otherwise
below.

There is no [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy)
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-interface-object"
id="the-windowproxy-exotic-object:interface-object"
data-x-internal="interface-object">interface object</a>.

Every [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object has a
<span id="concept-windowproxy-window" class="dfn"
export="">\[\[Window\]\]</span> internal slot representing the wrapped
[`Window`](#window) object.

Although [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) is named as a "proxy", it does
not do polymorphic dispatch on its target's internal methods as a real
proxy would, due to a desire to reuse machinery between
[`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) and [`Location`](#location) objects. As
long as the [`Window`](#window) object remains an ordinary object this
is unobservable and can be implemented either way.

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.1</span> \[\[GetPrototypeOf\]\] ( )<a href="#windowproxy-getprototypeof" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-getprototypeof:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-getprototypeof:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then return !
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarygetprototypeof"
    id="windowproxy-getprototypeof:ordinarygetprototypeof"
    data-x-internal="ordinarygetprototypeof">OrdinaryGetPrototypeOf</a>(`W`).

3.  Return null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.2</span> \[\[SetPrototypeOf\]\] ( `V` )<a href="#windowproxy-setprototypeof" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Return !
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-set-immutable-prototype"
    id="windowproxy-setprototypeof:setimmutableprototype"
    data-x-internal="setimmutableprototype">SetImmutablePrototype</a>(**this**,
    `V`).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.3</span> \[\[IsExtensible\]\] ( )<a href="#windowproxy-isextensible" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Return true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.4</span> \[\[PreventExtensions\]\] ( )<a href="#windowproxy-preventextensions" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.5</span> \[\[GetOwnProperty\]\] ( `P` )<a href="#windowproxy-getownproperty" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  If `P` is an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:array-index-property-name"
    data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
    name</a>, then:

    1.  Let `index` be ! <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-touint32"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:touint32"
        data-x-internal="touint32">ToUint32</a>(`P`).

    2.  Let `children` be the <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:document-tree-child-navigables">document-tree
        child navigables</a> of `W`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:concept-document-window">associated
        <code>Document</code></a>.

    3.  Let `value` be undefined.

    4.  If `index` is less than `children`'s
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:list-size"
        data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>, then:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-sort-in-ascending-order"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:list-sort"
            data-x-internal="list-sort">Sort</a> `children` in ascending
            order, with `navigableA` being less than `navigableB` if
            `navigableA`'s <a href="#nav-container"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:nav-container">container</a>
            was inserted into `W`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:concept-document-window-2">associated
            <code>Document</code></a> earlier than `navigableB`'s
            <a href="#nav-container"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:nav-container-2">container</a>
            was.

        2.  Set `value` to `children`\[`index`\]'s
            <a href="#nav-wp" id="windowproxy-getownproperty:nav-wp">active
            <code>WindowProxy</code></a>.

    5.  If `value` is undefined, then:

        1.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
            is true, then return undefined.

        2.  Throw a
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:securityerror"
            data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="windowproxy-getownproperty:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

    6.  Return <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:propertydescriptor"
        data-x-internal="propertydescriptor">PropertyDescriptor</a> {
        \[\[Value\]\]: `value`, \[\[Writable\]\]: false,
        \[\[Enumerable\]\]: true, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

3.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)-2">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then return !
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarygetownproperty"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:ordinarygetownproperty"
    data-x-internal="ordinarygetownproperty">OrdinaryGetOwnProperty</a>(`W`,
    `P`).

    This is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#willful-violation"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:willful-violation"
    data-x-internal="willful-violation">willful violation</a> of the
    JavaScript specification's <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
    data-x-internal="invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods">invariants
    of the essential internal methods</a> to maintain compatibility with
    existing web content. See [tc39/ecma262 issue
    \#672](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/issues/672) for more
    information. [\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#refsJAVASCRIPT)

4.  Let `property` be
    <a href="#crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-)"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:crossorigingetownpropertyhelper-(-o,-p-)">CrossOriginGetOwnPropertyHelper</a>(`W`,
    `P`).

5.  If `property` is not undefined, then return `property`.

6.  If `property` is undefined and `P` is in `W`'s
    <a href="#document-tree-child-navigable-target-name-property-set"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:document-tree-child-navigable-target-name-property-set">document-tree
    child navigable target name property set</a>, then:

    1.  Let `value` be the
        <a href="#nav-wp" id="windowproxy-getownproperty:nav-wp-2">active
        <code>WindowProxy</code></a> of the
        <a href="#dom-window-nameditem-filter"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:dom-window-nameditem-filter">named
        object</a> of `W` with the name `P`.

    2.  Return <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-property-descriptor-specification-type"
        id="windowproxy-getownproperty:propertydescriptor-2"
        data-x-internal="propertydescriptor">PropertyDescriptor</a> {
        \[\[Value\]\]: `value`, \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false,
        \[\[Writable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: true }.

        The reason the property descriptors are non-enumerable, despite
        this mismatching the same-origin behavior, is for compatibility
        with existing web content. See [issue
        \#3183](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3183) for details.

7.  Return ? <a href="#crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-)"
    id="windowproxy-getownproperty:crossoriginpropertyfallback-(-p-)">CrossOriginPropertyFallback</a>(`P`).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.6</span> \[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\] ( `P`, `Desc` )<a href="#windowproxy-defineownproperty" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then:

    1.  If `P` is an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
        id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:array-index-property-name"
        data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
        name</a>, return false.

    2.  Return ?
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydefineownproperty"
        id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:ordinarydefineownproperty"
        data-x-internal="ordinarydefineownproperty">OrdinaryDefineOwnProperty</a>(`W`,
        `P`, `Desc`).

        This is a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#willful-violation"
        id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:willful-violation"
        data-x-internal="willful-violation">willful violation</a> of the
        JavaScript specification's <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
        id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods"
        data-x-internal="invariants-of-the-essential-internal-methods">invariants
        of the essential internal methods</a> to maintain compatibility
        with existing web content. See [tc39/ecma262 issue
        \#672](https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/issues/672) for more
        information. [\[JAVASCRIPT\]](#refsJAVASCRIPT)

3.  Throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="windowproxy-defineownproperty:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.7</span> \[\[Get\]\] ( `P`, `Receiver` )<a href="#windowproxy-get" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-get:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  <a href="#coop-check-access-report"
    id="windowproxy-get:coop-check-access-report">Check if an access between
    two browsing contexts should be reported</a>, given the
    <a href="#current-global-object"
    id="windowproxy-get:current-global-object">current global object</a>'s
    <a href="#window-bc" id="windowproxy-get:window-bc">browsing context</a>,
    `W`'s <a href="#window-bc" id="windowproxy-get:window-bc-2">browsing
    context</a>, `P`, and the <a href="#current-settings-object"
    id="windowproxy-get:current-settings-object">current settings object</a>.

3.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-get:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then return ?
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryget"
    id="windowproxy-get:ordinaryget"
    data-x-internal="ordinaryget">OrdinaryGet</a>(**this**, `P`,
    `Receiver`).

4.  Return ? <a href="#crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-)"
    id="windowproxy-get:crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-)">CrossOriginGet</a>(**this**,
    `P`, `Receiver`).

**this** is passed rather than `W` as
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryget"
id="windowproxy-get:ordinaryget-2"
data-x-internal="ordinaryget">OrdinaryGet</a> and
<a href="#crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-)"
id="windowproxy-get:crossoriginget-(-o,-p,-receiver-)-2">CrossOriginGet</a>
will invoke the [\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#windowproxy-getownproperty)
internal method.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.8</span> \[\[Set\]\] ( `P`, `V`, `Receiver` )<a href="#windowproxy-set" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-set:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  <a href="#coop-check-access-report"
    id="windowproxy-set:coop-check-access-report">Check if an access between
    two browsing contexts should be reported</a>, given the
    <a href="#current-global-object"
    id="windowproxy-set:current-global-object">current global object</a>'s
    <a href="#browsing-context"
    id="windowproxy-set:browsing-context">browsing context</a>, `W`'s
    <a href="#browsing-context"
    id="windowproxy-set:browsing-context-2">browsing context</a>, `P`,
    and the <a href="#current-settings-object"
    id="windowproxy-set:current-settings-object">current settings object</a>.

3.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-set:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then:

    1.  If `P` is an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
        id="windowproxy-set:array-index-property-name"
        data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
        name</a>, then return false.

    2.  Return ? <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryset"
        id="windowproxy-set:ordinaryset"
        data-x-internal="ordinaryset">OrdinarySet</a>(`W`, `P`, `V`,
        `Receiver`).

4.  Return ? <a href="#crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-)"
    id="windowproxy-set:crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-)">CrossOriginSet</a>(**this**,
    `P`, `V`, `Receiver`).

    **this** is passed rather than `W` as
    <a href="#crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-)"
    id="windowproxy-set:crossoriginset-(-o,-p,-v,-receiver-)-2">CrossOriginSet</a>
    will invoke the
    [\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\]](#windowproxy-getownproperty) internal
    method.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.9</span> \[\[Delete\]\] ( `P` )<a href="#windowproxy-delete" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-delete:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-delete:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then:

    1.  If `P` is an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-array-index-property-name"
        id="windowproxy-delete:array-index-property-name"
        data-x-internal="array-index-property-name">array index property
        name</a>, then:

        1.  Let `desc` be ! **this**.\[\[GetOwnProperty\]\](`P`).

        2.  If `desc` is undefined, then return true.

        3.  Return false.

    2.  Return ? <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinarydelete"
        id="windowproxy-delete:ordinarydelete"
        data-x-internal="ordinarydelete">OrdinaryDelete</a>(`W`, `P`).

3.  Throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="windowproxy-delete:securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="windowproxy-delete:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

##### <span class="secno">7.2.3.10</span> \[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\] ( )<a href="#windowproxy-ownpropertykeys" class="self-link"></a>

1.  Let `W` be the value of the <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot of **this**.

2.  Let `maxProperties` be `W`'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>'s
    <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:document-tree-child-navigables">document-tree
    child navigables</a>'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>.

3.  Let `keys` be
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#the-exclusive-range"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:exclusive-range"
    data-x-internal="exclusive-range">the range</a> 0 to
    `maxProperties`, exclusive.

4.  If <a href="#isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:isplatformobjectsameorigin-(-o-)">IsPlatformObjectSameOrigin</a>(`W`)
    is true, then return the concatenation of `keys` and
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-ordinaryownpropertykeys"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:ordinaryownpropertykeys"
    data-x-internal="ordinaryownpropertykeys">OrdinaryOwnPropertyKeys</a>(`W`).

5.  Return the concatenation of `keys` and !
    <a href="#crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-)"
    id="windowproxy-ownpropertykeys:crossoriginownpropertykeys-(-o-)">CrossOriginOwnPropertyKeys</a>(`W`).

</div>

Each [`Window`](#window) object is associated with a unique instance of
a [`Location`](#location) object, allocated when the [`Window`](#window)
object is created.

The [`Location`](#location) exotic object is defined through a mishmash
of IDL, invocation of JavaScript internal methods post-creation, and
overridden JavaScript internal methods. Coupled with its scary security
policy, please take extra care while implementing this excrescence.

<div algorithm="">

To create a [`Location`](#location) object, run these steps:

1.  Let `location` be a new [`Location`](#location)
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-platform-object"
    id="the-location-interface:platform-object"
    data-x-internal="platform-object">platform object</a>.

2.  Let `valueOf` be `location`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-relevant-realm">relevant realm</a>.\[\[Intrinsics\]\].\[\[<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-object.prototype.valueof"
    id="the-location-interface:object.prototype.valueof"
    data-x-internal="object.prototype.valueof">%Object.prototype.valueOf%</a>\]\].

3.  Perform ! `location`.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\]("`valueOf`", {
    \[\[Value\]\]: `valueOf`, \[\[Writable\]\]: false,
    \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: false }).

4.  Perform !
    `location`.\[\[DefineOwnProperty\]\](<a href="#symbol.toprimitive"
    id="the-location-interface:symbol.toprimitive">%Symbol.toPrimitive%</a>,
    { \[\[Value\]\]: undefined, \[\[Writable\]\]: false,
    \[\[Enumerable\]\]: false, \[\[Configurable\]\]: false }).

5.  Set the value of the <a href="#defaultproperties"
    id="the-location-interface:defaultproperties">[[DefaultProperties]]</a>
    internal slot of `location` to `location`.\[\[OwnPropertyKeys\]\]().

6.  Return `location`.

</div>

The addition of `valueOf` and <a href="#symbol.toprimitive"
id="the-location-interface:symbol.toprimitive-2">%Symbol.toPrimitive%</a>
own data properties, as well as the fact that all of
[`Location`](#location)'s IDL attributes are marked
`[`<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#LegacyUnforgeable"
id="the-location-interface:legacyunforgeable"
data-x-internal="legacyunforgeable"><code>LegacyUnforgeable</code></a>`]`,
is required by legacy code that consulted the [`Location`](#location)
interface, or stringified it, to determine the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-location-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">document URL</a>, and then
used it in a security-sensitive way. In particular, the `valueOf`,
<a href="#symbol.toprimitive"
id="the-location-interface:symbol.toprimitive-3">%Symbol.toPrimitive%</a>,
and `[`<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#LegacyUnforgeable"
id="the-location-interface:legacyunforgeable-2"
data-x-internal="legacyunforgeable"><code>LegacyUnforgeable</code></a>`]`
stringifier mitigations ensure that code such as `foo[location] = bar`
or `location + ""` cannot be misdirected.

`document``.`<a href="#dom-document-location"
id="dom-document-location-dev"><code>location</code></a>` [ = ``value`` ]`  
`window``.`<a href="#dom-location" id="dom-location-dev"><code>location</code></a>` [ = ``value`` ]`  
Returns a [`Location`](#location) object with the current page's
location.

Can be set, to navigate to another page.

<div algorithm="">

The [`Document`](#document) object's <span id="dom-document-location"
class="dfn" dfn-for="Document" dfn-type="attribute">`location`</span>
getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-location-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-relevant-global"
id="the-location-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
object</a>'s [`Location`](#location) object, if
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-location-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a> is
<a href="#fully-active" id="the-location-interface:fully-active">fully
active</a>, and null otherwise.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`Window`](#window) object's <span id="dom-location" class="dfn"
dfn-for="Window" dfn-type="attribute">`location`</span> getter steps are
to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-location-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
[`Location`](#location) object.

</div>

[`Location`](#location) objects provide a representation of the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-location-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> of their associated
[`Document`](#document), as well as methods for
<a href="#navigate" id="the-location-interface:navigate">navigating</a>
and <a href="#reload" id="the-location-interface:reload">reloading</a>
the associated
<a href="#navigable" id="the-location-interface:navigable">navigable</a>.

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Location { // but see also additional creation steps and overridden internal methods
  [LegacyUnforgeable] stringifier attribute USVString href;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute USVString origin;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString protocol;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString host;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString hostname;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString port;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString pathname;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString search;
  [LegacyUnforgeable] attribute USVString hash;

  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined assign(USVString url);
  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined replace(USVString url);
  [LegacyUnforgeable] undefined reload();

  [LegacyUnforgeable] readonly attribute DOMStringList ancestorOrigins;
};
```

Returns a [`DOMStringList`](#domstringlist) object listing the origins
of the <a href="#ancestor-navigables"
id="the-location-interface:ancestor-navigables">ancestor navigables</a>'
<a href="#nav-document" id="the-location-interface:nav-document">active
documents</a>.

<div algorithm="">

A [`Location`](#location) object has an associated
<span id="relevant-document" class="dfn">relevant `Document`</span>,
which is its <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
id="the-location-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
object</a>'s
<a href="#window-bc" id="the-location-interface:window-bc">browsing
context</a>'s <a href="#active-document"
id="the-location-interface:active-document">active document</a>, if this
[`Location`](#location) object's <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
id="the-location-interface:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
object</a>'s
<a href="#window-bc" id="the-location-interface:window-bc-2">browsing
context</a> is non-null, and null otherwise.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A [`Location`](#location) object has an associated
<span id="concept-location-url" class="dfn">url</span>, which is this
[`Location`](#location) object's <a href="#relevant-document"
id="the-location-interface:relevant-document">relevant
<code>Document</code></a>'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-location-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-3"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>, if this
[`Location`](#location) object's <a href="#relevant-document"
id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-2">relevant
<code>Document</code></a> is non-null, and [`about:blank`](#about:blank)
otherwise.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="location-object-navigate" class="dfn">`Location`-object
navigate</span> a [`Location`](#location) object `location` to a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-location-interface:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`,
optionally given a
[`NavigationHistoryBehavior`](#navigationhistorybehavior)
`historyHandling` (default "[`auto`](#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)"):

1.  Let `navigable` be `location`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="the-location-interface:window-navigable">navigable</a>.

2.  Let `sourceDocument` be the <a href="#concept-incumbent-global"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-incumbent-global">incumbent global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

3.  If `location`'s <a href="#relevant-document"
    id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-3">relevant
    <code>Document</code></a> is not yet <a href="#completely-loaded"
    id="the-location-interface:completely-loaded">completely loaded</a>,
    and the <a href="#concept-incumbent-global"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-incumbent-global-2">incumbent global
    object</a> does not have <a href="#transient-activation"
    id="the-location-interface:transient-activation">transient
    activation</a>, then set `historyHandling` to
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

4.  <a href="#navigate" id="the-location-interface:navigate-2">Navigate</a>
    `navigable` to `url` using `sourceDocument`, with
    *<a href="#exceptions-enabled"
    id="the-location-interface:exceptions-enabled">exceptionsEnabled</a>*
    set to true and *[historyHandling](#navigation-hh)* set to
    `historyHandling`.

</div>

    id="the-location-interface:concept-location-url-19">url</a>'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-url-fragment-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The [`hash`](#dom-location-hash) setter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-location-interface:this-51" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#relevant-document"
    id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-27">relevant
    <code>Document</code></a> is null, then return.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-location-interface:this-52" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#relevant-document"
    id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-28">relevant
    <code>Document</code></a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-document-origin-16"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="the-location-interface:same-origin-domain-16">same origin-domain</a>
    with the <a href="#entry-settings-object"
    id="the-location-interface:entry-settings-object-17">entry settings
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-origin"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-settings-object-origin-16">origin</a>,
    then throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-location-interface:securityerror-16"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-location-interface:domexception-18">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Let `copyURL` be a copy of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-location-interface:this-53" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-location-url"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-location-url-20">url</a>.

4.  Let `thisURLFragment` be `copyURL`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-url-fragment-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> if it is
    non-null; otherwise the empty string.

5.  Let `input` be the given value with a single leading "`#`" removed,
    if any.

6.  Set `copyURL`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-url-fragment-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> to the empty
    string.

7.  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-basic-url-parser"
    id="the-location-interface:basic-url-parser-7"
    data-x-internal="basic-url-parser">Basic URL parse</a> `input`, with
    `copyURL` as
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-url"
    id="the-location-interface:basic-url-parser-url-7"
    data-x-internal="basic-url-parser-url"><em>url</em></a> and
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#fragment-state"
    id="the-location-interface:fragment-state"
    data-x-internal="fragment-state">fragment state</a> as
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#basic-url-parser-state-override"
    id="the-location-interface:basic-url-parser-state-override-7"
    data-x-internal="basic-url-parser-state-override"><em>state
    override</em></a>.

8.  If `copyURL`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-location-interface:concept-url-fragment-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> is
    `thisURLFragment`, then return.

    This bailout is necessary for compatibility with deployed content,
    which [redundantly sets `location.hash` on
    scroll](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1733797#c2). It
    does not apply to other mechanisms of fragment navigation, such as
    the [`location.href`](#dom-location-href) setter or
    [`location.assign()`](#dom-location-assign).

9.  <a href="#location-object-navigate"
    id="the-location-interface:location-object-navigate-8"><code>Location</code>-object
    navigate</a> <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-location-interface:this-54" data-x-internal="this">this</a>
    to `copyURL`.

</div>

Unlike the equivalent API for the [`a`](#the-a-element) and
[`area`](#the-area-element) elements, the [`hash`](#dom-location-hash)
setter does not special case the empty string, to remain compatible with
deployed scripts.

A [`Location`](#location) object has an associated
<span id="concept-location-empty-domstringlist" class="dfn"

empty <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"

returned when there is no <a href="#relevant-document"
id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-33">relevant

and it's not possible to return to a non-null
<a href="#relevant-document"
id="the-location-interface:relevant-document-34">relevant
<code>Document</code></a>.

As explained earlier, the [`Location`](#location) exotic object requires
additional logic beyond IDL for security purposes. The
[`Location`](#location) object must use the ordinary internal methods
except where it is explicitly specified otherwise below.

Also, every [`Location`](#location) object has a
<span id="defaultproperties"
class="dfn">\[\[DefaultProperties\]\]</span> internal slot representing
its own properties at time of its creation.

``` idl
enum ScrollRestoration { "auto", "manual" };

[Exposed=Window]
interface History {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  attribute ScrollRestoration scrollRestoration;
  readonly attribute any state;
  undefined go(optional long delta = 0);
  undefined back();
  undefined forward();
  undefined pushState(any data, DOMString unused, optional USVString? url = null);
  undefined replaceState(any data, DOMString unused, optional USVString? url = null);
};
```

id="the-history-interface:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> will

omitted; passing the empty string is traditional.)

class="dfn">history object</span>, a [`History`](#history-3) object.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`history`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"

<a href="#concept-document-window"
id="the-history-interface:concept-document-window">associated
<code>Document</code></a>'s

Each [`History`](#history-3) object has <span id="concept-history-state"
class="dfn">state</span>, initially null.

Each [`History`](#history-3) object has a
<span id="concept-history-length" class="dfn">length</span>, a
non-negative integer, initially 0.

Each [`History`](#history-3) object has an
<span id="concept-history-index" class="dfn">index</span>, a
non-negative integer, initially 0.

Although the <a href="#concept-history-index"
id="the-history-interface:concept-history-index">index</a> is not
directly exposed, it can be inferred from changes to the
<a href="#concept-history-length"
id="the-history-interface:concept-history-length">length</a> during
synchronous navigations. In fact, that is what it's used for.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-length" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="attribute">`length`</span> getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-history-interface:fully-active">fully
    active</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-3"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-history-length"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-history-length-2">length</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-scroll-restoration" class="dfn"
dfn-for="History" dfn-type="attribute">`scrollRestoration`</span> getter
steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-document-window-3">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-history-interface:fully-active-2">fully
    active</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-4"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="the-history-interface:window-navigable">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="the-history-interface:nav-active-history-entry-7">active session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="the-history-interface:she-scroll-restoration-mode-3">scroll
    restoration mode</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The [`scrollRestoration`](#dom-history-scroll-restoration) setter steps
are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-6" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global

    <code>Document</code></a> is not

    active</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-5"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-7" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="the-history-interface:window-navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="the-history-interface:nav-active-history-entry-8">active session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="the-history-interface:she-scroll-restoration-mode-4">scroll
    restoration mode</a> to the given value.

    active</a>, then throw a

    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-6"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-history-interface:this-9" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-history-state"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-history-state">state</a>.
