<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-go" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="method">`go(``delta``)`</span> method steps are to
<a href="#delta-traverse"
id="the-history-interface:delta-traverse">delta traverse</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-history-interface:this-10" data-x-internal="this">this</a> given
`delta`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-back" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="method">`back()`</span> method steps are to
<a href="#delta-traverse"
id="the-history-interface:delta-traverse-2">delta traverse</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-history-interface:this-11" data-x-internal="this">this</a> given
−1.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-forward" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="method">`forward()`</span> method steps are to
<a href="#delta-traverse"
id="the-history-interface:delta-traverse-3">delta traverse</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-history-interface:this-12" data-x-internal="this">this</a> given
+1.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="delta-traverse" class="dfn">delta traverse</span> a
[`History`](#history-3) object `history` given an integer `delta`:

1.  Let `document` be `history`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-document-window-6">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  If `document` is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-history-interface:fully-active-5">fully
    active</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-7"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-7">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If `delta` is 0, then
    <a href="#reload" id="the-history-interface:reload">reload</a>
    `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="the-history-interface:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>, and return.

4.  <a href="#traverse-the-history-by-a-delta"
    id="the-history-interface:traverse-the-history-by-a-delta">Traverse the
    history by a delta</a> given `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="the-history-interface:node-navigable-2">node navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-history-interface:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>,
    `delta`, and with *[sourceDocument](#traverse-sourcedocument)* set
    to `document`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-pushstate" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="method">`pushState(``data``, ``unused``, ``url``)`</span>
method steps are to run the
<a href="#shared-history-push/replace-state-steps"
id="the-history-interface:shared-history-push/replace-state-steps">shared
history push/replace state steps</a> given
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-history-interface:this-13" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
`data`, `url`, and "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-history-replacestate" class="dfn" dfn-for="History"
dfn-type="method">`replaceState(``data``, ``unused``, ``url``)`</span>
method steps are to run the
<a href="#shared-history-push/replace-state-steps"
id="the-history-interface:shared-history-push/replace-state-steps-2">shared
history push/replace state steps</a> given
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-history-interface:this-14" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
`data`, `url`, and "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="shared-history-push/replace-state-steps"
class="dfn">shared history push/replace state steps</span>, given a
[`History`](#history-3) `history`, a value `data`, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
id="the-history-interface:scalar-value-string"
data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a>-or-null
`url`, and a <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="the-history-interface:history-handling-behavior">history handling
behavior</a> `historyHandling`, are:

1.  Let `document` be `history`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-8">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-document-window-7">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  If `document` is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-history-interface:fully-active-6">fully
    active</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-8"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-8">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Optionally, throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-history-interface:securityerror-9"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-history-interface:domexception-9">DOMException</code></a>.
    (For example, the user agent might disallow calls to these methods
    that are invoked on a timer, or from event listeners that are not
    triggered in response to a clear user action, or that are invoked in
    rapid succession.)

4.  Let `serializedData` be <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
    id="the-history-interface:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(`data`).
    Rethrow any exceptions.

5.  Let `newURL` be `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-history-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

6.  If `url` is not null or the empty string, then:

    1.  Set `newURL` to the result of <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
        id="the-history-interface:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing a
        URL</a> given `url`, relative to the
        <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="the-history-interface:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
        object</a> of `history`.

    2.  If `newURL` is failure, then throw a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
        id="the-history-interface:securityerror-10"
        data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-history-interface:domexception-10">DOMException</code></a>.

    3.  If `document` <a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
        id="the-history-interface:can-have-its-url-rewritten-3">cannot have its
        URL rewritten</a> to `newURL`, then throw a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
        id="the-history-interface:securityerror-11"
        data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-history-interface:domexception-11">DOMException</code></a>.

    The special case for the empty string here is historical, and leads
    to different resulting URLs when comparing code such as
    `location.href = ""` (which performs URL parsing on the empty
    string) versus `history.pushState(null, "", "")` (which bypasses
    it).

7.  Let `navigation` be `history`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-relevant-global-9">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="the-history-interface:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

8.  Let `continue` be the result of
    <a href="#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event"
    id="the-history-interface:fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event">firing
    a push/replace/reload <code>navigate</code> event</a> at
    `navigation` with
    *[navigationType](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationtype)* set to
    `historyHandling`,
    *[isSameDocument](#fire-navigate-prr-issamedocument)* set to true,
    *[destinationURL](#fire-navigate-prr-destinationurl)* set to
    `newURL`, and
    *[classicHistoryAPIState](#fire-navigate-prr-classichistoryapistate)*
    set to `serializedData`.

9.  If `continue` is false, then return.

10. Run the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
    id="the-history-interface:url-and-history-update-steps">URL and history
    update steps</a> given `document` and `newURL`, with
    *[serializedData](#uhus-serializeddata)* set to `serializedData` and
    *[historyHandling](#uhus-historyhandling)* set to `historyHandling`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

User agents may limit the number of state objects added to the session
history per page. If a page hits the
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
id="the-history-interface:implementation-defined"
data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
limit, user agents must remove the entry immediately after the first
entry for that [`Document`](#document) object in the session history
after having added the new entry. (Thus the state history acts as a FIFO
buffer for eviction, but as a LIFO buffer for navigation.)

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A [`Document`](#document) `document`
<span id="can-have-its-url-rewritten" class="dfn">can have its URL
rewritten</span> to a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-history-interface:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `targetURL`
if the following algorithm returns true:

1.  Let `documentURL` be `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-history-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

2.  If `targetURL` and `documentURL` differ in their
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-username"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-username"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-username">username</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-password"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-password"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-password">password</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-host"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-host"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-host">host</a>, or
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-port"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-port"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-port">port</a> components, then return
    false.

3.  If `targetURL`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-scheme-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is an
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
    id="the-history-interface:http(s)-scheme"
    data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>, then return
    true.

    Differences in
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-path"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-path">path</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-query"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a>, and
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-fragment"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> are allowed for
    <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7230.html#http.uri"
    data-x-internal="http-protocol"><code
    id="the-history-interface:http-protocol">http:</code></a> and
    <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7230.html#https.uri"
    data-x-internal="https-protocol"><code
    id="the-history-interface:https-protocol">https:</code></a> URLs.

4.  If `targetURL`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-scheme-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is "`file`", then:

    1.  If `targetURL` and `documentURL` differ in their
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path"
        id="the-history-interface:concept-url-path-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-path">path</a> component, then
        return false.

    2.  Return true.

    Differences in
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-query-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> and
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-fragment-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> are allowed for
    `file:` URLs.

5.  If `targetURL` and `documentURL` differ in their
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-path"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-path-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-path">path</a> component or
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-query-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-query">query</a> components, then
    return false.

    Only differences in
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="the-history-interface:concept-url-fragment-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> are allowed for
    other types of URLs.

6.  Return true.

</div>

<div class="example">

| `document`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-history-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-3"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> | `targetURL` | <a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
id="can-have-its-url-rewritten-dev">can have its URL rewritten</a> |
|----|----|----|
| `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/home#about` | ✅ |
| `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/home?page=shop` | ✅ |
| `https://example.com/home` | `https://example.com/shop` | ✅ |
| `https://example.com/home` | `https://user:pass@example.com/home` | ❌ |
| `https://example.com/home` | `http://example.com/home` | ❌ |
| `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/x#hash` | ✅ |
| `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/x?search` | ✅ |
| `file:///path/to/x` | `file:///path/to/y` | ❌ |
| `about:blank` | `about:blank#hash` | ✅ |
| `about:blank` | `about:blank?search` | ❌ |
| `about:blank` | `about:srcdoc` | ❌ |
| `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,foo#hash` | ✅ |
| `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,foo?search` | ❌ |
| `data:text/html,foo` | `data:text/html,bar` | ❌ |
| `data:text/html,foo` | `data:bar` | ❌ |
| `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43#hash` | ✅ |
| `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43?search` | ❌ |
| `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:https://example.com/anything` | ❌ |
| `blob:https://example.com/77becafe-657b-4fdc-8bd3-e83aaa5e8f43` | `blob:path` | ❌ |

Note how only the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-history-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-4"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> of the
[`Document`](#document) matters, and not its
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="the-history-interface:concept-document-origin"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>. They can mismatch
in cases like [`about:blank`](#about:blank) [`Document`](#document)s
with inherited origins, in sandboxed [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element)s,
or when the [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) setter has been
used.

</div>

<div class="example">

Consider a game where the user can navigate along a line, such that the
user is always at some coordinate, and such that the user can bookmark
the page corresponding to a particular coordinate, to return to it
later.

A static page implementing the x=5 position in such a game could look
like the following:

``` html
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<!-- this is https://example.com/line?x=5 -->
<html lang="en">
<title>Line Game - 5</title>
<p>You are at coordinate 5 on the line.</p>
<p>
 <a href="?x=6">Advance to 6</a> or
 <a href="?x=4">retreat to 4</a>?
</p>
```

The problem with such a system is that each time the user clicks, the
whole page has to be reloaded. Here instead is another way of doing it,
using script:

``` html
<!DOCTYPE HTML>
<!-- this starts off as https://example.com/line?x=5 -->
<html lang="en">
<title>Line Game - 5</title>
<p>You are at coordinate <span id="coord">5</span> on the line.</p>
<p>
 <a href="?x=6" onclick="go(1); return false;">Advance to 6</a> or
 <a href="?x=4" onclick="go(-1); return false;">retreat to 4</a>?
</p>
<script>
 var currentPage = 5; // prefilled by server
 function go(d) {
   setupPage(currentPage + d);
   history.pushState(currentPage, "", '?x=' + currentPage);
 }
 onpopstate = function(event) {
   setupPage(event.state);
 }
 function setupPage(page) {
   currentPage = page;
   document.title = 'Line Game - ' + currentPage;
   document.getElementById('coord').textContent = currentPage;
   document.links[0].href = '?x=' + (currentPage+1);
   document.links[0].textContent = 'Advance to ' + (currentPage+1);
   document.links[1].href = '?x=' + (currentPage-1);
   document.links[1].textContent = 'retreat to ' + (currentPage-1);
 }
</script>
```

In systems without script, this still works like the previous example.
However, users that *do* have script support can now navigate much
faster, since there is no network access for the same experience.
Furthermore, contrary to the experience the user would have with just a
naïve script-based approach, bookmarking and navigating the session
history still work.

In the example above, the `data` argument to the
[`pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate) method is the same information
as would be sent to the server, but in a more convenient form, so that
the script doesn't have to parse the URL each time the user navigates.

</div>

<div class="example">

Most applications want to use the same
<a href="#scroll-restoration-mode"
id="the-history-interface:scroll-restoration-mode">scroll restoration
mode</a> value for all of their history entries. To achieve this they
can set the [`scrollRestoration`](#dom-history-scroll-restoration)
attribute as soon as possible (e.g., in the first
[`script`](#the-script-element) element in the document's
[`head`](#the-head-element) element) to ensure that any entry added to
the history session gets the desired scroll restoration mode.

``` html
<head>
  <script>
       if ('scrollRestoration' in history)
            history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
  </script>
</head>
   
```

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.2.6</span> The navigation API<a href="#navigation-api" class="self-link"></a>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.1</span> Introduction<a href="#navigation-api-intro" class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

The navigation API, provided by the global
[`navigation`](#dom-navigation) property, provides a modern and web
application-focused way of managing navigations and history entries. It
is a successor to the classic [`location`](#dom-location) and
[`history`](#dom-history) APIs.

One ability the API provides is inspecting
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-intro:session-history-entry">session history
entries</a>. For example, the following will display the entries' URLs
in an ordered list:

``` js
const ol = document.createElement("ol");
ol.start = 0; // so that the list items' ordinal values match up with the entry indices

for (const entry of navigation.entries()) {
  const li = document.createElement("li");

  if (entry.index < navigation.currentEntry.index) {
    li.className = "backward";
  } else if (entry.index > navigation.currentEntry.index) {
    li.className = "forward";
  } else {
    li.className = "current";
  }

  li.textContent = entry.url;
  ol.append(li);
}
```

The [`navigation.entries()`](#dom-navigation-entries) array contains
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) instances, which
have other useful properties in addition to the
[`url`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-url) and
[`index`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-index) properties shown here. Note
that the array only contains
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) objects that
represent the current
<a href="#navigable" id="navigation-api-intro:navigable">navigable</a>,
and thus its contents are not impacted by navigations inside
<a href="#navigable-container"
id="navigation-api-intro:navigable-container">navigable containers</a>
such as [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element)s, or by navigations of the
<a href="#nav-parent" id="navigation-api-intro:nav-parent">parent
navigable</a> in cases where the navigation API is itself being used
inside an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element). Additionally, it only
contains [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) objects
representing same-<a href="#concept-origin"
id="navigation-api-intro:concept-origin">origin</a>
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-intro:session-history-entry-2">session history
entries</a>, meaning that if the user has visited other origins before
or after the current one, there will not be corresponding
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)s.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The navigation API can also be used to navigate, reload, or traverse
through the history:

``` html
<button onclick="navigation.reload()">Reload</button>

<input type="url" id="navigationURL">
<button onclick="navigation.navigate(navigationURL.value)">Navigate</button>

<button id="backButton" onclick="navigation.back()">Back</button>
<button id="forwardButton" onclick="navigation.forward()">Forward</button>

<select id="traversalDestinations"></select>
<button id="goButton" onclick="navigation.traverseTo(traversalDestinations.value)">Traverse To</button>

<script>
backButton.disabled = !navigation.canGoBack;
forwardButton.disabled = !navigation.canGoForward;

for (const entry of navigation.entries()) {
  traversalDestinations.append(new Option(entry.url, entry.key));
}
</script>
```

Note that traversals are again limited to same-<a href="#concept-origin"
id="navigation-api-intro:concept-origin-2">origin</a> destinations,
meaning that, for example,
[`navigation.canGoBack`](#dom-navigation-cangoback) will be false if the
previous <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-intro:session-history-entry-3">session history
entry</a> is for a page from another origin.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The most powerful part of the navigation API is the
[`navigate`](#event-navigate) event, which fires whenever almost any
navigation or traversal occurs in the current
<a href="#navigable" id="navigation-api-intro:navigable-2">navigable</a>:

``` js
navigation.onnavigate = event => {
  console.log(event.navigationType); // "push", "replace", "reload", or "traverse"
  console.log(event.destination.url);
  console.log(event.userInitiated);
  // ... and other useful properties
};
```

(The event will not fire for [location bar-initiated
navigations](#nav-traversal-ui), or navigations initiated from other
windows, when the destination of the navigation is a new document.)

Much of the time, the event's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="navigation-api-intro:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
property will be true, meaning this event can be canceled using
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault"
data-x-internal="dom-event-preventdefault"><code
id="navigation-api-intro:dom-event-preventdefault">preventDefault()</code></a>:

``` js
navigation.onnavigate = event => {
  if (event.cancelable && isDisallowedURL(event.destination.url)) {
    alert(`Please don't go to ${event.destination.url}!`);
    event.preventDefault();
  }
};
```

The <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="navigation-api-intro:dom-event-cancelable-2">cancelable</code></a>
property will be false for some
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations, such as those
taking place inside <a href="#child-navigable"
id="navigation-api-intro:child-navigable">child navigables</a>, those
crossing to new origins, or when the user attempts to traverse again
shortly after a previous call to
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault"
data-x-internal="dom-event-preventdefault"><code
id="navigation-api-intro:dom-event-preventdefault-2">preventDefault()</code></a>
prevented them from doing so.

The [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent)'s
[`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method allows intercepting
a navigation and converting it into a same-document navigation:

``` js
navigation.addEventListener("navigate", e => {
  // Some navigations, e.g. cross-origin navigations, we cannot intercept.
  // Let the browser handle those normally.
  if (!e.canIntercept) {
    return;
  }

  // Similarly, don't intercept fragment navigations or downloads.
  if (e.hashChange || e.downloadRequest !== null) {
    return;
  }

  const url = new URL(event.destination.url);

  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/articles/")) {
    e.intercept({
      async handler() {
        // The URL has already changed, so show a placeholder while
        // fetching the new content, such as a spinner or loading page.
        renderArticlePagePlaceholder();

        // Fetch the new content and display when ready.
        const articleContent = await getArticleContent(url.pathname, { signal: e.signal });
        renderArticlePage(articleContent);
      }
    });
  }
});
```

Note that the [`handler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler)
function can return a promise to represent the asynchronous progress,
and success or failure, of the navigation. While the promise is still
pending, browser UI can treat the navigation as ongoing (e.g., by
presenting a loading spinner). Other parts of the navigation API are
also sensitive to these promises, such as the return value of
[`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate):

``` js
const { committed, finished } = await navigation.navigate("/articles/the-navigation-api-is-cool");

// The committed promise will fulfill once the URL has changed, which happens
// immediately (as long as the NavigateEvent wasn't canceled).
await committed;

// The finished promise will fulfill once the Promise returned by handler() has
// fulfilled, which happens once the article is downloaded and rendered. (Or,
// it will reject, if handler() fails along the way).
await finished;
```

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.2</span> The [`Navigation`](#navigation) interface<a href="#navigation-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Navigation : EventTarget {
  sequence<NavigationHistoryEntry> entries();
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry? currentEntry;
  undefined updateCurrentEntry(NavigationUpdateCurrentEntryOptions options);
  readonly attribute NavigationTransition? transition;
  readonly attribute NavigationActivation? activation;

  readonly attribute boolean canGoBack;
  readonly attribute boolean canGoForward;

  NavigationResult navigate(USVString url, optional NavigationNavigateOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult reload(optional NavigationReloadOptions options = {});

  NavigationResult traverseTo(DOMString key, optional NavigationOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult back(optional NavigationOptions options = {});
  NavigationResult forward(optional NavigationOptions options = {});

  attribute EventHandler onnavigate;
  attribute EventHandler onnavigatesuccess;
  attribute EventHandler onnavigateerror;
  attribute EventHandler oncurrententrychange;
};

dictionary NavigationUpdateCurrentEntryOptions {
  required any state;
};

dictionary NavigationOptions {
  any info;
};

dictionary NavigationNavigateOptions : NavigationOptions {
  any state;
  NavigationHistoryBehavior history = "auto";
};

dictionary NavigationReloadOptions : NavigationOptions {
  any state;
};

dictionary NavigationResult {
  Promise<NavigationHistoryEntry> committed;
  Promise<NavigationHistoryEntry> finished;
};

enum NavigationHistoryBehavior {
  "auto",
  "push",
  "replace"
};
```

<div algorithm="">

Each [`Window`](#window) has an associated
<span id="window-navigation-api" class="dfn">navigation API</span>,
which is a [`Navigation`](#navigation) object. Upon creation of the
[`Window`](#window) object, its <a href="#window-navigation-api"
id="navigation-interface:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a> must
be set to a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
id="navigation-interface:new" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
[`Navigation`](#navigation) object created in the [`Window`](#window)
object's <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
id="navigation-interface:concept-relevant-realm">relevant realm</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigation" class="dfn" dfn-for="Window"
dfn-type="attribute">`navigation`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="navigation-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#window-navigation-api"
id="navigation-interface:window-navigation-api-2">navigation API</a>.

</div>

The following are the
<a href="#event-handlers" id="navigation-interface:event-handlers">event
handlers</a> (and their corresponding
<a href="#event-handler-event-type"
id="navigation-interface:event-handler-event-type">event handler event
types</a>) that must be supported, as
<a href="#event-handler-idl-attributes"
id="navigation-interface:event-handler-idl-attributes">event handler IDL
attributes</a>, by all objects implementing the
[`Navigation`](#navigation) interface:

| <a href="#event-handlers"
id="navigation-interface:event-handlers-2">Event handler</a> | <a href="#event-handler-event-type"
id="navigation-interface:event-handler-event-type-2">Event handler event
type</a> |
|----|----|
| <span id="handler-navigation-onnavigate" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation" dfn-type="attribute">`onnavigate`</span> | [`navigate`](#event-navigate) |
| <span id="handler-navigation-onnavigatesuccess" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation" dfn-type="attribute">`onnavigatesuccess`</span> | [`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) |
| <span id="handler-navigation-onnavigateerror" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation" dfn-type="attribute">`onnavigateerror`</span> | [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) |
| <span id="handler-navigation-oncurrententrychange" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation" dfn-type="attribute">`oncurrententrychange`</span> | [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) |

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.3</span> Core infrastructure<a href="#navigation-api-core" class="self-link"></a>

Each [`Navigation`](#navigation) has an associated
<span id="navigation-entry-list" class="dfn">entry list</span>, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="navigation-api-core:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) objects, initially
empty.

Each [`Navigation`](#navigation) has an associated
<span id="navigation-current-entry-index" class="dfn">current entry
index</span>, an integer, initially −1.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="navigation-current-entry" class="dfn">current entry</span>
of a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation` is the result of running
the following steps:

1.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigation-api-core:has-entries-and-events-disabled">has entries and
    events disabled</a>, then return null.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigation-api-core:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-core:navigation-current-entry-index">current entry
    index</a> is not −1.

3.  Return `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
    id="navigation-api-core:navigation-entry-list">entry list</a>\[`navigation`'s
    <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-core:navigation-current-entry-index-2">current entry
    index</a>\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`
<span id="has-entries-and-events-disabled" class="dfn">has entries and
events disabled</span> if the following steps return true:

1.  Let `document` be `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigation-api-core:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigation-api-core:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  If `document` is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="navigation-api-core:fully-active">fully
    active</a>, then return true.

3.  If `document`'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="navigation-api-core:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> is true, then return true.

4.  If `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="navigation-api-core:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
    <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="navigation-api-core:concept-origin-opaque">opaque</a>, then
    return true.

5.  Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index" class="dfn">get the
navigation API entry index</span> of a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-core:session-history-entry">session history entry</a>
`she` within a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`:

1.  Let `index` be 0.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="navigation-api-core:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `nhe` of `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
    id="navigation-api-core:navigation-entry-list-2">entry list</a>:

    1.  If `nhe`'s
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigation-api-core:nhe-she">session history
        entry</a> is equal to `she`, then return `index`.

    2.  Increment `index` by 1.

3.  Return −1.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A key type used throughout the navigation API is the
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype) enumeration:

``` idl
enum NavigationType {
 "push",
 "replace",
 "reload",
 "traverse"
};
```

This captures the main web developer-visible types of "navigations",
which (as [noted elsewhere](#note-meaning-of-navigate)) do not exactly
correspond to this standard's singular
<a href="#navigate" id="navigation-api-core:navigate">navigate</a>
algorithm. The meaning of each value is the following:

"<span id="dom-navigationtype-push" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationType" dfn-type="enum-value">`push`</span>"  
Corresponds to calls to
<a href="#navigate" id="navigation-api-core:navigate-2">navigate</a>
where the <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="navigation-api-core:history-handling-behavior">history handling
behavior</a> ends up as "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)", or
to [`history.pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate).

"<span id="dom-navigationtype-replace" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationType" dfn-type="enum-value">`replace`</span>"  
Corresponds to calls to
<a href="#navigate" id="navigation-api-core:navigate-3">navigate</a>
where the <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="navigation-api-core:history-handling-behavior-2">history handling
behavior</a> ends up as
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", or to
[`history.replaceState()`](#dom-history-pushstate).

"<span id="dom-navigationtype-reload" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationType" dfn-type="enum-value">`reload`</span>"  
Corresponds to calls to
<a href="#reload" id="navigation-api-core:reload">reload</a>.

"<span id="dom-navigationtype-traverse" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationType" dfn-type="enum-value">`traverse`</span>"  
Corresponds to calls to <a href="#traverse-the-history-by-a-delta"
id="navigation-api-core:traverse-the-history-by-a-delta">traverse the
history by a delta</a>.

The value space of the [`NavigationType`](#navigationtype) enumeration
is a superset of the value space of the specification-internal
<a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="navigation-api-core:history-handling-behavior-3">history handling
behavior</a> type. Several parts of this standard make use of this
overlap, by passing in a <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="navigation-api-core:history-handling-behavior-4">history handling
behavior</a> to an algorithm that expects a
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype).

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.4</span> Initializing and updating the entry list<a href="#navigation-api-entry-updates" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="initialize-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-new-document"
class="dfn">initialize the navigation API entries for a new
document</span> given a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
of <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry">session history
entries</a> `newSHEs`, and a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-2">session
history entry</a> `initialSHE`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `navigation`'s
    <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list">entry list</a>
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-is-empty"
    data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is empty</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `navigation`'s
    <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index">current
    entry index</a> is −1.

3.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:has-entries-and-events-disabled">has
    entries and events disabled</a>, then return.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `newSHE` of `newSHEs`:

    1.  Let `newNHE` be a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:new" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
        [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) created in
        the <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-relevant-realm">relevant
        realm</a> of `navigation`.

    2.  Set `newNHE`'s
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigation-api-entry-updates:nhe-she">session
        history entry</a> to `newSHE`.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `newNHE` to
        `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-2">entry list</a>.

    `newSHEs` will have originally come from
    <a href="#getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api">getting
    session history entries for the navigation API</a>, and thus each
    `newSHE` will be contiguous <a href="#same-origin"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:same-origin">same</a>
    <a href="#document-state-origin"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:document-state-origin">origin</a>
    with `initialSHE`.

5.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-2">current
    entry index</a> to the result of
    <a href="#getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index">getting
    the navigation API entry index</a> of `initialSHE` within
    `navigation`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-reactivation"
class="dfn">update the navigation API entries for reactivation</span>
given a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
of <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-3">session
history entries</a> `newSHEs`, and a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-4">session
history entry</a> `reactivatedSHE`:

1.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:has-entries-and-events-disabled-2">has
    entries and events disabled</a>, then return.

2.  Let `newNHEs` be a new empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

3.  Let `oldNHEs` be a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-clone"
    data-x-internal="list-clone">clone</a> of `navigation`'s
    <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-3">entry list</a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `newSHE` of `newSHEs`:

    1.  Let `newNHE` be null.

    2.  If `oldNHEs`
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-contains"
        data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> a
        [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)
        `matchingOldNHE` whose
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigation-api-entry-updates:nhe-she-2">session
        history entry</a> is `newSHE`, then:

        1.  Set `newNHE` to `matchingOldNHE`.

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-remove"
            data-x-internal="list-remove">Remove</a> `matchingOldNHE`
            from `oldNHEs`.

    3.  Otherwise:

        1.  Set `newNHE` to a
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:new-2" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
            [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) created
            in the <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant
            realm</a> of `navigation`.

        2.  Set `newNHE`'s
            <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigation-api-entry-updates:nhe-she-3">session
            history entry</a> to `newSHE`.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `newNHE` to `newNHEs`.

    `newSHEs` will have originally come from
    <a href="#getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api-2">getting
    session history entries for the navigation API</a>, and thus each
    `newSHE` will be contiguous <a href="#same-origin"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:same-origin-2">same</a>
    <a href="#document-state-origin"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:document-state-origin-2">origin</a>
    with `reactivatedSHE`.

    By the end of this loop, all
    [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)s that remain in
    `oldNHEs` represent <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-5">session
    history entries</a> which have been disposed while the
    [`Document`](#document) was in [bfcache](#note-bfcache).

5.  Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#entry-list" id="navigation-api-entry-updates:entry-list">entry
    list</a> to `newNHEs`.

6.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-3">current
    entry index</a> to the result of
    <a href="#getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index-2">getting
    the navigation API entry index</a> of `reactivatedSHE` within
    `navigation`.

7.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:queue-a-global-task">Queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `navigation`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a> to run the following steps:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-iterate-3"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `disposedNHE` of
        `oldNHEs`:

        1.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-event-fire"
            data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
            [`dispose`](#event-dispose) at `disposedNHE`.

    <div class="note">

    We delay these steps by a task to ensure that
    [`dispose`](#event-dispose) events will fire after the
    [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) event. This ensures that
    [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) is the first event a page receives
    upon <a href="#reactivate-a-document"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:reactivate-a-document">reactivation</a>.

    (However, the rest of this algorithm runs before the
    [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) event fires. This ensures that
    [`navigation.entries()`](#dom-navigation-entries) and
    [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) will have
    correctly-updated values during any [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow)
    event handlers.)

    </div>

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation"
class="dfn">update the navigation API entries for a same-document
navigation</span> given a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-6">session
history entry</a> `destinationSHE`, and a
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype) `navigationType`:

1.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:has-entries-and-events-disabled-3">has
    entries and events disabled</a>, then return.

2.  Let `oldCurrentNHE` be the <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry">current
    entry</a> of `navigation`.

3.  Let `disposedNHEs` be a new empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-4" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

4.  If `navigationType` is "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)",
    then:

    1.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-4">current
        entry index</a> to the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index-3">getting
        the navigation API entry index</a> of `destinationSHE` within
        `navigation`.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:assert-3"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-5">current
        entry index</a> is not −1.

    This algorithm is only called for same-document traversals.
    Cross-document traversals will instead call either
    <a href="#initialize-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-new-document"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:initialize-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-new-document">initialize
    the navigation API entries for a new document</a> or
    <a href="#update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-reactivation"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-reactivation">update
    the navigation API entries for reactivation</a>.

5.  Otherwise, if `navigationType` is
    "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)", then:

    1.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-6">current
        entry index</a> to `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-7">current
        entry index</a> + 1.

    2.  Let `i` be `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-8">current
        entry index</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:while"
        data-x-internal="while">While</a> `i` \< `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-4">entry list</a>'s
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-size"
        data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-append-3"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `navigation`'s
            <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
            id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-5">entry list</a>\[`i`\]
            to `disposedNHEs`.

        2.  Set `i` to `i` + 1.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-remove-2"
        data-x-internal="list-remove">Remove</a> all items in
        `disposedNHEs` from `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-6">entry list</a>.

6.  Otherwise, if `navigationType` is
    "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)", then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-append-4"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `oldCurrentNHE` to
        `disposedNHEs`.

7.  If `navigationType` is "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
    "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)", then:

    1.  Let `newNHE` be a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:new-3" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
        [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) created in
        the <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-relevant-realm-3">relevant
        realm</a> of `navigation`.

    2.  Set `newNHE`'s
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigation-api-entry-updates:nhe-she-4">session
        history entry</a> to `destinationSHE`.

    3.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-entry-list-7">entry list</a>\[`navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-current-entry-index"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-index-9">current
        entry index</a>\] to `newNHE`.

8.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:ongoing-api-method-tracker">ongoing API
    method tracker</a> is non-null, then
    <a href="#notify-about-the-committed-to-entry"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:notify-about-the-committed-to-entry">notify
    about the committed-to entry</a> given `navigation`'s
    <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:ongoing-api-method-tracker-2">ongoing
    API method tracker</a> and the <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigation-current-entry-2">current
    entry</a> of `navigation`.

    It is important to do this before firing the
    [`dispose`](#event-dispose) or
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) events, since
    event handlers could start another navigation, or otherwise change
    the value of `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:ongoing-api-method-tracker-3">ongoing
    API method tracker</a>.

9.  Let `navigateEvent` be `navigation`'s
    <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:ongoing-navigate-event">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a>.

10. Let `apiMethodTracker` be `navigation`'s
    <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:ongoing-api-method-tracker-4">ongoing
    API method tracker</a>.

11. <a href="#prepare-to-run-script"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:prepare-to-run-script">Prepare to run
    script</a> given `navigation`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>.

    See [the discussion for other navigation API
    events](#note-suppress-microtasks-during-navigation-events) to
    understand why we do this.

12. <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-event-fire-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) at `navigation`
    using
    [`NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent`](#navigationcurrententrychangeevent),
    with its
    [`navigationType`](#dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-navigationtype)
    attribute initialized to `navigationType` and its
    [`from`](#dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-from) initialized to
    `oldCurrentNHE`.

13. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:list-iterate-4"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `disposedNHE` of
    `disposedNHEs`:

    1.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="navigation-api-entry-updates:concept-event-fire-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
        [`dispose`](#event-dispose) at `disposedNHE`.

14. Run the <a href="#navigate-event-intercept-commit-handler-steps"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:navigate-event-intercept-commit-handler-steps">navigate
    event intercept commit handler steps</a> given `navigation`,
    `navigateEvent`, and `apiMethodTracker`.

15. <a href="#clean-up-after-running-script"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:clean-up-after-running-script">Clean up
    after running script</a> given `navigation`'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="navigation-api-entry-updates:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant
    settings object</a>.

</div>

In implementations, same-document navigations can cause
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-entry-updates:session-history-entry-7">session
history entries</a> to be disposed by falling off the back of the
session history entry list. This is not yet handled by the above
algorithm (or by any other part of this standard). See [issue
\#8620](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8620) to track progress on
defining the correct behavior in such cases.

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.5</span> The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) interface<a href="#the-navigationhistoryentry-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationHistoryEntry : EventTarget {
  readonly attribute USVString? url;
  readonly attribute DOMString key;
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute long long index;
  readonly attribute boolean sameDocument;

  any getState();

  attribute EventHandler ondispose;
};
```

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-url"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-url-dev"><code>url</code></a>  
The URL of this navigation history entry.

This can return null if the entry corresponds to a different
[`Document`](#document) than the current one (i.e., if
[`sameDocument`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-samedocument) is false),
and that [`Document`](#document) was fetched with a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:referrer-policy"
data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a> of "`no-referrer`"
or "`origin`", since that indicates the [`Document`](#document) in
question is hiding its URL even from other same-origin pages.

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-key"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-key-dev"><code>key</code></a>  
A user agent-generated random UUID string representing this navigation
history entry's place in the navigation history list. This value will be
reused by other [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)
instances that replace this one due to
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations, and will survive
reloads and session restores.

This is useful for navigating back to this entry in the navigation
history list, using
[`navigation.traverseTo(key)`](#dom-navigation-traverseto).

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-id"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-id-dev"><code>id</code></a>  
A user agent-generated random UUID string representing this specific
navigation history entry. This value will *not* be reused by other
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) instances. This
value will survive reloads and session restores.

This is useful for associating data with this navigation history entry
using other storage APIs.

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-index"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-index-dev"><code>index</code></a>  
The index of this [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)
within [`navigation.entries()`](#dom-navigation-entries), or −1 if the
entry is not in the navigation history entry list.

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-samedocument"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-samedocument-dev"><code>sameDocument</code></a>  
Indicates whether or not this navigation history entry is for the same
[`Document`](#document) as the current one, or not. This will be true,
for example, when the entry represents a fragment navigation or
single-page app navigation.

`entry``.`<a href="#dom-navigationhistoryentry-getstate"
id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-getstate-dev"><code>getState</code></a>`()`  
Returns the <a href="#structureddeserialize"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:structureddeserialize">deserialization</a>
of the state stored in this entry, which was added to the entry using
[`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) or
[`navigation.updateCurrentEntry()`](#dom-navigation-updatecurrententry).
This state survives reloads and session restores.

Note that in general, unless the state value is a primitive,
`entry.getState() !== entry.getState()`, since a fresh deserialization
is returned each time.

This state is unrelated to the classic history API's
[`history.state`](#dom-history-state).

Each [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) has an
associated <span id="nhe-she" class="dfn">session history entry</span>,
which is a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-navigationhistoryentry-key" class="dfn">key</span>
of a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) `nhe` is given
by the return value of the following algorithm:

1.  If `nhe`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active">fully active</a>,
    then return the empty string.

2.  Return `nhe`'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she">session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-key"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-navigation-api-key">navigation
    API key</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-navigationhistoryentry-id" class="dfn">ID</span>
of a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) `nhe` is given
by the return value of the following algorithm:

1.  If `nhe`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active-2">fully
    active</a>, then return the empty string.

2.  Return `nhe`'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she-2">session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-id"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-navigation-api-id">navigation
    API ID</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-navigationhistoryentry-index"
class="dfn">index</span> of a
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) `nhe` is given by
the return value of the following algorithm:

1.  If `nhe`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window-3">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active-3">fully
    active</a>, then return −1.

2.  Return the result of
    <a href="#getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index">getting
    the navigation API entry index</a> of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she-3">session history
    entry</a> within <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:window-navigation-api">navigation
    API</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-url" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="attribute">`url`</span>
getter steps are:

1.  Let `document` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window-4">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  If `document` is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active-4">fully
    active</a>, then return the empty string.

3.  Let `she` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she-4">session history
    entry</a>.

4.  If `she`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-document">document</a>
    does not equal `document`, and `she`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-document-state">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:document-state-request-referrer-policy">request
    referrer policy</a> is "`no-referrer`" or "`origin`", then return
    null.

5.  Return `she`'s <a href="#she-url"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-url">URL</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-url-serializer"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialized</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-key" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="attribute">`key`</span>
getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-5"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationhistoryentry-key"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-navigationhistoryentry-key">key</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-id" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="attribute">`id`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-6"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationhistoryentry-id"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-navigationhistoryentry-id">ID</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-index" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="attribute">`index`</span>
getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-7"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationhistoryentry-index"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-navigationhistoryentry-index">index</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-samedocument" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry"
dfn-type="attribute">`sameDocument`</span> getter steps are:

1.  Let `document` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-8"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-6">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window-5">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  If `document` is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active-5">fully
    active</a>, then return false.

3.  Return true if <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-9"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she-5">session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-document-2">document</a>
    equals `document`, and false otherwise.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationhistoryentry-getstate" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="method">`getState()`</span>
method steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-10"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:concept-document-window-6">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:fully-active-6">fully
    active</a>, then return undefined.

2.  Return <a href="#structureddeserialize"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:structureddeserialize-2">StructuredDeserialize</a>(<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:this-11"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#nhe-she"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:nhe-she-6">session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:she-navigation-api-state">navigation
    API state</a>). Rethrow any exceptions.

    This can in theory throw an exception, if attempting to deserialize
    a large <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-ArrayBuffer"
    data-x-internal="idl-arraybuffer"><code
    id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:idl-arraybuffer">ArrayBuffer</code></a>
    when not enough memory is available.

</div>

The following are the <a href="#event-handlers"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:event-handlers">event
handlers</a> (and their corresponding
<a href="#event-handler-event-type"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:event-handler-event-type">event
handler event types</a>) that must be supported, as
<a href="#event-handler-idl-attributes"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:event-handler-idl-attributes">event
handler IDL attributes</a>, by all objects implementing the
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) interface:

| <a href="#event-handlers"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:event-handlers-2">Event
handler</a> | <a href="#event-handler-event-type"
id="the-navigationhistoryentry-interface:event-handler-event-type-2">Event
handler event type</a> |
|----|----|
| <span id="handler-navigationhistoryentry-ondispose" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationHistoryEntry" dfn-type="attribute">`ondispose`</span> | [`dispose`](#event-dispose) |

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.6</span> The history entry list<a href="#the-history-entry-list" class="self-link"></a>

`entries`` = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigation"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-entries"
id="dom-navigation-entries-dev"><code>entries()</code></a>  
Returns an array of [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)
instances represent the current navigation history entry list, i.e., all
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:session-history-entry">session history
entries</a> for this
<a href="#navigable" id="the-history-entry-list:navigable">navigable</a>
that are
<a href="#same-origin" id="the-history-entry-list:same-origin">same
origin</a> and contiguous to the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:nav-current-history-entry">current session
history entry</a>.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigation-2"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-currententry"
id="dom-navigation-currententry-dev"><code>currentEntry</code></a>  
Returns the [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)
corresponding to the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:nav-current-history-entry-2">current session
history entry</a>.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigation-3"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-updatecurrententry"
id="dom-navigation-updatecurrententry-dev"><code>updateCurrentEntry</code></a>`({ `<a href="#dom-navigationupdatecurrententryoptions-state"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigationupdatecurrententryoptions-state"><code>state</code></a>` })`  
Updates the <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
id="the-history-entry-list:she-navigation-api-state">navigation API
state</a> of the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:nav-current-history-entry-3">current session
history entry</a>, without performing a navigation like
[`navigation.reload()`](#dom-navigation-reload) would do.

This method is best used to capture updates to the page that have
already happened, and need to be reflected into the navigation API
state. For cases where the state update is meant to drive a page update,
instead use [`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) or
[`navigation.reload()`](#dom-navigation-reload), which will trigger a
[`navigate`](#event-navigate) event.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigation-4"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-cangoback"
id="dom-navigation-cangoback-dev"><code>canGoBack</code></a>  
Returns true if the current <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:nav-current-history-entry-4">current session
history entry</a> (i.e., [`currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry))
is not the first one in the navigation history entry list (i.e., in
[`entries()`](#dom-navigation-entries)). This means that there is a
previous <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-history-entry-list:session-history-entry-2">session history
entry</a> for this <a href="#navigable"
id="the-history-entry-list:navigable-2">navigable</a>, and its
<a href="#she-document-state"
id="the-history-entry-list:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
<a href="#document-state-origin"
id="the-history-entry-list:document-state-origin">origin</a> is

origin</a> with the current [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"

data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="the-history-entry-list:dom-navigation-5"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-cangoforward"

Returns true if the current <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"

id="the-history-entry-list:she-document-state-2">document state</a>'s
<a href="#document-state-origin"

origin</a> with the current [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="the-history-entry-list:concept-document-origin-2"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.
