##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.7</span> Initiating navigations<a href="#navigation-api-initiating-navigations" class="self-link"></a>

`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-navigate"
id="dom-navigation-navigate-dev"><code>navigate</code></a>`(``url``)`  
`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-2"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-2"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-2"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-navigate"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-navigate"><code>navigate</code></a>`(``url``, ``options``)`  
<a href="#navigate"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigate">Navigates</a> the
current page to the given `url`. `options` can contain the following
values:

- [`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history) can be set to
  "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)" to replace the
  current session history entry, instead of pushing a new one.

- [`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) can be set to any value; it will
  populate the [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) property of the
  corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent).

- [`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state) can be set to any
  <a href="#serializable-objects"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:serializable-objects">serializable</a>
  value; it will populate the state retrieved by
  [`navigation.currentEntry.getState()`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-getstate)
  once the navigation completes, for same-document navigations. (It will
  be ignored for navigations that end up cross-document.)

By default this will perform a full navigation (i.e., a cross-document
navigation, unless the given URL differs only in a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-url-fragment"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> from the current
one). The [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept)
method can be used to convert it into a same-document navigation.

The returned promises will behave as follows:

- For navigations that get aborted, both promises will reject with an
  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:aborterror"
  data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
  data-x-internal="domexception"><code
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

- For same-document navigations created by using the
  [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method,
  [`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed) will fulfill after the
  navigation commits, and [`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished)
  will fulfill or reject according to any promsies returned by handlers
  passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept).

- For other same-document navigations (e.g., non-intercepted
  <a href="#navigate-fragid"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigate-fragid">fragment
  navigations</a>), both promises will fulfill immediately.

- For cross-document navigations, or navigations that result in 204 or
  205 <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-response-status"
  data-x-internal="concept-response-status">statuses</a> or
  \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html"
  data-x-internal="http-content-disposition"><code
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:http-content-disposition">Content-Disposition: attachment</code></a>\`
  header fields from the server (and thus do not actually navigate),
  both promises will never settle.

In all cases, when the returned promises fulfill, it will be with the
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) that was navigated
to.

`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-4"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-4"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-3"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-reload"
id="dom-navigation-reload-dev"><code>reload</code></a>`(``options``)`  
<a href="#reload"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:reload">Reloads</a> the
current page. `options` can contain
[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) and
[`state`](#dom-navigationreloadoptions-state), which behave as described
above.

The default behavior of performing a from-network-or-cache reload of the
current page can be overriden by the using the
[`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method.
Doing so will mean this call only updates state or passes along the
appropriate [`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info), plus performing
whater actions the [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event handlers see fit
to carry out.

The returned promises will behave as follows:

- If the reload is intercepted by using the
  [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method,
  [`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed) will fulfill after the
  navigation commits, and [`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished)
  will fulfill or reject according to any promsies returned by handlers
  passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept).

- Otherwise, both promises will never settle.

`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-6"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-6"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-4"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-traverseto"
id="dom-navigation-traverseto-dev"><code>traverseTo</code></a>`(``key``)`  
`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-7"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-7"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-5"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-traverseto"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-traverseto"><code>traverseTo</code></a>`(``key``, { `<a href="#dom-navigationoptions-info"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationoptions-info-3"><code>info</code></a>` })`  
<a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:apply-the-traverse-history-step">Traverses</a>
to the closest <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a> that matches the
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) with the given
`key`. [`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) can be set to any value; it
will populate the [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) property of the
corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent).

If a traversal to that <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-2">session
history entry</a> is already in progress, then this will return the
promises for that original traversal, and
[`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) will be ignored.

The returned promises will behave as follows:

- If there is no [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) in
  [`navigation.entries()`](#dom-navigation-entries) whose
  [`key`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-key) matches `key`, both promises
  will reject with an
  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:invalidstateerror"
  data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
  data-x-internal="domexception"><code
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

- For same-document traversals intercepted by the
  [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method,
  [`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed) will fulfill as soon as
  the traversal is processed and
  [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) is updated,
  and [`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished) will fulfill or
  reject according to any promsies returned by the handlers passed to
  [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept).

- For non-intercepted same-document travesals, both promises will
  fulfill as soon as the traversal is processed and
  [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) is updated.

- For cross-document traversals, including attempted cross-document
  traversals that end up resulting in a 204 or 205
  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-response-status-2"
  data-x-internal="concept-response-status">statuses</a> or
  \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html"
  data-x-internal="http-content-disposition"><code
  id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:http-content-disposition-2">Content-Disposition: attachment</code></a>\`
  header fields from the server (and thus do not actually traverse),
  both promises will never settle.

`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-9"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-9"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-6"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-back"
id="dom-navigation-back-dev"><code>back</code></a>`(``key``)`  
`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-10"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-10"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-7"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-back"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-back"><code>back</code></a>`(``key``, { `<a href="#dom-navigationoptions-info"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationoptions-info-5"><code>info</code></a>` })`  
Traverses to the closest previous <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-3">session
history entry</a> which results in this <a href="#navigable"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigable">navigable</a>
traversing, i.e., which corresponds to a different
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) and thus will cause
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) to change.
[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) can be set to any value; it will
populate the [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) property of the
corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent).

If a traversal to that <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-4">session
history entry</a> is already in progress, then this will return the
promises for that original traversal, and
[`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) will be ignored.

The returned promises behave equivalently to those returned by
[`traverseTo()`](#dom-navigation-traverseto).

`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-11"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-11"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-8"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-forward"
id="dom-navigation-forward-dev"><code>forward</code></a>`(``key``)`  
`{ `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-committed"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-committed-12"><code>committed</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationresult-finished"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationresult-finished-12"><code>finished</code></a>` } = `<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-9"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-forward"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigation-forward"><code>forward</code></a>`(``key``, { `<a href="#dom-navigationoptions-info"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:dom-navigationoptions-info-7"><code>info</code></a>` })`  
Traverses to the closest forward <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-5">session
history entry</a> which results in this <a href="#navigable"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigable-2">navigable</a>
traversing, i.e., which corresponds to a different
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) and thus will cause
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) to change.
[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) can be set to any value; it will
populate the [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) property of the
corresponding [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent).

If a traversal to that <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-6">session
history entry</a> is already in progress, then this will return the
promises for that original traversal, and
[`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) will be ignored.

The returned promises behave equivalently to those returned by
[`traverseTo()`](#dom-navigation-traverseto).

The <span id="dom-navigation-navigate" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation"
dfn-type="method">`navigate(``url``, ``options``)`</span> method steps
are:

1.  Let `urlRecord` be the result of <a href="#parse-a-url"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:parse-a-url">parsing a URL</a>
    given `url`, relative to
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>.

2.  If `urlRecord` is failure, then return an
    <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result">early
    error result</a> for a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:syntaxerror"
    data-x-internal="syntaxerror">"<code>SyntaxError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If `urlRecord`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is
    "[`javascript`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case)", then return an
    <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-2">early
    error result</a> for a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:notsupportederror"
    data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  Let `document` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

5.  If
    `options`\["[`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history)"\]
    is "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)", and
    <a href="#the-navigation-must-be-a-replace"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:the-navigation-must-be-a-replace">the
    navigation must be a replace</a> given `urlRecord` and `document`,
    then return an <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-3">early
    error result</a> for a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:notsupportederror-2"
    data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

6.  Let `state` be
    `options`\["[`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state)"\], if
    it <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>; otherwise, undefined.

7.  Let `serializedState` be <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(`state`).
    If this throws an exception, then return an
    <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-4">early
    error result</a> for that exception.

    It is important to perform this step early, since serialization can
    invoke web developer code, which in turn might change various things
    we check in later steps.

8.  If `document` is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:fully-active">fully active</a>,

    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-5">early
    error result</a> for an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:invalidstateerror-2"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

9.  If `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:unload-counter">unload
    counter</a> is greater than 0, then return an
    <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-6">early
    error result</a> for an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-7">DOMException</code></a>.

10. Let `info` be `options`\["[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info)"\],
    if it <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>; otherwise, undefined.

11. Let `apiMethodTracker` be the result of
    <a href="#set-up-a-navigate/reload-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:set-up-a-navigate/reload-api-method-tracker">setting
    up a navigate/reload API method tracker</a> for
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a> given `info` and `serializedState`.

12. <a href="#navigate"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigate-2">Navigate</a>
    `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a> to `urlRecord` using `document`, with
    *[historyHandling](#navigation-hh)* set to
    `options`\["[`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history)"\],
    *[navigationAPIState](#navigation-navigation-api-state)* set to
    `serializedState`, and
    *[apiMethodTracker](#navigation-api-method-tracker-2)* set to
    `apiMethodTracker`.

    Unlike [`location.assign()`](#dom-location-assign) and friends,
    which are exposed across <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:same-origin-domain">origin-domain</a>
    boundaries, [`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) can
    only be accessed by code with direct synchronous access to the
    [`window.navigation`](#dom-navigation) property. Thus, we avoid the
    complications about attributing the source document of the
    navigation, and we don't need to deal with the
    <a href="#allowed-to-navigate"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:allowed-to-navigate">allowed
    by sandboxing to navigate</a> check and its acccompanying
    *[exceptionsEnabled](#exceptions-enabled)* flag. We just treat all
    navigations as if they come from the [`Document`](#document)
    corresponding to this [`Navigation`](#navigation) object itself
    (i.e., `document`).

13. Return a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result">navigation
    API method tracker-derived result</a> for `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

The <span id="dom-navigation-reload" class="dfn" dfn-for="Navigation"
dfn-type="method">`reload(``options``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `document` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"

        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this-5"
        data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

    2.  If `current` is not null, then set `serializedState` to
        `current`'s <a href="#nhe-she"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:nhe-she">session history
        entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:she-navigation-api-state">navigation

5.  If `document` is not <a href="#fully-active"

    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-8">early
    error result</a> for an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"

    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-8">DOMException</code></a>.

6.  If `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:unload-counter-2">unload
    counter</a> is greater than 0, then return an
    <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-9">early

    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"

    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-9">DOMException</code></a>.

7.  Let `info` be `options`\["[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info)"\],
    if it <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:map-exists-4"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>; otherwise, undefined.

8.  Let `apiMethodTracker` be the result of
    <a href="#set-up-a-navigate/reload-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:set-up-a-navigate/reload-api-method-tracker-2">setting
    up a navigate/reload API method tracker</a> for
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:this-6"

9.  <a href="#reload"

    navigable</a> with
    *[navigationAPIState](#reload-navigation-api-state)* set to
    `serializedState` and
    *[apiMethodTracker](#reload-api-method-tracker)* set to

10. Return a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result-2">navigation
    API method tracker-derived result</a> for `apiMethodTracker`.

    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:add-an-upcoming-traverse-api-method-tracker">adding
    an upcoming traverse API method tracker</a> for `navigation` given
    `key` and `info`.

9.  Let `navigable` be `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:node-navigable-3">node
    navigable</a>.

10. Let `traversable` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:nav-traversable">traversable
    navigable</a>.

11. Let `sourceSnapshotParams` be the result of
    <a href="#snapshotting-source-snapshot-params"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:snapshotting-source-snapshot-params">snapshotting
    source snapshot params</a> given `document`.

12. <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
    the following session history traversal steps</a> to `traversable`:

    1.  Let `navigableSHEs` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-session-history-entries"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:getting-session-history-entries">getting
        session history entries</a> given `navigable`.

    2.  Let `targetSHE` be the <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-7">session
        history entry</a> in `navigableSHEs` whose
        <a href="#she-navigation-api-key"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:she-navigation-api-key-5">navigation
        API key</a> is `key`. If no such entry exists, then:

        1.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:queue-a-global-task">Queue a
            global task</a> on the
            <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `navigation`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant
            global object</a> to <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:reject-the-finished-promise">reject
            the finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with an
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:invalidstateerror-12"
            data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-16">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Abort these steps.

        This path is taken if `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-entry-list-5">entry
        list</a> was outdated compared to `navigableSHEs`, which can
        occur for brief periods while all the relevant threads and
        processes are being synchronized in reaction to a history
        change.

    3.  If `targetSHE` is `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:nav-active-history-entry">active
        session history entry</a>, then:

        1.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a
            global task</a> on the
            <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `navigation`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant
            global object</a> to <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:reject-the-finished-promise-2">reject
            the finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with an
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:invalidstateerror-13"
            data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-17">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Abort these steps.

        This can occur if a previously
        <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps-2">queued</a>
        traversal already took us to this
        <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:session-history-entry-8">session
        history entry</a>.

    4.  Let `result` be the result of
        <a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:apply-the-traverse-history-step-2">applying
        the traverse history step</a> given by `targetSHE`'s
        <a href="#she-step"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:she-step">step</a> to
        `traversable`, given `sourceSnapshotParams`, `navigable`, and
        "[`none`](#uni-none)".

    5.  If `result` is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", then
        <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:queue-a-global-task-3">queue a
        global task</a> on the
        <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-3">navigation
        and traversal task source</a> given `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-global-6">relevant
        global object</a> to <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:reject-the-finished-promise-3">reject
        the finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with a new
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:aborterror-2"
        data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-18">DOMException</code></a>
        created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-realm">relevant
        realm</a>.

    6.  If `result` is "`initiator-disallowed`", then
        <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:queue-a-global-task-4">queue a
        global task</a> on the
        <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-4">navigation
        and traversal task source</a> given `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant
        global object</a> to <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:reject-the-finished-promise-4">reject
        the finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with a new
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:securityerror"
        data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-19">DOMException</code></a>
        created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant
        realm</a>.

        <div class="note">

        When `result` is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`" or
        "`initiator-disallowed`", the [`navigate`](#event-navigate)
        event was never fired, <a href="#abort-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:abort-the-ongoing-navigation">aborting
        the ongoing navigation</a> would not be correct; it would result
        in a [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) event without a
        preceding [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event.

        In the "`canceled-by-navigate`" case,
        [`navigate`](#event-navigate) *is* fired, but the
        <a href="#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm">inner
        <code>navigate</code> event firing algorithm</a> will take care
        of <a href="#abort-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:abort-the-ongoing-navigation-2">aborting
        the ongoing navigation</a>.

        </div>

13. Return a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result-4">navigation
    API method tracker-derived result</a> for `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

An <span id="navigation-api-early-error-result" class="dfn">early error
result</span> for an exception `e` is a
[`NavigationResult`](#navigationresult) dictionary instance given by «\[
"[`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed)" →
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:a-promise-rejected-with"
data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
`e`, "[`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished)" →
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:a-promise-rejected-with-2"
data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
`e` \]».

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To compute the <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-derived-result"
class="dfn">navigation API method tracker-derived result</span> for a
<a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation
API method tracker</a>-or-null `apiMethodTracker`:

1.  If `apiMethodTracker` is
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-pending">pending</a>,
    then return an <a href="#navigation-api-early-error-result"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-early-error-result-16">early
    error result</a> for an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:aborterror-3"
    data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:domexception-20">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Return a [`NavigationResult`](#navigationresult) dictionary instance
    given by «\[ "[`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed)" →
    `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed">committed
    promise</a>, "[`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished)" →
    `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
    id="navigation-api-initiating-navigations:navigation-api-method-tracker-finished">finished
    promise</a> \]».

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.8</span> Ongoing navigation tracking<a href="#ongoing-navigation-tracking" class="self-link"></a>

During any given navigation (in the <a href="#navigationtype"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigationtype">broad sense of the
word</a>), the [`Navigation`](#navigation) object needs to keep track of
the following:

| State | Duration | Explanation |
|----|----|----|
| The [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) | For the duration of event firing | So that if the navigation is canceled while the event is firing, we can <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:canceled-flag"
data-x-internal="canceled-flag">cancel</a> the event |
| The event's <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller">abort
controller</a> | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) have settled | So that if the navigation is canceled, we can <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal-abort"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:signal-abort"
data-x-internal="signal-abort">signal abort</a> |
| Whether a new element was <a href="#focusing-steps"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:focusing-steps">focused</a> | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) have settled | So that if one was, focus is not <a href="#potentially-reset-the-focus"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:potentially-reset-the-focus">reset</a> |
| The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) being navigated to | From when it is determined, until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) have settled | So that we know what to resolve any [`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed) and [`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished) promises with |
| Any [`finished`](#dom-navigationresult-finished) promise that was returned | Until all promises returned from handlers passed to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) have settled | So that we can resolve or reject it appropriately |

For all navigations

| State | Duration | Explanation |
|----|----|----|
| Any [`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state) | For the duration of event firing | So that we can update the current entry's <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:she-navigation-api-state">navigation API
state</a> if the event finishes firing without being <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:canceled-flag-2"
data-x-internal="canceled-flag">canceled</a> |

For non-"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations

| State | Duration | Explanation |
|----|----|----|
| Any [`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) | Until the task is queued to fire the [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event | So that we can use it to fire the [`navigate`](#event-navigate) after the trip through the <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session
history traversal queue</a>. |
| Any [`committed`](#dom-navigationresult-committed) promise that was returned | Until the session history is updated (inside that same task) | So that we can resolve or reject it appropriately |
| Whether [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) was called | Until the session history is updated (inside that same task) | So that we can suppress the normal scroll restoration logic in favor of the behavior given by the [`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll) option |

For "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations

We also cannot assume there is only a single navigation requested at any
given time, due to web developer code such as:

``` js
const p1 = navigation.navigate(url1).finished;
const p2 = navigation.navigate(url2).finished;
```

That is, in this scenario, we need to ensure that while navigating to
`url2`, we still have the promise `p1` around so that we can reject it.
We can't just get rid of any ongoing navigation promises the moment the
second call to [`navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) happens.

We end up accomplishing all this by associating the following with each
[`Navigation`](#navigation):

- <span id="ongoing-navigate-event" class="dfn">Ongoing `navigate`
  event</span>, a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) or null, initially
  null.

- <span id="focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation" class="dfn">Focus
  changed during ongoing navigation</span>, a boolean, initially false.

- <span id="suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
  class="dfn">Suppress normal scroll restoration during ongoing
  navigation</span>, a boolean, initially false.

- <span id="ongoing-api-method-tracker" class="dfn">Ongoing API method
  tracker</span>, a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
  id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation
  API method tracker</a> or null, initially null.

- <span id="upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers" class="dfn">Upcoming
  traverse API method trackers</span>, an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
  id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ordered-map"
  data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered map</a> from strings to
  <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
  id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-2">navigation
  API method trackers</a>, initially empty.

The state here that is not stored in
<a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-3">navigation
API method trackers</a> is state which needs to be tracked even for
navigations that are not initiated via navigation API methods.

A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker" class="dfn">navigation API
method tracker</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:struct"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation"
  class="dfn">navigation object</span>, a [`Navigation`](#navigation)

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-key" class="dfn">key</span>,
  a string or null

- An <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-info"
  class="dfn">info</span>, a JavaScript value

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
  class="dfn">serialized state</span>, a <a href="#serialized-state"
  id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:serialized-state">serialized state</a>
  or null

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
  class="dfn">committed-to entry</span>, a
  [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) or null

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
  class="dfn">committed promise</span>, a promise

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
  class="dfn">finished promise</span>, a promise

- A <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
  class="dfn">pending</span>, a boolean.

All this state is then managed via the following algorithms.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="set-up-a-navigate/reload-api-method-tracker"
class="dfn">set up a navigate/reload API method tracker</span> given a
[`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a JavaScript value `info`, and
a <a href="#serialized-state"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:serialized-state-2">serialized state</a>-or-null
`serializedState`:

1.  Let `committedPromise` and `finishedPromise` be new promises created
    in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-relevant-realm">relevant
    realm</a>.

2.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:mark-as-handled"
    data-x-internal="mark-as-handled">Mark as handled</a>
    `finishedPromise`.

    <div id="note-mark-as-handled-navigation-api-finished" class="note">

    <a href="#note-mark-as-handled-navigation-api-finished"
    class="self-link"></a>
    The web developer doesn’t necessarily care about `finishedPromise`
    being rejected:

    - They might only care about `committedPromise`.

    - They could be doing multiple synchronous navigations within the
      same task, in which case all but the last will be aborted (causing
      their `finishedPromise` to reject). This could be an application
      bug, but also could just be an emergent feature of disparate parts
      of the application overriding each others' actions.

    - They might prefer to listen to other transition-failure signals
      instead of `finishedPromise`, e.g., the
      [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) event, or the
      [`navigation.transition.finished`](#dom-navigationtransition-finished)
      promise.

    As such, we mark it as handled to ensure that it never triggers
    [`unhandledrejection`](#event-unhandledrejection) events.

    </div>

3.  Return a new <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-4">navigation
    API method tracker</a> with:

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation">navigation
    object</a>  
    `navigation`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-key"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-key">key</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-info"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-info">info</a>  
    `info`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-state">serialized
    state</a>  
    `serializedState`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry">committed-to
    entry</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed">committed
    promise</a>  
    `committedPromise`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-finished">finished
    promise</a>  
    `finishedPromise`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-pending">pending</a>  
    false if `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:has-entries-and-events-disabled">has
    entries and events disabled</a>; otherwise true

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="add-an-upcoming-traverse-api-method-tracker"
class="dfn">add an upcoming traverse API method tracker</span> given a
[`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a string `destinationKey`, and
a JavaScript value `info`:

1.  Let `committedPromise` and `finishedPromise` be new promises created
    in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant
    realm</a>.

2.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:mark-as-handled-2"
    data-x-internal="mark-as-handled">Mark as handled</a>
    `finishedPromise`.

    See the [previous
    discussion](#note-mark-as-handled-navigation-api-finished) about why
    this is done.

3.  Let `apiMethodTracker` be a new
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-5">navigation
    API method tracker</a> with:

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation-2">navigation
    object</a>  
    `navigation`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-key"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-key-2">key</a>  
    `destinationKey`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-info"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-info-2">info</a>  
    `info`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-state-2">serialized
    state</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry-2">committed-to
    entry</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-2">committed
    promise</a>  
    `committedPromise`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-finished-2">finished
    promise</a>  
    `finishedPromise`

    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-pending-2">pending</a>  
    false

4.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers">upcoming
    traverse API method trackers</a>\[`destinationKey`\] to
    `apiMethodTracker`.

5.  Return `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up" class="dfn">clean
up</span> a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-6">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker`:

1.  Let `navigation` be `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-navigation-3">navigation
    object</a>.

2.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-api-method-tracker">ongoing API
    method tracker</a> is `apiMethodTracker`, then set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-api-method-tracker-2">ongoing
    API method tracker</a> to null.

3.  Otherwise:

    1.  Let `key` be `apiMethodTracker`'s
        <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-key"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-key-3">key</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:assert"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `key` is not null.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:assert-2"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `navigation`'s
        <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-2">upcoming
        traverse API method trackers</a>\[`key`\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:map-exists"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:map-remove"
        data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a> `navigation`'s
        <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-3">upcoming
        traverse API method trackers</a>\[`key`\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="notify-about-the-committed-to-entry" class="dfn">notify
about the committed-to entry</span> given a
<a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-7">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker` and a
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) `nhe`:

1.  Set `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry-3">committed-to
    entry</a> to `nhe`.

2.  If `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-state-3">serialized
    state</a> is not null, then set `nhe`'s
    <a href="#nhe-she" id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:nhe-she">session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:she-navigation-api-state-2">navigation
    API state</a> to `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-state-4">serialized
    state</a>.

    If it's null, then we're traversing to `nhe` via
    [`navigation.traverseTo()`](#dom-navigation-traverseto), which does
    not allow changing the state.

    At this point, `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-state-5">serialized
    state</a> is no longer needed. Implementations might want to clear
    it out to avoid keeping it alive for the lifetime of the
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-8">navigation
    API method tracker</a>.

3.  Resolve `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-3">committed
    promise</a> with `nhe`.

    At this point, `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-4">committed
    promise</a> is only needed in cases where it has not yet been
    returned to author code. Implementations might want to clear it out
    to avoid keeping it alive for the lifetime of the
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-9">navigation
    API method tracker</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="resolve-the-finished-promise" class="dfn">resolve the
finished promise</span> for a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-10">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:assert-3"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry-4">committed-to
    entry</a> is not null.

2.  Resolve `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-finished-3">finished
    promise</a> with its
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-to-entry-5">committed-to
    entry</a>.

3.  <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up">Clean
    up</a> `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="reject-the-finished-promise" class="dfn">reject the
finished promise</span> for a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-11">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker` with a JavaScript value
`exception`:

1.  Reject `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-5">committed
    promise</a> with `exception`.

    This will do nothing if `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-committed-6">committed
    promise</a> was previously resolved via
    <a href="#notify-about-the-committed-to-entry"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:notify-about-the-committed-to-entry">notify
    about the committed-to entry</a>.

2.  Reject `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-finished"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-finished-4">finished
    promise</a> with `exception`.

3.  <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up-2">Clean
    up</a> `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="abort-the-ongoing-navigation" class="dfn">abort the ongoing
navigation</span> given a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation` and
an optional <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:domexception">DOMException</code></a>
`error`:

1.  Let `event` be `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-navigate-event">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:assert-4"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event` is not null.

3.  Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation">focus
    changed during ongoing navigation</a> to false.

4.  Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation">suppress
    normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation</a> to false.

5.  If `error` was not given, then let `error` be a new
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:aborterror"
    data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>
    created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-relevant-realm-3">relevant
    realm</a>.

6.  If `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dispatch-flag"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dispatch-flag"
    data-x-internal="dispatch-flag">dispatch flag</a> is set, then set
    `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:canceled-flag-3"
    data-x-internal="canceled-flag">canceled flag</a> to true.

7.  <a href="#abort-a-navigateevent"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:abort-a-navigateevent">Abort</a>
    `event` given `error`.

To <span id="abort-a-navigateevent" class="dfn">abort a
`NavigateEvent`</span> `event` given `reason`:

1.  Let `navigation` be `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:window-navigation-api">navigation
    API</a>.

2.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal-abort"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:signal-abort-2"
    data-x-internal="signal-abort">Signal abort</a> on `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-2">abort
    controller</a> given `reason`.

3.  Let `errorInfo` be the result of <a href="#extract-error"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:extract-error">extracting error
    information</a> from `reason`.

    For example, if this algorithm is reached because of a call to
    [`window.stop()`](#dom-window-stop), these properties would probably
    end up initialized based on the line of script that called
    [`window.stop()`](#dom-window-stop). But if it's because the user
    clicked the stop button, these properties would probably end up with
    default values like the empty string or 0.

4.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-navigate-event-2">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a> to null.

5.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-api-method-tracker-3">ongoing
    API method tracker</a> is non-null, then
    <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:reject-the-finished-promise">reject the
    finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with `reason`.

6.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
    [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) at `navigation` using
    [`ErrorEvent`](#errorevent), with additional attributes initialized
    according to `errorInfo`.

7.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigation-transition">transition</a>
    is null, then return.

8.  Reject `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigation-transition-2">transition</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-committed"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigationtransition-committed">committed
    promise</a> with `reason`.

9.  Reject `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigation-transition-3">transition</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-finished"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigationtransition-finished">finished
    promise</a> with `reason`.

10. Set `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigation-transition-4">transition</a>
    to null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation"
class="dfn">inform the navigation API about aborting navigation</span>
in a <a href="#navigable"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigable">navigable</a> `navigable`:

1.  If this algorithm is running on `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:nav-window">active
    window</a>'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>,
    then continue on to the following steps. Otherwise,
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:queue-a-global-task">queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:nav-window-2">active window</a> to
    run the following steps.

2.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-window"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:nav-window-3">active window</a>'s
    <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:window-navigation-api-2">navigation
    API</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:while" data-x-internal="while">While</a>
    `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:ongoing-navigate-event-3">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a> is not null:

    1.  <a href="#abort-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:abort-the-ongoing-navigation">Abort the
        ongoing navigation</a> given `navigation`.

    <div class="note">

    If there is an ongoing cross-document navigation, this means it will
    be signaled to the navigation API as aborted, e.g., by firing
    [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) events. This is somewhat
    accurate, since the next navigation the [`Document`](#document)
    experiences will be this same-document navigation, so a developer
    which was expecting the next navigation completion to be that of the
    cross-document navigation gets a useful signal that this did not
    happen. However, it is also somewhat inaccurate, as the browser will
    continue to process the ongoing cross-document navigation (applying
    it after this same-document one synchronously finishes).

    Ultimately, the navigation API gets a bit messy with overlapping
    cross- and same-document navigations, as the [ongoing navigation
    tracking](#ongoing-navigation-tracking) machinery and APIs are built
    to expose only a single ongoing navigation. Web developers will be
    best-served if they do not create such overlapping situations, e.g.,
    by `await`ing promises returned from
    [`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) before starting
    new navigations.

    </div>

    This is a loop, since <a href="#abort-the-ongoing-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:abort-the-ongoing-navigation-2">abort
    the ongoing navigation</a> can run JavaScript (e.g., via the
    [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) event), which might start a
    new navigation. Since such a newly-started navigation will be
    superseded by the completion of this navigation, it gets signaled to
    the navigation API as aborted.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="inform-the-navigation-api-about-child-navigable-destruction"
class="dfn">inform the navigation API about child navigable
destruction</span> given a <a href="#navigable"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:navigable-2">navigable</a> `navigable`:

1.  <a href="#inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation">Inform
    the navigation API about aborting navigation</a> in `navigable`.

2.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-window"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:nav-window-4">active window</a>'s
    <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:window-navigation-api-3">navigation
    API</a>.

3.  Let `traversalAPIMethodTrackers` be a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:list-clone"
    data-x-internal="list-clone">clone</a> of `navigation`'s
    <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-4">upcoming
    traverse API method trackers</a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `apiMethodTracker` of
    `traversalAPIMethodTrackers`: <a href="#reject-the-finished-promise"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:reject-the-finished-promise-2">reject
    the finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker` with a new
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#aborterror"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:aborterror-2"
    data-x-internal="aborterror">"<code>AbortError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>
    created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-relevant-realm-4">relevant
    realm</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The ongoing navigation concept is most-directly exposed to web
developers through the
[`navigation.transition`](#dom-navigation-transition) property, which is
an instance of the [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition)
interface:

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationTransition {
  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry from;
  readonly attribute NavigationDestination to;
  readonly attribute Promise<undefined> committed;
  readonly attribute Promise<undefined> finished;
};
```

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="dom-navigation-transition-dev"><code>transition</code></a>  
A [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) representing any
ongoing navigation that hasn't yet reached the
[`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) or
[`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) stage, if one exists; or null,
if there is no such transition ongoing.

Since [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) (and
other properties like [`location.href`](#dom-location-href)) are updated
immediately upon navigation, this
[`navigation.transition`](#dom-navigation-transition) property is useful
for determining when such navigations are not yet fully settled,
according to any handlers passed to
[`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept).

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-2"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-transition-3"><code>transition</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationtransition-navigationtype"
id="dom-navigationtransition-navigationtype-dev"><code>navigationType</code></a>  
One of "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)",
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)",
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", indicating what type of
navigation this transition is for.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-3"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-transition-4"><code>transition</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationtransition-from"
id="dom-navigationtransition-from-dev"><code>from</code></a>  
The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) from which the
transition is coming. This can be useful to compare against
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry).

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-4"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-transition-5"><code>transition</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationtransition-to"
id="dom-navigationtransition-to-dev"><code>to</code></a>  
The [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) of the transition.
This can be useful as a way to reflect a current navigation's
destination's [`url`](#dom-navigationdestination-url) without having to
listen to the [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-5"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-transition-6"><code>transition</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationtransition-committed"
id="dom-navigationtransition-committed-dev"><code>committed</code></a>  
A promise which fulfills once the
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) and
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> change. This occurs
after all of its
<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler">precommit
handlers</a> are fulfilled. The promise rejects if one or more of the
<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler-2">precommit
handlers</a> rejects.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-6"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:dom-navigation-transition-7"><code>transition</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationtransition-finished"
id="dom-navigationtransition-finished-dev"><code>finished</code></a>  
A promise which fulfills at the same time as the
[`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) fires, or rejects at the
same time the [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) event fires.

Each [`Navigation`](#navigation) has a
<span id="concept-navigation-transition" class="dfn">transition</span>,
which is a [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) or null,
initially null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigation-transition" class="dfn"
dfn-for="Navigation" dfn-type="attribute">`transition`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigation-transition-5">transition</a>.

</div>

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) has an associated
<span id="concept-navigationtransition-navigationtype"
class="dfn">navigation type</span>, which is a
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) has an associated
<span id="concept-navigationtransition-from" class="dfn">from
entry</span>, which is a
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) has an associated
<span id="concept-navigationtransition-destination"
class="dfn">destination</span>, which is a
[`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination).

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) has an associated
<span id="concept-navigationtransition-committed" class="dfn">committed
promise</span>, which is a promise.

Each [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) has an associated
<span id="concept-navigationtransition-finished" class="dfn">finished
promise</span>, which is a promise.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationtransition-navigationtype" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationTransition"
dfn-type="attribute">`navigationType`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationtransition-navigationtype"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigationtransition-navigationtype">navigation
type</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationtransition-from" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationTransition" dfn-type="attribute">`from`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationtransition-from"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigationtransition-from">from
entry</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationtransition-to" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationTransition" dfn-type="attribute">`to`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-navigationtransition-destination"
id="ongoing-navigation-tracking:concept-navigationtransition-destination">destination</a>.
