##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.9</span> The [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) interface<a href="#navigation-activation-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationActivation {
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry? from;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry entry;
  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
};
```

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-activation"
id="dom-navigation-activation-dev"><code>activation</code></a>  
A [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) containing information
about the most recent cross-document navigation, the navigation that
"activated" this [`Document`](#document).

While [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) and the
[`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="navigation-activation-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> can be updated
regularly due to same-document navigations,
[`navigation.activation`](#dom-navigation-activation) stays constant,
and its properties are only updated if the [`Document`](#document) is
<a href="#reactivate-a-document"
id="navigation-activation-interface:reactivate-a-document">reactivated</a>
from history.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-2"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-activation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-activation-2"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-entry"
id="dom-navigationactivation-entry-dev"><code>entry</code></a>  
A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), equivalent to the
value of the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry)
property at the moment the [`Document`](#document) was activated.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-3"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-activation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-activation-3"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-from"
id="dom-navigationactivation-from-dev"><code>from</code></a>  
A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), representing the
[`Document`](#document) that was active right before the current
[`Document`](#document). This will have a value null in case the
previous [`Document`](#document) was not <a href="#same-origin"
id="navigation-activation-interface:same-origin">same origin</a> with
this one or if it was the <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
id="navigation-activation-interface:is-initial-about:blank">initial
<code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document).

There are some cases in which either the
[`from`](#dom-navigationactivation-from) or
[`entry`](#dom-navigationactivation-entry)
[`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) objects would not be
viable targets for the [`traverseTo()`](#dom-navigation-traverseto)
method, as they might not be retained in history. For example, the
[`Document`](#document) can be activated using
[`location.replace()`](#dom-location-replace) or its initial entry could
be replaced by [`history.replaceState()`](#dom-history-replacestate).
However, those entries' [`url`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-url)
property and [`getState()`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-getstate) method
are still accessible.

<a href="#dom-navigation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-4"><code>navigation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigation-activation"
id="navigation-activation-interface:dom-navigation-activation-4"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-navigationtype"
id="dom-navigationactivation-navigationtype-dev"><code>navigationType</code></a>  
One of "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)",
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)",
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", indicating what type of
navigation activated this [`Document`](#document).

Each [`Navigation`](#navigation) has an associated
<span id="navigation-activation" class="dfn">activation</span>, which is
null or a [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) object,
initially null.

Each [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) has:

- <span id="nav-activation-old-entry" class="dfn">old entry</span>, null
  or a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry).

- <span id="nav-activation-new-entry" class="dfn">new entry</span>, null
  or a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry).

- <span id="nav-activation-navigation-type" class="dfn">navigation
  type</span>, a [`NavigationType`](#navigationtype).

##### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10</span> The [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event<a href="#the-navigate-event" class="self-link"></a>

A major feature of the navigation API is the
[`navigate`](#event-navigate) event. This event is fired on any
navigation (in the
<a href="#navigationtype" id="the-navigate-event:navigationtype">broad
sense of the word</a>), allowing web developers to monitor such outgoing
navigations. In many cases, the event is
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="the-navigate-event:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>,
which allows preventing the navigation from happening. And in others,
the navigation can be intercepted and replaced with a same-document
navigation by using the [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept)
method of the [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) class.

###### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10.1</span> The [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) interface<a href="#the-navigateevent-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigateEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, NavigateEventInit eventInitDict);

  readonly attribute NavigationType navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationDestination destination;
  readonly attribute boolean canIntercept;
  readonly attribute boolean userInitiated;
  readonly attribute boolean hashChange;
  readonly attribute AbortSignal signal;
  readonly attribute FormData? formData;
  readonly attribute DOMString? downloadRequest;
  readonly attribute any info;
  readonly attribute boolean hasUAVisualTransition;
  readonly attribute Element? sourceElement;

  undefined intercept(optional NavigationInterceptOptions options = {});
  undefined scroll();
};

dictionary NavigateEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationType navigationType = "push";
  required NavigationDestination destination;
  boolean canIntercept = false;
  boolean userInitiated = false;
  boolean hashChange = false;
  required AbortSignal signal;
  FormData? formData = null;
  DOMString? downloadRequest = null;
  any info;
  boolean hasUAVisualTransition = false;
  Element? sourceElement = null;
};

dictionary NavigationInterceptOptions {
  NavigationPrecommitHandler precommitHandler;
  NavigationInterceptHandler handler;
  NavigationFocusReset focusReset;
  NavigationScrollBehavior scroll;
};

enum NavigationFocusReset {
  "after-transition",
  "manual"
};

enum NavigationScrollBehavior {
  "after-transition",
  "manual"
};

callback NavigationInterceptHandler = Promise<undefined> ();
```

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype"
id="dom-navigateevent-navigationtype-dev"><code>navigationType</code></a>  
One of "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)",
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)",
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", indicating what type of
navigation this is.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="dom-navigateevent-destination-dev"><code>destination</code></a>  
A [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) representing the
destination of the navigation.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-canintercept"
id="dom-navigateevent-canintercept-dev"><code>canIntercept</code></a>  
True if [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) can be called to
intercept this navigation and convert it into a same-document
navigation, replacing its usual behavior; false otherwise.

Generally speaking, this will be true whenever the current
[`Document`](#document) <a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:can-have-its-url-rewritten">can have its
URL rewritten</a> to the destination URL, except for in the case of
cross-document "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations,
where it will always be false.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-userinitiated"
id="dom-navigateevent-userinitiated-dev"><code>userInitiated</code></a>  
True if this navigation was due to a user clicking on an
[`a`](#the-a-element) element, submitting a [`form`](#the-form-element)
element, or using the [browser UI](#nav-traversal-ui) to navigate; false
otherwise.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-hashchange"
id="dom-navigateevent-hashchange-dev"><code>hashChange</code></a>  
True for a <a href="#navigate-fragid"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:navigate-fragid">fragment navigation</a>;
false otherwise.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-signal"
id="dom-navigateevent-signal-dev"><code>signal</code></a>  
An <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal"
data-x-internal="abortsignal"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:abortsignal-3">AbortSignal</code></a>
which will become aborted if the navigation gets canceled, e.g., by the
user pressing their browser's "Stop" button, or by another navigation
interrupting this one.

The expected pattern is for developers to pass this along to any async
operations, such as
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-global-fetch"
data-x-internal="fetch()"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:fetch()">fetch()</code></a>, which they
perform as part of handling this navigation.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-formdata"
id="dom-navigateevent-formdata-dev"><code>formData</code></a>  
The <a href="https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata"
data-x-internal="formdata"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:formdata-3">FormData</code></a>
representing the submitted form entries for this navigation, if this
navigation is a "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigation representing a
POST <a href="#concept-form-submit"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-form-submit">form submission</a>;
null otherwise.

(Notably, this will be null even for
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations that are
revisiting a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:session-history-entry">session history
entry</a> that was originally created from a form submission.)

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-downloadrequest"
id="dom-navigateevent-downloadrequest-dev"><code>downloadRequest</code></a>  
Represents whether or not this navigation was requested to be a
download, by using an [`a`](#the-a-element) or
[`area`](#the-area-element) element's
[`download`](#attr-hyperlink-download) attribute:

- If a download was not requested, then this property is null.

- If a download was requested, returns the filename that was supplied as
  the [`download`](#attr-hyperlink-download) attribute's value. (This
  could be the empty string.)

Note that a download being requested does not always mean that a
download will happen: for example, a download might be blocked by
browser security policies, or end up being treated as a
"[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)" navigation for
<a href="https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7718"
class="XXX">unspecified reasons</a>.

Similarly, a navigation might end up being a download even if it was not
requested to be one, due to the destination server responding with a
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html"
data-x-internal="http-content-disposition"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:http-content-disposition">Content-Disposition: attachment</code></a>\`
header.

Finally, note that the [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event will not fire
at all for downloads initiated using browser UI affordances, e.g., those
created by right-clicking and choosing to save the target of a link.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-info"
id="dom-navigateevent-info-dev"><code>info</code></a>  
An arbitrary JavaScript value passed via one of the [navigation API
methods](#navigation-api-initiating-navigations) which initiated this
navigation, or undefined if the navigation was initiated by the user or
by a different API.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-hasuavisualtransition"
id="dom-navigateevent-hasuavisualtransition-dev"><code>hasUAVisualTransition</code></a>  
Returns true if the user agent performed a visual transition for this
navigation before dispatching this event. If true, the best user
experience will be given if the author synchronously updates the DOM to
the post-navigation state.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-sourceelement"
id="dom-navigateevent-sourceelement-dev"><code>sourceElement</code></a>  
Returns the <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:element">Element</code></a> responsible
for this navigation. This can be an [`a`](#the-a-element)or
[`area`](#the-area-element) element, a <a href="#concept-submit-button"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-submit-button">submit button</a>,
or a submitted [`form`](#the-form-element) element.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-intercept"
id="dom-navigateevent-intercept-dev"><code>intercept</code></a>`({ `<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler"
id="dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler-dev"><code>precommitHandler</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler"
id="dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler-dev"><code>handler</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset"
id="dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset-dev"><code>focusReset</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll"
id="dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll-dev"><code>scroll</code></a>` })`  
Intercepts this navigation, preventing its normal handling and instead
converting it into a same-document navigation of the same type to the
destination URL.

The
[`precommitHandler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler)
option can be a function that accepts a
[`NavigationPrecommitController`](#navigationprecommitcontroller) and
returns a promise. The precommit handler function will run after the
[`navigate`](#event-navigate) event has finished firing, but before the
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) property has
been updated. Returning a rejected promise will abort the navigation and
its effect, such as updating the URL and session history. After all the
precommit handlers are fulfilled, the navigation can proceed to commit
and call the rest of the handlers. The
[`precommitHandler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler)
option can only be passed when the event is
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>:
trying to pass a
[`precommitHandler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler)
to a non-cancelable [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) will throw a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:securityerror"
data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

The [`handler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler) option can be a
function that returns a promise. The handler function will run after the
[`navigate`](#event-navigate) event has finished firing and the
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry) property has
been updated. This returned promise is used to signal the duration, and
success or failure, of the navigation. After it settles, the browser
signals to the user (e.g., via a loading spinner UI, or assistive
technology) that the navigation is finished. Additionally, it fires
[`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) or
[`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) events as appropriate, which
other parts of the web application can respond to.

By default, using this method will cause focus to reset when any
handlers' returned promises settle. Focus will be reset to the first
element with the [`autofocus`](#attr-fe-autofocus) attribute set, or
<a href="#the-body-element-2"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:the-body-element-2">the body element</a>
if the attribute isn't present. The
[`focusReset`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset) option can be
set to "[`manual`](#dom-navigationfocusreset-manual)" to avoid this
behavior.

By default, using this method will delay the browser's scroll
restoration logic for "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" or
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" navigations, or its
scroll-reset/scroll-to-a-fragment logic for
"[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations, until any
handlers' returned promises settle. The
[`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll) option can be set to
"[`manual`](#dom-navigationscrollbehavior-manual)" to turn off any
browser-driven scroll behavior entirely for this navigation, or
[`scroll()`](#dom-navigateevent-scroll) can be called before the promise
settles to trigger this behavior early.

This method will throw a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:securityerror-2"
data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>
if [`canIntercept`](#dom-navigateevent-canintercept) is false, or if
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted"
data-x-internal="dom-event-istrusted"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:dom-event-istrusted">isTrusted</code></a>
is false. It will throw an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>
if not called synchronously, during event dispatch.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-scroll"
id="dom-navigateevent-scroll-dev"><code>scroll</code></a>`()`  
For "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" or
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" navigations, restores the
scroll position using the browser's usual scroll restoration logic.

For "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations, either resets
the scroll position to the top of the document or scrolls to the
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-url-fragment"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> specified by
[`destination.url`](#dom-navigationdestination-url) if there is one.

If called more than once, or called after automatic post-transition
scroll processing has happened due to the
[`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll) option being left as
"[`after-transition`](#dom-navigationscrollbehavior-after-transition)",
or called before the navigation has committed, this method will throw an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has an
<span id="concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
class="dfn">interception state</span>, which is either "`none`",
"`intercepted`", "`committed`", "`scrolled`", or "`finished`", initially
"`none`".

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has a
<span id="concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list"
class="dfn">navigation precommit handler list</span>, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
[`NavigationPrecommitHandler`](#navigationprecommithandler) callbacks,
initially empty.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has a
<span id="concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list"
class="dfn">navigation handler list</span>, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
of [`NavigationInterceptHandler`](#navigationintercepthandler)
callbacks, initially empty.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has a
<span id="concept-navigateevent-focusreset" class="dfn">focus reset
behavior</span>, a
[`NavigationFocusReset`](#navigationfocusreset)-or-null, initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has a
<span id="concept-navigateevent-scroll" class="dfn">scroll
behavior</span>, a
[`NavigationScrollBehavior`](#navigationscrollbehavior)-or-null,
initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has an
<span id="concept-navigateevent-abort-controller" class="dfn">abort
controller</span>, an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller"
data-x-internal="abortcontroller"><code
id="the-navigateevent-interface:abortcontroller">AbortController</code></a>-or-null,
initially null.

Each [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) has a
<span id="concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
class="dfn">classic history API state</span>, a
<a href="#serialized-state"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:serialized-state">serialized state</a>
or null. It is only used in some cases where the event's
[`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype) is
"[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)", and is set appropriately
when the event is
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-event-fire"
data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fired</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigateevent-navigationtype" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`navigationType`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-destination" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`destination`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-canintercept" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`canIntercept`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-userinitiated" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`userInitiated`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-hashchange" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`hashChange`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-signal" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigateEvent"
dfn-type="attribute">`signal`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-formdata" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`formData`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-downloadrequest" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`downloadRequest`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-info" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigateEvent"
dfn-type="attribute">`info`</span>,
<span id="dom-navigateevent-hasuavisualtransition" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent"
dfn-type="attribute">`hasUAVisualTransition`</span>, and
<span id="dom-navigateevent-sourceelement" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`sourceElement`</span>
attributes must return the values they are initialized to.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigateevent-intercept" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent"
dfn-type="method">`intercept(``options``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  <a href="#navigateevent-perform-shared-checks"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:navigateevent-perform-shared-checks">Perform
    shared checks</a> given
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    [`canIntercept`](#dom-navigateevent-canintercept) attribute was
    initialized to false, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:securityerror-3"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dispatch-flag"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:dispatch-flag"
    data-x-internal="dispatch-flag">dispatch flag</a> is unset, then
    throw an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  If
    `options`\["[`precommitHandler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then:

    1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
        data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:dom-event-cancelable-2">cancelable</code></a>
        attribute is initialized to false, then throw an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-4"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-7">DOMException</code></a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a>
        `options`\["[`precommitHandler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-precommithandler)"\]
        to <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list">navigation
        precommit handler list</a>.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-6" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state">interception
    state</a> is either "`none`" or "`intercepted`".

6.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-7" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-2">interception
    state</a> to "`intercepted`".

7.  If
    `options`\["[`handler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:list-append-2"
    data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-8" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list">navigation
    handler list</a>.

8.  If
    `options`\["[`focusReset`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then:

    1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-9" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-focusreset"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-focusreset">focus
        reset behavior</a> is not null, and it is not equal to
        `options`\["[`focusReset`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset)"\],
        then the user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the
        [`focusReset`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset)
        option for a previous call to
        [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) was overridden by
        this new value, and the previous value will be ignored.

    2.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-10" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-focusreset"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-focusreset-2">focus
        reset behavior</a> to
        `options`\["[`focusReset`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-focusreset)"\].

9.  If `options`\["[`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:map-exists-4"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then:

    1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-11" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-scroll"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-scroll">scroll
        behavior</a> is not null, and it is not equal to
        `options`\["[`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll)"\],
        then the user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:report-a-warning-to-the-console-2"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the
        [`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll) option for a
        previous call to [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept)
        was overridden by this new value, and the previous value will be
        ignored.

    2.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-12" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-scroll"
        id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-scroll-2">scroll
        behavior</a> to
        `options`\["[`scroll`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-scroll)"\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigateevent-scroll" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigateEvent" dfn-type="method">`scroll()`</span> method steps
are:

1.  <a href="#navigateevent-perform-shared-checks"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:navigateevent-perform-shared-checks-2">Perform
    shared checks</a> given
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-13" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-14" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-3">interception
    state</a> is not "`committed`", then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-5"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-8">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  <a href="#process-scroll-behavior"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:process-scroll-behavior">Process scroll
    behavior</a> given <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:this-15" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigateevent-perform-shared-checks" class="dfn">perform
shared checks</span> for a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`:

1.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:fully-active">fully active</a>, then
    throw an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-6"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-9">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  If `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-istrusted"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:dom-event-istrusted-2">isTrusted</code></a>
    attribute was initialized to false, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:securityerror-4"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-10">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If `event`'s <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:canceled-flag"
    data-x-internal="canceled-flag">canceled flag</a> is set, then throw
    an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:invalidstateerror-7"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigateevent-interface:domexception-11">DOMException</code></a>.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10.2</span> The [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#navigationprecommitcontroller) interface<a href="#the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface"
class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
  interface NavigationPrecommitController {
    undefined redirect(USVString url, optional NavigationNavigateOptions options = {});
    undefined addHandler(NavigationInterceptHandler handler);
  };

  callback NavigationPrecommitHandler = Promise<undefined> (NavigationPrecommitController controller);
```

`precommitController``.`<a href="#dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-redirect"
id="dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-redirect-dev"><code>redirect</code></a>`(USVString ``url``, `<a href="#navigationnavigateoptions"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigationnavigateoptions-2"><code>NavigationNavigateOptions</code></a>` ``options``)`  
For "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations, sets the
[`destination.url`](#dom-navigationdestination-url) to `url`.

If `options` is given, also sets the [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info)
and the resulting [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry)'s
<a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationdestination-state">state</a>
to `options`'s [`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info) and
[`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state), if they are present.
The [`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history) option can also
switch between "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations types.

For "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations, an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
will be thrown.

If the current [`Document`](#document)
<a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:can-have-its-url-rewritten">cannot
have its URL rewritten</a> to `url`, a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:securityerror"
data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception">DOMException</code></a>
will be thrown.

`precommitController``.`<a href="#dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-addhandler"
id="dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-addhandler-dev"><code>addHandler</code></a>`(`<a href="#navigationintercepthandler"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigationintercepthandler-2"><code>NavigationInterceptHandler</code></a>` ``handler``)`  
Adds a <a href="#navigationintercepthandler"
id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigationintercepthandler-3">NavigationInterceptHandler</a>
callback that would be called once the navigation is committed, as if
this method was passed to the
[`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) method as a
[`handler`](#dom-navigationinterceptoptions-handler).

Each [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#navigationprecommitcontroller)
has a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent)
<span id="concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
class="dfn">event</span>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-redirect" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationPrecommitController"
dfn-type="method">`redirect(``url``, ``options``)`</span> method steps
are:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event">event</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state">interception
    state</a> is not "`none`".

2.  <a href="#navigateevent-perform-shared-checks"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigateevent-perform-shared-checks">Perform
    shared checks</a> given
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-2"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-2">event</a>.

3.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-3"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-3">event</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-2">interception
    state</a> is not "`intercepted`", then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:invalidstateerror-2"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-4"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-4">event</a>'s
    [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype) is neither
    "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" nor
    "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)", then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

5.  Let `document` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-5"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

6.  Let `destinationURL` be the result of <a href="#parse-a-url"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:parse-a-url">parsing</a>
    `url` given `document`.

7.  If `destinationURL` is failure, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:syntaxerror"
    data-x-internal="syntaxerror">"<code>SyntaxError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

8.  If `document` <a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:can-have-its-url-rewritten-2">cannot
    have its URL rewritten</a> to `destinationURL`, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:securityerror-2"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

9.  If
    `options`\["[`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history)"\]
    is "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)" or
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", then set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-6"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-5">event</a>'s
    [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype) to
    `options`\["[`history`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-history)"\].

10. If `options`\["[`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then:

    1.  Let `serializedState` be the result of calling
        <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(`options`\["[`state`](#dom-navigationreloadoptions-state)"\]).
        This may throw an exception.

    2.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-7"
        data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-6">event</a>'s
        [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationdestination-state-2">state</a>
        to `serializedState`.

    3.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-8"
        data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-7">event</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-target"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-event-target"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-target">target</a>'s
        <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:ongoing-api-method-tracker">ongoing
        API method tracker</a>'s
        <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-state"
        id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigation-api-method-tracker-state">serialized
        state</a> to `serializedState`.

11. Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-9"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-8">event</a>'s
    [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationdestination-url">URL</a>
    to `destinationURL`.

12. If `options`\["[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info)"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-10"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-9">event</a>'s
    [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) to
    `options`\["[`info`](#dom-navigationoptions-info)"\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationprecommitcontroller-addhandler" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationPrecommitController"
dfn-type="method">`addHandler(``handler``,)`</span> method steps are:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-11"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-10">event</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-3">interception
    state</a> is not "`none`".

2.  <a href="#navigateevent-perform-shared-checks"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:navigateevent-perform-shared-checks-2">Perform
    shared checks</a> given
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-12"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-11">event</a>.

3.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-13"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-12">event</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-4">interception
    state</a> is not "`intercepted`", then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:invalidstateerror-4"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:list-append"
    data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `handler` to
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:this-14"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event-13">event</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list"
    id="the-navigationprecommitcontroller-interface:concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list">navigation
    handler list</a>.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10.3</span> The [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) interface<a href="#the-navigationdestination-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationDestination {
  readonly attribute USVString url;
  readonly attribute DOMString key;
  readonly attribute DOMString id;
  readonly attribute long long index;
  readonly attribute boolean sameDocument;

  any getState();
};
```

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-url"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-url-2"><code>url</code></a>  
The URL being navigated to.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination-2"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-key"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-key-2"><code>key</code></a>  
The value of the [`key`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-key) property of
the destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), if
this is a "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigation, or
the empty string otherwise.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination-3"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-id"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-id-2"><code>id</code></a>  
The value of the [`id`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-id) property of the
destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), if this
is a "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigation, or the
empty string otherwise.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination-4"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-index"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-index-2"><code>index</code></a>  
The value of the [`index`](#dom-navigationhistoryentry-index) property
of the destination [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry),
if this is a "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigation, or
−1 otherwise.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination-5"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-samedocument"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-samedocument-2"><code>sameDocument</code></a>  
Indicates whether or not this navigation is to the same
[`Document`](#document) as the current one, or not. This will be true,
for example, in the case of fragment navigations or
[`history.pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate) navigations.

Note that this property indicates the original nature of the navigation.
If a cross-document navigation is converted into a same-document
navigation using
[`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept), that will
not change the value of this property.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigateevent-destination"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigateevent-destination-6"><code>destination</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationdestination-getstate"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:dom-navigationdestination-getstate-2"><code>getState</code></a>`()`  
For "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigations, returns
the <a href="#structureddeserialize"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:structureddeserialize">deserialization</a>
of the state stored in the destination <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a>.

For "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)" or
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)" navigations, returns the
<a href="#structureddeserialize"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:structureddeserialize-2">deserialization</a>
of the state passed to
[`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate), if the navigation
was initiated by that method, or undefined it if it wasn't.

For "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" navigations, returns the
<a href="#structureddeserialize"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:structureddeserialize-3">deserialization</a>
of the state passed to [`navigation.reload()`](#dom-navigation-reload),
if the reload was initiated by that method, or undefined it if it
wasn't.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) has a
<span id="concept-navigationdestination-url" class="dfn">URL</span>,
which is a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:url"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a>.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) has an
<span id="concept-navigationdestination-entry" class="dfn">entry</span>,
which is a [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) or null.

It will be non-null if and only if the
[`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) corresponds to a
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" navigation.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) has a
<span id="concept-navigationdestination-state" class="dfn">state</span>,
which is a <a href="#serialized-state"
id="the-navigationdestination-interface:serialized-state">serialized
state</a>.

Each [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) has an
<span id="concept-navigationdestination-samedocument" class="dfn">is
same document</span>, which is a boolean.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationdestination-url" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationDestination" dfn-type="attribute">`url`</span> getter

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"

    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
    id="the-navigationdestination-interface:concept-navigationdestination-entry-4">entry</a>'s

    id="the-navigationdestination-interface:concept-navigationhistoryentry-id">ID</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationdestination-index" class="dfn"

    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"

    is null, then return −1.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"

same document</a>.
