###### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10.4</span> Firing the event<a href="#navigate-event-firing" class="self-link"></a>

Other parts of the standard fire the [`navigate`](#event-navigate)
event, through a series of wrapper algorithms given in this section.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fire-a-traverse-navigate-event" class="dfn">fire a traverse
`navigate` event</span> at a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`
given a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigate-event-firing:session-history-entry">session history
entry</a> <span id="fire-navigate-traverse-destinationshe"
class="dfn">`destinationSHE`</span> and an optional
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="navigate-event-firing:user-navigation-involvement">user navigation
involvement</a> <span id="fire-navigate-traverse-userinvolvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span> (default "[`none`](#uni-none)"):

1.  Let `event` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-create"
    id="navigate-event-firing:creating-an-event"
    data-x-internal="creating-an-event">creating an event</a> given
    [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent), in `navigation`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm">relevant realm</a>.

2.  Set `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state">classic
    history API state</a> to null.

3.  Let `destination` be a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
    id="navigate-event-firing:new" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
    [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) created in
    `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant realm</a>.

4.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url">URL</a>
    to `destinationSHE`'s
    <a href="#she-url" id="navigate-event-firing:she-url">URL</a>.

5.  Let `destinationNHE` be the
    [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) in
    `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-entry-list">entry list</a>
    whose
    <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigate-event-firing:nhe-she">session history
    entry</a> is `destinationSHE`, or null if no such
    [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) exists.

6.  If `destinationNHE` is non-null, then:

    1.  Set `destination`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry">entry</a>
        to `destinationNHE`.

    2.  Set `destination`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-state">state</a>
        to `destinationSHE`'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
        id="navigate-event-firing:she-navigation-api-state">navigation API
        state</a>.

7.  Otherwise,

    1.  Set `destination`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-2">entry</a>
        to null.

    2.  Set `destination`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-state-2">state</a>
        to <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
        id="navigate-event-firing:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(null).

8.  Set `destination`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument">is
    same document</a> to true if `destinationSHE`'s
    <a href="#she-document"
    id="navigate-event-firing:she-document">document</a> is equal to
    `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>; otherwise false.

9.  Return the result of performing the
    <a href="#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm">inner
    <code>navigate</code> event firing algorithm</a> given `navigation`,
    "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", `event`,
    `destination`, `userInvolvement`, null, null, and null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event" class="dfn">fire
a push/replace/reload `navigate` event</span> at a
[`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation` given a
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype)
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-navigationtype"
class="dfn">`navigationType`</span>, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="navigate-event-firing:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-destinationurl"
class="dfn">`destinationURL`</span>, a boolean
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-issamedocument"
class="dfn">`isSameDocument`</span>, an optional
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="navigate-event-firing:user-navigation-involvement-2">user navigation
involvement</a> <span id="fire-navigate-prr-userinvolvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span> (default "[`none`](#uni-none)"), an
optional <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="navigate-event-firing:element">Element</code></a>-or-null
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-sourceelement"
class="dfn">`sourceElement`</span> (default null), an optional
<a href="#entry-list" id="navigate-event-firing:entry-list">entry
list</a>-or-null <span id="fire-navigate-prr-formdataentrylist"
class="dfn">`formDataEntryList`</span> (default null), an optional
<a href="#serialized-state"
id="navigate-event-firing:serialized-state">serialized state</a>
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-navigationapistate"
class="dfn">`navigationAPIState`</span> (default
<a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
id="navigate-event-firing:structuredserializeforstorage-2">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(null)),
an optional <a href="#serialized-state"
id="navigate-event-firing:serialized-state-2">serialized state</a>-or-null
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-classichistoryapistate"
class="dfn">`classicHistoryAPIState`</span> (default null), and an
optional <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation API
method tracker</a>-or-null
<span id="fire-navigate-prr-api-method-tracker"
class="dfn">`apiMethodTracker`</span>:

1.  Let `document` be `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  <a href="#inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation"
    id="navigate-event-firing:inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation">Inform
    the navigation API about aborting navigation</a> in `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="navigate-event-firing:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>.

3.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigate-event-firing:has-entries-and-events-disabled">has entries
    and events disabled</a>, and `apiMethodTracker` is not null:

    1.  Set `apiMethodTracker`'s
        <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
        id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-pending">pending</a>
        to false.

    2.  Set `apiMethodTracker` to null.

    If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigate-event-firing:has-entries-and-events-disabled-2">has entries
    and events disabled</a>, then
    [`navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) and
    [`reload()`](#dom-navigation-reload) calls return promises that will
    never fulfill. We never create a
    [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) object for such
    [`Document`](#document)s, there is no
    [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) to apply
    `serializedState` to, and there is no [`navigate`](#event-navigate)
    event to include `info` with. So, we don't need to track this API
    method call after all. We need to check this after aborting previous
    navigations, in case the [`Document`](#document) has became
    non-<a href="#fully-active" id="navigate-event-firing:fully-active">fully
    active</a> as a result of a [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror)
    event.

4.  If `document` is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="navigate-event-firing:fully-active-2">fully
    active</a>, then return false.

5.  Let `event` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-create"
    id="navigate-event-firing:creating-an-event-2"
    data-x-internal="creating-an-event">creating an event</a> given
    [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent), in `navigation`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-3">relevant realm</a>.

6.  Set `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state-2">classic
    history API state</a> to `classicHistoryAPIState`.

7.  Let `destination` be a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
    id="navigate-event-firing:new-2" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
    [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) created in
    `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-4">relevant realm</a>.

8.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url-2">URL</a>
    to `destinationURL`.

9.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-3">entry</a>
    to null.

10. Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-state-3">state</a>
    to `navigationAPIState`.

11. Set `destination`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-2">is
    same document</a> to `isSameDocument`.

12. Return the result of performing the
    <a href="#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm-2">inner
    <code>navigate</code> event firing algorithm</a> given `navigation`,
    `navigationType`, `event`, `destination`, `userInvolvement`,
    `sourceElement`, `formDataEntryList`, null, and `apiMethodTracker`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fire-a-download-request-navigate-event" class="dfn">fire a
download request `navigate` event</span> at a
[`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation` given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="navigate-event-firing:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
<span id="fire-navigate-download-destinationurl"
class="dfn">`destinationURL`</span>, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="navigate-event-firing:user-navigation-involvement-3">user navigation
involvement</a> <span id="fire-navigate-download-userinvolvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span>, an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="navigate-event-firing:element-2">Element</code></a>-or-null
<span id="fire-navigate-download-sourceelement"
class="dfn">`sourceElement`</span>, and a string
<span id="fire-navigate-download-filename"
class="dfn">`filename`</span>:

1.  Let `event` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-create"
    id="navigate-event-firing:creating-an-event-3"
    data-x-internal="creating-an-event">creating an event</a> given
    [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent), in `navigation`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-5">relevant realm</a>.

2.  Set `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state-3">classic
    history API state</a> to null.

3.  Let `destination` be a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
    id="navigate-event-firing:new-3" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
    [`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) created in
    `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-6">relevant realm</a>.

4.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url-3">URL</a>
    to `destinationURL`.

5.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-4">entry</a>
    to null.

6.  Set `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-state-4">state</a>
    to <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
    id="navigate-event-firing:structuredserializeforstorage-3">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(null).

7.  Set `destination`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-3">is
    same document</a> to false.

8.  Return the result of performing the
    <a href="#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm-3">inner
    <code>navigate</code> event firing algorithm</a> given `navigation`,
    "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)", `event`, `destination`,
    `userInvolvement`, `sourceElement`, null, and `filename`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm" class="dfn">inner
`navigate` event firing algorithm</span> consists of the following
steps, given a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype) `navigationType`, a
[`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`, a
[`NavigationDestination`](#navigationdestination) `destination`, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="navigate-event-firing:user-navigation-involvement-4">user navigation
involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="navigate-event-firing:element-3">Element</code></a>-or-null
`sourceElement`, an
<a href="#entry-list" id="navigate-event-firing:entry-list-2">entry
list</a>-or-null `formDataEntryList`, a string-or-null
`downloadRequestFilename`, and an optional
<a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-2">navigation
API method tracker</a>-or-null `apiMethodTracker` (default null):

1.  If `navigation` <a href="#has-entries-and-events-disabled"
    id="navigate-event-firing:has-entries-and-events-disabled-3">has entries
    and events disabled</a>, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
        id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-api-method-tracker">ongoing API method
        tracker</a> is null.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `navigation`'s <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
        id="navigate-event-firing:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers">upcoming
        traverse API method trackers</a>
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
        id="navigate-event-firing:list-is-empty"
        data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is empty</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-3" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `apiMethodTracker` is null.

    4.  Return true.

    These assertions holds because
    [`traverseTo()`](#dom-navigation-traverseto),
    [`back()`](#dom-navigation-back), and
    [`forward()`](#dom-navigation-forward) will immediately fail when
    entries and events are disabled (since there are no entries to
    traverse to).

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-firing:assert-4" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-api-method-tracker-2">ongoing API
    method tracker</a> is null.

3.  If `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-5">entry</a>
    is non-null:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-5" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `apiMethodTracker` is null.

        `apiMethodTracker` is passed as an argument only for
        [`navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate) and
        [`reload()`](#dom-navigation-reload) calls.

    2.  Let `destinationKey` be `destination`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-6">entry</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationhistoryentry-key"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationhistoryentry-key">key</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-6" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `destinationKey` is not the empty string.

    4.  If `navigation`'s
        <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
        id="navigate-event-firing:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-2">upcoming
        traverse API method trackers</a>\[`destinationKey`\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="navigate-event-firing:map-exists"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  Set `apiMethodTracker` to `navigation`'s
            <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
            id="navigate-event-firing:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-3">upcoming
            traverse API method trackers</a>\[`destinationKey`\].

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
            id="navigate-event-firing:map-remove"
            data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a> `navigation`'s
            <a href="#upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers"
            id="navigate-event-firing:upcoming-traverse-api-method-trackers-4">upcoming
            traverse API method trackers</a>\[`destinationKey`\].

4.  If `apiMethodTracker` is not null:

    1.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-api-method-tracker"
        id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-api-method-tracker-3">ongoing API
        method tracker</a> to `apiMethodTracker`.

    2.  Set `apiMethodTracker`'s
        <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-pending"
        id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-pending-2">pending</a>
        to false.

5.  Let `navigable` be `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigate-event-firing:window-navigable">navigable</a>.

6.  Let `document` be `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window-3">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

7.  If `document` <a href="#can-have-its-url-rewritten"
    id="navigate-event-firing:can-have-its-url-rewritten">can have its URL
    rewritten</a> to `destination`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url-4">URL</a>,
    and either `destination`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-4">is
    same document</a> is true or `navigationType` is not
    "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", then initialize
    `event`'s [`canIntercept`](#dom-navigateevent-canintercept) to true.
    Otherwise, initialize it to false.

8.  <div id="navigate-event-traverse-can-be-canceled">

    Let `traverseCanBeCanceled` be true if all of the following are
    true:

    - `navigable` is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
      id="navigate-event-firing:top-level-traversable">top-level
      traversable</a>;

    - `destination`'s
      <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-5">is
      same document</a> is true; and

    - either `userInvolvement` is not "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)",
      or `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant global
      object</a> has <a href="#history-action-activation"
      id="navigate-event-firing:history-action-activation">history-action
      activation</a>.

    Otherwise, let it be false.

    </div>

9.  If either:

    - `navigationType` is not
      "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)"; or

    - `traverseCanBeCanceled` is true,

    then initialize `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
    id="navigate-event-firing:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
    to true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.

10. Initialize `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-type"><code
    id="navigate-event-firing:dom-event-type">type</code></a> to
    "[`navigate`](#event-navigate)".

11. Initialize `event`'s
    [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype) to
    `navigationType`.

12. Initialize `event`'s [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)
    to `destination`.

13. Initialize `event`'s
    [`downloadRequest`](#dom-navigateevent-downloadrequest) to
    `downloadRequestFilename`.

14. If `apiMethodTracker` is not null, then initialize `event`'s
    [`info`](#dom-navigateevent-info) to `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-info"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-info">info</a>.
    Otherwise, initialize it to undefined.

    At this point `apiMethodTracker`'s
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-info"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-info-2">info</a>
    is no longer needed and can be nulled out instead of keeping it
    alive for the lifetime of the
    <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-3">navigation
    API method tracker</a>.

15. Initialize `event`'s
    [`hasUAVisualTransition`](#dom-navigateevent-hasuavisualtransition)
    to true if a visual transition, to display a cached rendered state
    of the `document`'s
    <a href="#latest-entry" id="navigate-event-firing:latest-entry">latest
    entry</a>, was done by the user agent. Otherwise, initialize it to
    false.

16. Initialize `event`'s
    [`sourceElement`](#dom-navigateevent-sourceelement) to
    `sourceElement`.

17. Set `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller">abort
    controller</a> to a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
    id="navigate-event-firing:new-4" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller"
    data-x-internal="abortcontroller"><code
    id="navigate-event-firing:abortcontroller">AbortController</code></a>
    created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-7">relevant realm</a>.

18. Initialize `event`'s [`signal`](#dom-navigateevent-signal) to
    `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-2">abort
    controller</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-abortcontroller-signal"
    data-x-internal="concept-abortcontroller-signal">signal</a>.

19. Let `currentURL` be `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="navigate-event-firing:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

20. If all of the following are true:

    - `event`'s
      <a href="#concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state-4">classic
      history API state</a> is null;

    - `destination`'s
      <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-6">is
      same document</a> is true;

    - `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url-5">URL</a>
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-url-equals"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-equals">equals</a> `currentURL` with
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments"
      id="navigate-event-firing:url-equals-exclude-fragments"
      data-x-internal="url-equals-exclude-fragments"><em>exclude
      fragments</em></a> set to true; and

    - `destination`'s <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-url"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-url-6">URL</a>'s
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-url-fragment"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> is not
      <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
      id="navigate-event-firing:identical-to"
      data-x-internal="identical-to">identical to</a> `currentURL`'s
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
      id="navigate-event-firing:concept-url-fragment-2"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>,

    then initialize `event`'s
    [`hashChange`](#dom-navigateevent-hashchange) to true. Otherwise,
    initialize it to false.

    The first condition here means that
    [`hashChange`](#dom-navigateevent-hashchange) will be true for
    <a href="#navigate-fragid"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigate-fragid">fragment navigations</a>,
    but false for cases like
    `history.pushState(undefined, "", "#fragment")`.

21. If `userInvolvement` is not "[`none`](#uni-none)", then initialize
    `event`'s [`userInitiated`](#dom-navigateevent-userinitiated) to
    true. Otherwise, initialize it to false.

22. If `formDataEntryList` is not null, then initialize `event`'s
    [`formData`](#dom-navigateevent-formdata) to a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
    id="navigate-event-firing:new-5" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
    <a href="https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata"
    data-x-internal="formdata"><code
    id="navigate-event-firing:formdata">FormData</code></a> created in
    `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-8">relevant realm</a>,
    associated to `formDataEntryList`. Otherwise, initialize it to null.

23. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-firing:assert-7" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-navigate-event">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a> is null.

24. Set `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-navigate-event-2">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a> to `event`.

25. Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="navigate-event-firing:focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation">focus
    changed during ongoing navigation</a> to false.

26. Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="navigate-event-firing:suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation">suppress
    normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation</a> to false.

27. Let `dispatchResult` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-dispatch"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-event-dispatch"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-dispatch">dispatching</a> `event` at
    `navigation`.

28. If `dispatchResult` is false:

    1.  If `navigationType` is
        "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", then
        <a href="#consume-history-action-user-activation"
        id="navigate-event-firing:consume-history-action-user-activation">consume
        history-action user activation</a> given `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-6">relevant global
        object</a>.

    2.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-3">abort
        controller</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-abortcontroller-signal-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-abortcontroller-signal">signal</a> is
        not <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-aborted"
        id="navigate-event-firing:abortsignal-aborted"
        data-x-internal="abortsignal-aborted">aborted</a>, then
        <a href="#abort-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="navigate-event-firing:abort-the-ongoing-navigation">abort the
        ongoing navigation</a> given `navigation`.

    3.  Return false.

29. If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state">interception
    state</a> is not "`none`":

    1.  Let `fromNHE` be the <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
        id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-current-entry">current entry</a>
        of `navigation`.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-8" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `fromNHE` is not null.

    3.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition">transition</a>
        to a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
        id="navigate-event-firing:new-6" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
        [`NavigationTransition`](#navigationtransition) created in
        `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-9">relevant realm</a>,
        with

        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-navigationtype"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-navigationtype">navigation
        type</a>  
        `navigationType`

        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-from"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-from">from
        entry</a>  
        `fromNHE`

        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-destination"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-destination">destination</a>  
        `event`'s [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)

        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-committed"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-committed">committed
        promise</a>  
        a new promise created in `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-10">relevant realm</a>

        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-finished"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-finished">finished
        promise</a>  
        a new promise created in `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-11">relevant realm</a>

    4.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled"
        id="navigate-event-firing:mark-as-handled"
        data-x-internal="mark-as-handled">Mark as handled</a>
        `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-2">transition</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-finished"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-finished-2">finished
        promise</a>.

        See the [discussion about other finished
        promises](#note-mark-as-handled-navigation-api-finished) to
        understand why this is done.

    5.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#mark-a-promise-as-handled"
        id="navigate-event-firing:mark-as-handled-2"
        data-x-internal="mark-as-handled">Mark as handled</a>
        `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-3">transition</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-committed"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-committed-2">committed
        promise</a>.

30. If `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list">navigation
    precommit handler list</a>
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
    id="navigate-event-firing:list-is-empty-2"
    data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is empty</a> then
    <a href="#commit-a-navigate-event"
    id="navigate-event-firing:commit-a-navigate-event">commit</a>
    `event` given `apiMethodTracker`.

31. Otherwise:

    1.  Let `precommitController` be a new
        [`NavigationPrecommitController`](#navigationprecommitcontroller)
        created in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-realm-12">relevant realm</a>,
        whose <a href="#concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationprecommitcontroller-event">event</a>
        is `event`.

    2.  Let `precommitPromisesList` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="navigate-event-firing:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="navigate-event-firing:list-iterate"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `handler` of
        `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list-2">navigation
        precommit handler list</a>:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="navigate-event-firing:list-append"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> the result of
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function"
            id="navigate-event-firing:es-invoking-callback-functions"
            data-x-internal="es-invoking-callback-functions">invoking</a>
            `handler` with « `precommitController` » to
            `precommitPromisesList`.

    4.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all"
        id="navigate-event-firing:wait-for-all"
        data-x-internal="wait-for-all">Wait for all</a>
        `precommitPromisesList` with the following success steps:
        <a href="#commit-a-navigate-event"
        id="navigate-event-firing:commit-a-navigate-event-2">commit</a>
        `event` given `apiMethodTracker`, and the following failure step
        given `reason`:
        <a href="#process-navigate-event-handler-failure"
        id="navigate-event-firing:process-navigate-event-handler-failure">process
        navigate event handler failure</a> given `event` and `reason`.

32. If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-2">interception
    state</a> is "`none`", then return true.

33. Return false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="navigate-event-intercept-commit-handler-steps"
class="dfn">navigate event intercept commit handler steps</span>, given
a [`Navigation`](#navigation) `navigation`, a
[`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) object `event`, and a
<a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-4">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker` are as follows:

1.  Let `promisesList` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="navigate-event-firing:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="navigate-event-firing:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `handler` of `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-navigation-handler-list">navigation
    handler list</a>:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="navigate-event-firing:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> the result of
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function"
        id="navigate-event-firing:es-invoking-callback-functions-2"
        data-x-internal="es-invoking-callback-functions">invoking</a>
        `handler` with an empty arguments list to `promisesList`.

3.  If `promisesList`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="navigate-event-firing:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> is 0, then set `promisesList`
    to «
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-resolved-with"
    id="navigate-event-firing:a-promise-resolved-with"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-resolved-with">a promise resolved with</a>
    undefined ».

    There is a subtle timing difference between how
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all"
    id="navigate-event-firing:wait-for-all-2"
    data-x-internal="wait-for-all">waiting for all</a> schedules its
    success and failure steps when given zero promises versus ≥1
    promises. For most uses of
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all"
    id="navigate-event-firing:wait-for-all-3"
    data-x-internal="wait-for-all">waiting for all</a>, this does not
    matter. However, with this API, there are so many events and promise
    handlers which could fire around the same time that the difference
    is pretty easily observable: it can cause the event/promise handler
    sequence to vary. (Some of the events and promises involved include:
    [`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) /
    [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror),
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange),
    [`dispose`](#event-dispose), `apiMethodTracker`'s promises, and the
    [`navigation.transition.finished`](#dom-navigationtransition-finished)
    promise.)

4.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#wait-for-all"
    id="navigate-event-firing:wait-for-all-4"
    data-x-internal="wait-for-all">Wait for all</a> of `promisesList`,
    with the following success steps:

    1.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant global
        object</a> is not
        <a href="#fully-active" id="navigate-event-firing:fully-active-3">fully
        active</a>, then abort these steps.

    2.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-4">abort
        controller</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-abortcontroller-signal-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-abortcontroller-signal">signal</a> is
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-aborted"
        id="navigate-event-firing:abortsignal-aborted-2"
        data-x-internal="abortsignal-aborted">aborted</a>, then abort
        these steps.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-firing:assert-9" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `event` equals `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
        id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-navigate-event-3">ongoing
        <code>navigate</code> event</a>.

    4.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
        id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-navigate-event-4">ongoing
        <code>navigate</code> event</a> to null.

    5.  <a href="#navigateevent-finish"
        id="navigate-event-firing:navigateevent-finish">Finish</a>
        `event` given true.

    6.  If `apiMethodTracker` is non-null, then
        <a href="#resolve-the-finished-promise"
        id="navigate-event-firing:resolve-the-finished-promise">resolve the
        finished promise</a> for `apiMethodTracker`.

    7.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-event-fire"
        data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
        [`navigatesuccess`](#event-navigatesuccess) at `navigation`.

    8.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-4">transition</a>
        is not null, then resolve `navigation`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-5">transition</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-finished"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-finished-3">finished
        promise</a> with undefined.

    9.  Set `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-6">transition</a>
        to null.

    and the following failure step given `reason`:
    <a href="#process-navigate-event-handler-failure"
    id="navigate-event-firing:process-navigate-event-handler-failure-2">process
    navigate event handler failure</a> given `event` and `reason`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="commit-a-navigate-event" class="dfn">commit a navigate
event</span> given a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) object `event`
and a <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-5">navigation
API method tracker</a> `apiMethodTracker`:

1.  Let `navigation` be `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-target"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-event-target"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-target">target</a>.

2.  Let `navigable` be `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-8">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigate-event-firing:window-navigable-2">navigable</a>.

3.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-9">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window-4">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="navigate-event-firing:fully-active-4">fully
    active</a>, then return.

4.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-5">abort
    controller</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-abortcontroller-signal-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-abortcontroller-signal">signal</a> is
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-aborted"
    id="navigate-event-firing:abortsignal-aborted-3"
    data-x-internal="abortsignal-aborted">aborted</a>, then return.

5.  Let `endResultIsSameDocument` be true if `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-3">interception
    state</a> is not "`none`" or `event`'s
    [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-samedocument"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-samedocument-7">is
    same document</a> is true.

6.  <a href="#prepare-to-run-script"
    id="navigate-event-firing:prepare-to-run-script">Prepare to run
    script</a> given `navigation`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="navigate-event-firing:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
    object</a>.

    <div id="note-suppress-microtasks-during-navigation-events"
    class="note">

    <a href="#note-suppress-microtasks-during-navigation-events"
    class="self-link"></a>
    This is done to avoid the
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack"
    id="navigate-event-firing:javascript-execution-context-stack"
    data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context-stack">JavaScript
    execution context stack</a> becoming empty right after any
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) event handlers run
    as a result of the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
    id="navigate-event-firing:url-and-history-update-steps">URL and history
    update steps</a> that could soon happen. If the stack were to become
    empty at that time, then it would immediately
    <a href="#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint"
    id="navigate-event-firing:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint">perform a
    microtask checkpoint</a>, causing various promise fulfillment
    handlers to run interleaved with the event handlers and before any
    handlers passed to
    [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept). This is
    undesirable since it means promise handler ordering vs.
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) event handler
    ordering vs. [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) handler
    ordering would be dependent on whether the navigation is happening
    with an empty
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#execution-context-stack"
    id="navigate-event-firing:javascript-execution-context-stack-2"
    data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context-stack">JavaScript
    execution context stack</a> (e.g., because the navigation was
    user-initiated) or with a nonempty one (e.g., because the navigation
    was caused by a JavaScript API call).

    By inserting an otherwise-unnecessary
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-execution-contexts"
    id="navigate-event-firing:javascript-execution-context"
    data-x-internal="javascript-execution-context">JavaScript execution
    context</a> onto the stack in this step, we essentially suppress the
    <a href="#perform-a-microtask-checkpoint"
    id="navigate-event-firing:perform-a-microtask-checkpoint-2">perform a
    microtask checkpoint</a> algorithm until later, thus ensuring that
    the sequence is always:
    [`currententrychange`](#event-currententrychange) event handlers,
    then [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) handlers, then
    promise handlers.

    </div>

7.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-4">interception
    state</a> is not "`none`":

    1.  Set `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-5">interception
        state</a> to "`committed`".

    2.  Switch on `event`'s
        [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype):

        "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)"  
        "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)"  
        Run the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
        id="navigate-event-firing:url-and-history-update-steps-2">URL and
        history update steps</a> given `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-10">relevant global
        object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window-5">associated
        <code>Document</code></a> and `event`'s
        [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)'s
        <a href="#dom-navigationdestination-url"
        id="navigate-event-firing:dom-navigationdestination-url">URL</a>,
        with *[serializedData](#uhus-serializeddata)* set to `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state"
        id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-classic-history-api-state-5">classic
        history API state</a> and
        *[historyHandling](#uhus-historyhandling)* set to `event`'s
        [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype).

        "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)"  
        <a
        href="#update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation"
        id="navigate-event-firing:update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation">Update
        the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation</a>
        given `navigation`, `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="navigate-event-firing:nav-active-history-entry">active session
        history entry</a>, and "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)".

        "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)"  
        1.  Set `navigation`'s
            <a href="#suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
            id="navigate-event-firing:suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation-2">suppress
            normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation</a> to
            true.

            If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-scroll"
            id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-scroll">scroll
            behavior</a> was set to
            "[`after-transition`](#dom-navigationscrollbehavior-after-transition)",
            then scroll restoration will happen as part of
            <a href="#navigateevent-finish"
            id="navigate-event-firing:navigateevent-finish-2">finishing</a>
            the relevant [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent). Otherwise,
            there will be no scroll restoration. That is, no navigation
            which is intercepted by
            [`intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept) goes through
            the normal scroll restoration process; scroll restoration
            for such navigations is either done manually, by the web
            developer, or is done after the transition.

        2.  Let `userInvolvement` be "[`none`](#uni-none)".

        3.  If `event`'s
            [`userInitiated`](#dom-navigateevent-userinitiated) is true,
            then set `userInvolvement` to
            "[`activation`](#uni-activation)".

            At this point after interception, it is not consequential
            whether the activation was a result of browser UI.

        4.  <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
            id="navigate-event-firing:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
            the following session history traversal steps</a> to
            `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
            id="navigate-event-firing:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>:

            1.  <a href="#resume-applying-the-traverse-history-step"
                id="navigate-event-firing:resume-applying-the-traverse-history-step">Resume
                applying the traverse history step</a> given `event`'s
                [`destination`](#dom-navigateevent-destination)'s
                <a href="#concept-navigationdestination-entry"
                id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationdestination-entry-7">entry</a>'s
                <a href="#nhe-she" id="navigate-event-firing:nhe-she-2">session history
                entry</a>'s
                <a href="#she-step" id="navigate-event-firing:she-step">step</a>,
                `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
                id="navigate-event-firing:nav-traversable-2">traversable navigable</a>,
                and `userInvolvement`.

8.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-7">transition</a>
    is not null, then resolve `navigation`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigation-transition"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigation-transition-8">transition</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-navigationtransition-committed"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigationtransition-committed-3">committed
    promise</a> with undefined.

9.  If `endResultIsSameDocument` is false and `apiMethodTracker` is
    non-null, then <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigation-api-method-tracker-clean-up">clean
    up</a> `apiMethodTracker`.

10. <a href="#clean-up-after-running-script"
    id="navigate-event-firing:clean-up-after-running-script">Clean up after
    running script</a> given `navigation`'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="navigate-event-firing:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant settings
    object</a>.

    Per the [previous
    note](#note-suppress-microtasks-during-navigation-events), this
    stops suppressing any potential promise handler microtasks, causing
    them to run at this point or later.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="process-navigate-event-handler-failure" class="dfn">process
navigate event handler failure</span> given a
[`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) object `event` and a `reason`:

1.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-11">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-document-window-6">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="navigate-event-firing:fully-active-5">fully
    active</a>, then return.

2.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-abort-controller"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-abort-controller-6">abort
    controller</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortcontroller-signal"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-abortcontroller-signal-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-abortcontroller-signal">signal</a> is
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#abortsignal-aborted"
    id="navigate-event-firing:abortsignal-aborted-4"
    data-x-internal="abortsignal-aborted">aborted</a>, then return.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-firing:assert-10" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `event` is `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-relevant-global-12">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="navigate-event-firing:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>'s
    <a href="#ongoing-navigate-event"
    id="navigate-event-firing:ongoing-navigate-event-5">ongoing
    <code>navigate</code> event</a>.

4.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-firing:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-6">interception
    state</a> is not "`intercepted`", then
    <a href="#navigateevent-finish"
    id="navigate-event-firing:navigateevent-finish-3">finish</a> `event`
    given false.

5.  <a href="#abort-a-navigateevent"
    id="navigate-event-firing:abort-a-navigateevent">Abort</a> `event`
    given `reason`.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.2.6.10.5</span> Scroll and focus behavior<a href="#navigate-event-scroll-focus" class="self-link"></a>

By calling [`navigateEvent.intercept()`](#dom-navigateevent-intercept),
web developers can suppress the normal scroll and focus behavior for
same-document navigations, instead invoking cross-document
navigation-like behavior at a later time. The algorithms in this section
are called at those appropriate later points.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigateevent-finish" class="dfn">finish</span> a
[`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`, given a boolean `didFulfill`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state">interception
    state</a> is not "`finished`".

2.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-2">interception
    state</a> is "`intercepted`", then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert-2"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `didFulfill` is false.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert-3"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-navigation-precommit-handler-list">navigation
        precommit handler list</a>
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:list-is-empty"
        data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is not empty</a>.

        Only precommit handlers can cancel a navigation before it is
        committed.

    3.  Set `event`'s
        <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-3">interception
        state</a> to "`finished`".

    4.  Return.

3.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-4">interception
    state</a> is "`none`", then return.

4.  <a href="#potentially-reset-the-focus"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:potentially-reset-the-focus">Potentially
    reset the focus</a> given `event`.

5.  If `didFulfill` is true, then
    <a href="#potentially-process-scroll-behavior"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:potentially-process-scroll-behavior">potentially
    process scroll behavior</a> given `event`.

6.  Set `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-5">interception
    state</a> to "`finished`".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="potentially-reset-the-focus" class="dfn">potentially reset
the focus</span> given a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert-4"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-6">interception
    state</a> is "`committed`" or "`scrolled`".

2.  Let `navigation` be `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:window-navigation-api">navigation
    API</a>.

3.  Let `focusChanged` be `navigation`'s
    <a href="#focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation">focus
    changed during ongoing navigation</a>.

4.  Set `navigation`'s
    <a href="#focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:focus-changed-during-ongoing-navigation-2">focus
    changed during ongoing navigation</a> to false.

5.  If `focusChanged` is true, then return.

6.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-focusreset"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-focusreset">focus
    reset behavior</a> is
    "[`manual`](#dom-navigationfocusreset-manual)", then return.

    If it was left as null, then we treat that as
    "[`after-transition`](#dom-navigationfocusreset-after-transition)",
    and continue onward.

7.  Let `document` be `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

8.  Let `focusTarget` be the <a href="#autofocus-delegate"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:autofocus-delegate">autofocus
    delegate</a> for `document`.

9.  If `focusTarget` is null, then set `focusTarget` to `document`'s
    <a href="#the-body-element-2"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:the-body-element-2">body element</a>.

10. If `focusTarget` is null, then set `focusTarget` to `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:document-element"
    data-x-internal="document-element">document element</a>.

11. Run the <a href="#focusing-steps"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:focusing-steps">focusing steps</a>
    for `focusTarget`, with `document`'s
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:viewport"
    data-x-internal="viewport">viewport</a> as the *fallback target*.

12. Move the <a href="#sequential-focus-navigation-starting-point"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:sequential-focus-navigation-starting-point">sequential
    focus navigation starting point</a> to `focusTarget`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="potentially-process-scroll-behavior"
class="dfn">potentially process scroll behavior</span> given a
[`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert-5"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-7">interception
    state</a> is "`committed`" or "`scrolled`".

2.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-8">interception
    state</a> is "`scrolled`", then return.

3.  If `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-scroll"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-scroll">scroll
    behavior</a> is "[`manual`](#dom-navigationscrollbehavior-manual)",
    then return.

    If it was left as null, then we treat that as
    "[`after-transition`](#dom-navigationscrollbehavior-after-transition)",
    and continue onward.

4.  <a href="#process-scroll-behavior"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:process-scroll-behavior">Process scroll
    behavior</a> given `event`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="process-scroll-behavior" class="dfn">process scroll
behavior</span> given a [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) `event`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:assert-6"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-9">interception
    state</a> is "`committed`".

2.  Set `event`'s <a href="#concept-navigateevent-interception-state"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-navigateevent-interception-state-10">interception
    state</a> to "`scrolled`".

3.  If `event`'s [`navigationType`](#dom-navigateevent-navigationtype)
    was initialized to "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)" or
    "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", then
    <a href="#restore-scroll-position-data"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:restore-scroll-position-data">restore
    scroll position data</a> given `event`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigable"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:window-navigable">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:nav-active-history-entry">active session
    history entry</a>.

4.  Otherwise:

    1.  Let `document` be `event`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant
        global object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:concept-document-window-2">associated
        <code>Document</code></a>.

    2.  If `document`'s <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:the-indicated-part-of-the-document">indicated
        part</a> is null, then <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document"
        data-x-internal="scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document">scroll to the
        beginning of the document</a> given `document`.
        [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#refsCSSOMVIEW)

    3.  Otherwise, <a href="#scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier"
        id="navigate-event-scroll-focus:scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier">scroll
        to the fragment</a> given `document`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.2.7</span> Event interfaces<a href="#nav-traversal-event-interfaces" class="self-link"></a>

The [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent) interface has [its own dedicated
section](#the-navigate-event), due to its complexity.

##### <span class="secno">7.2.7.1</span> The [`NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent`](#navigationcurrententrychangeevent) interface<a href="#the-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-interface"
class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEventInit eventInitDict);

  readonly attribute NavigationType? navigationType;
  readonly attribute NavigationHistoryEntry from;
};

dictionary NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationType? navigationType = null;
  required NavigationHistoryEntry from;
};
```

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-navigationtype"
id="dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-navigationtype-dev"><code>navigationType</code></a>  
Returns the type of navigation which caused the current entry to change,
or null if the change is due to
[`navigation.updateCurrentEntry()`](#dom-navigation-updatecurrententry).

`event``.`<a href="#dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-from"
id="dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-from-dev"><code>from</code></a>  
Returns the previous value of
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry), before the
current entry changed.

If
[`navigationType`](#dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-navigationtype)
is null or "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", then this value
will be the same as
[`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry). In that case,
the event signifies that the contents of the entry changed, even if we
did not move to a new entry or replace the current one.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-navigationtype"
class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent"
dfn-type="attribute">`navigationType`</span> and
<span id="dom-navigationcurrententrychangeevent-from" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NavigationCurrentEntryChangeEvent"
dfn-type="attribute">`from`</span> attributes must return the values
they were initialized to.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.2.7.4</span> The [`PageSwapEvent`](#pageswapevent) interface<a href="#the-pageswapevent-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface PageSwapEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional PageSwapEventInit eventInitDict = {});
  readonly attribute NavigationActivation? activation;
  readonly attribute ViewTransition? viewTransition;
};

dictionary PageSwapEventInit : EventInit {
  NavigationActivation? activation = null;
  ViewTransition? viewTransition = null;
};
```

`event``.`<a href="#dom-pageswapevent-activation"
id="dom-pageswapevent-activation-dev"><code>activation</code></a>  
A [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) object representing
the destination and type of the cross-document navigation. This would be
null for cross-origin navigations.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-pageswapevent-activation"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-pageswapevent-activation-2"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-entry"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-navigationactivation-entry"><code>entry</code></a>  
A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), representing the
[`Document`](#document) that is about to become active.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-pageswapevent-activation"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-pageswapevent-activation-3"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-from"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-navigationactivation-from"><code>from</code></a>  
A [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry), equivalent to the
value of the [`navigation.currentEntry`](#dom-navigation-currententry)
property at the moment the event is fired.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-pageswapevent-activation"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-pageswapevent-activation-4"><code>activation</code></a>`.`<a href="#dom-navigationactivation-navigationtype"
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:dom-navigationactivation-navigationtype"><code>navigationType</code></a>  
One of "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)",
"[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)",
"[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)", or
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)", indicating what type of
navigation that is about to result in a page swap.

`event``.`<a href="#dom-pageswapevent-viewtransition"
id="dom-pageswapevent-viewtransition-dev"><code>viewTransition</code></a>  
Returns the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#viewtransition"
data-x-internal="viewtransition"><code
id="the-pageswapevent-interface:viewtransition-3">ViewTransition</code></a>
object that represents an outbound cross-document view transition, if
such transition is active when the event is fired. Otherwise, returns
null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-pageswapevent-activation" class="dfn"
dfn-for="PageSwapEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`activation`</span> and
<span id="dom-pageswapevent-viewtransition" class="dfn"
dfn-for="PageSwapEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`viewTransition`</span>
attributes must return the values they were initialized to.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer11</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios yes">Safari
iOS4+</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android yes">WebView
Android37+</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

For the [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) event, returns false if the page
is newly being loaded (and the [`load`](#event-load) event will fire).
Otherwise, returns true.

For the [`pagehide`](#event-pagehide) event, returns false if the page
is going away for the last time. Otherwise, returns true, meaning that
the page might be reused if the user navigates back to this page (if the
[`Document`](#document)'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
state stays true).

Things that can cause the page to be unsalvageable include:

- The user agent decided to not keep the [`Document`](#document) alive
  in a <a href="#session-history-entry"
  id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:session-history-entry">session
  history entry</a> after <a href="#unload-a-document"
  id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:unload-a-document">unload</a>

- Having [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element)s that are not
  *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*

- Active <a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket"
  data-x-internal="websocket-2"><code
  id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:websocket-2">WebSocket</code></a>
  objects

- <a href="#abort-a-document"
  id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:abort-a-document">Aborting a
  <code>Document</code></a>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-pagetransitionevent-persisted" class="dfn"
dfn-for="PageTransitionEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`persisted`</span>
attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents the
context information for the event.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fire-a-page-transition-event" class="dfn">fire a page
transition event</span> named `eventName` at a [`Window`](#window)
`window` with a boolean `persisted`,
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:concept-event-fire"
data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named `eventName`
at `window`, using [`PageTransitionEvent`](#pagetransitionevent), with
the [`persisted`](#dom-pagetransitionevent-persisted) attribute
initialized to `persisted`, the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
attribute initialized to true, the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:dom-event-bubbles">bubbles</code></a>
attribute initialized to true, and *legacy target override flag* set.

</div>

The values for
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:dom-event-cancelable-2">cancelable</code></a>
and <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles"
data-x-internal="dom-event-bubbles"><code
id="the-pagetransitionevent-interface:dom-event-bubbles-2">bubbles</code></a>
don't make any sense, since canceling the event does nothing and it's
not possible to bubble past the [`Window`](#window) object. They are set
to true for historical reasons.

##### <span class="secno">7.2.7.7</span> The [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#beforeunloadevent) interface<a href="#the-beforeunloadevent-interface" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[BeforeUnloadEvent](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/BeforeUnloadEvent "BeforeUnloadEvent is an interface for the beforeunload event.")

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge unknown">Edge
(Legacy)?</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer4+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android yes">WebView
Android37+</span><span class="samsunginternet_android yes">Samsung
Internet3.0+</span><span class="opera_android unknown">Opera
Android?</span>
