``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface BeforeUnloadEvent : Event {
  attribute DOMString returnValue;
};
```

There are no [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#beforeunloadevent)-specific
initialization methods.

The [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#beforeunloadevent) interface is a legacy
interface which allows <a href="#checking-if-unloading-is-canceled"
id="the-beforeunloadevent-interface:checking-if-unloading-is-canceled">checking
if unloading is canceled</a> to be controlled not only by canceling the
event, but by setting the
[`returnValue`](#dom-beforeunloadevent-returnvalue) attribute to a value
besides the empty string. Authors should use the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-preventdefault"
data-x-internal="dom-event-preventdefault"><code
id="the-beforeunloadevent-interface:dom-event-preventdefault">preventDefault()</code></a>
method, or other means of canceling events, instead of using
[`returnValue`](#dom-beforeunloadevent-returnvalue).

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-beforeunloadevent-returnvalue" class="dfn"
dfn-for="BeforeUnloadEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`returnValue`</span>
attribute controls the process of
<a href="#checking-if-unloading-is-canceled"
id="the-beforeunloadevent-interface:checking-if-unloading-is-canceled-2">checking
if unloading is canceled</a>. When the event is created, the attribute
must be set to the empty string. On getting, it must return the last
value it was set to. On setting, the attribute must be set to the new
value.

</div>

This attribute is a `DOMString` only for historical reasons. Any value
besides the empty string will be treated as a request to ask the user
for confirmation.

#### <span class="secno">7.2.8</span> The [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) interface<a href="#the-notrestoredreasons-interface" class="self-link"></a>

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface NotRestoredReasonDetails {
  readonly attribute DOMString reason;
  [Default] object toJSON();
};

[Exposed=Window]
interface NotRestoredReasons {
  readonly attribute USVString? src;
  readonly attribute DOMString? id;
  readonly attribute DOMString? name;
  readonly attribute USVString? url;
  readonly attribute FrozenArray<NotRestoredReasonDetails>? reasons;
  readonly attribute FrozenArray<NotRestoredReasons>? children;
  [Default] object toJSON();
};
```

`notRestoredReasonDetails``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reason-details-reason"
id="dom-not-restored-reason-details-reason-dev"><code>reason</code></a>  
Returns a string that explains the reason that prevented the document
from [being served from back/forward cache](#note-bfcache). See the
definition of <a href="#concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details">bfcache
blocking details</a> for the possible string values.

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-src"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-src-dev"><code>src</code></a>  
Returns the [`src`](#attr-iframe-src) attribute of the document's
<a href="#node-navigable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:node-navigable">node navigable</a>'s
<a href="#nav-container"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nav-container">container</a> if it
is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if not
set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-id"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-id-dev"><code>id</code></a>  
Returns the [`id`](#the-id-attribute) attribute of the document's
<a href="#node-navigable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:node-navigable-2">node
navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-container"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nav-container-2">container</a> if
it is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if
not set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-name"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-name-dev"><code>name</code></a>  
Returns the [`name`](#attr-iframe-name) attribute of the document's
<a href="#node-navigable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:node-navigable-3">node
navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-container"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nav-container-3">container</a> if
it is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element. This can be null if
not set or if it is not an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element.

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-url"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-url-dev"><code>url</code></a>  
Returns the document's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>, or null if the
document is in a cross-origin [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element). This is
reported in addition to [`src`](#dom-not-restored-reasons-src) because
it is possible [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) navigated since the
original [`src`](#attr-iframe-src) was set.

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-reasons"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-reasons-dev"><code>reasons</code></a>  
Returns an array of
[`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#notrestoredreasondetails) for the
document. This is null if the document is in a cross-origin
[`iframe`](#the-iframe-element).

`notRestoredReasons``.`<a href="#dom-not-restored-reasons-children"
id="dom-not-restored-reasons-children-dev"><code>children</code></a>  
Returns an array of [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) that are
for the document’s children. This is null if the document is in a
cross-origin [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element).

A [`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#notrestoredreasondetails) object has a
<span id="concept-not-restored-reason-details-backing-struct"
class="dfn">backing struct</span>, a <a href="#nrr-details-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-details-struct">not restored
reason details</a> or null, initially null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reason-details-reason" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasonDetails" dfn-type="attribute">`reason`</span>
getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-not-restored-reason-details-backing-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reason-details-backing-struct">backing
struct</a>'s <a href="#nrr-details-reason"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-details-reason">reason</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-notrestoredreasondetails-object"
class="dfn">create a `NotRestoredReasonDetails` object</span> given a
<a href="#nrr-details-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-details-struct-2">not restored
reason details</a> `backingStruct` and a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-code-realms"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:realm"
data-x-internal="realm">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `notRestoredReasonDetails` be a new
    [`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#notrestoredreasondetails) object
    created in `realm`.

2.  Set `notRestoredReasonDetails`'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reason-details-backing-struct"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reason-details-backing-struct-2">backing
    struct</a> to `backingStruct`.

3.  Return `notRestoredReasonDetails`.

</div>

A <span id="nrr-details-struct" class="dfn" export="">not restored
reason details</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:struct"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="nrr-details-reason" class="dfn">reason</span>, a string,
  initially empty.

The <a href="#nrr-details-reason"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-details-reason-2">reason</a> is
a string that represents the reason that prevented the page from being
restored from [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache). The string is one of
the following:

"<span id="blocking-fetch" class="dfn">`fetch`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document">unloading</a>, a
fetch initiated by this [`Document`](#document) was still ongoing and
was canceled, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in the
[back/forward cache](#note-bfcache).

"<span id="blocking-navigation-failure" class="dfn">`navigation-failure`</span>"  
The original navigation that created this [`Document`](#document)
errored, so storing the resulting error document in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache) was prevented.

"<span id="blocking-parser-aborted" class="dfn">`parser-aborted`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) never finished its initial HTML parsing, so
storing the unfinished document in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache) was prevented.

"<span id="blocking-websocket" class="dfn">`websocket`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-2">unloading</a>,
an open <a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket"
data-x-internal="websocket-2"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:websocket-2">WebSocket</code></a>
connection was shut down, so the page was not in a state that could be
stored in the [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache).
[\[WEBSOCKETS\]](#refsWEBSOCKETS)

"<span id="blocking-weblock" class="dfn" export="">`lock`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-3">unloading</a>,
held <a href="https://w3c.github.io/web-locks/#lock-concept"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:locks"
data-x-internal="locks">locks</a> and
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/web-locks/#lock-request"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:lock-requests"
data-x-internal="lock-requests">lock requests</a> were terminated, so
the page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache). [\[WEBLOCKS\]](#refsWEBLOCKS)

"<span id="blocking-masked" class="dfn" export="">`masked`</span>"  
This [`Document`](#document) has children that are in a cross-origin
[`iframe`](#the-iframe-element), and they prevented [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache); or this [`Document`](#document) could not be
[back/forward cached](#note-bfcache) for user agent-specific reasons,
and the user agent has chosen not to use one of the more specific
reasons from the list of <a href="#ua-specific-blocking-reasons"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:ua-specific-blocking-reasons">user-agent
specific blocking reasons</a>.

In addition to the list above, a user agent might choose to expose a
reason that prevented the page from being restored from [back/forward
cache](note-bfcache) for <span id="ua-specific-blocking-reasons"
class="dfn">user-agent specific blocking reasons</span>. These are one
of the following strings:

"<span id="blocking-audio-capture" class="dfn" export="">`audio-capture`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) requested audio capture permission by using
Media Capture and Streams's <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#dom-mediadevices-getusermedia"
data-x-internal="getusermedia()"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:getusermedia()">getUserMedia()</code></a>
with audio. [\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#refsMEDIASTREAM)

"<span id="blocking-background-work" class="dfn" export="">`background-work`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) requested background work by calling
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/background-sync/spec/#syncmanager"
data-x-internal="syncmanager"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:syncmanager">SyncManager</code></a>'s
<a
href="https://wicg.github.io/background-sync/spec/#dom-syncmanager-register"
data-x-internal="dom-syncmanager-register"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-syncmanager-register">register()</code></a>
method, <a
href="https://wicg.github.io/periodic-background-sync/#periodicsyncmanager"
data-x-internal="periodicsyncmanager"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:periodicsyncmanager">PeriodicSyncManager</code></a>'s
<a
href="https://wicg.github.io/periodic-background-sync/#dom-periodicsyncmanager-register"
data-x-internal="dom-periodicsyncmanager-register"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-periodicsyncmanager-register">register()</code></a>
method, or <a
href="https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#backgroundfetchmanager"
data-x-internal="backgroundfetchmanager"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:backgroundfetchmanager">BackgroundFetchManager</code></a>'s
<a
href="https://wicg.github.io/background-fetch/#dom-backgroundfetchmanager-fetch"
data-x-internal="dom-backgroundfetchmanager-fetch"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-backgroundfetchmanager-fetch">fetch()</code></a>
method.

"<span id="blocking-broadcastchannel-message" class="dfn" export="">`broadcastchannel-message`</span>"  
While the page was stored in [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache), a
[`BroadcastChannel`](#broadcastchannel) connection on the page received
a message and [`message`](#event-message) event was fired.

"<span id="blocking-idb-event" class="dfn" export="">`idbversionchangeevent`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had a pending
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/IndexedDB/#idbversionchangeevent"
data-x-internal="idbversionchangeevent"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:idbversionchangeevent">IDBVersionChangeEvent</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-4">unloading</a>.
[\[INDEXEDDB\]](#refsINDEXEDDB)

"<span id="blocking-idledetector" class="dfn" export="">`idledetector`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had an active
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/idle-detection/#idledetector"
data-x-internal="idledetector"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:idledetector">IdleDetector</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-5">unloading</a>.

"<span id="blocking-keyboard-lock" class="dfn" export="">`keyboardlock`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-6">unloading</a>,
keyboard lock was still active because
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/keyboard-lock/#keyboard"
data-x-internal="keyboard"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:keyboard">Keyboard</code></a>'s
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/keyboard-lock/#dom-keyboard-lock"
data-x-internal="dom-keyboard-lock"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-keyboard-lock">lock()</code></a>
method was called.

"<span id="blocking-mediastream" class="dfn" export="">`mediastream`</span>"  
A <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#mediastreamtrack"
data-x-internal="mediastreamtrack"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:mediastreamtrack">MediaStreamTrack</code></a>
was in the <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#idl-def-MediaStreamTrackState.live"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:live-state"
data-x-internal="live-state">live state</a> upon
<a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-7">unloading</a>.
[\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#refsMEDIASTREAM)

"<span id="blocking-midi" class="dfn" export="">`midi`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) requested a MIDI permission by calling <a
href="https://webaudio.github.io/web-midi-api/#dom-navigator-requestmidiaccess"
data-x-internal="dom-navigator-requestmidiaccess"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-navigator-requestmidiaccess">navigator.requestMIDIAccess()</code></a>.

"<span id="blocking-modals" class="dfn" export="">`modals`</span>"  
[User prompts](#user-prompts) were shown while
<a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-8">unloading</a>.

"<span id="blocking-navigating" class="dfn" export="">`navigating`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-9">unloading</a>,
loading was still ongoing, and so the [`Document`](#document) was not in
a state that could be stored in [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache).

"<span id="blocking-navigation-canceled" class="dfn" export="">`navigation-canceled`</span>"  
The navigation request was canceled by calling
[`window.stop()`](#dom-window-stop) and the page was not in a state to
be stored in [back/forward cache](note-bfcache).

"<span id="blocking-non-trivial-bcg" class="dfn" export="">`non-trivial-browsing-context-group`</span>"  
The <a href="#browsing-context-group"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:browsing-context-group">browsing
context group</a> of this [`Document`](#document) had more than one
<a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:top-level-browsing-context">top-level
browsing context</a>.

"<span id="blocking-otp" class="dfn" export="">`otpcredential`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) created an
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/web-otp/#otpcredential"
data-x-internal="otpcredential"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:otpcredential">OTPCredential</code></a>.

"<span id="blocking-outstanding-network-request" class="dfn" export="">`outstanding-network-request`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-10">unloading</a>,
the [`Document`](#document) had outstanding network requests and was not
in a state that could be stored in [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache).

"<span id="blocking-payment" class="dfn" export="">`paymentrequest`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had an active
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/payment-request/#dom-paymentrequest"
data-x-internal="paymentrequest"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:paymentrequest">PaymentRequest</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-11">unloading</a>.
[\[PAYMENTREQUEST\]](#refsPAYMENTREQUEST)

"<span id="blocking-picture-in-picture" class="dfn" export="">`pictureinpicturewindow`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had an active <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/picture-in-picture/#pictureinpicturewindow"
data-x-internal="pictureinpicturewindow"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:pictureinpicturewindow">PictureInPictureWindow</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-12">unloading</a>.
[\[PICTUREINPICTURE\]](#refsPICTUREINPICTURE)

"<span id="blocking-plugins" class="dfn" export="">`plugins`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) contained <a href="#plugin"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:plugin">plugins</a>.

"<span id="blocking-method-not-get" class="dfn" export="">`request-method-not-get`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP request whose
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-method"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-request-method"
data-x-internal="concept-request-method">method</a> was not \``GET`\`.
[\[FETCH\]](#refsFETCH)

"<span id="blocking-auth-required" class="dfn" export="">`response-auth-required`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response that
required HTTP authentication.

"<span id="blocking-ccns" class="dfn" export="">`response-cache-control-no-store`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control"
data-x-internal="http-cache-control"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http-cache-control">Cache-Control</code></a>\`
header included the "`no-store`" token. [\[HTTP\]](#refsHTTP)

"<span id="blocking-ccnc" class="dfn" export="">`response-cache-control-no-cache`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control"
data-x-internal="http-cache-control"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http-cache-control-2">Cache-Control</code></a>\`
header included the "`no-cache`" token. [\[HTTP\]](#refsHTTP)

"<span id="blocking-keepalive" class="dfn" export="">`response-keep-alive`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response that
contained a \``Keep-Alive`\` header.

"<span id="blocking-not-http-https" class="dfn" export="">`response-scheme-not-http-or-https`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from a response whose
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-response-url"
data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>'s
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-url-scheme"
data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> was not an
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http(s)-scheme"
data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>.
[\[FETCH\]](#refsFETCH)

"<span id="blocking-response-not-ok" class="dfn" export="">`response-status-not-ok`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-response-status"
data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> was not an
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:ok-status"
data-x-internal="ok-status">ok status</a>. [\[FETCH\]](#refsFETCH)

"<span id="blocking-rtc" class="dfn" export="">`rtc`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-13">unloading</a>,
a <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcpeerconnection"
data-x-internal="rtcpeerconnection"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:rtcpeerconnection">RTCPeerConnection</code></a>
or <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcdatachannel"
data-x-internal="rtcdatachannel"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:rtcdatachannel">RTCDataChannel</code></a>
was shut down, so the page was not in a state that could be stored in
the [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache). [\[WEBRTC\]](#refsWEBRTC)

"<span id="blocking-rtc-used-with-ccns" class="dfn" export="">`rtc-used-with-cache-control-no-store`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control"
data-x-internal="http-cache-control"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http-cache-control-3">Cache-Control</code></a>\`
header included the "`no-store`" token, and it has created a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcpeerconnection"
data-x-internal="rtcpeerconnection"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:rtcpeerconnection-2">RTCPeerConnection</code></a>
or <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webrtc-pc/#dom-rtcdatachannel"
data-x-internal="rtcdatachannel"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:rtcdatachannel-2">RTCDataChannel</code></a>
which might be used to receive sensitive information, so the page was
not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache). [\[HTTP\]](#refsHTTP) [\[WEBRTC\]](#refsWEBRTC)

"<span id="blocking-sensors" class="dfn" export="">`sensors`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/sensors/#request-sensor-access"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:request-sensor-access"
data-x-internal="request-sensor-access">requested sensor access</a>.

"<span id="sw-added" class="dfn" export="">`serviceworker-added`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)'s <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
data-x-internal="serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client">service
worker client</a> started to be
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#dfn-control"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dfn-control"
data-x-internal="dfn-control">controlled</a> by a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworker"
data-x-internal="serviceworker"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworker">ServiceWorker</code></a>

[\[SW\]](#refsSW)

"<span id="sw-claimed" class="dfn" export="">`serviceworker-claimed`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)'s <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client-2"
data-x-internal="serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client">service

id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-environment-active-service-worker">active
service worker</a> was claimed while the page was in [back/forward

"<span id="blocking-sw-message" class="dfn" export="">`serviceworker-postmessage`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)'s <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client-3"
data-x-internal="serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client">service
worker client</a>'s <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-environment-active-service-worker-2">active

"<span id="blocking-sw-activation" class="dfn" export="">`serviceworker-version-activated`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)'s <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client-4"
data-x-internal="serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client">service
worker client</a>'s <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-environment-active-service-worker-3">active
service worker</a>'s version was activated while the page was in
[back/forward cache](#note-bfcache). [\[SW\]](#refsSW)

"<span id="blocking-sw-unregistered" class="dfn" export="">`serviceworker-unregistered`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document)'s <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client-5"
data-x-internal="serviceworkercontainer-service-worker-client">service
worker client</a>'s <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"

page was in [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache). [\[SW\]](#refsSW)

"<span id="blocking-sharedworker" class="dfn" export="">`sharedworker`</span>"  
This [`Document`](#document) was in the
<a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set">owner
set</a> of a [`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#sharedworkerglobalscope).

User agents that support the [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache) for
documents using shared workers can use more specific reasons such as
[`"sharedworker-message"`](#blocking-sharedworker-message) or
[`"sharedworker-with-no-active-client"`](#blocking-sharedworker-with-no-active-client)
instead of this general reason, since the usage of shared workers itself
is supported outside of the cases described in those reasons.

"<span id="blocking-sharedworker-message" class="dfn" export="">`sharedworker-message`</span>"  
While the page was stored in [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache), a
message was received from a
[`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#sharedworkerglobalscope) whose
<a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set-2">owner
set</a> <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-contains"
data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> this
[`Document`](#document).

"<span id="blocking-sharedworker-with-no-active-client" class="dfn" export="">`sharedworker-with-no-active-client`</span>"  
This [`Document`](#document) was in the
<a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set-3">owner
set</a> of a [`SharedWorkerGlobalScope`](#sharedworkerglobalscope) that
is not <a href="#active-needed-worker"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:active-needed-worker">actively
needed</a>.

"<span id="blocking-smartcard" class="dfn" export="">`smartcardconnection`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had an active
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/web-smart-card/#dom-smartcardconnection"
data-x-internal="smartcardconnection"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:smartcardconnection">SmartCardConnection</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-14">unloading</a>.

"<span id="blocking-speech-reco" class="dfn" export="">`speechrecognition`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) had an active
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/speech-api/#speechrecognition"
data-x-internal="speechrecognition"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:speechrecognition">SpeechRecognition</code></a>
while <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-15">unloading</a>.

"<span id="blocking-storage" class="dfn" export="">`storageaccess`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) requested storage access permission by using
the Storage Access API.

"<span id="blocking-unload" class="dfn" export="">`unload-listener`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) registered an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-listener"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:event-listener"
data-x-internal="event-listener">event listener</a> for the
[`unload`](#event-unload) event.

"<span id="blocking-video-capture" class="dfn" export="">`video-capture`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) requested video capture permission by using
Media Capture and Streams's <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/mediacapture-main/getusermedia.html#dom-mediadevices-getusermedia"
data-x-internal="getusermedia()"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:getusermedia()-2">getUserMedia()</code></a>
with video. [\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#refsMEDIASTREAM)

"<span id="blocking-webhid" class="dfn" export="">`webhid`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) called the WebHID API's
<a href="https://wicg.github.io/webhid/#requestdevice-method"
data-x-internal="request-device"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:request-device">requestDevice()</code></a>
method.

"<span id="blocking-webshare" class="dfn" export="">`webshare`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) used the Web Share API's
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/web-share/#share-method"
data-x-internal="dom-navigator-share"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:dom-navigator-share">navigator.share()</code></a>
method.

"<span id="blocking-websocket-used-with-ccns" class="dfn" export="">`websocket-used-with-cache-control-no-store`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control"
data-x-internal="http-cache-control"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http-cache-control-4">Cache-Control</code></a>\`
header included the "`no-store`" token, and it has created a
<a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket"
data-x-internal="websocket-2"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:websocket-2-2">WebSocket</code></a>
connection which might be used to receive sensitive information, so the
page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache). [\[HTTP\]](#refsHTTP)
[\[WEBSOCKETS\]](#refsWEBSOCKETS)

"<span id="blocking-webtransport" class="dfn" export="">`webtransport`</span>"  
While <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:unload-a-document-16">unloading</a>,
an open <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webtransport/#webtransport"
data-x-internal="webtransport"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:webtransport">WebTransport</code></a>
connection was shut down, so the page was not in a state that could be
stored in the [back/forward cache](#note-bfcache).
[\[WEBTRANSPORT\]](#refsWEBTRANSPORT)

"<span id="blocking-webtransport-used-with-ccns" class="dfn" export="">`webtransport-used-with-cache-control-no-store`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) was created from an HTTP response whose
\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7234.html#header.cache-control"
data-x-internal="http-cache-control"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:http-cache-control-5">Cache-Control</code></a>\`
header included the "`no-store`" token, and it has created a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/webtransport/#webtransport"
data-x-internal="webtransport"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:webtransport-2">WebTransport</code></a>
connection which might be used to receive sensitive information, so the
page was not in a state that could be stored in the [back/forward
cache](#note-bfcache). [\[HTTP\]](#refsHTTP)
[\[WEBTRANSPORT\]](#refsWEBTRANSPORT)

"<span id="blocking-webxr" class="dfn" export="">`webxrdevice`</span>"  
The [`Document`](#document) created a
<a href="https://immersive-web.github.io/webxr/#xrsystem"
data-x-internal="xrsystem"><code
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:xrsystem">XRSystem</code></a>.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) object has a
<span id="concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
class="dfn">backing struct</span>, a <a href="#nrr-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-struct">not restored
reasons</a> or null, initially null.

A [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) object has a
<span id="concept-not-restored-reasons-reasons" class="dfn">reasons
array</span>, a
`FrozenArray<`[`NotRestoredReasonDetails`](#notrestoredreasondetails)`>`
or null, initially null.

A [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) object has a
<span id="concept-not-restored-reasons-children" class="dfn">children
array</span>, a `FrozenArray<`<a href="#notrestoredreasons"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:notrestoredreasons-7"><code>NotRestoredReasons</code></a>`>`
or null, initially null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-src" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasons" dfn-type="attribute">`src`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"

data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct">backing
struct</a>'s
<a href="#nrr-src" id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-src">src</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-id" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasons" dfn-type="attribute">`id`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-3"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct-2">backing
struct</a>'s
<a href="#nrr-id" id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-id">id</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-name" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasons" dfn-type="attribute">`name`</span> getter
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-4"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct-3">backing
struct</a>'s <a href="#nrr-name"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-name">name</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-url" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasons" dfn-type="attribute">`url`</span> getter
steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-5"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct-4">backing
    struct</a>'s
    <a href="#nrr-url" id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-url">URL</a>
    is null, then return null.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-6"
    data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct-5">backing
    struct</a>'s <a href="#nrr-url"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-url-2">URL</a>,
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-url-serializer"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialized</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-reasons" class="dfn"

<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-7"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s

array</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-not-restored-reasons-children" class="dfn"
dfn-for="NotRestoredReasons" dfn-type="attribute">`children`</span>
getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:this-8"
data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-children"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-children">children
array</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-notrestoredreasons-object" class="dfn"
export="">create a `NotRestoredReasons` object</span> given a
<a href="#nrr-struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-struct-2">not restored
reasons</a> `backingStruct` and a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-code-realms"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:realm-2"
data-x-internal="realm">realm</a> `realm`:

1.  Let `notRestoredReasons` be a new
    [`NotRestoredReasons`](#notrestoredreasons) object created in
    `realm`.

2.  Set `notRestoredReasons`'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-backing-struct-6">backing
    struct</a> to `backingStruct`.

3.  If `backingStruct`'s <a href="#nrr-reasons"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-reasons">reasons</a> is
    null, set `notRestoredReasons`'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-reasons"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-reasons-2">reasons
    array</a> to null.

4.  Otherwise:

    1.  Let `reasonsArray` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list"
        data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-iterate"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `reason` of
        `backingStruct`'s <a href="#nrr-reasons"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-reasons-2">reasons</a>:

        1.  <a href="#create-a-notrestoredreasondetails-object"
            id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:create-a-notrestoredreasondetails-object">Create
            a <code>NotRestoredReasonDetails</code> object</a> given
            `reason` and `realm`, and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-append"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to
            `reasonsArray`.

    3.  Set `notRestoredReasons`'s
        <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-reasons"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-reasons-3">reasons
        array</a> to the result of
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-create-frozen-array"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:creating-a-frozen-array"
        data-x-internal="creating-a-frozen-array">creating a frozen array</a>
        given `reasonsArray`.

5.  If `backingStruct`'s <a href="#nrr-children"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-children">children</a> is
    null, set `notRestoredReasons`'s
    <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-children"
    id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-children-2">children
    array</a> to null.

6.  Otherwise:

    1.  Let `childrenArray` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-2"
        data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-iterate-2"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `child` of
        `backingStruct`'s <a href="#nrr-children"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-children-2">children</a>:

        1.  <a href="#create-a-notrestoredreasons-object"
            id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:create-a-notrestoredreasons-object">Create
            a <code>NotRestoredReasons</code> object</a> given `child`
            and `realm` and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-append-2"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> it to
            `childrenArray`.

    3.  Set `notRestoredReasons`'s
        <a href="#concept-not-restored-reasons-children"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:concept-not-restored-reasons-children-3">children
        array</a> to the result of
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-create-frozen-array"
        id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:creating-a-frozen-array-2"
        data-x-internal="creating-a-frozen-array">creating a frozen array</a>
        given `childrenArray`.

7.  Return `notRestoredReasons`.

</div>

A <span id="nrr-struct" class="dfn" export="">not restored
reasons</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:struct-2"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:struct-item-2"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="nrr-src" class="dfn">src</span>, a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:scalar-value-string"
  data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a> or null,
  initially null.

- <span id="nrr-id" class="dfn">id</span>, a string or null, initially
  null.

- <span id="nrr-name" class="dfn">name</span>, a string or null,
  initially null.

- <span id="nrr-url" class="dfn">url</span>, a
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
  or null, initially null.

- <span id="nrr-reasons" class="dfn">reasons</span>, null or a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-3"
  data-x-internal="list">list</a> of <a href="#nrr-details-struct"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-details-struct-3">not restored
  reason details</a>, initially null.

- <span id="nrr-children" class="dfn">children</span>, null or a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:list-4"
  data-x-internal="list">list</a> of <a href="#nrr-struct"
  id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nrr-struct-3">not restored
  reasons</a>, initially null.

<div algorithm="">

A <span id="concept-document-nrr" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
lt="not restored reasons" export="">`Document`'s not restored
reasons</span> is its <a href="#node-navigable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:node-navigable-4">node
navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:nav-active-history-entry">active
session history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:she-document-state">document
state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-not-restored-reasons"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:document-state-not-restored-reasons">not
restored reasons</a>, if [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="#node-navigable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:node-navigable-5">node
navigable</a> is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="the-notrestoredreasons-interface:top-level-traversable">top-level
traversable</a>; otherwise null.

### <span class="secno">7.3</span> Infrastructure for sequences of documents<a href="#infrastructure-for-sequences-of-documents"
class="self-link"></a>

This standard contains several related concepts for grouping sequences
of documents. As a brief, non-normative summary:

- <a href="#navigable"
  id="infrastructure-for-sequences-of-documents:navigable">Navigables</a>
  are a user-facing representation of a sequence of documents, i.e.,
  they represent something that can be navigated between documents.
  Typical examples are tabs or windows in a web browser, or
  [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element)s, or [`frame`](#frame)s in a
  [`frameset`](#frameset).

- <a href="#traversable-navigable"
  id="infrastructure-for-sequences-of-documents:traversable-navigable">Traversable
  navigables</a> are a special type of navigable which control the
  session history of themselves and of their descendant navigables. That
  is, in addition to their own series of documents, they represent a
  tree of further series of documents, plus the ability to linearly
  traverse back and forward through a flattened view of this tree.

- <a href="#browsing-context"
  id="infrastructure-for-sequences-of-documents:browsing-context">Browsing
  contexts</a> are a developer-facing representation of a series of
  documents. They correspond 1:1 with [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy)
  objects. Each navigable can present a series of browsing contexts,
  with
  [switches](#browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy)
  between those browsing contexts occuring under certain well-defined
  circumstances.

Most of this standard works in the language of navigables, but certain
APIs expose the existence of browsing context switches, and so some
parts of the standard need to work in terms of browsing contexts.

#### <span class="secno">7.3.1</span> Navigables<a href="#navigables" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="navigable" class="dfn" export="">navigable</span> presents a
[`Document`](#document) to the user via its
<a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry">active session history
entry</a>. Each navigable has:

- An <span id="nav-id" class="dfn">id</span>, a
  <a href="#new-unique-internal-value"
  id="navigables:new-unique-internal-value">new unique internal value</a>.

- A <span id="nav-parent" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable"
  export="">parent</span>, a
  <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable">navigable</a> or null.

- A <span id="nav-current-history-entry" class="dfn">current session
  history entry</span>, a <a href="#session-history-entry"
  id="navigables:session-history-entry">session history entry</a>.

  This can only be modified within the
  <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
  id="navigables:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session history
  traversal queue</a> of the parent <a href="#traversable-navigable"
  id="navigables:traversable-navigable">traversable navigable</a>.

- An <span id="nav-active-history-entry" class="dfn">active session
  history entry</span>, a <a href="#session-history-entry"
  id="navigables:session-history-entry-2">session history entry</a>.

  This can only be modified from the event loop of the
  <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
  id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session history
  entry</a>'s
  <a href="#she-document" id="navigables:she-document">document</a>.

- An <span id="is-closing" class="dfn">is closing</span> boolean,
  initially false.

  This is only ever set to true for <a href="#top-level-traversable"
  id="navigables:top-level-traversable">top-level traversable
  navigables</a>.

- An <span id="delaying-load-events-mode" class="dfn">is delaying `load`
  events</span> boolean, initially false.

  This is only ever set to true in cases where the navigable's
  <a href="#nav-parent" id="navigables:nav-parent">parent</a> is
  non-null.

The <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-current-history-entry">current session history
entry</a> and the <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-3">active session history
entry</a> are usually the same, but they get out of sync when:

- Synchronous navigations are performed. This causes the
  <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
  id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-4">active session history
  entry</a> to temporarily step ahead of the
  <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
  id="navigables:nav-current-history-entry-2">current session history
  entry</a>.

- A non-displayable, non-error response is received when
  <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
  id="navigables:apply-the-history-step">applying the history step</a>.
  This updates the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
  id="navigables:nav-current-history-entry-3">current session history
  entry</a> but leaves the <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
  id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-5">active session history
  entry</a> as-is.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
<span id="nav-document" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable" export="">active
document</span> is its <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-6">active session history
entry</a>'s
<a href="#she-document" id="navigables:she-document-2">document</a>.

</div>

This can be safely read from within the
<a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
id="navigables:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-2">session history
traversal queue</a> of the navigable's
<a href="#nav-top" id="navigables:nav-top">top-level traversable</a>.
Although a
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-3">navigable</a>'s
<a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-7">active history entry</a> can
change synchronously, the new entry will always have the same
[`Document`](#document).

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-4">navigable</a>'s
<span id="nav-bc" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable" export="">active
browsing context</span> is its
<a href="#nav-document" id="navigables:nav-document">active document</a>'s
<a href="#concept-document-bc"
id="navigables:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>. If this
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-5">navigable</a> is a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="navigables:traversable-navigable-2">traversable navigable</a>, then
its <a href="#nav-bc" id="navigables:nav-bc">active browsing context</a>
will be a <a href="#top-level-browsing-context"
id="navigables:top-level-browsing-context">top-level browsing
context</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-6">navigable</a>'s
<span id="nav-wp" class="dfn">active `WindowProxy`</span> is its
<a href="#nav-bc" id="navigables:nav-bc-2">active browsing context</a>'s
associated [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-7">navigable</a>'s
<span id="nav-window" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable" export="">active
window</span> is its <a href="#nav-wp" id="navigables:nav-wp">active
<code>WindowProxy</code></a>'s <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
id="navigables:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>.

</div>

This will always equal the navigable's
<a href="#nav-document" id="navigables:nav-document-2">active
document</a>'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
id="navigables:concept-relevant-global">relevant global object</a>; this
is kept in sync by the
<a href="#make-active" id="navigables:make-active">make active</a>
algorithm.

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-8">navigable</a>'s
<span id="nav-target" class="dfn">target name</span> is its
<a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-8">active session history
entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
id="navigables:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
<a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
id="navigables:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable target name</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="node-navigable" class="dfn" export="">node
navigable</span> of a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
id="navigables:node" data-x-internal="node">node</a> `node`, return the
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-9">navigable</a> whose
<a href="#nav-document" id="navigables:nav-document-3">active
document</a> is `node`'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="navigables:node-document" data-x-internal="node-document">node
document</a>, or null if there is no such
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-10">navigable</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="initialize-the-navigable" class="dfn">initialize the
navigable</span>
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-11">navigable</a>
`navigable`, given a
<a href="#document-state-2" id="navigables:document-state-2">document
state</a> `documentState` and an optional
<a href="#navigable" id="navigables:navigable-12">navigable</a>-or-null
`parent` (default null):

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert" id="navigables:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `documentState`'s
    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="navigables:document-state-document">document</a> is non-null.

2.  Let `entry` be a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="navigables:session-history-entry-3">session history entry</a>,
    with

    <a href="#she-url" id="navigables:she-url">URL</a>  
    `documentState`'s <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="navigables:document-state-document-2">document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="navigables:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>

    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="navigables:she-document-state-2">document state</a>  
    `documentState`

    The caller of this algorithm is responsible for initializing
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-step" id="navigables:she-step">step</a>; it
    will be left as "`pending`" until that is complete.

3.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
    id="navigables:nav-current-history-entry-4">current session history
    entry</a> to `entry`.

4.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="navigables:nav-active-history-entry-9">active session history
    entry</a> to `entry`.

5.  Set `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-parent" id="navigables:nav-parent-2">parent</a> to
    `parent`.

6.  <a href="#set-the-initial-visibility-state"
    id="navigables:set-the-initial-visibility-state">Set the initial
    visibility state</a> of `documentState`'s
    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="navigables:document-state-document-3">document</a> to
    `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-traversable" id="navigables:nav-traversable">traversable
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#system-visibility-state"
    id="navigables:system-visibility-state">system visibility state</a>.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.3.1.1</span> Traversable navigables<a href="#traversable-navigables" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="traversable-navigable" class="dfn" export="">traversable
navigable</span> is a
<a href="#navigable" id="traversable-navigables:navigable">navigable</a>
that also controls which <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="traversable-navigables:session-history-entry">session history
entry</a> should be the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="traversable-navigables:nav-current-history-entry">current session
history entry</a> and <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="traversable-navigables:nav-active-history-entry">active session
history entry</a> for itself and its descendant <a href="#navigable"
id="traversable-navigables:navigable-2">navigables</a>.

In addition to the properties of a <a href="#navigable"
id="traversable-navigables:navigable-3">navigable</a>, a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="traversable-navigables:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a> has:

- A <span id="tn-current-session-history-step" class="dfn"
  export="">current session history step</span>, a number, initially 0.

- <span id="tn-session-history-entries" class="dfn">Session history
  entries</span>, a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="traversable-navigables:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
  <a href="#session-history-entry"
  id="traversable-navigables:session-history-entry-2">session history
  entries</a>, initially a new
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="traversable-navigables:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

- A <span id="tn-session-history-traversal-queue" class="dfn">session
  history traversal queue</span>, a
  <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue"
  id="traversable-navigables:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue">session
  history traversal parallel queue</a>, the result of
  <a href="#starting-a-new-session-history-traversal-parallel-queue"
  id="traversable-navigables:starting-a-new-session-history-traversal-parallel-queue">starting
  a new session history traversal parallel queue</a>.

- A <span id="tn-running-nested-apply-history-step" class="dfn">running
  nested apply history step</span> boolean, initially false.

- A <span id="system-visibility-state" class="dfn">system visibility
  state</span>, which is either "`hidden`" or "`visible`".

  See the [page visibility](#page-visibility) section for the
  requirements on this item.

- An <span id="is-created-by-web-content" class="dfn">is created by web
  content</span> boolean, initially false.

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="nav-traversable" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable"
export="">traversable navigable</span> of a <a href="#navigable"
id="traversable-navigables:navigable-4">navigable</a> `inputNavigable`:

1.  Let `navigable` be `inputNavigable`.

2.  While `navigable` is not a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
    id="traversable-navigables:traversable-navigable-2">traversable
    navigable</a>, set `navigable` to `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-parent" id="traversable-navigables:nav-parent">parent</a>.

3.  Return `navigable`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.3.1.2</span> Top-level traversables<a href="#top-level-traversables" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

A <span id="top-level-traversable" class="dfn" export="">top-level
traversable</span> is a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="top-level-traversables:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a> with a null
<a href="#nav-parent" id="top-level-traversables:nav-parent">parent</a>.

</div>

Currently, all <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="top-level-traversables:traversable-navigable-2">traversable
navigables</a> are <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="top-level-traversables:top-level-traversable">top-level
traversables</a>. Future proposals envision introducing non-top-level
traversables.

A user agent holds a <span id="top-level-traversable-set" class="dfn"
dfn-for="user agent" export="">top-level traversable set</span> (a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
id="top-level-traversables:set" data-x-internal="set">set</a> of
<a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="top-level-traversables:top-level-traversable-2">top-level
traversables</a>). These are typically presented to the user in the form
of browser windows or browser tabs.

<div algorithm="">

To get the <span id="nav-top" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable"
export="">top-level traversable</span> of a
<a href="#navigable" id="top-level-traversables:navigable">navigable</a>
`inputNavigable`:

1.  Let `navigable` be `inputNavigable`.

2.  While `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-parent"
    id="top-level-traversables:nav-parent-2">parent</a> is not null, set
    `navigable` to `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-parent"
    id="top-level-traversables:nav-parent-3">parent</a>.

3.  Return `navigable`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-new-top-level-traversable" class="dfn">create a
new top-level traversable</span> given a <a href="#browsing-context"
id="top-level-traversables:browsing-context">browsing context</a>-or-null
`opener`, a string `targetName`, and an optional <a href="#navigable"
id="top-level-traversables:navigable-2">navigable</a>
`openerNavigableForWebDriver`:

1.  Let `document` be null.

2.  If `opener` is null, then set `document` to the second return value
    of <a href="#creating-a-new-top-level-browsing-context"
    id="top-level-traversables:creating-a-new-top-level-browsing-context">creating
    a new top-level browsing context and document</a>.

3.  Otherwise, set `document` to the second return value of
    <a href="#creating-a-new-auxiliary-browsing-context"
    id="top-level-traversables:creating-a-new-auxiliary-browsing-context">creating
    a new auxiliary browsing context and document</a> given `opener`.

4.  Let `documentState` be a new <a href="#document-state-2"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-2">document state</a>,
    with

    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-document">document</a>  
    `document`

    <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
    origin</a>  
    null if `opener` is null; otherwise, `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="top-level-traversables:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#document-state-origin"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-origin">origin</a>  
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="top-level-traversables:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
    target name</a>  
    `targetName`

    <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="top-level-traversables:document-state-about-base-url">about base
    URL</a>  
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-about-base-url"
    id="top-level-traversables:concept-document-about-base-url">about base
    URL</a>

5.  Let `traversable` be a new <a href="#traversable-navigable"
    id="top-level-traversables:traversable-navigable-3">traversable
    navigable</a>.

6.  <a href="#initialize-the-navigable"
    id="top-level-traversables:initialize-the-navigable">Initialize the

7.  Let `initialHistoryEntry` be `traversable`'s

    id="top-level-traversables:nav-active-history-entry">active session

8.  Set `initialHistoryEntry`'s
    <a href="#she-step" id="top-level-traversables:she-step">step</a> to

9.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="top-level-traversables:list-append"
    data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `initialHistoryEntry` to
    `traversable`'s <a href="#tn-session-history-entries"
    id="top-level-traversables:tn-session-history-entries">session history
    entries</a>.

10. <div id="copy-session-storage">

    If `opener` is non-null, then <a
    href="https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#legacy-clone-a-traversable-storage-shed"
    id="top-level-traversables:legacy-clone-a-traversable-storage-shed"
    data-x-internal="legacy-clone-a-traversable-storage-shed">legacy-clone a
    traversable storage shed</a> given `opener`'s
    <a href="#bc-traversable"
    id="top-level-traversables:bc-traversable">top-level traversable</a>
    and `traversable`. [\[STORAGE\]](#refsSTORAGE)

    </div>

11. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="top-level-traversables:list-append-2"
    data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `traversable` to the user
    agent's <a href="#top-level-traversable-set"
    id="top-level-traversables:top-level-traversable-set">top-level
    traversable set</a>.

12. Invoke <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigable-created"
    id="top-level-traversables:webdriver-bidi-navigable-created"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigable-created">WebDriver BiDi
    navigable created</a> with `traversable` and
    `openerNavigableForWebDriver`.

13. Return `traversable`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-fresh-top-level-traversable" class="dfn"
export="">create a fresh top-level traversable</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="top-level-traversables:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`initialNavigationURL` and an optional
<a href="#post-resource" id="top-level-traversables:post-resource">POST
resource</a>-or-null `initialNavigationPostResource` (default null):

1.  Let `traversable` be the result of
    <a href="#creating-a-new-top-level-traversable"
    id="top-level-traversables:creating-a-new-top-level-traversable">creating
    a new top-level traversable</a> given null and the empty string.

2.  <a href="#navigate" id="top-level-traversables:navigate">Navigate</a>
    `traversable` to `initialNavigationURL` using `traversable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="top-level-traversables:nav-document">active
    document</a>, with *[documentResource](#navigation-resource)* set to
    `initialNavigationPostResource`.

    We treat these initial navigations as `traversable` navigating
    itself, which will ensure all relevant security checks pass.

3.  Return `traversable`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.3.1.3</span> Child navigables<a href="#child-navigables" class="self-link"></a>

Certain elements (for example, [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) elements)
can present a
<a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable">navigable</a> to
the user. These elements are called <span id="navigable-container"
class="dfn" lt="navigable container" export="">navigable
containers</span>.

Each <a href="#navigable-container"
id="child-navigables:navigable-container">navigable container</a> has a
<span id="content-navigable" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable container"
export="">content navigable</span>, which is either a
<a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-2">navigable</a> or
null. It is initially null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="nav-container" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable"
export="">container</span> of a
<a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-3">navigable</a>
`navigable` is the <a href="#navigable-container"
id="child-navigables:navigable-container-2">navigable container</a>
whose <a href="#content-navigable"
id="child-navigables:content-navigable">content navigable</a> is
`navigable`, or null if there is no such element.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="nav-container-document" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigable"
export="">container document</span> of a
<a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-4">navigable</a>
`navigable` is the result of running these steps:

1.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="child-navigables:nav-container">container</a> is null, then
    return null.

2.  Return `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="child-navigables:nav-container-2">container</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="child-navigables:node-document" data-x-internal="node-document">node
    document</a>.

    This is equal to `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="child-navigables:nav-container-3">container</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-root"
    id="child-navigables:shadow-including-root"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-root">shadow-including root</a> as
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="child-navigables:nav-container-4">container</a> has to be
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected"
    id="child-navigables:connected"
    data-x-internal="connected">connected</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="doc-container-document" class="dfn">container
document</span> of a [`Document`](#document) `document` is the result of
running these steps:

1.  If `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="child-navigables:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a> is null, then return null.

2.  Return `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="child-navigables:node-navigable-2">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="child-navigables:nav-container-document">container document</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-5">navigable</a>
`navigable` is a <span id="child-navigable" class="dfn" export="">child
navigable</span> of another navigable `potentialParent` when
`navigable`'s
<a href="#nav-parent" id="child-navigables:nav-parent">parent</a> is
`potentialParent`. We can also just say that a
<a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-6">navigable</a> "is
a <a href="#child-navigable" id="child-navigables:child-navigable">child
navigable</a>", which means that its
<a href="#nav-parent" id="child-navigables:nav-parent-2">parent</a> is
non-null.

</div>

All
<a href="#child-navigable" id="child-navigables:child-navigable-2">child
navigables</a> are the <a href="#content-navigable"
id="child-navigables:content-navigable-2">content navigable</a> of their
<a href="#nav-container"
id="child-navigables:nav-container-5">container</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="concept-bcc-content-document" class="dfn">content
document</span> of a <a href="#navigable-container"
id="child-navigables:navigable-container-3">navigable container</a>
`container` is the result of running these steps:

1.  If `container`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:content-navigable-3">content navigable</a> is
    null, then return null.

2.  Let `document` be `container`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:content-navigable-4">content navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="child-navigables:nav-document">active
    document</a>.

3.  If `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> and
    `container`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="child-navigables:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> are not
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="child-navigables:same-origin-domain">same origin-domain</a>,
    then return null.

4.  Return `document`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="content-window" class="dfn">content window</span> of a
<a href="#navigable-container"
id="child-navigables:navigable-container-4">navigable container</a>
`container` is the result of running these steps:

1.  If `container`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:content-navigable-5">content navigable</a> is
    null, then return null.

2.  Return `container`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:content-navigable-6">content navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-wp" id="child-navigables:nav-wp">active
    <code>WindowProxy</code></a>'s object.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-a-new-child-navigable" class="dfn">create a new
child navigable</span>, given an element `element`:

1.  Let `parentNavigable` be `element`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="child-navigables:node-navigable-3">node
    navigable</a>.

2.  Let `group` be `element`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="child-navigables:node-document-3"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>'s
    <a href="#bc-tlbc" id="child-navigables:bc-tlbc">top-level browsing
    context</a>'s
    <a href="#tlbc-group" id="child-navigables:tlbc-group">group</a>.

3.  Let `browsingContext` and `document` be the result of
    <a href="#creating-a-new-browsing-context"
    id="child-navigables:creating-a-new-browsing-context">creating a new
    browsing context and document</a> given `element`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="child-navigables:node-document-4"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>, `element`, and
    `group`.

4.  Let `targetName` be null.

5.  If `element` has a `name` content attribute, then set `targetName`
    to the value of that attribute.

6.  Let `documentState` be a new <a href="#document-state-2"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-2">document state</a>, with

    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-document">document</a>  
    `document`

    <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
    origin</a>  
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-origin-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#document-state-origin"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-origin">origin</a>  
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-origin-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable target
    name</a>  
    `targetName`

    <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="child-navigables:document-state-about-base-url">about base URL</a>  
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-about-base-url"
    id="child-navigables:concept-document-about-base-url">about base URL</a>

7.  Let `navigable` be a new
    <a href="#navigable" id="child-navigables:navigable-7">navigable</a>.

8.  <a href="#initialize-the-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:initialize-the-navigable">Initialize the
    navigable</a> `navigable` given `documentState` and
    `parentNavigable`.

9.  Set `element`'s <a href="#content-navigable"
    id="child-navigables:content-navigable-7">content navigable</a> to
    `navigable`.

10. Let `historyEntry` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="child-navigables:nav-active-history-entry">active session history
    entry</a>.

11. Let `traversable` be `parentNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="child-navigables:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>.

12. <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
    id="child-navigables:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
    the following session history traversal steps</a> to `traversable`:

    1.  Let `parentDocState` be `parentNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="child-navigables:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session history
        entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="child-navigables:she-document-state">document state</a>.

    2.  Let `parentNavigableEntries` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-session-history-entries"
        id="child-navigables:getting-session-history-entries">getting session
        history entries</a> for `parentNavigable`.

    3.  Let `targetStepSHE` be the first
        <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="child-navigables:session-history-entry">session history entry</a>
        in `parentNavigableEntries` whose <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="child-navigables:she-document-state-2">document state</a>
        equals `parentDocState`.

    4.  Set `historyEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="child-navigables:she-step">step</a> to
        `targetStepSHE`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="child-navigables:she-step-2">step</a>.

    5.  Let `nestedHistory` be a new
        <a href="#nested-history" id="child-navigables:nested-history">nested
        history</a> whose <a href="#nested-history-id"
        id="child-navigables:nested-history-id">id</a> is `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-id" id="child-navigables:nav-id">id</a> and
        <a href="#nested-history-entries"
        id="child-navigables:nested-history-entries">entries list</a> is
        « `historyEntry` ».

    6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="child-navigables:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `nestedHistory` to
        `parentDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-nested-histories"
        id="child-navigables:document-state-nested-histories">nested
        histories</a>.

    7.  <a href="#update-for-navigable-creation/destruction"
        id="child-navigables:update-for-navigable-creation/destruction">Update
        for navigable creation/destruction</a> given `traversable`.

13. Invoke <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigable-created"
    id="child-navigables:webdriver-bidi-navigable-created"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigable-created">WebDriver BiDi
    navigable created</a> with `traversable`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.3.1.4</span> Jake diagrams<a href="#jake-diagrams" class="self-link"></a>

A useful method for visualizing sequences of documents, and in
particular
<a href="#navigable" id="jake-diagrams:navigable">navigables</a> and
their <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="jake-diagrams:session-history-entry">session history entries</a>, is
the <span id="jake-diagram" class="dfn">Jake diagram</span>. A typical
Jake diagram is the following:

|             | 0      | 1      | 2      | 3        | 4    |
|-------------|--------|--------|--------|----------|------|
| `top`       | /t-a   |        |        | /t-a#foo | /t-b |
| `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |        |          |      |
| `frames[1]` | /i-1-a |        | /i-1-b |          |      |

Here, each numbered column denotes a possible value for the
traversable's <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
id="jake-diagrams:tn-current-session-history-step">session history
step</a>. Each labeled row depicts a
<a href="#navigable" id="jake-diagrams:navigable-2">navigable</a>, as it
transitions between different URLs and documents. The first, labeled
`top`, being the <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="jake-diagrams:top-level-traversable">top-level traversable</a>, and
the others being
<a href="#child-navigable" id="jake-diagrams:child-navigable">child
navigables</a>. The documents are given by the background color of each
cell, with a new background color indicating a new document in that
<a href="#navigable" id="jake-diagrams:navigable-3">navigable</a>. The
URLs are given by the text content of the cells; usually they are given
as <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-relative"
id="jake-diagrams:relative-url" data-x-internal="relative-url">relative
URLs</a> for brevity, unless a cross-origin case is specifically under
investigation. A given navigable might not exist at a given step, in
which case the corresponding cells are empty. The bold-italic step
number depicts the <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
