<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:struct-item-3"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

<span id="navigation-params-id" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">id</span>  
null or a <a href="#navigation-id"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>

<span id="navigation-params-navigable" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">navigable</span>  
the <a href="#navigable"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigable-3">navigable</a> to be
navigated

<span id="navigation-params-request" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">request</span>  
null or a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:concept-request"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> that started the
navigation

<span id="navigation-params-response" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">response</span>  
a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> that ultimately was
navigated to (potentially a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:network-error"
data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>)

<span id="navigation-params-fetch-controller" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">fetch controller</span>  
null or a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:fetch-controller"
data-x-internal="fetch-controller">fetch controller</a>

<span id="navigation-params-commit-early-hints" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">commit early hints</span>  
null or an algorithm accepting a [`Document`](#document), once it has
been created

<span id="navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">COOP enforcement result</span>  
an <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:coop-enforcement-result">opener
policy enforcement result</a>, used for reporting and potentially for
causing a [browsing context group
switch](#browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy)

<span id="navigation-params-reserved-environment" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">reserved environment</span>  
null or an <a href="#environment"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:environment">environment</a> reserved
for the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-origin" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">origin</span>  
an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:concept-origin">origin</a> to use for
the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-policy-container" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">policy container</span>  
a <a href="#policy-container"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:policy-container-3">policy
container</a> to use for the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-sandboxing" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">final sandboxing flag set</span>  
a <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:sandboxing-flag-set-4">sandboxing
flag set</a> to impose on the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">`iframe` element referrer policy</span>  
a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:referrer-policy-2"
data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>, used in the
<a href="#internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:internal-ancestor-origin-objects-list-creation-steps">internal
ancestor origin objects list creation steps</a>

<span id="navigation-params-coop" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">opener policy</span>  
an <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:cross-origin-opener-policy">opener
policy</a> to use for the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-nav-timing-type" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">navigation timing type</span>  
a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigationtimingtype">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
used for <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dfn-create-the-navigation-timing-entry"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:create-the-navigation-timing-entry"
data-x-internal="create-the-navigation-timing-entry">creating the
navigation timing entry</a> for the new [`Document`](#document)

<span id="navigation-params-about-base-url" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">about base URL</span>  
a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> or
null used to populate the new [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="#concept-document-about-base-url"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:concept-document-about-base-url">about
base URL</a>

<span id="navigation-params-user-involvement" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigation params">user involvement</span>  
a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> used when
<a href="#obtain-browsing-context-navigation"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:obtain-browsing-context-navigation">obtaining
a browsing context</a> for the new [`Document`](#document)

Once a <a href="#navigation-params"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> struct is created, this standard does not mutate any of its
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:struct-item-4"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>. They are only passed onward to
other algorithms.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <span id="navigation-id" class="dfn">navigation ID</span> is a UUID
string generated during navigation. It is used to interface with the
WebDriver BiDi specification as well as to track the
<a href="#ongoing-navigation"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:ongoing-navigation">ongoing
navigation</a>. [\[WEBDRIVERBIDI\]](#refsWEBDRIVERBIDI)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

After [`Document`](#document) creation, the relevant
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a>'s <a href="#tn-session-history-entries"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:tn-session-history-entries">session
history</a> gets updated. The
[`NavigationHistoryBehavior`](#navigationhistorybehavior) enumeration is
used to indicate the desired type of session history update to the
<a href="#navigate"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigate-2">navigate</a> algorithm.
It is one of the following:

<span id="hh-push"></span>"<span id="navigationhistorybehavior-push" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationHistoryBehavior" dfn-type="enum-value">`push`</span>"  
A regular navigation which adds a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a>, and will <a href="#clear-the-forward-session-history"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:clear-the-forward-session-history">clear
the forward session history</a>.

"<span id="navigationhistorybehavior-replace" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationHistoryBehavior" dfn-type="enum-value">`replace`</span>"  
A navigation that will replace the <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:nav-active-history-entry">active
session history entry</a>.

"<span id="navigationhistorybehavior-auto" class="dfn" dfn-for="NavigationHistoryBehavior" dfn-type="enum-value">`auto`</span>"  
The default value, which will be converted very early in the
<a href="#navigate"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:navigate-3">navigate</a> algorithm
into "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)" or
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)". Usually it becomes
"[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)", but under [certain
circumstances](#navigate-convert-to-replace) it becomes
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)" instead.

A <span id="history-handling-behavior" class="dfn">history handling
behavior</span> is a
[`NavigationHistoryBehavior`](#navigationhistorybehavior) that is either
"[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)" or
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", i.e., that has been
resolved away from any initial
"[`auto`](#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)" value.

<div algorithm="">

<span id="the-navigation-must-be-a-replace" class="dfn">The navigation
must be a replace</span>, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`url` and a [`Document`](#document) `document`, if any of the following
are true:

- `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
  id="navigation-supporting-concepts:concept-url-scheme"
  data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is
  "[`javascript`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case)"; or

- `document`'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
  id="navigation-supporting-concepts:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
  <code>about:blank</code></a> is true.

</div>

<div class="note">

Other cases that often, but not always, force a
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)" navigation are:

- if the [`Document`](#document) is not <a href="#completely-loaded"
  id="navigation-supporting-concepts:completely-loaded">completely
  loaded</a>; or

- if the target <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
  id="navigation-supporting-concepts:url-3" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
  equals the [`Document`](#document)'s
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
  id="navigation-supporting-concepts:the-document&#39;s-address"
  data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Various parts of the platform track whether a user is involved in a
navigation. A <span id="user-navigation-involvement" class="dfn"
export="">user navigation involvement</span> is one of the following:

"<span id="uni-browser-ui" class="dfn" dfn-for="user navigation involvement" export="">`browser UI`</span>"  
The navigation was initiated by the user via browser UI mechanisms.

"<span id="uni-activation" class="dfn" dfn-for="user navigation involvement" export="">`activation`</span>"  
The navigation was initiated by the user via the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior"
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:activation-behaviour"
data-x-internal="activation-behaviour">activation behavior</a> of an
element.

"<span id="uni-none" class="dfn" dfn-for="user navigation involvement" export="">`none`</span>"  
The navigation was not initiated by the user.

<div algorithm="">

For convenience at certain call sites, the <span id="event-uni"
class="dfn" dfn-for="Event">user navigation involvement</span> for an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-event"
data-x-internal="event"><code
id="navigation-supporting-concepts:event">Event</code></a> `event` is
defined as follows:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this algorithm is being called
    as part of an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior"
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:activation-behaviour-2"
    data-x-internal="activation-behaviour">activation behavior</a>
    definition.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-type"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-type"><code
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:dom-event-type">type</code></a>
    is "<a href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click"
    data-x-internal="event-click"><code
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:event-click">click</code></a>".

3.  If `event`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-istrusted"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-istrusted"><code
    id="navigation-supporting-concepts:dom-event-istrusted">isTrusted</code></a>
    is initialized to true, then return
    "[`activation`](#uni-activation)".

4.  Return "[`none`](#uni-none)".

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.2.2</span> Beginning navigation<a href="#beginning-navigation" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate" class="dfn" export="">navigate</span> a
<a href="#navigable" id="beginning-navigation:navigable">navigable</a>
`navigable` to a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="beginning-navigation:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url` using
an optional [`Document`](#document)-or-null `sourceDocument` (default
null), with an optional
<a href="#post-resource" id="beginning-navigation:post-resource">POST
resource</a>, string, or null <span id="navigation-resource" class="dfn"
dfn-for="navigate" export="">`documentResource`</span> (default null),
an optional <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="beginning-navigation:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>-or-null
<span id="navigation-response" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigate"
export="">`response`</span> (default null), an optional boolean
<span id="exceptions-enabled" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigate"
export="">`exceptionsEnabled`</span> (default false), an optional
[`NavigationHistoryBehavior`](#navigationhistorybehavior)
<span id="navigation-hh" class="dfn" dfn-for="navigate"
export="">`historyHandling`</span> (default
"[`auto`](#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)"), an optional
<a href="#serialized-state"
id="beginning-navigation:serialized-state">serialized state</a>-or-null
<span id="navigation-navigation-api-state" class="dfn"
dfn-for="navigate" export="">`navigationAPIState`</span> (default null),
an optional
<a href="#entry-list" id="beginning-navigation:entry-list">entry
list</a> or null <span id="navigation-form-data-entry-list" class="dfn"
dfn-for="navigate" export="">`formDataEntryList`</span> (default null),
an optional <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
id="beginning-navigation:referrer-policy"
data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>
<span id="navigation-referrer-policy"
class="dfn">`referrerPolicy`</span> (default the empty string), an
optional <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="beginning-navigation:user-navigation-involvement">user navigation
involvement</a> <span id="navigation-user-involvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span> (default "[`none`](#uni-none)"), an
optional <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="beginning-navigation:element">Element</code></a>
<span id="navigation-source-element" class="dfn">`sourceElement`</span>
(default null), an optional boolean
<span id="navigation-initial-insertion" class="dfn"
dfn-for="navigate">`initialInsertion`</span> (default false), and an
optional <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="beginning-navigation:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation API
method tracker</a>-or-null <span id="navigation-api-method-tracker-2"
class="dfn" dfn-for="navigate">`apiMethodTracker`</span> (default null):

1.  Let `cspNavigationType` be "`form-submission`" if
    `formDataEntryList` is non-null; otherwise "`other`".

2.  Let `sourceSnapshotParams` be the result of
    <a href="#snapshotting-source-snapshot-params"
    id="beginning-navigation:snapshotting-source-snapshot-params">snapshotting
    source snapshot params</a> given `sourceDocument`.

3.  Let `initiatorOriginSnapshot` be a new
    <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="beginning-navigation:concept-origin-opaque">opaque origin</a>.

4.  Let `initiatorBaseURLSnapshot` be [`about:blank`](#about:blank).

5.  If `sourceDocument` is null:

    1.  <div id="assert-null-sourcedocument">

        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="beginning-navigation:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `userInvolvement` is "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)".

        </div>

    2.  If `url`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-scheme"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is
        "[`javascript`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case)", then set
        `initiatorOriginSnapshot` to `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document">active
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-origin"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

6.  Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="beginning-navigation:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `userInvolvement` is not "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)".

    2.  <div id="sandboxLinks">

        If `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="#node-navigable" id="beginning-navigation:node-navigable">node
        navigable</a> is not <a href="#allowed-to-navigate"
        id="beginning-navigation:allowed-to-navigate">allowed by sandboxing to
        navigate</a> `navigable` given `sourceSnapshotParams`:

        1.  If `exceptionsEnabled` is true, then throw a
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
            id="beginning-navigation:securityerror"
            data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
            <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
            data-x-internal="domexception"><code
            id="beginning-navigation:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

        2.  Return.

        </div>

    3.  Set `initiatorOriginSnapshot` to `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

    4.  Set `initiatorBaseURLSnapshot` to `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="#document-base-url"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-base-url">document base URL</a>.

7.  Let `navigationId` be the result of
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webcrypto/#dfn-generate-a-random-uuid"
    id="beginning-navigation:generating-a-random-uuid"
    data-x-internal="generating-a-random-uuid">generating a random UUID</a>.
    [\[WEBCRYPTO\]](#refsWEBCRYPTO)

8.  If the <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#surrounding-agent"
    id="beginning-navigation:surrounding-agent"
    data-x-internal="surrounding-agent">surrounding agent</a> is equal
    to `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-2">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="beginning-navigation:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>, then
    continue these steps. Otherwise, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="beginning-navigation:queue-a-global-task">queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="beginning-navigation:nav-window">active
    window</a> to continue these steps.

    <div class="note">

    We do this because we are about to look at a lot of properties of
    `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-3">active
    document</a>, which are in theory only accessible over in the
    appropriate
    <a href="#event-loop" id="beginning-navigation:event-loop">event
    loop</a>. (But, we do not want to unconditionally queue a task,
    since — for example — same-event-loop <a href="#navigate-fragid"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigate-fragid">fragment navigations</a>
    need to take effect synchronously.)

    Another implementation strategy would be to replicate the relevant
    information across event loops, or into a canonical "browser
    process", so that it can be consulted without queueing a task. This
    could give different results than what we specify here in edge
    cases, where the relevant properties have changed over in the target
    event loop but not yet been replicated. Further testing is needed to
    determine which of these strategies best matches browser behavior,
    in such racy edge cases.

    </div>

9.  If `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-4">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="beginning-navigation:unload-counter">unload counter</a> is
    greater than 0, then invoke <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
    id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed">WebDriver BiDi
    navigation failed</a> with `navigable` and a <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
    id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
    navigation status</a> whose
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-id"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `navigationId`,
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-status"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-canceled"><code
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-canceled">canceled</code></a>",
    and
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-url"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `url`, and
    return.

10. Let `container` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="beginning-navigation:nav-container">container</a>.

11. If `container` is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element and
    <a href="#will-lazy-load-element-steps"
    id="beginning-navigation:will-lazy-load-element-steps">will lazy load
    element steps</a> given `container` returns true, then
    <a href="#stop-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element"
    id="beginning-navigation:stop-intersection-observing-a-lazy-loading-element">stop
    intersection-observing a lazy loading element</a> `container` and
    set `container`'s <a href="#lazy-load-resumption-steps"
    id="beginning-navigation:lazy-load-resumption-steps">lazy load
    resumption steps</a> to null.

12. <div id="navigate-convert-to-replace">

    If `historyHandling` is "[`auto`](#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)",
    then:

    1.  If `url`
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-equals"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-equals">equals</a> `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-5">active
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
        id="beginning-navigation:the-document&#39;s-address"
        data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>, and
        `initiatorOriginSnapshot` is
        <a href="#same-origin" id="beginning-navigation:same-origin">same
        origin</a> with `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-6">active
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-origin-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then set
        `historyHandling` to
        "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

    2.  Otherwise, set `historyHandling` to
        "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)".

    </div>

13. If <a href="#the-navigation-must-be-a-replace"
    id="beginning-navigation:the-navigation-must-be-a-replace">the
    navigation must be a replace</a> given `url` and `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-7">active
    document</a>, then set `historyHandling` to
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

14. <div id="navigate-fragid-step">

    If all of the following are true:

    - `documentResource` is null;

    - `response` is null;

    - `url` <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals"
      id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-equals-2"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-equals">equals</a> `navigable`'s
      <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
      id="beginning-navigation:nav-active-history-entry">active session
      history entry</a>'s
      <a href="#she-url" id="beginning-navigation:she-url">URL</a> with
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments"
      id="beginning-navigation:url-equals-exclude-fragments"
      data-x-internal="url-equals-exclude-fragments"><em>exclude
      fragments</em></a> set to true; and

    - `url`'s
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
      id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-fragment"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> is non-null,

    then:

    1.  <a href="#navigate-fragid"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigate-fragid-2">Navigate to a fragment</a>
        given `navigable`, `url`, `historyHandling`, `userInvolvement`,
        `sourceElement`, `navigationAPIState`, and `navigationId`.

    2.  Return.

    </div>

15. If `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-parent" id="beginning-navigation:nav-parent">parent</a>
    is non-null, then set `navigable`'s
    <a href="#delaying-load-events-mode"
    id="beginning-navigation:delaying-load-events-mode">is delaying
    <code>load</code> events</a> to true.

16. Let `targetSnapshotParams` be the result of
    <a href="#snapshotting-target-snapshot-params"
    id="beginning-navigation:snapshotting-target-snapshot-params">snapshotting
    target snapshot params</a> given `navigable`.

17. Invoke <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-started"
    id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-started"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-started">WebDriver BiDi
    navigation started</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
    id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status-2"
    data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
    navigation status</a> whose
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-id-2"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `navigationId`,
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-status-2"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-pending"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-pending"><code
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-pending">pending</code></a>",
    and
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-url-2"
    data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `url`.

18. If `navigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="beginning-navigation:ongoing-navigation">ongoing navigation</a>
    is "`traversal`", then:

    1.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
        id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed-2"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation failed</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status-3"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation status</a> whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-id-3"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `navigationId`,
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-status-3"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-canceled"><code
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-canceled-2">canceled</code></a>",
        and
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-url-3"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `url`.

    2.  Return.

    Any attempts to navigate a
    <a href="#navigable" id="beginning-navigation:navigable-2">navigable</a>
    that is currently <a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
    id="beginning-navigation:apply-the-traverse-history-step">traversing</a>
    are ignored.

19. <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
    id="beginning-navigation:set-the-ongoing-navigation">Set the ongoing
    navigation</a> for `navigable` to `navigationId`.

    This will have the effect of aborting other ongoing navigations of
    `navigable`, since at certain points during navigation changes to
    the <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="beginning-navigation:ongoing-navigation-2">ongoing navigation</a>
    will cause further work to be abandoned.

20. If `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-scheme-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is
    "[`javascript`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case)", then:

    1.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="beginning-navigation:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a global task</a>
        on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
        and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-window" id="beginning-navigation:nav-window-2">active
        window</a> to <a href="#navigate-to-a-javascript:-url"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigate-to-a-javascript:-url">navigate to a
        <code>javascript:</code> URL</a> given `navigable`, `url`,
        `historyHandling`, `sourceSnapshotParams`,
        `initiatorOriginSnapshot`, `userInvolvement`,
        `cspNavigationType`, `initialInsertion`, and `navigationId`.

    2.  Return.

21. If all of the following are true:

    - `userInvolvement` is not "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)";

    - `navigable`'s
      <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-8">active
      document</a>'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-origin-4"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
      <a href="#same-origin-domain"
      id="beginning-navigation:same-origin-domain">same origin-domain</a>
      with `sourceDocument`'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-origin-5"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>;

    - `navigable`'s
      <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-9">active
      document</a>'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
      id="beginning-navigation:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
      <code>about:blank</code></a> is false; and

    - `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
      id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-scheme-3"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is a
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
      id="beginning-navigation:fetch-scheme"
      data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>,

    then:

    1.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-window" id="beginning-navigation:nav-window-3">active
        window</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
        id="beginning-navigation:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

    2.  Let `entryListForFiring` be `formDataEntryList` if
        `documentResource` is a
        <a href="#post-resource" id="beginning-navigation:post-resource-2">POST
        resource</a>; otherwise, null.

    3.  Let `navigationAPIStateForFiring` be `navigationAPIState` if
        `navigationAPIState` is not null; otherwise,
        <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
        id="beginning-navigation:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(undefined).

    4.  Let `continue` be the result of
        <a href="#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event"
        id="beginning-navigation:fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event">firing
        a push/replace/reload <code>navigate</code> event</a> at
        `navigation` with
        *[navigationType](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationtype)* set to
        `historyHandling`,
        *[isSameDocument](#fire-navigate-prr-issamedocument)* set to
        false, *[userInvolvement](#fire-navigate-prr-userinvolvement)*
        set to `userInvolvement`,
        *[sourceElement](#fire-navigate-prr-sourceelement)* set to
        `sourceElement`,
        *[formDataEntryList](#fire-navigate-prr-formdataentrylist)* set
        to `entryListForFiring`,
        *[destinationURL](#fire-navigate-prr-destinationurl)* set to
        `url`,
        *[navigationAPIState](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationapistate)*
        set to `navigationAPIStateForFiring`, and
        *[apiMethodTracker](#fire-navigate-prr-api-method-tracker)* set
        to `apiMethodTracker`.

    5.  If `continue` is false, then return.

    It is possible for navigations with `userInvolvement` of
    "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)" or initiated by a
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="beginning-navigation:same-origin-domain-2">cross origin-domain</a>
    `sourceDocument` to fire [`navigate`](#event-navigate) events, if
    they go through the earlier <a href="#navigate-fragid"
    id="beginning-navigation:navigate-fragid-3">navigate to a fragment</a>
    path.

22. If `sourceDocument` is `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="beginning-navigation:nav-container-document">container document</a>,
    then
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#reserve-deferred-fetch-quota"
    id="beginning-navigation:reserve-deferred-fetch-quota"
    data-x-internal="reserve-deferred-fetch-quota">reserve deferred fetch
    quota</a> for `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="beginning-navigation:nav-container-2">container</a> given
    `url`'s <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
    id="beginning-navigation:concept-url-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>.

23. <a href="#in-parallel" id="beginning-navigation:in-parallel">In
    parallel</a>, run these steps:

    1.  Let `unloadPromptCanceled` be the result of
        <a href="#checking-if-unloading-is-canceled"
        id="beginning-navigation:checking-if-unloading-is-canceled">checking if
        unloading is canceled</a> for `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-10">active
        document</a>'s <a href="#inclusive-descendant-navigables"
        id="beginning-navigation:inclusive-descendant-navigables">inclusive
        descendant navigables</a>.

    2.  If `unloadPromptCanceled` is not "`continue`", or `navigable`'s
        <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
        id="beginning-navigation:ongoing-navigation-3">ongoing navigation</a>
        is no longer `navigationId`:

        1.  Invoke <a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
            id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed-3"
            data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed">WebDriver BiDi
            navigation failed</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
            id="beginning-navigation:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status-4"
            data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
            navigation status</a> whose
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-id-4"
            data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is
            `navigationId`,
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-status-4"
            data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled"
            data-x-internal="navigation-status-canceled"><code
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-canceled-3">canceled</code></a>",
            and
            <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-status-url-4"
            data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `url`.

        2.  Abort these steps.

    3.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="beginning-navigation:queue-a-global-task-3">Queue a global task</a>
        on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-3">navigation
        and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-window" id="beginning-navigation:nav-window-4">active
        window</a> to <a href="#abort-a-document-and-its-descendants"
        id="beginning-navigation:abort-a-document-and-its-descendants">abort a
        document and its descendants</a> given `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="beginning-navigation:nav-document-11">active
        document</a>.

    4.  <div id="navigation-create-document-state">

        Let `documentState` be a new <a href="#document-state-2"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-2">document state</a>
        with

        <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-request-referrer-policy">request
        referrer policy</a>  
        `referrerPolicy`

        <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
        origin</a>  
        `initiatorOriginSnapshot`

        <a href="#document-state-resource"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-resource">resource</a>  
        `documentResource`

        <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
        target name</a>  
        `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-target" id="beginning-navigation:nav-target">target
        name</a>

        The <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
        id="beginning-navigation:document-state-nav-target-name-2">navigable
        target name</a> can get cleared under various conditions later
        in the navigation process, before the document state is
        finalized.

        </div>

    5.  If `url` <a href="#matches-about:blank"
        id="beginning-navigation:matches-about:blank">matches
        <code>about:blank</code></a> or is
        [`about:srcdoc`](#about:srcdoc), then:

        1.  Set `documentState`'s <a href="#document-state-origin"
            id="beginning-navigation:document-state-origin">origin</a>
            to `initiatorOriginSnapshot`.

        2.  Set `documentState`'s
            <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:document-state-about-base-url">about base
            URL</a> to `initiatorBaseURLSnapshot`.

    6.  Let `historyEntry` be a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="beginning-navigation:session-history-entry">session history
        entry</a>, with its
        <a href="#she-url" id="beginning-navigation:she-url-2">URL</a>
        set to `url` and its <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="beginning-navigation:she-document-state">document state</a>
        set to `documentState`.

    7.  Let `navigationParams` be null.

    8.  If `response` is non-null:

        <a href="#note-navigate-called-with-response" class="self-link"></a>The
        <a href="#navigate" id="beginning-navigation:navigate">navigate</a>
        algorithm is only supplied with a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
        id="beginning-navigation:concept-response-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> as part of the
        [`object`](#the-object-element) and
        [`embed`](#the-embed-element) processing models, or for
        processing parts of
        <a href="#navigate-multipart-x-mixed-replace"
        id="beginning-navigation:navigate-multipart-x-mixed-replace"><code>multipart/x-mixed-replace</code>
        responses</a> after the initial response.

        1.  Let `sourcePolicyContainer` be a
            <a href="#clone-a-policy-container"
            id="beginning-navigation:clone-a-policy-container">clone</a>
            of the `sourceDocument`'s
            <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
            id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-policy-container">policy
            container</a>, if `sourceDocument` is not null; otherwise
            null.

        2.  Let `policyContainer` be the result of
            <a href="#determining-navigation-params-policy-container"
            id="beginning-navigation:determining-navigation-params-policy-container">determining
            navigation params policy container</a> given `response`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:concept-response-url"
            data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, null,
            `sourcePolicyContainer`, `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-container-document"
            id="beginning-navigation:nav-container-document-2">container
            document</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
            id="beginning-navigation:concept-document-policy-container-2">policy
            container</a>, and null.

        3.  Let `finalSandboxFlags` be the
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-union"
            id="beginning-navigation:set-union"
            data-x-internal="set-union">union</a> of
            `targetSnapshotParams`'s
            <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
            id="beginning-navigation:target-snapshot-params-sandbox">sandboxing
            flags</a> and `policyContainer`'s
            <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
            id="beginning-navigation:policy-container-csp-list">CSP list</a>'s
            <a href="#csp-derived-sandboxing-flags"
            id="beginning-navigation:csp-derived-sandboxing-flags">CSP-derived
            sandboxing flags</a>.

        4.  Let `responseOrigin` be the result of
            <a href="#determining-the-origin"
            id="beginning-navigation:determining-the-origin">determining the
            origin</a> given `response`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:concept-response-url-2"
            data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>,
            `finalSandboxFlags`, and `documentState`'s
            <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
            id="beginning-navigation:document-state-initiator-origin-2">initiator
            origin</a>.

        5.  Let `coop` be a new <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
            id="beginning-navigation:cross-origin-opener-policy">opener policy</a>.

        6.  Let `coopEnforcementResult` be a new
            <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
            id="beginning-navigation:coop-enforcement-result">opener policy
            enforcement result</a> with

            <a href="#coop-enforcement-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:coop-enforcement-url">url</a>  
            `response`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:concept-response-url-3"
            data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>

            <a href="#coop-enforcement-origin"
            id="beginning-navigation:coop-enforcement-origin">origin</a>  
            `responseOrigin`

            <a href="#coop-enforcement-coop"
            id="beginning-navigation:coop-enforcement-coop">opener policy</a>  
            `coop`

        7.  Set `navigationParams` to a new <a href="#navigation-params"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params">navigation params</a>,
            with

            <a href="#navigation-params-id"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-id">id</a>  
            `navigationId`

            <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-navigable">navigable</a>  
            `navigable`

            <a href="#navigation-params-request"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-request">request</a>  
            null

            <a href="#navigation-params-response"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-response">response</a>  
            `response`

            <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-fetch-controller">fetch
            controller</a>  
            null

            <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-commit-early-hints">commit
            early hints</a>  
            null

            <a href="#navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result">COOP
            enforcement result</a>  
            `coopEnforcementResult`

            <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-reserved-environment">reserved
            environment</a>  
            null

            <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-origin">origin</a>  
            `responseOrigin`

            <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-policy-container">policy
            container</a>  
            `policyContainer`

            <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-sandboxing">final sandboxing
            flag set</a>  
            `finalSandboxFlags`

            <a href="#navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
            element referrer policy</a>  
            `targetSnapshotParams`'s
            <a href="#target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
            id="beginning-navigation:target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
            element referrer policy</a>

            <a href="#navigation-params-coop"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-coop">opener policy</a>  
            `coop`

            <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-nav-timing-type">navigation
            timing type</a>  
            "<a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"
            data-x-internal="dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"><code
            id="beginning-navigation:dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate">navigate</code></a>"

            <a href="#navigation-params-about-base-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-about-base-url">about base
            URL</a>  
            `documentState`'s <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
            id="beginning-navigation:document-state-about-base-url-2">about base
            URL</a>

            <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
            id="beginning-navigation:navigation-params-user-involvement">user
            involvement</a>  
            `userInvolvement`

    9.  <a href="#attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document"
        id="beginning-navigation:attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document">Attempt
        to populate the history entry's document</a> for `historyEntry`,
        given `navigable`, "<a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"
        data-x-internal="dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"><code
        id="beginning-navigation:dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate-2">navigate</code></a>",
        `sourceSnapshotParams`, `targetSnapshotParams`,
        `userInvolvement`, `navigationId`, `navigationParams`,
        `cspNavigationType`, with
        *[allowPOST](#attempt-to-populate-allow-post)* set to true and
        *[completionSteps](#attempt-to-populate-completion-steps)* set
        to the following step:

        1.  <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
            id="beginning-navigation:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
            session history traversal steps</a> to `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-traversable"
            id="beginning-navigation:nav-traversable">traversable</a> to
            <a href="#finalize-a-cross-document-navigation"
            id="beginning-navigation:finalize-a-cross-document-navigation">finalize
            a cross-document navigation</a> given `navigable`,
            `historyHandling`, `userInvolvement`, and `historyEntry`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.2.3</span> Ending navigation<a href="#ending-navigation" class="self-link"></a>

Although the usual cross-document navigation case will first foray into
[populating a session history
entry](#populating-a-session-history-entry) with a
[`Document`](#document), all navigations that don't get aborted will
ultimately end up calling into one of the below algorithms.

###### <span class="secno">7.4.2.3.1</span> The usual cross-document navigation case<a href="#the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case"
class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="finalize-a-cross-document-navigation" class="dfn">finalize
a cross-document navigation</span> given a <a href="#navigable"
id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:navigable">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:history-handling-behavior">history
handling behavior</a> `historyHandling`, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, and a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a> `historyEntry`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this is running on
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:nav-traversable">traversable
    navigable's</a> <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session
    history traversal queue</a>.

2.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#delaying-load-events-mode"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:delaying-load-events-mode">is
    delaying <code>load</code> events</a> to false.

3.  If `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document">document</a>
    is null, then return.

    This means that
    <a href="#attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document">attempting
    to populate the history entry's document</a> ended up not creating a
    document, as a result of e.g., the navigation being canceled by a
    subsequent navigation, a 204 No Content response, etc.

4.  <div id="resetBCName">

    If all of the following are true:

    - `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-parent"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:nav-parent">parent</a>
      is null;

    - `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document-2">document</a>'s
      <a href="#concept-document-bc"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:concept-document-bc">browsing
      context</a> is not an <a href="#auxiliary-browsing-context"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:auxiliary-browsing-context">auxiliary
      browsing context</a> whose <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:opener-browsing-context">opener
      browsing context</a> is non-null; and

    - `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document-3">document</a>'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:concept-document-origin"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
      `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:nav-document">active
      document</a>'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:concept-document-origin-2"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>,

    then set `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document-state">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
    target name</a> to the empty string.

    </div>

5.  Let `entryToReplace` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:nav-active-history-entry">active
    session history entry</a> if `historyHandling` is
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", otherwise null.

6.  Let `traversable` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:nav-traversable-2">traversable
    navigable</a>.

7.  Let `targetStep` be null.

8.  Let `targetEntries` be the result of
    <a href="#getting-session-history-entries"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:getting-session-history-entries">getting
    session history entries</a> for `navigable`.

9.  If `entryToReplace` is null, then:

    1.  <a href="#clear-the-forward-session-history"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:clear-the-forward-session-history">Clear
        the forward session history</a> of `traversable`.

    2.  Set `targetStep` to `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:tn-current-session-history-step">current
        session history step</a> + 1.

    3.  Set `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-step"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-step">step</a>
        to `targetStep`.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `historyEntry` to
        `targetEntries`.

    Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-replace"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:list-replace"
        data-x-internal="list-replace">Replace</a> `entryToReplace` with
        `historyEntry` in `targetEntries`.

    2.  Set `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-step"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-step-2">step</a>
        to `entryToReplace`'s <a href="#she-step"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-step-3">step</a>.

    3.  If `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document-state-2">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:document-state-origin">origin</a>
        is <a href="#same-origin"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:same-origin">same
        origin</a> with `entryToReplace`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-document-state-3">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:document-state-origin-2">origin</a>,
        then set `historyEntry`'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-key"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-navigation-api-key">navigation
        API key</a> to `entryToReplace`'s
        <a href="#she-navigation-api-key"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:she-navigation-api-key-2">navigation
        API key</a>.

    4.  Set `targetStep` to `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
        id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:tn-current-session-history-step-2">current
        session history step</a>.

10. <a href="#apply-the-push/replace-history-step"
    id="the-usual-cross-document-navigation-case:apply-the-push/replace-history-step">Apply
    the push/replace history step</a> `targetStep` to `traversable`
    given `historyHandling` and `userInvolvement`.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.4.2.3.2</span> <span class="dfn">The `javascript:` URL special case</span><a href="#the-javascript:-url-special-case" class="self-link"></a>

[`javascript:`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case) URLs have a
[dedicated
label](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20javascript%3A%20URLs)
on the issue tracker documenting various problems with their
specification.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-to-a-javascript:-url" class="dfn">navigate to a
`javascript:` URL</span>, given a <a href="#navigable"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigable">navigable</a>
`targetNavigable`, a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`url`, a <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:history-handling-behavior">history
handling behavior</a> `historyHandling`, a
<a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:source-snapshot-params">source
snapshot params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-origin">origin</a>
`initiatorOrigin`, a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, a string
`cspNavigationType`, a boolean `initialInsertion`, and a
<a href="#navigation-id"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>
`navigationId`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `historyHandling` is
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

2.  If `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:ongoing-navigation">ongoing
    navigation</a> is no longer `navigationId`, then return.

3.  <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:set-the-ongoing-navigation">Set the
    ongoing navigation</a> for `targetNavigable` to null.

4.  If `initiatorOrigin` is not <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:same-origin-domain">same
    origin-domain</a> with `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document">active document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then return.

5.  Let `request` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-request"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> whose
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-request-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a> is `url` and whose <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-request-policy-container"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-policy-container">policy container</a>
    is `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:source-snapshot-params-policy-container">source
    policy container</a>.

    This is a synthetic
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-request-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> solely for plumbing
    into the next step. It will never hit the network.

6.  If the result of <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-navigation-request"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:should-navigation-request-of-type-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy"
    data-x-internal="should-navigation-request-of-type-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy">should
    navigation request of type be blocked by Content Security Policy?</a>
    given `request` and `cspNavigationType` is "`Blocked`", then return.
    [\[CSP\]](#refsCSP)

7.  Let `newDocument` be the result of
    <a href="#evaluate-a-javascript:-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:evaluate-a-javascript:-url">evaluating
    a <code>javascript:</code> URL</a> given `targetNavigable`, `url`,
    `initiatorOrigin`, and `userInvolvement`.

8.  If `newDocument` is null:

    1.  If `initialInsertion` is true and `targetNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document"
        id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-2">active document</a>'s
        <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
        id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
        <code>about:blank</code></a> is true, then run the
        <a href="#iframe-load-event-steps"
        id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:iframe-load-event-steps">iframe
        load event steps</a> given `targetNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-container"
        id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-container">container</a>.

    2.  Return.

    In this case, some JavaScript code was executed, but no new
    [`Document`](#document) was created, so we will not perform a
    navigation.

9.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `initiatorOrigin` is
    `newDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

10. Let `entryToReplace` be `targetNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-active-history-entry">active
    session history entry</a>.

11. Let `oldDocState` be `entryToReplace`'s
    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:she-document-state">document
    state</a>.

12. Let `documentState` be a new <a href="#document-state-2"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-2">document
    state</a> with

    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-document">document</a>  
    `newDocument`

    <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-history-policy-container">history
    policy container</a>  
    a <a href="#clone-a-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:clone-a-policy-container">clone</a>
    of the `oldDocState`'s
    <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-history-policy-container-2">history
    policy container</a> if it is non-null; null otherwise

    <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-request-referrer">request
    referrer</a>  
    `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-request-referrer-2">request
    referrer</a>

    <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-request-referrer-policy">request
    referrer policy</a>  
    `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-request-referrer-policy-2">request
    referrer policy</a> <span class="XXX">or should this be the
    `referrerPolicy` that was passed to <a href="#navigate"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigate">navigate</a>?</span>

    <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
    origin</a>  
    `initiatorOrigin`

    <a href="#document-state-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-origin">origin</a>  
    `initiatorOrigin`

    <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-about-base-url">about
    base URL</a>  
    `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-about-base-url-2">about
    base URL</a>

    <a href="#document-state-resource"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-resource">resource</a>  
    null

    <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-ever-populated">ever
    populated</a>  
    true

    <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
    target name</a>  
    `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:document-state-nav-target-name-2">navigable
    target name</a>

13. Let `historyEntry` be a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:session-history-entry">session
    history entry</a>, with

    <a href="#she-url" id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:she-url">URL</a>  
    `entryToReplace`'s <a href="#she-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:she-url-2">URL</a>

    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:she-document-state-2">document
    state</a>  
    `documentState`

    For the <a href="#she-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:she-url-3">URL</a>, we do *not*
    use `url`, i.e. the actual
    [`javascript:`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case) URL that the
    <a href="#navigate"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigate-2">navigate</a>
    algorithm was called with. This means
    [`javascript:`](#the-javascript:-url-special-case) URLs are never
    stored in session history, and so can never be traversed to.

14. <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
    session history traversal steps</a> to `targetNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-traversable">traversable</a>
    to <a href="#finalize-a-cross-document-navigation"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:finalize-a-cross-document-navigation">finalize
    a cross-document navigation</a> with `targetNavigable`,
    `historyHandling`, `userInvolvement`, and `historyEntry`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="evaluate-a-javascript:-url" class="dfn">evaluate a
`javascript:` URL</span> given a <a href="#navigable"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigable-2">navigable</a>
`targetNavigable`, a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:url-2"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-origin-2">origin</a>
`newDocumentOrigin`, and a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:user-navigation-involvement-2">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`:

1.  Let `urlString` be the result of running the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-url-serializer"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">URL serializer</a> on
    `url`.

2.  Let `encodedScriptSource` be the result of removing the leading
    "`javascript:`" from `urlString`.

3.  Let `scriptSource` be the
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:utf-8-decode"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-decode">UTF-8 decoding</a> of the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-percent-decode"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:percent-decode"
    data-x-internal="percent-decode">percent-decoding</a> of
    `encodedScriptSource`.

4.  Let `settings` be `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-3">active document</a>'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>.

5.  Let `baseURL` be `settings`'s <a href="#api-base-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:api-base-url">API base URL</a>.

6.  Let `script` be the result of <a href="#creating-a-classic-script"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:creating-a-classic-script">creating
    a classic script</a> given `scriptSource`, `settings`, `baseURL`,
    and the <a href="#default-script-fetch-options"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:default-script-fetch-options">default
    script fetch options</a>.

7.  Let `evaluationStatus` be the result of
    <a href="#run-a-classic-script"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:run-a-classic-script">running the
    classic script</a> `script`.

8.  Let `result` be null.

9.  If `evaluationStatus` is a normal completion, and
    `evaluationStatus`.\[\[Value\]\] is a String, then set `result` to
    `evaluationStatus`.\[\[Value\]\].

10. Otherwise, return null.

11. Let `response` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> with

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-response-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>  
    `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-4">active document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-response-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>  
    « (\`[`Content-Type`](#content-type)\`,
    \``text/html;charset=utf-8`\`) »

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-response-body"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a>  
    the <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-encode"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:utf-8-encode"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-encode">UTF-8 encoding</a> of `result`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:as-a-body"
    data-x-internal="as-a-body">as a body</a>

    The encoding to UTF-8 means that unpaired
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#surrogate"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:surrogate"
    data-x-internal="surrogate">surrogates</a> will not roundtrip, once
    the HTML parser decodes the response body.

12. Let `policyContainer` be `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-5">active document</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-document-policy-container">policy
    container</a>.

13. Let `finalSandboxFlags` be `policyContainer`'s
    <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:policy-container-csp-list">CSP
    list</a>'s <a href="#csp-derived-sandboxing-flags"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:csp-derived-sandboxing-flags">CSP-derived
    sandboxing flags</a>.

14. Let `coop` be `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-6">active document</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-document-coop"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-document-coop">opener
    policy</a>.

15. Let `coopEnforcementResult` be a new
    <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:coop-enforcement-result">opener
    policy enforcement result</a> with

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:coop-enforcement-url">url</a>  
    `url`

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:coop-enforcement-origin">origin</a>  
    `newDocumentOrigin`

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-coop"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:coop-enforcement-coop">opener
    policy</a>  
    `coop`

16. Let `navigationParams` be a new <a href="#navigation-params"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params">navigation
    params</a>, with

    <a href="#navigation-params-id"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-id">id</a>  
    `navigationId`

    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-navigable">navigable</a>  
    `targetNavigable`

    <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-request">request</a>  
    null <span class="XXX">this will cause the referrer of the resulting
    [`Document`](#document) to be null; is that correct?</span>

    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-response">response</a>  
    `response`

    <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-fetch-controller">fetch
    controller</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-commit-early-hints">commit
    early hints</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result">COOP
    enforcement result</a>  
    `coopEnforcementResult`

    <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-reserved-environment">reserved
    environment</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-origin">origin</a>  
    `newDocumentOrigin`

    <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-policy-container">policy
    container</a>  
    `policyContainer`

    <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-sandboxing">final
    sandboxing flag set</a>  
    `finalSandboxFlags`

    <a href="#navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
    element referrer policy</a>  
    `targetSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
    element referrer policy</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-coop">opener
    policy</a>  
    `coop`

    <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-nav-timing-type">navigation
    timing type</a>  
    "<a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"
    data-x-internal="dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate"><code
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:dom-navigationtimingtype-navigate">navigate</code></a>"

    <a href="#navigation-params-about-base-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-about-base-url">about
    base URL</a>  
    `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:nav-document-7">active document</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-document-about-base-url"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:concept-document-about-base-url">about
    base URL</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigation-params-user-involvement">user
    involvement</a>  
    `userInvolvement`

17. Return the result of <a href="#navigate-html"
    id="the-javascript:-url-special-case:navigate-html">loading an HTML
    document</a> given `navigationParams`.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.4.2.3.3</span> Fragment navigations<a href="#scroll-to-fragid" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-fragid" class="dfn">navigate to a fragment</span>
given a
<a href="#navigable" id="scroll-to-fragid:navigable">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="scroll-to-fragid:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, a
<a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="scroll-to-fragid:history-handling-behavior">history handling
behavior</a> `historyHandling`, a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="scroll-to-fragid:user-navigation-involvement">user navigation
involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="scroll-to-fragid:element">Element</code></a>-or-null
`sourceElement`, a <a href="#serialized-state"
id="scroll-to-fragid:serialized-state">serialized state</a>-or-null
`navigationAPIState`, and a
<a href="#navigation-id" id="scroll-to-fragid:navigation-id">navigation
ID</a> `navigationId`:

1.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-window">active window</a>'s
    <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.
