2.  Let `destinationNavigationAPIState` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry">active session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-navigation-api-state">navigation API state</a>.

3.  If `navigationAPIState` is not null, then set
    `destinationNavigationAPIState` to `navigationAPIState`.

4.  Let `continue` be the result of
    <a href="#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event">firing a
    push/replace/reload <code>navigate</code> event</a> at `navigation`
    with *[navigationType](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationtype)* set to
    `historyHandling`,
    *[isSameDocument](#fire-navigate-prr-issamedocument)* set to true,
    *[userInvolvement](#fire-navigate-prr-userinvolvement)* set to
    `userInvolvement`,
    *[sourceElement](#fire-navigate-prr-sourceelement)* set to
    `sourceElement`,
    *[destinationURL](#fire-navigate-prr-destinationurl)* set to `url`,
    and *[navigationAPIState](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationapistate)*
    set to `destinationNavigationAPIState`.

5.  If `continue` is false, then return.

6.  Let `historyEntry` be a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:session-history-entry">session history entry</a>,
    with

    <a href="#she-url" id="scroll-to-fragid:she-url">URL</a>  
    `url`

    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-document-state">document state</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-document-state-2">document state</a>

    <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-navigation-api-state-2">navigation API
    state</a>  
    `destinationNavigationAPIState`

    <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-scroll-restoration-mode">scroll restoration
    mode</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry-3">active session history
    entry</a>'s <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-scroll-restoration-mode-2">scroll restoration
    mode</a>

    <div class="note">

    For navigations performed with
    [`navigation.navigate()`](#dom-navigation-navigate), the value
    provided by the [`state`](#dom-navigationnavigateoptions-state)
    option is used for the new <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-navigation-api-state-3">navigation API
    state</a>. (This will set it to the serialization of undefined, if
    no value is provided for that option.) For other fragment
    navigations, including user-initiated ones, the
    <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-navigation-api-state-4">navigation API
    state</a> is carried over from the previous entry.

    The <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:she-classic-history-api-state">classic history API
    state</a> is never carried over.

    </div>

7.  Let `entryToReplace` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry-4">active session history
    entry</a> if `historyHandling` is
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", otherwise null.

8.  Let `history` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-document">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="#doc-history" id="scroll-to-fragid:doc-history">history
    object</a>.

9.  Let `scriptHistoryIndex` be `history`'s
    <a href="#concept-history-index"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:concept-history-index">index</a>.

10. Let `scriptHistoryLength` be `history`'s
    <a href="#concept-history-length"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:concept-history-length">length</a>.

11. If `historyHandling` is "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)",
    then:

    1.  Set `history`'s <a href="#concept-history-state"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:concept-history-state">state</a> to null.

    2.  Increment `scriptHistoryIndex`.

    3.  Set `scriptHistoryLength` to `scriptHistoryIndex` + 1.

12. Set `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-document-2">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> to `url`.

13. Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry-5">active session history
    entry</a> to `historyEntry`.

14. <a href="#update-document-for-history-step-application"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:update-document-for-history-step-application">Update
    document for history step application</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-document-3">active
    document</a>, `historyEntry`, true, `scriptHistoryIndex`,
    `scriptHistoryLength`, and `historyHandling`.

    This algorithm will be called twice as a result of a single fragment
    navigation: once synchronously, where best-guess values
    `scriptHistoryIndex` and `scriptHistoryLength` are set,
    [`history.state`](#dom-history-state) is nulled out, and various
    events are fired; and once asynchronously, where the final values
    for index and length are set, [`history.state`](#dom-history-state)
    remains untouched, and no events are fired.

15. <a href="#scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier">Scroll to the
    fragment</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-document-4">active
    document</a>.

    If the scrolling fails because the [`Document`](#document) is new
    and the relevant <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:concept-id" data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a>
    has not yet been parsed, then the second asynchronous call to
    <a href="#update-document-for-history-step-application"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:update-document-for-history-step-application-2">update
    document for history step application</a> will take care of
    scrolling.

16. Let `traversable` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>.

17. <a href="#tn-append-session-history-sync-nav-steps"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-append-session-history-sync-nav-steps">Append
    the following session history synchronous navigation steps</a>
    involving `navigable` to `traversable`:

    1.  <a href="#finalize-a-same-document-navigation"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:finalize-a-same-document-navigation">Finalize a
        same-document navigation</a> given `traversable`, `navigable`,
        `historyEntry`, `entryToReplace`, `historyHandling`, and
        `userInvolvement`.

    2.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-fragment-navigated"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:webdriver-bidi-fragment-navigated"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-fragment-navigated">WebDriver BiDi
        fragment navigated</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation status</a> whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:navigation-status-id"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `navigationId`,
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:navigation-status-url"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `url`, and
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:navigation-status-status"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-complete"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-complete"><code
        id="scroll-to-fragid:navigation-status-complete">complete</code></a>".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="finalize-a-same-document-navigation" class="dfn">finalize a
same-document navigation</span> given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="scroll-to-fragid:traversable-navigable">traversable navigable</a>
`traversable`, a
<a href="#navigable" id="scroll-to-fragid:navigable-2">navigable</a>
`targetNavigable`, a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="scroll-to-fragid:session-history-entry-2">session history entry</a>
`targetEntry`, a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="scroll-to-fragid:session-history-entry-3">session history entry</a>-or-null
`entryToReplace`, a <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="scroll-to-fragid:history-handling-behavior-2">history handling
behavior</a> `historyHandling`, and a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="scroll-to-fragid:user-navigation-involvement-2">user navigation
involvement</a> `userInvolvement`:

This is used by both <a href="#navigate-fragid"
id="scroll-to-fragid:navigate-fragid">fragment navigations</a> and by
the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
id="scroll-to-fragid:url-and-history-update-steps">URL and history
update steps</a>, which are the only synchronous updates to session
history. By virtue of being synchronous, those algorithms are performed
outside of the <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="scroll-to-fragid:top-level-traversable">top-level traversable</a>'s
<a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session history
traversal queue</a>. This puts them out of sync with the
<a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="scroll-to-fragid:top-level-traversable-2">top-level traversable</a>'s
<a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-current-session-history-step">current session
history step</a>, so this algorithm is used to resolve conflicts due to
race conditions.

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    this is running on `traversable`'s
    <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-2">session
    history traversal queue</a>.

2.  If `targetNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:nav-active-history-entry-6">active session history
    entry</a> is not `targetEntry`, then return.

3.  Let `targetStep` be null.

4.  Let `targetEntries` be the result of
    <a href="#getting-session-history-entries"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:getting-session-history-entries">getting session
    history entries</a> for `targetNavigable`.

5.  If `entryToReplace` is null, then:

    1.  <a href="#clear-the-forward-session-history"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:clear-the-forward-session-history">Clear the
        forward session history</a> of `traversable`.

    2.  Set `targetStep` to `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-current-session-history-step-2">current session
        history step</a> + 1.

    3.  Set `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="scroll-to-fragid:she-step">step</a> to
        `targetStep`.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `targetEntry` to
        `targetEntries`.

    Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-replace"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:list-replace"
        data-x-internal="list-replace">Replace</a> `entryToReplace` with
        `targetEntry` in `targetEntries`.

    2.  Set `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="scroll-to-fragid:she-step-2">step</a> to
        `entryToReplace`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="scroll-to-fragid:she-step-3">step</a>.

    3.  Set `targetStep` to `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
        id="scroll-to-fragid:tn-current-session-history-step-3">current session
        history step</a>.

6.  <a href="#apply-the-push/replace-history-step"
    id="scroll-to-fragid:apply-the-push/replace-history-step">Apply the
    push/replace history step</a> `targetStep` to `traversable` given
    `historyHandling` and `userInvolvement`.

    This is done even for
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)" navigations, as it
    resolves race conditions across multiple synchronous navigations.

</div>

###### <span class="secno">7.4.2.3.4</span> Non-fetch schemes and external software<a href="#non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software"
class="self-link"></a>

The input to <a href="#attempt-to-create-a-non-fetch-scheme-document"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:attempt-to-create-a-non-fetch-scheme-document">attempt
to create a non-fetch scheme document</a> is the
<span id="non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params" class="dfn">non-fetch
scheme navigation params</span>
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:struct"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>. It is a lightweight version of
<a href="#navigation-params"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> which only carries parameters relevant to the
non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:fetch-scheme"
data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a> navigation case. It has
the following <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-id" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">id</span>  
null or a <a href="#navigation-id"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigation-id">navigation
ID</a>

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">navigable</span>  
the <a href="#navigable"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigable">navigable</a>
experiencing the navigation

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-url" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation params">URL</span>  
a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:url"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a>

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">target snapshot sandboxing flags</span>  
the <a href="#target-snapshot-params"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:target-snapshot-params">target
snapshot params</a>'s <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:target-snapshot-params-sandbox">sandboxing
flags</a> present during navigation

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">source snapshot has transient activation</span>  
a copy of the <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:source-snapshot-params">source
snapshot params</a>'s <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:source-snapshot-params-activation">has
transient activation</a> boolean present during activation

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">initiator origin</span>  
an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:concept-origin">origin</a>
possibly for use in a user-facing prompt to confirm the invocation of an
external software package

This differs slightly from a <a href="#she-document-state"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:she-document-state">document
state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
origin</a> in that a <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params">non-fetch
scheme navigation params</a>'s
<a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin">initiator
origin</a> follows redirects up to the last
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:fetch-scheme-2"
data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a> URL in a redirect chain
that ends in a non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:fetch-scheme-3"
data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a> URL.

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">navigation timing type</span>  
a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigationtimingtype">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
used for <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dfn-create-the-navigation-timing-entry"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:create-the-navigation-timing-entry"
data-x-internal="create-the-navigation-timing-entry">creating the
navigation timing entry</a> for the new [`Document`](#document) (if one
is created)

<span id="non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement" class="dfn" dfn-for="non-fetch scheme navigation
   params">user involvement</span>  
a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> used when
<a href="#obtain-browsing-context-navigation"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:obtain-browsing-context-navigation">obtaining
a browsing context</a> for the new [`Document`](#document) (if one is
created)

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="attempt-to-create-a-non-fetch-scheme-document"
class="dfn">attempt to create a non-fetch scheme document</span>, given
a <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-2">non-fetch
scheme navigation params</a> `navigationParams`:

1.  Let `url` be `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-url"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-url">URL</a>.

2.  Let `navigable` be `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable">navigable</a>.

3.  If `url` is to be handled using a mechanism that does not affect
    `navigable`, e.g., because `url`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:concept-url-scheme"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is handled
    externally, then:

    1.  <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
        id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:hand-off-to-external-software">Hand-off
        to external software</a> given `url`, `navigable`,
        `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox"
        id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox">target
        snapshot sandboxing flags</a>, `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation"
        id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation">source
        snapshot has transient activation</a>, and `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin"
        id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin-2">initiator
        origin</a>.

    2.  Return null.

4.  Handle `url` by displaying some sort of inline content, e.g., an
    error message because the specified scheme is not one of the
    supported protocols, or an inline prompt to allow the user to select
    <a href="#dom-navigator-registerprotocolhandler"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:dom-navigator-registerprotocolhandler">a
    registered handler</a> for the given scheme. Return the result of
    <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigate-ua-inline">displaying
    the inline content</a> given `navigable`, `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-id"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-id">id</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type">navigation
    timing type</a>, and `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement">user
    involvement</a>.

    In the case of a registered handler being used, <a href="#navigate"
    id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigate">navigate</a>
    will be invoked with a new URL.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="hand-off-to-external-software" class="dfn">hand-off to
external software</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:url-2"
data-x-internal="url">URL</a> or
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:concept-response"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `resource`, a
<a href="#navigable"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:navigable-2">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:sandboxing-flag-set">sandboxing
flag set</a> `sandboxFlags`, a boolean `hasTransientActivation`, and an
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:concept-origin-2">origin</a>
`initiatorOrigin`, user agents should:

1.  If all of the following are true:

    - `navigable` is not a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
      id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:top-level-traversable">top-level
      traversable</a>;

    - `sandboxFlags` has its
      <a href="#sandboxed-custom-protocols-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:sandboxed-custom-protocols-navigation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      custom protocols navigation browsing context flag</a> set; and

    - `sandboxFlags` has its <a
      href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
      id="non-fetch-schemes-and-external-software:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
      top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag</a>
      set, or `hasTransientActivation` is false,

    then return without invoking the external software package.

    Navigation inside an iframe toward external software can be seen by
    users as a new popup or a new top-level navigation. That's why its
    is allowed in sandboxed [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) only when
    one of [`allow-popups`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-popups),
    [`allow-top-navigation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation),
    [`allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation),
    or
    [`allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols`](#attr-iframe-sandbox-allow-top-navigation-to-custom-protocols)
    is specified.

2.  Perform the appropriate handoff of `resource` while attempting to
    mitigate the risk that this is an attempt to exploit the target
    software. For example, user agents could prompt the user to confirm
    that `initiatorOrigin` is to be allowed to invoke the external
    software in question. In particular, if `hasTransientActivation` is
    false, then the user agent should not invoke the external software
    package without prior user confirmation.

    For example, there could be a vulnerability in the target software's
    URL handler which a hostile page would attempt to exploit by
    tricking a user into clicking a link.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.2.4</span> Preventing navigation<a href="#preventing-navigation" class="self-link"></a>

A couple of scenarios can intervene early in the navigation process and
put the whole thing to a halt. This can be especially exciting when
multiple
<a href="#navigable" id="preventing-navigation:navigable">navigables</a>
are navigating at the same time, due to a session history traversal.

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#navigable"
id="preventing-navigation:navigable-2">navigable</a> `source` is
<span id="allowed-to-navigate" class="dfn">allowed by sandboxing to
navigate</span> a second <a href="#navigable"
id="preventing-navigation:navigable-3">navigable</a> `target`, given a
<a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params">source snapshot
params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, if the following steps return true:

1.  If `source` is `target`, then return true.

2.  If `source` is an ancestor of `target`, then return true.

3.  If `target` is an ancestor of `source`, then:

    1.  If `target` is not a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
        id="preventing-navigation:top-level-traversable">top-level
        traversable</a>, then return true.

    2.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
        id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-activation">has
        transient activation</a> is true, and `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-sandbox"
        id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-sandbox">sandboxing
        flags</a>'s <a
        href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
        id="preventing-navigation:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-with-user-activation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
        top-level navigation with user activation browsing context flag</a>
        is set, then return false.

    3.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
        id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-activation-2">has
        transient activation</a> is false, and `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-sandbox"
        id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-sandbox-2">sandboxing
        flags</a>'s <a
        href="#sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag"
        id="preventing-navigation:sandboxed-top-level-navigation-without-user-activation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
        top-level navigation without user activation browsing context flag</a>
        is set, then return false.

    4.  Return true.

4.  If `target` is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="preventing-navigation:top-level-traversable-2">top-level
    traversable</a>:

    1.  If `source` is the <a href="#one-permitted-sandboxed-navigator"
        id="preventing-navigation:one-permitted-sandboxed-navigator">one
        permitted sandboxed navigator</a> of `target`, then return true.

    2.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-sandbox"
        id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-sandbox-3">sandboxing
        flags</a>'s
        <a href="#sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
        id="preventing-navigation:sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
        navigation browsing context flag</a> is set, then return false.

    3.  Return true.

5.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-sandbox"
    id="preventing-navigation:source-snapshot-params-sandbox-4">sandboxing
    flags</a>'s <a href="#sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag"
    id="preventing-navigation:sandboxed-navigation-browsing-context-flag-2">sandboxed
    navigation browsing context flag</a> is set, then return false.

6.  Return true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<span id="prompt-to-unload"></span><span id="checking-if-unloading-is-user-canceled"></span>To
<span id="checking-if-unloading-is-canceled" class="dfn">check if
unloading is canceled</span> for a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="preventing-navigation:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#navigable"
id="preventing-navigation:navigable-4">navigables</a>
`navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload`, given an optional
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="preventing-navigation:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, an optional integer `targetStep`, and an
optional <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="preventing-navigation:user-navigation-involvement">user navigation
involvement</a> `userInvolvementForNavigateEvent`, run these steps. They
return "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", "`canceled-by-navigate`", or
"`continue`".

1.  Let `documentsToFireBeforeunload` be the
    <a href="#nav-document" id="preventing-navigation:nav-document">active
    document</a> of each
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
    id="preventing-navigation:list-item"
    data-x-internal="list-item">item</a> in
    `navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload`.

2.  Let `unloadPromptShown` be false.

3.  Let `finalStatus` be "`continue`".

4.  If `traversable` was given, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="preventing-navigation:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `targetStep` and `userInvolvementForNavigateEvent` were given.

    2.  Let `targetEntry` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
        id="preventing-navigation:getting-the-target-history-entry">getting the
        target history entry</a> given `traversable` and `targetStep`.

    3.  If `targetEntry` is not `traversable`'s
        <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="preventing-navigation:nav-current-history-entry">current session
        history entry</a>, and `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="preventing-navigation:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="preventing-navigation:document-state-origin">origin</a> is
        the
        <a href="#same-origin" id="preventing-navigation:same-origin">same</a>
        as `traversable`'s <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="preventing-navigation:nav-current-history-entry-2">current session
        history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="preventing-navigation:she-document-state-2">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="preventing-navigation:document-state-origin-2">origin</a>,
        then:

        <div class="note">

        In this case, we're going to fire the
        [`navigate`](#event-navigate) event for `traversable` here.
        Because [under some
        circumstances](#navigate-event-traverse-can-be-canceled) it
        might be canceled, we need to do this separately from [other
        traversal `navigate`
        events](#descendant-navigable-traversal-navigate-events), which
        happen later.

        Additionally, because we want
        [`beforeunload`](#event-beforeunload) events to fire before
        [`navigate`](#event-navigate) events, this means we need to fire
        [`beforeunload`](#event-beforeunload) for `traversable` here (if
        applicable), instead of doing it as part of the below loop over
        `documentsToFireBeforeunload`.

        </div>

        1.  Let `eventsFired` be false.

        2.  Let `needsBeforeunload` be true if
            `navigablesThatNeedBeforeUnload`
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
            id="preventing-navigation:list-contains"
            data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> `traversable`;
            otherwise false.

        3.  If `needsBeforeunload` is true, then
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
            id="preventing-navigation:list-remove"
            data-x-internal="list-remove">remove</a> `traversable`'s
            <a href="#nav-document" id="preventing-navigation:nav-document-2">active
            document</a> from `documentsToFireBeforeunload`.

        4.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="preventing-navigation:queue-a-global-task">Queue a global task</a>
            on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="preventing-navigation:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `traversable`'s
            <a href="#nav-window" id="preventing-navigation:nav-window">active
            window</a> to perform the following steps:

            1.  If `needsBeforeunload` is true, then:

                1.  Let (`unloadPromptShownForThisDocument`,
                    `unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument`) be the result
                    of running the <a href="#steps-to-fire-beforeunload"
                    id="preventing-navigation:steps-to-fire-beforeunload">steps to fire
                    <code>beforeunload</code></a> given `traversable`'s
                    <a href="#nav-document" id="preventing-navigation:nav-document-3">active
                    document</a> and false.

                2.  If `unloadPromptShownForThisDocument` is true, then
                    set `unloadPromptShown` to true.

                3.  If `unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument` is true,
                    then set `finalStatus` to
                    "`canceled-by-beforeunload`".

            2.  If `finalStatus` is "`canceled-by-beforeunload`", then
                abort these steps.

            3.  Let `navigation` be `traversable`'s
                <a href="#nav-window" id="preventing-navigation:nav-window-2">active
                window</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
                id="preventing-navigation:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

            4.  Let `navigateEventResult` be the result of
                <a href="#fire-a-traverse-navigate-event"
                id="preventing-navigation:fire-a-traverse-navigate-event">firing a
                traverse <code>navigate</code> event</a> at `navigation`
                given `targetEntry` and
                `userInvolvementForNavigateEvent`.

            5.  If `navigateEventResult` is false, then set
                `finalStatus` to "`canceled-by-navigate`".

            6.  Set `eventsFired` to true.

        5.  Wait until `eventsFired` is true.

        6.  If `finalStatus` is not "`continue`", then return
            `finalStatus`.

5.  Let `totalTasks` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="preventing-navigation:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> of
    `documentsToFireBeforeunload`.

6.  Let `completedTasks` be 0.

7.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="preventing-navigation:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `document` of
    `documentsToFireBeforeunload`, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="preventing-navigation:queue-a-global-task-2">queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="preventing-navigation:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="preventing-navigation:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a> to run the steps:

    1.  Let (`unloadPromptShownForThisDocument`,
        `unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument`) be the result of running
        the <a href="#steps-to-fire-beforeunload"
        id="preventing-navigation:steps-to-fire-beforeunload-2">steps to fire
        <code>beforeunload</code></a> given `document` and
        `unloadPromptShown`.

    2.  If `unloadPromptShownForThisDocument` is true, then set
        `unloadPromptShown` to true.

    3.  If `unloadPromptCanceledByThisDocument` is true, then set
        `finalStatus` to "`canceled-by-beforeunload`".

    4.  Increment `completedTasks`.

8.  Wait for `completedTasks` to be `totalTasks`.

9.  Return `finalStatus`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="steps-to-fire-beforeunload" class="dfn">steps to fire
`beforeunload`</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `document` and a
boolean `unloadPromptShown` are:

1.  Let `unloadPromptCanceled` be false.

2.  Increase the `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="preventing-navigation:unload-counter">unload counter</a> by 1.

3.  Increase `document`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="preventing-navigation:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="preventing-navigation:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>'s
    <a href="#termination-nesting-level"
    id="preventing-navigation:termination-nesting-level">termination nesting
    level</a> by 1.

4.  Let `eventFiringResult` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="preventing-navigation:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">firing an event</a> named
    [`beforeunload`](#event-beforeunload) at `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="preventing-navigation:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>, using [`BeforeUnloadEvent`](#beforeunloadevent), with
    the <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable"
    data-x-internal="dom-event-cancelable"><code
    id="preventing-navigation:dom-event-cancelable">cancelable</code></a>
    attribute initialized to true.

5.  Decrease `document`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="preventing-navigation:relevant-agent-2">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="preventing-navigation:concept-agent-event-loop-2">event loop</a>'s
    <a href="#termination-nesting-level"
    id="preventing-navigation:termination-nesting-level-2">termination
    nesting level</a> by 1.

6.  If all of the following are true:

    - `unloadPromptShown` is false;

    - `document`'s <a href="#active-sandboxing-flag-set"
      id="preventing-navigation:active-sandboxing-flag-set">active sandboxing
      flag set</a> does not have its <a href="#sandboxed-modals-flag"
      id="preventing-navigation:sandboxed-modals-flag">sandboxed modals
      flag</a> set;

    - `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
      id="preventing-navigation:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
      object</a> has <a href="#sticky-activation"
      id="preventing-navigation:sticky-activation">sticky activation</a>;

    - `eventFiringResult` is false, or the
      [`returnValue`](#dom-beforeunloadevent-returnvalue) attribute of
      `event` is not the empty string; and

    - showing an unload prompt is unlikely to be annoying, deceptive, or
      pointless,

    then:

    1.  Set `unloadPromptShown` to true.

    2.  Let `userPromptHandler` be the result of <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-opened"
        id="preventing-navigation:webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-opened"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-opened">WebDriver BiDi user
        prompt opened</a> with `document`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="preventing-navigation:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global
        object</a>, "`beforeunload`", and "".

    3.  If `userPromptHandler` is "`dismiss`", then set
        `unloadPromptCanceled` to true.

    4.  If `userPromptHandler` is "`none`", then:

        1.  Ask the user to confirm that they wish to unload the
            document, and
            <a href="#pause" id="preventing-navigation:pause">pause</a>
            while waiting for the user's response.

            The message shown to the user is not customizable, but
            instead determined by the user agent. In particular, the
            actual value of the
            [`returnValue`](#dom-beforeunloadevent-returnvalue)
            attribute is ignored.

        2.  If the user did not confirm the page navigation, then set
            `unloadPromptCanceled` to true.

    5.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-closed"
        id="preventing-navigation:webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-closed"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-user-prompt-closed">WebDriver BiDi user
        prompt closed</a> with `document`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="preventing-navigation:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant global
        object</a>, "`beforeunload`", and true if `unloadPromptCanceled`
        is false or false otherwise.

7.  Decrease `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="preventing-navigation:unload-counter-2">unload counter</a> by 1.

8.  Return (`unloadPromptShown`, `unloadPromptCanceled`).

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.2.5</span> Aborting navigation<a href="#aborting-navigation" class="self-link"></a>

Each
<a href="#navigable" id="aborting-navigation:navigable">navigable</a>
has an <span id="ongoing-navigation" class="dfn">ongoing
navigation</span>, which is a <a href="#navigation-id"
id="aborting-navigation:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>, "`traversal`",
or null, initially null. It is used to track navigation aborting and to
prevent any navigations from taking place during
<a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
id="aborting-navigation:apply-the-traverse-history-step">traversal</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="set-the-ongoing-navigation" class="dfn">set the ongoing
navigation</span> for a
<a href="#navigable" id="aborting-navigation:navigable-2">navigable</a>
`navigable` to `newValue`:

1.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="aborting-navigation:ongoing-navigation">ongoing navigation</a>
    is equal to `newValue`, then return.

2.  <a href="#inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation"
    id="aborting-navigation:inform-the-navigation-api-about-aborting-navigation">Inform
    the navigation API about aborting navigation</a> given `navigable`.

3.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="aborting-navigation:ongoing-navigation-2">ongoing navigation</a>
    to `newValue`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.4.3</span> Reloading and traversing<a href="#reloading-and-traversing" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="reload" class="dfn">reload</span> a <a href="#navigable"
id="reloading-and-traversing:navigable">navigable</a> `navigable` given
an optional <a href="#serialized-state"
id="reloading-and-traversing:serialized-state">serialized state</a>-or-null
<span id="reload-navigation-api-state"
class="dfn">`navigationAPIState`</span> (default null), an optional
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="reloading-and-traversing:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> <span id="reload-user-involvement"
class="dfn">`userInvolvement`</span> (default "[`none`](#uni-none)"),
and an optional <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
id="reloading-and-traversing:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation
API method tracker</a>-or-null <span id="reload-api-method-tracker"
class="dfn">`apiMethodTracker`</span> (default null):

1.  If `userInvolvement` is not "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)", then:

    1.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-window" id="reloading-and-traversing:nav-window">active
        window</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

    2.  Let `destinationNavigationAPIState` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:nav-active-history-entry">active session
        history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-navigation-api-state"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:she-navigation-api-state">navigation API
        state</a>.

    3.  If `navigationAPIState` is not null, then set
        `destinationNavigationAPIState` to `navigationAPIState`.

    4.  Let `continue` be the result of
        <a href="#fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:fire-a-push/replace/reload-navigate-event">firing
        a push/replace/reload <code>navigate</code> event</a> at
        `navigation` with
        *[navigationType](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationtype)* set to
        "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)",
        *[isSameDocument](#fire-navigate-prr-issamedocument)* set to
        false, *[userInvolvement](#fire-navigate-prr-userinvolvement)*
        set to `userInvolvement`,
        *[destinationURL](#fire-navigate-prr-destinationurl)* set to
        `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session
        history entry</a>'s
        <a href="#she-url" id="reloading-and-traversing:she-url">URL</a>,
        *[navigationAPIState](#fire-navigate-prr-navigationapistate)*
        set to `destinationNavigationAPIState`, and
        *[apiMethodTracker](#fire-navigate-prr-api-method-tracker)* set
        to `apiMethodTracker`.

    5.  If `continue` is false, then return.

2.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:nav-active-history-entry-3">active session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
    <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:document-state-reload-pending">reload
    pending</a> to true.

3.  Let `traversable` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>.

4.  <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
    the following session history traversal steps</a> to `traversable`:

    1.  <a href="#apply-the-reload-history-step"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:apply-the-reload-history-step">Apply the
        reload history step</a> to `traversable` given
        `userInvolvement`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="traverse-the-history-by-a-delta" class="dfn">traverse the
history by a delta</span> given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="reloading-and-traversing:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, an integer `delta`, and an optional
[`Document`](#document) <span id="traverse-sourcedocument"
class="dfn">`sourceDocument`</span>:

1.  Let `sourceSnapshotParams` and `initiatorToCheck` be null.

2.  Let `userInvolvement` be "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)".

3.  If `sourceDocument` is given, then:

    1.  Set `sourceSnapshotParams` to the result of
        <a href="#snapshotting-source-snapshot-params"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:snapshotting-source-snapshot-params">snapshotting
        source snapshot params</a> given `sourceDocument`.

    2.  Set `initiatorToCheck` to `sourceDocument`'s
        <a href="#node-navigable"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:node-navigable">node navigable</a>.

    3.  Set `userInvolvement` to "[`none`](#uni-none)".

4.  <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
    id="reloading-and-traversing:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps-2">Append
    the following session history traversal steps</a> to `traversable`:

    1.  Let `allSteps` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-all-used-history-steps"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:getting-all-used-history-steps">getting all
        used history steps</a> for `traversable`.

    2.  Let `currentStepIndex` be the index of `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:tn-current-session-history-step">current
        session history step</a> within `allSteps`.

    3.  Let `targetStepIndex` be `currentStepIndex` plus `delta`.

    4.  If `allSteps`\[`targetStepIndex`\] does not
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:list-contains"
        data-x-internal="list-contains">exist</a>, then abort these
        steps.

    5.  <a href="#apply-the-traverse-history-step"
        id="reloading-and-traversing:apply-the-traverse-history-step">Apply the
        traverse history step</a> `allSteps`\[`targetStepIndex`\] to
        `traversable`, given `sourceSnapshotParams`, `initiatorToCheck`,
        and `userInvolvement`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.4.4</span> Non-fragment synchronous "navigations"<a href="#navigate-non-frag-sync" class="self-link"></a>

Apart from the
<a href="#navigate" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:navigate">navigate</a>
algorithm, <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:session-history-entry">session history
entries</a> can be pushed or replaced via one more mechanism, the
<a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:url-and-history-update-steps">URL and history
update steps</a>. The most well-known callers of these steps are the
[`history.replaceState()`](#dom-history-replacestate) and
[`history.pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate) APIs, but various other
parts of the standard also need to perform updates to the
<a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:nav-active-history-entry">active history
entry</a>, and they use these steps to do so.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="url-and-history-update-steps" class="dfn">URL and history
update steps</span>, given a [`Document`](#document) `document`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `newURL`,
an optional <a href="#serialized-state"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:serialized-state">serialized state</a>-or-null
<span id="uhus-serializeddata" class="dfn">`serializedData`</span>
(default null), and an optional <a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:history-handling-behavior">history handling
behavior</a> <span id="uhus-historyhandling"
class="dfn">`historyHandling`</span> (default
"[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)"), are:

1.  Let `navigable` be `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:node-navigable">node navigable</a>.

2.  Let `activeEntry` be `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session
    history entry</a>.

3.  Let `newEntry` be a new <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:session-history-entry-2">session history
    entry</a>, with

    <a href="#she-url" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-url">URL</a>  
    `newURL`

    <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-classic-history-api-state">serialized
    state</a>  
    if `serializedData` is not null, `serializedData`; otherwise
    `activeEntry`'s <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-classic-history-api-state-2">classic
    history API state</a>

    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-document-state">document state</a>  
    `activeEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-document-state-2">document state</a>

    <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-scroll-restoration-mode">scroll
    restoration mode</a>  
    `activeEntry`'s <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-scroll-restoration-mode-2">scroll
    restoration mode</a>

    <a href="#she-other" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-other">persisted
    user state</a>  
    `activeEntry`'s
    <a href="#she-other" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:she-other-2">persisted
    user state</a>

4.  If `document`'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> is true, then set `historyHandling` to
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

    This means that [`pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate) on an
    <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:is-initial-about:blank-2">initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document) behaves as a
    [`replaceState()`](#dom-history-replacestate) call.

5.  Let `entryToReplace` be `activeEntry` if `historyHandling` is
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)", otherwise null.

6.  If `historyHandling` is "[`push`](#navigationhistorybehavior-push)",
    then:

    1.  Increment `document`'s
        <a href="#doc-history" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:doc-history">history
        object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-index"
        id="navigate-non-frag-sync:concept-history-index">index</a>.

    2.  Set `document`'s
        <a href="#doc-history" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:doc-history-2">history
        object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-length"
        id="navigate-non-frag-sync:concept-history-length">length</a> to
        its <a href="#concept-history-index"
        id="navigate-non-frag-sync:concept-history-index-2">index</a> +
        1.

    These are temporary best-guess values for immediate synchronous
    access.

7.  If `serializedData` is not null, then
    <a href="#restore-the-history-object-state"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:restore-the-history-object-state">restore the
    history object state</a> given `document` and `newEntry`.

8.  <a href="#set-the-url" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:set-the-url">Set the
    URL</a> given `document` to `newURL`.

    Since this is neither a <a href="#navigate"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:navigate-2">navigation</a> nor a
    <a href="#traverse-the-history-by-a-delta"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:traverse-the-history-by-a-delta">history
    traversal</a>, it does not cause a [`hashchange`](#event-hashchange)
    event to be fired.

9.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#latest-entry" id="navigate-non-frag-sync:latest-entry">latest
    entry</a> to `newEntry`.

10. Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:nav-active-history-entry-3">active session
    history entry</a> to `newEntry`.

11. <a
    href="#update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation">Update
    the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation</a> given
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>,
    `newEntry`, and `historyHandling`.

12. Let `traversable` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>.

13. <a href="#tn-append-session-history-sync-nav-steps"
    id="navigate-non-frag-sync:tn-append-session-history-sync-nav-steps">Append
    the following session history synchronous navigation steps</a>
    involving `navigable` to `traversable`:

    1.  <a href="#finalize-a-same-document-navigation"
        id="navigate-non-frag-sync:finalize-a-same-document-navigation">Finalize
        a same-document navigation</a> given `traversable`, `navigable`,
        `newEntry`, `entryToReplace`, `historyHandling`, and
        "[`none`](#uni-none)".

    2.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-history-updated"
        id="navigate-non-frag-sync:webdriver-bidi-history-updated"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-history-updated">WebDriver BiDi history
        updated</a> with `navigable`.

</div>

Although both <a href="#navigate-fragid"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:navigate-fragid">fragment navigation</a> and
the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:url-and-history-update-steps-2">URL and
history update steps</a> perform synchronous history updates, only
fragment navigation contains a synchronous call to
<a href="#update-document-for-history-step-application"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:update-document-for-history-step-application">update
document for history step application</a>. The
<a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
id="navigate-non-frag-sync:url-and-history-update-steps-3">URL and
history update steps</a> instead perform a few select updates inside the
above algorithm, omitting others. This is somewhat of an unfortunate
historical accident, and generally leads to [web-developer
sadness](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5562) about the
inconsistency. For example, this means that
[`popstate`](#event-popstate) events fire for fragment navigations, but
not for [`history.pushState()`](#dom-history-pushstate) calls.

#### <span class="secno">7.4.5</span> <span id="history-traversal"></span><span id="traverse-the-history"></span>Populating a session history entry<a href="#populating-a-session-history-entry" class="self-link"></a>

As explained in [the overview](#history), both
[navigation](#navigating-across-documents) and
[traversal](#reloading-and-traversing) involve creating a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a> and then attempting to populate its
<a href="#she-document"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document">document</a>
member, so that it can be presented inside the <a href="#navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable">navigable</a>.

This involves either: using [an already-given
response](#note-navigate-called-with-response); using the
<a href="#document-state-resource"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource">srcdoc
resource</a> stored in the <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-2">session
history entry</a>; or <a href="#create-navigation-params-by-fetching"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:create-navigation-params-by-fetching">fetching</a>.
The process has several failure modes, which can either result in doing
nothing (leaving the <a href="#navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable-2">navigable</a> on its
currently-<a href="#nav-document"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document">active</a>
[`Document`](#document)) or can result in populating the
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-3">session
history entry</a> with an <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-ua-inline">error
document</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry's-document"
class="dfn">attempt to populate the history entry's document</span> for
a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-4">session
history entry</a> `entry`, given a <a href="#navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable-3">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigationtimingtype">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
`navTimingType`, a <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params">source
snapshot params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, a
<a href="#target-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params">target
snapshot params</a> `targetSnapshotParams`, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, an optional
<a href="#navigation-id"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>-or-null
`navigationId` (default null), an optional <a href="#navigation-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params">navigation
params</a>-or-null `navigationParams` (default null), an optional string
`cspNavigationType` (default "`other`"), an optional boolean
<span id="attempt-to-populate-allow-post" class="dfn">`allowPOST`</span>
(default false), and optional algorithm steps
<span id="attempt-to-populate-completion-steps"
class="dfn">`completionSteps`</span> (default an empty algorithm):

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this is running
    <a href="#in-parallel"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:in-parallel">in parallel</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: if `navigationParams` is
    non-null, then `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response">response</a>
    is non-null.

3.  Let `documentResource` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-resource"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-2">resource</a>.

4.  If `navigationParams` is null, then:

    1.  If `documentResource` is a string, then set `navigationParams`
        to the result of
        <a href="#create-navigation-params-from-a-srcdoc-resource"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:create-navigation-params-from-a-srcdoc-resource">creating
        navigation params from a srcdoc resource</a> given `entry`,
        `navigable`, `targetSnapshotParams`, `userInvolvement`,
        `navigationId`, and `navTimingType`.

    2.  Otherwise, if all of the following are true:

        - `entry`'s <a href="#she-url"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-url">URL</a>'s
          <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme"
          data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is a
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme"
          data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>; and

        - `documentResource` is null, or `allowPOST` is true and
          `documentResource`'s <a href="#post-resource-request-body"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:post-resource-request-body">request
          body</a> is not failure,

        then set `navigationParams` to the result of
        <a href="#create-navigation-params-by-fetching"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:create-navigation-params-by-fetching-2">creating
        navigation params by fetching</a> given `entry`, `navigable`,
        `sourceSnapshotParams`, `targetSnapshotParams`,
        `cspNavigationType`, `userInvolvement`, `navigationId`, and
        `navTimingType`.

    3.  Otherwise, if `entry`'s <a href="#she-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-url-2">URL</a>'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is not a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-2"
        data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>, then set
        `navigationParams` to a new
        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params">non-fetch
        scheme navigation params</a>, with

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-id"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-id">id</a>  
        `navigationId`

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable">navigable</a>  
        `navigable`

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-url">URL</a>  
        `entry`'s <a href="#she-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-url-3">URL</a>

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox">target
        snapshot sandboxing flags</a>  
        `targetSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-sandbox">sandboxing
        flags</a>

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation">source
        snapshot has transient activation</a>  
        `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-activation">has
        transient activation</a>

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin">initiator
        origin</a>  
        `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-2">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
        origin</a>

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type">navigation
        timing type</a>  
        `navTimingType`

        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement">user
        involvement</a>  
        `userInvolvement`

5.  <div id="process-a-navigate-response">

    <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:queue-a-global-task">Queue a
    global task</a> on the
    <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a>, given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#active-window"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:active-window">active window</a>,
    to run these steps:

    1.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:ongoing-navigation">ongoing
        navigation</a> no longer equals `navigationId`, then run
        `completionSteps` and abort these steps.

    2.  Let `saveExtraDocumentState` be true.

        <div class="note">

        Usually, in the cases where we end up populating `entry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-3">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document">document</a>,
        we then want to save some of the state from that
        [`Document`](#document) into `entry`. This ensures that if there
        are future traversals to `entry` where its
        <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-2">document</a>
        [has been destroyed](#note-bfcache), we can use that state when
        creating a new [`Document`](#document).

        However, in some specific cases, saving the state would be
        unhelpful. For those, we set `saveExtraDocumentState` to false
        later in this algorithm.

        </div>

    3.  If `navigationParams` is a
        <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-2">non-fetch
        scheme navigation params</a>, then:

        1.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-4">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-3">document</a>
            to the result of running
            <a href="#attempt-to-create-a-non-fetch-scheme-document"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:attempt-to-create-a-non-fetch-scheme-document">attempt
            to create a non-fetch scheme document</a> given
            `navigationParams`.

            This can result in setting `entry`'s
            <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-5">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-4">document</a>
            to null, e.g., when <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:hand-off-to-external-software">handing-off
            to external software</a>.

        2.  Set `saveExtraDocumentState` to false.

    4.  Otherwise, if any of the following are true:

        - `navigationParams` is null;

        - the result of <a
          href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-navigation-response"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:should-navigation-response-to-navigation-request-of-type-in-target-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy"
          data-x-internal="should-navigation-response-to-navigation-request-of-type-in-target-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy">should
          navigation response to navigation request of type in target be blocked
          by Content Security Policy?</a> given `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-request"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-request">request</a>,
          `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-2">response</a>,
          `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container">policy
          container</a>'s <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:policy-container-csp-list">CSP
          list</a>, `cspNavigationType`, and `navigable` is "`Blocked`";

        - `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-reserved-environment">reserved
          environment</a> is non-null and the result of <a
          href="#check-a-navigation-response&#39;s-adherence-to-its-embedder-policy"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:check-a-navigation-response&#39;s-adherence-to-its-embedder-policy">checking
          a navigation response's adherence to its embedder policy</a>
          given `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-response"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-3">response</a>,
          `navigable`, and `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container-2">policy
          container</a>'s <a href="#policy-container-embedder-policy"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:policy-container-embedder-policy">embedder
          policy</a> is false; or

        - the result of <a
          href="#check-a-navigation-response&#39;s-adherence-to-x-frame-options"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:check-a-navigation-response&#39;s-adherence-to-x-frame-options">checking
          a navigation response's adherence to `<code>X-Frame-Options</code>`</a>
          given `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-response"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-4">response</a>,
          `navigable`, `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container-3">policy
          container</a>'s <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:policy-container-csp-list-2">CSP
          list</a>, and `navigationParams`'s
          <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
          id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-origin">origin</a>
          is false,

        then:

        1.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-6">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-5">document</a>
            to the result of <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-ua-inline-2">creating a
            document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM</a>,
            given `navigable`, null, `navTimingType`, and
            `userInvolvement`. The inline content should indicate to the
            user the sort of error that occurred.

        2.  <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:make-document-unsalvageable">Make
            document unsalvageable</a> given `entry`'s
            <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-7">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-6">document</a>
            and "[`navigation-failure`](#blocking-navigation-failure)".

        3.  Set `saveExtraDocumentState` to false.

        4.  If `navigationParams` is not null, then:

            1.  Run the <a href="#environment-discarding-steps"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:environment-discarding-steps">environment
                discarding steps</a> for `navigationParams`'s
                <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-reserved-environment-2">reserved
                environment</a>.

            2.  Invoke <a
                href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed"
                data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-failed">WebDriver BiDi
                navigation failed</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
                href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
                data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
                navigation status</a> whose
                <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-status-id"
                data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is
                `navigationId`,
                <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-status-status"
                data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is
                "<a
                href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled"
                data-x-internal="navigation-status-canceled"><code
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-status-canceled">canceled</code></a>",
                and
                <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-status-url"
                data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is
                `navigationParams`'s
                <a href="#navigation-params-response"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-5">response</a>'s
                <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url"
                data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>.

    5.  <div id="navigation-as-a-download">

        Otherwise, if `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#navigation-params-response"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-6">response</a>
        has a \`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc6266.html"
        data-x-internal="http-content-disposition"><code
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:http-content-disposition">Content-Disposition</code></a>\`
        header specifying the `attachment` disposition type, then:

        1.  Let `sourceAllowsDownloading` be `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
            <a href="#source-snapshot-params-download"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-download">allows
            downloading</a>.

        2.  Let `targetAllowsDownloading` be false if
            `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-sandboxing">final
            sandboxing flag set</a> has the
            <a href="#sandboxed-downloads-browsing-context-flag"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:sandboxed-downloads-browsing-context-flag">sandboxed
            downloads browsing context flag</a> set; otherwise true.

        3.  Let `uaAllowsDownloading` be true.

        4.  Optionally, the user agent may set `uaAllowsDownloading` to
            false, if it believes doing so would safeguard the user from
            a potentially hostile download.

        5.  If `sourceAllowsDownloading`, `targetAllowsDownloading`, and
            `uaAllowsDownloading` are true, then:

            1.  <a href="#handle-as-a-download"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:handle-as-a-download">Handle as a
                download</a> `navigationParams`'s
                <a href="#navigation-params-response"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-7">response</a>
                with `navigable` and `navigationId`.

        This branch leaves `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-8">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-7">document</a>
        as null.

        </div>

    6.  Otherwise, if `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#navigation-params-response"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-8">response</a>'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-status"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not 204
        and is not 205, then set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-9">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-8">document</a>
