        to the result of <a href="#loading-a-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:loading-a-document">loading a
        document</a> given `navigationParams`, `sourceSnapshotParams`,
        and `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-10">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-2">initiator
        origin</a>.

        This can result in setting `entry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-11">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-9">document</a>
        to null, e.g., when <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:hand-off-to-external-software-2">handing-off
        to external software</a>.

    7.  If `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-12">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-10">document</a>
        is not null, then:

        1.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-13">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-ever-populated">ever
            populated</a> to true.

        2.  If `saveExtraDocumentState` is true:

            1.  Let `document` be `entry`'s
                <a href="#she-document-state"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-14">document
                state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-document"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-11">document</a>.

            2.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-15">document
                state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-origin"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-origin">origin</a>
                to `document`'s
                <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin"
                data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

            3.  If `document`'s
                <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:the-document&#39;s-address"
                data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>
                <a href="#requires-storing-the-policy-container-in-history"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:requires-storing-the-policy-container-in-history">requires
                storing the policy container in history</a>, then:

                1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-3"
                    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
                    `navigationParams` is a <a href="#navigation-params"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-2">navigation
                    params</a> (i.e., neither null nor a
                    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-3">non-fetch
                    scheme navigation params</a>).

                2.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-16">document
                    state</a>'s
                    <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container">history
                    policy container</a> to `navigationParams`'s
                    <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
                    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container-4">policy
                    container</a>.

        3.  If `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-17">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer">request
            referrer</a> is "`client`", and `navigationParams` is a
            <a href="#navigation-params"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-3">navigation
            params</a> (i.e., neither null nor a
            <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-4">non-fetch
            scheme navigation params</a>), then:

            1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-4"
                data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
                `navigationParams`'s
                <a href="#navigation-params-request"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-request-2">request</a>
                is not null.

            2.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-18">document
                state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-2">request
                referrer</a> to `navigationParams`'s
                <a href="#navigation-params-request"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-request-3">request</a>'s
                <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-referrer"
                data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a>.

    8.  Run `completionSteps`.

    </div>

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-navigation-params-from-a-srcdoc-resource"
class="dfn">create navigation params from a srcdoc resource</span> given
a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-5">session
history entry</a> `entry`, a <a href="#navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable-4">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a href="#target-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-2">target
snapshot params</a> `targetSnapshotParams`, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:user-navigation-involvement-2">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, a <a href="#navigation-id"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-id-2">navigation
ID</a>-or-null `navigationId`, and a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigationtimingtype-2">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
`navTimingType`:

1.  Let `documentResource` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"

    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>  
    [`about:srcdoc`](#about:srcdoc)

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>

    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:utf-8-encode"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-encode">UTF-8 encoding</a> of

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence-as-a-body"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:as-a-body"
    data-x-internal="as-a-body">as a body</a>

3.  Let `responseOrigin` be the result of
    <a href="#determining-the-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:determining-the-origin">determining

    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-origin-2">origin</a>.

4.  Let `coop` be a new <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"

    policy</a>.

5.  Let `coopEnforcementResult` be a new
    <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-result">opener
    policy enforcement result</a> with

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-url">url</a>  
    `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-origin">origin</a>  
    `responseOrigin`

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-coop"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-coop">opener
    policy</a>  
    `coop`

6.  Let `policyContainer` be the result of
    <a href="#determining-navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:determining-navigation-params-policy-container">determining
    navigation params policy container</a> given `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-21">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container-2">history
    policy container</a>, null, `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-document">container
    document</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-policy-container">policy
    container</a>, and null.

7.  Return a new <a href="#navigation-params"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-4">navigation

    <a href="#navigation-params-id"

    `navigationId`

    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable">navigable</a>  
    `navigable`

    <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-request-4">request</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-9">response</a>  
    `response`

    <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-fetch-controller">fetch
    controller</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-commit-early-hints">commit
    early hints</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result">COOP
    enforcement result</a>  
    `coopEnforcementResult`

    <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-reserved-environment-3">reserved
    environment</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-origin-2">origin</a>  
    `responseOrigin`

    <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container-5">policy
    container</a>  
    `policyContainer`

    <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-sandboxing-2">final
    sandboxing flag set</a>  
    `targetSnapshotParams`'s <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-sandbox-3">sandboxing
    flags</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
    element referrer policy</a>  
    `targetSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
    element referrer policy</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-coop">opener
    policy</a>  
    `coop`

    <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-nav-timing-type">navigation
    timing type</a>  
    `navTimingType`

    <a href="#navigation-params-about-base-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-about-base-url">about
    base URL</a>  
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-22">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-about-base-url">about
    base URL</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-user-involvement">user

    `userInvolvement`

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="create-navigation-params-by-fetching" class="dfn">create
navigation params by fetching</span> given a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-6">session
history entry</a> `entry`, a <a href="#navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable-5">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-2">source
snapshot params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, a
<a href="#target-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-3">target
snapshot params</a> `targetSnapshotParams`, a string
`cspNavigationType`, a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:user-navigation-involvement-3">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, a <a href="#navigation-id"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-id-3">navigation
ID</a>-or-null `navigationId`, and a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigationtimingtype-3">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
`navTimingType`, perform the following steps. They return a
<a href="#navigation-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-5">navigation
params</a>, a <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-5">non-fetch
scheme navigation params</a>, or null.

This algorithm mutates `entry`.

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-5"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this is running
    <a href="#in-parallel"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:in-parallel-2">in parallel</a>.

2.  Let `documentResource` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-23">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-resource"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-4">resource</a>.

3.  Let `request` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a>, with

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">url</a>  
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-url-4">URL</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-client"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a>  
    `sourceSnapshotParams`'s <a href="#source-snapshot-params-client"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-client">fetch
    client</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-destination"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>  
    "`document`" <span class="note">The destination is updated below
    when `navigable` has a <a href="#nav-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container">container</a>.</span>

    <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-credentials-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>  
    "`include`"

    <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:use-url-credentials-flag"
    data-x-internal="use-url-credentials-flag">use-URL-credentials flag</a>  
    set

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-redirect-mode"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-redirect-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-redirect-mode">redirect mode</a>  
    "`manual`"

    <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-replaces-client-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-replaces-client-id"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-replaces-client-id">replaces client
    id</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-2">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>'s <a href="#concept-environment-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-id">id</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">mode</a>  
    "`navigate`"

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-referrer-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a>  
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-24">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-3">request
    referrer</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-referrer-policy"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>  
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-25">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-policy">request
    referrer policy</a>

    <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-policy-container"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-policy-container">policy container</a>  
    `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-policy-container">source
    policy container</a>

    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-window"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-traversable-for-user-prompts"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-traversable-for-user-prompts">traversable
    for user prompts</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-top"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-top">top-level
    traversable</a>

4.  If `navigable` is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:top-level-traversable">top-level
    traversable</a>, then set `request`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-top-level-navigation-initiator-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:top-level-navigation-initiator-origin"
    data-x-internal="top-level-navigation-initiator-origin">top-level
    navigation initiator origin</a> to `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-26">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-3">initiator
    origin</a>.

5.  If `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-client-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> is null:

    This [only occurs](#assert-null-sourcedocument) in the case of a
    browser UI-initiated navigation.

    1.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-origin"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-origin">origin</a> to a new
        <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-origin-opaque">opaque
        origin</a>.

    2.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-service-workers-mode"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-service-workers-mode"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-service-workers-mode">service-workers
        mode</a> to "`all`".

    3.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-referrer-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> to
        "`no-referrer`".

6.  If `documentResource` is a <a href="#post-resource"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:post-resource">POST resource</a>:

    1.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-method"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-method"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-method">method</a> to
        \``POST`\`.

    2.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-body"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-body">body</a> to
        `documentResource`'s <a href="#post-resource-request-body"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:post-resource-request-body-2">request
        body</a>.

    3.  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-set"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-header-list-set"
        data-x-internal="concept-header-list-set">Set</a>
        \``Content-Type`\` to `documentResource`'s
        <a href="#post-resource-request-content-type"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:post-resource-request-content-type">request
        content-type</a> in `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-header-list"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-header-list"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-header-list">header list</a>.

7.  If `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-27">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-reload-pending">reload
    pending</a> is true, then set `request`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reload-navigation-flag"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reload-navigation-flag"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-reload-navigation-flag">reload-navigation
    flag</a>.

8.  Otherwise, if `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-28">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-ever-populated-2">ever
    populated</a> is true, then set `request`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-history-navigation-flag"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-history-navigation-flag"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-history-navigation-flag">history-navigation
    flag</a>.

9.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-activation-2">has
    transient activation</a> is true, then set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-user-activation"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-user-activation"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-user-activation">user-activation</a>
    to true.

10. If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-2">container</a>
    is non-null:

    1.  If the `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-3">container</a>
        has a <a href="#browsing-context-scope-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:browsing-context-scope-origin">browsing
        context scope origin</a>, then set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-origin">origin</a> to that
        <a href="#browsing-context-scope-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:browsing-context-scope-origin-2">browsing
        context scope origin</a>.

    2.  Set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-destination-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a> to
        `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-4">container</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-element-local-name"
        data-x-internal="concept-element-local-name">local name</a>.

    3.  If `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#source-snapshot-params-client"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-client-2">fetch
        client</a> is `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-document-2">container
        document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant
        settings object</a>, then set `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-initiator-type"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
        to `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-5">container</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-element-local-name-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-element-local-name">local name</a>.

        This ensure that only container-initiated navigations are
        reported to resource timing.

11. Let `response` be null.

12. Let `responseOrigin` be null.

13. Let `fetchController` be null.

14. Let `coopEnforcementResult` be a new
    <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-result-2">opener
    policy enforcement result</a>, with

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-url-2">url</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-3">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-origin-2">origin</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-4">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-coop"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-coop-2">opener
    policy</a>  
    `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-5">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-coop"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-coop">opener
    policy</a>

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-source"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforcement-source">current
    context is navigation source</a>  
    true if `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-6">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
    <a href="#same-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:same-origin">same origin</a>
    with `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-29">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-4">initiator
    origin</a> otherwise false

15. Let `finalSandboxFlags` be an empty <a href="#sandboxing-flag-set"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:sandboxing-flag-set">sandboxing
    flag set</a>.

16. Let `responsePolicyContainer` be null.

17. Let `responseCOOP` be a new <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:cross-origin-opener-policy-2">opener
    policy</a>.

18. Let `locationURL` be null.

19. Let `currentURL` be `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-current-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-current-url">current URL</a>.

20. Let `commitEarlyHints` be null.

21. While true:

    1.  If `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>
        is not null and `currentURL`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-origin"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a> is not the
        <a href="#same-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:same-origin-2">same</a>
        as `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-environment-creation-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-creation-url">creation
        URL</a>'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a>, then:

        1.  Run the <a href="#environment-discarding-steps"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:environment-discarding-steps-2">environment
            discarding steps</a> for `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-3"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>.

        2.  Set `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-4"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>
            to null.

        3.  Set `commitEarlyHints` to null.

            Preloaded links from <a href="#early-hints-2"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:early-hints-2">early hint
            headers</a> remain in the preload cache after a
            <a href="#same-origin"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:same-origin-3">same origin</a>
            redirect, but get discarded when the redirect is
            cross-origin.

    2.  If `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-5"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>
        is null, then:

        1.  Let `topLevelCreationURL` be `currentURL`.

        2.  Let `topLevelOrigin` be null.

        3.  If `navigable` is not a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:top-level-traversable-2">top-level
            traversable</a>, then:

            1.  Let `parentEnvironment` be `navigable`'s
                <a href="#nav-parent"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-parent">parent</a>'s
                <a href="#nav-document"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-7">active
                document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:relevant-settings-object-3">relevant
                settings object</a>.

            2.  Set `topLevelCreationURL` to `parentEnvironment`'s
                <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-creation-url"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-top-level-creation-url">top-level
                creation URL</a>.

            3.  Set `topLevelOrigin` to `parentEnvironment`'s
                <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-origin"
                id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-top-level-origin">top-level
                origin</a>.

        4.  Set `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-6"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>
            to a new <a href="#environment"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:environment">environment</a>
            whose <a href="#concept-environment-id"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-id-2">id</a>
            is a unique opaque string,
            <a href="#concept-environment-target-browsing-context"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-target-browsing-context">target
            browsing context</a> is `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-bc" id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-bc">active
            browsing context</a>,
            <a href="#concept-environment-creation-url"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-creation-url-2">creation
            URL</a> is `currentURL`,
            <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-creation-url"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-top-level-creation-url-2">top-level
            creation URL</a> is `topLevelCreationURL`, and
            <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-origin"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-top-level-origin-2">top-level
            origin</a> is `topLevelOrigin`.

            The created environment's
            <a href="#concept-environment-active-service-worker"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-environment-active-service-worker">active
            service worker</a> is set in the <a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/#on-fetch-request-algorithm"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:on-fetch-request-algorithm"
            data-x-internal="on-fetch-request-algorithm">Handle Fetch</a>
            algorithm during the fetch if the request URL matches a
            service worker registration. [\[SW\]](#refsSW)

    3.  If the result of <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-csp/#should-block-navigation-request"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:should-navigation-request-of-type-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy"
        data-x-internal="should-navigation-request-of-type-be-blocked-by-content-security-policy">should
        navigation request of type be blocked by Content Security Policy?</a>
        given `request` and `cspNavigationType` is "`Blocked`", then set
        `response` to a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> and
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break"
        data-x-internal="break">break</a>. [\[CSP\]](#refsCSP)

    4.  Set `response` to null.

    5.  If `fetchController` is null, then set `fetchController` to the
        result of <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-fetch"
        data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetching</a> `request`, with
        *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-processearlyhintsresponse"
        data-x-internal="processearlyhintsresponse">processEarlyHintsResponse</a>*
        set to `processEarlyHintsResponse` as defined below,
        *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response"
        data-x-internal="processresponse">processResponse</a>* set to
        `processResponse` as defined below, and
        *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-useparallelqueue"
        data-x-internal="useparallelqueue">useParallelQueue</a>* set to
        true.

        Let `processEarlyHintsResponse` be the following algorithm given
        a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `earlyResponse`:

        1.  If `commitEarlyHints` is null, then set `commitEarlyHints`
            to the result of <a href="#process-early-hint-headers"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:process-early-hint-headers">processing
            early hint headers</a> given `earlyResponse` and `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-7"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>.

        Let `processResponse` be the following algorithm given a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>
        `fetchedResponse`:

        1.  Set `response` to `fetchedResponse`.

    6.  Otherwise, <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-process-the-next-manual-redirect"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:process-the-next-manual-redirect"
        data-x-internal="process-the-next-manual-redirect">process the next
        manual redirect</a> for `fetchController`.

        This will result in calling the
        *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response"
        data-x-internal="processresponse">processResponse</a>* we
        supplied above, during our first iteration through the loop, and
        thus setting `response`.

        Navigation handles redirects manually as navigation is the only
        place in the web platform that cares for redirects to
        <a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6068#section-2"
        data-x-internal="mailto-protocol"><code
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:mailto-protocol">mailto:</code></a>
        URLs and such.

    7.  Wait until either `response` is non-null, or `navigable`'s
        <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:ongoing-navigation-2">ongoing
        navigation</a> changes to no longer equal `navigationId`.

        If the latter condition occurs, then
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-controller-abort"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-controller-abort"
        data-x-internal="fetch-controller-abort">abort</a>
        `fetchController`, and return.

        Otherwise, proceed onward.

    8.  If `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-body-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-body">body</a> is null, then
        set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-30">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-resource"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-5">resource</a>
        to null.

        Fetch unsets the
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-body"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-body-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-body">body</a> for particular
        redirects.

    9.  Set `responsePolicyContainer` to the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-policy-container-from-a-fetch-response"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:creating-a-policy-container-from-a-fetch-response">creating
        a policy container from a fetch response</a> given `response`
        and `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-8"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>.

    10. Set `finalSandboxFlags` to the
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-union"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:set-union"
        data-x-internal="set-union">union</a> of
        `targetSnapshotParams`'s
        <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-sandbox-4">sandboxing
        flags</a> and `responsePolicyContainer`'s
        <a href="#policy-container-csp-list"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:policy-container-csp-list-3">CSP
        list</a>'s <a href="#csp-derived-sandboxing-flags"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:csp-derived-sandboxing-flags">CSP-derived
        sandboxing flags</a>.

    11. Set `responseOrigin` to the result of
        <a href="#determining-the-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:determining-the-origin-2">determining
        the origin</a> given `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-6"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>,
        `finalSandboxFlags`, and `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-31">document
        state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-5">initiator
        origin</a>.

        If `response` is a redirect, then `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-7"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a> will be the URL
        that led to the redirect to `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-location-url"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-location-url">location URL</a>;
        it will not be the
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-location-url-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-location-url">location URL</a>
        itself.

    12. If `navigable` is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:top-level-traversable-3">top-level
        traversable</a>, then:

        1.  Set `responseCOOP` to the result of <a href="#obtain-coop"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:obtain-coop">obtaining an opener
            policy</a> given `response` and `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-9"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>.

        2.  Set `coopEnforcementResult` to the result of
            <a href="#coop-enforce"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-enforce">enforcing the
            response's opener policy</a> given `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-bc"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-bc-2">active browsing
            context</a>, `response`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-8"
            data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>,
            `responseOrigin`, `responseCOOP`, `coopEnforcementResult`,
            and `request`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-referrer-4"
            data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a>.

        3.  If `finalSandboxFlags` is not empty and `responseCOOP`'s
            <a href="#coop-struct-value"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:coop-struct-value">value</a>
            is not "[`unsafe-none`](#coop-unsafe-none)", then set
            `response` to an appropriate
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-2"
            data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> and
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break-2"
            data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

            This results in a network error as one cannot simultaneously
            provide a clean slate to a response using opener policy and
            sandbox the result of navigating to that response.

    13. If `response` is not a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-3"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>, `navigable`
        is a <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:child-navigable">child
        navigable</a>, and the result of performing a <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-check"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:cross-origin-resource-policy-check"
        data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy-check">cross-origin
        resource policy check</a> with `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-container-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-document-3">container
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-4"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>,
        `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-document-4">container
        document</a>'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:relevant-settings-object-4">relevant
        settings object</a>, `request`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-destination-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>,
        `response`, and true is **blocked**, then set `response` to a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-4"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> and
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break-3"
        data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

        Here we're running the <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#cross-origin-resource-policy-check"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:cross-origin-resource-policy-check-2"
        data-x-internal="cross-origin-resource-policy-check">cross-origin
        resource policy check</a> against the <a href="#nav-parent"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-parent-2">parent
        navigable</a> rather than `navigable` itself. This is because we
        care about the same-originness of the embedded content against
        the parent context, not the navigation source.

    14. Set `locationURL` to `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-location-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-location-url-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-location-url">location URL</a>
        given `currentURL`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-fragment"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>.

    15. If `locationURL` is failure or null, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break-4"
        data-x-internal="break">break</a>.

    16. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-6"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `locationURL` is a
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url"
        data-x-internal="url">URL</a>.

    17. Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-classic-history-api-state">classic
        history API state</a> to
        <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(null).

    18. Let `oldDocState` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-32">document
        state</a>.

    19. Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-33">document
        state</a> to a new <a href="#document-state-2"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-2">document
        state</a>, with

        <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container-3">history
        policy container</a>  
        a <a href="#clone-a-policy-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:clone-a-policy-container">clone</a>
        of the `oldDocState`'s
        <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container-4">history
        policy container</a> if it is non-null; null otherwise

        <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-4">request
        referrer</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-5">request
        referrer</a>

        <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-policy-2">request
        referrer policy</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s
        <a href="#document-state-request-referrer-policy"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-request-referrer-policy-3">request
        referrer policy</a>

        <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-6">initiator
        origin</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-initiator-origin-7">initiator
        origin</a>

        <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-origin-3">origin</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-origin-4">origin</a>

        <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-about-base-url-2">about
        base URL</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-about-base-url-3">about
        base URL</a>

        <a href="#document-state-resource"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-6">resource</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-resource"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-7">resource</a>

        <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-ever-populated-3">ever
        populated</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-ever-populated-4">ever
        populated</a>

        <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
        target name</a>  
        `oldDocState`'s <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-nav-target-name-2">navigable
        target name</a>

        For the navigation case, only `entry` referenced `oldDocState`,
        which was created [early in the navigate
        algorithm](#navigation-create-document-state). So for
        navigations, this is functionally just an update to `entry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-34">document
        state</a>. For the traversal case, it's possible adjacent
        <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-7">session
        history entries</a> also reference `oldDocState`, in which case
        they will continue doing so even after we've updated `entry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-35">document
        state</a>.

        `oldDocState`'s
        <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container-5">history
        policy container</a> is only ever non-null here in the traversal
        case, after we've populated it during a navigation to a URL that
        <a href="#requires-storing-the-policy-container-in-history"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:requires-storing-the-policy-container-in-history-2">requires
        storing the policy container in history</a>.

        <div class="example">

        The setup is given by the following <a href="#jake-diagram"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:jake-diagram">Jake diagram</a>:

        |       | 0   | 1      | 2      | 3   |
        |-------|-----|--------|--------|-----|
        | `top` | /a  | /a#foo | /a#bar | /b  |

        Also assume that the <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-36">document
        state</a> shared by the entries in steps 0, 1, and 2 has a null
        <a href="#document-state-document"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-document-12">document</a>,
        i.e., [bfcache](#note-bfcache) is not in play.

        Now consider the scenario where we traverse back to step 2, but
        this time when fetching `/a`, the server responds with a
        \``Location`\` header pointing to `/c`. That is, `locationURL`
        points to `/c` and so we have reached this step instead of
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break-5"
        data-x-internal="break">breaking</a> out of the loop.

        In this case, we replace the <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-37">document
        state</a> of the <a href="#session-history-entry"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:session-history-entry-8">session
        history entry</a> occupying step 2, but we do *not* replace the
        document state of the entries occupying steps 0 and 1. The
        resulting <a href="#jake-diagram"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:jake-diagram-2">Jake diagram</a>
        looks like this:

        |       | 0   | 1      | 2      | 3   |
        |-------|-----|--------|--------|-----|
        | `top` | /a  | /a#foo | /c#bar | /b  |

        Note that we perform this replacement even if we end up in a
        redirect chain back to the original URL, for example if `/c`
        itself had a \``Location`\` header pointing to `/a`. Such a case
        would end up like so:

        |       | 0   | 1      | 2      | 3   |
        |-------|-----|--------|--------|-----|
        | `top` | /a  | /a#foo | /a#bar | /b  |

        </div>

    20. If `locationURL`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is not an
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:http(s)-scheme"
        data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>, then:

        1.  Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-38">document
            state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-resource"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-resource-8">resource</a>
            to null.

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-break"
            id="populating-a-session-history-entry:break-6"
            data-x-internal="break">Break</a>.

    21. Set `currentURL` to `locationURL`.

    22. Set `entry`'s <a href="#she-url"
        id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-url-5">URL</a> to
        `currentURL`.

    <div class="note">

    By the end of this loop we will be in one of these scenarios:

    - `locationURL` is failure, because of an unparseable \``Location`\`
      header.

    - `locationURL` is null, either because `response` is a
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-5"
      data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> or because we
      successfully fetched a
      non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-6"
      data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> HTTP(S) response
      with no \``Location`\` header.

    - `locationURL` is a
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-2"
      data-x-internal="url">URL</a> with a
      non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:http(s)-scheme-2"
      data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S)</a>
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-4"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a>.

    </div>

22. If `locationURL` is a
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-3"
    data-x-internal="url">URL</a> whose
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is not a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-3"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>, then return a new
    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-navigation-params-6">non-fetch
    scheme navigation params</a>, with

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-id-2">id</a>  
    `navigationId`

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-navigable-2">navigable</a>  
    `navigable`

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-url-2">URL</a>  
    `locationURL`

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-target-sandbox-2">target
    snapshot sandboxing flags</a>  
    `targetSnapshotParams`'s <a href="#target-snapshot-params-sandbox"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:target-snapshot-params-sandbox-5">sandboxing
    flags</a>

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-source-activation-2">source
    snapshot has transient activation</a>  
    `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-activation-3">has
    transient activation</a>

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-initiator-origin-2">initiator
    origin</a>  
    `responseOrigin`

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-nav-timing-type-2">navigation
    timing type</a>  
    `navTimingType`

    <a href="#non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:non-fetch-scheme-params-user-involvement-2">user
    involvement</a>  
    `userInvolvement`

    At this point, `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-current-url-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-current-url">current URL</a> is the
    last <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-4"
    data-x-internal="url">URL</a> in the redirect chain with a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-4"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch</a>
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> before redirecting
    to a non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-5"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-5"
    data-x-internal="url">URL</a>. It is this
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-6"
    data-x-internal="url">URL</a>'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-origin-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-origin">origin</a> that will be used as
    the initiator origin for navigations to
    non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-6"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-7"
    data-x-internal="url">URLs</a>.

23. If any of the following are true:

    - `response` is a
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-7"
      data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>;

    - `locationURL` is failure; or

    - `locationURL` is a
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-8"
      data-x-internal="url">URL</a> whose
      <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-url-scheme-7"
      data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is a
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
      id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-7"
      data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>,

    then return null.

    We allow redirects to
    non-<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-8"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-9"
    data-x-internal="url">URLs</a>, but redirects to
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:fetch-scheme-9"
    data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch scheme</a>
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:url-10"
    data-x-internal="url">URLs</a> that aren't
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:http(s)-scheme-3"
    data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S)</a> are treated like
    network errors.

24. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:assert-7"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `locationURL` is null and
    `response` is not a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:network-error-8"
    data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>.

25. Let `resultPolicyContainer` be the result of
    <a href="#determining-navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:determining-navigation-params-policy-container-2">determining
    navigation params policy container</a> given `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-url-9"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-39">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-history-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-history-policy-container-6">history
    policy container</a>, `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-policy-container-2">source
    policy container</a>, null, and `responsePolicyContainer`.

26. If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-6">container</a>
    is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element), and `response`'s <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-timing-allow-passed"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-response-timing-allow-passed"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-timing-allow-passed">timing allow
    passed flag</a> is set, then set `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-container-7">container</a>'s
    <a href="#iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:iframe-pending-resource-timing-start-time">pending
    resource-timing start time</a> to null.

    If the [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) is allowed to report to
    resource timing, we don't need to run its fallback steps as the
    normal reporting would happen.

27. Return a new <a href="#navigation-params"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-6">navigation
    params</a>, with

    <a href="#navigation-params-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-id-2">id</a>  
    `navigationId`

    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-2">navigable</a>  
    `navigable`

    <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-request-5">request</a>  
    `request`

    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-10">response</a>  
    `response`

    <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-fetch-controller-2">fetch
    controller</a>  
    `fetchController`

    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-commit-early-hints-2">commit
    early hints</a>  
    `commitEarlyHints`

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-coop-2">opener
    policy</a>  
    `responseCOOP`

    <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-reserved-environment-4">reserved
    environment</a>  
    `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-reserved-client"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-request-reserved-client-10"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-reserved-client">reserved client</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-origin-3">origin</a>  
    `responseOrigin`

    <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-policy-container-6">policy
    container</a>  
    `resultPolicyContainer`

    <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-sandboxing-3">final
    sandboxing flag set</a>  
    `finalSandboxFlags`

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result-2">COOP
    enforcement result</a>  
    `coopEnforcementResult`

    <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-nav-timing-type-2">navigation
    timing type</a>  
    `navTimingType`

    <a href="#navigation-params-about-base-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-about-base-url-2">about
    base URL</a>  
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:she-document-state-40">document
    state</a>'s <a href="#document-state-about-base-url"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:document-state-about-base-url-4">about
    base URL</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-user-involvement-2">user
    involvement</a>  
    `userInvolvement`

</div>

<div algorithm="">

An element has a <span id="browsing-context-scope-origin"
class="dfn">browsing context scope origin</span> if its
[`Document`](#document)'s <a href="#node-navigable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:node-navigable">node
navigable</a> is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:top-level-traversable-4">top-level
traversable</a> or if all of its [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="#ancestor-navigables"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:ancestor-navigables">ancestor
navigables</a> have <a href="#nav-document"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:nav-document-8">active
documents</a> whose
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-5"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origins</a> are the
<a href="#same-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:same-origin-4">same origin</a> as
the element's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:node-document"
data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-6"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>. If an element has
a <a href="#browsing-context-scope-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:browsing-context-scope-origin-3">browsing
context scope origin</a>, then its value is the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-document-origin-7"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of the element's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:node-document-2"
data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

</div>

This definition is broken and needs investigation to see what it was
intended to express: see [issue
\#4703](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4703).

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="loading-a-document" class="dfn">load a document</span>
given <a href="#navigation-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-7">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams`, <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-3">source
snapshot params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, and
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="populating-a-session-history-entry:concept-origin">origin</a>
`initiatorOrigin`, perform the following steps. They return a
[`Document`](#document) or null.

1.  Let `type` be the
    <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:content-type-sniffing-2"
    data-x-internal="content-type-sniffing-2">computed type</a> of
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-11">response</a>.

2.  If the user agent has been configured to process resources of the
    given `type` using some mechanism other than rendering the content
    in a <a href="#navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigable-6">navigable</a>,
    then skip this step. Otherwise, if the `type` is one of the
    following types:

    an <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#html-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:html-mime-type"
    data-x-internal="html-mime-type">HTML MIME type</a>  
    Return the result of <a href="#navigate-html"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-html">loading an HTML
    document</a>, given `navigationParams`.

    an <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:xml-mime-type"
    data-x-internal="xml-mime-type">XML MIME type</a> that is not an <a href="#explicitly-supported-xml-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:explicitly-supported-xml-mime-type">explicitly
    supported XML MIME type</a>  
    Return the result of <a href="#read-xml"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:read-xml">loading an XML
    document</a> given `navigationParams` and `type`.

    a <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:javascript-mime-type"
    data-x-internal="javascript-mime-type">JavaScript MIME type</a>  
    a <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:json-mime-type"
    data-x-internal="json-mime-type">JSON MIME type</a> that is not an <a href="#explicitly-supported-json-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:explicitly-supported-json-mime-type">explicitly
    supported JSON MIME type</a>  
    "[`text/css`](#text/css)"  
    "<a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3"
    data-x-internal="text/plain"><code
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:text/plain">text/plain</code></a>"  
    "[`text/vtt`](#text/vtt)"  
    Return the result of <a href="#navigate-text"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-text">loading a text
    document</a> given `navigationParams` and `type`.

    "[`multipart/x-mixed-replace`](#multipart/x-mixed-replace)"  
    Return the result of <a href="#navigate-multipart-x-mixed-replace"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-multipart-x-mixed-replace">loading
    a <code>multipart/x-mixed-replace</code> document</a>, given
    `navigationParams`, `sourceSnapshotParams`, and `initiatorOrigin`.

    a supported image, video, or audio type  
    Return the result of <a href="#navigate-media"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-media">loading a media
    document</a> given `navigationParams` and `type`.

    "`application/pdf`"  
    "`text/pdf`"  
    If the user agent's <a href="#pdf-viewer-supported"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:pdf-viewer-supported">PDF viewer
    supported</a> is true, return the result of
    <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-ua-inline-3">creating a
    document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM</a> given
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-3">navigable</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-id-3">id</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-nav-timing-type-3">navigation
    timing type</a>, and `navigationParams`'s
