    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-user-involvement-3">user
    involvement</a>.

    Otherwise, proceed onward.

    An <span id="explicitly-supported-xml-mime-type"
    class="dfn">explicitly supported XML MIME type</span> is an
    <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:xml-mime-type-2"
    data-x-internal="xml-mime-type">XML MIME type</a> for which the user
    agent is configured to use an external application to render the
    content, or for which the user agent has dedicated processing rules.
    For example, a web browser with a built-in Atom feed viewer would be
    said to explicitly support the
    [`application/atom+xml`](#application/atom+xml) MIME type.

    An <span id="explicitly-supported-json-mime-type"
    class="dfn">explicitly supported JSON MIME type</span> is a
    <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:json-mime-type-2"
    data-x-internal="json-mime-type">JSON MIME type</a> for which the
    user agent is configured to use an external application to render
    the content, or for which the user agent has dedicated processing
    rules.

    In both cases, the external application or user agent will either
    <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-ua-inline-4">display the
    content inline</a> directly in `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-4">navigable</a>,
    or <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:hand-off-to-external-software-3">hand
    it off to external software</a>. Both happen in the steps below.

3.  <div id="navigate-non-Document">

    If, given `type`, the new resource is to be handled by displaying
    some sort of inline content, e.g., a native rendering of the content
    or an error message because the specified type is not supported,
    then return the result of <a href="#navigate-ua-inline"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigate-ua-inline-5">creating a
    document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM</a> given
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-5">navigable</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-id"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-id-4">id</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-nav-timing-type-4">navigation
    timing type</a>, and `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-user-involvement-4">user
    involvement</a>.

    </div>

4.  Otherwise, the document's `type` is such that the resource will not
    affect `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-6">navigable</a>,
    e.g., because the resource is to be handed to an external
    application or because it is an unknown type that will be processed
    by <a href="#handle-as-a-download"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:handle-as-a-download-2">handle as
    a download</a>. <a href="#hand-off-to-external-software"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:hand-off-to-external-software-4">Hand-off
    to external software</a> given `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-response-12">response</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-navigable-7">navigable</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:navigation-params-sandboxing-4">final
    sandboxing flag set</a>, `sourceSnapshotParams`'s
    <a href="#source-snapshot-params-activation"
    id="populating-a-session-history-entry:source-snapshot-params-activation-4">has
    transient activation</a>, and `initiatorOrigin`.

5.  Return null.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.4.6</span> Applying the history step<a href="#applying-the-history-step" class="self-link"></a>

For both navigation and traversal, once we have an idea of where we want
to head to in the session history, much of the work comes about in
applying that notion to the <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="applying-the-history-step:traversable-navigable">traversable
navigable</a> and the relevant [`Document`](#document). For navigations,
this work generally occurs toward the end of the process; for
traversals, it is the beginning.

##### <span class="secno">7.4.6.1</span> Updating the traversable<a href="#updating-the-traversable" class="self-link"></a>

Ensuring a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable">traversable</a> ends
up at the right session history step is particularly complex, as it can
involve coordinating across multiple <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable">navigable</a> descendants of the
traversable, [populating](#populating-a-session-history-entry) them in
parallel, and then synchronizing back up to ensure everyone has the same
view of the result. This is further complicated by the existence of
synchronous same-document navigations being mixed together with
cross-document navigations, and how web pages have come to have certain
relative timing expectations.

A <span id="changing-navigable-continuation-state" class="dfn">changing
navigable continuation state</span> is used to store information during
the <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step">apply the history
step</a> algorithm, allowing parts of the algorithm to continue only
after other parts have finished. It is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="updating-the-traversable:struct" data-x-internal="struct">struct</a>
with:

<span id="changing-nav-continuation-displayed-document" class="dfn" dfn-for="changing navigable
   continuation state">displayed document</span>  
A [`Document`](#document)

<span id="changing-nav-continuation-target-entry" class="dfn" dfn-for="changing navigable continuation
   state">target entry</span>  
A <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry">session history
entry</a>

<span id="changing-nav-continuation-navigable" class="dfn" dfn-for="changing navigable continuation
   state">navigable</span>  
A <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-2">navigable</a>

<span id="changing-nav-continuation-update-only" class="dfn" dfn-for="changing navigable continuation
   state">update only</span>  
A boolean

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Although all updates to the <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-2">traversable
navigable</a> end up in the same <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-2">apply the history
step</a> algorithm, each possible entry point comes along with some
minor customizations:

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="update-for-navigable-creation/destruction"
class="dfn">update for navigable creation/destruction</span> given a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-3">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`:

1.  Let `step` be `traversable`'s
    <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:tn-current-session-history-step">current
    session history step</a>.

2.  Return the result of <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-3">applying the
    history step</a> `step` to `traversable` given false, null, null,
    "[`none`](#uni-none)", and null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="apply-the-push/replace-history-step" class="dfn">apply the
push/replace history step</span> given a non-negative integer `step` to
a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-4">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, given a
<a href="#history-handling-behavior"
id="updating-the-traversable:history-handling-behavior">history handling
behavior</a> `historyHandling` and a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`:

1.  Return the result of <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-4">applying the
    history step</a> `step` to `traversable` given false, null, null,
    `userInvolvement`, and `historyHandling`.

</div>

<a href="#apply-the-push/replace-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-push/replace-history-step">Apply
the push/replace history step</a> never passes
<a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="updating-the-traversable:source-snapshot-params">source snapshot
params</a> or an initiator <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-3">navigable</a> to
<a href="#apply-the-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-5">apply the history
step</a>. This is because those checks are done earlier in the
<a href="#navigate"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigate">navigation</a> algorithm.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="apply-the-reload-history-step" class="dfn">apply the reload
history step</span> to a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-5">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable` given <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement-2">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`:

1.  Let `step` be `traversable`'s
    <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:tn-current-session-history-step-2">current
    session history step</a>.

2.  Return the result of <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-6">applying the
    history step</a> `step` to `traversable` given true, null, null,
    `userInvolvement`, and "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)".

</div>

<a href="#apply-the-reload-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-reload-history-step">Apply the
reload history step</a> never passes <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="updating-the-traversable:source-snapshot-params-2">source snapshot
params</a> or an initiator <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-4">navigable</a> to
<a href="#apply-the-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-7">apply the history
step</a>. This is because reloading is always treated as if it were done
by the <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-5">navigable</a> itself, even in
cases like `parent.location.reload()`.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="apply-the-traverse-history-step" class="dfn">apply the
traverse history step</span> given a non-negative integer `step` to a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-6">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, with <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="updating-the-traversable:source-snapshot-params-3">source snapshot
params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-6">navigable</a>
`initiatorToCheck`, and <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement-3">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`:

1.  Return the result of <a href="#apply-the-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-8">applying the
    history step</a> `step` to `traversable` given true,
    `sourceSnapshotParams`, `initiatorToCheck`, `userInvolvement`, and
    "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="resume-applying-the-traverse-history-step"
class="dfn">resume applying the traverse history step</span> given a
non-negative integer `step`, a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-7">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement-4">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`,
<a href="#apply-the-history-step"
id="updating-the-traversable:apply-the-history-step-9">apply</a> `step`
to `traversable` given false, null, null, `userInvolvement`, and
"[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)".

</div>

When resuming a traverse, we are already past the cancelation,
initiator, and source snapshot checks, and this traversal has already
been determined to be a same-document traversal. Hence, we can pass
false and null for those arguments.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now for the algorithm itself.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="apply-the-history-step" class="dfn">apply the history
step</span> given a non-negative integer `step` to a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-8">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, with boolean `checkForCancelation`,
<a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="updating-the-traversable:source-snapshot-params-4">source snapshot
params</a>-or-null `sourceSnapshotParams`, <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-7">navigable</a>-or-null
`initiatorToCheck`, <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement-5">user
navigation involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, and
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype)-or-null `navigationType`, perform
the following steps. They return "`initiator-disallowed`",
"`canceled-by-beforeunload`", "`canceled-by-navigate`", or "`applied`".

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="updating-the-traversable:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    This is running within `traversable`'s
    <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
    id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session
    history traversal queue</a>.

2.  Let `targetStep` be the result of <a href="#getting-the-used-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-used-step">getting the used
    step</a> given `traversable` and `step`.

3.  If `initiatorToCheck` is not null, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-traversable:assert-2"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `sourceSnapshotParams` is
        not null.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of <a
        href="#get-all-navigables-whose-current-session-history-entry-will-change-or-reload"
        id="updating-the-traversable:get-all-navigables-whose-current-session-history-entry-will-change-or-reload">get
        all navigables whose current session history entry will change or
        reload</a>: if `initiatorToCheck` is not
        <a href="#allowed-to-navigate"
        id="updating-the-traversable:allowed-to-navigate">allowed by sandboxing
        to navigate</a> `navigable` given `sourceSnapshotParams`, then
        return "`initiator-disallowed`".

4.  Let `navigablesCrossingDocuments` be the result of <a
    href="#getting-all-navigables-that-might-experience-a-cross-document-traversal"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-all-navigables-that-might-experience-a-cross-document-traversal">getting
    all navigables that might experience a cross-document traversal</a>
    given `traversable` and `targetStep`.

5.  If `checkForCancelation` is true, and the result of
    <a href="#checking-if-unloading-is-canceled"
    id="updating-the-traversable:checking-if-unloading-is-canceled">checking
    if unloading is canceled</a> given `navigablesCrossingDocuments`,
    `traversable`, `targetStep`, and `userInvolvement` is not
    "`continue`", then return that result.

6.  Let `changingNavigables` be the result of <a
    href="#get-all-navigables-whose-current-session-history-entry-will-change-or-reload"
    id="updating-the-traversable:get-all-navigables-whose-current-session-history-entry-will-change-or-reload-2">get
    all navigables whose current session history entry will change or
    reload</a> given `traversable` and `targetStep`.

7.  Let `nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates` be the result of <a
    href="#getting-all-navigables-that-only-need-history-object-length/index-update"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-all-navigables-that-only-need-history-object-length/index-update">getting
    all navigables that only need history object length/index update</a>
    given `traversable` and `targetStep`.

8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `changingNavigables`:

    1.  Let `targetEntry` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-target-history-entry">getting
        the target history entry</a> given `navigable` and `targetStep`.

    2.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry">current session
        history entry</a> to `targetEntry`.

    3.  <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="updating-the-traversable:set-the-ongoing-navigation">Set the ongoing
        navigation</a> for `navigable` to "`traversal`".

9.  Let `totalChangeJobs` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> of `changingNavigables`.

10. Let `completedChangeJobs` be 0.

11. Let `changingNavigableContinuations` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#queue"
    id="updating-the-traversable:queue" data-x-internal="queue">queue</a>
    of <a href="#changing-navigable-continuation-state"
    id="updating-the-traversable:changing-navigable-continuation-state">changing
    navigable continuation states</a>.

    This queue is used to split the operations on `changingNavigables`
    into two parts. Specifically, `changingNavigableContinuations` holds
    data for the [second part](#continuations-dequeue).

12. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-3"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `changingNavigables`, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task">queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> of `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window">active
    window</a> to run the steps:

    This set of steps are split into two parts to allow synchronous
    navigations to be processed before documents unload. State is stored
    in `changingNavigableContinuations` for the [second
    part](#continuations-dequeue).

    1.  Let `displayedEntry` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry">active session
        history entry</a>.

    2.  Let `targetEntry` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-2">current
        session history entry</a>.

    3.  Let `changingNavigableContinuation` be a
        <a href="#changing-navigable-continuation-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-navigable-continuation-state-2">changing
        navigable continuation state</a> with:

        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-displayed-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-displayed-document">displayed
        document</a>  
        `displayedEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document">document</a>

        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-target-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-target-entry">target
        entry</a>  
        `targetEntry`

        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-navigable">navigable</a>  
        `navigable`

        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only">update-only</a>  
        false

    4.  If `displayedEntry` is `targetEntry` and `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending">reload
        pending</a> is false, then:

        1.  Set `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
            <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
            id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only-2">update-only</a>
            to true.

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#queue-enqueue"
            id="updating-the-traversable:enqueue"
            data-x-internal="enqueue">Enqueue</a>
            `changingNavigableContinuation` on
            `changingNavigableContinuations`.

        3.  Abort these steps.

        This case occurs due to a
        <a href="#finalize-a-same-document-navigation"
        id="updating-the-traversable:finalize-a-same-document-navigation">synchronous
        navigation</a> which already updated the
        <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-2">active session
        history entry</a>.

    5.  Switch on `navigationType`:

        "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)"  
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-traversable:assert-3"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-2">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-2">reload
        pending</a> is true.

        "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)"  
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-traversable:assert-4"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-3">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-ever-populated">ever
        populated</a> is true.

        "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)"  
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-traversable:assert-5"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step">step</a>
        is `displayedEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-2">step</a>
        and `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-4">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-ever-populated-2">ever
        populated</a> is false.

        "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)"  
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-traversable:assert-6"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-3">step</a>
        is `displayedEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-4">step</a> +
        1 and `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-5">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-ever-populated"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-ever-populated-3">ever
        populated</a> is false.

    6.  Let `oldOrigin` be `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-6">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-origin"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-origin">origin</a>.

    7.  <div id="descendant-navigable-traversal-navigate-events">

        If all of the following are true:

        - `navigable` is not `traversable`;

        - `targetEntry` is not `navigable`'s
          <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
          id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-3">current
          session history entry</a>; and

        - `oldOrigin` is the <a href="#same-origin"
          id="updating-the-traversable:same-origin">same</a> as
          `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
          id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-4">current
          session history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
          id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-7">document state</a>'s
          <a href="#document-state-origin"
          id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-origin-2">origin</a>,

        then:

        1.  Let `navigation` be `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window-2">active
            window</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
            id="updating-the-traversable:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

        2.  <a href="#fire-a-traverse-navigate-event"
            id="updating-the-traversable:fire-a-traverse-navigate-event">Fire a
            traverse <code>navigate</code> event</a> at `navigation`
            given `targetEntry` and `userInvolvement`.

        </div>

    8.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-2">document</a> is
        null, or `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-8">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-3">reload
        pending</a> is true, then:

        1.  Let `navTimingType` be "<a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward"
            data-x-internal="dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward"><code
            id="updating-the-traversable:dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward">back_forward</code></a>"
            if `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-3">document</a> is
            null; otherwise "<a
            href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward"
            data-x-internal="dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward"><code
            id="updating-the-traversable:dom-navigationtimingtype-back_forward-2">reload</code></a>".

        2.  Let `targetSnapshotParams` be the result of
            <a href="#snapshotting-target-snapshot-params"
            id="updating-the-traversable:snapshotting-target-snapshot-params">snapshotting
            target snapshot params</a> given `navigable`.

        3.  Let `potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams` be
            `sourceSnapshotParams`.

        4.  If `potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams` is null,
            then set it to the result of
            <a href="#snapshotting-source-snapshot-params"
            id="updating-the-traversable:snapshotting-source-snapshot-params">snapshotting
            source snapshot params</a> given `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document">active document</a>.

            In this case there is no clear source of the
            traversal/reload. We treat this situation as if `navigable`
            navigated itself, but note that some properties of
            `targetEntry`'s original initiator are preserved in
            `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-9">document state</a>,
            such as the <a href="#document-state-initiator-origin"
            id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-initiator-origin">initiator
            origin</a> and <a href="#document-state-request-referrer"
            id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-request-referrer">referrer</a>,
            which will appropriately influence the navigation.

        5.  Set `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-10">document state</a>'s
            <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
            id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-4">reload
            pending</a> to false.

        6.  Let `allowPOST` be `targetEntry`'s
            <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-11">document state</a>'s
            <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
            id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-5">reload
            pending</a>.

        7.  <a href="#in-parallel" id="updating-the-traversable:in-parallel">In
            parallel</a>,
            <a href="#attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:attempt-to-populate-the-history-entry&#39;s-document">attempt
            to populate the history entry's document</a> for
            `targetEntry`, given `navigable`,
            `potentiallyTargetSpecificSourceSnapshotParams`,
            `targetSnapshotParams`, `userInvolvement`, with
            *[allowPOST](#attempt-to-populate-allow-post)* set to
            `allowPOST` and
            <a href="#attempt-to-populate-completion-steps"
            id="updating-the-traversable:attempt-to-populate-completion-steps"><em>completionSteps</em></a>
            set to <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task-2">queue a global
            task</a> on the
            <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window-3">active
            window</a> to run `afterDocumentPopulated`.

        Otherwise, run `afterDocumentPopulated` <a href="#immediately"
        id="updating-the-traversable:immediately">immediately</a>.

        In both cases, let `afterDocumentPopulated` be the following
        steps:

        1.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-4">document</a> is
            null, then set `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
            <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
            id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only-3">update-only</a>
            to true.

            This means we tried to populate the document, but were
            unable to do so, e.g. because of the server returning a 204.

            <div class="note">

            These kinds of failed navigations or traversals will not be
            signaled to the [navigation API](#navigation-api) (e.g.,
            through the promises of any
            <a href="#navigation-api-method-tracker"
            id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-api-method-tracker">navigation
            API method tracker</a>, or the
            [`navigateerror`](#event-navigateerror) event). Doing so
            would leak information about the timing of responses from
            other origins, in the cross-origin case, and providing
            different results in the cross-origin vs. same-origin cases
            was deemed too confusing.

            However, implementations could use this opportunity to clear
            any promise handlers for the
            [`navigation.transition.finished`](#dom-navigationtransition-finished)
            promise, as they are guaranteed at this point to never run.
            And, they might wish to <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="updating-the-traversable:report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> if any part of the navigation API initiated
            these navigations, to make it clear to the web developer why
            their promises will never settle and events will never fire.

            </div>

        2.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-5">document</a>'s
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
            id="updating-the-traversable:concept-document-origin"
            data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
            `oldOrigin`, then set `targetEntry`'s
            <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-classic-history-api-state">classic
            history API state</a> to
            <a href="#structuredserializeforstorage"
            id="updating-the-traversable:structuredserializeforstorage">StructuredSerializeForStorage</a>(null).

            This clears history state when the origin changed vs a
            previous load of `targetEntry` without a redirect occuring.
            This can happen due to a change in CSP sandbox headers.

        3.  If all of the following are true:

            - `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-parent"
              id="updating-the-traversable:nav-parent">parent</a> is
              null;

            - `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
              id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-6">document</a>'s
              <a href="#concept-document-bc"
              id="updating-the-traversable:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>
              is not an <a href="#auxiliary-browsing-context"
              id="updating-the-traversable:auxiliary-browsing-context">auxiliary
              browsing context</a> whose
              <a href="#opener-browsing-context"
              id="updating-the-traversable:opener-browsing-context">opener browsing
              context</a> is non-null; and

            - `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
              id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-7">document</a>'s
              <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
              id="updating-the-traversable:concept-document-origin-2"
              data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
              not `oldOrigin`,

            then set `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-12">document state</a>'s
            <a href="#document-state-nav-target-name"
            id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-nav-target-name">navigable
            target name</a> to the empty string.

        4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#queue-enqueue"
            id="updating-the-traversable:enqueue-2"
            data-x-internal="enqueue">Enqueue</a>
            `changingNavigableContinuation` on
            `changingNavigableContinuations`.

            The rest of this job [runs later](#continuations-dequeue) in
            this algorithm.

13. Let `navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="updating-the-traversable:set" data-x-internal="set">set</a>.

14. While `completedChangeJobs` does not equal `totalChangeJobs`:

    1.  If `traversable`'s
        <a href="#tn-running-nested-apply-history-step"
        id="updating-the-traversable:tn-running-nested-apply-history-step">running
        nested apply history step</a> is false, then:

        1.  <div id="sync-navigations-jump-queue">

            While `traversable`'s
            <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
            id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-2">session
            history traversal queue</a>'s
            <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set"
            id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set">algorithm
            set</a>
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
            id="updating-the-traversable:list-contains"
            data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> one or more
            <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps"
            id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps">synchronous
            navigation steps</a> with a <a
            href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps-target-nav"
            id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps-target-nav">target
            navigable</a> not
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
            id="updating-the-traversable:list-contains-2"
            data-x-internal="list-contains">contained</a> in
            `navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation`:

            1.  Let `steps` be the first
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
                id="updating-the-traversable:list-item"
                data-x-internal="list-item">item</a> in `traversable`'s
                <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
                id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-3">session
                history traversal queue</a>'s
                <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set"
                id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set-2">algorithm
                set</a> that is
                <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps"
                id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps-2">synchronous
                navigation steps</a> with a <a
                href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps-target-nav"
                id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-sync-nav-steps-target-nav-2">target
                navigable</a> not
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
                id="updating-the-traversable:list-contains-3"
                data-x-internal="list-contains">contained</a> in
                `navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation`.

            2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
                id="updating-the-traversable:list-remove"
                data-x-internal="list-remove">Remove</a> `steps` from
                `traversable`'s
                <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
                id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-4">session
                history traversal queue</a>'s
                <a href="#session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set"
                id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-traversal-parallel-queue-algorithm-set-3">algorithm
                set</a>.

            3.  Set `traversable`'s
                <a href="#tn-running-nested-apply-history-step"
                id="updating-the-traversable:tn-running-nested-apply-history-step-2">running
                nested apply history step</a> to true.

            4.  Run `steps`.

            5.  Set `traversable`'s
                <a href="#tn-running-nested-apply-history-step"
                id="updating-the-traversable:tn-running-nested-apply-history-step-3">running
                nested apply history step</a> to false.

            Synchronous navigations that are intended to take place
            before this traversal jump the queue at this point, so they
            can be added to the correct place in `traversable`'s
            <a href="#tn-session-history-entries"
            id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-entries">session history
            entries</a> before this traversal potentially unloads their
            document. [More details can be found
            here](#sync-navigation-steps-queue-jumping-examples).

            </div>

    2.  <div id="continuations-dequeue">

        Let `changingNavigableContinuation` be the result of
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#queue-dequeue"
        id="updating-the-traversable:dequeue"
        data-x-internal="dequeue">dequeuing</a> from
        `changingNavigableContinuations`.

        </div>

    3.  If `changingNavigableContinuation` is nothing, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="updating-the-traversable:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    4.  Let `displayedDocument` be `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-displayed-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-displayed-document-2">displayed
        document</a>.

    5.  Let `targetEntry` be `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-target-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-target-entry-2">target
        entry</a>.

    6.  Let `navigable` be `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-navigable-2">navigable</a>.

    7.  Let (`scriptHistoryLength`, `scriptHistoryIndex`) be the result
        of <a href="#getting-the-history-object-length-and-index"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-history-object-length-and-index">getting
        the history object length and index</a> given `traversable` and
        `targetStep`.

        These values might have changed since they were last calculated.

    8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `navigable` to
        `navigablesThatMustWaitBeforeHandlingSyncNavigation`.

        Once a navigable has reached this point in traversal,
        additionally queued synchronous navigation steps are likely to
        be intended to occur after this traversal rather than before it,
        so they no longer jump the queue. [More details can be found
        here](#sync-navigation-steps-queue-jumping-examples).

    9.  Let `entriesForNavigationAPI` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-session-history-entries-for-the-navigation-api">getting
        session history entries for the navigation API</a> given
        `navigable` and `targetStep`.

    10. If `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
        <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
        id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only-4">update-only</a>
        is true, or `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-8">document</a> is
        `displayedDocument`, then:

        This is a same-document navigation: we proceed without
        unloading.

        1.  <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
            id="updating-the-traversable:set-the-ongoing-navigation-2">Set the
            ongoing navigation</a> for `navigable` to null.

            This allows new <a href="#navigate"
            id="updating-the-traversable:navigate-2">navigations</a> of
            `navigable` to start, whereas during the traversal they were
            blocked.

        2.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task-3">Queue a global
            task</a> on the
            <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-3">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window-4">active
            window</a> to perform `afterPotentialUnloads`.

    11. Otherwise:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="updating-the-traversable:assert-7"
            data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `navigationType` is not
            null.

        2.  <a href="#deactivate-a-document-for-a-cross-document-navigation"
            id="updating-the-traversable:deactivate-a-document-for-a-cross-document-navigation">Deactivate</a>
            `displayedDocument`, given `userInvolvement`, `targetEntry`,
            `navigationType`, and `afterPotentialUnloads`.

    12. In both cases, let `afterPotentialUnloads` be the following
        steps:

        1.  Let `previousEntry` be `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
            id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-3">active session
            history entry</a>.

        2.  If `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
            <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
            id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only-5">update-only</a>
            is false, then <a href="#activate-history-entry"
            id="updating-the-traversable:activate-history-entry">activate history
            entry</a> `targetEntry` for `navigable`.

        3.  Let `updateDocument` be an algorithm step which performs
            <a href="#update-document-for-history-step-application"
            id="updating-the-traversable:update-document-for-history-step-application">update
            document for history step application</a> given
            `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-9">document</a>,
            `targetEntry`, `changingNavigableContinuation`'s
            <a href="#changing-nav-continuation-update-only"
            id="updating-the-traversable:changing-nav-continuation-update-only-6">update-only</a>,
            `scriptHistoryLength`, `scriptHistoryIndex`,
            `navigationType`, `entriesForNavigationAPI`, and
            `previousEntry`.

        4.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-10">document</a>
            is equal to `displayedDocument`, then perform
            `updateDocument`.

        5.  Otherwise, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task-4">queue a global
            task</a> on the
            <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
            id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-4">navigation
            and traversal task source</a> given `targetEntry`'s
            <a href="#she-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-11">document</a>'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="updating-the-traversable:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
            object</a> to perform `updateDocument`.

        6.  Increment `completedChangeJobs`.

15. Let `totalNonchangingJobs` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-size-2"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> of
    `nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates`.

    This step onwards deliberately waits for all the previous operations
    to complete, as they include [processing synchronous
    navigations](#sync-navigations-jump-queue) which will also post
    tasks to update history length and index.

16. Let `completedNonchangingJobs` be 0.

17. Let (`scriptHistoryLength`, `scriptHistoryIndex`) be the result of
    <a href="#getting-the-history-object-length-and-index"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-history-object-length-and-index-2">getting
    the history object length and index</a> given `traversable` and
    `targetStep`.

18. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-4"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `nonchangingNavigablesThatStillNeedUpdates`,
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task-5">queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-5">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window-5">active
    window</a> to run the steps:

    1.  Let `document` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-2">active document</a>.

    2.  Set `document`'s
        <a href="#doc-history" id="updating-the-traversable:doc-history">history
        object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-index"
        id="updating-the-traversable:concept-history-index">index</a> to
        `scriptHistoryIndex`.

    3.  Set `document`'s <a href="#doc-history"
        id="updating-the-traversable:doc-history-2">history object</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-history-length"
        id="updating-the-traversable:concept-history-length">length</a>
        to `scriptHistoryLength`.

    4.  Increment `completedNonchangingJobs`.

19. Wait for `completedNonchangingJobs` to equal `totalNonchangingJobs`.

20. Set `traversable`'s <a href="#tn-current-session-history-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:tn-current-session-history-step-3">current
    session history step</a> to `targetStep`.

21. Return "`applied`".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="deactivate-a-document-for-a-cross-document-navigation"
class="dfn">deactivate a document for a cross-document navigation</span>
given a [`Document`](#document) `displayedDocument`, a
<a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="updating-the-traversable:user-navigation-involvement-6">user
navigation involvement</a> `userNavigationInvolvement`, a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry-2">session history
entry</a> `targetEntry`, a [`NavigationType`](#navigationtype)
`navigationType`, and `afterPotentialUnloads`, which is an algorithm
that receives no arguments:

1.  Let `navigable` be `displayedDocument`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="updating-the-traversable:node-navigable">node navigable</a>.

2.  Let `potentiallyTriggerViewTransition` be false.

3.  Let `isBrowserUINavigation` be true if `userNavigationInvolvement`
    is "[`browser UI`](#uni-browser-ui)"; otherwise false.

4.  Set `potentiallyTriggerViewTransition` to the result of calling <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#can-navigation-trigger-a-cross-document-view-transition"
    id="updating-the-traversable:can-navigation-trigger-a-cross-document-view-transition"
    data-x-internal="can-navigation-trigger-a-cross-document-view-transition">can
    navigation trigger a cross-document view-transition?</a> given
    `displayedDocument`, `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-12">document</a>,
    `navigationType`, and `isBrowserUINavigation`.

5.  If `potentiallyTriggerViewTransition` is false, then:

    1.  Let `firePageSwapBeforeUnload` be the following step:

        1.  <a href="#fire-the-pageswap-event"
            id="updating-the-traversable:fire-the-pageswap-event">Fire the
            <code>pageswap</code> event</a> given `displayedDocument`,
            `targetEntry`, `navigationType`, and null.

    2.  <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
        id="updating-the-traversable:set-the-ongoing-navigation-3">Set the
        ongoing navigation</a> for `navigable` to null.

        This allows new <a href="#navigate"
        id="updating-the-traversable:navigate-3">navigations</a> of
        `navigable` to start, whereas during the traversal they were
        blocked.

    3.  <a href="#unload-a-document-and-its-descendants"
        id="updating-the-traversable:unload-a-document-and-its-descendants">Unload
        a document and its descendants</a> given `displayedDocument`,
        `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-13">document</a>,
        `afterPotentialUnloads`, and `firePageSwapBeforeUnload`.

6.  Otherwise, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="updating-the-traversable:queue-a-global-task-6">queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-6">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="updating-the-traversable:nav-window-6">active
    window</a> to run the steps:

    1.  Let `proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture` be the
        following step:

        1.  <a href="#tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps"
            id="updating-the-traversable:tn-append-session-history-traversal-steps">Append
            the following session history traversal steps</a> to
            `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
            id="updating-the-traversable:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>:

            1.  <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
                id="updating-the-traversable:set-the-ongoing-navigation-4">Set the
                ongoing navigation</a> for `navigable` to null.

                This allows new <a href="#navigate"
                id="updating-the-traversable:navigate-4">navigations</a>
                of `navigable` to start, whereas during the traversal
                they were blocked.

            2.  <a href="#unload-a-document-and-its-descendants"
                id="updating-the-traversable:unload-a-document-and-its-descendants-2">Unload
                a document and its descendants</a> given
                `displayedDocument`, `targetEntry`'s
                <a href="#she-document"
                id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-14">document</a>,
                and `afterPotentialUnloads`.

    2.  Let `viewTransition` be the result of <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#setup-cross-document-view-transition"
        id="updating-the-traversable:setting-up-a-cross-document-view-transition"
        data-x-internal="setting-up-a-cross-document-view-transition">setting up
        a cross-document view-transition</a> given `displayedDocument`,
        `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-15">document</a>,
        `navigationType`, and
        `proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture`.

    3.  <a href="#fire-the-pageswap-event"
        id="updating-the-traversable:fire-the-pageswap-event-2">Fire the
        <code>pageswap</code> event</a> given `displayedDocument`,
        `targetEntry`, `navigationType`, and `viewTransition`.

    4.  If `viewTransition` is null, then run
        `proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture`.

        In the case where a view transition started, the view
        transitions algorithms are responsible for calling
        `proceedWithNavigationAfterViewTransitionCapture`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fire-the-pageswap-event" class="dfn">fire the `pageswap`
event</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `displayedDocument`, a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry-3">session history
entry</a> `targetEntry`, a [`NavigationType`](#navigationtype)
`navigationType`, and a
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#viewtransition"
data-x-internal="viewtransition"><code
id="updating-the-traversable:viewtransition">ViewTransition</code></a>-or-null
`viewTransition`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="updating-the-traversable:assert-8"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this is running as part of a
    <a href="#concept-task"
    id="updating-the-traversable:concept-task">task</a> queued on
    `displayedDocument`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="updating-the-traversable:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="updating-the-traversable:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>.

2.  Let `navigation` be `displayedDocument`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-traversable:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="updating-the-traversable:window-navigation-api-2">navigation API</a>.

3.  Let `activation` be null.

4.  If all of the following are true:

    - `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-16">document</a>'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="updating-the-traversable:concept-document-origin-3"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
      <a href="#same-origin" id="updating-the-traversable:same-origin-2">same
      origin</a> with `displayedDocument`'s
      <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
      id="updating-the-traversable:concept-document-origin-4"
      data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>; and

    - `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-17">document</a>'s
      <a href="#was-created-via-cross-origin-redirects"
      id="updating-the-traversable:was-created-via-cross-origin-redirects">was
      created via cross-origin redirects</a> is false, or
      `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-18">document</a>'s
      <a href="#latest-entry"
      id="updating-the-traversable:latest-entry">latest entry</a> is not
      null,

    then:

    1.  Let `destinationEntry` be determined by switching on
        `navigationType`:

        "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)"  
        The <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-current-entry">current entry</a>
        of `navigation`

        "[`traverse`](#dom-navigationtype-traverse)"  
        The [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) in
        `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-entry-list">entry list</a>
        whose
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="updating-the-traversable:nhe-she">session history
        entry</a> is `targetEntry`

        "[`push`](#dom-navigationtype-push)"  
        "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)"  
        A new [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) in
        `displayedDocument`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="updating-the-traversable:concept-relevant-realm">relevant realm</a>
        with its
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="updating-the-traversable:nhe-she-2">session
        history entry</a> set to `targetEntry`

    2.  Set `activation` to a
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#new"
        id="updating-the-traversable:new" data-x-internal="new">new</a>
        [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) created in
        `displayedDocument`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="updating-the-traversable:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant
        realm</a>, with

        <a href="#nav-activation-old-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-activation-old-entry">old entry</a>  
        the <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:navigation-current-entry-2">current
        entry</a> of `navigation`

        <a href="#nav-activation-new-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-activation-new-entry">new entry</a>  
        `destinationEntry`

        <a href="#nav-activation-navigation-type"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-activation-navigation-type">navigation
        type</a>  
        `navigationType`

    This means that a cross-origin redirect during a navigation would
    result in a null [`activation`](#dom-pageswapevent-activation) in
    the old document's [`PageSwapEvent`](#pageswapevent), unless the new
    document is being restored from [bfcache](#note-bfcache).

5.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="updating-the-traversable:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
    [`pageswap`](#event-pageswap) at `displayedDocument`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-traversable:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>, using [`PageSwapEvent`](#pageswapevent) with its
    [`activation`](#dom-pageswapevent-activation) set to `activation`,
    and its [`viewTransition`](#dom-pageswapevent-viewtransition) set to
    `viewTransition`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="activate-history-entry" class="dfn">activate history
entry</span> <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry-4">session history
entry</a> `entry` for <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-8">navigable</a> `navigable`:

1.  <a href="#save-persisted-state"
    id="updating-the-traversable:save-persisted-state">Save persisted
    state</a> to the <a href="#navigable"
    id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-9">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-4">active session
    history entry</a>.

2.  Let `newDocument` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-19">document</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="updating-the-traversable:assert-9"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `newDocument`'s
    <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="updating-the-traversable:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> is false, i.e., we never traverse back
    to the <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="updating-the-traversable:is-initial-about:blank-2">initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document) because it
    always gets [replaced](#navigate-convert-to-replace) when we
    navigate away from it.

4.  Set `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-5">active session
    history entry</a> to `entry`.

5.  <a href="#make-active" id="updating-the-traversable:make-active">Make
    active</a> `newDocument`.

6.  <a href="#set-the-initial-visibility-state"
    id="updating-the-traversable:set-the-initial-visibility-state">Set the
    initial visibility state</a> of `newDocument` to `navigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="updating-the-traversable:nav-traversable-2">traversable
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#system-visibility-state"
    id="updating-the-traversable:system-visibility-state">system visibility
    state</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="getting-the-used-step" class="dfn">get the used step</span>
given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-9">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and a non-negative integer `step`, perform
the following steps. They return a non-negative integer.

1.  Let `steps` be the result of
    <a href="#getting-all-used-history-steps"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-all-used-history-steps">getting all
    used history steps</a> within `traversable`.

2.  Return the greatest
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-item-2"
    data-x-internal="list-item">item</a> in `steps` that is less than or
    equal to `step`.

    This caters for situations where there's no
    <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry-5">session history
    entry</a> with
    <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-5">step</a>
    `step`, due to the removal of a <a href="#navigable"
    id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-10">navigable</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="getting-the-history-object-length-and-index"
class="dfn">get the history object length and index</span> given a
<a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-10">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and a non-negative integer `step`, perform
the following steps. They return a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tuple"
id="updating-the-traversable:tuple" data-x-internal="tuple">tuple</a> of
two non-negative integers.

1.  Let `steps` be the result of
    <a href="#getting-all-used-history-steps"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-all-used-history-steps-2">getting
    all used history steps</a> within `traversable`.

2.  Let `scriptHistoryLength` be the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-size-3"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> of `steps`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="updating-the-traversable:assert-10"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `steps`
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-contains-4"
    data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> `step`.

    It is assumed that `step` has been adjusted by
    <a href="#getting-the-used-step"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-used-step-2">getting the used
    step</a>.

4.  Let `scriptHistoryIndex` be the index of `step` in `steps`.

5.  Return (`scriptHistoryLength`, `scriptHistoryIndex`).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="get-all-navigables-whose-current-session-history-entry-will-change-or-reload"
class="dfn">get all navigables whose current session history entry will
change or reload</span> given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-11">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and a non-negative integer `targetStep`,
perform the following steps. They return a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="updating-the-traversable:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-11">navigables</a>.

1.  Let `results` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  Let `navigablesToCheck` be « `traversable` ».

    This list is extended in the loop below.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-5"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `navigablesToCheck`:

    1.  Let `targetEntry` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-target-history-entry-2">getting
        the target history entry</a> given `navigable` and `targetStep`.

    2.  If `targetEntry` is not `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-5">current
        session history entry</a> or `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-13">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-6">reload
        pending</a> is true, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `navigable` to
        `results`.

    3.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-20">document</a> is
        `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-3">document</a>, and
        `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-14">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-7">reload
        pending</a> is false, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-extend"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-extend"
        data-x-internal="list-extend">extend</a> `navigablesToCheck`
        with the <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable">child navigables</a>
        of `navigable`.

        Adding <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-2">child navigables</a>
        to `navigablesToCheck` means those navigables will also be
        checked by this loop. <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-3">Child navigables</a>
        are only checked if the `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-4">active document</a>
        will not change as part of this traversal.

4.  Return `results`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="getting-all-navigables-that-only-need-history-object-length/index-update"
class="dfn">get all navigables that only need history object
length/index update</span> given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-12">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and a non-negative integer `targetStep`,
perform the following steps. They return a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="updating-the-traversable:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-12">navigables</a>.

Other <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-13">navigables</a> might not be
impacted by the traversal. For example, if the response is a 204, the
currently active document will remain. Additionally, going 'back' after
a 204 will change the <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-6">current
session history entry</a>, but the <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-6">active session
history entry</a> will already be correct.

1.  Let `results` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-4" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  Let `navigablesToCheck` be « `traversable` ».

    This list is extended in the loop below.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-6"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `navigablesToCheck`:

    1.  Let `targetEntry` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-target-history-entry-3">getting
        the target history entry</a> given `navigable` and `targetStep`.

    2.  If `targetEntry` is `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-current-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-current-history-entry-7">current
        session history entry</a> and `targetEntry`'s
        <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-15">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-8">reload
        pending</a> is false, then:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="updating-the-traversable:list-append-3"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `navigable` to
            `results`.

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-extend"
            id="updating-the-traversable:list-extend-2"
            data-x-internal="list-extend">Extend</a> `navigablesToCheck`
            with `navigable`'s <a href="#child-navigable"
            id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-4">child navigables</a>.

            Adding <a href="#child-navigable"
            id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-5">child navigables</a>
            to `navigablesToCheck` means those navigables will also be
            checked by this loop. <a href="#child-navigable"
            id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-6">child navigables</a>
            are only checked if the `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-document"
            id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-5">active document</a>
            will not change as part of this traversal.

4.  Return `results`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="getting-the-target-history-entry" class="dfn">get the
target history entry</span> given a <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-14">navigable</a> `navigable`,
and a non-negative integer `step`, perform the following steps. They
return a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:session-history-entry-6">session history
entry</a>.

1.  Let `entries` be the result of
    <a href="#getting-session-history-entries"
    id="updating-the-traversable:getting-session-history-entries">getting
    session history entries</a> for `navigable`.

2.  Return the <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-item-3"
    data-x-internal="list-item">item</a> in `entries` that has the
    greatest
    <a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-6">step</a>
    less than or equal to `step`.

</div>

<div id="example-getting-the-target-history-entry" class="example">

<a href="#example-getting-the-target-history-entry"
class="self-link"></a>

To see why <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-target-history-entry-4">getting
the target history entry</a> returns the entry with the greatest
<a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-7">step</a>
less than or equal to the input step, consider the following
<a href="#jake-diagram" id="updating-the-traversable:jake-diagram">Jake
diagram</a>:

|             | 0      | 1      | 2   | 3      |
|-------------|--------|--------|-----|--------|
| `top`       | /t     |        |     | /t#foo |
| `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |     |        |

For the input step 1, the target history entry for the `top` navigable
is the `/t` entry, whose
<a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-8">step</a> is
0, while the target history entry for the `frames[0]` navigable is the
`/i-0-b` entry, whose
<a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-9">step</a> is
1:

|             | 0      | 1      | 2   | 3      |
|-------------|--------|--------|-----|--------|
| `top`       | /t     |        |     | /t#foo |
| `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |     |        |

Similarly, given the input step 3 we get the `top` entry whose
<a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-10">step</a>
is 3, and the `frames[0]` entry whose
<a href="#she-step" id="updating-the-traversable:she-step-11">step</a>
is 1:

|             | 0      | 1      | 2   | 3      |
|-------------|--------|--------|-----|--------|
| `top`       | /t     |        |     | /t#foo |
| `frames[0]` | /i-0-a | /i-0-b |     |        |

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="getting-all-navigables-that-might-experience-a-cross-document-traversal"
class="dfn">get all navigables that might experience a cross-document
traversal</span> given a <a href="#traversable-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:traversable-navigable-13">traversable
navigable</a> `traversable`, and a non-negative integer `targetStep`,
perform the following steps. They return a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="updating-the-traversable:list-5" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-15">navigables</a>.

<div class="note">

From `traversable`'s <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
id="updating-the-traversable:tn-session-history-traversal-queue-5">session
history traversal queue</a>'s perspective, these documents are
candidates for going cross-document during the traversal described by
`targetStep`. They will not experience a cross-document traversal if the
status code for their target document is HTTP 204 No Content.

Note that if a given <a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-16">navigable</a> might
experience a cross-document traversal, this algorithm will return
<a href="#navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:navigable-17">navigable</a> but not its
<a href="#child-navigable"
id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-7">child navigables</a>.
Those would end up <a href="#unload-a-document"
id="updating-the-traversable:unload-a-document">unloaded</a>, not
traversed.

</div>

1.  Let `results` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-6" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  Let `navigablesToCheck` be « `traversable` ».

    This list is extended in the loop below.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-traversable:list-iterate-7"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `navigablesToCheck`:

    1.  Let `targetEntry` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-target-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:getting-the-target-history-entry-5">getting
        the target history entry</a> given `navigable` and `targetStep`.

    2.  If `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-21">document</a> is
        not `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-6">document</a> or
        `targetEntry`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
        id="updating-the-traversable:she-document-state-16">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-reload-pending"
        id="updating-the-traversable:document-state-reload-pending-9">reload
        pending</a> is true, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-append-4"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `navigable` to
        `results`.

        Although `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-active-history-entry-7">active history
        entry</a> can change synchronously, the new entry will always
        have the same [`Document`](#document), so accessing
        `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-7">document</a> is
        reliable.

    3.  Otherwise, <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-extend"
        id="updating-the-traversable:list-extend-3"
        data-x-internal="list-extend">extend</a> `navigablesToCheck`
        with `navigable`'s <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-8">child navigables</a>.

        Adding <a href="#child-navigable"
        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-9">child navigables</a>
        to `navigablesToCheck` means those navigables will also be
        checked by this loop. <a href="#child-navigable"
