        id="updating-the-traversable:child-navigable-10">Child navigables</a>
        are only checked if the `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="updating-the-traversable:nav-document-8">active document</a>
        will not change as part of this traversal.

4.  Return `results`.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.6.2</span> Updating the document<a href="#updating-the-document" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="update-document-for-history-step-application"
class="dfn">update document for history step application</span> given a
[`Document`](#document) `document`, a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry">session history
entry</a> `entry`, a boolean `doNotReactivate`, integers
`scriptHistoryLength` and `scriptHistoryIndex`,
[`NavigationType`](#navigationtype)-or-null `navigationType`, an
optional <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="updating-the-document:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry-2">session history
entries</a> `entriesForNavigationAPI`, and an optional
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry-3">session history
entry</a> `previousEntryForActivation`:

1.  Let `documentIsNew` be true if `document`'s
    <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry">latest
    entry</a> is null; otherwise false.

2.  Let `documentsEntryChanged` be true if `document`'s
    <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry-2">latest
    entry</a> is not `entry`; otherwise false.

3.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#doc-history" id="updating-the-document:doc-history">history
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-index"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-history-index">index</a> to
    `scriptHistoryIndex`.

4.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#doc-history" id="updating-the-document:doc-history-2">history
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-length"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-history-length">length</a> to
    `scriptHistoryLength`.

5.  Let `navigation` be `history`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="updating-the-document:window-navigation-api">navigation API</a>.

6.  If `documentsEntryChanged` is true, then:

    1.  Let `oldURL` be `document`'s
        <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry-3">latest
        entry</a>'s
        <a href="#she-url" id="updating-the-document:she-url">URL</a>.

    2.  Set `document`'s
        <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry-4">latest
        entry</a> to `entry`.

    3.  <a href="#restore-the-history-object-state"
        id="updating-the-document:restore-the-history-object-state">Restore the
        history object state</a> given `document` and `entry`.

    4.  If `documentIsNew` is false, then:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="updating-the-document:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `navigationType` is not null.

        2.  <a
            href="#update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation"
            id="updating-the-document:update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-same-document-navigation">Update
            the navigation API entries for a same-document navigation</a>
            given `navigation`, `entry`, and `navigationType`.

        3.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-event-fire"
            data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
            [`popstate`](#event-popstate) at `document`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
            object</a>, using [`PopStateEvent`](#popstateevent), with
            the [`state`](#dom-popstateevent-state) attribute
            initialized to `document`'s
            <a href="#doc-history" id="updating-the-document:doc-history-3">history
            object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-state"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-history-state">state</a>
            and
            [`hasUAVisualTransition`](#dom-popstateevent-hasuavisualtransition)
            initialized to true if a visual transition, to display a
            cached rendered state of the
            <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry-5">latest
            entry</a>, was done by the user agent.

        4.  <a href="#restore-persisted-state"
            id="updating-the-document:restore-persisted-state">Restore persisted
            state</a> given `entry`.

        5.  If `oldURL`'s
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-url-fragment"
            data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> is not
            equal to `entry`'s
            <a href="#she-url" id="updating-the-document:she-url-2">URL</a>'s
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-url-fragment-2"
            data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>, then
            <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
            id="updating-the-document:queue-a-global-task">queue a global task</a>
            on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
            id="updating-the-document:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM manipulation
            task source</a> given `document`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
            object</a> to
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-event-fire-2"
            data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
            [`hashchange`](#event-hashchange) at `document`'s
            <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global
            object</a>, using [`HashChangeEvent`](#hashchangeevent),
            with the [`oldURL`](#dom-hashchangeevent-oldurl) attribute
            initialized to the
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-url-serializer"
            data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a>
            of `oldURL` and the [`newURL`](#dom-hashchangeevent-newurl)
            attribute initialized to the
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
            id="updating-the-document:concept-url-serializer-2"
            data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a>
            of `entry`'s
            <a href="#she-url" id="updating-the-document:she-url-3">URL</a>.

    5.  Otherwise:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="updating-the-document:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `entriesForNavigationAPI` is given.

        2.  <a href="#restore-persisted-state"
            id="updating-the-document:restore-persisted-state-2">Restore persisted
            state</a> given `entry`.

        3.  <a href="#initialize-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-new-document"
            id="updating-the-document:initialize-the-navigation-api-entries-for-a-new-document">Initialize
            the navigation API entries for a new document</a> given
            `navigation`, `entriesForNavigationAPI`, and `entry`.

7.  If all the following are true:

    - `previousEntryForActivation` is given;

    - `navigationType` is non-null; and

    - `navigationType` is "[`reload`](#dom-navigationtype-reload)" or
      `previousEntryForActivation`'s <a href="#she-document"
      id="updating-the-document:she-document">document</a> is not
      `document`,

    then:

    1.  If `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-activation"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-activation">activation</a>
        is null, then set `navigation`'s
        <a href="#navigation-activation"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-activation-2">activation</a>
        to a new [`NavigationActivation`](#navigationactivation) object
        in `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-realm">relevant realm</a>.

    2.  Let `previousEntryIndex` be the result of
        <a href="#getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index"
        id="updating-the-document:getting-the-navigation-api-entry-index">getting
        the navigation API entry index</a> of
        `previousEntryForActivation` within `navigation`.

    3.  If `previousEntryIndex` is non-negative, then set `activation`'s
        <a href="#nav-activation-old-entry"
        id="updating-the-document:nav-activation-old-entry">old entry</a>
        to `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-entry-list"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-entry-list">entry list</a>\[`previousEntryIndex`\].

    4.  Otherwise, if all the following are true:

        - `navigationType` is
          "[`replace`](#dom-navigationtype-replace)";

        - `previousEntryForActivation`'s <a href="#she-document-state"
          id="updating-the-document:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
          <a href="#document-state-origin"
          id="updating-the-document:document-state-origin">origin</a> is
          <a href="#same-origin" id="updating-the-document:same-origin">same
          origin</a> with `document`'s
          <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
          id="updating-the-document:concept-document-origin"
          data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>; and

        - `previousEntryForActivation`'s <a href="#she-document"
          id="updating-the-document:she-document-2">document</a>'s
          <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
          id="updating-the-document:is-initial-about:blank">initial
          <code>about:blank</code></a> is false,

        then set `activation`'s <a href="#nav-activation-old-entry"
        id="updating-the-document:nav-activation-old-entry-2">old entry</a>
        to a new [`NavigationHistoryEntry`](#navigationhistoryentry) in
        `navigation`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-realm-2">relevant realm</a>,
        whose
        <a href="#nhe-she" id="updating-the-document:nhe-she">session history
        entry</a> is `previousEntryForActivation`.

    5.  Set `activation`'s <a href="#nav-activation-new-entry"
        id="updating-the-document:nav-activation-new-entry">new entry</a>
        to `navigation`'s <a href="#navigation-current-entry"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-current-entry">current entry</a>.

    6.  Set `activation`'s <a href="#nav-activation-navigation-type"
        id="updating-the-document:nav-activation-navigation-type">navigation
        type</a> to `navigationType`.

8.  If `documentIsNew` is true, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-document:assert-3" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-document-navigation-id">during-loading
        navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</a> is not null.

    2.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-committed"
        id="updating-the-document:webdriver-bidi-navigation-committed"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-committed">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation committed</a> with `navigable` and a new <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        id="updating-the-document:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation status</a> whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-status-id"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `document`'s
        <a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-document-navigation-id-2">during-loading
        navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</a>,
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-status-status"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-committed"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-committed"><code
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-status-committed">committed</code></a>",
        and
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
        id="updating-the-document:navigation-status-url"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `document`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
        id="updating-the-document:the-document&#39;s-address"
        data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

    3.  <a href="#try-to-scroll-to-the-fragment"
        id="updating-the-document:try-to-scroll-to-the-fragment">Try to scroll
        to the fragment</a> for `document`.

    4.  At this point
        <span id="scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document"
        class="dfn">scripts may run for the newly-created
        document</span> `document`.

9.  Otherwise, if `documentsEntryChanged` is false and `doNotReactivate`
    is false, then:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-document:assert-4" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `entriesForNavigationAPI` is given.

    2.  <a href="#reactivate-a-document"
        id="updating-the-document:reactivate-a-document">Reactivate</a>
        `document` given `entry` and `entriesForNavigationAPI`.

    `documentsEntryChanged` can be false for one of two reasons: either
    we are restoring from [bfcache](#note-bfcache), or we are
    asynchronously finishing up a synchronous navigation which already
    synchronously set `document`'s
    <a href="#latest-entry" id="updating-the-document:latest-entry-6">latest
    entry</a>. The `doNotReactivate` argument distinguishes between
    these two cases.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="restore-the-history-object-state" class="dfn">restore the
history object state</span> given [`Document`](#document) `document` and
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry-4">session history
entry</a> `entry`:

1.  Let `targetRealm` be `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-realm"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-realm-3">relevant realm</a>.

2.  Let `state` be <a href="#structureddeserialize"
    id="updating-the-document:structureddeserialize">StructuredDeserialize</a>(`entry`'s
    <a href="#she-classic-history-api-state"
    id="updating-the-document:she-classic-history-api-state">classic history
    API state</a>, `targetRealm`). If this throws an exception, catch it
    and let `state` be null.

3.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#doc-history" id="updating-the-document:doc-history-4">history
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-history-state"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-history-state-2">state</a> to
    `state`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="make-active" class="dfn">make active</span> a
[`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  Let `window` be `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant global
    object</a>.

2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>'s
    [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy)'s
    <a href="#concept-windowproxy-window"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-windowproxy-window">[[Window]]</a>
    internal slot value to `window`.

3.  Set `window`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="updating-the-document:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-environment-execution-ready-flag"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-environment-execution-ready-flag">execution
    ready flag</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="reactivate-a-document" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
export="">reactivate</span> a [`Document`](#document) `document` given a
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry-5">session history
entry</a> `reactivatedEntry` and a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="updating-the-document:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<a href="#session-history-entry"
id="updating-the-document:session-history-entry-6">session history
entries</a> `entriesForNavigationAPI`:

This algorithm updates `document` after it has come out of
[bfcache](#note-bfcache), i.e., after it has been made
<a href="#fully-active" id="updating-the-document:fully-active">fully
active</a> again. Other specifications that want to watch for this
change to the
<a href="#fully-active" id="updating-the-document:fully-active-2">fully
active</a> state are encouraged to add steps into this algorithm, so
that the ordering of events that happen in effect of the change is
clear.

1.  <div id="history-autocomplete">

    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-document:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `formControl` of form
    controls in `document` with an <a href="#autofill-field-name"
    id="updating-the-document:autofill-field-name">autofill field name</a>
    of "[`off`](#attr-fe-autocomplete-off)", invoke the
    <a href="#concept-form-reset-control"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-form-reset-control">reset
    algorithm</a> for `formControl`.

    </div>

2.  If `document`'s <a href="#suspended-timer-handles"
    id="updating-the-document:suspended-timer-handles">suspended timer
    handles</a> is not
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
    id="updating-the-document:list-is-empty"
    data-x-internal="list-is-empty">empty</a>:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="updating-the-document:assert-5" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `document`'s <a href="#suspension-time"
        id="updating-the-document:suspension-time">suspension time</a>
        is not zero.

    2.  Let `suspendDuration` be the <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time"
        id="updating-the-document:current-high-resolution-time"
        data-x-internal="current-high-resolution-time">current high resolution
        time</a> minus `document`'s <a href="#suspension-time"
        id="updating-the-document:suspension-time-2">suspension time</a>.

    3.  Let `activeTimers` be `document`'s
        <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-6">relevant global
        object</a>'s <a href="#map-of-active-timers"
        id="updating-the-document:map-of-active-timers">map of active timers</a>.

    4.  For each `handle` in `document`'s
        <a href="#suspended-timer-handles"
        id="updating-the-document:suspended-timer-handles-2">suspended timer
        handles</a>, if `activeTimers`\[`handle`\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="updating-the-document:map-exists"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then increase
        `activeTimers`\[`handle`\] by `suspendDuration`.

3.  <a href="#update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-reactivation"
    id="updating-the-document:update-the-navigation-api-entries-for-reactivation">Update
    the navigation API entries for reactivation</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="updating-the-document:window-navigation-api-2">navigation API</a>,
    `entriesForNavigationAPI`, and `reactivatedEntry`.

4.  If `document`'s <a href="#current-document-readiness"
    id="updating-the-document:current-document-readiness">current document
    readiness</a> is "`complete`", and `document`'s
    <a href="#page-showing" id="updating-the-document:page-showing">page
    showing</a> is false:

    1.  Set `document`'s
        <a href="#page-showing" id="updating-the-document:page-showing-2">page
        showing</a> to true.

    2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#has-been-revealed"
        id="updating-the-document:has-been-revealed">has been revealed</a>
        to false.

    3.  <a href="#update-the-visibility-state"
        id="updating-the-document:update-the-visibility-state">Update the
        visibility state</a> of `document` to "`visible`".

    4.  <a href="#fire-a-page-transition-event"
        id="updating-the-document:fire-a-page-transition-event">Fire a page
        transition event</a> named [`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) at
        `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-8">relevant global
        object</a> with true.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="try-to-scroll-to-the-fragment" class="dfn">try to scroll to
the fragment</span> for a [`Document`](#document) `document`, perform
the following steps
<a href="#in-parallel" id="updating-the-document:in-parallel">in
parallel</a>:

1.  Wait for an
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
    id="updating-the-document:implementation-defined"
    data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
    amount of time. (This is intended to allow the user agent to
    optimize the user experience in the face of performance concerns.)

2.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="updating-the-document:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="updating-the-document:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-relevant-global-9">relevant global
    object</a> to run these steps:

    1.  If `document` has no parser, or its parser has
        <a href="#stop-parsing" id="updating-the-document:stop-parsing">stopped
        parsing</a>, or the user agent has reason to believe the user is
        no longer interested in scrolling to the
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-url-fragment-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>, then abort
        these steps.

    2.  <a href="#scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier"
        id="updating-the-document:scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier">Scroll to
        the fragment</a> given `document`.

    3.  If `document`'s <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
        id="updating-the-document:the-indicated-part-of-the-document">indicated
        part</a> is still null, then
        <a href="#try-to-scroll-to-the-fragment"
        id="updating-the-document:try-to-scroll-to-the-fragment-2">try to scroll
        to the fragment</a> for `document`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="make-document-unsalvageable" class="dfn" export="">make
document unsalvageable</span>, given a [`Document`](#document)
`document` and a string `reason`:

1.  Let `details` be a new <a href="#nrr-details-struct"
    id="updating-the-document:nrr-details-struct">not restored reason
    details</a> whose <a href="#nrr-details-reason"
    id="updating-the-document:nrr-details-reason">reason</a> is
    `reason`.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
    id="updating-the-document:set-append"
    data-x-internal="set-append">Append</a> `details` to `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details">bfcache
    blocking details</a>.

3.  Set `document`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
    state to false.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="build-not-restored-reasons-for-document-state"
class="dfn">build not restored reasons for document state</span> given
[`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  Let `notRestoredReasonsForDocument` be a new
    <a href="#nrr-struct" id="updating-the-document:nrr-struct">not restored
    reasons</a>.

2.  Set `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s
    <a href="#nrr-url" id="updating-the-document:nrr-url">URL</a> to
    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="updating-the-document:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

3.  Let `container` be `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="updating-the-document:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="updating-the-document:nav-container">container</a>.

4.  If `container` is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element:

    1.  Let `src` be the empty string.

    2.  If `container` has a [`src`](#dom-iframe-src) attribute:

        1.  Let `src` be the result of
            <a href="#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url"
            id="updating-the-document:encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url">encoding-parsing-and-serializing
            a URL</a> given `container`'s [`src`](#attr-iframe-src)
            attribute's value, relative to `container`'s
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
            id="updating-the-document:node-document"
            data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

        2.  If `src` is failure, then set `src` to `container`'s
            [`src`](#attr-iframe-src) attribute's value.

    3.  Set `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s
        <a href="#nrr-src" id="updating-the-document:nrr-src">src</a> to
        `src`.

    4.  Set `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s
        <a href="#nrr-id" id="updating-the-document:nrr-id">id</a> to
        `container`'s [`id`](#the-id-attribute) attribute's value, or
        the empty string if it has no such attribute.

    5.  Set `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s
        <a href="#nrr-name" id="updating-the-document:nrr-name">name</a>
        to `container`'s [`name`](#attr-iframe-name) attribute's value,
        or the empty string if it has no such attribute.

5.  Set `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s <a href="#nrr-reasons"
    id="updating-the-document:nrr-reasons">reasons</a> to a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone"
    id="updating-the-document:list-clone"
    data-x-internal="list-clone">clone</a> of `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details"
    id="updating-the-document:concept-document-bfcache-blocking-details-2">bfcache
    blocking details</a>.

6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-document:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `navigable` of
    `document`'s <a href="#document-tree-child-navigables"
    id="updating-the-document:document-tree-child-navigables">document-tree
    child navigables</a>:

    1.  Let `childDocument` be `navigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document">active
        document</a>.

    2.  <a href="#build-not-restored-reasons-for-document-state"
        id="updating-the-document:build-not-restored-reasons-for-document-state">Build
        not restored reasons for document state</a> given
        `childDocument`.

    3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="updating-the-document:list-append"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `childDocument`'s
        <a href="#concept-document-nrr"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-document-nrr">not restored reasons</a>
        to `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`'s <a href="#nrr-children"
        id="updating-the-document:nrr-children">children</a>.

7.  Set `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="updating-the-document:node-navigable-2">node navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="updating-the-document:nav-active-history-entry">active session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="updating-the-document:she-document-state-2">document state</a>'s
    <a href="#document-state-not-restored-reasons"
    id="updating-the-document:document-state-not-restored-reasons">not
    restored reasons</a> to `notRestoredReasonsForDocument`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To
<span id="build-not-restored-reasons-for-a-top-level-traversable-and-its-descendants"
class="dfn">build not restored reasons for a top-level traversable and
its descendants</span> given <a href="#top-level-traversable"
id="updating-the-document:top-level-traversable">top-level
traversable</a> `topLevelTraversable`:

1.  <a href="#build-not-restored-reasons-for-document-state"
    id="updating-the-document:build-not-restored-reasons-for-document-state-2">Build
    not restored reasons for document state</a> given
    `topLevelTraversable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-2">active
    document</a>.

2.  Let `crossOriginDescendants` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="updating-the-document:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-document:list-iterate-3"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `childNavigable` of
    `topLevelTraversable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-3">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#descendant-navigables"
    id="updating-the-document:descendant-navigables">descendant
    navigables</a>:

    1.  If `childNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-4">active
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-document-origin-2"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
        <a href="#same-origin" id="updating-the-document:same-origin-2">same
        origin</a> with `topLevelTraversable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-5">active
        document</a>'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
        id="updating-the-document:concept-document-origin-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="updating-the-document:list-append-2"
        data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `childNavigable` to
        `crossOriginDescendants`.

4.  Let `crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache` be false.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="updating-the-document:list-iterate-4"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `crossOriginNavigable`
    of `crossOriginDescendants`:

    1.  Let `reasonsForCrossOriginChild` be `crossOriginNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-6">active
        document</a>'s <a href="#document-state-2"
        id="updating-the-document:document-state-2">document state</a>'s
        <a href="#document-state-not-restored-reasons"
        id="updating-the-document:document-state-not-restored-reasons-2">not
        restored reasons</a>.

    2.  If `reasonsForCrossOriginChild`'s <a href="#nrr-reasons"
        id="updating-the-document:nrr-reasons-2">reasons</a> is not
        empty, set `crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache` to true.

    3.  Set `reasonsForCrossOriginChild`'s
        <a href="#nrr-url" id="updating-the-document:nrr-url-2">URL</a>
        to null.

    4.  Set `reasonsForCrossOriginChild`'s <a href="#nrr-reasons"
        id="updating-the-document:nrr-reasons-3">reasons</a> to null.

    5.  Set `reasonsForCrossOriginChild`'s <a href="#nrr-children"
        id="updating-the-document:nrr-children-2">children</a> to null.

6.  If `crossOriginDescendantsPreventsBfcache` is true,
    <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
    id="updating-the-document:make-document-unsalvageable">make document
    unsalvageable</a> given `topLevelTraversable`'s
    <a href="#nav-document" id="updating-the-document:nav-document-7">active
    document</a> and "[`masked`](#blocking-masked)".

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.6.3</span> Revealing the document<a href="#revealing-the-document" class="self-link"></a>

A [`Document`](#document) has a boolean <span id="has-been-revealed"
class="dfn">has been revealed</span>, initially false. It is used to
ensure that the [`pagereveal`](#event-pagereveal) event is fired once
for each activation of the [`Document`](#document) (once when it's
rendered initially, and once for each <a href="#reactivate-a-document"
id="revealing-the-document:reactivate-a-document">reactivation</a>).

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="reveal" class="dfn">reveal</span> a [`Document`](#document)
`document`:

1.  If `document`'s <a href="#has-been-revealed"
    id="revealing-the-document:has-been-revealed">has been revealed</a>
    is true, then return.

2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#has-been-revealed"
    id="revealing-the-document:has-been-revealed-2">has been revealed</a>
    to true.

3.  Let `transition` be the result of <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions-2/#resolve-inbound-cross-document-view-transition"
    id="revealing-the-document:resolving-inbound-cross-document-view-transition"
    data-x-internal="resolving-inbound-cross-document-view-transition">resolving
    inbound cross-document view-transition</a> for `document`.

4.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="revealing-the-document:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">Fire an event</a> named
    [`pagereveal`](#event-pagereveal) at `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="revealing-the-document:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>, using [`PageRevealEvent`](#pagerevealevent) with its
    [`viewTransition`](#dom-pagerevealevent-viewtransition) set to
    `transition`.

5.  If `transition` is not null, then:

    1.  <a href="#prepare-to-run-script"
        id="revealing-the-document:prepare-to-run-script">Prepare to run
        script</a> given `document`'s
        <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="revealing-the-document:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
        object</a>.

    2.  <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-view-transitions/#activate-view-transition"
        id="revealing-the-document:activate-view-transition"
        data-x-internal="activate-view-transition">Activate</a>
        `transition`.

    3.  <a href="#clean-up-after-running-script"
        id="revealing-the-document:clean-up-after-running-script">Clean up after
        running script</a> given `document`'s
        <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
        id="revealing-the-document:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant settings
        object</a>.

    Activating a view transition might resolve/reject promises, so by
    wrapping the activation with prepare/cleanup we ensure those
    promises are handled before the next rendering step.

</div>

Though [`pagereveal`](#event-pagereveal) is guaranteed to be fired
during the first <a href="#update-the-rendering"
id="revealing-the-document:update-the-rendering">update the
rendering</a> step that displays an up-to-date version of the page, user
agents are free to display a cached frame of the page before firing it.
This prevents the presence of a [`pagereveal`](#event-pagereveal)
handler from delaying the presentation of such cached frame.

##### <span class="secno">7.4.6.4</span> Scrolling to a fragment<a href="#scrolling-to-a-fragment" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="scroll-to-the-fragment-identifier" class="dfn">scroll to
the fragment</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  If `document`'s <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-indicated-part-of-the-document">indicated
    part</a> is null, then set `document`'s <a href="#target-element"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:target-element">target element</a> to
    null.

2.  Otherwise, if `document`'s
    <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-indicated-part-of-the-document-2">indicated
    part</a> is <a href="#top-of-the-document"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:top-of-the-document">top of the document</a>,
    then:

    1.  Set `document`'s <a href="#target-element"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:target-element-2">target element</a>
        to null.

    2.  <a
        href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document"
        data-x-internal="scroll-to-the-beginning-of-the-document">Scroll to the
        beginning of the document</a> for `document`.
        [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#refsCSSOMVIEW)

    3.  Return.

3.  Otherwise:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `document`'s <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-indicated-part-of-the-document-3">indicated
        part</a> is an element.

    2.  Let `target` be `document`'s
        <a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-indicated-part-of-the-document-4">indicated
        part</a>.

    3.  Set `document`'s <a href="#target-element"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:target-element-3">target element</a>
        to `target`.

    4.  Run the <a href="#ancestor-revealing-algorithm"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:ancestor-revealing-algorithm">ancestor
        revealing algorithm</a> on `target`.

    5.  <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view/#scroll-a-target-into-view"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:scroll-a-target-into-view"
        data-x-internal="scroll-a-target-into-view">Scroll <var>target</var>
        into view</a>, with *behavior* set to "auto", *block* set to
        "start", and *inline* set to "nearest".
        [\[CSSOMVIEW\]](#refsCSSOMVIEW)

    6.  Run the <a href="#focusing-steps"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:focusing-steps">focusing steps</a>
        for `target`, with the [`Document`](#document)'s
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:viewport"
        data-x-internal="viewport">viewport</a> as the *fallback
        target*.

    7.  Move the <a href="#sequential-focus-navigation-starting-point"
        id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:sequential-focus-navigation-starting-point">sequential
        focus navigation starting point</a> to `target`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A [`Document`](#document)'s
<span id="the-indicated-part-of-the-document" class="dfn">indicated
part</span> is the one that its
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>'s
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-url-fragment"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> identifies, or null
if the fragment does not identify anything. The semantics of the
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-url-fragment-2"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> in terms of mapping
it to a node is defined by the specification that defines the
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:mime-type" data-x-internal="mime-type">MIME
type</a> used by the [`Document`](#document) (for example, the
processing of
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-url-fragment-3"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragments</a> for
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-mime-type"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:xml-mime-type"
data-x-internal="xml-mime-type">XML MIME types</a> is the responsibility
of RFC7303). [\[RFC7303\]](#refsRFC7303)

</div>

There is also a <span id="target-element" class="dfn">target
element</span> for each [`Document`](#document), which is used in
defining the [`:target`](#selector-target) pseudo-class and is updated
by the above algorithm. It is initially null.

<div algorithm="">

For an <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:html-documents"
data-x-internal="html-documents">HTML document</a> `document`, its
<a href="#the-indicated-part-of-the-document"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-indicated-part-of-the-document-5">indicated
part</a> is the result of <a href="#select-the-indicated-part"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:select-the-indicated-part">selecting the
indicated part</a> given `document` and `document`'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="select-the-indicated-part" class="dfn">select the indicated
part</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `document` and a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`:

1.  If `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:the-document&#39;s-address-3"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> does not
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-url-equals"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-equals">equal</a> `url` with
    *<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-equals-exclude-fragments"
    data-x-internal="url-equals-exclude-fragments">exclude fragments</a>*
    set to true, then return null.

2.  Let `fragment` be `url`'s
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-url-fragment-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>.

3.  If `fragment` is the empty string, then return the special value
    <span id="top-of-the-document" class="dfn">top of the
    document</span>.

4.  Let `potentialIndicatedElement` be the result of
    <a href="#find-a-potential-indicated-element"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:find-a-potential-indicated-element">finding
    a potential indicated element</a> given `document` and `fragment`.

5.  If `potentialIndicatedElement` is not null, then return
    `potentialIndicatedElement`.

6.  Let `fragmentBytes` be the result of
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-percent-decode"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:percent-decode"
    data-x-internal="percent-decode">percent-decoding</a> `fragment`.

7.  Let `decodedFragment` be the result of running
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode-without-bom"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:utf-8-decode-without-bom"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-decode-without-bom">UTF-8 decode without BOM</a>
    on `fragmentBytes`.

8.  Set `potentialIndicatedElement` to the result of
    <a href="#find-a-potential-indicated-element"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:find-a-potential-indicated-element-2">finding
    a potential indicated element</a> given `document` and
    `decodedFragment`.

9.  If `potentialIndicatedElement` is not null, then return
    `potentialIndicatedElement`.

10. If `decodedFragment` is an
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:ascii-case-insensitive"
    data-x-internal="ascii-case-insensitive">ASCII case-insensitive</a>
    match for the string `top`, then return the
    <a href="#top-of-the-document"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:top-of-the-document-2">top of the
    document</a>.

11. Return null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="find-a-potential-indicated-element" class="dfn">find a
potential indicated element</span> given a [`Document`](#document)
`document` and a string `fragment`, run these steps:

1.  If there is an element
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:in-a-document-tree"
    data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in the document tree</a> whose
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:root" data-x-internal="root">root</a> is
    `document` and that has an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:concept-id"
    data-x-internal="concept-id">ID</a> equal to `fragment`, then return
    the first such element in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:tree-order"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

2.  If there is an [`a`](#the-a-element) element
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#in-a-document-tree"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:in-a-document-tree-2"
    data-x-internal="in-a-document-tree">in the document tree</a> whose
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:root-2" data-x-internal="root">root</a>
    is `document` that has a [`name`](#attr-a-name) attribute whose
    value is equal to `fragment`, then return the first such element in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="scrolling-to-a-fragment:tree-order-2"
    data-x-internal="tree-order">tree order</a>.

3.  Return null.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.4.6.5</span> Persisted history entry state<a href="#persisted-user-state-restoration" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="save-persisted-state" class="dfn">save persisted
state</span> to a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:session-history-entry">session
history entry</a> `entry`:

1.  Set the <a href="#she-scroll-position"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-scroll-position">scroll
    position data</a> of `entry` to contain the scroll positions for all
    of `entry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-document">document</a>'s
    <a href="#restorable-scrollable-regions"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:restorable-scrollable-regions">restorable
    scrollable regions</a>.

2.  Optionally, update `entry`'s <a href="#she-other"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-other">persisted user state</a>
    to reflect any state that the user agent wishes to persist, such as
    the values of form fields.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="restore-persisted-state" class="dfn">restore persisted
state</span> from a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:session-history-entry-2">session
history entry</a> `entry`:

1.  If `entry`'s <a href="#she-scroll-restoration-mode"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-scroll-restoration-mode">scroll
    restoration mode</a> is "[`auto`](#dom-scrollrestoration-auto)", and
    `entry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-document-2">document</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:concept-relevant-global">relevant
    global object</a>'s <a href="#window-navigation-api"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:window-navigation-api">navigation
    API</a>'s
    <a href="#suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation">suppress
    normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation</a> is false,
    then <a href="#restore-scroll-position-data"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:restore-scroll-position-data">restore
    scroll position data</a> given `entry`.

    The user agent not restoring scroll positions does not imply that
    scroll positions will be left at any particular value (e.g., (0,0)).
    The actual scroll position depends on the navigation type and the
    user agent's particular caching strategy. So web applications cannot
    assume any particular scroll position but rather are urged to set it
    to what they want it to be.

    If
    <a href="#suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:suppress-normal-scroll-restoration-during-ongoing-navigation-2">suppress
    normal scroll restoration during ongoing navigation</a> is true,
    then <a href="#restore-scroll-position-data"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:restore-scroll-position-data-2">restoring
    scroll position data</a> might still happen at a later point, as
    part of <a href="#navigateevent-finish"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:navigateevent-finish">finishing</a>
    the relevant [`NavigateEvent`](#navigateevent), or via a
    [`navigateEvent.scroll()`](#dom-navigateevent-scroll) method call.

2.  Optionally, update other aspects of `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-document"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-document-3">document</a>
    and its rendering, for instance values of form fields, that the user
    agent had previously recorded in `entry`'s <a href="#she-other"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-other-2">persisted user
    state</a>.

    This can even include updating the [`dir`](#attr-dir) attribute of
    [`textarea`](#the-textarea-element) elements or
    [`input`](#the-input-element) elements whose
    [`type`](#attr-input-type) attribute is in the
    <a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)">Text</a>,
    <a href="#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)-2">Search</a>,
    <a href="#telephone-state-(type=tel)"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:telephone-state-(type=tel)">Telephone</a>,
    <a href="#url-state-(type=url)"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:url-state-(type=url)">URL</a>,
    or <a href="#email-state-(type=email)"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:email-state-(type=email)">Email</a>
    state, if the persisted state includes the directionality of user
    input in such controls.

    Restoring the value of form controls as part of this process does
    not fire any
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input"
    data-x-internal="event-input"><code
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:event-input">input</code></a>
    or [`change`](#event-change) events, but can trigger the
    `formStateRestoreCallback` of
    <a href="#form-associated-custom-element"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:form-associated-custom-element">form-associated
    custom elements</a>.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each [`Document`](#document) has a boolean
<span id="has-been-scrolled-by-the-user" class="dfn">has been scrolled
by the user</span>, initially false. If the user scrolls the document,
the user agent must set that document's
<a href="#has-been-scrolled-by-the-user"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:has-been-scrolled-by-the-user">has
been scrolled by the user</a> to true.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="restorable-scrollable-regions" class="dfn">restorable
scrollable regions</span> of a [`Document`](#document) `document` are
`document`'s <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css2/#viewport"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:viewport"
data-x-internal="viewport">viewport</a>, and all of `document`'s
scrollable regions excepting any <a href="#navigable-container"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:navigable-container">navigable
containers</a>.

</div>

<a href="#child-navigable"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:child-navigable">Child
navigable</a> scroll restoration is handled as part of state restoration
for the <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:session-history-entry-3">session
history entry</a> for those <a href="#navigable"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:navigable">navigables</a>'
[`Document`](#document)s.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="restore-scroll-position-data" class="dfn">restore scroll
position data</span> given a <a href="#session-history-entry"
id="persisted-user-state-restoration:session-history-entry-4">session
history entry</a> `entry`:

1.  Let `document` be `entry`'s <a href="#she-document"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-document-4">document</a>.

2.  If `document`'s <a href="#has-been-scrolled-by-the-user"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:has-been-scrolled-by-the-user-2">has
    been scrolled by the user</a> is true, then the user agent should
    return.

3.  The user agent should attempt to use `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-scroll-position"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-scroll-position-2">scroll
    position data</a> to restore the scroll positions of `entry`'s
    <a href="#she-document"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-document-5">document</a>'s
    <a href="#restorable-scrollable-regions"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:restorable-scrollable-regions-2">restorable
    scrollable regions</a>. The user agent may continue to attempt to do
    so periodically, until `document`'s
    <a href="#has-been-scrolled-by-the-user"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:has-been-scrolled-by-the-user-3">has
    been scrolled by the user</a> becomes true.

    This is formulated as an *attempt*, which is potentially repeated
    until success or until the user scrolls, due to the fact that
    relevant content indicated by the <a href="#she-scroll-position"
    id="persisted-user-state-restoration:she-scroll-position-3">scroll
    position data</a> might take some time to load from the network.

    Scroll restoration might be affected by scroll anchoring.
    [\[CSSSCROLLANCHORING\]](#refsCSSSCROLLANCHORING)

</div>

### <span class="secno">7.5</span> Document lifecycle<a href="#document-lifecycle" class="self-link"></a>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.1</span> Shared document creation infrastructure<a href="#shared-document-creation-infrastructure"
class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When loading a document using one of the below algorithms, we use the
following steps to <span id="initialise-the-document-object"
class="dfn">create and initialize a `Document` object</span>, given a
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-type"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-type"
data-x-internal="concept-document-type">type</a> `type`,
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-content-type"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-content-type"
data-x-internal="concept-document-content-type">content type</a>
`contentType`, and <a href="#navigation-params"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams`:

[`Document`](#document) objects are also created when
<a href="#creating-a-new-browsing-context"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:creating-a-new-browsing-context">creating
a new browsing context and document</a>; such
<a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:is-initial-about:blank">initial
<code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document) are never created
by this algorithm. Also, <a href="#concept-document-bc"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-bc">browsing
context</a>-less [`Document`](#document) objects can be created via
various APIs, such as <a
href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-domimplementation-createhtmldocument"
data-x-internal="dom-domimplementation-createhtmldocument"><code
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:dom-domimplementation-createhtmldocument">document.implementation.createHTMLDocument()</code></a>.

1.  Let `browsingContext` be the result of
    <a href="#obtain-browsing-context-navigation"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:obtain-browsing-context-navigation">obtaining
    a browsing context to use for a navigation response</a> given
    `navigationParams`.

    This can result in a [browsing context group
    switch](#browsing-context-group-switches-due-to-cross-origin-opener-policy),
    in which case `browsingContext` will be a
    <a href="#creating-a-new-browsing-context"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:creating-a-new-browsing-context-2">newly-created</a>
    <a href="#browsing-context"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:browsing-context">browsing
    context</a> instead of being `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-navigable">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-bc"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:nav-bc">active browsing
    context</a>. In such a case, the created [`Window`](#window),
    [`Document`](#document), and
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-agents"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:agent"
    data-x-internal="agent">agent</a> will not end up being used;
    because the created [`Document`](#document)'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
    <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-origin-opaque">opaque</a>,
    we will end up creating a new
    <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-agents"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:agent-2"
    data-x-internal="agent">agent</a> and [`Window`](#window) [later in
    this algorithm](#create-new-agent-and-window) to go along with the
    new [`Document`](#document).

2.  Let `permissionsPolicy` be the result of <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#create-from-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:creating-a-permissions-policy-from-a-response"
    data-x-internal="creating-a-permissions-policy-from-a-response">creating
    a permissions policy from a response</a> given `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-navigable-2">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-container"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:nav-container">container</a>,
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-origin">origin</a>,
    and `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response">response</a>.
    [\[PERMISSIONSPOLICY\]](#refsPERMISSIONSPOLICY)

    <div class="note">

    The <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-feature-policy/#create-from-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:creating-a-permissions-policy-from-a-response-2"
    data-x-internal="creating-a-permissions-policy-from-a-response">creating
    a permissions policy from a response</a> algorithm makes use of the
    passed <a href="#concept-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-origin">origin</a>.
    If [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) has been used for
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-navigable-3">navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-container-document"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:nav-container-document">container
    document</a>, then its
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> cannot be
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-domain">same
    origin-domain</a> with the passed origin, because these steps run
    before the `document` is created, so it cannot itself yet have used
    [`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain). Note that this means that
    Permissions Policy checks are less permissive compared to doing a
    <a href="#same-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin">same origin</a>
    check instead.

    See below for some examples of this in action.

    </div>

3.  Let `creationURL` be `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response-2">response</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-response-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>.

4.  If `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-request">request</a>
    is non-null, then set `creationURL` to `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-request-2">request</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-current-url"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-request-current-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-current-url">current URL</a>.

5.  Let `window` be null.

6.  If `browsingContext`'s <a href="#active-document"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:active-document">active
    document</a>'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:is-initial-about:blank-2">is
    initial <code>about:blank</code></a> is true, and
    `browsingContext`'s <a href="#active-document"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:active-document-2">active
    document</a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-document-origin-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
    <a href="#same-origin-domain"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-domain-2">same
    origin-domain</a> with `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-origin-2">origin</a>,
    then set `window` to `browsingContext`'s <a href="#active-window"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:active-window">active
    window</a>.

    This means that both the <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:is-initial-about:blank-3">initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document), and the new
    [`Document`](#document) that is about to be created, will share the
    same [`Window`](#window) object.

7.  <div id="create-new-agent-and-window">

    Otherwise:

    1.  Let `oacHeader` be the result of <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-get-structured-header"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:getting-a-structured-field-value"
        data-x-internal="getting-a-structured-field-value">getting a structured
        field value</a> given
        \`[`Origin-Agent-Cluster`](#origin-agent-cluster)\` and "`item`"
        from `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response-3">response</a>'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-response-header-list"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

    2.  Let `requestsOAC` be true if `oacHeader` is not null and
        `oacHeader`\[0\] is the
        <a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc8941.html#boolean"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:http-structured-header-boolean"
        data-x-internal="http-structured-header-boolean">boolean</a>
        true; otherwise false.

    3.  If `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-reserved-environment">reserved
        environment</a> is a <a href="#non-secure-context"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:non-secure-context">non-secure
        context</a>, then set `requestsOAC` to false.

    4.  Let `agent` be the result of
        <a href="#obtain-similar-origin-window-agent"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:obtain-similar-origin-window-agent">obtaining
        a similar-origin window agent</a> given `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-origin-3">origin</a>,
        `browsingContext`'s <a href="#tlbc-group"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:tlbc-group">group</a>,
        and `requestsOAC`.

    5.  Let `realmExecutionContext` be the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-new-javascript-realm"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:creating-a-new-javascript-realm">creating
        a new realm</a> given `agent` and the following customizations:

        - For the global object, create a new [`Window`](#window)
          object.

        - For the global **this** binding, use `browsingContext`'s
          [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) object.

    6.  Set `window` to the <a href="#concept-realm-global"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-realm-global">global
        object</a> of `realmExecutionContext`'s Realm component.

    7.  Let `topLevelCreationURL` be `creationURL`.

    8.  Let `topLevelOrigin` be `navigationParams`'s
        <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-origin-4">origin</a>.

    9.  If `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-container"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:nav-container-2">container</a>
        is not null, then:

        1.  Let `parentEnvironment` be `navigable`'s
            <a href="#nav-container"

            <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
            id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:relevant-settings-object">relevant
            settings object</a>.

        2.  Set `topLevelCreationURL` to `parentEnvironment`'s
            <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-creation-url"
            id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-environment-top-level-creation-url">top-level
            creation URL</a>.

        3.  Set `topLevelOrigin` to `parentEnvironment`'s
            <a href="#concept-environment-top-level-origin"
            id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:concept-environment-top-level-origin">top-level
            origin</a>.

    10. <a href="#set-up-a-window-environment-settings-object"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:set-up-a-window-environment-settings-object">Set

        <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-reserved-environment-2">reserved
        environment</a>, `topLevelCreationURL`, and `topLevelOrigin`.

    This is the usual case, where the new [`Document`](#document) we're
    about to create gets a new [`Window`](#window) to go along with it.

    </div>

8.  Let `loadTimingInfo` be a new <a href="#document-load-timing-info"

        <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"

    2.  Let `redirectCount` be 0 if `navigationParams`'s

16. <a

    <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"

17. If `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response-11">response</a>

    1.  Let `value` be the
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#isomorphic-decode"
        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:isomorphic-decode"
        data-x-internal="isomorphic-decode">isomorphic decoding</a> of

        id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:shared-declarative-refresh-steps">shared

    We do not currently have a spec for how to handle multiple

    \#2900](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/2900).

18. If `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-commit-early-hints">commit
    early hints</a> is not null, then call `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-commit-early-hints-2">commit
    early hints</a> with `document`.

19. <a href="#process-link-headers"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:process-link-headers">Process
    link headers</a> given `document`, `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response-12">response</a>,
    and "`pre-media`".

20. If `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-navigable-4">navigable</a>
    is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:top-level-traversable">top-level
    traversable</a>, then
    <a href="#process-the-speculation-rules-header"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:process-the-speculation-rules-header">process
    the `<code>Speculation-Rules</code>` header</a> given `document` and
    `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:navigation-params-response-13">response</a>.

    This is conditional because [speculative loads are only considered

21. <a

    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:potentially-free-deferred-fetch-quota"

22. Return `document`.

<div class="example">

In this example, the child document is not allowed to use
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/payment-request/#dom-paymentrequest"
data-x-internal="paymentrequest"><code
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:paymentrequest">PaymentRequest</code></a>,
despite being <a href="#same-origin-domain"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-domain-3">same
origin-domain</a> at the time the child document tries to use it. At the
time the child document is initialized, only the parent document has set
[`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain), and the child document has
not.

``` html
<!-- https://foo.example.com/a.html -->
<!doctype html>
<script>
document.domain = 'example.com';
</script>
<iframe src=b.html></iframe>
```

``` html
<!-- https://bar.example.com/b.html -->
<!doctype html>
<script>
document.domain = 'example.com'; // This happens after the document is initialized
new PaymentRequest(…); // Not allowed to use
</script>
```

</div>

<div class="example">

In this example, the child document *is* allowed to use
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/payment-request/#dom-paymentrequest"
data-x-internal="paymentrequest"><code
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:paymentrequest-2">PaymentRequest</code></a>,
despite not being <a href="#same-origin-domain"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-domain-4">same
origin-domain</a> at the time the child document tries to use it. At the
time the child document is initialized, none of the documents have set
[`document.domain`](#dom-document-domain) yet so
<a href="#same-origin-domain"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-domain-5">same
origin-domain</a> falls back to a normal <a href="#same-origin"
id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:same-origin-2">same
origin</a> check.

``` html
<!-- https://example.com/a.html -->
<!doctype html>
<iframe src=b.html></iframe>
<!-- The child document is now initialized, before the script below is run. -->
<script>
document.domain = 'example.com';
</script>
```

``` html
<!-- https://example.com/b.html -->
<!doctype html>
<script>
new PaymentRequest(…); // Allowed to use
</script>
```

</div>

<div algorithm="">

`html`/`head`/`body`</span> given a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:create-an-element"

2.  Let `head` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:create-an-element-2"
    data-x-internal="create-an-element">creating an element</a> given

    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:html-namespace-2-2"
    data-x-internal="html-namespace-2">HTML namespace</a>.

3.  Let `body` be the result of
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:create-an-element-3"
    data-x-internal="create-an-element">creating an element</a> given
    `document`, "`body`", and the
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace"
    id="shared-document-creation-infrastructure:html-namespace-2-3"
    data-x-internal="html-namespace-2">HTML namespace</a>.

4.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append"

    data-x-internal="concept-node-append">Append</a> `html` to
