#### <span class="secno">7.5.2</span> Loading HTML documents<a href="#read-html" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-html" class="dfn">load an HTML document</span>,
given
<a href="#navigation-params" id="read-html:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams`:

1.  Let `document` be the result of
    <a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
    id="read-html:initialise-the-document-object">creating and initializing
    a <code>Document</code> object</a> given "`html`", "`text/html`",
    and `navigationParams`.

2.  If `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="read-html:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> is
    [`about:blank`](#about:blank), then
    <a href="#populate-with-html/head/body"
    id="read-html:populate-with-html/head/body">populate with
    <code>html</code>/<code>head</code>/<code>body</code></a> given
    `document`.

    This special case, where even non-<a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="read-html:is-initial-about:blank">initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document)s are
    synchronously given their element nodes, is necessary for compatible
    with deployed content. In other words, it is not compatible to
    instead go down the "otherwise" branch and feed the empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="read-html:byte-sequence" data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte
    sequence</a> into an
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-html:html-parser">HTML parser</a> to
    asynchronously populate `document`.

3.  Otherwise, create an
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-html:html-parser-2">HTML parser</a>
    and associate it with the `document`. Each
    <a href="#concept-task" id="read-html:concept-task">task</a> that
    the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-html:networking-task-source">networking task source</a>
    places on the
    <a href="#task-queue" id="read-html:task-queue">task queue</a> while
    fetching runs must then fill the parser's
    <a href="#the-input-byte-stream"
    id="read-html:the-input-byte-stream">input byte stream</a> with the
    fetched bytes and cause the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-html:html-parser-3">HTML parser</a>
    to perform the appropriate processing of the input stream.

    The first
    <a href="#concept-task" id="read-html:concept-task-2">task</a> that
    the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-html:networking-task-source-2">networking task source</a>
    places on the
    <a href="#task-queue" id="read-html:task-queue-2">task queue</a>
    while fetching runs must <a href="#process-link-headers"
    id="read-html:process-link-headers">process link headers</a> given
    `document`, `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-html:navigation-params-response">response</a>, and
    "`media`", after the task has been processed by the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-html:html-parser-4">HTML parser</a>.

    Before any script execution occurs, the user agent must wait for
    <a href="#scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document"
    id="read-html:scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document">scripts
    may run for the newly-created document</a> to be true for
    `document`.

    The <a href="#the-input-byte-stream"
    id="read-html:the-input-byte-stream-2">input byte stream</a>
    converts bytes into characters for use in the
    <a href="#tokenization" id="read-html:tokenization">tokenizer</a>.
    This process relies, in part, on character encoding information
    found in the real
    <a href="#content-type" id="read-html:content-type">Content-Type
    metadata</a> of the resource; the computed type is not used for this
    purpose.

    When no more bytes are available, the user agent must
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task" id="read-html:queue-a-global-task">queue
    a global task</a> on the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-html:networking-task-source-3">networking task source</a>
    given `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="read-html:concept-relevant-global">relevant global object</a> to
    have the parser process the implied EOF character, which eventually
    causes a [`load`](#event-load) event to be fired.

4.  Return `document`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.3</span> <span class="dfn">Loading XML documents</span><a href="#read-xml" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When faced with displaying an XML file inline, provided
<a href="#navigation-params" id="read-xml:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams` and a string `type`, user agents must
follow the requirements defined in XML and Namespaces in XML, XML Media
Types, DOM, and other relevant specifications to
<a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
id="read-xml:initialise-the-document-object">create and initialize a
<code>Document</code> object</a> `document`, given "`xml`", `type`, and
`navigationParams`, and return that [`Document`](#document). They must
also create a corresponding
<a href="#xml-parser" id="read-xml:xml-parser">XML parser</a>.
[\[XML\]](#refsXML) [\[XMLNS\]](#refsXMLNS) [\[RFC7303\]](#refsRFC7303)
[\[DOM\]](#refsDOM)

At the time of writing, the XML specification community had not actually
yet specified how XML and the DOM interact.

The first <a href="#concept-task" id="read-xml:concept-task">task</a>
that the <a href="#networking-task-source"
id="read-xml:networking-task-source">networking task source</a> places
on the <a href="#task-queue" id="read-xml:task-queue">task queue</a>
while fetching runs must <a href="#process-link-headers"
id="read-xml:process-link-headers">process link headers</a> given
`document`, `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
id="read-xml:navigation-params-response">response</a>, and "`media`",
after the task has been processed by the
<a href="#xml-parser" id="read-xml:xml-parser-2">XML parser</a>.

The actual HTTP headers and other metadata, not the headers as mutated
or implied by the algorithms given in this specification, are the ones
that must be used when determining the character encoding according to
the rules given in the above specifications. Once the character encoding
is established, the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
id="read-xml:document&#39;s-character-encoding"
data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">document's character
encoding</a> must be set to that character encoding.

Before any script execution occurs, the user agent must wait for
<a href="#scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document"
id="read-xml:scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document">scripts may
run for the newly-created document</a> to be true for the newly-created
[`Document`](#document).

Once parsing is complete, the user agent must set `document`'s
<a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
id="read-xml:concept-document-navigation-id">during-loading navigation
ID for WebDriver BiDi</a> to null.

</div>

For HTML documents this is reset when parsing is complete, after firing
the load event.

Error messages from the parse process (e.g., XML namespace
well-formedness errors) may be reported inline by mutating the
[`Document`](#document).

#### <span class="secno">7.5.4</span> Loading text documents<a href="#read-text" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-text" class="dfn">load a text document</span>,
given a
<a href="#navigation-params" id="read-text:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams` and a string `type`:

1.  Let `document` be the result of
    <a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
    id="read-text:initialise-the-document-object">creating and initializing
    a <code>Document</code> object</a> given "`html`", `type`, and
    `navigationParams`.

2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#parser-cannot-change-the-mode-flag"
    id="read-text:parser-cannot-change-the-mode-flag">parser cannot change
    the mode flag</a> to true.

3.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-mode"
    id="read-text:concept-document-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-mode">mode</a> to "`no-quirks`".

4.  Create an
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-text:html-parser">HTML parser</a>
    and associate it with the `document`. Act as if the tokenizer had
    emitted a start tag token with the tag name "pre" followed by a
    single U+000A LINE FEED (LF) character, and switch the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-text:html-parser-2">HTML parser</a>'s
    tokenizer to the
    <a href="#plaintext-state" id="read-text:plaintext-state">PLAINTEXT
    state</a>. Each
    <a href="#concept-task" id="read-text:concept-task">task</a> that
    the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-text:networking-task-source">networking task source</a>
    places on the
    <a href="#task-queue" id="read-text:task-queue">task queue</a> while
    fetching runs must then fill the parser's
    <a href="#the-input-byte-stream"
    id="read-text:the-input-byte-stream">input byte stream</a> with the
    fetched bytes and cause the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-text:html-parser-3">HTML parser</a>
    to perform the appropriate processing of the input stream.

    `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
    id="read-text:document&#39;s-character-encoding"
    data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">encoding</a>
    must be set to the character encoding used to decode the document
    during parsing.

    The first
    <a href="#concept-task" id="read-text:concept-task-2">task</a> that
    the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-text:networking-task-source-2">networking task source</a>
    places on the
    <a href="#task-queue" id="read-text:task-queue-2">task queue</a>
    while fetching runs must <a href="#process-link-headers"
    id="read-text:process-link-headers">process link headers</a> given
    `document`, `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-text:navigation-params-response">response</a>, and
    "`media`", after the task has been processed by the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="read-text:html-parser-4">HTML parser</a>.

    Before any script execution occurs, the user agent must wait for
    <a href="#scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document"
    id="read-text:scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document">scripts
    may run for the newly-created document</a> to be true for
    `document`.

    When no more bytes are available, the user agent must
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task" id="read-text:queue-a-global-task">queue
    a global task</a> on the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="read-text:networking-task-source-3">networking task source</a>
    given `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="read-text:concept-relevant-global">relevant global object</a> to
    have the parser process the implied EOF character, which eventually
    causes a [`load`](#event-load) event to be fired.

5.  User agents may add content to the [`head`](#the-head-element)
    element of `document`, e.g., linking to a style sheet, providing
    script, or giving the document a [`title`](#the-title-element).

    In particular, if the user agent supports the `Format=Flowed`
    feature of RFC 3676 then the user agent would need to apply extra
    styling to cause the text to wrap correctly and to handle the
    quoting feature. This could be performed using, e.g., a CSS
    extension.

6.  Return `document`.

The rules for how to convert the bytes of the plain text document into
actual characters, and the rules for actually rendering the text to the
user, are defined by the specifications for the
<a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#computed-mime-type"
id="read-text:content-type-sniffing-2"
data-x-internal="content-type-sniffing-2">computed MIME type</a> of the
resource (i.e., `type`).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.5</span> Loading [`multipart/x-mixed-replace`](#multipart/x-mixed-replace) documents<a href="#read-multipart-x-mixed-replace" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-multipart-x-mixed-replace" class="dfn">load a
`multipart/x-mixed-replace` document</span>, given
<a href="#navigation-params"
id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params">navigation
params</a> `navigationParams`, <a href="#source-snapshot-params"
id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:source-snapshot-params">source
snapshot params</a> `sourceSnapshotParams`, and
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:concept-origin">origin</a>
`initiatorOrigin`:

1.  Parse `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-response">response</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:concept-response-body"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a> using the rules for
    multipart types. [\[RFC2046\]](#refsRFC2046)

2.  Let `firstPartNavigationParams` be a copy of `navigationParams`.

3.  Set `firstPartNavigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-response-2">response</a>
    to a new <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> representing the
    first part of `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-response-3">response</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:concept-response-body-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a>'s multipart stream.

4.  Let `document` be the result of <a href="#loading-a-document"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:loading-a-document">loading a
    document</a> given `firstPartNavigationParams`,
    `sourceSnapshotParams`, and `initiatorOrigin`.

    For each additional body part obtained from `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-response-4">response</a>,
    the user agent must <a href="#navigate"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigate">navigate</a>
    `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:node-navigable">node navigable</a>
    to `navigationParams`'s <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-request">request</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:concept-request-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a>, using `document`,
    with *[response](#navigation-response)* set to `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-multipart-x-mixed-replace:navigation-params-response-5">response</a>
    and *[historyHandling](#navigation-hh)* set to
    "[`replace`](#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)".

5.  Return `document`.

</div>

For the purposes of algorithms processing these body parts as if they
were complete stand-alone resources, the user agent must act as if there
were no more bytes for those resources whenever the boundary following
the body part is reached.

Thus, [`load`](#event-load) events (and for that matter
[`unload`](#event-unload) events) do fire for each body part loaded.

#### <span class="secno">7.5.6</span> Loading media documents<a href="#read-media" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="navigate-media" class="dfn">load a media document</span>,
given `navigationParams` and a string `type`:

1.  Let `document` be the result of
    <a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
    id="read-media:initialise-the-document-object">creating and initializing
    a <code>Document</code> object</a> given "`html`", `type`, and
    `navigationParams`.

2.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-mode"
    id="read-media:concept-document-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-mode">mode</a> to "`no-quirks`".

3.  <a href="#populate-with-html/head/body"
    id="read-media:populate-with-html/head/body">Populate with
    <code>html</code>/<code>head</code>/<code>body</code></a> given
    `document`.

4.  Append an element `host element` for the media, as described below,
    to the [`body`](#the-body-element) element.

5.  Set the appropriate attribute of the element `host element`, as
    described below, to the address of the image, video, or audio
    resource.

6.  User agents may add content to the [`head`](#the-head-element)
    element of `document`, or attributes to `host element`, e.g., to
    link to a style sheet, to provide a script, to give the document a
    [`title`](#the-title-element), or to make the media
    <a href="#attr-media-autoplay"
    id="read-media:attr-media-autoplay">autoplay</a>.

7.  <a href="#process-link-headers"
    id="read-media:process-link-headers">Process link headers</a> given
    `document`, `navigationParams`'s
    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-media:navigation-params-response">response</a>, and
    "`media`".

8.  Act as if the user agent had
    <a href="#stop-parsing" id="read-media:stop-parsing">stopped parsing</a>
    `document`.

9.  Return `document`.

The element `host element` to create for the media is the element given
in the table below in the second cell of the row whose first cell
describes the media. The appropriate attribute to set is the one given
by the third cell in that same row.

| Type of media | Element for the media         | Appropriate attribute    |
|---------------|-------------------------------|--------------------------|
| Image         | [`img`](#the-img-element)     | [`src`](#attr-img-src)   |
| Video         | [`video`](#the-video-element) | [`src`](#attr-media-src) |
| Audio         | [`audio`](#the-audio-element) | [`src`](#attr-media-src) |

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Before any script execution occurs, the user agent must wait for
<a href="#scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document"
id="read-media:scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document">scripts
may run for the newly-created document</a> to be true for the
[`Document`](#document).

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.7</span> <span id="read-ua-plugin"></span><span id="navigate-plugin"></span>Loading a document for inline content that doesn't have a DOM<a href="#read-ua-inline" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

When the user agent is to <span id="navigate-ua-inline"
class="dfn">create a document to display a user agent page or PDF viewer
inline</span>, provided a
<a href="#navigable" id="read-ua-inline:navigable">navigable</a>
`navigable`, a
<a href="#navigation-id" id="read-ua-inline:navigation-id">navigation
ID</a> `navigationId`, a <a
href="https://w3c.github.io/navigation-timing/#dom-navigationtimingtype"
data-x-internal="navigationtimingtype"><code
id="read-ua-inline:navigationtimingtype">NavigationTimingType</code></a>
`navTimingType`, and a <a href="#user-navigation-involvement"
id="read-ua-inline:user-navigation-involvement">user navigation
involvement</a> `userInvolvement`, the user agent should:

1.  Let `origin` be a new <a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
    id="read-ua-inline:concept-origin-opaque">opaque origin</a>.

2.  Let `coop` be a new <a href="#cross-origin-opener-policy"
    id="read-ua-inline:cross-origin-opener-policy">opener policy</a>.

3.  Let `coopEnforcementResult` be a new
    <a href="#coop-enforcement-result"
    id="read-ua-inline:coop-enforcement-result">opener policy enforcement
    result</a> with

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-url"
    id="read-ua-inline:coop-enforcement-url">url</a>  
    `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="read-ua-inline:concept-response-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-origin"
    id="read-ua-inline:coop-enforcement-origin">origin</a>  
    `origin`

    <a href="#coop-enforcement-coop"
    id="read-ua-inline:coop-enforcement-coop">opener policy</a>  
    `coop`

4.  Let `navigationParams` be a new <a href="#navigation-params"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params">navigation params</a> with

    <a href="#navigation-params-id"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-id">id</a>  
    `navigationId`

    <a href="#navigation-params-navigable"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-navigable">navigable</a>  
    `navigable`

    <a href="#navigation-params-request"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-request">request</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-response"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-response">response</a>  
    a new <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="read-ua-inline:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-origin"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-origin">origin</a>  
    `origin`

    <a href="#navigation-params-fetch-controller"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-fetch-controller">fetch
    controller</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-commit-early-hints"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-commit-early-hints">commit early
    hints</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-coop-enforcement-result">COOP
    enforcement result</a>  
    `coopEnforcementResult`

    <a href="#navigation-params-reserved-environment"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-reserved-environment">reserved
    environment</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-policy-container"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-policy-container">policy
    container</a>  
    a new
    <a href="#policy-container" id="read-ua-inline:policy-container">policy
    container</a>

    <a href="#navigation-params-sandboxing"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-sandboxing">final sandboxing flag
    set</a>  
    an empty set

    <a href="#navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-iframe-referrer-policy"><code>iframe</code>
    element referrer policy</a>  
    the empty string

    <a href="#navigation-params-coop"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-coop">opener policy</a>  
    `coop`

    <a href="#navigation-params-nav-timing-type"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-nav-timing-type">navigation timing
    type</a>  
    `navTimingType`

    <a href="#navigation-params-about-base-url"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-about-base-url">about base URL</a>  
    null

    <a href="#navigation-params-user-involvement"
    id="read-ua-inline:navigation-params-user-involvement">user
    involvement</a>  
    `userInvolvement`

5.  Let `document` be the result of
    <a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
    id="read-ua-inline:initialise-the-document-object">creating and
    initializing a <code>Document</code> object</a> given "`html`",
    "`text/html`", and `navigationParams`.

6.  Either associate `document` with a custom rendering that is not
    rendered using the normal [`Document`](#document) rendering rules,
    or mutate `document` until it represents the content the user agent
    wants to render.

7.  Act as if the user agent had
    <a href="#stop-parsing" id="read-ua-inline:stop-parsing">stopped
    parsing</a> `document`.

    This is done to avoid leaking information to the parent page about
    whether a navigation has been blocked by CSP, or if the response was
    a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
    id="read-ua-inline:network-error"
    data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>. In the case where
    the container is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element,
    <a href="#stop-parsing" id="read-ua-inline:stop-parsing-2">stopping
    parsing</a> causes the <a href="#iframe-load-event-steps"
    id="read-ua-inline:iframe-load-event-steps">iframe load event steps</a>
    to run.

8.  Return `document`.

Because we ensure the resulting [`Document`](#document)'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="read-ua-inline:concept-document-origin"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is
<a href="#concept-origin-opaque"
id="read-ua-inline:concept-origin-opaque-2">opaque</a>, and the
resulting [`Document`](#document) cannot run script with access to the
DOM, the existence and properties of this [`Document`](#document) are
not observable to web developer code. This means that most of the above
values, e.g., the [`text/html`](#text/html)
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-type"
id="read-ua-inline:concept-document-type"
data-x-internal="concept-document-type">type</a>, do not matter.
Similarly, most of the items in `navigationParams` don't have any
observable effect, besides preventing the
<a href="#initialise-the-document-object"
id="read-ua-inline:initialise-the-document-object-2"><code>Document</code>-creation
algorithm</a> from getting confused, and so are set to default values.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.8</span> Finishing the loading process<a href="#loading-documents" class="self-link"></a>

A [`Document`](#document) has a <span id="completely-loaded-time"
class="dfn">completely loaded time</span> (a time or null), which is
initially null.

<div algorithm="">

A [`Document`](#document) is considered <span id="completely-loaded"
class="dfn">completely loaded</span> if its
<a href="#completely-loaded-time"
id="loading-documents:completely-loaded-time">completely loaded time</a>
is non-null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="completely-finish-loading" class="dfn">completely finish
loading</span> a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="loading-documents:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="loading-documents:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a> is
    non-null.

2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#completely-loaded-time"
    id="loading-documents:completely-loaded-time-2">completely loaded
    time</a> to the current time.

3.  Let `container` be `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="loading-documents:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-container"
    id="loading-documents:nav-container">container</a>.

    <div class="note">

    This will be null in the case where `document` is the
    <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="loading-documents:is-initial-about:blank">initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> [`Document`](#document) in a
    [`frame`](#frame) or [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element), since at the
    point of <a href="#creating-a-new-browsing-context"
    id="loading-documents:creating-a-new-browsing-context">browsing context
    creation</a> which calls this algorithm, the container relationship
    has not yet been established. (That happens in a subsequent step of
    <a href="#create-a-new-child-navigable"
    id="loading-documents:create-a-new-child-navigable">create a new child
    navigable</a>.)

    The consequence of this is that the following steps do nothing,
    i.e., we do not fire an asynchronous [`load`](#event-load) event on
    the container element for such cases. Instead, a synchronous
    [`load`](#event-load) event is fired in a special initial-insertion
    case when <a href="#process-the-iframe-attributes"
    id="loading-documents:process-the-iframe-attributes">processing the
    <code>iframe</code> attributes</a>.

    </div>

4.  If `container` is an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) element, then
    <a href="#queue-an-element-task"
    id="loading-documents:queue-an-element-task">queue an element task</a>
    on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
    id="loading-documents:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM manipulation
    task source</a> given `container` to run the
    <a href="#iframe-load-event-steps"
    id="loading-documents:iframe-load-event-steps">iframe load event
    steps</a> given `container`.

5.  Otherwise, if `container` is non-null, then
    <a href="#queue-an-element-task"
    id="loading-documents:queue-an-element-task-2">queue an element task</a>
    on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
    id="loading-documents:dom-manipulation-task-source-2">DOM manipulation
    task source</a> given `container` to
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="loading-documents:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    [`load`](#event-load) at `container`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.9</span> Unloading documents<a href="#unloading-documents" class="self-link"></a>

A [`Document`](#document) has a <span id="concept-document-salvageable"
class="dfn">*salvageable*</span> state, which must initially be true,
and a <span id="page-showing" class="dfn">page showing</span> boolean,
which is initially false. The
<a href="#page-showing" id="unloading-documents:page-showing">page
showing</a> boolean is used to ensure that scripts receive
[`pageshow`](#event-pageshow) and [`pagehide`](#event-pagehide) events
in a consistent manner (e.g., that they never receive two
[`pagehide`](#event-pagehide) events in a row without an intervening
[`pageshow`](#event-pageshow), or vice versa).

A [`Document`](#document) has a
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dom-domhighrestimestamp"
data-x-internal="domhighrestimestamp"><code
id="unloading-documents:domhighrestimestamp">DOMHighResTimeStamp</code></a>
<span id="suspension-time" class="dfn">suspension time</span>, initially
0.

A [`Document`](#document) has a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="unloading-documents:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
<span id="suspended-timer-handles" class="dfn">suspended timer
handles</span>, initially empty.

<a href="#event-loop" id="unloading-documents:event-loop">Event
loops</a> have a <span id="termination-nesting-level"
class="dfn">termination nesting level</span> counter, which must
initially be 0.

[`Document`](#document) objects have an <span id="unload-counter"
class="dfn">unload counter</span>, which is used to ignore certain
operations while the below algorithms run. Initially, the counter must
be set to zero.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="unload-a-document" class="dfn">unload</span> a
[`Document`](#document) `oldDocument`, given an optional
[`Document`](#document) `newDocument`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="unloading-documents:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    this is running as part of a
    <a href="#concept-task" id="unloading-documents:concept-task">task</a>
    queued on `oldDocument`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="unloading-documents:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>.

2.  Let `unloadTimingInfo` be a new
    <a href="#document-unload-timing-info"
    id="unloading-documents:document-unload-timing-info">document unload
    timing info</a>.

3.  If `newDocument` is not given, then set `unloadTimingInfo` to null.

    In this case there is no new document that needs to know about how
    long it took `oldDocument` to unload.

4.  Otherwise, if `newDocument`'s
    <a href="#event-loop" id="unloading-documents:event-loop-2">event
    loop</a> is not `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#event-loop" id="unloading-documents:event-loop-3">event
    loop</a>, then the user agent may be <a href="#unload-a-document"
    id="unloading-documents:unload-a-document">unloading</a>
    `oldDocument`
    <a href="#in-parallel" id="unloading-documents:in-parallel">in
    parallel</a>. In that case, the user agent should set
    `unloadTimingInfo` to null.

    In this case `newDocument`'s loading is not impacted by how long it
    takes to unload `oldDocument`, so it would be meaningless to
    communicate that timing info.

5.  Let `intendToKeepInBfcache` be true if the user agent intends to
    keep `oldDocument` alive in a <a href="#session-history-entry"
    id="unloading-documents:session-history-entry">session history entry</a>,
    such that it can later be [used for history
    traversal](#note-bfcache).

    This must be false if `oldDocument` is not
    *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*, or if there are any
    descendants of `oldDocument` which the user agent does not intend to
    keep alive in the same way (including due to their lack of
    *[salvageability](#concept-document-salvageable)*).

6.  Let `eventLoop` be `oldDocument`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="unloading-documents:relevant-agent-2">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-agent-event-loop-2">event loop</a>.

7.  Increase `eventLoop`'s <a href="#termination-nesting-level"
    id="unloading-documents:termination-nesting-level">termination nesting
    level</a> by 1.

8.  Increase `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#unload-counter" id="unloading-documents:unload-counter">unload
    counter</a> by 1.

9.  If `intendToKeepInBfcache` is false, then set `oldDocument`'s
    *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)* state to false.

10. If `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#page-showing" id="unloading-documents:page-showing-2">page
    showing</a> is true:

    1.  Set `oldDocument`'s
        <a href="#page-showing" id="unloading-documents:page-showing-3">page
        showing</a> to false.

    2.  <a href="#fire-a-page-transition-event"
        id="unloading-documents:fire-a-page-transition-event">Fire a page
        transition event</a> named [`pagehide`](#event-pagehide) at
        `oldDocument`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
        object</a> with `oldDocument`'s
        *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)* state.

    3.  <a href="#update-the-visibility-state"
        id="unloading-documents:update-the-visibility-state">Update the
        visibility state</a> of `oldDocument` to "`hidden`".

11. If `unloadTimingInfo` is not null, then set `unloadTimingInfo`'s
    <a href="#unload-event-start-time"
    id="unloading-documents:unload-event-start-time">unload event start
    time</a> to the <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time"
    id="unloading-documents:current-high-resolution-time"
    data-x-internal="current-high-resolution-time">current high resolution
    time</a> given `newDocument`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>,
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-coarsen-time"
    id="unloading-documents:coarsen-time"
    data-x-internal="coarsen-time">coarsened</a> given `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="unloading-documents:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
    object</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability">cross-origin
    isolated capability</a>.

12. If `oldDocument`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
    state is false, then
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    [`unload`](#event-unload) at `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>, with *legacy target override flag* set.

13. If `unloadTimingInfo` is not null, then set `unloadTimingInfo`'s
    <a href="#unload-event-end-time"
    id="unloading-documents:unload-event-end-time">unload event end time</a>
    to the <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time"
    id="unloading-documents:current-high-resolution-time-2"
    data-x-internal="current-high-resolution-time">current high resolution
    time</a> given `newDocument`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-4">relevant global
    object</a>,
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-coarsen-time"
    id="unloading-documents:coarsen-time-2"
    data-x-internal="coarsen-time">coarsened</a> given `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="unloading-documents:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant settings
    object</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-settings-object-cross-origin-isolated-capability-2">cross-origin
    isolated capability</a>.

14. Decrease `eventLoop`'s <a href="#termination-nesting-level"
    id="unloading-documents:termination-nesting-level-2">termination nesting
    level</a> by 1.

15. Set `oldDocument`'s <a href="#suspension-time"
    id="unloading-documents:suspension-time">suspension time</a> to the
    <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/hr-time/#dfn-current-high-resolution-time"
    id="unloading-documents:current-high-resolution-time-3"
    data-x-internal="current-high-resolution-time">current high resolution
    time</a> given `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-5">relevant global
    object</a>.

16. Set `oldDocument`'s <a href="#suspended-timer-handles"
    id="unloading-documents:suspended-timer-handles">suspended timer
    handles</a> to the result of
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-getting-the-keys"
    id="unloading-documents:map-get-the-keys"
    data-x-internal="map-get-the-keys">getting the keys</a> for the
    <a href="#map-of-active-timers"
    id="unloading-documents:map-of-active-timers">map of active timers</a>.

17. Set `oldDocument`'s <a href="#has-been-scrolled-by-the-user"
    id="unloading-documents:has-been-scrolled-by-the-user">has been scrolled
    by the user</a> to false.

18. Run any <a href="#unloading-document-cleanup-steps"
    id="unloading-documents:unloading-document-cleanup-steps">unloading
    document cleanup steps</a> for `oldDocument` that are defined by
    this specification and <a href="#other-applicable-specifications"
    id="unloading-documents:other-applicable-specifications">other
    applicable specifications</a>.

19. If `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="unloading-documents:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a> is a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="unloading-documents:top-level-traversable">top-level traversable</a>,
    <a
    href="#build-not-restored-reasons-for-a-top-level-traversable-and-its-descendants"
    id="unloading-documents:build-not-restored-reasons-for-a-top-level-traversable-and-its-descendants">build
    not restored reasons for a top-level traversable and its descendants</a>
    given `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="unloading-documents:node-navigable-2">node
    navigable</a>.

20. If `oldDocument`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
    state is false, then <a href="#destroy-a-document"
    id="unloading-documents:destroy-a-document">destroy</a>
    `oldDocument`.

21. Decrease `oldDocument`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="unloading-documents:unload-counter-2">unload counter</a> by 1.

22. If `newDocument` is given, `newDocument`'s
    <a href="#was-created-via-cross-origin-redirects"
    id="unloading-documents:was-created-via-cross-origin-redirects">was
    created via cross-origin redirects</a> is false, and `newDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is the
    <a href="#same-origin" id="unloading-documents:same-origin">same</a>
    as `oldDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then set
    `newDocument`'s <a href="#previous-document-unload-timing"
    id="unloading-documents:previous-document-unload-timing">previous
    document unload timing</a> to `unloadTimingInfo`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="unload-a-document-and-its-descendants" class="dfn">unload a
document and its descendants</span>, given a [`Document`](#document)
`document`, an optional [`Document`](#document)-or-null `newDocument`
(default null), an optional set of steps `afterAllUnloads`, and an
optional set of steps `firePageSwapSteps`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="unloading-documents:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    this is running within `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="unloading-documents:node-navigable-3">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="unloading-documents:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#tn-session-history-traversal-queue"
    id="unloading-documents:tn-session-history-traversal-queue">session
    history traversal queue</a>.

2.  Let `childNavigables` be `document`'s <a href="#child-navigable"
    id="unloading-documents:child-navigable">child navigables</a>.

3.  Let `numberUnloaded` be 0.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="unloading-documents:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `childNavigable` of `childNavigables` <span class="XXX">in
    what order?</span>, <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="unloading-documents:queue-a-global-task">queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="unloading-documents:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `childNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="unloading-documents:nav-window">active
    window</a> to perform the following steps:

    1.  Let `incrementUnloaded` be an algorithm step which increments
        `numberUnloaded`.

    2.  <a href="#unload-a-document-and-its-descendants"
        id="unloading-documents:unload-a-document-and-its-descendants">Unload a
        document and its descendants</a> given `childNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="unloading-documents:nav-document">active
        document</a>, null, and `incrementUnloaded`.

5.  Wait until `numberUnloaded` equals `childNavigable`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="unloading-documents:list-size" data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>.

6.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="unloading-documents:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="unloading-documents:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-6">relevant global
    object</a> to perform the following steps:

    1.  If `firePageSwapSteps` is given, then run `firePageSwapSteps`.

    2.  <a href="#unload-a-document"
        id="unloading-documents:unload-a-document-2">Unload</a>
        `document`, passing along `newDocument` if it is not null.

    3.  If `afterAllUnloads` was given, then run it.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

This specification defines the following
<span id="unloading-document-cleanup-steps" class="dfn"
export="">unloading document cleanup steps</span>. Other specifications
can define more. Given a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  Let `window` be `document`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-7">relevant global
    object</a>.

2.  For each <a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket"
    data-x-internal="websocket-2"><code
    id="unloading-documents:websocket-2">WebSocket</code></a> object
    `webSocket` whose <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-8">relevant global
    object</a> is `window`,
    <a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#make-disappear"
    id="unloading-documents:make-disappear"
    data-x-internal="make-disappear">make disappear</a> `webSocket`.

    If this affected any
    <a href="https://websockets.spec.whatwg.org/#websocket"
    data-x-internal="websocket-2"><code
    id="unloading-documents:websocket-2-2">WebSocket</code></a> objects,
    then <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
    id="unloading-documents:make-document-unsalvageable">make document
    unsalvageable</a> given `document` and
    "[`websocket`](#blocking-websocket)".

3.  For each <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webtransport/#webtransport"
    data-x-internal="webtransport"><code
    id="unloading-documents:webtransport">WebTransport</code></a> object
    `transport` whose <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-9">relevant global
    object</a> is `window`, run the
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webtransport/#context-cleanup-steps"
    id="unloading-documents:context-cleanup-steps"
    data-x-internal="context-cleanup-steps">context cleanup steps</a>
    given `transport`.

4.  If `document`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)* state
    is false, then:

    1.  For each [`EventSource`](#eventsource) object `eventSource`
        whose <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
        id="unloading-documents:concept-relevant-global-10">relevant global
        object</a> is equal to `window`,
        <a href="#concept-eventsource-forcibly-close"
        id="unloading-documents:concept-eventsource-forcibly-close">forcibly
        close</a> `eventSource`.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-clear"
        id="unloading-documents:map-clear" data-x-internal="map-clear">Clear</a>
        `window`'s <a href="#map-of-active-timers"
        id="unloading-documents:map-of-active-timers-2">map of active timers</a>.

</div>

<div class="XXX">

It would be better if specification authors sent a pull request to add
calls from here into their specifications directly, instead of using the
<a href="#unloading-document-cleanup-steps"
id="unloading-documents:unloading-document-cleanup-steps-2">unloading
document cleanup steps</a> hook, to ensure well-defined
cross-specification call order. As of the time of this writing the
following specifications are known to have
<a href="#unloading-document-cleanup-steps"
id="unloading-documents:unloading-document-cleanup-steps-3">unloading
document cleanup steps</a>, which will be run in an unspecified order:
Fullscreen API, Web NFC, WebDriver BiDi, Compute Pressure, File API,
Media Capture and Streams, Picture-in-Picture, Screen Orientation,
Service Workers, WebLocks API, WebAudio API, WebRTC.
[\[FULLSCREEN\]](#refsFULLSCREEN) [\[WEBNFC\]](#refsWEBNFC)
[\[WEBDRIVERBIDI\]](#refsWEBDRIVERBIDI)
[\[COMPUTEPRESSURE\]](#refsCOMPUTEPRESSURE) [\[FILEAPI\]](#refsFILEAPI)
[\[MEDIASTREAM\]](#refsMEDIASTREAM)
[\[PICTUREINPICTURE\]](#refsPICTUREINPICTURE)
[\[SCREENORIENTATION\]](#refsSCREENORIENTATION) [\[SW\]](#refsSW)
[\[WEBLOCKS\]](#refsWEBLOCKS) [\[WEBAUDIO\]](#refsWEBAUDIO)
[\[WEBRTC\]](#refsWEBRTC)

[Issue \#8906](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8906) tracks the
work to make the order of these steps clear.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.10</span> Destroying documents<a href="#destroying-documents" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="destroy-a-document" class="dfn">destroy</span> a
[`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="destroying-documents:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    this is running as part of a
    <a href="#concept-task" id="destroying-documents:concept-task">task</a>
    queued on `document`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="destroying-documents:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>.

2.  <a href="#abort-a-document"
    id="destroying-documents:abort-a-document">Abort</a> `document`.

3.  Set `document`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
    state to false.

4.  Let `ports` be the list of [`MessagePort`](#messageport)s whose
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> is `document`.

5.  For each `port` in `ports`, <a href="#disentangle"
    id="destroying-documents:disentangle">disentangle</a> `port`.

6.  Run any <a href="#unloading-document-cleanup-steps"
    id="destroying-documents:unloading-document-cleanup-steps">unloading
    document cleanup steps</a> for `document` that are defined by this
    specification and <a href="#other-applicable-specifications"
    id="destroying-documents:other-applicable-specifications">other
    applicable specifications</a>.

7.  Remove any <a href="#concept-task"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-task-2">tasks</a> whose
    <a href="#concept-task-document"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-task-document">document</a> is
    `document` from any
    <a href="#task-queue" id="destroying-documents:task-queue">task
    queue</a> (without running those tasks).

8.  Set `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>
    to null.

9.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="destroying-documents:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-active-history-entry"
    id="destroying-documents:nav-active-history-entry">active session
    history entry</a>'s <a href="#she-document-state"
    id="destroying-documents:she-document-state">document state</a>'s
    <a href="#document-state-document"
    id="destroying-documents:document-state-document">document</a> to
    null.

10. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-remove"
    id="destroying-documents:list-remove"
    data-x-internal="list-remove">Remove</a> `document` from the
    <a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set">owner
    set</a> of each [`WorkerGlobalScope`](#workerglobalscope) object
    whose set <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
    id="destroying-documents:list-contains"
    data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> `document`.

11. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="destroying-documents:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `workletGlobalScope` in
    `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-worklet-global-scopes"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-document-worklet-global-scopes">worklet
    global scopes</a>, <a href="#terminate-a-worklet-global-scope"
    id="destroying-documents:terminate-a-worklet-global-scope">terminate</a>
    `workletGlobalScope`.

</div>

Even after destruction, the [`Document`](#document) object itself might
still be accessible to script, in the case where we are
<a href="#destroy-a-child-navigable"
id="destroying-documents:destroy-a-child-navigable">destroying a child
navigable</a>.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="destroy-a-document-and-its-descendants" class="dfn">destroy
a document and its descendants</span> given a [`Document`](#document)
`document` and an optional set of steps `afterAllDestruction`, perform
the following steps
<a href="#in-parallel" id="destroying-documents:in-parallel">in
parallel</a>:

1.  If `document` is not
    <a href="#fully-active" id="destroying-documents:fully-active">fully
    active</a>, then:

    1.  Let `reason` be a string from
        <a href="#ua-specific-blocking-reasons"
        id="destroying-documents:ua-specific-blocking-reasons">user-agent
        specific blocking reasons</a>. If none apply, then let `reason`
        be "[`masked`](#blocking-masked)".

    2.  <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
        id="destroying-documents:make-document-unsalvageable">Make document
        unsalvageable</a> given `document` and `reason`.

    3.  If `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
        id="destroying-documents:node-navigable-2">node navigable</a> is
        a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
        id="destroying-documents:top-level-traversable">top-level
        traversable</a>, <a
        href="#build-not-restored-reasons-for-a-top-level-traversable-and-its-descendants"
        id="destroying-documents:build-not-restored-reasons-for-a-top-level-traversable-and-its-descendants">build
        not restored reasons for a top-level traversable and its descendants</a>
        given `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
        id="destroying-documents:node-navigable-3">node navigable</a>.

2.  Let `childNavigables` be `document`'s <a href="#child-navigable"
    id="destroying-documents:child-navigable">child navigables</a>.

3.  Let `numberDestroyed` be 0.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="destroying-documents:list-iterate-2"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `childNavigable` of
    `childNavigables` <span class="XXX">in what order?</span>,
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="destroying-documents:queue-a-global-task">queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="destroying-documents:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `childNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="destroying-documents:nav-window">active
    window</a> to perform the following steps:

    1.  Let `incrementDestroyed` be an algorithm step which increments
        `numberDestroyed`.

    2.  <a href="#destroy-a-document-and-its-descendants"
        id="destroying-documents:destroy-a-document-and-its-descendants">Destroy
        a document and its descendants</a> given `childNavigable`'s
        <a href="#nav-document" id="destroying-documents:nav-document">active
        document</a> and `incrementDestroyed`.

5.  Wait until `numberDestroyed` equals `childNavigable`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="destroying-documents:list-size" data-x-internal="list-size">size</a>.

6.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="destroying-documents:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="destroying-documents:navigation-and-traversal-task-source-2">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="destroying-documents:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a> to perform the following steps:

    1.  <a href="#destroy-a-document"
        id="destroying-documents:destroy-a-document">Destroy</a>
        `document`.

    2.  If `afterAllDestruction` was given, then run it.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">7.5.11</span> Aborting a document load<a href="#aborting-a-document-load" class="self-link"></a>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="abort-a-document" class="dfn">abort</span> a
[`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    this is running as part of a <a href="#concept-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-task">task</a> queued on
    `document`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:relevant-agent">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-agent-event-loop">event loop</a>.

2.  Cancel any instances of the
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-fetch"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> algorithm in the context
    of `document`, discarding any <a href="#concept-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-task-2">tasks</a>
    <a href="#queue-a-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:queue-a-task">queued</a> for them, and
    discarding any further data received from the network for them. If
    this resulted in any instances of the
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-fetch-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> algorithm being canceled
    or any <a href="#queue-a-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:queue-a-task-2">queued</a>
    <a href="#concept-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-task-3">tasks</a> or any
    network data getting discarded, then
    <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:make-document-unsalvageable">make document
    unsalvageable</a> given `document` and "[`fetch`](#blocking-fetch)".

3.  If `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-document-navigation-id">during-loading
    navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</a> is non-null, then:

    1.  Invoke <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-aborted"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:webdriver-bidi-navigation-aborted"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-aborted">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation aborted</a> with `document`'s
        <a href="#node-navigable"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:node-navigable">node navigable</a>
        and a new <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:webdriver-bidi-navigation-status"
        data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-navigation-status">WebDriver BiDi
        navigation status</a> whose
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-id"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-status-id"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-id">id</a> is `document`'s
        <a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-document-navigation-id-2">during-loading
        navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</a>,
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-status"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-status-status"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-status">status</a> is "<a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-canceled"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-canceled"><code
        id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-status-canceled">canceled</code></a>",
        and
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#navigation-status-url"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-status-url"
        data-x-internal="navigation-status-url">url</a> is `document`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:the-document&#39;s-address"
        data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

    2.  Set `document`'s <a href="#concept-document-navigation-id"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-document-navigation-id-3">during-loading
        navigation ID for WebDriver BiDi</a> to null.

4.  If `document` has an <a href="#active-parser"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:active-parser">active parser</a>, then:

    1.  Set `document`'s <a href="#active-parser-was-aborted"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:active-parser-was-aborted">active parser
        was aborted</a> to true.

    2.  <a href="#abort-a-parser"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:abort-a-parser">Abort that parser</a>.

    3.  <a href="#make-document-unsalvageable"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:make-document-unsalvageable-2">Make
        document unsalvageable</a> given `document` and
        "[`parser-aborted`](#blocking-parser-aborted)".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="abort-a-document-and-its-descendants" class="dfn">abort a
document and its descendants</span> given a [`Document`](#document)
`document`:

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this is running as part of a
    <a href="#concept-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-task-4">task</a> queued on
    `document`'s <a href="#relevant-agent"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:relevant-agent-2">relevant agent</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-agent-event-loop"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:concept-agent-event-loop-2">event loop</a>.

2.  Let `descendantNavigables` be `document`'s
    <a href="#descendant-navigables"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:descendant-navigables">descendant
    navigables</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `descendantNavigable` of
    `descendantNavigables` <span class="XXX">in what order?</span>,
    <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:queue-a-global-task">queue a global
    task</a> on the <a href="#navigation-and-traversal-task-source"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-and-traversal-task-source">navigation
    and traversal task source</a> given `descendantNavigable`'s
    <a href="#nav-window" id="aborting-a-document-load:nav-window">active
    window</a> to perform the following steps:

    1.  <a href="#abort-a-document"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:abort-a-document">Abort</a>
        `descendantNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:nav-document">active document</a>.

    2.  If `descendantNavigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
        id="aborting-a-document-load:nav-document-2">active document</a>'s
        *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)* is false, then
        set `document`'s *[salvageable](#concept-document-salvageable)*
        to false.

4.  <a href="#abort-a-document"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:abort-a-document-2">Abort</a>
    `document`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="nav-stop" class="dfn">stop loading</span> a
<a href="#navigable"
id="aborting-a-document-load:navigable">navigable</a> `navigable`:

1.  Let `document` be `navigable`'s <a href="#nav-document"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:nav-document-3">active document</a>.

2.  If `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:unload-counter">unload counter</a> is
    0, and `navigable`'s <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:ongoing-navigation">ongoing navigation</a>
    is a <a href="#navigation-id"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>, then
    <a href="#set-the-ongoing-navigation"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:set-the-ongoing-navigation">set the ongoing
    navigation</a> for `navigable` to null.

    This will have the effect of aborting any ongoing navigations of
    `navigable`, since at certain points during navigation, changes to
    the <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:ongoing-navigation-2">ongoing
    navigation</a> will cause further work to be abandoned.

3.  <a href="#abort-a-document-and-its-descendants"
    id="aborting-a-document-load:abort-a-document-and-its-descendants">Abort
    a document and its descendants</a> given `document`.

</div>

Through their [user interface](#nav-traversal-ui), user agents also
allow stopping traversals, i.e. cases where the
<a href="#ongoing-navigation"
id="aborting-a-document-load:ongoing-navigation-3">ongoing
navigation</a> is "`traversal`". The above algorithm does not account
for this. (On the other hand, user agents do not allow
[`window.stop()`](#dom-window-stop) to stop traversals, so the above
algorithm is correct for that caller.) See [issue
\#6905](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/6905).

### <span class="secno">7.6</span> Speculative loading<a href="#speculative-loading" class="self-link"></a>

Speculative loading is the practice of performing navigation actions,
such as prefetching, ahead of navigation starting. This makes subsequent
navigations faster.

Developers can initiate speculative loads by using
<a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculative-loading:speculation-rule-set">speculation rules</a>.
User agents might also perform speculative loads in certain
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
id="speculative-loading:implementation-defined"
data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
scenarios, such as typing into the address bar.

#### <span class="secno">7.6.1</span> Speculation rules<a href="#speculation-rules" class="self-link"></a>

<a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-set">Speculation rules</a> are
how developers instruct the browser about speculative loading operations
that the developer believes will be beneficial. They are delivered as
JSON documents, via either:

- inline [`script`](#the-script-element) elements with their
  [`type`](#attr-script-type) attribute set to "`speculationrules`"; or

- resources fetched from a URL specified in the
  \`[`Speculation-Rules`](#speculation-rules-2)\` HTTP response header.

<div id="example-speculation-rules-simple" class="example">

<a href="#example-speculation-rules-simple" class="self-link"></a>

The following JSON document is parsed into a
<a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-set-2">speculation rule set</a>
specifying a number of desired conditions for the user agent to <a
href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch"
id="speculation-rules:start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch"
data-x-internal="start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch">start
a referrer-initiated navigational prefetch</a>:

``` json
{
  "prefetch": [
    {
      "urls": ["/chapters/5"]
    },
    {
      "eagerness": "moderate",
      "where": {
        "and": [
          { "href_matches": "/*" },
          { "not": { "selector_matches": ".no-prefetch" } }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

</div>

A JSON document representing a <a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-set-3">speculation rule set</a>
must meet the following
<span id="speculation-rule-set-authoring-requirements"
class="dfn">speculation rule set authoring requirements</span>:

- It must be valid JSON. [\[JSON\]](#refsJSON)

- The JSON must represent a JSON object, with at most three keys
  "`tag`", "`prefetch`" and "`prerender`".

  In this standard, "`prerender`" is optionally converted to
  "`prefetch`" [at parse
  time](#note-speculation-rules-parse-prerender-as-prefetch). Some
  implementations might implement different behavior for prerender, as
  specified in Prerendering Revamped.
  [\[PRERENDERING-REVAMPED\]](#refsPRERENDERING-REVAMPED)

- The value corresponding to the "`tag`" key, if present, must be a
  <a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
  id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-tag">speculation rule tag</a>.

- The values corresponding to the "`prefetch`" and "`prerender`" keys,
  if present, must be arrays of <a href="#valid-speculation-rule"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-speculation-rule">valid speculation
  rules</a>.

A <span id="valid-speculation-rule" class="dfn">valid speculation
rule</span> is a JSON object that meets the following requirements:

- It must have at most the following keys: "`source`", "`urls`",
  "`where`", "`relative_to`", "`eagerness`", "`referrer_policy`",
  "`tag`", "`requires`", "`expects_no_vary_search`", or "`target_hint`".

  In this standard, ["`target_hint`" is
  ignored](#note-speculation-rules-parse-target-hint).

- The value corresponding to the "`source`" key, if present, must be
  either "`list`" or "`document`".

- If the value corresponding to the "`source`" key is "`list`", then the
  "`urls`" key must be present, and the "`where`" key must be absent.

- If the value corresponding to the "`source`" key is "`document`", then
  the "`urls`" key must be absent.

- The "`urls`" and "`where`" keys must not both be present.

- If the value corresponding to the "`source`" key is "`document`" or
  the "`where`" key is present, then the "`relative_to`" key must be
  absent.

- The value corresponding to the "`urls`" key, if present, must be an
  array of <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-url-string"
  data-x-internal="valid-url-string">valid URL strings</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`where`" key, if present, must be a
  <a href="#valid-document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-document-rule-predicate">valid document rule
  predicate</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`relative_to`" key, if present, must
  be either "`ruleset`" or "`document`".

- The value corresponding to the "`eagerness`" key, if present, must be
  a <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
  id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-eagerness">speculation rule
  eagerness</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`referrer_policy`" key, if present,
  must be a <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
  id="speculation-rules:referrer-policy"
  data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`tag`" key, if present, must be a
  <a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
  id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-tag-2">speculation rule tag</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`requires`" key, if present, must be
  an array of <a href="#speculation-rule-requirement"
  id="speculation-rules:speculation-rule-requirement">speculation rule
  requirements</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`expects_no_vary_search`" key, if
  present, must be a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
  id="speculation-rules:string" data-x-internal="string">string</a> that
  is <a
  href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#parse-a-url-search-variance"
  id="speculation-rules:parse-a-url-search-variance"
  data-x-internal="parse-a-url-search-variance">parseable</a> as a \`<a
  href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-http-header-field-definitio"
  data-x-internal="no-vary-search"><code
  id="speculation-rules:no-vary-search">No-Vary-Search</code></a>\`
  header value.

A <span id="valid-document-rule-predicate" class="dfn">valid document
rule predicate</span> is a JSON object that meets the following
requirements:

- It must contain exactly one of the keys "`and`", "`or`", "`not`",
  "`href_matches`", or "`selector_matches`".

- It must not contain any keys apart from the above or "`relative_to`".

- If it contains the key "`relative_to`", then it must also contain the
  key "`href_matches`".

- The value corresponding to the "`relative_to`" key, if present, must
  be either "`ruleset`" or "`document`".

- The value corresponding to the "`and`" or "`or`" keys, if present,
  must be arrays of <a href="#valid-document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-document-rule-predicate-2">valid document
  rule predicates</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`not`" key, if present, must be a
  <a href="#valid-document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-document-rule-predicate-3">valid document
  rule predicate</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`href_matches`" key, if present, must
  be either a <a href="#valid-url-pattern-input"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-url-pattern-input">valid URL pattern
  input</a> or an array of <a href="#valid-url-pattern-input"
  id="speculation-rules:valid-url-pattern-input-2">valid URL pattern
  inputs</a>.

- The value corresponding to the "`selector_matches`" key, if present,
  must be either a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
  id="speculation-rules:string-2" data-x-internal="string">string</a>
  matching
  <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/selectors/#typedef-selector-list"
  data-x-internal="selector-list"><code
  id="speculation-rules:selector-list">&lt;selector-list&gt;</code></a>
  or an array of <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
  id="speculation-rules:string-3" data-x-internal="string">strings</a>
  that match
  <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/selectors/#typedef-selector-list"
  data-x-internal="selector-list"><code
  id="speculation-rules:selector-list-2">&lt;selector-list&gt;</code></a>.

A <span id="valid-url-pattern-input" class="dfn">valid URL pattern
input</span> is either:

- a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
  id="speculation-rules:scalar-value-string"
  data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value string</a> that can
  be successfully
  <a href="https://urlpattern.spec.whatwg.org/#parse-a-constructor-string"
  id="speculation-rules:parse-a-url-pattern-constructor-string"
  data-x-internal="parse-a-url-pattern-constructor-string">parsed</a> as
  a URL pattern constructor string, or;

- a JSON object whose keys are drawn from the members of the
  <a href="https://urlpattern.spec.whatwg.org/#dictdef-urlpatterninit"
  data-x-internal="urlpatterninit"><code
  id="speculation-rules:urlpatterninit">URLPatternInit</code></a>
  dictionary and whose values are
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string"
  id="speculation-rules:scalar-value-string-2"
  data-x-internal="scalar-value-string">scalar value strings</a>.

##### <span class="secno">7.6.1.1</span> Data model<a href="#speculation-rules-data-model" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="speculation-rule-set" class="dfn">speculation rule
set</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="sr-set-prefetch" class="dfn">prefetch rules</span>, a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
  of <a href="#speculation-rule"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule">speculation rules</a>,
  initially empty

In the future, other rules will be possible, e.g., prerender rules. See
Prerendering Revamped for such not-yet-accepted extensions.
[\[PRERENDERING-REVAMPED\]](#refsPRERENDERING-REVAMPED)

A <span id="speculation-rule" class="dfn">speculation rule</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-2"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-item-2"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="sr-urls" class="dfn">URLs</span>, an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:set" data-x-internal="set">ordered
  set</a> of <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:url" data-x-internal="url">URLs</a>

- <span id="sr-predicate" class="dfn">predicate</span>, a
  <a href="#document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:document-rule-predicate">document rule
  predicate</a> or null

- <span id="sr-eagerness" class="dfn">eagerness</span>, a
  <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-eagerness">speculation
  rule eagerness</a>

- <span id="sr-referrer-policy" class="dfn">referrer policy</span>, a <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:referrer-policy"
  data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>

- <span id="sr-tags" class="dfn">tags</span>, an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:set-2" data-x-internal="set">ordered

  id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-tag">speculation rule

- <span id="sr-requirements" class="dfn">requirements</span>, an

  id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-requirement">speculation

- <span id="sr-nvs-hint" class="dfn">No-Vary-Search hint</span>, a <a

  id="speculation-rules-data-model:url-search-variance"
  data-x-internal="url-search-variance">URL search variance</a>

A <span id="document-rule-predicate" class="dfn">document rule

  id="speculation-rules-data-model:document-rule-url-pattern-predicate">document
  rule URL pattern predicate</a>; or

- a <a href="#document-rule-selector-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:document-rule-selector-predicate">document
  rule selector predicate</a>.

A <span id="document-rule-conjunction" class="dfn">document rule
conjunction</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"

<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"

  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
  of <a href="#document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:document-rule-predicate-2">document

disjunction</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"

<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-item-4"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="sr-dr-d-clauses" class="dfn">clauses</span>, a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a>

A <span id="document-rule-negation" class="dfn">document rule
negation</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-5"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-item-5"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="sr-dr-n-clause" class="dfn">clause</span>, a
  <a href="#document-rule-predicate"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:document-rule-predicate-4">document
  rule predicate</a>

A <span id="document-rule-url-pattern-predicate" class="dfn">document
rule URL pattern predicate</span> is a

data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:struct-item-6"

- <span id="sr-dr-urlpattern-patterns" class="dfn">patterns</span>, a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:list-4" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
  of <a href="https://urlpattern.spec.whatwg.org/#url-pattern"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:url-pattern"
  data-x-internal="url-pattern">URL patterns</a>

A <span id="document-rule-selector-predicate" class="dfn">document rule
selector predicate</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"

data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"

- <span id="sr-dr-cssselector-selectors" class="dfn">selectors</span>, a
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:list-5" data-x-internal="list">list</a>
  of <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/selectors/#selector"
  id="speculation-rules-data-model:selector"
  data-x-internal="selector">selectors</a>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <span id="speculation-rule-eagerness" class="dfn">speculation rule
eagerness</span> is one of the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:string"
data-x-internal="string">strings</a>:

"<span id="sr-eagerness-immediate" class="dfn">`immediate`</span>"
