The developer believes that performing the associated speculative loads
is very likely to be worthwhile, and they might also expect that load to
require significant lead time to complete. User agents should usually
enact the speculative load candidate as soon as practical, subject only
to considerations such as user preferences, device conditions, and
resource limits.

"<span id="sr-eagerness-eager" class="dfn">`eager`</span>"  
User agents should enact the speculative load candidate on even a slight
suggestion that the user may navigate to this URL in the future. For
instance, the user might have moved the cursor toward a link or hovered
it, even momentarily, or paused scrolling when the link is one of the
more prominent ones in the viewport. The author is seeking to capture as
many navigations as possible, as early as possible.

"<span id="sr-eagerness-moderate" class="dfn">`moderate`</span>"  
User agents should enact the candidate if user behavior suggests the
user may navigate to this URL in the near future. For instance, the user
might have scrolled a link into the viewport and shown signs of being
likely to click it, e.g., by moving the cursor over it for some time.
The developer is seeking a balance between
"[`eager`](#sr-eagerness-eager)" and
"[`conservative`](#sr-eagerness-conservative)".

"<span id="sr-eagerness-conservative" class="dfn">`conservative`</span>"  
User agents should enact the candidate only when the user is very likely
to navigate to this URL at any moment. For instance, the user might have
begun to interact with a link. The developer is seeking to capture some
of the benefits of speculative loading with a fairly small tradeoff of
resources.

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-2">speculation
rule eagerness</a> `A` is <span id="sr-eagerness-less-eager"
class="dfn">less eager</span> than another
<a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-3">speculation
rule eagerness</a> `B` if `A` follows `B` in the above list.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-4">speculation
rule eagerness</a> `A` is <span id="sr-eagerness-at-least-as-eager"
class="dfn">at least as eager</span> as another
<a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-5">speculation
rule eagerness</a> `B` if `A` is not <a href="#sr-eagerness-less-eager"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:sr-eagerness-less-eager">less eager</a>
than `B`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <span id="speculation-rule-tag" class="dfn">speculation rule
tag</span> is either an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-string"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:ascii-string"
data-x-internal="ascii-string">ASCII string</a> whose
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-point"
id="speculation-rules-data-model:code-point"
data-x-internal="code-point">code points</a> are all in the range U+0020
to U+007E inclusive, or null.

This code point range restriction ensures the value can be sent in an
HTTP header with no escaping or modification.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

A <span id="speculation-rule-requirement" class="dfn">speculation rule
requirement</span> is the string
"`anonymous-client-ip-when-cross-origin`".

In the future, more possible requirements might be defined.

##### <span class="secno">7.6.1.2</span> Parsing<a href="#speculation-rules-parsing" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="note">

Since speculative loading is a progressive enhancement, this standard is
fairly conservative in its parsing behavior. In particular, unknown keys
or invalid values usually cause parsing failure, since it is safer to do
nothing than to possibly misinterpret a speculation rule.

That said, parsing failure for a single speculation rule still allows
other speculation rules to be processed. It is only in the case of
top-level misconfiguration that the entire speculation rule set is
discarded.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="parse-a-speculation-rule-set-string" class="dfn">parse a
speculation rule set string</span> given a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:string"
data-x-internal="string">string</a> `input`, a [`Document`](#document)
`document`, and a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`baseURL`:

1.  Let `parsed` be the result of <a
    href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#parse-a-json-string-to-an-infra-value"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-json-string-to-an-infra-value"
    data-x-internal="parse-a-json-string-to-an-infra-value">parsing a JSON
    string to an Infra value</a> given `input`.

2.  If `parsed` is not a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:ordered-map"
    data-x-internal="ordered-map">map</a>, then throw a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
    data-x-internal="typeerror"><code
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:typeerror">TypeError</code></a>
    indicating that the top-level value needs to be a JSON object.

3.  Let `result` be a new <a href="#speculation-rule-set"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-set">speculation rule
    set</a>.

4.  Let `tag` be null.

5.  If `parsed`\["`tag`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `parsed`\["`tag`"\] is not a <a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-tag">speculation rule
        tag</a>, then throw a <a
        href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
        data-x-internal="typeerror"><code
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:typeerror-2">TypeError</code></a>
        indicating that the speculation rule tag is invalid.

    2.  Set `tag` to `parsed`\["`tag`"\].

6.  Let `typesToTreatAsPrefetch` be « "`prefetch`" ».

7.  The user agent may
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append"
    data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> "`prerender`" to
    `typesToTreatAsPrefetch`.

    <a href="#note-speculation-rules-parse-prerender-as-prefetch"
    class="self-link"></a>Since this specification only includes
    prefetching, this allows user agents to treat requests for
    prerendering as requests for prefetching. User agents which
    implement prerendering, per the Prerendering Revamped specification,
    will instead interpret these as prerender requests.
    [\[PRERENDERING-REVAMPED\]](#refsPRERENDERING-REVAMPED)

8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `type` of
    `typesToTreatAsPrefetch`:

    1.  If `parsed`\[`type`\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-2"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  If `parsed`\[`type`\] is a
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list" data-x-internal="list">list</a>,
            then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-2"
            data-x-internal="list-iterate">for each</a> `rule` of
            `parsed`\[`type`\]:

            1.  Let `rule` be the result of
                <a href="#parse-a-speculation-rule"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-speculation-rule">parsing a
                speculation rule</a> given `rule`, `tag`, `document`,
                and `baseURL`.

            2.  If `rule` is null, then
                <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:continue"
                data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

            3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append-2"
                data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `rule` to
                `result`'s <a href="#sr-set-prefetch"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-set-prefetch">prefetch rules</a>.

        2.  Otherwise, the user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the rules list for `type`
            needs to be a JSON array.

9.  Return `result`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="parse-a-speculation-rule" class="dfn">parse a speculation
rule</span> given a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:ordered-map-2"
data-x-internal="ordered-map">map</a> `input`, a
<a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-tag-2">speculation rule
tag</a> `rulesetLevelTag`, a [`Document`](#document) `document`, and a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`baseURL`:

1.  If `input` is not a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:ordered-map-3"
    data-x-internal="ordered-map">map</a>:

    1.  The user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-2"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the rule needs to be a JSON
        object.

    2.  Return null.

2.  If `input` has any <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-key"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-key" data-x-internal="map-key">key</a>
    other than "`source`", "`urls`", "`where`", "`relative_to`",
    "`eagerness`", "`referrer_policy`", "`tag`", "`requires`",
    "`expects_no_vary_search`", or "`target_hint`":

    1.  The user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-3"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the rule has unrecognized keys.

    2.  Return null.

    <a href="#note-speculation-rules-parse-target-hint"
    class="self-link"></a>"`target_hint`" has no impact on the
    processing model in this standard. However, implementations of
    Prerendering Revamped can use it for prerendering rules, and so
    requiring user agents to fail parsing such rules would be
    counterproductive.
    [\[PRERENDERING-REVAMPED\]](#refsPRERENDERING-REVAMPED).

3.  Let `source` be null.

4.  If `input`\["`source`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then set `source` to
    `input`\["`source`"\].

5.  Otherwise, if `input`\["`urls`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-4"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and `input`\["`where`"\]
    does not <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-5"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then set `source` to
    "`list`".

6.  Otherwise, if `input`\["`where`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-6"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a> and `input`\["`urls`"\] does
    not <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-7"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then set `source` to
    "`document`".

7.  If `source` is neither "`list`" nor "`document`":

    1.  The user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-4"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that a source could not be inferred
        or an invalid source was specified.

    2.  Return null.

8.  Let `urls` be an empty <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

9.  Let `predicate` be null.

10. If `source` is "`list`":

    1.  If `input`\["`where`"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-8"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-5"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that there were conflicting
            sources for this rule.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-9"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\] is neither "`ruleset`" nor
            "`document`":

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-6"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied relative-to
                value was invalid.

            2.  Return null.

        2.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\] is "`document`", then set
            `baseURL` to `document`'s <a href="#document-base-url"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-base-url">document base URL</a>.

    3.  If `input`\["`urls`"\] does not
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-10"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a> or is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-3" data-x-internal="list">list</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-7"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the supplied URL list was
            invalid.

        2.  Return null.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-3"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `urlString` of
        `input`\["`urls`"\]:

        1.  If `urlString` is not a string:

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-8"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied URL must be
                a string.

            2.  Return null.

        2.  Let `parsedURL` be the result of
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-parser"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:url-parser"
            data-x-internal="url-parser">URL parsing</a> `urlString`
            with `baseURL`.

        3.  If `parsedURL` is failure, or `parsedURL`'s
            <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:concept-url-scheme"
            data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is not an
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:http(s)-scheme"
            data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>:

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-9"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied URL string
                was unparseable.

            2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:continue-2"
                data-x-internal="continue">Continue</a>.

        4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append-3"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `parsedURL` to
            `urls`.

11. If `source` is "`document`":

    1.  If `input`\["`urls`"\] or `input`\["`relative_to`"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-11"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-10"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that there were conflicting
            sources for this rule.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  If `input`\["`where`"\] does not
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-12"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then set `predicate` to
        a <a href="#document-rule-conjunction"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-conjunction">document rule
        conjunction</a> whose <a href="#sr-dr-c-clauses"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-c-clauses">clauses</a> is an
        empty <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-4" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

        Such a predicate will match all links.

    3.  Otherwise, set `predicate` to the result of
        <a href="#parse-a-document-rule-predicate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-document-rule-predicate">parsing a
        document rule predicate</a> given `input`\["`where`"\],
        `document`, and `baseURL`.

    4.  If `predicate` is null, then return null.

12. Let `eagerness` be "[`immediate`](#sr-eagerness-immediate)" if
    `source` is "`list`"; otherwise,
    "[`conservative`](#sr-eagerness-conservative)".

13. If `input`\["`eagerness`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-13"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `input`\["`eagerness`"\] is not a
        <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-eagerness">speculation
        rule eagerness</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-11"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the eagerness was invalid.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  Set `eagerness` to `input`\["`eagerness`"\].

14. Let `referrerPolicy` be the empty string.

15. If `input`\["`referrer_policy`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-14"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `input`\["`referrer_policy`"\] is not a <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:referrer-policy"
        data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-12"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the referrer policy was
            invalid.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  Set `referrerPolicy` to `input`\["`referrer_policy`"\].

16. Let `tags` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:set" data-x-internal="set">ordered set</a>.

17. If `rulesetLevelTag` is not null, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:set-append"
    data-x-internal="set-append">append</a> `rulesetLevelTag` to `tags`.

18. If `input`\["`tag`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-15"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `input`\["`tag`"\] is not a <a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-tag-3">speculation rule
        tag</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-13"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the tag was invalid.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:set-append-2"
        data-x-internal="set-append">Append</a> `input`\["`tag`"\] to
        `tags`.

19. If `tags` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-is-empty"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-is-empty"
    data-x-internal="list-is-empty">is empty</a>, then
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:set-append-3"
    data-x-internal="set-append">append</a> null to `tags`.

20. <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:assert"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `tags`'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-size"
    data-x-internal="list-size">size</a> is either 1 or 2.

21. Let `requirements` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:set-2" data-x-internal="set">ordered
    set</a>.

22. If `input`\["`requires`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-16"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `input`\["`requires`"\] is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-5" data-x-internal="list">list</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-14"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the requirements were not
            understood.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-4"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `requirement` of
        `input`\["`requires`"\]:

        1.  If `requirement` is not a
            <a href="#speculation-rule-requirement"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule-requirement">speculation
            rule requirement</a>:

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-15"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the requirement was not
                understood.

            2.  Return null.

        2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:set-append-4"
            data-x-internal="set-append">Append</a> `requirement` to
            `requirements`.

23. Let `noVarySearchHint` be the <a
    href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-data-model"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:default-url-search-variance"
    data-x-internal="default-url-search-variance">default URL search
    variance</a>.

24. If `input`\["`expects_no_vary_search`"\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-17"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  If `input`\["`expects_no_vary_search`"\] is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:string-2"
        data-x-internal="string">string</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-16"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the \`<a
            href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-http-header-field-definitio"
            data-x-internal="no-vary-search"><code
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:no-vary-search">No-Vary-Search</code></a>\`
            hint was invalid.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  Set `noVarySearchHint` to the result of <a
        href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#parse-a-url-search-variance"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-url-search-variance"
        data-x-internal="parse-a-url-search-variance">parsing a URL search
        variance</a> given `input`\["`expects_no_vary_search`"\].

25. Return a <a href="#speculation-rule"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:speculation-rule">speculation rule</a>
    with:

    <a href="#sr-urls" id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-urls">URLs</a>  
    `urls`

    <a href="#sr-predicate"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-predicate">predicate</a>  
    `predicate`

    <a href="#sr-eagerness"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-eagerness">eagerness</a>  
    `eagerness`

    <a href="#sr-referrer-policy"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>  
    `referrerPolicy`

    <a href="#sr-tags" id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-tags">tags</a>  
    `tags`

    <a href="#sr-requirements"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-requirements">requirements</a>  
    `requirements`

    <a href="#sr-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-nvs-hint">No-Vary-Search hint</a>  
    `noVarySearchHint`

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="parse-a-document-rule-predicate" class="dfn">parse a
document rule predicate</span> given a value `input`, a
[`Document`](#document) `document`, and a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="speculation-rules-parsing:url-3" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>
`baseURL`:

1.  If `input` is not a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:ordered-map-4"
    data-x-internal="ordered-map">map</a>:

    1.  The user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-17"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate was
        invalid.

    2.  Return null.

2.  If `input` does not
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-18"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">contain</a> exactly one of "`and`",
    "`or`", "`not`", "`href_matches`", or "`selector_matches`":

    1.  The user agent may <a
        href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-18"
        data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
        the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate was
        empty or ambiguous.

    2.  Return null.

3.  Let `predicateType` be the single key found in the previous step.

4.  If `predicateType` is "`and`" or "`or`":

    1.  If `input` has any
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-key"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-key-2"
        data-x-internal="map-key">key</a> other than `predicateType`:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-19"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate
            had unexpected extra options.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  If `input`\[`predicateType`\] is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-6" data-x-internal="list">list</a>:

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-20"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate
            had an invalid clause list.

        2.  Return null.

    3.  Let `clauses` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-7" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-5"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `rawClause` of
        `input`\[`predicateType`\]:

        1.  Let `clause` be the result of
            <a href="#parse-a-document-rule-predicate"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-document-rule-predicate-2">parsing
            a document rule predicate</a> given `rawClause`, `document`,
            and `baseURL`.

        2.  If `clause` is null, then return null.

        3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append-4"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `clause` to
            `clauses`.

    5.  If `predicateType` is "`and`", then return a
        <a href="#document-rule-conjunction"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-conjunction-2">document rule
        conjunction</a> whose <a href="#sr-dr-c-clauses"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-c-clauses-2">clauses</a> is
        `clauses`.

    6.  Return a <a href="#document-rule-disjunction"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-disjunction">document rule
        disjunction</a> whose <a href="#sr-dr-d-clauses"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-d-clauses">clauses</a> is
        `clauses`.

5.  If `predicateType` is "`not`":

    1.  If `input` has any
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-key"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-key-3"
        data-x-internal="map-key">key</a> other than "`not`":

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-21"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate
            had unexpected extra options.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  Let `clause` be the result of
        <a href="#parse-a-document-rule-predicate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-document-rule-predicate-3">parsing
        a document rule predicate</a> given `input`\[`predicateType`\],
        `document`, and `baseURL`.

    3.  If `clause` is null, then return null.

    4.  Return a <a href="#document-rule-negation"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-negation">document rule
        negation</a> whose <a href="#sr-dr-n-clause"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-n-clause">clause</a> is
        `clause`.

6.  If `predicateType` is "`href_matches`":

    1.  If `input` has any
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-key"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-key-4"
        data-x-internal="map-key">key</a> other than "`href_matches`" or
        "`relative_to`":

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-22"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate
            had unexpected extra options.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\]
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-exists-19"
        data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

        1.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\] is neither "`ruleset`" nor
            "`document`":

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-23"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied relative-to
                value was invalid.

            2.  Return null.

        2.  If `input`\["`relative_to`"\] is "`document`", then set
            `baseURL` to `document`'s <a href="#document-base-url"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-base-url-2">document base URL</a>.

    3.  Let `rawPatterns` be `input`\["`href_matches`"\].

    4.  If `rawPatterns` is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-8" data-x-internal="list">list</a>,
        then set `rawPatterns` to « `rawPatterns` ».

    5.  Let `patterns` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-9" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-6"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `rawPattern` of
        `rawPatterns`:

        1.  Let `pattern` be the result of <a
            href="https://urlpattern.spec.whatwg.org/#build-a-url-pattern-from-an-infra-value"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:build-a-url-pattern-from-an-infra-value"
            data-x-internal="build-a-url-pattern-from-an-infra-value">building a URL
            pattern from an Infra value</a> given `rawPattern` and
            `baseURL`. If this step throws an exception, catch the
            exception and set `pattern` to null.

        2.  If `pattern` is null:

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-24"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied URL pattern
                was invalid.

            2.  Return null.

        3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append-5"
            data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `pattern` to
            `patterns`.

    7.  Return a <a href="#document-rule-url-pattern-predicate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-url-pattern-predicate">document
        rule URL pattern predicate</a> whose
        <a href="#sr-dr-urlpattern-patterns"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-urlpattern-patterns">patterns</a>
        is `patterns`.

7.  If `predicateType` is "`selector_matches`":

    1.  If `input` has any
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-key"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:map-key-5"
        data-x-internal="map-key">key</a> other than
        "`selector_matches`":

        1.  The user agent may <a
            href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-25"
            data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
            the console</a> indicating that the document rule predicate
            had unexpected extra options.

        2.  Return null.

    2.  Let `rawSelectors` be `input`\["`selector_matches`"\].

    3.  If `rawSelectors` is not a
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-10" data-x-internal="list">list</a>,
        then set `rawSelectors` to « `rawSelectors` ».

    4.  Let `selectors` be an empty
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-11" data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

    5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-7"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `rawSelector` of
        `rawSelectors`:

        1.  Let `parsedSelectorList` be failure.

        2.  If `rawSelector` is a string, then set `parsedSelectorList`
            to the result of
            <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/selectors/#parse-a-selector"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:parse-a-selector"
            data-x-internal="parse-a-selector">parsing a selector</a>
            given `rawSelector`.

        3.  If `parsedSelectorList` is failure:

            1.  The user agent may <a
                href="https://console.spec.whatwg.org/#report-a-warning-to-the-console"
                id="speculation-rules-parsing:report-a-warning-to-the-console-26"
                data-x-internal="report-a-warning-to-the-console">report a warning to
                the console</a> indicating that the supplied selector
                list was invalid.

            2.  Return null.

        4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-iterate-8"
            data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `selector` of
            `parsedSelectorList`,
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
            id="speculation-rules-parsing:list-append-6"
            data-x-internal="list-append">append</a> `selector` to
            `selectors`.

    6.  Return a <a href="#document-rule-selector-predicate"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:document-rule-selector-predicate">document
        rule selector predicate</a> whose
        <a href="#sr-dr-cssselector-selectors"
        id="speculation-rules-parsing:sr-dr-cssselector-selectors">selectors</a>
        is `selectors`.

8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="speculation-rules-parsing:assert-2"
    data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: this step is never reached, as
    one of the previous branches was taken.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">7.6.1.3</span> Processing model<a href="#speculation-rules-processing-model" class="self-link"></a>

A <span id="speculative-load-candidate" class="dfn">speculative load
candidate</span> is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:struct"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> with the following
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:struct-item"
data-x-internal="struct-item">items</a>:

- <span id="sl-candidate-url" class="dfn">URL</span>, a
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:url"
  data-x-internal="url">URL</a>

- <span id="sl-candidate-nvs-hint" class="dfn">No-Vary-Search
  hint</span>, a <a
  href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-data-model"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:url-search-variance"
  data-x-internal="url-search-variance">URL search variance</a>

- <span id="sl-candidate-eagerness" class="dfn">eagerness</span>, a
  <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-eagerness">speculation
  rule eagerness</a>

- <span id="sl-candidate-referrer-policy" class="dfn">referrer
  policy</span>, a <a
  href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:referrer-policy"
  data-x-internal="referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>

- <span id="sl-candidate-tags" class="dfn">tags</span>, an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:set"
  data-x-internal="set">ordered set</a> of
  <a href="#speculation-rule-tag"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-tag">speculation
  rule tags</a>

A <span id="prefetch-candidate" class="dfn">prefetch candidate</span> is
a <a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate">speculative
load candidate</a> with the following additional
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:struct-item-2"
data-x-internal="struct-item">item</a>:

- <span id="sl-candidate-anonymization-policy" class="dfn">anonymization
  policy</span>, a <a href="#prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy">prefetch
  IP anonymization policy</a>

A <span id="prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy" class="dfn">prefetch IP
anonymization policy</span> is either null or a
<a href="#cross-origin-prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:cross-origin-prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy">cross-origin
prefetch IP anonymization policy</a>.

A <span id="cross-origin-prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy"
class="dfn">cross-origin prefetch IP anonymization policy</span> is a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:struct-2"
data-x-internal="struct">struct</a> whose single
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#struct-item"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:struct-item-3"
data-x-internal="struct-item">item</a> is its <span id="copiap-origin"
class="dfn">origin</span>, an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:concept-origin">origin</a>.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

A <a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate-2">speculative
load candidate</a> `candidateA` is
<span id="sl-candidate-redundant-with" class="dfn">redundant with</span>
another <a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate-3">speculative
load candidate</a> `candidateB` if the following steps return true:

1.  If `candidateA`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a> is not equal to `candidateB`'s
    <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-2">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a>, then return false.

2.  If `candidateA`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url">URL</a> is
    not <a
    href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-comparing"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:equivalent-modulo-search-variance"
    data-x-internal="equivalent-modulo-search-variance">equivalent modulo
    search variance</a> to `candidateB`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-2">URL</a>
    given `candidateA`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-3">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a>, then return false.

3.  Return true.

</div>

<div id="note-sl-candidate-redundant-with-nvs-strictness" class="note">

<a href="#note-sl-candidate-redundant-with-nvs-strictness"
class="self-link"></a>

The requirement that the <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-4">No-Vary-Search
hints</a> be equivalent is somewhat strict. It means that some cases
which could theoretically be treated as matching, are not treated as
such. Thus, redundant speculative loads could happen.

However, allowing more lenient matching makes the check no longer an
equivalence relation, and producing such matches would require an
implementation strategy that does a full comparison, instead of a
simpler one using normalized URL keys. This is in line with the best
practices for server operators, and attendant HTTP cache implementation
notes, in [No Vary Search § 6
Comparing](https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#section-6).

In practice, we do not expect this to cause redundant speculative loads,
since server operators and the corresponding speculation rules-writing
web developers will follow best practices and use static \`<a
href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-http-header-field-definitio"
data-x-internal="no-vary-search"><code
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:no-vary-search">No-Vary-Search</code></a>\`
header values/speculation rule hints.

</div>

<div id="example-sl-candidate-reundant-with-nvs-strictness"
class="example" var-scope="">

<a href="#example-sl-candidate-reundant-with-nvs-strictness"
class="self-link"></a>

Consider three <a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate-4">speculative
load candidates</a>:

1.  `A` has a <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-3">URL</a>
    of `https://example.com?a=1&b=1` and a
    <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-5">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a> parsed from `params=("a")`.

2.  `B` has a <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-4">URL</a>
    of `https://example.com?a=2&b=1` and a
    <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-6">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a> parsed from `params=("b")`.

3.  `C` has a <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-5">URL</a>
    of `https://example.com?a=2&b=2` and a
    <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-7">No-Vary-Search
    hint</a> parsed from `params=("a")`.

With the current definition of <a href="#sl-candidate-redundant-with"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-redundant-with">redundant
with</a>, none of these candidates are redundant with each other. A
<a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-set">speculation
rule set</a> which contained all three could cause three separate
speculative loads.

A definition which did not require equivalent
<a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-8">No-Vary-Search
hints</a> could consider `A` and `B` to match (using `A`'s
<a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-9">No-Vary-Search
hint</a>), and `B` and `C` to match (using `B`'s
<a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-10">No-Vary-Search
hint</a>). But it could not consider `A` and `C` to match, so it would
not be transitive, and thus not an equivalence relation.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every [`Document`](#document) has <span id="document-sr-sets"
class="dfn">speculation rule sets</span>, a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list"
data-x-internal="list">list</a> of <a href="#speculation-rule-set"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-set-2">speculation
rule sets</a>, initially empty.

Every [`Document`](#document) has a
<span id="consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued"
class="dfn">consider speculative loads microtask queued</span>, a
boolean, initially false.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="consider-speculative-loads" class="dfn">consider
speculative loads</span> for a [`Document`](#document) `document`:

1.  <div id="step-consider-speculative-loads-top-level-only">

    If `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a> is not a <a href="#top-level-traversable"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:top-level-traversable">top-level
    traversable</a>, then return.

    Supporting speculative loads into <a href="#child-navigable"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:child-navigable">child
    navigables</a> has some complexities and is not currently defined.
    It might be possible to define it in the future.

    </div>

2.  If `document`'s
    <a href="#consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued">consider
    speculative loads microtask queued</a> is true, then return.

3.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="#consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued-2">consider
    speculative loads microtask queued</a> to true.

4.  <a href="#queue-a-microtask"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:queue-a-microtask">Queue a
    microtask</a> given `document` to run the following steps:

    1.  Set `document`'s
        <a href="#consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-microtask-queued-3">consider
        speculative loads microtask queued</a> to false.

    2.  Run the <a href="#inner-consider-speculative-loads-steps"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:inner-consider-speculative-loads-steps">inner
        consider speculative loads steps</a> for `document`.

</div>

In addition to the call sites explicitly given in this standard:

- When style recalculation would cause selector matching results to
  change, the user agent must <a href="#consider-speculative-loads"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads">consider
  speculative loads</a> for the relevant [`Document`](#document).

- When the user indicates interest in <a href="#hyperlink"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:hyperlink">hyperlinks</a>, in
  one of the
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:implementation-defined"
  data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
  ways that the user agent uses to implement the
  <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-2">speculation
  rule eagerness</a> heuristics, the user agent may
  <a href="#consider-speculative-loads"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-2">consider
  speculative loads</a> for the hyperlink's
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:node-document"
  data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

  For example, a user agent which implements
  "[`conservative`](#sr-eagerness-conservative)" eagerness by watching
  for
  <a href="https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#the-pointerdown-event"
  data-x-internal="event-pointerdown"><code
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:event-pointerdown">pointerdown</code></a>
  events would want to <a href="#consider-speculative-loads"
  id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-3">consider
  speculative loads</a> as part of reacting to such events.

<div id="note-consider-speculative-loads-stateless" class="note">

<a href="#note-consider-speculative-loads-stateless"
class="self-link"></a>

In this standard, every call to <a href="#consider-speculative-loads"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-4">consider
speculative loads</a> is given just a [`Document`](#document), and the
algorithm re-computes all possible candidates in a stateless way. A real
implementation would likely cache previous computations, and pass along
information from the call site to make updates more efficient. For
example, if an [`a`](#the-a-element) element's
[`href`](#attr-hyperlink-href) attribute is changed, that specific
element could be passed along in order to update only the related
<a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate-5">speculative
load candidate</a>.

Note that because of how <a href="#consider-speculative-loads"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:consider-speculative-loads-5">consider
speculative loads</a> queues a microtask, by the time the
<a href="#inner-consider-speculative-loads-steps"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:inner-consider-speculative-loads-steps-2">inner
consider speculative loads steps</a> are run, multiple updates (or
[cancelations](#step-prefetch-record-cancel-and-discard)) might be
processed together.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="inner-consider-speculative-loads-steps" class="dfn">inner
consider speculative loads steps</span> for a [`Document`](#document)
`document` are:

1.  If `document` is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:fully-active">fully active</a>,
    then return.

2.  Let `prefetchCandidates` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-2"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `ruleSet` of
    `document`'s <a href="#document-sr-sets"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:document-sr-sets">speculation
    rule sets</a>:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-2"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `rule` of
        `ruleSet`'s <a href="#sr-set-prefetch"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-set-prefetch">prefetch
        rules</a>:

        1.  Let `anonymizationPolicy` be null.

        2.  If `rule`'s <a href="#sr-requirements"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-requirements">requirements</a>
            <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-contains"
            data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a>
            "`anonymous-client-ip-when-cross-origin`", then set
            `anonymizationPolicy` to a
            <a href="#cross-origin-prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:cross-origin-prefetch-ip-anonymization-policy-2">cross-origin
            prefetch IP anonymization policy</a> whose
            <a href="#copiap-origin"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:copiap-origin">origin</a>
            is `document`'s
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:concept-document-origin"
            data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>.

        3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-3"
            data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `url` of
            `rule`'s <a href="#sr-urls"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-urls">URLs</a>:

            1.  Let `referrerPolicy` be the result of
                <a href="#compute-a-speculative-load-referrer-policy"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:compute-a-speculative-load-referrer-policy">computing
                a speculative load referrer policy</a> given `rule` and
                null.

            2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-append"
                data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> a new
                <a href="#prefetch-candidate"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-candidate">prefetch
                candidate</a> with

                <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-6">URL</a>  
                `url`

                <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-11">No-Vary-Search
                hint</a>  
                `rule`'s <a href="#sr-nvs-hint"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-nvs-hint">No-Vary-Search
                hint</a>

                <a href="#sl-candidate-eagerness"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-eagerness">eagerness</a>  
                `rule`'s <a href="#sr-eagerness"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-eagerness">eagerness</a>

                <a href="#sl-candidate-referrer-policy"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-referrer-policy">referrer
                policy</a>  
                `referrerPolicy`

                <a href="#sl-candidate-tags"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-tags">tags</a>  
                `rule`'s <a href="#sr-tags"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-tags">tags</a>

                <a href="#sl-candidate-anonymization-policy"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-anonymization-policy">anonymization
                policy</a>  
                `anonymizationPolicy`

                to `prefetchCandidates`.

        4.  If `rule`'s <a href="#sr-predicate"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-predicate">predicate</a>
            is not null:

            1.  Let `links` be the result of
                <a href="#find-matching-links"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:find-matching-links">finding
                matching links</a> given `document` and `rule`'s
                <a href="#sr-predicate"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-predicate-2">predicate</a>.

            2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
                id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-4"
                data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `link` of
                `links`:

                1.  Let `referrerPolicy` be the result of
                    <a href="#compute-a-speculative-load-referrer-policy"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:compute-a-speculative-load-referrer-policy-2">computing
                    a speculative load referrer policy</a> given `rule`
                    and `link`.

                2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-append-2"
                    data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> a new
                    <a href="#prefetch-candidate"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-candidate-2">prefetch
                    candidate</a> with

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-7">URL</a>  
                    `link`'s <a href="#concept-hyperlink-url"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:concept-hyperlink-url">url</a>

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-12">No-Vary-Search
                    hint</a>  
                    `rule`'s <a href="#sr-nvs-hint"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-nvs-hint-2">No-Vary-Search
                    hint</a>

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-eagerness"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-eagerness-2">eagerness</a>  
                    `rule`'s <a href="#sr-eagerness"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-eagerness-2">eagerness</a>

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-referrer-policy"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-referrer-policy-2">referrer
                    policy</a>  
                    `referrerPolicy`

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-tags"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-tags-2">tags</a>  
                    `rule`'s <a href="#sr-tags"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-tags-2">tags</a>

                    <a href="#sl-candidate-anonymization-policy"
                    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-anonymization-policy-2">anonymization
                    policy</a>  
                    `anonymizationPolicy`

                    to `prefetchCandidates`.

4.  <div id="step-prefetch-record-cancel-and-discard">

    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-5"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `prefetchRecord` of
    `document`'s <a
    href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#document-prefetch-records"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:document-prefetch-records"
    data-x-internal="document-prefetch-records">prefetch records</a>:

    1.  If `prefetchRecord`'s <a
        href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-source"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-source"
        data-x-internal="prefetch-record-source">source</a> is not
        "`speculation rules`", then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:continue"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:assert"
        data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>: `prefetchRecord`'s <a
        href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-state"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-state"
        data-x-internal="prefetch-record-state">state</a> is not
        "`canceled`".

    3.  If `prefetchRecord` is not <a
        href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-still-being-speculated"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:still-being-speculated"
        data-x-internal="still-being-speculated">still being speculated</a>
        given `prefetchCandidates`, then <a
        href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-cancel-and-discard"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-cancel-and-discard"
        data-x-internal="prefetch-record-cancel-and-discard">cancel and
        discard</a> `prefetchRecord` given `document`.

    </div>

5.  Let `prefetchCandidateGroups` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-3"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

6.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-6"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `candidate` of
    `prefetchCandidates`:

    1.  Let `group` be « `candidate` ».

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-extend"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-extend"
        data-x-internal="list-extend">Extend</a> `group` with all
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-item"
        data-x-internal="list-item">items</a> in `prefetchCandidates`,
        apart from `candidate` itself, which are
        <a href="#sl-candidate-redundant-with"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-redundant-with-2">redundant
        with</a> `candidate` and whose <a href="#sl-candidate-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-eagerness-3">eagerness</a>
        is <a href="#sr-eagerness-at-least-as-eager"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-eagerness-at-least-as-eager">at
        least as eager</a> as `candidate`'s
        <a href="#sl-candidate-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-eagerness-4">eagerness</a>.

    3.  If `prefetchCandidateGroups`
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-contains-2"
        data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> another group whose
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-item"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-item-2"
        data-x-internal="list-item">items</a> are the same as `group`,
        ignoring order, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:continue-2"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-append-3"
        data-x-internal="list-append">Append</a> `group` to
        `prefetchCandidateGroups`.

    <div id="example-redundant-speculation-rules" class="example">

    <a href="#example-redundant-speculation-rules" class="self-link"></a>
    The following speculation rules generate two
    <a href="#sl-candidate-redundant-with"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-redundant-with-3">redundant</a>
    <a href="#prefetch-candidate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-candidate-3">prefetch
    candidates</a>:

    ``` json
    {
      "prefetch": [
        {
          "tag": "a",
          "urls": ["next.html"]
        },
        {
          "tag": "b",
          "urls": ["next.html"],
          "referrer_policy": "no-referrer"
        }
      ]
    }
    ```

    This step will create a single group containing them both, in the
    given order. (The second pass through will not create a group, since
    its contents would be the same as the first group, just in a
    different order.) This means that if the user agent chooses to
    execute the "may" step below to enact the group, it will enact the
    first candidate, and ignore the second. Thus, the request will be
    made with the <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#default-referrer-policy"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:default-referrer-policy"
    data-x-internal="default-referrer-policy">default referrer policy</a>,
    instead of using "<a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#referrer-policy-no-referrer"
    data-x-internal="referrer-policy-no-referrer"><code
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:referrer-policy-no-referrer">no-referrer</code></a>".

    However, the
    <a href="#collect-tags-from-speculative-load-candidates"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:collect-tags-from-speculative-load-candidates">collect
    tags from speculative load candidates</a> algorithm will collect
    tags from both candidates in the group, so the
    \`[`Sec-Speculation-Tags`](#sec-speculation-tags)\` header value
    will be \``"a", "b"`\`. This indicates to server operators that
    either rule could have caused the speculative load.

    </div>

7.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-7"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `group` of
    `prefetchCandidateGroups`:

    1.  The user agent may run the following steps:

        1.  Let `prefetchCandidate` be `group`\[0\].

        2.  Let `tagsToSend` be the result of
            <a href="#collect-tags-from-speculative-load-candidates"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:collect-tags-from-speculative-load-candidates-2">collecting
            tags from speculative load candidates</a> given `group`.

        3.  Let `prefetchRecord` be a new <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record">prefetch record</a> with

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-source"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-source-2"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-source">source</a>  
            "`speculation rules`"

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-url"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-url"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-url">URL</a>  
            `prefetchCandidate`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-8">URL</a>

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-no-vary-search-hint"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-nvs-hint"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-nvs-hint">No-Vary-Search hint</a>  
            `prefetchCandidate`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-13">No-Vary-Search
            hint</a>

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-referrer-policy"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-referrer-policy"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a>  
            `prefetchCandidate`'s
            <a href="#sl-candidate-referrer-policy"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-referrer-policy-3">referrer
            policy</a>

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-anonymization-policy"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-anonymization-policy"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-anonymization-policy">anonymization
            policy</a>  
            `prefetchCandidate`'s
            <a href="#sl-candidate-anonymization-policy"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-anonymization-policy-3">anonymization
            policy</a>

            <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#prefetch-record-tags"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:prefetch-record-tags"
            data-x-internal="prefetch-record-tags">tags</a>  
            `tagsToSend`

        4.  <a
            href="https://wicg.github.io/nav-speculation/prefetch.html#start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch"
            id="speculation-rules-processing-model:start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch"
            data-x-internal="start-a-referrer-initiated-navigational-prefetch">Start
            a referrer-initiated navigational prefetch</a> given
            `document` and `prefetchRecord`.

        When deciding whether to execute this "may" step, user agents
        should consider `prefetchCandidate`'s
        <a href="#sl-candidate-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-eagerness-5">eagerness</a>,
        in accordance to the current behavior of the user and the
        definitions of <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-3">speculation
        rule eagerness</a>.

        `prefetchCandidate`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-14">No-Vary-Search
        hint</a> can also be useful in implementing the heuristics
        defined for the <a href="#speculation-rule-eagerness"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule-eagerness-4">speculation
        rule eagerness</a> values. For example, a user hovering of a
        link whose <a href="#concept-hyperlink-url"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:concept-hyperlink-url-2">URL</a>
        is <a
        href="https://httpwg.org/http-extensions/draft-ietf-httpbis-no-vary-search.html#name-comparing"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:equivalent-modulo-search-variance-2"
        data-x-internal="equivalent-modulo-search-variance">equivalent modulo
        search variance</a> to `prefetchCandidate`'s
        <a href="#sl-candidate-url"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-url-9">URL</a>
        given `prefetchCandidate`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-nvs-hint"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-nvs-hint-15">No-Vary-Search
        hint</a> could indicate to the user agent that performing this
        step would be useful.

        When deciding whether to execute this "may" step, user agents
        should prioritize user preferences (express or implied, such as
        data-saver or battery-saver modes) over the eagerness supplied
        by the web developer.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="compute-a-speculative-load-referrer-policy"
class="dfn">compute a speculative load referrer policy</span> given a
<a href="#speculation-rule"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculation-rule">speculation
rule</a> `rule` and an [`a`](#the-a-element) element,
[`area`](#the-area-element) element, or null `link`:

1.  If `rule`'s <a href="#sr-referrer-policy"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-referrer-policy">referrer
    policy</a> is not the empty string, then return `rule`'s
    <a href="#sr-referrer-policy"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sr-referrer-policy-2">referrer
    policy</a>.

2.  If `link` is null, then return the empty string.

3.  Return `link`'s <a href="#hyperlink-referrer-policy"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:hyperlink-referrer-policy">hyperlink
    referrer policy</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="collect-tags-from-speculative-load-candidates"
class="dfn">collect tags from speculative load candidates</span> given a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-4"
data-x-internal="list">list</a> of <a href="#speculative-load-candidate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:speculative-load-candidate-6">speculative
load candidates</a> `candidates`:

1.  Let `tags` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-set"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:set-2"
    data-x-internal="set">ordered set</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-8"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `candidate` of
    `candidates`:

    1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-9"
        data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `tag` of
        `candidate`'s <a href="#sl-candidate-tags"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:sl-candidate-tags-3">tags</a>:
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#set-append"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:set-append"
        data-x-internal="set-append">append</a> `tag` to `tags`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-sort-in-ascending-order"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-sort"
    data-x-internal="list-sort">Sort in ascending order</a> `tags`, with
    `tagA` being less than `tagB` if `tagA` is null, or if `tagA` is
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-unit-less-than"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:code-unit-less-than"
    data-x-internal="code-unit-less-than">code unit less than</a>
    `tagB`.

4.  Return `tags`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="find-matching-links" class="dfn">find matching links</span>
given a [`Document`](#document) `document` and a
<a href="#document-rule-predicate"
id="speculation-rules-processing-model:document-rule-predicate">document
rule predicate</a> `predicate`:

1.  Let `links` be an empty
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-5"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a>.

2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:list-iterate-10"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-descendant"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:shadow-including-descendant"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-descendant">shadow-including
    descendant</a> `descendant` of `document`, in <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-tree-order"
    id="speculation-rules-processing-model:shadow-including-tree-order"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-tree-order">shadow-including tree
    order</a>:

    1.  If `descendant` is not an [`a`](#the-a-element) or
        [`area`](#the-area-element) element with an
        [`href`](#attr-hyperlink-href) attribute, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:continue-3"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

    2.  If `descendant` is not <a href="#being-rendered"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:being-rendered">being
        rendered</a> or is part of
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-contain/#skips-its-contents"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:skips-its-contents"
        data-x-internal="skips-its-contents">skipped contents</a>, then
        <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue"
        id="speculation-rules-processing-model:continue-4"
        data-x-internal="continue">continue</a>.

        Such links, though present in `document`, aren't available for
        the user to interact with, and thus are unlikely to be good
        candidates. In addition, they might not have their style or
        layout computed, which might make selector matching less
        efficient in user agents which skip some or all of that work for
