otherwise stated, its value is false.

<span id="concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority" class="dfn">fetch priority</span>  
The <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-priority"
data-x-internal="concept-request-priority">priority</a> used for the
initial fetch

Recall that via the <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-import-calls"
data-x-internal="import()"><code
id="fetching-scripts:import()">import()</code></a> feature,
<a href="#classic-script" id="fetching-scripts:classic-script-3">classic
scripts</a> can import
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-5">module
scripts</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="default-script-fetch-options" class="dfn">default script
fetch options</span> are a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options">script fetch options</a>
whose <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-nonce"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-nonce">cryptographic
nonce</a> is the empty string,
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-integrity">integrity
metadata</a> is the empty string,
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-parser"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-parser">parser
metadata</a> is "`not-parser-inserted`",
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials">credentials
mode</a> is "`same-origin`",
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy">referrer
policy</a> is the empty string, and
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority">fetch
priority</a> is "`auto`".

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="set-up-the-classic-script-request" class="dfn">set up the
classic script request</span>, given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> `request` and a
<a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-2">script fetch options</a>
`options`, set `request`'s
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-nonce-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-nonce-metadata-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-nonce-metadata">cryptographic nonce
metadata</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-nonce"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-nonce-2">cryptographic
nonce</a>, its <a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-integrity-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-integrity-metadata-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-integrity-metadata">integrity
metadata</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-integrity-2">integrity
metadata</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-parser-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-parser-metadata-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-parser-metadata">parser metadata</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-parser"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-parser-2">parser
metadata</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-referrer-policy-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy-2">referrer
policy</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-render-blocking"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-render-blocking-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-render-blocking">render-blocking</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking">render-blocking</a>,
and its <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-priority-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-priority">priority</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority-2">fetch
priority</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="set-up-the-module-script-request" class="dfn">set up the
module script request</span>, given a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> `request` and a
<a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-3">script fetch options</a>
`options`, set `request`'s
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-nonce-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-nonce-metadata-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-nonce-metadata">cryptographic nonce
metadata</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-nonce"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-nonce-3">cryptographic
nonce</a>, its <a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-integrity-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-integrity-metadata-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-integrity-metadata">integrity
metadata</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-integrity-3">integrity
metadata</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-parser-metadata"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-parser-metadata-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-parser-metadata">parser metadata</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-parser"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-parser-3">parser
metadata</a>, its <a
href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-credentials-mode-2"
data-x-internal="concept-request-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>
to `options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials-2">credentials
mode</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer-policy"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-referrer-policy-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer-policy">referrer policy</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy-3">referrer
policy</a>, its
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-render-blocking"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-render-blocking-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-render-blocking">render-blocking</a> to
`options`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-render-blocking-2">render-blocking</a>,
and its <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-priority-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-priority">priority</a> to `options`'s
<a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority-3">fetch
priority</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="get-the-descendant-script-fetch-options" class="dfn">get
the descendant script fetch options</span> given a
<a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-4">script fetch options</a>
`originalOptions`, a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, and an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`:

1.  Let `newOptions` be a copy of `originalOptions`.

2.  Let `integrity` be the result of
    <a href="#resolving-a-module-integrity-metadata"
    id="fetching-scripts:resolving-a-module-integrity-metadata">resolving a
    module integrity metadata</a> with `url` and `settingsObject`.

3.  Set `newOptions`'s <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-integrity-4">integrity
    metadata</a> to `integrity`.

4.  Set `newOptions`'s
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority-4">fetch
    priority</a> to "`auto`".

5.  Return `newOptions`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="resolving-a-module-integrity-metadata" class="dfn">resolve
a module integrity metadata</span>, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url` and an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-2">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`:

1.  Let `map` be `settingsObject`'s
    <a href="#concept-settings-object-global"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-settings-object-global">global object</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-global-import-map"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-global-import-map">import map</a>.

2.  If `map`'s <a href="#concept-import-map-integrity"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-import-map-integrity">integrity</a>\[`url`\]
    does not <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="fetching-scripts:map-exists" data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>,
    then return the empty string.

3.  Return `map`'s <a href="#concept-import-map-integrity"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-import-map-integrity-2">integrity</a>\[`url`\].

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

Several of the below algorithms can be customized with a
<span id="fetching-scripts-perform-fetch" class="dfn"
dfn-for="fetching scripts" export="">perform the fetch hook</span>
algorithm, which takes a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a>, a boolean
[`isTopLevel`](#fetching-scripts-is-top-level), and a
<span id="fetching-scripts-processcustomfetchresponse" class="dfn"
dfn-for="fetching
  scripts" export="">`processCustomFetchResponse`</span> algorithm. It
runs
[`processCustomFetchResponse`](#fetching-scripts-processcustomfetchresponse)
with a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-3"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> and either null (on
failure) or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence" data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte
sequence</a> containing the response body.
<span id="fetching-scripts-is-top-level" class="dfn"
dfn-for="fetching scripts" export="">`isTopLevel`</span> will be true
for all
<a href="#classic-script" id="fetching-scripts:classic-script-4">classic
script</a> fetches, and for the initial fetch when
<a href="#fetch-a-module-script-tree"
id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-module-script-tree">fetching an external
module script graph</a> or <a href="#fetch-a-module-worker-script-tree"
id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-module-worker-script-tree">fetching a
module worker script graph</a>, but false for the fetches resulting from
`import` statements encountered throughout the graph or from `import()`
expressions.

</div>

By default, not supplying a <a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch">perform the fetch
hook</a> will cause the below algorithms to simply
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> the given
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-4"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a>, with algorithm-specific
customizations to the
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-5"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> and validations of the
resulting <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-4"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>.

To layer your own customizations on top of these algorithm-specific
ones, supply a <a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-2">perform the fetch
hook</a> that modifies the given
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-6"
data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a>,
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-2"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetches</a> it, and then performs
specific validations of the resulting
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-5"
data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> (completing with a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
id="fetching-scripts:network-error"
data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a> if the validations
fail).

The hook can also be used to perform more subtle customizations, such as
keeping a cache of
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-6"
data-x-internal="concept-response">responses</a> and avoiding performing
a <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-3"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> at all.

Service Workers is an example of a specification that runs these
algorithms with its own options for the hook. [\[SW\]](#refsSW)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Now for the algorithms themselves.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-classic-script" class="dfn" export="">fetch a
classic script</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-3" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-3">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-5">script fetch options</a>
`options`, a <a href="#cors-settings-attribute"
id="fetching-scripts:cors-settings-attribute">CORS settings attribute
state</a> `corsSetting`, an
<a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding"
id="fetching-scripts:encoding" data-x-internal="encoding">encoding</a>
`encoding`, and an algorithm `onComplete`, run these steps. `onComplete`
must be an algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#classic-script" id="fetching-scripts:classic-script-5">classic
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `request` be the result of
    <a href="#create-a-potential-cors-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:create-a-potential-cors-request">creating a
    potential-CORS request</a> given `url`, "`script`", and
    `corsSetting`.

2.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-client"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> to
    `settingsObject`.

3.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-initiator-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    to "`script`".

4.  <a href="#set-up-the-classic-script-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:set-up-the-classic-script-request">Set up the
    classic script request</a> given `request` and `options`.

5.  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">Fetch</a> `request` with the
    following
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    steps given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-7"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence-2"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes`:

    `response` can be either <a href="#cors-same-origin"
    id="fetching-scripts:cors-same-origin">CORS-same-origin</a> or
    <a href="#cors-cross-origin"
    id="fetching-scripts:cors-cross-origin">CORS-cross-origin</a>. This
    only affects how error reporting happens.

    1.  Set `response` to `response`'s
        <a href="#unsafe-response" id="fetching-scripts:unsafe-response">unsafe
        response</a>.

    2.  If any of the following are true:

        - `bodyBytes` is null or failure; or

        - `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-status"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not an
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:ok-status" data-x-internal="ok-status">ok
          status</a>,

        then run `onComplete` given null, and abort these steps.

        For historical reasons, this algorithm does not include MIME
        type checking, unlike the other script-fetching algorithms in
        this section.

    3.  Let `potentialMIMETypeForEncoding` be the result of <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-extract-mime-type"
        id="fetching-scripts:extract-a-mime-type"
        data-x-internal="extract-a-mime-type">extracting a MIME type</a>
        given `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-header-list"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

    4.  Set `encoding` to the result of
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#legacy-extract-an-encoding"
        id="fetching-scripts:legacy-extract-an-encoding"
        data-x-internal="legacy-extract-an-encoding">legacy extracting an
        encoding</a> given `potentialMIMETypeForEncoding` and
        `encoding`.

        This intentionally ignores the
        <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence"
        id="fetching-scripts:mime-type-essence"
        data-x-internal="mime-type-essence">MIME type essence</a>.

    5.  Let `sourceText` be the result of
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#decode"
        id="fetching-scripts:decode" data-x-internal="decode">decoding</a>
        `bodyBytes` to Unicode, using `encoding` as the fallback
        encoding.

        The <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#decode"
        id="fetching-scripts:decode-2" data-x-internal="decode">decode</a>
        algorithm overrides `encoding` if the file contains a BOM.

    6.  Let `mutedErrors` be true if `response` was
        <a href="#cors-cross-origin"
        id="fetching-scripts:cors-cross-origin-2">CORS-cross-origin</a>,
        and false otherwise.

    7.  Let `script` be the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-classic-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-classic-script">creating a classic
        script</a> given `sourceText`, `settingsObject`, `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, `options`,
        `mutedErrors`, and `url`.

    8.  Run `onComplete` given `script`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-classic-worker-script" class="dfn" export="">fetch
a classic worker script</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-4" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-4">environment settings
object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-5">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, an algorithm `onComplete`, and an optional
<a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-3">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. `onComplete` must be an
algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#classic-script" id="fetching-scripts:classic-script-6">classic
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `request` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-7"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> whose
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a> is `url`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-client-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> is
    `fetchClient`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a> is
    `destination`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-initiator-type-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    is "`other`",
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">mode</a> is "`same-origin`",
    <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-credentials-mode-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-credentials-mode">credentials mode</a>
    is "`same-origin`",
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-parser-metadata"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-parser-metadata-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-parser-metadata">parser metadata</a>
    is "`not parser-inserted`", and whose <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag"
    id="fetching-scripts:use-url-credentials-flag"
    data-x-internal="use-url-credentials-flag">use-URL-credentials flag</a>
    is set.

2.  If `performFetch` was given, run `performFetch` with `request`,
    true, and with `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined below.

    Otherwise, <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> `request` with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined below.

    In both cases, let `processResponseConsumeBody` given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-8"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence-3"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes` be the
    following algorithm:

    1.  Set `response` to `response`'s <a href="#unsafe-response"
        id="fetching-scripts:unsafe-response-2">unsafe response</a>.

    2.  If any of the following are true:

        - `bodyBytes` is null or failure; or

        - `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-status-2"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not an
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:ok-status-2" data-x-internal="ok-status">ok
          status</a>,

        then run `onComplete` given null, and abort these steps.

    3.  If all of the following are true:

        - `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-2"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>'s
          <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-url-scheme"
          data-x-internal="concept-url-scheme">scheme</a> is an
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-scheme"
          id="fetching-scripts:http(s)-scheme"
          data-x-internal="http(s)-scheme">HTTP(S) scheme</a>; and

        - the result of <a
          href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-extract-mime-type"
          id="fetching-scripts:extract-a-mime-type-2"
          data-x-internal="extract-a-mime-type">extracting a MIME type</a>
          from `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-header-list-2"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>
          is not a
          <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type"
          id="fetching-scripts:javascript-mime-type"
          data-x-internal="javascript-mime-type">JavaScript MIME type</a>,

        then run `onComplete` given null, and abort these steps.

        Other <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-scheme"
        id="fetching-scripts:fetch-scheme" data-x-internal="fetch-scheme">fetch
        schemes</a> are exempted from MIME type checking for historical
        web-compatibility reasons. We might be able to tighten this in
        the future; see [issue
        \#3255](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3255).

    4.  Let `sourceText` be the result of
        <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode"
        id="fetching-scripts:utf-8-decode" data-x-internal="utf-8-decode">UTF-8
        decoding</a> `bodyBytes`.

    5.  Let `script` be the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-classic-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-classic-script-2">creating a classic
        script</a> using `sourceText`, `settingsObject`, `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-3"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, and the
        <a href="#default-script-fetch-options"
        id="fetching-scripts:default-script-fetch-options">default script fetch
        options</a>.

    6.  Run `onComplete` given `script`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-classic-worker-imported-script" class="dfn"
export="">fetch a classic worker-imported script</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-5" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-6">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, and an optional
<a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-4">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. The algorithm will return a
<a href="#classic-script" id="fetching-scripts:classic-script-7">classic
script</a> on success, or throw an exception on failure.

1.  Let `response` be null.

2.  Let `bodyBytes` be null.

3.  Let `request` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-8"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> whose
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-url-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a> is `url`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-client-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> is
    `settingsObject`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a> is
    "`script`",
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-initiator-type-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    is "`other`",
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-parser-metadata"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-parser-metadata-5"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-parser-metadata">parser metadata</a>
    is "`not parser-inserted`", and whose <a
    href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag"
    id="fetching-scripts:use-url-credentials-flag-2"
    data-x-internal="use-url-credentials-flag">use-URL-credentials flag</a>
    is set.

4.  If `performFetch` was given, run `performFetch` with `request`,
    `isTopLevel`, and with `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined
    below.

    Otherwise, <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-6"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> `request` with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined below.

    In both cases, let `processResponseConsumeBody` given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-9"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `res` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence-4"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bb` be the
    following algorithm:

    1.  Set `bodyBytes` to `bb`.

    2.  Set `response` to `res`.

5.  <a href="#pause" id="fetching-scripts:pause">Pause</a> until
    `response` is not null.

    Unlike other algorithms in this section, the fetching process is
    synchronous here.

6.  Set `response` to `response`'s <a href="#unsafe-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:unsafe-response-3">unsafe response</a>.

7.  If any of the following are true:

    - `bodyBytes` is null or failure;

    - `response`'s
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
      id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-status-3"
      data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not an
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
      id="fetching-scripts:ok-status-3" data-x-internal="ok-status">ok
      status</a>; or

    - the result of <a
      href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-extract-mime-type"
      id="fetching-scripts:extract-a-mime-type-3"
      data-x-internal="extract-a-mime-type">extracting a MIME type</a>
      from `response`'s
      <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
      id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-header-list-3"
      data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a> is
      not a
      <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type"
      id="fetching-scripts:javascript-mime-type-2"
      data-x-internal="javascript-mime-type">JavaScript MIME type</a>,

    then throw a <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#networkerror"
    id="fetching-scripts:networkerror"
    data-x-internal="networkerror">"<code>NetworkError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="fetching-scripts:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

8.  Let `sourceText` be the result of
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode"
    id="fetching-scripts:utf-8-decode-2"
    data-x-internal="utf-8-decode">UTF-8 decoding</a> `bodyBytes`.

9.  Let `mutedErrors` be true if `response` was
    <a href="#cors-cross-origin"
    id="fetching-scripts:cors-cross-origin-3">CORS-cross-origin</a>, and
    false otherwise.

10. Let `script` be the result of <a href="#creating-a-classic-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-classic-script-3">creating a classic
    script</a> given `sourceText`, `settingsObject`, `response`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, the
    <a href="#default-script-fetch-options"
    id="fetching-scripts:default-script-fetch-options-2">default script
    fetch options</a>, and `mutedErrors`.

11. Return `script`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-module-script-tree" class="dfn" export="">fetch an
external module script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-6" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-7">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-6">script fetch options</a>
`options`, and an algorithm `onComplete`, run these steps. `onComplete`
must be an algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-6">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  <a href="#fetch-a-single-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-single-module-script">Fetch a single module
    script</a> given `url`, `settingsObject`, "`script`", `options`,
    `settingsObject`, "`client`", true, and with the following steps
    given `result`:

    1.  If `result` is null, run `onComplete` given null, and abort
        these steps.

    2.  <a href="#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script">Fetch
        the descendants of and link</a> `result` given `settingsObject`,
        "`script`", and `onComplete`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-modulepreload-module-script-graph"
class="dfn">fetch a modulepreload module script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-7" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-4"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-8">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-7">script fetch options</a>
`options`, and an algorithm `onComplete`, run these steps. `onComplete`
must be an algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-7">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  <a href="#fetch-a-single-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-single-module-script-2">Fetch a single
    module script</a> given `url`, `settingsObject`, `destination`,
    `options`, `settingsObject`, "`client`", true, and with the
    following steps given `result`:

    1.  Run `onComplete` given `result`.

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
        id="fetching-scripts:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
        `settingsObject`'s <a href="#concept-settings-object-global"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-settings-object-global-2">global object</a>
        implements [`Window`](#window).

    3.  If `result` is not null, optionally
        <a href="#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script-2">fetch
        the descendants of and link</a> `result` given `settingsObject`,
        `destination`, and an empty algorithm.

        Generally, performing this step will be beneficial for
        performance, as it allows pre-loading the modules that will
        invariably be requested later, via algorithms such as
        <a href="#fetch-a-module-script-tree"
        id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-module-script-tree-2">fetch an external
        module script graph</a> that fetch the entire graph. However,
        user agents might wish to skip them in bandwidth-constrained
        situations, or situations where the relevant fetches are already
        in flight.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-an-inline-module-script-graph" class="dfn">fetch an
inline module script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="fetching-scripts:string" data-x-internal="string">string</a>
`sourceText`, a <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-8" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `baseURL`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-9">environment settings
object</a> `settingsObject`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-8">script fetch options</a>
`options`, and an algorithm `onComplete`, run these steps. `onComplete`
must be an algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-8">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `script` be the result of
    <a href="#creating-a-javascript-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-javascript-module-script">creating a
    JavaScript module script</a> using `sourceText`, `settingsObject`,
    `baseURL`, and `options`.

2.  <a href="#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script-3">Fetch
    the descendants of and link</a> `script`, given `settingsObject`,
    "`script`", and `onComplete`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-module-worker-script-tree" class="dfn"
export="">fetch a module worker script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-9" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-10">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-5"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, a <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials-3">credentials
mode</a> `credentialsMode`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-11">environment
settings object</a> `settingsObject`, and an algorithm `onComplete`,
<a href="#fetch-a-worklet/module-worker-script-graph"
id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-worklet/module-worker-script-graph">fetch a
worklet/module worker script graph</a> given `url`, `fetchClient`,
`destination`, `credentialsMode`, `settingsObject`, and `onComplete`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-worklet-script-graph" class="dfn">fetch a worklet
script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-10" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-12">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-6"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, a <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials-4">credentials
mode</a> `credentialsMode`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-13">environment
settings object</a> `settingsObject`, a
<a href="#concept-worklet-module-responses-map"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-worklet-module-responses-map">module
responses map</a> `moduleResponsesMap`, and an algorithm `onComplete`,
<a href="#fetch-a-worklet/module-worker-script-graph"
id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-worklet/module-worker-script-graph-2">fetch
a worklet/module worker script graph</a> given `url`, `fetchClient`,
`destination`, `credentialsMode`, `settingsObject`, `onComplete`, and
the following <a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-5">perform the fetch
hook</a> given `request` and
[`processCustomFetchResponse`](#fetching-scripts-processcustomfetchresponse):

1.  Let `requestURL` be `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-url-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a>.

2.  If `moduleResponsesMap`\[`requestURL`\] is "`fetching`", wait
    <a href="#in-parallel" id="fetching-scripts:in-parallel">in parallel</a>
    until that entry's value changes, then
    <a href="#queue-a-task" id="fetching-scripts:queue-a-task">queue a
    task</a> on the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="fetching-scripts:networking-task-source">networking task source</a>
    to proceed with running the following steps.

3.  If `moduleResponsesMap`\[`requestURL`\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="fetching-scripts:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, then:

    1.  Let `cached` be `moduleResponsesMap`\[`requestURL`\].

    2.  Run `processCustomFetchResponse` with `cached`\[0\] and
        `cached`\[1\].

    3.  Return.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
    id="fetching-scripts:map-set" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
    `moduleResponsesMap`\[`requestURL`\] to "`fetching`".

5.  <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-7"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">Fetch</a> `request`, with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to the following steps given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-10"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence-5"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes`:

    1.  Set `moduleResponsesMap`\[`requestURL`\] to (`response`,
        `bodyBytes`).

    2.  Run `processCustomFetchResponse` with `response` and
        `bodyBytes`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following algorithms are meant for internal use by this
specification only as part of <a href="#fetch-a-module-script-tree"
id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-module-script-tree-3">fetching an external
module script graph</a> or other similar concepts above, and should not
be used directly by other specifications.

This diagram illustrates how these algorithms relate to the ones above,
as well as to each other:

<img
src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,"
id="module-script-fetching-diagram" />

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-worklet/module-worker-script-graph"
class="dfn">fetch a worklet/module worker script graph</span> given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-11" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-14">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-7"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, a <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials-5">credentials
mode</a> `credentialsMode`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-15">environment
settings object</a> `settingsObject`, an algorithm `onComplete`, and an
optional <a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-6">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. `onComplete` must be an
algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-9">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `options` be a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
    id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-9">script fetch options</a>
    whose <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-nonce"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-nonce-4">cryptographic
    nonce</a> is the empty string,
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-integrity"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-integrity-5">integrity
    metadata</a> is the empty string,
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-parser"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-parser-4">parser
    metadata</a> is "`not-parser-inserted`",
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-credentials"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-credentials-6">credentials
    mode</a> is `credentialsMode`,
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy-4">referrer
    policy</a> is the empty string, and
    <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-fetch-priority-5">fetch
    priority</a> is "`auto`".

2.  <a href="#fetch-a-single-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-single-module-script-3">Fetch a single
    module script</a> given `url`, `fetchClient`, `destination`,
    `options`, `settingsObject`, "`client`", true, and
    `onSingleFetchComplete` as defined below. If `performFetch` was
    given, pass it along as well.

    `onSingleFetchComplete` given `result` is the following algorithm:

    1.  If `result` is null, run `onComplete` given null, and abort
        these steps.

    2.  <a href="#fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script-5">Fetch
        the descendants of and link</a> `result` given `fetchClient`,
        `destination`, and `onComplete`. If `performFetch` was given,
        pass it along as well.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-the-descendants-of-and-link-a-module-script"
class="dfn">fetch the descendants of and link</span> a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-10">module
script</a> `moduleScript`, given an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-16">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-8"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, an algorithm `onComplete`, and an optional
<a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-7">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. `onComplete` must be an
algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-11">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `record` be `moduleScript`'s <a href="#concept-script-record"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-record">record</a>.

2.  If `record` is null, then:

    1.  Set `moduleScript`'s <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow">error to
        rethrow</a> to `moduleScript`'s
        <a href="#parse-errors" id="fetching-scripts:parse-errors">parse
        error</a>.

    2.  Run `onComplete` given `moduleScript`.

    3.  Return.

3.  Let `state` be <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-list-and-record-specification-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:record" data-x-internal="record">Record</a> {
    \[\[ErrorToRethrow\]\]: null, \[\[Destination\]\]: `destination`,
    \[\[PerformFetch\]\]: null, \[\[FetchClient\]\]: `fetchClient` }.

4.  If `performFetch` was given, set `state`.\[\[PerformFetch\]\] to
    `performFetch`.

5.  Let `loadingPromise` be
    `record`.<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-LoadRequestedModules"
    id="fetching-scripts:js-loadrequestedmodules"
    data-x-internal="js-loadrequestedmodules">LoadRequestedModules</a>(`state`).

    This step will recursively load all the module transitive
    dependencies.

6.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#upon-fulfillment"
    id="fetching-scripts:upon-fulfillment"
    data-x-internal="upon-fulfillment">Upon fulfillment</a> of
    `loadingPromise`, run the following steps:

    1.  Perform
        `record`.<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-moduledeclarationlinking"
        id="fetching-scripts:js-link" data-x-internal="js-link">Link</a>().

        This step will recursively call
        <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-moduledeclarationlinking"
        id="fetching-scripts:js-link-2" data-x-internal="js-link">Link</a>
        on all of the module's unlinked dependencies.

        If this throws an exception, catch it, and set `moduleScript`'s
        <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-2">error to
        rethrow</a> to that exception.

    2.  Run `onComplete` given `moduleScript`.

7.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#upon-rejection"
    id="fetching-scripts:upon-rejection"
    data-x-internal="upon-rejection">Upon rejection</a> of
    `loadingPromise`, run the following steps:

    1.  If `state`.\[\[ErrorToRethrow\]\] is not null, set
        `moduleScript`'s <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-3">error to
        rethrow</a> to `state`.\[\[ErrorToRethrow\]\] and run
        `onComplete` given `moduleScript`.

    2.  Otherwise, run `onComplete` given null.

        `state`.\[\[ErrorToRethrow\]\] is null when `loadingPromise` is
        rejected due to a loading error.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-single-module-script" class="dfn">fetch a single
module script</span>, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-12" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-17">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-9"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-10">script fetch options</a>
`options`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-18">environment
settings object</a> `settingsObject`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-referrer"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> `referrer`, an
optional <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#modulerequest-record"
id="fetching-scripts:modulerequest-record"
data-x-internal="modulerequest-record">ModuleRequest Record</a>
`moduleRequest`, a boolean
[`isTopLevel`](#fetching-scripts-is-top-level), an algorithm
`onComplete`, and an optional <a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-8">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. `onComplete` must be an
algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-12">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  Let `moduleType` be "`javascript-or-wasm`".

2.  If `moduleRequest` was given, then set `moduleType` to the result of
    running the <a href="#module-type-from-module-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:module-type-from-module-request">module type from
    module request</a> steps given `moduleRequest`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="fetching-scripts:assert-2" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    the result of running the <a href="#module-type-allowed"
    id="fetching-scripts:module-type-allowed">module type allowed</a>
    steps given `moduleType` and `settingsObject` is true. Otherwise, we
    would not have reached this point because a failure would have been
    raised when inspecting `moduleRequest`.\[\[Attributes\]\] in
    [HostLoadImportedModule](#validate-requested-module-specifiers) or
    <a href="#fetch-a-single-imported-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-single-imported-module-script">fetch a
    single imported module script</a>.

4.  Let `moduleMap` be `settingsObject`'s
    <a href="#concept-settings-object-module-map"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-settings-object-module-map">module map</a>.

5.  If `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\] is "`fetching`", wait
    <a href="#in-parallel" id="fetching-scripts:in-parallel-2">in
    parallel</a> until that entry's value changes, then
    <a href="#queue-a-task" id="fetching-scripts:queue-a-task-2">queue a
    task</a> on the <a href="#networking-task-source"
    id="fetching-scripts:networking-task-source-2">networking task
    source</a> to proceed with running the following steps.

6.  If `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="fetching-scripts:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>, run `onComplete` given
    `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\], and return.

7.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
    id="fetching-scripts:map-set-2" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
    `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\] to "`fetching`".

8.  Let `request` be a new
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-9"
    data-x-internal="concept-request">request</a> whose
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-url-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-url">URL</a> is `url`,
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-mode-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">mode</a> is "`cors`",
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-referrer-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> is
    `referrer`, and
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-client-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> is
    `fetchClient`.

9.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-10"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a> to the
    result of running the <a href="#fetch-destination-from-module-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-destination-from-module-type">fetch
    destination from module type</a> steps given `destination` and
    `moduleType`.

10. If `destination` is "`worker`", "`sharedworker`", or
    "`serviceworker`", and `isTopLevel` is true, then set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-mode"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-mode-3"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-mode">mode</a> to "`same-origin`".

11. Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-initiator-type-4"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    to "`script`".

12. <a href="#set-up-the-module-script-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:set-up-the-module-script-request">Set up the module
    script request</a> given `request` and `options`.

13. If `performFetch` was given, run `performFetch` with `request`,
    `isTopLevel`, and with `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined
    below.

    Otherwise, <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-fetch-8"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> `request` with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response-end-of-body"
    data-x-internal="processresponseconsumebody">processResponseConsumeBody</a>*
    set to `processResponseConsumeBody` as defined below.

    In both cases, let `processResponseConsumeBody` given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-11"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `response` and null,
    failure, or a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
    id="fetching-scripts:byte-sequence-6"
    data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte sequence</a> `bodyBytes` be the
    following algorithm:

    `response` is always <a href="#cors-same-origin"
    id="fetching-scripts:cors-same-origin-2">CORS-same-origin</a>.

    1.  If any of the following are true:

        - `bodyBytes` is null or failure; or

        - `response`'s
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-status-4"
          data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not an
          <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#ok-status"
          id="fetching-scripts:ok-status-4" data-x-internal="ok-status">ok
          status</a>,

        then <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
        id="fetching-scripts:map-set-3" data-x-internal="map-set">set</a>
        `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\] to null, run `onComplete`
        given null, and abort these steps.

    2.  Let `mimeType` be the result of <a
        href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-extract-mime-type"
        id="fetching-scripts:extract-a-mime-type-4"
        data-x-internal="extract-a-mime-type">extracting a MIME type</a>
        from `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-header-list"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-header-list-4"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-header-list">header list</a>.

    3.  Let `moduleScript` be null.

    4.  Let `referrerPolicy` be the result of <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-referrer-policy/#parse-referrer-policy-from-header"
        id="fetching-scripts:parse-referrer-policy-header-2"
        data-x-internal="parse-referrer-policy-header">parsing the
        `<code>Referrer-Policy</code>` header</a> given `response`.
        [\[REFERRERPOLICY\]](#refsREFERRERPOLICY)

    5.  If `referrerPolicy` is not the empty string, set `options`'s
        <a href="#concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-fetch-options-referrer-policy-5">referrer
        policy</a> to `referrerPolicy`.

    6.  If `mimeType`'s
        <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence"
        id="fetching-scripts:mime-type-essence-2"
        data-x-internal="mime-type-essence">essence</a> is
        "[`application/wasm`](#application/wasm)" and `moduleType` is
        "`javascript-or-wasm`", then set `moduleScript` to the result of
        <a href="#creating-a-webassembly-module-script"
        id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-webassembly-module-script">creating a
        WebAssembly module script</a> given `bodyBytes`,
        `settingsObject`, `response`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-5"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, and `options`.

    7.  Otherwise:

        1.  Let `sourceText` be the result of
            <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-decode"
            id="fetching-scripts:utf-8-decode-3"
            data-x-internal="utf-8-decode">UTF-8 decoding</a>
            `bodyBytes`.

        2.  If `moduleType` is "`text`", then set `moduleScript` to the
            result of <a href="#creating-a-text-module-script"
            id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-text-module-script">creating a text
            module script</a> given `sourceText` and `settingsObject`.

        3.  If `mimeType` is a
            <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-mime-type"
            id="fetching-scripts:javascript-mime-type-3"
            data-x-internal="javascript-mime-type">JavaScript MIME type</a>
            and `moduleType` is "`javascript-or-wasm`", then set
            `moduleScript` to the result of
            <a href="#creating-a-javascript-module-script"
            id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-javascript-module-script-2">creating a
            JavaScript module script</a> given `sourceText`,
            `settingsObject`, `response`'s
            <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
            id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-6"
            data-x-internal="concept-response-url">URL</a>, and
            `options`.

        4.  If the
            <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#mime-type-essence"
            id="fetching-scripts:mime-type-essence-3"
            data-x-internal="mime-type-essence">MIME type essence</a> of
            `mimeType` is "[`text/css`](#text/css)" and `moduleType` is
            "`css`", then set `moduleScript` to the result of
            <a href="#creating-a-css-module-script"
            id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-css-module-script">creating a CSS module
            script</a> given `sourceText` and `settingsObject`.

        5.  If `mimeType` is a
            <a href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#json-mime-type"
            id="fetching-scripts:json-mime-type"
            data-x-internal="json-mime-type">JSON MIME type</a> and
            `moduleType` is "`json`", then set `moduleScript` to the
            result of <a href="#creating-a-json-module-script"
            id="fetching-scripts:creating-a-json-module-script">creating a JSON
            module script</a> given `sourceText` and `settingsObject`.

    8.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
        id="fetching-scripts:map-set-4" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
        `moduleMap`\[(`url`, `moduleType`)\] to `moduleScript`, and run
        `onComplete` given `moduleScript`.

        It is intentional that the
        <a href="#module-map" id="fetching-scripts:module-map">module map</a>
        is keyed by the
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-url-5"
        data-x-internal="concept-request-url">request URL</a>, whereas
        the <a href="#concept-script-base-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-script-base-url">base URL</a> for
        the
        <a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-13">module
        script</a> is set to the
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
        id="fetching-scripts:concept-response-url-7"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-url">response URL</a>. The
        former is used to deduplicate fetches, while the latter is used
        for URL resolution.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="fetch-a-single-imported-module-script" class="dfn">fetch a
single imported module script</span>, given a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="fetching-scripts:url-13" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `url`, an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-19">environment
settings object</a> `fetchClient`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-destination-11"
data-x-internal="concept-request-destination">destination</a>
`destination`, a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="fetching-scripts:script-fetch-options-11">script fetch options</a>
`options`, <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="fetching-scripts:environment-settings-object-20">environment
settings object</a> `settingsObject`, a
<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-referrer"
id="fetching-scripts:concept-request-referrer-3"
data-x-internal="concept-request-referrer">referrer</a> `referrer`, a
<a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#modulerequest-record"
id="fetching-scripts:modulerequest-record-2"
data-x-internal="modulerequest-record">ModuleRequest Record</a>
`moduleRequest`, an algorithm `onComplete`, and an optional
<a href="#fetching-scripts-perform-fetch"
id="fetching-scripts:fetching-scripts-perform-fetch-9">perform the fetch
hook</a> `performFetch`, run these steps. `onComplete` must be an
algorithm accepting null (on failure) or a
<a href="#module-script" id="fetching-scripts:module-script-14">module
script</a> (on success).

1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
    id="fetching-scripts:assert-3" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
    `moduleRequest`.\[\[Attributes\]\] does not contain any <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-list-and-record-specification-type"
    id="fetching-scripts:record-2" data-x-internal="record">Record</a>
    `entry` such that `entry`.\[\[Key\]\] is not "`type`", because we
    only asked for "`type`" attributes in
    <a href="#hostgetsupportedimportattributes"
    id="fetching-scripts:hostgetsupportedimportattributes">HostGetSupportedImportAttributes</a>.

2.  Let `moduleType` be the result of running the
    <a href="#module-type-from-module-request"
    id="fetching-scripts:module-type-from-module-request-2">module type from
    module request</a> steps given `moduleRequest`.

3.  If the result of running the <a href="#module-type-allowed"
    id="fetching-scripts:module-type-allowed-2">module type allowed</a>
    steps given `moduleType` and `settingsObject` is false, then run
    `onComplete` given null, and return.

4.  <a href="#fetch-a-single-module-script"
    id="fetching-scripts:fetch-a-single-module-script-4">Fetch a single
    module script</a> given `url`, `fetchClient`, `destination`,
    `options`, `settingsObject`, `referrer`, `moduleRequest`, false, and
    `onComplete`. If `performFetch` was given, pass it along as well.

</div>

##### <span class="secno">8.1.4.3</span> Creating scripts<a href="#creating-scripts" class="self-link"></a>

This standard refers to the following concepts defined there:

- <span id="webdriver-bidi-command-script-evaluate"
  class="dfn">[WebDriver BiDi command
  "script.evaluate"](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-script-evaluate)</span>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-classic-script" class="dfn">create a classic
script</span>, given a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="creating-scripts:string" data-x-internal="string">string</a>
`source`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object">environment settings
object</a> `settings`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="creating-scripts:url" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `baseURL`, a
<a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="creating-scripts:script-fetch-options">script fetch options</a>
`options`, an optional boolean `mutedErrors` (default false), an
optional <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="creating-scripts:url-2" data-x-internal="url">URL</a>-or-null
`sourceURLForWindowScripts` (default null), and an optional boolean
`bypassDisabledScripting` (default false):

The `bypassDisabledScripting` parameter is intended to be used for
running scripts even if <a href="#concept-environment-noscript"
id="creating-scripts:concept-environment-noscript">scripting is
disabled</a>. This is required for some automation scenarios, e.g. for
WebDriver BiDi command
["script.evaluate"](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#commands-scriptevaluate).

The `bypassDisabledScripting` parameter is intended to be used for
running scripts even if scripting is disabled. This is required for some
automation scenarios, e.g. for
<a href="https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#command-script-evaluate"
id="creating-scripts:webdriver-bidi-command-script-evaluate"
data-x-internal="webdriver-bidi-command-script-evaluate">WebDriver BiDi
command "script.evaluate"</a>. When the scripting process (e.g.,
executing a script via a WebDriver BiDi command) is invoked with
`bypassDisabledScripting` set to true, the event loop is allowed to run
to resolve thenables (from promises) and weakmap finalizations created
by that script, even if <a href="#concept-environment-noscript"
id="creating-scripts:concept-environment-noscript-2">scripting is
disabled</a>. This is necessary to ensure the proper functioning of
testing scripts, which often rely on asynchronous operations.

1.  If `mutedErrors` is true, then set `baseURL` to
    [`about:blank`](#about:blank).

    When `mutedErrors` is true, `baseURL` is the script's
    <a href="#cors-cross-origin"
    id="creating-scripts:cors-cross-origin">CORS-cross-origin</a>
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a>'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-url"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-response-url"
    data-x-internal="concept-response-url">url</a>, which shouldn't be
    exposed to JavaScript. Therefore, `baseURL` is sanitized here.

2.  If <a href="#concept-environment-noscript"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-environment-noscript-3">scripting is
    disabled</a> for `settings` and `bypassDisabledScripting` is false,
    then set `source` to the empty string.

3.  Let `script` be a new
    <a href="#classic-script" id="creating-scripts:classic-script">classic
    script</a> that this algorithm will subsequently initialize.

4.  Set `script`'s <a href="#settings-object"
    id="creating-scripts:settings-object">settings object</a> to
    `settings`.

5.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-base-url"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-base-url">base URL</a> to
    `baseURL`.

6.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-script-fetch-options"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-script-fetch-options">fetch
    options</a> to `options`.

7.  Set `script`'s
    <a href="#muted-errors" id="creating-scripts:muted-errors">muted
    errors</a> to `mutedErrors`.

8.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error">parse error</a> and
    <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow">error to
    rethrow</a> to null.

9.  <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/long-animation-frames/#record-classic-script-creation-time"
    id="creating-scripts:record-classic-script-creation-time"
    data-x-internal="record-classic-script-creation-time">Record classic
    script creation time</a> given `script` and
    `sourceURLForWindowScripts`.

10. Let `result` be <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-parse-script"
    id="creating-scripts:js-parsescript"
    data-x-internal="js-parsescript">ParseScript</a>(`source`,
    `settings`'s <a href="#environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm"
    id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm">realm</a>,
    `script`).

    Passing `script` as the last parameter here ensures
    `result`.\[\[HostDefined\]\] will be `script`.

11. If `result` is a
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list" id="creating-scripts:list"
    data-x-internal="list">list</a> of errors, then:

    1.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
        id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-2">parse error</a>
        and its <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
        id="creating-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-2">error to
        rethrow</a> to `result`\[0\].

    2.  Return `script`.

12. Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-record"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-record">record</a> to `result`.

13. Return `script`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-javascript-module-script" class="dfn">create a
JavaScript module script</span>, given a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="creating-scripts:string-2" data-x-internal="string">string</a>
`source`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object-2">environment settings
object</a> `settings`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="creating-scripts:url-3" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `baseURL`, and
a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="creating-scripts:script-fetch-options-2">script fetch options</a>
`options`:

1.  If <a href="#concept-environment-noscript"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-environment-noscript-4">scripting is
    disabled</a> for `settings`, then set `source` to the empty string.

2.  Let `script` be a new
    <a href="#module-script" id="creating-scripts:module-script">module
    script</a> that this algorithm will subsequently initialize.

3.  Set `script`'s <a href="#settings-object"
    id="creating-scripts:settings-object-2">settings object</a> to
    `settings`.

4.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-base-url"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-base-url-2">base URL</a> to
    `baseURL`.

5.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-script-fetch-options"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-script-fetch-options-2">fetch
    options</a> to `options`.

6.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-3">parse error</a>
    and <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-3">error to
    rethrow</a> to null.

7.  Let `result` be <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-parsemodule"
    id="creating-scripts:js-parsemodule"
    data-x-internal="js-parsemodule">ParseModule</a>(`source`,
    `settings`'s <a href="#environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm"
    id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm-2">realm</a>,
    `script`).

    Passing `script` as the last parameter here ensures
    `result`.\[\[HostDefined\]\] will be `script`.

8.  If `result` is a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list"
    id="creating-scripts:list-2" data-x-internal="list">list</a> of
    errors, then:

    1.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
        id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-4">parse error</a>
        to `result`\[0\].

    2.  Return `script`.

9.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-record"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-record-2">record</a> to
    `result`.

10. Return `script`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-webassembly-module-script" class="dfn">create a
WebAssembly module script</span>, given a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#byte-sequence"
id="creating-scripts:byte-sequence" data-x-internal="byte-sequence">byte
sequence</a> `bodyBytes`, an <a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object-3">environment settings
object</a> `settings`, a
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
id="creating-scripts:url-4" data-x-internal="url">URL</a> `baseURL`, and
a <a href="#script-fetch-options"
id="creating-scripts:script-fetch-options-3">script fetch options</a>
`options`:

1.  If <a href="#concept-environment-noscript"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-environment-noscript-5">scripting is
    disabled</a> for `settings`, then set `bodyBytes` to the byte
    sequence 0x00 0x61 0x73 0x6D 0x01 0x00 0x00 0x00.

    This byte sequence corresponds to an empty WebAssembly module with
    only the magic bytes and version number provided.

2.  Let `script` be a new
    <a href="#module-script" id="creating-scripts:module-script-2">module
    script</a> that this algorithm will subsequently initialize.

3.  Set `script`'s <a href="#settings-object"
    id="creating-scripts:settings-object-3">settings object</a> to
    `settings`.

4.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-base-url"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-base-url-3">base URL</a> to
    `baseURL`.

5.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-script-fetch-options"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-script-fetch-options-3">fetch
    options</a> to `options`.

6.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-5">parse error</a>
    and <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-4">error to
    rethrow</a> to null.

7.  Let `result` be the result of <a
    href="https://webassembly.github.io/esm-integration/js-api/index.html#parse-a-webassembly-module"
    id="creating-scripts:parse-a-webassembly-module"
    data-x-internal="parse-a-webassembly-module">parsing a WebAssembly
    module</a> given `bodyBytes`, `settings`'s
    <a href="#environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm"
    id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object&#39;s-realm-3">realm</a>,
    and `script`.

    Passing `script` as the last parameter here ensures
    `result`.\[\[HostDefined\]\] will be `script`.

8.  If the previous step threw an error `error`, then:

    1.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
        id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-6">parse error</a>
        to `error`.

    2.  Return `script`.

9.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-record"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-record-3">record</a> to
    `result`.

10. Return `script`.

</div>

WebAssembly JavaScript Interface: ESM Integration specifies the hooks
for the WebAssembly integration with ECMA-262 module loading. This
includes support both for direct dependency imports, as well as for
source phase imports, which support virtualization and
multi-instantiation. [\[WASMESM\]](#refsWASMESM)

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="creating-a-css-module-script" class="dfn">create a CSS
module script</span>, given a string `source` and an
<a href="#environment-settings-object"
id="creating-scripts:environment-settings-object-4">environment settings
object</a> `settings`:

1.  Let `script` be a new
    <a href="#module-script" id="creating-scripts:module-script-3">module
    script</a> that this algorithm will subsequently initialize.

2.  Set `script`'s <a href="#settings-object"
    id="creating-scripts:settings-object-4">settings object</a> to
    `settings`.

3.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-base-url"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-base-url-4">base URL</a> and
    <a href="#concept-script-script-fetch-options"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-script-fetch-options-4">fetch
    options</a> to null.

4.  Set `script`'s <a href="#concept-script-parse-error"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-parse-error-7">parse error</a>
    and <a href="#concept-script-error-to-rethrow"
    id="creating-scripts:concept-script-error-to-rethrow-5">error to
    rethrow</a> to null.

5.  Let `sheet` be the result of running the steps to <a
    href="https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom/#create-a-constructed-cssstylesheet"
    id="creating-scripts:create-a-constructed-cssstylesheet"
    data-x-internal="create-a-constructed-cssstylesheet">create a
    constructed <code>CSSStyleSheet</code></a> with an empty dictionary
    as the argument.

6.  Run the steps to <a
