Takes the input data, in the form of a Unicode string containing
base64-encoded binary data, decodes it, and returns a string consisting
of characters in the range U+0000 to U+00FF, each representing a binary
byte with values 0x00 to 0xFF respectively, corresponding to that binary
data.

Throws an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidcharactererror"
id="atob:invalidcharactererror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidcharactererror">"<code>InvalidCharacterError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="atob:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if the input string is
not valid base64 data.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-btoa" class="dfn" dfn-for="WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope"
dfn-type="method">`btoa(``data``)`</span> method must throw an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidcharactererror"
id="atob:invalidcharactererror-3"
data-x-internal="invalidcharactererror">"<code>InvalidCharacterError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="atob:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a> if `data` contains any
character whose code point is greater than U+00FF. Otherwise, the user
agent must convert `data` to a byte sequence whose `n`th byte is the
eight-bit representation of the `n`th code point of `data`, and then
must apply
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#forgiving-base64-encode"
id="atob:forgiving-base64-encode"
data-x-internal="forgiving-base64-encode">forgiving-base64 encode</a> to
that byte sequence and return the result.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-atob" class="dfn" dfn-for="WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope"
dfn-type="method">`atob(``data``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `decodedData` be the result of running
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#forgiving-base64-decode"
    id="atob:forgiving-base64-decode"
    data-x-internal="forgiving-base64-decode">forgiving-base64 decode</a>
    on `data`.

2.  If `decodedData` is failure, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidcharactererror"
    id="atob:invalidcharactererror-4"
    data-x-internal="invalidcharactererror">"<code>InvalidCharacterError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="atob:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Return `decodedData`.

</div>

### <span class="secno">8.4</span> <span class="dfn">Dynamic markup insertion</span><a href="#dynamic-markup-insertion" class="self-link"></a>

APIs for dynamically inserting markup into the document interact with
the parser, and thus their behavior varies depending on whether they are
used with <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document"
id="dynamic-markup-insertion:html-documents"
data-x-internal="html-documents">HTML documents</a> (and the
<a href="#html-parser" id="dynamic-markup-insertion:html-parser">HTML
parser</a>) or <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
id="dynamic-markup-insertion:xml-documents"
data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML documents</a> (and the
<a href="#xml-parser" id="dynamic-markup-insertion:xml-parser">XML
parser</a>).

[`Document`](#document) objects have a
<span id="throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter"
class="dfn">throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion counter</span>, which is
used in conjunction with the <a href="#create-an-element-for-the-token"
id="dynamic-markup-insertion:create-an-element-for-the-token">create an
element for the token</a> algorithm to prevent
<a href="#custom-element-constructor"
id="dynamic-markup-insertion:custom-element-constructor">custom element
constructors</a> from being able to use
[`document.open()`](#dom-document-open),
[`document.close()`](#dom-document-close), and
[`document.write()`](#dom-document-write) when they are invoked by the
parser. Initially, the counter must be set to zero.

#### <span class="secno">8.4.1</span> Opening the input stream<a href="#opening-the-input-stream" class="self-link"></a>

`document`` = ``document``.`<a href="#dom-document-open"
id="dom-document-open-dev"><code>open</code></a>`()`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Document/open](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/open "The Document.open() method opens a document for writing.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox1+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari11+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome64+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera yes">Opera51+</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer4+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android yes">Opera Android47+</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Causes the [`Document`](#document) to be replaced in-place, as if it was
a new [`Document`](#document) object, but reusing the previous object,
which is then returned.

The resulting [`Document`](#document) has an HTML parser associated with
it, which can be given data to parse using
[`document.write()`](#dom-document-write).

The method has no effect if the [`Document`](#document) is still being
parsed.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="opening-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception">DOMException</code></a> if
the [`Document`](#document) is an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
id="opening-the-input-stream:xml-documents"
data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="opening-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if
the parser is currently executing a
<a href="#custom-element-constructor"
id="opening-the-input-stream:custom-element-constructor">custom element
constructor</a>.

`window`` = ``document``.`<a href="#dom-document-open-window"
id="opening-the-input-stream:dom-document-open-window"><code>open</code></a>`(``url``, ``name``, ``features``)`

Works like the [`window.open()`](#dom-open) method.

[`Document`](#document) objects have an
<span id="active-parser-was-aborted" class="dfn">active parser was
aborted</span> boolean, which is used to prevent scripts from invoking
the [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) and
[`document.write()`](#dom-document-write) methods (directly or
indirectly) after the document's <a href="#active-parser"
id="opening-the-input-stream:active-parser">active parser</a> has been
aborted. It is initially false.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="document-open-steps" class="dfn">document open
steps</span>, given a `document`, are as follows:

1.  If `document` is an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:xml-documents-2"
    data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  If `document`'s <a href="#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter">throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion
    counter</a> is greater than 0, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-4"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  Let `entryDocument` be the <a href="#entry-global-object"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:entry-global-object">entry global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

4.  If `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-document-origin"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> is not
    <a href="#same-origin" id="opening-the-input-stream:same-origin">same
    origin</a> to `entryDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-document-origin-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a>, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:securityerror"
    data-x-internal="securityerror">"<code>SecurityError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

5.  If `document` has an <a href="#active-parser"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:active-parser-2">active parser</a>
    whose <a href="#script-nesting-level"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:script-nesting-level">script nesting
    level</a> is greater than 0, then return `document`.

    This basically causes [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) to be
    ignored when it's called in an inline script found during parsing,
    while still letting it have an effect when called from a non-parser
    task such as a timer callback or event handler.

6.  Similarly, if `document`'s <a href="#unload-counter"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:unload-counter">unload counter</a> is
    greater than 0, then return `document`.

    This basically causes [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) to be
    ignored when it's called from a
    [`beforeunload`](#event-beforeunload),
    [`pagehide`](#event-pagehide), or [`unload`](#event-unload) event
    handler while the [`Document`](#document) is being unloaded.

7.  If `document`'s <a href="#active-parser-was-aborted"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:active-parser-was-aborted">active parser
    was aborted</a> is true, then return `document`.

    This notably causes [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) to be
    ignored if it is called after a <a href="#navigate"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:navigate">navigation</a> has started,
    but only during the initial parse. See [issue
    \#4723](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4723) for more
    background.

8.  If `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:node-navigable">node navigable</a> is
    non-null and `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:node-navigable-2">node navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#ongoing-navigation"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:ongoing-navigation">ongoing navigation</a>
    is a <a href="#navigation-id"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:navigation-id">navigation ID</a>, then
    <a href="#nav-stop" id="opening-the-input-stream:nav-stop">stop
    loading</a> `document`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:node-navigable-3">node navigable</a>.

9.  For each <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:shadow-including-inclusive-descendant"
    data-x-internal="shadow-including-inclusive-descendant">shadow-including
    inclusive descendant</a> `node` of `document`,
    <a href="#erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers">erase
    all event listeners and handlers</a> given `node`.

10. If `document` is the <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a> of `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>, then <a href="#erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers-2">erase
    all event listeners and handlers</a> given `document`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>.

11. <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace-all"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-node-replace-all"
    data-x-internal="concept-node-replace-all">Replace all</a> with null
    within `document`.

12. If `document` is
    <a href="#fully-active" id="opening-the-input-stream:fully-active">fully
    active</a>, then:

    1.  Let `newURL` be a copy of `entryDocument`'s
        <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
        id="opening-the-input-stream:the-document&#39;s-address"
        data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

    2.  If `entryDocument` is not `document`, then set `newURL`'s
        <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
        id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-url-fragment"
        data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a> to null.

    3.  Run the <a href="#url-and-history-update-steps"
        id="opening-the-input-stream:url-and-history-update-steps">URL and
        history update steps</a> with `document` and `newURL`.

13. Set `document`'s <a href="#is-initial-about:blank"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:is-initial-about:blank">is initial
    <code>about:blank</code></a> to false.

14. If `document`'s <a href="#iframe-load-in-progress"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:iframe-load-in-progress">iframe load in
    progress</a> flag is set, then set `document`'s
    <a href="#mute-iframe-load"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:mute-iframe-load">mute iframe load</a>
    flag.

15. Set `document` to
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-no-quirks"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:no-quirks-mode"
    data-x-internal="no-quirks-mode">no-quirks mode</a>.

16. Create a new
    <a href="#html-parser" id="opening-the-input-stream:html-parser">HTML
    parser</a> and associate it with `document`. This is a
    <span id="script-created-parser" class="dfn">script-created
    parser</span> (meaning that it can be closed by the
    [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) and
    [`document.close()`](#dom-document-close) methods, and that the
    tokenizer will wait for an explicit call to
    [`document.close()`](#dom-document-close) before emitting an
    end-of-file token). The encoding
    <a href="#concept-encoding-confidence"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:concept-encoding-confidence">confidence</a>
    is *irrelevant*.

17. Set the <a href="#insertion-point"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:insertion-point">insertion point</a> to
    point at just before the end of the
    <a href="#input-stream" id="opening-the-input-stream:input-stream">input
    stream</a> (which at this point will be empty).

18. <a href="#update-the-current-document-readiness"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:update-the-current-document-readiness">Update
    the current document readiness</a> of `document` to "`loading`".

    This causes a [`readystatechange`](#event-readystatechange) event to
    fire, but the event is actually unobservable to author code, because
    of the previous step which
    <a href="#erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:erase-all-event-listeners-and-handlers-3">erased
    all event listeners and handlers</a> that could observe it.

19. Return `document`.

</div>

The <a href="#document-open-steps"
id="opening-the-input-stream:document-open-steps">document open
steps</a> do not affect whether a [`Document`](#document) is
<a href="#ready-for-post-load-tasks"
id="opening-the-input-stream:ready-for-post-load-tasks">ready for
post-load tasks</a> or <a href="#completely-loaded"
id="opening-the-input-stream:completely-loaded">completely loaded</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-document-open" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`open(``unused1``, ``unused2``)`</span> method must
return the result of running the <a href="#document-open-steps"
id="opening-the-input-stream:document-open-steps-2">document open
steps</a> with <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="opening-the-input-stream:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

<a href="#dom-document-open-unused-arguments" class="self-link"></a>The
`unused1` and `unused2` arguments are ignored, but kept in the IDL to
allow code that calls the function with one or two arguments to continue
working. They are necessary due to Web IDL <a
href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-overload-resolution-algorithm"
id="opening-the-input-stream:overload-resolution-algorithm"
data-x-internal="overload-resolution-algorithm">overload resolution
algorithm</a> rules, which would throw a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
data-x-internal="typeerror"><code
id="opening-the-input-stream:typeerror">TypeError</code></a> exception
for such calls had the arguments not been there. [whatwg/webidl issue
\#581](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/issues/581) investigates
changing the algorithm to allow for their removal.
[\[WEBIDL\]](#refsWEBIDL)

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-document-open-window" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`open(``url``, ``name``, ``features``)`</span> method
must run these steps:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>
    is not <a href="#fully-active"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:fully-active-2">fully active</a>, then
    throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidaccesserror"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:invalidaccesserror"
    data-x-internal="invalidaccesserror">"<code>InvalidAccessError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="opening-the-input-stream:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Return the result of running the <a href="#window-open-steps"
    id="opening-the-input-stream:window-open-steps">window open steps</a>
    with `url`, `name`, and `features`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">8.4.2</span> Closing the input stream<a href="#closing-the-input-stream" class="self-link"></a>

`document``.`<a href="#dom-document-close"
id="dom-document-close-dev"><code>close</code></a>`()`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Document/close](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/close "The Document.close() method finishes writing to a document, opened with Document.open().")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox1+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari11+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome64+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera yes">Opera51+</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer4+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android yes">Opera Android47+</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Closes the input stream that was opened by the
[`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) method.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="closing-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="closing-the-input-stream:domexception">DOMException</code></a> if
the [`Document`](#document) is an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
id="closing-the-input-stream:xml-documents"
data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="closing-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="closing-the-input-stream:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if
the parser is currently executing a
<a href="#custom-element-constructor"
id="closing-the-input-stream:custom-element-constructor">custom element
constructor</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-document-close" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`close()`</span> method must run the following steps:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>
    is an <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:xml-documents-2"
    data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="closing-the-input-stream:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter">throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion
    counter</a> is greater than zero, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:invalidstateerror-4"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="closing-the-input-stream:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  If there is no <a href="#script-created-parser"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:script-created-parser">script-created
    parser</a> associated with
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
    then return.

4.  Insert an <a href="#explicit-eof-character"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:explicit-eof-character">explicit "EOF"
    character</a> at the end of the parser's
    <a href="#input-stream" id="closing-the-input-stream:input-stream">input
    stream</a>.

5.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#pending-parsing-blocking-script"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:pending-parsing-blocking-script">pending
    parsing-blocking script</a> is not null, then return.

6.  Run the tokenizer, processing resulting tokens as they are emitted,
    and stopping when the tokenizer reaches the
    <a href="#explicit-eof-character"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:explicit-eof-character-2">explicit "EOF"
    character</a> or <a href="#spin-the-event-loop"
    id="closing-the-input-stream:spin-the-event-loop">spins the event
    loop</a>.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">8.4.3</span> [`document.write()`](#dom-document-write)<a href="#document.write()" class="self-link"></a>

`document``.`<a href="#dom-document-write"
id="dom-document-write-dev"><code>write</code></a>`(...``text``)`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[Document/write](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/write "The document.write() method writes a string of text to a document stream opened by document.open().")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox1+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari1+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome1+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera yes">Opera3+</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer4+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android yes">Opera
Android10.1+</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

In general, adds the given string(s) to the [`Document`](#document)'s
input stream.

This method has very idiosyncratic behavior. In some cases, this method
can affect the state of the
<a href="#html-parser" id="document.write():html-parser">HTML parser</a>
while the parser is running, resulting in a DOM that does not correspond
to the source of the document (e.g. if the string written is the string
"`<plaintext>`" or "`<!--`"). In other cases, the call can clear the
current page first, as if [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open) had
been called. In yet more cases, the method is simply ignored, or throws
an exception. User agents are [explicitly allowed to avoid executing
`script` elements inserted via this
method](#document-written-scripts-intervention). And to make matters
even worse, the exact behavior of this method can in some cases be
dependent on network latency, which can lead to failures that are very
hard to debug. **For all these reasons, use of this method is strongly
discouraged.**

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="document.write():invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="document.write():domexception">DOMException</code></a> when invoked
on <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
id="document.write():xml-documents" data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML
documents</a>.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="document.write():invalidstateerror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="document.write():domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if the
parser is currently executing a <a href="#custom-element-constructor"
id="document.write():custom-element-constructor">custom element
constructor</a>.

This method performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous
elements and attributes like [`script`](#the-script-element) or
<a href="#event-handler-content-attributes"
id="document.write():event-handler-content-attributes">event handler
content attributes</a>.

[`Document`](#document) objects have an
<span id="ignore-destructive-writes-counter"
class="dfn">ignore-destructive-writes counter</span>, which is used in
conjunction with the processing of [`script`](#the-script-element)
elements to prevent external scripts from being able to use
[`document.write()`](#dom-document-write) to blow away the document by
implicitly calling [`document.open()`](#dom-document-open). Initially,
the counter must be set to zero.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="document-write-steps" class="dfn">document write
steps</span>, given a [`Document`](#document) object `document`, a list
`text`, a boolean `lineFeed`, and a string `sink`, are as follows:

1.  Let `string` be the empty string.

2.  Let `isTrusted` be false if `text`
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
    id="document.write():list-contains"
    data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> a string; otherwise
    true.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="document.write():list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `value` of `text`:

    1.  If `value` is a
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml"
        data-x-internal="tt-trustedhtml"><code
        id="document.write():tt-trustedhtml">TrustedHTML</code></a>
        object, then append `value`'s associated <a
        href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml-data"
        id="document.write():tt-trustedhtml-data"
        data-x-internal="tt-trustedhtml-data">data</a> to `string`.

    2.  Otherwise, append `value` to `string`.

4.  If `isTrusted` is false, set `string` to the result of invoking the
    <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string"
    id="document.write():tt-getcompliantstring"
    data-x-internal="tt-getcompliantstring">get trusted type compliant
    string</a> algorithm with
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml"
    data-x-internal="tt-trustedhtml"><code
    id="document.write():tt-trustedhtml-2">TrustedHTML</code></a>,
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="document.write():this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="document.write():concept-relevant-global">relevant global object</a>,
    `string`, `sink`, and "`script`".

5.  If `lineFeed` is true, append U+000A LINE FEED to `string`.

6.  If `document` is an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
    id="document.write():xml-documents-2"
    data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="document.write():invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="document.write():domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

7.  If `document`'s <a href="#throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter"
    id="document.write():throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion-counter">throw-on-dynamic-markup-insertion
    counter</a> is greater than 0, then throw an
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="document.write():invalidstateerror-4"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="document.write():domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

8.  If `document`'s <a href="#active-parser-was-aborted"
    id="document.write():active-parser-was-aborted">active parser was
    aborted</a> is true, then return.

9.  If the <a href="#insertion-point"
    id="document.write():insertion-point">insertion point</a> is
    undefined, then:

    1.  If `document`'s
        <a href="#unload-counter" id="document.write():unload-counter">unload
        counter</a> is greater than 0 or `document`'s
        <a href="#ignore-destructive-writes-counter"
        id="document.write():ignore-destructive-writes-counter">ignore-destructive-writes
        counter</a> is greater than 0, then return.

    2.  Run the <a href="#document-open-steps"
        id="document.write():document-open-steps">document open steps</a>
        with `document`.

10. Insert `string` into the
    <a href="#input-stream" id="document.write():input-stream">input
    stream</a> just before the <a href="#insertion-point"
    id="document.write():insertion-point-2">insertion point</a>.

11. If `document`'s <a href="#pending-parsing-blocking-script"
    id="document.write():pending-parsing-blocking-script">pending
    parsing-blocking script</a> is null, then have the
    <a href="#html-parser" id="document.write():html-parser-2">HTML
    parser</a> process `string`, one code point at a time, processing
    resulting tokens as they are emitted, and stopping when the
    tokenizer reaches the insertion point or when the processing of the
    tokenizer is aborted by the tree construction stage (this can happen
    if a [`script`](#the-script-element) end tag token is emitted by the
    tokenizer).

    If the [`document.write()`](#dom-document-write) method was called
    from script executing inline (i.e. executing because the parser
    parsed a set of [`script`](#the-script-element) tags), then this is
    a [reentrant invocation of the parser](#nestedParsing). If the
    <a href="#parser-pause-flag"
    id="document.write():parser-pause-flag">parser pause flag</a> is
    set, the tokenizer will abort immediately and no HTML will be
    parsed, per the tokenizer's [parser pause flag
    check](#check-parser-pause-flag).

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-document-write" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`document.write(...``text``)`</span> method steps are
to run the <a href="#document-write-steps"
id="document.write():document-write-steps">document write steps</a> with
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="document.write():this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>, `text`,
false, and "`Document write`".

</div>

id="dom-document-writeln-dev"><code>writeln</code></a>`(...``text``)`

Adds the given string(s) to the [`Document`](#document)'s input stream,
followed by a newline character. If necessary, calls the
[`open()`](#dom-document-open) method implicitly first.

This method has very idiosyncratic behavior. **Use of this method is
strongly discouraged, for the same reasons as
[`document.write()`](#dom-document-write).**

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="document.writeln():invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="document.writeln():domexception">DOMException</code></a> when
invoked on <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
id="document.writeln():xml-documents"
data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML documents</a>.

Throws an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="document.writeln():invalidstateerror-2"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="document.writeln():domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if the
parser is currently executing a <a href="#custom-element-constructor"
id="document.writeln():custom-element-constructor">custom element
constructor</a>.

This method performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous
elements and attributes like [`script`](#the-script-element) or
<a href="#event-handler-content-attributes"
id="document.writeln():event-handler-content-attributes">event handler
content attributes</a>.

The <span id="dom-document-writeln" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`document.writeln(...``text``)`</span> method steps

with <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"

#### <span class="secno">8.5.1</span> The [`DOMParser`](#domparser) interface<a href="#the-domparser-interface" class="self-link"></a>

The [`DOMParser`](#domparser) interface allows authors to create new
[`Document`](#document) objects by parsing strings, as either HTML or
XML.

`parser`` = new `<a href="#dom-domparser-constructor"
id="dom-domparser-constructor-dev"><code>DOMParser</code></a>`()`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

Constructs a new [`DOMParser`](#domparser) object.

`document`` = ``parser``.`<a href="#dom-domparser-parsefromstring"
id="dom-domparser-parsefromstring-dev"><code>parseFromString</code></a>`(``string``, ``type``)`

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped before">

**✔**MDN

<div class="feature">

[DOMParser/parseFromString](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/DOMParser/parseFromString "The parseFromString() method of the DOMParser interface parses a string containing either HTML or XML, returning an HTMLDocument or an XMLDocument.")

Support in all current engines.

<div class="support">

<span class="firefox yes">Firefox1+</span><span class="safari yes">Safari1.3+</span><span class="chrome yes">Chrome1+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="opera yes">Opera8+</span><span class="edge_blink yes">Edge79+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="edge yes">Edge
(Legacy)12+</span><span class="ie yes">Internet Explorer9+</span>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<span class="firefox_android unknown">Firefox
Android?</span><span class="safari_ios unknown">Safari
iOS?</span><span class="chrome_android unknown">Chrome
Android?</span><span class="webview_android unknown">WebView
Android?</span><span class="samsunginternet_android unknown">Samsung
Internet?</span><span class="opera_android yes">Opera
Android10.1+</span>

</div>

</div>

</div>

Parses `string` using either the HTML or XML parser, according to
`type`, and returns the resulting [`Document`](#document). `type` can be
"[`text/html`](#text/html)" (which will invoke the HTML parser), or any
of "[`text/xml`](#text/xml)", "[`application/xml`](#application/xml)",
"[`application/xhtml+xml`](#application/xhtml+xml)", or
"[`image/svg+xml`](#image/svg+xml)" (which will invoke the XML parser).

For the XML parser, if `string` cannot be parsed, then the returned
[`Document`](#document) will contain elements describing the resulting
error.

Note that [`script`](#the-script-element) elements are not evaluated
during parsing, and the resulting document's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
id="the-domparser-interface:document&#39;s-character-encoding"
data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">encoding</a> will
always be <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8"
id="the-domparser-interface:utf-8" data-x-internal="utf-8">UTF-8</a>.
The document's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="the-domparser-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> will be inherited
from `parser`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
id="the-domparser-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
object</a>.

Values other than the above for `type` will cause a <a
href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror"
data-x-internal="typeerror"><code
id="the-domparser-interface:typeerror">TypeError</code></a> exception to
be thrown.

The design of [`DOMParser`](#domparser), as a class that needs to be
constructed and then have its
[`parseFromString()`](#dom-domparser-parsefromstring) method called, is
an unfortunate historical artifact. If we were designing this
functionality today it would be a standalone function. For parsing HTML,
the modern alternative is
[`Document.parseHTMLUnsafe()`](#dom-parsehtmlunsafe).

This method performs no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous
elements and attributes like [`script`](#the-script-element) or
<a href="#event-handler-content-attributes"
id="the-domparser-interface:event-handler-content-attributes">event
handler content attributes</a>.

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface DOMParser {
  constructor();

  [NewObject] Document parseFromString((TrustedHTML or DOMString) string, DOMParserSupportedType type);
};

enum DOMParserSupportedType {
  "text/html",
  "text/xml",
  "application/xml",
  "application/xhtml+xml",
  "image/svg+xml"
};
```

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-domparser-constructor"
class="dfn">`new DOMParser()`</span> constructor steps are to do
nothing.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-domparser-parsefromstring" class="dfn"
dfn-for="DOMParser"
dfn-type="method">`parseFromString(``string``, ``type``)`</span> method
steps are:

1.  Let `compliantString` be the result of invoking the <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string"
    id="the-domparser-interface:tt-getcompliantstring"
    data-x-internal="tt-getcompliantstring">get trusted type compliant
    string</a> algorithm with
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml"
    data-x-internal="tt-trustedhtml"><code
    id="the-domparser-interface:tt-trustedhtml-2">TrustedHTML</code></a>,
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-domparser-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a>, `string`, "`DOMParser parseFromString`", and "`script`".

2.  Let `document` be a new [`Document`](#document), whose
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-content-type"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-document-content-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-content-type">content type</a> is
    `type` and
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-domparser-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-2"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> is
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-domparser-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-domparser-interface:the-document&#39;s-address-3"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

    The document's
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
    id="the-domparser-interface:document&#39;s-character-encoding-2"
    data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">encoding</a>
    will be left as its default, of
    <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8"
    id="the-domparser-interface:utf-8-2" data-x-internal="utf-8">UTF-8</a>.
    In particular, any XML declarations or [`meta`](#the-meta-element)
    elements found while parsing `compliantString` will have no effect.

3.  Switch on `type`:

    "<span id="dom-domparsersupportedtype-texthtml" class="dfn" dfn-for="DOMParserSupportedType" dfn-type="enum-value">`text/html`</span>"  
    1.  <a href="#parse-html-from-a-string"
        id="the-domparser-interface:parse-html-from-a-string">Parse HTML from a
        string</a> given `document` and `compliantString`.

    Since `document` does not have a <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-document-bc">browsing context</a>,
    <a href="#concept-n-script"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-n-script">scripting is disabled</a>.

    <span id="dom-domparsersupportedtype-otherwise" class="dfn">Otherwise</span>  
    1.  Create an
        <a href="#xml-parser" id="the-domparser-interface:xml-parser">XML
        parser</a> `parser`, associated with `document`, and with
        <a href="#xml-scripting-support-disabled"
        id="the-domparser-interface:xml-scripting-support-disabled">XML
        scripting support disabled</a>.

    2.  Parse `compliantString` using `parser`.

    3.  If the previous step resulted in an XML well-formedness or XML
        namespace well-formedness error, then:

        1.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert"
            id="the-domparser-interface:assert" data-x-internal="assert">Assert</a>:
            `document` has no child nodes.

        2.  Let `root` be the result of
            <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element"
            id="the-domparser-interface:create-an-element"
            data-x-internal="create-an-element">creating an element</a>
            given `document`, "`parsererror`", and
            "`http://www.mozilla.org/newlayout/xml/parsererror.xml`".

        3.  Optionally, add attributes or children to `root` to describe
            the nature of the parsing error.

        4.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append"
            id="the-domparser-interface:concept-node-append"
            data-x-internal="concept-node-append">Append</a> `root` to
            `document`.

4.  Return `document`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="parse-html-from-a-string" class="dfn">parse HTML from a
string</span>, given a [`Document`](#document) `document` and a
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="the-domparser-interface:string" data-x-internal="string">string</a>
`html`:

1.  Set `document`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-type"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-document-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-type">type</a> to "`html`".

2.  Create an
    <a href="#html-parser" id="the-domparser-interface:html-parser">HTML
    parser</a> `parser`, associated with `document`.

3.  Place `html` into the
    <a href="#input-stream" id="the-domparser-interface:input-stream">input
    stream</a> for `parser`. The encoding
    <a href="#concept-encoding-confidence"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-encoding-confidence">confidence</a>
    is *irrelevant*.

4.  Start `parser` and let it run until it has consumed all the
    characters just inserted into the input stream.

    This might mutate the document's
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-mode"
    id="the-domparser-interface:concept-document-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-mode">mode</a>.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">8.5.2</span> Unsafe HTML parsing methods<a href="#unsafe-html-parsing-methods" class="self-link"></a>

`element``.`<a href="#dom-element-sethtmlunsafe"
id="dom-element-sethtmlunsafe-dev"><code>setHTMLUnsafe</code></a>`(``html``)`  
Parses `html` using the HTML parser, and replaces the children of
`element` with the result. `element` provides context for the HTML
parser.

`shadowRoot``.`<a href="#dom-shadowroot-sethtmlunsafe"
id="dom-shadowroot-sethtmlunsafe-dev"><code>setHTMLUnsafe</code></a>`(``html``)`  
Parses `html` using the HTML parser, and replaces the children of
`shadowRoot` with the result. `shadowRoot`'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-documentfragment-host"
data-x-internal="concept-documentfragment-host">host</a> provides
context for the HTML parser.

`doc`` = Document.`<a href="#dom-parsehtmlunsafe"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:dom-parsehtmlunsafe"><code>parseHTMLUnsafe</code></a>`(``html``)`  
Parses `html` using the HTML parser, and returns the resulting
[`Document`](#document).

Note that [`script`](#the-script-element) elements are not evaluated
during parsing, and the resulting document's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:document&#39;s-character-encoding"
data-x-internal="document&#39;s-character-encoding">encoding</a> will
always be <a href="https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:utf-8" data-x-internal="utf-8">UTF-8</a>.
The document's
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:the-document&#39;s-address"
data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a> will be
[`about:blank`](#about:blank).

These methods perform no sanitization to remove potentially-dangerous
elements and attributes like [`script`](#the-script-element) or
<a href="#event-handler-content-attributes"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:event-handler-content-attributes">event
handler content attributes</a>.

<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"

2.  Let `target` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#template-contents"

    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>

    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

3.  <a href="#unsafely-set-html"

data-x-internal="shadowroot"><code
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:shadowroot">ShadowRoot</code></a>'s
<span id="dom-shadowroot-sethtmlunsafe" class="dfn" dfn-for="ShadowRoot"
dfn-type="method">`setHTMLUnsafe(``html``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `compliantHTML` be the result of invoking the <a

    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"

2.  <a href="#unsafely-set-html"

    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host"

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="unsafely-set-html" class="dfn">unsafely set HTML</span>,
given an <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:element-2">Element</code></a> or
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment"
data-x-internal="documentfragment"><code
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:documentfragment">DocumentFragment</code></a>
`target`, an <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:element-3">Element</code></a>
`contextElement`, and a <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string"
id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:string"
data-x-internal="string">string</a> `html`:

1.  Let `newChildren` be the result of the
    <a href="#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:html-fragment-parsing-algorithm">HTML
    fragment parsing algorithm</a> given `contextElement`, `html`, and
    true.

2.  Let `fragment` be a new
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment"
    data-x-internal="documentfragment"><code
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:documentfragment-2">DocumentFragment</code></a>
    whose <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> is
    `contextElement`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

3.  For each `node` in `newChildren`,
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-node-append"
    data-x-internal="concept-node-append">append</a> `node` to
    `fragment`.

4.  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-replace-all"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-node-replace-all"
    data-x-internal="concept-node-replace-all">Replace all</a> with
    `fragment` within `target`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The static <span id="dom-parsehtmlunsafe" class="dfn" dfn-for="Document"
dfn-type="method">`parseHTMLUnsafe(``html``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `compliantHTML` be the result of invoking the <a
    href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#get-trusted-type-compliant-string"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:tt-getcompliantstring-3"
    data-x-internal="tt-getcompliantstring">get trusted type compliant
    string</a> algorithm with
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/trusted-types/dist/spec/#trustedhtml"
    data-x-internal="tt-trustedhtml"><code
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:tt-trustedhtml-3">TrustedHTML</code></a>,
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:this-9" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant
    global object</a>, `html`, "`Document parseHTMLUnsafe`", and
    "`script`".

2.  Let `document` be a new [`Document`](#document), whose
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-content-type"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-document-content-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-content-type">content type</a> is
    "`text/html`".

    Since `document` does not have a <a href="#concept-document-bc"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-document-bc">browsing
    context</a>, <a href="#concept-n-script"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-n-script">scripting is
    disabled</a>.

3.  Set `document`'s <a
    href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-allow-declarative-shadow-roots"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:concept-document-allow-declarative-shadow-roots"
    data-x-internal="concept-document-allow-declarative-shadow-roots">allow
    declarative shadow roots</a> to true.

4.  <a href="#parse-html-from-a-string"
    id="unsafe-html-parsing-methods:parse-html-from-a-string">Parse HTML
    from a string</a> given `document` and `compliantHTML`.

5.  Return `document`.

</div>

#### <span class="secno">8.5.3</span> HTML serialization methods<a href="#html-serialization-methods" class="self-link"></a>

`html`` = ``element``.`<a href="#dom-element-gethtml"
id="dom-element-gethtml-dev"><code>getHTML</code></a>`({ `<a href="#dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots"
id="html-serialization-methods:dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots"><code>serializableShadowRoots</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots"
id="html-serialization-methods:dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots"><code>shadowRoots</code></a>` })`  
Returns the result of serializing `element` to HTML.
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root"
id="html-serialization-methods:shadow-root"
data-x-internal="shadow-root">Shadow roots</a> within `element` are
serialized according to the provided options:

- If
  [`serializableShadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots)
  is true, then all shadow roots marked as
  <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#shadowroot-serializable"
  id="html-serialization-methods:shadow-serializable"
  data-x-internal="shadow-serializable">serializable</a> are serialized.

- If the [`shadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots) array is
  provided, then all shadow roots specified in the array are serialized,
  regardless of whether or not they are marked as serializable.

If neither option is provided, then no shadow roots are serialized.

`html`` = ``shadowRoot``.`<a href="#dom-shadowroot-gethtml"
id="dom-shadowroot-gethtml-dev"><code>getHTML</code></a>`({ `<a href="#dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots"
id="html-serialization-methods:dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots-3"><code>serializableShadowRoots</code></a>`, `<a href="#dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots"
id="html-serialization-methods:dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots-3"><code>shadowRoots</code></a>` })`  
Returns the result of serializing `shadowRoot` to HTML, using its
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host"
id="html-serialization-methods:concept-documentfragment-host"
data-x-internal="concept-documentfragment-host">shadow host</a> as the
context element.
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root"
id="html-serialization-methods:shadow-root-2"
data-x-internal="shadow-root">Shadow roots</a> within `shadowRoot` are
serialized according to the provided options, as above.

<div algorithm="">

<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="html-serialization-methods:element">Element</code></a>'s
<span id="dom-element-gethtml" class="dfn" dfn-for="Element"
dfn-type="method">`getHTML(``options``)`</span> method steps are to
return the result of <a href="#html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm"
id="html-serialization-methods:html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm">HTML
fragment serialization algorithm</a> with
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="html-serialization-methods:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
`options`\["[`serializableShadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots)"\],
and `options`\["[`shadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots)"\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-shadowroot"
data-x-internal="shadowroot"><code
id="html-serialization-methods:shadowroot">ShadowRoot</code></a>'s
<span id="dom-shadowroot-gethtml" class="dfn" dfn-for="ShadowRoot"
dfn-type="method">`getHTML(``options``)`</span> method steps are to
return the result of <a href="#html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm"
id="html-serialization-methods:html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm-2">HTML
fragment serialization algorithm</a> with
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="html-serialization-methods:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>,
`options`\["[`serializableShadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-serializableshadowroots)"\],
and `options`\["[`shadowRoots`](#dom-gethtmloptions-shadowroots)"\].

</div>

#### <span class="secno">8.5.4</span> The [`innerHTML`](#dom-element-innerhtml) property<a href="#the-innerhtml-property" class="self-link"></a>

The [`innerHTML`](#dom-element-innerhtml) property has a number of
outstanding issues in the DOM Parsing and Serialization [issue
tracker](https://github.com/w3c/DOM-Parsing/issues), documenting various
problems with its specification.

`element``.`<a href="#dom-element-innerhtml"
id="dom-element-innerhtml-dev"><code>innerHTML</code></a>  
Returns a fragment of HTML or XML that represents the element's
contents.

In the case of an XML document, throws an
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
id="the-innerhtml-property:invalidstateerror"
data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:domexception">DOMException</code></a> if the
element cannot be serialized to XML.

`element``.`<a href="#dom-element-innerhtml"
id="the-innerhtml-property:dom-element-innerhtml-3"><code>innerHTML</code></a>` = ``value`  
Replaces the contents of the element with nodes parsed from the given
string.

In the case of an XML document, throws a
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror"
id="the-innerhtml-property:syntaxerror"
data-x-internal="syntaxerror">"<code>SyntaxError</code>"</a>
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
data-x-internal="domexception"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a> if
the given string is not well-formed.

`shadowRoot``.`<a href="#dom-shadowroot-innerhtml"
id="dom-shadowroot-innerhtml-dev"><code>innerHTML</code></a>  
Returns a fragment of HTML that represents the shadow roots's contents.

`shadowRoot``.`<a href="#dom-shadowroot-innerhtml"
id="the-innerhtml-property:dom-shadowroot-innerhtml"><code>innerHTML</code></a>` = ``value`  
Replaces the contents of the shadow root with nodes parsed from the
given string.

These properties' setters perform no sanitization to remove
potentially-dangerous elements and attributes like
[`script`](#the-script-element) or
<a href="#event-handler-content-attributes"
id="the-innerhtml-property:event-handler-content-attributes">event
handler content attributes</a>.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="fragment-serializing-algorithm-steps" class="dfn"
export="">fragment serializing algorithm steps</span>, given an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:element">Element</code></a>,
[`Document`](#document), or
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment"
data-x-internal="documentfragment"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:documentfragment">DocumentFragment</code></a>
`node` and a boolean `require well-formed`, are:

1.  Let `context document` be `node`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node-document"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

2.  If `context document` is an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#html-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:html-documents"
    data-x-internal="html-documents">HTML document</a>, return the
    result of <a href="#html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:html-fragment-serialisation-algorithm">HTML
    fragment serialization algorithm</a> with `node`, false, and « ».

3.  Return the
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/DOM-Parsing/#dfn-xml-serialization"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:xml-serialization"
    data-x-internal="xml-serialization">XML serialization</a> of `node`
    given `require well-formed`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="fragment-parsing-algorithm-steps" class="dfn"
export="">fragment parsing algorithm steps</span>, given an
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:element-2">Element</code></a> `context`, a
string `markup`, and an optional
<a href="#fragment-parser-scripting-mode"
id="the-innerhtml-property:fragment-parser-scripting-mode">fragment
parser scripting mode</a> `scriptingMode` (default
<a href="#scripting-mode-inert"
id="the-innerhtml-property:scripting-mode-inert">Inert</a>), are:

1.  Let `algorithm` be the <a href="#html-fragment-parsing-algorithm"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:html-fragment-parsing-algorithm">HTML
    fragment parsing algorithm</a>.

2.  If `context`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node-document-2"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> is an
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#xml-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:xml-documents"
    data-x-internal="xml-documents">XML document</a>, then set
    `algorithm` to the <a href="#xml-fragment-parsing-algorithm"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:xml-fragment-parsing-algorithm">XML fragment
    parsing algorithm</a>.

3.  Let `newChildren` be the result of invoking `algorithm` given
    `context`, `markup`, false, and `scriptingMode`.

4.  Let `fragment` be a new
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-documentfragment"
    data-x-internal="documentfragment"><code
    id="the-innerhtml-property:documentfragment-2">DocumentFragment</code></a>
    whose <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node-document-3"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> is `context`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node-document-4"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a>.

5.  For each `node` of `newChildren`, in
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:tree-order" data-x-internal="tree-order">tree
    order</a>:
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:concept-node-append"
    data-x-internal="concept-node-append">append</a> `node` to
    `fragment`.

    This ensures the
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node-document-5"
    data-x-internal="node-document">node document</a> for the new
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-node"
    id="the-innerhtml-property:node" data-x-internal="node">nodes</a> is
    correct.

6.  Return `fragment`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element"
data-x-internal="element"><code
id="the-innerhtml-property:element-3">Element</code></a>'s
<span id="dom-element-innerhtml" class="dfn" dfn-for="Element"
dfn-type="attribute">`innerHTML`</span> getter steps are to return the
result of running <a href="#fragment-serializing-algorithm-steps"
id="the-innerhtml-property:fragment-serializing-algorithm-steps">fragment
serializing algorithm steps</a> with
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-innerhtml-property:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a> and
true.
