Returns the
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-height"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:natural-height"
data-x-internal="natural-height">natural height</a> of the image, in
<a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:&#39;px&#39;-3"
data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS pixels</a>.

An [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object whose <a href="#detached"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:detached-2">[[Detached]]</a> internal slot
value is false always has associated
<span id="concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data" class="dfn">bitmap
data</span>, with a width and a height. However, it is possible for this
data to be corrupted. If an [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object's media
data can be decoded without errors, it is said to be
<span id="concept-imagebitmap-good" class="dfn">fully decodable</span>.

An [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object's bitmap has an
<a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean">origin-clean</a>
flag, which indicates whether the bitmap is tainted by content from a
different <a href="#concept-origin"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-origin-2">origin</a>. The flag is
initially set to true and may be changed to false by the steps of
[`createImageBitmap()`](#dom-createimagebitmap).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) objects are
<a href="#serializable-objects"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:serializable-objects">serializable
objects</a> and <a href="#transferable-objects"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:transferable-objects">transferable
objects</a>.

<div algorithm="">

Their <a href="#serialization-steps"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:serialization-steps">serialization
steps</a>, given `value` and `serialized`, are:

1.  If `value`'s <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-2">origin-clean</a>
    flag is not set, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#datacloneerror"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:datacloneerror"
    data-x-internal="datacloneerror">"<code>DataCloneError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-3">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Set `serialized`.\[\[BitmapData\]\] to a copy of `value`'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-3">bitmap
    data</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Their <a href="#deserialization-steps"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:deserialization-steps">deserialization
steps</a>, given `serialized`, `value`, and `targetRealm`, are:

1.  Set `value`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-4">bitmap
    data</a> to `serialized`.\[\[BitmapData\]\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Their <a href="#transfer-steps"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:transfer-steps">transfer steps</a>, given
`value` and `dataHolder`, are:

1.  If `value`'s <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-3">origin-clean</a>
    flag is not set, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#datacloneerror"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:datacloneerror-2"
    data-x-internal="datacloneerror">"<code>DataCloneError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-4">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Set `dataHolder`.\[\[BitmapData\]\] to `value`'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-5">bitmap
    data</a>.

3.  Unset `value`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-6">bitmap
    data</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Their <a href="#transfer-receiving-steps"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:transfer-receiving-steps">transfer-receiving
steps</a>, given `dataHolder` and `value`, are:

1.  Set `value`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-7">bitmap
    data</a> to `dataHolder`.\[\[BitmapData\]\].

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a href="#dom-createimagebitmap"
id="the-imagebitmap-interface:dom-createimagebitmap-3">createImageBitmap</a>
method uses the <span id="bitmap-task-source" class="dfn">bitmap task
source</span> to settle its returned Promise.

<div var-scope="">

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-createimagebitmap" class="dfn"
dfn-for="WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope"
dfn-type="method">`createImageBitmap(``image``, ``options``)`</span> and
`createImageBitmap(``image``, ``sx``, ``sy``, ``sw``, ``sh``, ``options``)`
methods, when invoked, must run these steps:

1.  If either `sw` or `sh` is given and is 0, then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    a <a
    href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-rangeerror"
    data-x-internal="js-rangeerror"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:js-rangeerror">RangeError</code></a>.

2.  If either `options`'s <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth"
    class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`resizeWidth`</span> or `options`'s
    <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`resizeHeight`</span> is present and is 0,
    then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-2"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-2"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-5">DOMException</code></a>.

3.  <a href="#check-the-usability-of-the-image-argument"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:check-the-usability-of-the-image-argument">Check
    the usability of the <var>image</var> argument</a>. If this throws
    an exception or returns *bad*, then return
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-3"
    data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
    an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-3"
    data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-6">DOMException</code></a>.

4.  Let `promise` be a new promise.

5.  Let `imageBitmap` be a new [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap) object.

6.  Switch on `image`:

    [`img`](#the-img-element)  
    <a href="https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/embedded.html#ImageElement"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:svg-image-2"
    data-x-internal="svg-image">SVG <code>image</code></a>  
    1.  If `image`'s media data has no
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:natural-dimensions"
        data-x-internal="natural-dimensions">natural dimensions</a>
        (e.g., it's a vector graphic with no specified content size) and
        either `options`'s
        [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) or
        `options`'s
        [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) is not
        present, then return
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-4"
        data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
        an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-4"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-7">DOMException</code></a>.

    2.  If `image`'s media data has no
        <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:natural-dimensions-2"
        data-x-internal="natural-dimensions">natural dimensions</a>
        (e.g., it's a vector graphic with no specified content size), it
        should be rendered to a bitmap of the size specified by the
        [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) and the
        [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) options.

    3.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-8">bitmap
        data</a> to a copy of `image`'s media data,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>. If this is an
        animated image, `imageBitmap`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-9">bitmap
        data</a> must only be taken from the default image of the
        animation (the one that the format defines is to be used when
        animation is not supported or is disabled), or, if there is no
        such image, the first frame of the animation.

    4.  If `image` <a href="#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean">is
        not origin-clean</a>, then set the
        <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-4">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `imageBitmap`'s bitmap to false.

    5.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source">bitmap task source</a>,
        to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    [`video`](#the-video-element)  
    1.  If `image`'s [`networkState`](#dom-media-networkstate) attribute
        is [`NETWORK_EMPTY`](#dom-media-network_empty), then return
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-5"
        data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
        an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-5"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-8">DOMException</code></a>.

    2.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-10">bitmap
        data</a> to a copy of the frame at the
        <a href="#current-playback-position"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:current-playback-position">current
        playback position</a>, at the <a href="#media-resource"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:media-resource">media resource</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-video-intrinsic-width"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-video-intrinsic-width">natural
        width</a> and <a href="#concept-video-intrinsic-height"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-video-intrinsic-height">natural
        height</a> (i.e., after any aspect-ratio correction has been
        applied),
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-2">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>.

    3.  If `image` <a href="#the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:the-image-argument-is-not-origin-clean-2">is
        not origin-clean</a>, then set the
        <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-5">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `imageBitmap`'s bitmap to false.

    4.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-2">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-2">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element)  
    1.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-11">bitmap
        data</a> to a copy of `image`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-12">bitmap
        data</a>,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-3">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>.

    2.  Set the <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-6">origin-clean</a>
        flag of the `imageBitmap`'s bitmap to the same value as the
        <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-7">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `image`'s bitmap.

    3.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-3">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-3">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
    data-x-internal="blob"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:blob-4">Blob</code></a>  
    Run these steps
    <a href="#in-parallel" id="the-imagebitmap-interface:in-parallel">in
    parallel</a>:

    1.  Let `imageData` be the result of reading `image`'s data. If an
        <a href="#file-error-read"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:file-error-read">error occurs during
        reading of the object</a>, then <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-4">queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-4">bitmap task
        source</a>, to reject `promise` with an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-6"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-9">DOMException</code></a>
        and abort these steps.

    2.  Apply the <a
        href="https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-images-specifically"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:content-type-sniffing:-image"
        data-x-internal="content-type-sniffing:-image">image sniffing rules</a>
        to determine the file format of `imageData`, with MIME type of
        `image` (as given by `image`'s
        <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-type"
        data-x-internal="dom-blob-type"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:dom-blob-type">type</code></a>
        attribute) giving the official type.

    3.  If `imageData` is not in a supported image file format (e.g.,
        it's not an image at all), or if `imageData` is corrupted in
        some fatal way such that the image dimensions cannot be obtained
        (e.g., a vector graphic with no natural size), then
        <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-5">queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-5">bitmap task
        source</a>, to reject `promise` with an
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-7"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-10">DOMException</code></a>
        and abort these steps.

    4.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-13">bitmap
        data</a> to `imageData`,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-4">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>. If this is an
        animated image, `imageBitmap`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-14">bitmap
        data</a> must only be taken from the default image of the
        animation (the one that the format defines is to be used when
        animation is not supported or is disabled), or, if there is no
        such image, the first frame of the animation.

    5.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-6">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-6">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    [`ImageData`](#imagedata)  
    1.  Let `buffer` be `image`'s [`data`](#dom-imagedata-data)
        attribute value's \[\[ViewedArrayBuffer\]\] internal slot.

    2.  If <a href="https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-isdetachedbuffer"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:isdetachedbuffer"
        data-x-internal="isdetachedbuffer">IsDetachedBuffer</a>(`buffer`)
        is true, then return
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#a-promise-rejected-with"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:a-promise-rejected-with-6"
        data-x-internal="a-promise-rejected-with">a promise rejected with</a>
        an <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:invalidstateerror-8"
        data-x-internal="invalidstateerror">"<code>InvalidStateError</code>"</a>
        <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
        data-x-internal="domexception"><code
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:domexception-11">DOMException</code></a>.

    3.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-15">bitmap
        data</a> to `image`'s image data,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-5">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>.

    4.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-7">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-7">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    [`ImageBitmap`](#imagebitmap)  
    1.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-16">bitmap
        data</a> to a copy of `image`'s
        <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-17">bitmap
        data</a>,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-6">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>.

    2.  Set the <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-8">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `imageBitmap`'s bitmap to the same value as the
        <a href="#concept-canvas-origin-clean"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-canvas-origin-clean-9">origin-clean</a>
        flag of `image`'s bitmap.

    3.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-8">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-8">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/webcodecs/#videoframe-interface"
    data-x-internal="videoframe"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:videoframe">VideoFrame</code></a>  
    1.  Set `imageBitmap`'s <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-18">bitmap
        data</a> to a copy of `image`'s visible pixel data,
        <a href="#cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting-7">cropped
        to the source rectangle with formatting</a>.

    2.  <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:queue-a-global-task-9">Queue a global
        task</a>, using the <a href="#bitmap-task-source"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:bitmap-task-source-9">bitmap task
        source</a>, to resolve `promise` with `imageBitmap`.

7.  Return `promise`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

When the steps above require that the user agent
<span id="cropped-to-the-source-rectangle-with-formatting"
class="dfn">crop bitmap data to the source rectangle with
formatting</span>, the user agent must run the following steps:

1.  Let `input` be the <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-19">bitmap
    data</a> being transformed.

2.  If `sx`, `sy`, `sw` and `sh` are specified, let `sourceRectangle` be
    a rectangle whose corners are the four points (`sx`, `sy`),
    (`sx`+`sw`, `sy`), (`sx`+`sw`, `sy`+`sh`), (`sx`, `sy`+`sh`).
    Otherwise, let `sourceRectangle` be a rectangle whose corners are
    the four points (0, 0), (width of `input`, 0), (width of `input`,
    height of `input`), (0, height of `input`).

    If either `sw` or `sh` are negative, then the top-left corner of
    this rectangle will be to the left or above the (`sx`, `sy`) point.

3.  Let `outputWidth` be determined as follows:

    If the [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) member of `options` is specified  
    the value of the
    [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) member of
    `options`

    If the [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) member of `options` is not specified, but the [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) member is specified  
    the width of `sourceRectangle`, times the value of the
    [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) member of
    `options`, divided by the height of `sourceRectangle`, rounded up to
    the nearest integer

    If neither [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) nor [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) are specified  
    the width of `sourceRectangle`

4.  Let `outputHeight` be determined as follows:

    If the [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) member of `options` is specified  
    the value of the
    [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) member of
    `options`

    If the [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) member of `options` is not specified, but the [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) member is specified  
    the height of `sourceRectangle`, times the value of the
    [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) member of
    `options`, divided by the width of `sourceRectangle`, rounded up to
    the nearest integer

    If neither [`resizeWidth`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizewidth) nor [`resizeHeight`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizeheight) are specified  
    the height of `sourceRectangle`

5.  Place `input` on an infinite
    <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#transparent-black"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:transparent-black-2"
    data-x-internal="transparent-black">transparent black</a> grid
    plane, positioned so that its top left corner is at the origin of
    the plane, with the `x`-coordinate increasing to the right, and the
    `y`-coordinate increasing down, and with each pixel in the `input`
    image data occupying a cell on the plane's grid.

6.  Let `output` be the rectangle on the plane denoted by
    `sourceRectangle`.

7.  Scale `output` to the size specified by `outputWidth` and
    `outputHeight`. The user agent should use the value of the
    <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-resizequality" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`resizeQuality`</span> option to guide the
    choice of scaling algorithm.

8.  If the value of the
    <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-imageorientation" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`imageOrientation`</span> member of `options`
    is "<span id="dom-imageorientation-flipy" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageOrientation" dfn-type="enum-value">`flipY`</span>",
    `output` must be flipped vertically, disregarding any image
    orientation metadata of the source (such as EXIF metadata), if any.
    [\[EXIF\]](#refsEXIF)

    If the value is "<span id="dom-imageorientation-from-image"
    class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageOrientation"
    dfn-type="enum-value">`from-image`</span>", no extra step is needed.

    There used to be a
    "<span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-imageorientation-none"
    class="dfn">`none`</span>" enum value. It was renamed to
    "[`from-image`](#dom-imageorientation-from-image)". In the future,
    "[`none`](#dom-imagebitmapoptions-imageorientation-none)" will be
    added back with a different meaning.

9.  If `image` is an [`img`](#the-img-element) element or a
    <a href="https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob"
    data-x-internal="blob"><code
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:blob-5">Blob</code></a> object, let
    `val` be the value of the
    <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-colorspaceconversion" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`colorSpaceConversion`</span> member of
    `options`, and then run these substeps:

    1.  If `val` is "<span id="dom-colorspaceconversion-default"
        class="dfn" dfn-for="ColorSpaceConversion"
        dfn-type="enum-value">`default`</span>", the color space
        conversion behavior is implementation-specific, and should be
        chosen according to the default color space that the
        implementation uses for drawing images onto the canvas.

    2.  If `val` is "<span id="dom-colorspaceconversion-none"
        class="dfn" dfn-for="ColorSpaceConversion"
        dfn-type="enum-value">`none`</span>", `output` must be decoded
        without performing any color space conversions. This means that
        the image decoding algorithm must ignore color profile metadata
        embedded in the source data as well as the display device color
        profile.

10. Let `val` be the value of
    <span id="dom-imagebitmapoptions-premultiplyalpha" class="dfn"
    dfn-for="ImageBitmapOptions"
    dfn-type="dict-member">`premultiplyAlpha`</span> member of
    `options`, and then run these substeps:

    1.  If `val` is "<span id="dom-premultiplyalpha-default" class="dfn"
        dfn-for="PremultiplyAlpha"
        dfn-type="enum-value">`default`</span>", the alpha
        premultiplication behavior is implementation-specific, and
        should be chosen according to implementation deems optimal for
        drawing images onto the canvas.

    2.  If `val` is "<span id="dom-premultiplyalpha-premultiply"
        class="dfn" dfn-for="PremultiplyAlpha"
        dfn-type="enum-value">`premultiply`</span>", the `output` that
        is not premultiplied by alpha must have its color components
        <a href="#convert-to-premultiplied"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:convert-to-premultiplied">multiplied by
        alpha</a> and that is premultiplied by alpha must be left
        untouched.

    3.  If `val` is "<span id="dom-premultiplyalpha-none" class="dfn"
        dfn-for="PremultiplyAlpha" dfn-type="enum-value">`none`</span>",
        the `output` that is not premultiplied by alpha must be left
        untouched and that is premultiplied by alpha must have its color
        components <a href="#convert-from-premultiplied"
        id="the-imagebitmap-interface:convert-from-premultiplied">divided by
        alpha</a>.

11. Return `output`.

</div>

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-imagebitmap-close" class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmap"
dfn-type="method">`close()`</span> method steps are:

1.  Set <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#detached"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:detached-3">[[Detached]]</a> internal
    slot value to true.

2.  Unset <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:concept-imagebitmap-bitmap-data-20">bitmap
    data</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-imagebitmap-width" class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmap"
dfn-type="attribute">`width`</span> getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#detached"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:detached-4">[[Detached]]</a> internal
    slot's value is true, then return 0.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    width, in <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:&#39;px&#39;-4"
    data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS pixels</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-imagebitmap-height" class="dfn" dfn-for="ImageBitmap"
dfn-type="attribute">`height`</span> getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#detached"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:detached-5">[[Detached]]</a> internal
    slot's value is true, then return 0.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:this-6" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    height, in <a href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px"
    id="the-imagebitmap-interface:&#39;px&#39;-5"
    data-x-internal="&#39;px&#39;">CSS pixels</a>.

</div>

The [`ResizeQuality`](#resizequality) enumeration is used to express a
preference for the interpolation quality to use when scaling images.

The "<span id="dom-resizequality-pixelated" class="dfn"
dfn-for="ResizeQuality" dfn-type="enum-value">`pixelated`</span>" value
indicates a preference for scaling the image to preserve the pixelation
of the original as much as possible, with minor smoothing as necessary
to avoid distorting the image when the target size is not a clean
multiple of the original.

To implement "[`pixelated`](#dom-resizequality-pixelated)", for each
axis independently, first determine the integer multiple of its natural
size that puts it closest to the target size and is greater than zero.
Scale it to this integer-multiple-size using nearest neighbor, then
scale it the rest of the way to the target size using bilinear
interpolation.

The "<span id="dom-resizequality-low" class="dfn"
dfn-for="ResizeQuality" dfn-type="enum-value">`low`</span>" value
indicates a preference for a low level of image interpolation quality.
Low-quality image interpolation may be more computationally efficient
than higher settings.

The "<span id="dom-resizequality-medium" class="dfn"
dfn-for="ResizeQuality" dfn-type="enum-value">`medium`</span>" value
indicates a preference for a medium level of image interpolation
quality.

The "<span id="dom-resizequality-high" class="dfn"
dfn-for="ResizeQuality" dfn-type="enum-value">`high`</span>" value
indicates a preference for a high level of image interpolation quality.
High-quality image interpolation may be more computationally expensive
than lower settings.

Bilinear scaling is an example of a relatively fast, lower-quality
image-smoothing algorithm. Bicubic or Lanczos scaling are examples of
image-scaling algorithms that produce higher-quality output. This
specification does not mandate that specific interpolation algorithms be
used, except for "[`pixelated`](#dom-resizequality-pixelated)" as
described above.

<div class="example">

Using this API, a sprite sheet can be precut and prepared:

``` js
var sprites = {};
function loadMySprites() {
  var image = new Image();
  image.src = 'mysprites.png';
  var resolver;
  var promise = new Promise(function (arg) { resolver = arg });
  image.onload = function () {
    resolver(Promise.all([
      createImageBitmap(image,  0,  0, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.person = image }),
      createImageBitmap(image, 40,  0, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.grass  = image }),
      createImageBitmap(image, 80,  0, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.tree   = image }),
      createImageBitmap(image,  0, 40, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.hut    = image }),
      createImageBitmap(image, 40, 40, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.apple  = image }),
      createImageBitmap(image, 80, 40, 40, 40).then(function (image) { sprites.snake  = image })
    ]));
  };
  return promise;
}

function runDemo() {
  var canvas = document.querySelector('canvas#demo');
  var context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  context.drawImage(sprites.tree, 30, 10);
  context.drawImage(sprites.snake, 70, 10);
}

loadMySprites().then(runDemo);
```

</div>

### <span class="secno">8.11</span> Animation frames<a href="#animation-frames" class="self-link"></a>

Some objects include the
[`AnimationFrameProvider`](#animationframeprovider) interface mixin.

``` idl
callback FrameRequestCallback = undefined (DOMHighResTimeStamp time);

interface mixin AnimationFrameProvider {
  unsigned long requestAnimationFrame(FrameRequestCallback callback);
  undefined cancelAnimationFrame(unsigned long handle);
};
Window includes AnimationFrameProvider;
DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope includes AnimationFrameProvider;
```

<div algorithm="">

Each [`AnimationFrameProvider`](#animationframeprovider) object also has
a <span id="concept-animationframeprovider-target-object"
class="dfn">target object</span> that stores the provider's internal
state. It is defined as follows:

If the [`AnimationFrameProvider`](#animationframeprovider) is a [`Window`](#window)  
The [`Window`](#window)'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
id="animation-frames:concept-document-window">associated
<code>Document</code></a>

If the [`AnimationFrameProvider`](#animationframeprovider) is a [`DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope`](#dedicatedworkerglobalscope)  
The [`DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope`](#dedicatedworkerglobalscope)

</div>

Each <a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-target-object"
id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-target-object">target
object</a> has a <span id="list-of-animation-frame-callbacks"
class="dfn">map of animation frame callbacks</span>, which is an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ordered-map"
id="animation-frames:ordered-map" data-x-internal="ordered-map">ordered
map</a> that must be initially empty, and an
<span id="animation-frame-callback-identifier" class="dfn">animation
frame callback identifier</span>, which is a number that must initially
be zero.

<div algorithm="">

An [`AnimationFrameProvider`](#animationframeprovider) `provider` is
considered <span id="concept-animationframeprovider-supported"
class="dfn">supported</span> if any of the following are true:

- `provider` is a [`Window`](#window).

- `provider`'s <a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
  id="animation-frames:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set">owner set</a>
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-contain"
  id="animation-frames:list-contains"
  data-x-internal="list-contains">contains</a> a [`Document`](#document)
  object.

- Any of the [`DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope`](#dedicatedworkerglobalscope)
  objects in `provider`'s <a href="#concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set"
  id="animation-frames:concept-WorkerGlobalScope-owner-set-2">owner
  set</a> are <a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-supported"
  id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-supported">supported</a>.

The <span id="dom-animationframeprovider-requestanimationframe"
class="dfn" dfn-for="AnimationFrameProvider"
dfn-type="method">`requestAnimationFrame(``callback``)`</span> method
steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="animation-frames:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a> is not
    <a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-supported"
    id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-supported-2">supported</a>,
    then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"
    id="animation-frames:notsupportederror"
    data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="animation-frames:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Let `target` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="animation-frames:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-target-object"
    id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-target-object-2">target
    object</a>.

3.  Increment `target`'s <a href="#animation-frame-callback-identifier"
    id="animation-frames:animation-frame-callback-identifier">animation
    frame callback identifier</a> by one, and let `handle` be the
    result.

4.  Let `callbacks` be `target`'s
    <a href="#list-of-animation-frame-callbacks"
    id="animation-frames:list-of-animation-frame-callbacks">map of animation
    frame callbacks</a>.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
    id="animation-frames:map-set" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
    `callbacks`\[`handle`\] to `callback`.

6.  Return `handle`.

</div>

    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror"

    data-x-internal="notsupportederror">"<code>NotSupportedError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="animation-frames:domexception-2">DOMException</code></a>.

2.  Let `callbacks` be <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="animation-frames:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-target-object"
    id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-target-object-3">target
    object</a>'s <a href="#list-of-animation-frame-callbacks"
    id="animation-frames:list-of-animation-frame-callbacks-2">map of
    animation frame callbacks</a>.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
    id="animation-frames:map-remove" data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a>
    `callbacks`\[`handle`\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="run-the-animation-frame-callbacks" class="dfn">run the
animation frame callbacks</span> for a
<a href="#concept-animationframeprovider-target-object"
id="animation-frames:concept-animationframeprovider-target-object-4">target
object</a> `target` with a timestamp `now`:

1.  Let `callbacks` be `target`'s
    <a href="#list-of-animation-frame-callbacks"
    id="animation-frames:list-of-animation-frame-callbacks-3">map of
    animation frame callbacks</a>.

2.  Let `callbackHandles` be the result of
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-getting-the-keys"
    id="animation-frames:map-get-the-keys"
    data-x-internal="map-get-the-keys">getting the keys</a> of
    `callbacks`.

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="animation-frames:list-iterate" data-x-internal="list-iterate">For
    each</a> `handle` in `callbackHandles`, if `handle`
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="animation-frames:map-exists" data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>
    in `callbacks`:

    1.  Let `callback` be `callbacks`\[`handle`\].

    2.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
        id="animation-frames:map-remove-2"
        data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a> `callbacks`\[`handle`\].

    3.  <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invoke-a-callback-function"
        id="animation-frames:es-invoking-callback-functions"
        data-x-internal="es-invoking-callback-functions">Invoke</a>
        `callback` with « `now` » and "`report`".

</div>

<div class="example">

Inside workers,
[`requestAnimationFrame()`](#dom-animationframeprovider-requestanimationframe)
can be used together with an [`OffscreenCanvas`](#offscreencanvas)
transferred from a [`canvas`](#the-canvas-element) element. First, in
the document, transfer control to the worker:

``` js
const offscreenCanvas = document.getElementById("c").transferControlToOffscreen();
worker.postMessage(offscreenCanvas, [offscreenCanvas]);
```

Then, in the worker, the following code will draw a rectangle moving
from left to right:

``` js
let ctx, pos = 0;
function draw(dt) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 100, 100);
  ctx.fillRect(pos, 0, 10, 10);
  pos += 10 * dt;
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

self.onmessage = function(ev) {
  const transferredCanvas = ev.data;
  ctx = transferredCanvas.getContext("2d");
  draw();
};
```

</div>

Messages in <a href="#server-sent-events"
id="the-messageevent-interface:server-sent-events">server-sent
events</a>, <a href="#web-messaging"
id="the-messageevent-interface:web-messaging">cross-document
messaging</a>, <a href="#channel-messaging"
id="the-messageevent-interface:channel-messaging">channel messaging</a>,
<a href="#broadcasting-to-other-browsing-contexts"
id="the-messageevent-interface:broadcasting-to-other-browsing-contexts">broadcast
channels</a>, and WebSockets use the [`MessageEvent`](#messageevent)
interface for their [`message`](#event-message) events:
[\[WEBSOCKETS\]](#refsWEBSOCKETS)

``` idl
[Exposed=(Window,Worker,AudioWorklet)]
interface MessageEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional MessageEventInit eventInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute any data;
  readonly attribute USVString origin;
  readonly attribute DOMString lastEventId;
  readonly attribute MessageEventSource? source;
  readonly attribute FrozenArray<MessagePort> ports;

  undefined initMessageEvent(DOMString type, optional boolean bubbles = false, optional boolean cancelable = false, optional any data = null, optional USVString origin = "", optional DOMString lastEventId = "", optional MessageEventSource? source = null, optional sequence<MessagePort> ports = []);
};

dictionary MessageEventInit : EventInit {
  any data = null;
  USVString origin = "";
  DOMString lastEventId = "";
  MessageEventSource? source = null;
  sequence<MessagePort> ports = [];
};

typedef (WindowProxy or MessagePort or ServiceWorker) MessageEventSource;
```

Each [`MessageEvent`](#messageevent) has an
<span id="concept-messageevent-origin" class="dfn"
dfn-for="MessageEvent" export="">origin</span> (an
<a href="#concept-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-origin">origin</a>, a string, or
null), initially null.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-messageevent-origin" class="dfn"
dfn-for="MessageEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`origin`</span> attribute
represents, in <a href="#server-sent-events"
id="the-messageevent-interface:server-sent-events-4">server-sent
events</a> and <a href="#web-messaging"
id="the-messageevent-interface:web-messaging-5">cross-document
messaging</a>, the
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-document-origin"
data-x-internal="concept-document-origin">origin</a> of the document
that sent the message (typically the scheme, hostname, and port of the
document, but not its path or
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-fragment"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-url-fragment"
data-x-internal="concept-url-fragment">fragment</a>).

The [`origin`](#dom-messageevent-origin) getter steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin">origin</a>
    is an <a href="#concept-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-origin-2">origin</a>, then
    return the <a href="#ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:ascii-serialisation-of-an-origin">serialization</a>
    of <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin-2">origin</a>.

2.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin-3">origin</a>
    is null, then return the empty string.

3.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
    id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin-4">origin</a>.

When the [`origin`](#dom-messageevent-origin) attribute is "initialized"
(during [`MessageEvent`](#messageevent)'s
<a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-constructor"
id="the-messageevent-interface:dom-event-constructor-2"
data-x-internal="dom-event-constructor">constructor</a>, for example),
the initialization value is placed into the object's
<a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin-5">origin</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

Objects implementing the [`MessageEvent`](#messageevent) interface's
<a href="#extract-an-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:extract-an-origin">extract an origin</a>
steps are to return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-messageevent-interface:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-messageevent-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-messageevent-origin-6">origin</a>
if it is an <a href="#concept-origin"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-origin-3">origin</a>; otherwise
null.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-messageevent-lasteventid" class="dfn"
dfn-for="MessageEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`lastEventId`</span>
attribute must return the value it was initialized to. It represents, in
<a href="#server-sent-events"
id="the-messageevent-interface:server-sent-events-5">server-sent
events</a>, the <a href="#concept-event-stream-last-event-id"
id="the-messageevent-interface:concept-event-stream-last-event-id-2">last
event ID string</a> of the event source.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-messageevent-source" class="dfn"
dfn-for="MessageEvent" dfn-type="attribute">`source`</span> attribute
must return the value it was initialized to. It represents, in
<a href="#web-messaging"
id="the-messageevent-interface:web-messaging-6">cross-document
messaging</a>, the [`WindowProxy`](#windowproxy) of the
<a href="#browsing-context"
id="the-messageevent-interface:browsing-context">browsing context</a> of
the [`Window`](#window) object from which the message came; and in the
[`connect`](#event-workerglobalscope-connect) events used by
<a href="#sharedworkerglobalscope"

### <span class="secno">9.2</span> <span class="dfn">Server-sent events</span><a href="#server-sent-events" class="self-link"></a>

<div class="mdn-anno wrapped">

[Server-sent_events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events "Traditionally, a web page has to send a request to the server to receive new data; that is, the page requests data from the server. With server-sent events, it's possible for a server to send new data to a web page at any time, by pushing messages to the web page. These incoming messages can be treated as Events + data inside the web page.")

#### <span class="secno">9.2.1</span> Introduction<a href="#server-sent-events-intro" class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

To enable servers to push data to web pages over HTTP or using dedicated
server-push protocols, this specification introduces the
[`EventSource`](#eventsource) interface.

Using this API consists of creating an [`EventSource`](#eventsource)
object and registering an event listener.

``` js
var source = new EventSource('updates.cgi');
source.onmessage = function (event) {
  alert(event.data);
};
```

On the server-side, the script ("`updates.cgi`" in this case) sends
messages in the following form, with the
[`text/event-stream`](#text/event-stream) MIME type:

    data: This is the first message.

    data: This is the second message, it
    data: has two lines.

    data: This is the third message.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Authors can separate events by using different event types. Here is a
stream that has two event types, "add" and "remove":

    event: add
    data: 73857293

    event: remove
    data: 2153

    event: add
    data: 113411

The script to handle such a stream would look like this (where
`addHandler` and `removeHandler` are functions that take one argument,
the event):

``` js
var source = new EventSource('updates.cgi');
source.addEventListener('add', addHandler, false);
source.addEventListener('remove', removeHandler, false);
```

The default event type is "message".

Event streams are always decoded as UTF-8. There is no way to specify
another character encoding.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Event stream requests can be redirected using HTTP 301 and 307 redirects
as with normal HTTP requests. Clients will reconnect if the connection
is closed; a client can be told to stop reconnecting using the HTTP 204
No Content response code.

Using this API rather than emulating it using
<a href="https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#xmlhttprequest"
data-x-internal="xmlhttprequest"><code
id="server-sent-events-intro:xmlhttprequest">XMLHttpRequest</code></a>
or an [`iframe`](#the-iframe-element) allows the user agent to make
better use of network resources in cases where the user agent
implementer and the network operator are able to coordinate in advance.
Amongst other benefits, this can result in significant savings in
battery life on portable devices. This is discussed further in the
section below on [connectionless push](#eventsource-push).

``` idl
[Exposed=(Window,Worker)]
interface EventSource : EventTarget {
  constructor(USVString url, optional EventSourceInit eventSourceInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute USVString url;
  readonly attribute boolean withCredentials;

  // ready state
  const unsigned short CONNECTING = 0;
  const unsigned short OPEN = 1;
  const unsigned short CLOSED = 2;
  readonly attribute unsigned short readyState;

  // networking
  attribute EventHandler onopen;
  attribute EventHandler onmessage;
  attribute EventHandler onerror;
  undefined close();
};

dictionary EventSourceInit {
  boolean withCredentials = false;
};
```

Each [`EventSource`](#eventsource) object has the following associated
with it:

- A <span id="concept-eventsource-url" class="dfn"
  dfn-for="EventSource">url</span> (a
  <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url"
  id="the-eventsource-interface:url-record"
  data-x-internal="url-record">URL record</a>). Set during construction.

- A <span id="concept-event-stream-request" class="dfn">request</span>.
  This must initially be null.

- A <span id="concept-event-stream-reconnection-time"
  class="dfn">reconnection time</span>, in milliseconds. This must
  initially be an
  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
  id="the-eventsource-interface:implementation-defined"
  data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
  value, probably in the region of a few seconds.

- A <span id="concept-event-stream-last-event-id" class="dfn">last event
  ID string</span>. This must initially be the empty string.

Apart from <a href="#concept-eventsource-url"
id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-eventsource-url">url</a> these are
not currently exposed on the [`EventSource`](#eventsource) object.

`source`` = new `<a href="#dom-eventsource"
id="dom-eventsource-dev"><code>EventSource</code></a>`( ``url`` [, { `<a href="#dom-eventsourceinit-withcredentials"
id="the-eventsource-interface:dom-eventsourceinit-withcredentials"><code>withCredentials</code></a>`: true } ])`

Returns the state of this [`EventSource`](#eventsource) object's
connection. It can have the values described below.

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-eventsource" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource"
dfn-type="constructor">`EventSource(``url``, ``eventSourceInitDict``)`</span>
constructor, when invoked, must run these steps:

1.  Let `ev` be a new [`EventSource`](#eventsource) object.

2.  Let `settings` be `ev`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:relevant-settings-object">relevant
    settings object</a>.

3.  Let `urlRecord` be the result of <a href="#encoding-parsing-a-url"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:encoding-parsing-a-url">encoding-parsing a
    URL</a> given `url`, relative to `settings`.

4.  If `urlRecord` is failure, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#syntaxerror"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:syntaxerror"
    data-x-internal="syntaxerror">"<code>SyntaxError</code>"</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException"
    data-x-internal="domexception"><code
    id="the-eventsource-interface:domexception">DOMException</code></a>.

5.  Set `ev`'s <a href="#concept-eventsource-url"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-eventsource-url-4">url</a> to
    `urlRecord`.

6.  Let `corsAttributeState` be <a href="#attr-crossorigin-anonymous"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:attr-crossorigin-anonymous">Anonymous</a>.

7.  If the value of `eventSourceInitDict`'s
    [`withCredentials`](#dom-eventsourceinit-withcredentials) member is
    true, then set `corsAttributeState` to
    <a href="#attr-crossorigin-use-credentials"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:attr-crossorigin-use-credentials">Use
    Credentials</a> and set `ev`'s
    [`withCredentials`](#dom-eventsource-withcredentials) attribute to
    true.

8.  Let `request` be the result of
    <a href="#create-a-potential-cors-request"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:create-a-potential-cors-request">creating
    a potential-CORS request</a> given `urlRecord`, the empty string,
    and `corsAttributeState`.

9.  Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-request-client"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-client">client</a> to `settings`.

10. User agents may
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-header-list-set"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-header-list-set"
    data-x-internal="concept-header-list-set">set</a>
    (\`<a href="https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc7231.html#header.accept"
    data-x-internal="http-accept"><code
    id="the-eventsource-interface:http-accept">Accept</code></a>\`,
    \`[`text/event-stream`](#text/event-stream)\`) in `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-header-list"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-request-header-list"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-header-list">header list</a>.

11. Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-cache-mode"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-request-cache-mode"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-cache-mode">cache mode</a> to
    "`no-store`".

12. Set `request`'s
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-request-initiator-type"
    data-x-internal="concept-request-initiator-type">initiator type</a>
    to "`other`".

13. Set `ev`'s <a href="#concept-event-stream-request"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-event-stream-request">request</a>
    to `request`.

14. Let `processEventSourceEndOfBody` given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-response"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `res` be the
    following step: if `res` is not a
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:network-error"
    data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>, then
    <a href="#reestablish-the-connection"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:reestablish-the-connection">reestablish
    the connection</a>.

15. <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-fetch-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-fetch">Fetch</a> `request`, with
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-processresponseendofbody"
    data-x-internal="processresponseendofbody">processResponseEndOfBody</a>*
    set to `processEventSourceEndOfBody` and
    *<a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#process-response"
    data-x-internal="processresponse">processResponse</a>* set to the
    following steps given
    <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response"
    id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-response-2"
    data-x-internal="concept-response">response</a> `res`:

    1.  If `res` is an
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-aborted-network-error"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:aborted-network-error"
        data-x-internal="aborted-network-error">aborted network error</a>,
        then <a href="#fail-the-connection"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:fail-the-connection">fail the
        connection</a>.

    2.  Otherwise, if `res` is a
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-network-error"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:network-error-2"
        data-x-internal="network-error">network error</a>, then
        <a href="#reestablish-the-connection"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:reestablish-the-connection-2">reestablish
        the connection</a>, unless the user agent knows that to be
        futile, in which case the user agent may
        <a href="#fail-the-connection"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:fail-the-connection-2">fail the
        connection</a>.

    3.  Otherwise, if `res`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-status"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-response-status"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-status">status</a> is not 200,
        or if `res`'s \`[`Content-Type`](#content-type)\` is not
        \`[`text/event-stream`](#text/event-stream)\`, then
        <a href="#fail-the-connection"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:fail-the-connection-3">fail the
        connection</a>.

    4.  Otherwise, <a href="#announce-the-connection"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:announce-the-connection">announce the
        connection</a> and [interpret](#event-stream-interpretation)
        `res`'s
        <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response-body"
        id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-response-body"
        data-x-internal="concept-response-body">body</a> line by line.

16. Return `ev`.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-eventsource-url" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource"
dfn-type="attribute">`url`</span> attribute's getter must return the
<a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-url-serializer"
data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a> of this
[`EventSource`](#eventsource) object's
<a href="#concept-eventsource-url"
id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-eventsource-url-5">url</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-eventsource-withcredentials" class="dfn"
dfn-for="EventSource" dfn-type="attribute">`withCredentials`</span>
attribute must return the value to which it was last initialized. When
the object is created, it must be initialized to false.

</div>

The <span id="dom-eventsource-readystate" class="dfn"
dfn-for="EventSource" dfn-type="attribute">`readyState`</span> attribute
represents the state of the connection. It can have the following
values:

<span id="dom-eventsource-connecting" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource" dfn-type="const">`CONNECTING`</span> (numeric value 0)  
The connection has not yet been established, or it was closed and the
user agent is reconnecting.

<span id="dom-eventsource-open" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource" dfn-type="const">`OPEN`</span> (numeric value 1)  
The user agent has an open connection and is dispatching events as it
receives them.

<span id="dom-eventsource-closed" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource" dfn-type="const">`CLOSED`</span> (numeric value 2)  
The connection is not open, and the user agent is not trying to
reconnect. Either there was a fatal error or the
[`close()`](#dom-eventsource-close) method was invoked.

<div algorithm="">

When the object is created, its
[`readyState`](#dom-eventsource-readystate) must be set to
[`CONNECTING`](#dom-eventsource-connecting) (0). The rules given below
for handling the connection define when the value changes.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-eventsource-close" class="dfn" dfn-for="EventSource"
dfn-type="method">`close()`</span> method must abort any instances of
the <a href="https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch"
id="the-eventsource-interface:concept-fetch-3"
data-x-internal="concept-fetch">fetch</a> algorithm started for this
[`EventSource`](#eventsource) object, and must set the
[`readyState`](#dom-eventsource-readystate) attribute to
[`CLOSED`](#dom-eventsource-closed).

</div>
