### <span class="secno">12.1</span> Introduction<a href="#introduction-15" class="self-link"></a>

*This section is non-normative.*

This specification introduces two related mechanisms, similar to HTTP
session cookies, for storing name-value pairs on the client side.
[\[COOKIES\]](#refsCOOKIES)

The first is designed for scenarios where the user is carrying out a
single transaction, but could be carrying out multiple transactions in
different windows at the same time.

Cookies don't really handle this case well. For example, a user could be
buying plane tickets in two different windows, using the same site. If
the site used cookies to keep track of which ticket the user was buying,
then as the user clicked from page to page in both windows, the ticket
currently being purchased would "leak" from one window to the other,
potentially causing the user to buy two tickets for the same flight
without noticing.

To address this, this specification introduces the
[`sessionStorage`](#dom-sessionstorage) getter. Sites can add data to
the session storage, and it will be accessible to any page from the same
site opened in that window.

<div class="example">

For example, a page could have a checkbox that the user ticks to
indicate that they want insurance:

``` html
<label>
 <input type="checkbox" onchange="sessionStorage.insurance = checked ? 'true' : ''">
  I want insurance on this trip.
</label>
```

A later page could then check, from script, whether the user had checked
the checkbox or not:

``` js
if (sessionStorage.insurance) { ... }
```

If the user had multiple windows opened on the site, each one would have
its own individual copy of the session storage object.

</div>

The second storage mechanism is designed for storage that spans multiple
windows, and lasts beyond the current session. In particular, web
applications might wish to store megabytes of user data, such as entire
user-authored documents or a user's mailbox, on the client side for
performance reasons.

Again, cookies do not handle this case well, because they are
transmitted with every request.

The [`localStorage`](#dom-localstorage) getter is used to access a
page's local storage area.

<div class="example">

The site at example.com can display a count of how many times the user
has loaded its page by putting the following at the bottom of its page:

``` html
<p>
  You have viewed this page
  <span id="count">an untold number of</span>
  time(s).
</p>
<script>
  if (!localStorage.pageLoadCount)
    localStorage.pageLoadCount = 0;
  localStorage.pageLoadCount = parseInt(localStorage.pageLoadCount) + 1;
  document.getElementById('count').textContent = localStorage.pageLoadCount;
</script>
```

</div>

Each site has its own separate storage area.

The [`localStorage`](#dom-localstorage) getter provides access to shared
state. This specification does not define the interaction with other
agent clusters in a multiprocess user agent, and authors are encouraged
to assume that there is no locking mechanism. A site could, for
instance, try to read the value of a key, increment its value, then
write it back out, using the new value as a unique identifier for the
session; if the site does this twice in two different browser windows at
the same time, it might end up using the same "unique" identifier for
both sessions, with potentially disastrous effects.

``` idl
[Exposed=Window]
interface Storage {
  readonly attribute unsigned long length;
  DOMString? key(unsigned long index);
  getter DOMString? getItem(DOMString key);
  setter undefined setItem(DOMString key, DOMString value);
  deleter undefined removeItem(DOMString key);
  undefined clear();
};
```

A [`Storage`](#storage-2) object has an associated:

<span id="concept-storage-map" class="dfn">map</span>  
A <a href="https://storage.spec.whatwg.org/#storage-proxy-map"
id="the-storage-interface:storage-proxy-map"
data-x-internal="storage-proxy-map">storage proxy map</a>.

<span id="concept-storage-type" class="dfn">type</span>  
"`local`" or "`session`".

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-storage-reorder" class="dfn">reorder</span> a
[`Storage`](#storage-2) object `storage`, reorder `storage`'s
<a href="#concept-storage-map"
id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map">map</a>'s
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-entry"
id="the-storage-interface:map-entry"
data-x-internal="map-entry">entries</a> in an
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined"
id="the-storage-interface:implementation-defined"
data-x-internal="implementation-defined">implementation-defined</a>
manner.

</div>

Unfortunate as it is, iteration order is not defined and can change upon
most mutations.

<div algorithm="">

To <span id="concept-storage-broadcast" class="dfn">broadcast</span> a
[`Storage`](#storage-2) object `storage`, given a `key`, `oldValue`, and
`newValue`, run these steps:

1.  Let `thisDocument` be `storage`'s <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-relevant-global">relevant global
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-document-window">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>.

2.  Let `url` be the
    <a href="https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-serializer"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-url-serializer"
    data-x-internal="concept-url-serializer">serialization</a> of
    `thisDocument`'s
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url"
    id="the-storage-interface:the-document&#39;s-address"
    data-x-internal="the-document&#39;s-address">URL</a>.

3.  Let `remoteStorages` be all [`Storage`](#storage-2) objects
    excluding `storage` whose:

    - <a href="#concept-storage-type"
      id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-type">type</a> is
      `storage`'s <a href="#concept-storage-type"
      id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-type-2">type</a>
    - <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
      id="the-storage-interface:relevant-settings-object">relevant settings
      object</a>'s <a href="#concept-origin"
      id="the-storage-interface:concept-origin">origin</a> is
      <a href="#same-origin" id="the-storage-interface:same-origin">same
      origin</a> with `storage`'s <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
      id="the-storage-interface:relevant-settings-object-2">relevant settings
      object</a>'s <a href="#concept-origin"
      id="the-storage-interface:concept-origin-2">origin</a>

    and, if <a href="#concept-storage-type"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-type-3">type</a> is
    "`session`", whose <a href="#relevant-settings-object"
    id="the-storage-interface:relevant-settings-object-3">relevant settings
    object</a>'s <a href="#concept-document-window"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-document-window-2">associated
    <code>Document</code></a>'s
    <a href="#node-navigable" id="the-storage-interface:node-navigable">node
    navigable</a>'s <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-storage-interface:nav-traversable">traversable navigable</a>
    is `thisDocument`'s <a href="#node-navigable"
    id="the-storage-interface:node-navigable-2">node navigable</a>'s
    <a href="#nav-traversable"
    id="the-storage-interface:nav-traversable-2">traversable navigable</a>.

4.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate"
    id="the-storage-interface:list-iterate"
    data-x-internal="list-iterate">For each</a> `remoteStorage` of
    `remoteStorages`: <a href="#queue-a-global-task"
    id="the-storage-interface:queue-a-global-task">queue a global task</a>
    on the <a href="#dom-manipulation-task-source"
    id="the-storage-interface:dom-manipulation-task-source">DOM manipulation
    task source</a> given `remoteStorage`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-relevant-global-2">relevant global
    object</a> to
    <a href="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-event-fire"
    data-x-internal="concept-event-fire">fire an event</a> named
    [`storage`](#event-storage) at `remoteStorage`'s
    <a href="#concept-relevant-global"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-relevant-global-3">relevant global
    object</a>, using [`StorageEvent`](#storageevent), with
    [`key`](#dom-storageevent-key) initialized to `key`,
    [`oldValue`](#dom-storageevent-oldvalue) initialized to `oldValue`,
    [`newValue`](#dom-storageevent-newvalue) initialized to `newValue`,
    [`url`](#dom-storageevent-url) initialized to `url`, and
    [`storageArea`](#dom-storageevent-storagearea) initialized to
    `remoteStorage`.

    The [`Document`](#document) object associated with the resulting
    <a href="#concept-task" id="the-storage-interface:concept-task">task</a>
    is not necessarily
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-storage-interface:fully-active">fully
    active</a>, but events fired on such objects are ignored by the
    <a href="#event-loop" id="the-storage-interface:event-loop">event
    loop</a> until the [`Document`](#document) becomes
    <a href="#fully-active" id="the-storage-interface:fully-active-2">fully
    active</a> again.

</div>

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-storage-length" class="dfn" dfn-for="Storage"
dfn-type="attribute">`length`</span> getter steps are to return
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
id="the-storage-interface:this" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
<a href="#concept-storage-map"
id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-2">map</a>'s
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-size"
id="the-storage-interface:map-size" data-x-internal="map-size">size</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-storage-key" class="dfn" dfn-for="Storage"
dfn-type="method">`key(``index``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  If `index` is greater than or equal to
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-2" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-3">map</a>'s
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-size"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-size-2"
    data-x-internal="map-size">size</a>, then return null.

2.  Let `keys` be the result of running
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-getting-the-keys"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-get-the-keys"
    data-x-internal="map-get-the-keys">get the keys</a> on
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-3" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-4">map</a>.

3.  Return `keys`\[`index`\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The
<a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names"
id="the-storage-interface:supported-property-names"
data-x-internal="supported-property-names">supported property names</a>
on a [`Storage`](#storage-2) object `storage` are the result of running
<a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-getting-the-keys"
id="the-storage-interface:map-get-the-keys-2"
data-x-internal="map-get-the-keys">get the keys</a> on `storage`'s
<a href="#concept-storage-map"
id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-5">map</a>.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-storage-getitem" class="dfn" dfn-for="Storage"
dfn-type="method">`getItem(``key``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-4" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-6">map</a>\[`key`\]
    does not <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-exists"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then return null.

2.  Return <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-5" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-7">map</a>\[`key`\].

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-storage-setitem" class="dfn" dfn-for="Storage"
dfn-type="method">`setItem(``key``, ``value``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  Let `oldValue` be null.

2.  Let `reorder` be true.

3.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-6" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-8">map</a>\[`key`\]
    <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-exists-2"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exists</a>:

    1.  Set `oldValue` to <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
        id="the-storage-interface:this-7" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
        <a href="#concept-storage-map"
        id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-9">map</a>\[`key`\].

    2.  If `oldValue` <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is"
        id="the-storage-interface:is" data-x-internal="is">is</a>
        `value`, then return.

    3.  Set `reorder` to false.

4.  If `value` cannot be stored, then throw a
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#quotaexceedederror"
    data-x-internal="quotaexceedederror"><code
    id="the-storage-interface:quotaexceedederror-2">QuotaExceededError</code></a>.

5.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-set"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-set" data-x-internal="map-set">Set</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-8" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-10">map</a>\[`key`\]
    to `value`.

6.  If `reorder` is true, then <a href="#concept-storage-reorder"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-reorder">reorder</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-9" data-x-internal="this">this</a>.

7.  <a href="#concept-storage-broadcast"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-broadcast">Broadcast</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-10" data-x-internal="this">this</a>
    with `key`, `oldValue`, and `value`.

</div>

<div algorithm="">

The <span id="dom-storage-removeitem" class="dfn" dfn-for="Storage"
dfn-type="method">`removeItem(``key``)`</span> method steps are:

1.  If <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-11" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-11">map</a>\[`key`\]
    does not <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-exists"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-exists-3"
    data-x-internal="map-exists">exist</a>, then return.

2.  Set `oldValue` to <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-12" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-12">map</a>\[`key`\].

3.  <a href="https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#map-remove"
    id="the-storage-interface:map-remove"
    data-x-internal="map-remove">Remove</a>
    <a href="https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this"
    id="the-storage-interface:this-13" data-x-internal="this">this</a>'s
    <a href="#concept-storage-map"
    id="the-storage-interface:concept-storage-map-13">map</a>\[`key`\].
